meanings_zh: n. 假期；度假 | n. 节日；法定假日 | v. 度假
definition_en: A period away from work or study for rest or travel. | An officially recognised day when many people do not work. | To spend time away from home for pleasure.
example1_en: We spent our holiday swimming and exploring quiet villages.
example1_zh: 我们假期里游泳，还探访了宁静的村庄。
example2_en: Flexible holiday arrangements can improve employee wellbeing while allowing businesses to maintain essential services throughout the year.
example2_zh: 灵活的休假安排可以改善员工福祉，同时让企业全年维持基本服务。
collocations: go on holiday｜去度假 ; public holiday｜法定假日 ; holiday destination｜度假目的地 ; holiday entitlement｜应享假期
tip_zh: 英式on holiday指度假；美式通常说on vacation。

meanings_zh: n. 前部；正面 | adj. 前面的；正面的 | n. 锋；天气锋面
definition_en: The forward part or outward-facing surface of something. | Located at or near the forward part of something. | A boundary where masses of warm and cold air meet.
example1_en: Please leave your muddy boots by the front door.
example1_zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在前门旁。
example2_en: Placing bicycle racks at the front of public buildings can encourage more residents to cycle.
example2_zh: 在公共建筑前部设置自行车架，可以鼓励更多居民骑车出行。
collocations: front door｜前门 ; at the front of｜在……的前部 ; in front of｜在……前面 ; cold front｜冷锋
tip_zh: in front of指外部前方；at the front of指前部。

meanings_zh: v. 讨论；商讨 | v. 论述
definition_en: to talk about something and exchange ideas | to examine a subject in speech or writing
example1_en: Let's discuss our holiday plans over dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚我们边吃晚饭边商量度假计划吧。
example2_en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
example2_zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。
collocations: discuss a problem｜讨论问题 ; discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事 ; discuss in detail｜详细讨论
tip_zh: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

meanings_zh: n. 零食；小吃 | v. 吃零食；吃点心
definition_en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals. | To eat small amounts of food between main meals.
example1_en: I packed an apple and some nuts for a snack.
example1_zh: 我装了一个苹果和一些坚果，留着当零食吃。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthier eating habits by offering nutritious snacks instead of foods high in sugar.
example2_zh: 学校可以提供营养丰富的点心来代替高糖食品，从而鼓励更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: a healthy snack｜健康零食 ; a light snack｜少量点心 ; snack on nuts｜吃坚果当零食
tip_zh: 动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。

meanings_zh: n. 球拍 | n. 喧闹声
definition_en: An object with strings used to hit balls in sports. | A loud, unpleasant noise.
example1_en: I left my tennis racket beside the court.
example1_zh: 我把网球拍落在球场边了。
example2_en: Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.
example2_zh: 提供球拍等基本器材，可以让更多孩子参与学校体育活动。
collocations: tennis racket｜网球拍 ; badminton racket｜羽毛球拍 ; make a racket｜制造喧闹声
tip_zh: 球拍也可拼作racquet；喧闹声只用racket。

meanings_zh: n. 夜晚；夜间
definition_en: The dark part of each day when the sun is down.
example1_en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。
example2_en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
example2_zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。
collocations: at night｜在夜间 ; last night｜昨晚 ; night shift｜夜班 ; a good night's sleep｜一夜好眠
tip_zh: 泛指夜间用at night；last night前不加介词。

meanings_zh: v. 问；询问 | v. 请求；要求 | v. 邀请
definition_en: say something to get information or an answer | say that you want someone to do or give something | invite someone to come somewhere or join an activity
example1_en: I asked the driver where the bus stopped.
example1_zh: 我问司机公交车在哪里停。
example2_en: Schools should ask students for feedback before introducing major changes to classroom teaching methods.
example2_zh: 学校在对课堂教学方法作出重大调整前，应征求学生的反馈。
collocations: ask a question｜提问 ; ask for help｜请求帮助 ; ask someone to do something｜请某人做某事 ; ask someone over｜邀请某人来家里
tip_zh: ask for接想要的东西；ask someone to do表示请某人做。

meanings_zh: n. 夹克；短外套 | n. 书籍护封；保护套
definition_en: A short coat covering the upper body and arms. | An outer cover that protects a book or object.
example1_en: I grabbed my jacket before stepping into the cold.
example1_zh: 我抓起外套，才走进寒冷的室外。
example2_en: A durable jacket made from recycled materials can offer consumers a more sustainable clothing choice.
example2_zh: 用再生材料制成的耐穿夹克可以为消费者提供更可持续的服装选择。
collocations: a waterproof jacket｜防水夹克 ; a suit jacket｜西装上衣 ; a book jacket｜书籍护封
tip_zh: jacket通常是短外套，不专指羽绒服。

meanings_zh: adj. 幸运的；侥幸的 | adj. 被认为带来好运的
definition_en: Having good things happen by chance. | Believed to bring good fortune.
example1_en: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
example1_zh: 我们很幸运，赶上了回家的末班公交车。
example2_en: Although some entrepreneurs benefit from lucky opportunities, long-term business success usually requires careful planning and consistent effort.
example2_zh: 虽然一些创业者受益于偶然的机遇，但企业的长期成功通常需要周密规划和持续努力。
collocations: lucky enough to｜有幸能够 ; a lucky escape｜侥幸脱险 ; a lucky charm｜幸运符 ; a lucky break｜好运带来的机会
tip_zh: “有幸做某事”用be lucky to do something。

meanings_zh: n. 牛仔裤
definition_en: Trousers made from strong cotton cloth, usually denim.
example1_en: These jeans are still wet from the wash.
example1_zh: 这条牛仔裤洗后还没干。
example2_en: Allowing employees to wear jeans may create a more relaxed workplace without necessarily reducing professional standards.
example2_zh: 允许员工穿牛仔裤可能营造更轻松的工作环境，而不一定降低职业标准。
collocations: a pair of jeans｜一条牛仔裤 ; blue jeans｜蓝色牛仔裤 ; faded jeans｜褪色牛仔裤
tip_zh: jeans用复数；一条用a pair of jeans。

meanings_zh: n. 笔友
definition_en: a friend you write letters to but may never meet
example1_en: I have a penfriend in Australia.
example1_zh: 我有一个澳大利亚的笔友。
example2_en: She wrote a letter to her penfriend in English.
example2_zh: 她用英语给笔友写了一封信。
tip_zh: penfriend 是英式说法，pen pal 是美式说法。

meanings_zh: n. 模型；模式 | n. 模范；榜样 | n. 模特儿
definition_en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised | someone or something that provides a good example to follow | a person who displays clothes or poses for artists
example1_en: He built a model of a bridge from cardboard.
example1_zh: 他用硬纸板做了一座桥的模型。
example2_en: Researchers use a computer model to predict how rising temperatures may affect regional water supplies.
example2_zh: 研究人员利用计算机模型预测气温上升可能如何影响区域供水。
collocations: scale model｜比例模型 ; computer model｜计算机模型 ; role model｜榜样 ; fashion model｜时装模特
tip_zh: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。

meanings_zh: n. 邮件；邮政 | v. 邮寄
definition_en: letters and parcels sent or delivered through a postal service | to send a letter or parcel through a postal service
example1_en: The mail arrived just as we finished breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们刚吃完早饭，邮件就到了。
example2_en: Although digital communication is widespread, many rural residents still depend on mail for essential documents.
example2_zh: 尽管数字通信已很普及，许多农村居民仍依赖邮政收取重要文件。
collocations: send by mail｜通过邮政寄送 ; check the mail｜查看邮件 ; mail a parcel｜邮寄包裹
tip_zh: mail作“邮件”通常不可数；英式日常也常用post。

meanings_zh: n. 火；火灾 | v. 解雇；开除 | v. 开枪；发射
definition_en: Burning that produces heat and light, sometimes causing damage. | To make someone leave their job. | To shoot a gun or launch a weapon.
example1_en: We warmed our hands by the fire after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们在炉火旁暖手。
example2_en: Regular safety inspections can reduce the risk of fire in older residential buildings with outdated electrical systems.
example2_zh: 定期安全检查可以降低电气系统老化的旧住宅楼发生火灾的风险。
collocations: catch fire｜着火 ; put out a fire｜灭火 ; fire safety｜消防安全 ; fire an employee｜解雇员工
tip_zh: catch fire指开始着火；be on fire指正在燃烧。

meanings_zh: n. 姐姐；妹妹 | n. 修女
definition_en: a female sibling | a woman who belongs to a religious community
example1_en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
example1_zh: 我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。
example2_en: Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.
example2_zh: 经常与兄弟姐妹分担责任的孩子，可能会在家中培养出更强的合作能力。
collocations: an older sister｜姐姐 ; a younger sister｜妹妹 ; a twin sister｜双胞胎姐妹 ; a sister company｜姐妹公司
tip_zh: sister不分姐姐妹妹；需用older或younger说明年龄关系。

meanings_zh: n. 连裤袜；紧身裤袜
definition_en: thin clothes covering the legs worn by women or children
example1_en: She wore red tights with her dress.
example1_zh: 她穿着红色连裤袜配连衣裙。
example2_en: A pair of tights is in the laundry basket.
example2_zh: 洗衣篮里有一条连裤袜。
collocations: a pair of tights｜一条连裤袜
tip_zh: tights 常用复数；一条说 a pair of tights。

meanings_zh: v. 发明；创造 | v. 编造；虚构
definition_en: To design or make something that did not exist before. | To make up a story or excuse that is untrue.
example1_en: My sister invented a clever tool for picking apples.
example1_zh: 我姐姐发明了一种巧妙的摘苹果工具。
example2_en: Engineers must invent affordable technologies that help rural communities gain access to clean drinking water.
example2_zh: 工程师必须发明价格可负担的技术，帮助农村社区获得清洁饮用水。
collocations: invent a device｜发明装置 ; invent an excuse｜编造借口 ; invent a story｜虚构故事
tip_zh: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。

meanings_zh: v. 发现
definition_en: to find something or learn something previously unknown
example1_en: We discovered a quiet beach behind the cliffs.
example1_zh: 我们在悬崖后面发现了一片安静的海滩。
example2_en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
example2_zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。
collocations: discover a cure｜发现疗法 ; discover a new species｜发现新物种 ; discover the truth｜发现真相
tip_zh: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

meanings_zh: adv. 也；还
definition_en: also; in addition
example1_en: She speaks French, and she speaks German as well.
example1_zh: 她会说法语，也会说德语。
example2_en: I'll have a coffee, and a cake as well, please.
example2_zh: 请给我一杯咖啡，再来一块蛋糕。
tip_zh: as well 放在句末，too 常放句末，also 常放句中。

meanings_zh: v. 去；走；进行
definition_en: to move or travel somewhere
example1_en: We go to school by bike.
example1_zh: 我们骑自行车上学。
example2_en: Let's go to the park this afternoon.
example2_zh: 今天下午我们去公园吧。
collocations: go home｜回家 ; go shopping｜去购物
tip_zh: go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone/been。

meanings_zh: n. 摩托车
definition_en: a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine
example1_en: He rides his motorbike to work every day.
example1_zh: 他每天骑摩托车上班。
example2_en: The motorbike stopped in front of the café.
example2_zh: 摩托车停在咖啡馆前面。
tip_zh: motorbike 是英式口语说法；motorcycle 更正式。

meanings_zh: n. 冬季；冬天 | v. 过冬；越冬
definition_en: The coldest season, between autumn and spring. | To spend the winter in a particular place.
example1_en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
example1_zh: 冬天寒风来袭时，我们会穿上厚外套。
example2_en: Warmer winters can disrupt natural ecosystems by changing the seasonal behaviour of plants and migrating animals.
example2_zh: 更暖的冬季可能改变植物和迁徙动物的季节性行为，从而扰乱自然生态系统。
collocations: in winter｜在冬季 ; a harsh winter｜严冬 ; winter months｜冬季的几个月 ; winter clothing｜冬装
tip_zh: 泛指在冬天用in winter；具体某年可用in the winter of…。

meanings_zh: n. 医生 | n. 博士 | v. 篡改；伪造
definition_en: a trained professional who diagnoses and treats illnesses | a person who has earned the highest university degree | to change something dishonestly to deceive people
example1_en: The doctor listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
example1_zh: 我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。
example2_en: Governments should train more doctors to ensure that rural communities have reliable access to healthcare.
example2_zh: 政府应培养更多医生，确保农村社区能够稳定获得医疗服务。
collocations: see a doctor｜看医生 ; family doctor｜家庭医生 ; a doctor of philosophy｜哲学博士 ; doctor the evidence｜篡改证据
tip_zh: 看医生常说see a doctor；动词doctor可指篡改。

meanings_zh: n. 天鹅
definition_en: A large waterbird with a long neck, usually white
example1_en: A white swan glided silently across the lake.
example1_zh: 一只白天鹅悄无声息地游过湖面。
example2_en: Protecting wetland habitats benefits swan populations while also preserving the wider ecosystems on which many other species depend.
example2_zh: 保护湿地栖息地有益于天鹅种群，同时也能保护许多其他物种赖以生存的更广泛生态系统。
collocations: a pair of swans｜一对天鹅 ; a swan's nest｜天鹅的巢 ; black swan｜黑天鹅
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数swans；幼天鹅称cygnet。

meanings_zh: n. 比萨饼
definition_en: Flat bread baked with toppings such as tomato sauce and cheese.
example1_en: We shared a mushroom pizza after the film.
example1_zh: 电影结束后，我们分着吃了一张蘑菇比萨。
example2_en: Although pizza is convenient, its nutritional value depends largely on the ingredients and portion size.
example2_zh: 虽然比萨方便食用，但其营养价值主要取决于食材和食用份量。
collocations: a slice of pizza｜一片比萨 ; pizza dough｜比萨面团 ; order a pizza｜点一张比萨
tip_zh: 整张可数：a pizza；泛指食物可说some pizza。

meanings_zh: adj. 煮熟的；水煮的
definition_en: cooked in very hot water
example1_en: I like boiled eggs for breakfast.
example1_zh: 早餐我喜欢吃煮鸡蛋。
example2_en: She made boiled potatoes for dinner.
example2_zh: 她晚饭做了煮土豆。
collocations: boiled egg｜煮鸡蛋
tip_zh: boiled 指用开水煮过的；fried 是煎的，roasted 是烤的。

meanings_zh: n. 体育场
definition_en: a large sports venue with seating around a central area
example1_en: Fans filled the stadium before the football match began.
example1_zh: 足球比赛开始前，球迷们就坐满了体育场。
example2_en: Building a new stadium may attract visitors, but its long-term maintenance costs require careful consideration.
example2_zh: 修建新体育场或许能吸引游客，但其长期维护费用需要仔细考虑。
collocations: football stadium｜足球场 ; packed stadium｜座无虚席的体育场 ; stadium capacity｜体育场容纳人数
tip_zh: 复数可用stadiums或stadia，前者更常见。

meanings_zh: n. 小学生；中学生 | n. 瞳孔
definition_en: A child who attends school. | The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.
example1_en: Each pupil brought a leaf to the science lesson.
example1_zh: 每个学生都带了一片树叶来上科学课。
example2_en: Smaller classes may allow teachers to give each pupil more individual support and useful feedback.
example2_zh: 小班教学可能让教师为每个学生提供更多个别指导和有用的反馈。
collocations: primary school pupil｜小学生 ; former pupil｜校友；昔日学生 ; dilated pupils｜扩大的瞳孔
tip_zh: 英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

meanings_zh: adj. 迷路的；丢失的 | adj. 困惑的；不知所措的 | v. 丢失；失去；输掉
definition_en: Unable to find the way, or unable to be found. | Unable to understand something or decide what to do. | Past tense and past participle of lose.
example1_en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
example1_zh: 我们在老城区步行时迷路了。
example2_en: Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
example2_zh: 缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。
collocations: get lost｜迷路 ; lost property｜失物 ; feel lost｜感到迷茫 ; lost in thought｜陷入沉思
tip_zh: get lost可指迷路；单独用作命令语气粗鲁。

meanings_zh: n. 一双；一对；一副 | n. 两人；一组两人 | v. 配对；使成对
definition_en: Two matching things, or one object with two connected parts. | Two people who are together or work together. | To put people or things together in groups of two.
example1_en: I left my favourite pair of gloves on the bus.
example1_zh: 我把最喜欢的那双手套落在公交车上了。
example2_en: Teachers often pair students with different strengths to encourage cooperation and improve learning outcomes.
example2_zh: 教师常将各有所长的学生配成一组，以鼓励合作并改善学习成效。
collocations: a pair of shoes｜一双鞋 ; a pair of scissors｜一把剪刀 ; work in pairs｜两人一组工作 ; pair up with someone｜与某人结成一组
tip_zh: a pair of shoes作主语时，谓语用单数。

meanings_zh: n. 学生
definition_en: a person who studies at a school, college, or university
example1_en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
example1_zh: 一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。
example2_en: Universities should ensure that every student can access affordable housing and appropriate support throughout their studies.
example2_zh: 大学应确保每位学生在整个求学期间都能获得负担得起的住宿及适当支持。
collocations: university student｜大学生 ; international student｜国际学生 ; student loan｜学生贷款 ; student accommodation｜学生住宿
tip_zh: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

meanings_zh: pron. 你自己；您自己 | pron. 你亲自；你本人
definition_en: Used when you are both the subject and object. | Used to emphasize the person being addressed.
example1_en: Be careful not to cut yourself with that knife.
example1_zh: 用那把刀时要小心，别割伤自己。
example2_en: Preparing meals yourself can reduce household spending while giving you greater control over nutritional quality.
example2_zh: 亲自做饭可以减少家庭开支，同时让你更好地把控营养质量。
collocations: by yourself｜独自；独立地 ; help yourself to｜随意取用 ; enjoy yourself｜玩得开心 ; be yourself｜做你自己
tip_zh: 对应单数you；对多人说“你们自己”用yourselves。

meanings_zh: n. 价格；价钱 | n. 代价 | v. 给……定价
definition_en: The amount of money needed to buy something. | Something unpleasant experienced to achieve or obtain something else. | To decide how much money something will cost.
example1_en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
example1_zh: 这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。
example2_en: Rising food prices place considerable pressure on families with limited incomes, particularly in urban areas.
example2_zh: 食品价格上涨给低收入家庭带来很大压力，在城市地区尤其如此。
collocations: high prices｜高价 ; pay the price｜付出代价 ; price rise｜价格上涨 ; reasonably priced｜定价合理的
tip_zh: 价格高低用high或low；物品贵便宜用expensive或cheap。

meanings_zh: n. 法院；法庭 | n. 球场 | v. 设法获得；招致
definition_en: a place or institution where legal cases are heard | an area for playing sports such as tennis or basketball | to seek something desirable or risk something harmful
example1_en: She will appear in court on Monday morning.
example1_zh: 她将于星期一上午出庭。
example2_en: Local councils should provide public tennis courts so that more residents can exercise regularly.
example2_zh: 地方议会应提供公共网球场，让更多居民能够经常锻炼。
collocations: go to court｜上法庭 ; tennis court｜网球场 ; court disaster｜招致灾难
tip_zh: in court指在法庭上；on court指在球场上。

meanings_zh: adj. 最后的；最近过去的 | v. 持续；够用；耐用 | adv. 最后；上次
definition_en: Final in a sequence, or most recent before the present. | To continue for a period or remain usable. | After everyone else, or on the most recent previous occasion.
example1_en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
example1_zh: 我在午夜前刚好赶上了回家的末班车。
example2_en: Products that last longer can reduce household spending and limit the amount of waste sent to landfill.
example2_zh: 更耐用的产品可以减少家庭开支，并减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。
collocations: last week｜上周 ; last chance｜最后的机会 ; last for years｜持续多年 ; last a lifetime｜用一辈子
tip_zh: last week指上周；the last week可指最后一周。

meanings_zh: adv. 无疑；肯定 | adv. 当然可以
definition_en: Used to express that something is definitely true. | Used to agree politely to a request.
example1_en: This warm coat will certainly keep you comfortable outside.
example1_zh: 这件暖和的大衣肯定能让你在外面也舒舒服服的。
example2_en: Improved public transport would certainly benefit commuters, although its success would depend on reliable services and affordable fares.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通无疑会惠及通勤者，但成效取决于服务是否可靠、票价是否合理。
collocations: almost certainly｜几乎肯定 ; certainly not｜当然不 ; will certainly help｜肯定会有帮助
tip_zh: 常置于实义动词前、be后；也可单独礼貌回应请求。

meanings_zh: adj. 贫穷的 | adj. 差的；不足的 | adj. 可怜的
definition_en: Having very little money or few possessions | Of low quality or lacking something necessary | Deserving sympathy because of an unfortunate situation
example1_en: The poor family could barely afford fresh vegetables.
example1_zh: 这户贫困家庭几乎买不起新鲜蔬菜。
example2_en: Poor public transport can limit employment opportunities for people living far from major urban centres.
example2_zh: 公共交通不便可能限制远离主要城市中心的居民的就业机会。
collocations: poor health｜健康状况不佳 ; poor quality｜质量差 ; poor in nutrients｜营养匮乏 ; poor families｜贫困家庭
tip_zh: poor at表示不擅长；poor in表示缺乏。

meanings_zh: mv. 必须；不得不
definition_en: used to say something is necessary
example1_en: I have to get up early tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我明天必须早起。
example2_en: Do we have to wear a uniform at school?
example2_zh: 我们在学校必须穿校服吗？
tip_zh: have to 表客观需要，must 表主观必须；否定 don't have to 是“不必”。

meanings_zh: n. 健身房；体育馆 | n. 体育课；体育活动
definition_en: A room or building equipped for exercise and sport. | Physical exercise taught or practised at school.
example1_en: I usually go to the gym before work.
example1_zh: 我通常在上班前去健身房。
example2_en: Affordable gym membership can encourage regular exercise, although safe outdoor spaces are equally important for public health.
example2_zh: 价格实惠的健身房会员服务能鼓励定期锻炼，不过安全的户外空间对公共健康同样重要。
collocations: go to the gym｜去健身房 ; gym membership｜健身房会员资格 ; gym equipment｜健身器材 ; gym class｜体育课
tip_zh: gym是gymnasium的简称；去健身房用go to the gym。

meanings_zh: n. 多样化；变化 | n. 种类；品种
definition_en: the presence of different things rather than only one kind | a particular type of something
example1_en: We add variety to lunch with different colourful vegetables.
example1_zh: 我们用各种色彩鲜艳的蔬菜让午餐更丰富。
example2_en: Schools should offer a wide variety of activities to support students with different interests.
example2_zh: 学校应提供丰富多样的活动，以支持兴趣各异的学生。
collocations: a wide variety of｜各种各样的 ; add variety to｜使……更加多样 ; a variety of reasons｜多种原因 ; a new variety｜新品种
tip_zh: 多样性为不可数义；表示一种品种时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 危险；风险 | n. 危险因素；威胁
definition_en: The possibility that someone or something will be harmed. | Someone or something that may cause harm.
example1_en: Keep away from the edge; there's a danger of falling.
example1_zh: 离边缘远一点，有掉下去的危险。
example2_en: Poorly maintained roads pose a serious danger to cyclists, particularly in areas without dedicated cycling lanes.
example2_zh: 维护不善的道路对骑车人构成严重威胁，尤其是在没有专用自行车道的地区。
collocations: in danger｜处于危险中 ; out of danger｜脱离危险 ; pose a danger to｜对……构成威胁 ; danger of extinction｜灭绝的危险
tip_zh: in danger指处于危险中；dangerous指会带来危险。

meanings_zh: adj. 室内的
definition_en: Located, used, or happening inside a building.
example1_en: Our hotel has an indoor pool beside the gym.
example1_zh: 我们酒店的健身房旁边有一个室内游泳池。
example2_en: Indoor sports facilities allow children to remain physically active regardless of weather conditions throughout the year.
example2_zh: 室内运动设施让孩子们全年都能保持运动，不受天气条件影响。
collocations: indoor swimming pool｜室内游泳池 ; indoor activities｜室内活动 ; indoor air quality｜室内空气质量
tip_zh: indoor作定语；indoors作副词，如stay indoors。

meanings_zh: n. 阅读 | n. 读数 | n. 朗读；朗诵会
definition_en: The activity of understanding written words. | A measurement shown by an instrument. | An occasion when someone reads a written work aloud.
example1_en: Reading before bed helps me relax after a busy day.
example1_zh: 忙碌一天后，睡前阅读能让我放松下来。
example2_en: Regular reading exposes students to varied vocabulary and helps them develop stronger critical thinking skills.
example2_zh: 经常阅读能让学生接触丰富的词汇，并帮助他们提高批判性思维能力。
collocations: reading comprehension｜阅读理解 ; reading habits｜阅读习惯 ; take a reading｜测取读数 ; poetry reading｜诗歌朗诵会
tip_zh: 表示阅读活动通常不可数；表示读数或朗诵会可数。

meanings_zh: n. 吉他
definition_en: A stringed musical instrument played by plucking or strumming.
example1_en: My sister plays the guitar beside the window every evening.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在窗边弹吉他。
example2_en: Learning to play the guitar can help students develop patience, coordination, and confidence through regular practice.
example2_zh: 学习弹吉他能帮助学生通过规律练习培养耐心、协调能力和自信。
collocations: play the guitar｜弹吉他 ; acoustic guitar｜原声吉他 ; electric guitar｜电吉他 ; guitar strings｜吉他弦
tip_zh: 表示弹吉他，通常说play the guitar。

meanings_zh: adj. 电的；电动的 | adj. 令人激动的
definition_en: Using, producing, or relating to electricity. | Full of excitement and energy.
example1_en: Our electric kettle boils water in two minutes.
example1_zh: 我们的电水壶两分钟就能把水烧开。
example2_en: Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.
example2_zh: 电动公交车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源供电时。
collocations: electric car｜电动汽车 ; electric current｜电流 ; electric shock｜电击 ; electric atmosphere｜热烈的气氛
tip_zh: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

meanings_zh: n. 太阳 | n. 阳光 | v. 晒太阳
definition_en: The star that gives Earth light and heat. | The light and warmth coming from the sun. | Sit or lie where sunlight warms your body.
example1_en: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
example1_zh: 我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。
example2_en: Energy from the sun can provide a renewable alternative to fossil fuels in regions with suitable conditions.
example2_zh: 在条件适宜的地区，太阳能可以成为化石燃料的可再生替代能源。
collocations: the rising sun｜初升的太阳 ; in the sun｜在阳光下 ; direct sun｜直射阳光 ; sun yourself｜晒太阳
tip_zh: 指太阳通常用the sun；in the sun表示在阳光下。

meanings_zh: n. 甲虫
definition_en: An insect with hard outer wings covering its flying wings.
example1_en: A shiny beetle crawled slowly across the garden path.
example1_zh: 一只发亮的甲虫缓缓爬过花园小径。
example2_en: Some beetle species help maintain healthy forests by breaking down dead wood and recycling nutrients.
example2_zh: 一些甲虫通过分解枯木和循环利用养分，帮助维持森林健康。
collocations: dung beetle｜蜣螂 ; stag beetle｜锹甲 ; beetle species｜甲虫种类
tip_zh: 指甲虫；不要用它表示“近视的人”。

meanings_zh: adj. 生气的；愤怒的
definition_en: feeling strong displeasure about something unfair, wrong, or unpleasant
example1_en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
example1_zh: 有人弄坏了他的自行车，他感到很生气。
example2_en: Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 市政委员会决定关闭社区唯一的图书馆，居民们对此感到愤怒。
collocations: angry with someone｜生某人的气 ; angry about something｜因某事生气 ; get angry｜生气
tip_zh: 生某人的气用angry with；因某事生气用about。

meanings_zh: n. 飞机
definition_en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.
example1_en: The aeroplane flew low over the sandy beach.
example1_zh: 飞机低空飞过沙滩上方。
example2_en: Travelling by aeroplane connects distant communities, but its environmental impact has encouraged debate about alternative transport.
example2_zh: 乘飞机出行连接了相隔遥远的社区，但其环境影响引发了对替代交通方式的讨论。
collocations: board an aeroplane｜登机 ; fly an aeroplane｜驾驶飞机 ; aeroplane engine｜飞机发动机
tip_zh: 英式用aeroplane，美式用airplane；口语常用plane。

meanings_zh: n. 春天；春季 | n. 弹簧；发条 | n. 泉；泉水
definition_en: the season between winter and summer | a coiled piece of metal that stretches or compresses | a place where water flows naturally out of the ground
example1_en: We plant flowers in the garden every spring.
example1_zh: 我们每年春天都在花园里种花。
example2_en: Warmer temperatures in spring can cause plants to flower earlier, affecting insects that depend on them.
example2_zh: 春季气温升高会使植物提前开花，影响依赖这些植物的昆虫。
collocations: in spring｜在春天 ; early spring｜早春 ; a natural spring｜天然泉 ; a coil spring｜螺旋弹簧
tip_zh: 季节前通常用in；泉和弹簧义均为可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 乐队 | n. 带；环；条带 | n. 范围；频段；等级
definition_en: A group of musicians who perform together. | A narrow strip or ring of material or colour. | A range of frequencies, values, or levels within a system.
example1_en: My sister plays the drums in a local band.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在当地一支乐队里打鼓。
example2_en: Live bands at community festivals can attract visitors and create opportunities for local businesses.
example2_zh: 社区节庆中的现场乐队演出能吸引游客，并为当地商家创造机会。
collocations: a rock band｜摇滚乐队 ; a rubber band｜橡皮筋 ; a frequency band｜频段 ; an income band｜收入区间
tip_zh: IELTS中的band指成绩等级，不是乐队。

meanings_zh: n. 东方；东部 | adj. 东部的；向东的 | adv. 向东；在东方
definition_en: the direction where the sun rises, opposite west | in the east or facing towards it | towards or in the east
example1_en: Our kitchen window faces east and catches the morning sun.
example1_zh: 我们厨房的窗户朝东，能照到早晨的阳光。
example2_en: Investment in rail connections could improve access to employment for communities in the east of the country.
example2_zh: 投资铁路交通可以让该国东部地区的居民更容易获得就业机会。
collocations: in the east｜在东部 ; east coast｜东海岸 ; head east｜向东行进 ; east of｜在……以东
tip_zh: in the east of指内部东部；east of指在其以东。

meanings_zh: n. 香蕉
definition_en: A long curved fruit with soft flesh and usually yellow skin
example1_en: He peeled a banana and sliced it over his cereal.
example1_zh: 他剥了一根香蕉，切成片放在麦片上。
example2_en: Banana farming provides an important source of income for many families in tropical regions.
example2_zh: 香蕉种植为热带地区的许多家庭提供了重要收入来源。
collocations: ripe banana｜熟香蕉 ; banana peel｜香蕉皮 ; a bunch of bananas｜一串香蕉
tip_zh: 可数名词：一根香蕉是a banana。

meanings_zh: n. 照相机；摄像机
definition_en: A device used to take photographs or record moving images.
example1_en: She raised her camera to photograph the sleeping cat.
example1_zh: 她举起相机，给熟睡的猫拍照。
example2_en: Installing a camera at each entrance may improve security, but residents have raised concerns about privacy.
example2_zh: 在每个入口安装摄像头或许能提高安全性，但居民对隐私问题表示担忧。
collocations: a digital camera｜数码相机 ; a security camera｜监控摄像头 ; a camera lens｜相机镜头 ; on camera｜在镜头前
tip_zh: camera可指照相机或摄像机，具体看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 菜单 | n. 计算机菜单；选项列表
definition_en: A list of food and drinks available to order | A list of choices available on a computer or device
example1_en: There are several vegetarian dishes on the menu.
example1_zh: 菜单上有几道素菜。
example2_en: Displaying nutritional information on a restaurant menu may help customers make healthier choices when eating out.
example2_zh: 在餐厅菜单上标注营养信息，可能有助于顾客外出就餐时做出更健康的选择。
collocations: on the menu｜在菜单上 ; set menu｜套餐菜单 ; drop-down menu｜下拉菜单
tip_zh: 说菜品在菜单上，用on the menu，不用in。

meanings_zh: det. 几个；一些
definition_en: a small number of things or people
example1_en: I have a few questions to ask you.
example1_zh: 我有几个问题想问你。
example2_en: She invited a few friends to her birthday party.
example2_zh: 她邀请了几个朋友来参加她的生日聚会。
collocations: a few days｜几天
tip_zh: a few 表示“有一些”，带肯定意味；few 表示“几乎没有”。

meanings_zh: n. 女孩；姑娘
definition_en: A female child or young woman
example1_en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
example1_zh: 那个女孩小心翼翼地把小猫抱进屋里。
example2_en: Ensuring that every girl can attend school is essential for reducing inequality and supporting economic development.
example2_zh: 确保每个女孩都能上学，对于减少不平等和促进经济发展至关重要。
collocations: young girl｜小女孩 ; teenage girl｜十几岁的女孩 ; school girl｜女学生
tip_zh: 成年女性正式称woman；girl不直接表示女朋友。

meanings_zh: n. 回答；答案；解决办法 | v. 回答；答复；接听
definition_en: a reply, correct result, or solution to a problem | to reply to someone or respond to a call
example1_en: I asked the price, but nobody gave an answer.
example1_zh: 我问了价格，却没有人回答。
example2_en: Improving public transport may provide an answer to traffic congestion in rapidly growing urban areas.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通或许能为快速发展的城市地区提供缓解交通拥堵的办法。
collocations: answer a question｜回答问题 ; answer the phone｜接电话 ; the answer to a problem｜问题的解决办法 ; a clear answer｜明确的答复
tip_zh: 动词answer直接接问题；名词用the answer to。

meanings_zh: phr v. 回来
definition_en: to return to a place
example1_en: When did you come back from holiday?
example1_zh: 你什么时候度假回来的？
example2_en: She will come back home before dinner.
example2_zh: 她会在晚饭前回家。
tip_zh: come back 强调“回到说话人所在的地方”；return 更正式。

meanings_zh: n. 职业；职业生涯 | v. 飞驰；猛冲
definition_en: a person's working life, often within a particular profession | to move very fast in a way that seems uncontrolled
example1_en: My sister hopes to build a career in nursing.
example1_zh: 我姐姐希望在护理行业发展事业。
example2_en: Access to affordable training enables adults to change career and adapt to a rapidly evolving labour market.
example2_zh: 获得负担得起的培训，使成年人能够转行并适应快速变化的劳动力市场。
collocations: career prospects｜职业前景 ; career development｜职业发展 ; pursue a career｜从事某种职业 ; a career in teaching｜教学生涯
tip_zh: career侧重长期职业发展，job指具体工作。

meanings_zh: n. 线；线条 | n. 一排；队伍 | n. 线路；路线
definition_en: a long, thin mark on a surface | people or things arranged one behind or beside another | a route or connection for transport or communication
example1_en: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
example1_zh: 用尺子在纸上画一条直线。
example2_en: Extending the railway line could connect rural communities with employment opportunities in nearby cities.
example2_zh: 延长铁路线可以让农村社区的居民获得附近城市的就业机会。
collocations: straight line｜直线 ; stand in line｜排队 ; railway line｜铁路线 ; telephone line｜电话线路
tip_zh: 排队在美式英语中常用stand in line，英式常用queue。

meanings_zh: n. 门
definition_en: A movable barrier used to open or close an entrance.
example1_en: Please close the door before the cat gets out.
example1_zh: 请关上门，别让猫跑出去。
example2_en: Installing wider doors in public buildings can make everyday journeys easier for people who use wheelchairs.
example2_zh: 在公共建筑中安装更宽的门，可以让轮椅使用者的日常出行更方便。
collocations: front door｜前门；正门 ; answer the door｜应声开门 ; knock on the door｜敲门
tip_zh: at the door指在门口；answer the door指应声开门。

meanings_zh: pron. 她的（所有物）
definition_en: something that belongs to a female person
example1_en: This umbrella is not mine; it's hers.
example1_zh: 这把伞不是我的，是她的。
example2_en: My bag is blue and hers is red.
example2_zh: 我的包是蓝色的，她的是红色的。
tip_zh: hers 是名词性物主代词，后面不再接名词。

meanings_zh: adj.&adv. 好的；可以的；没问题
definition_en: okay; in a satisfactory way
example1_en: Are you alright? You look tired.
example1_zh: 你还好吗？你看起来很累。
example2_en: We'll meet at eight, alright?
example2_zh: 我们八点见面，行吗？
tip_zh: alright 是 all right 的口语拼写，两者意思相同。

meanings_zh: n. 同情；怜悯 | n. 遗憾；可惜的事 | v. 同情；怜悯
definition_en: Sadness and concern for someone who is suffering. | Something disappointing or unfortunate. | To feel sorry for someone because of their difficulties.
example1_en: I felt pity for the puppy shivering in the rain.
example1_zh: 看到小狗在雨中发抖，我心生怜悯。
example2_en: It is a pity that many historic buildings are demolished before their cultural value is properly assessed.
example2_zh: 许多历史建筑的文化价值尚未得到充分评估就被拆除，实在令人遗憾。
collocations: feel pity for｜同情 ; take pity on｜怜悯并帮助 ; what a pity｜真可惜 ; a sense of pity｜怜悯之情
tip_zh: 表同情通常不可数；表遗憾常用a pity。

meanings_zh: n. 女士（女性称谓，不限婚否）
definition_en: title used before a woman's surname
example1_en: Ms Lee is the new manager of the shop.
example1_zh: 李女士是这家店的新经理。
example2_en: Please address the letter to Ms Chen.
example2_zh: 请把信寄给陈女士。
tip_zh: Ms 不表明婚否，是现代更常用的女性称谓。

meanings_zh: n. 小狗；幼犬
definition_en: A young dog.
example1_en: The puppy fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
example1_zh: 小狗钻进我的空鞋子里睡着了。
example2_en: Adopting a puppy requires a long-term commitment to training, exercise, and regular veterinary care.
example2_zh: 领养幼犬意味着要长期承担训练、运动和定期兽医护理的责任。
collocations: a litter of puppies｜一窝幼犬 ; adopt a puppy｜领养幼犬 ; puppy training｜幼犬训练
tip_zh: 复数为puppies；通常专指幼犬。

meanings_zh: n. 滑板车 | n. 踏板式小型摩托车
definition_en: A small wheeled platform with handlebars, ridden standing up. | A small motorcycle with a low platform for your feet.
example1_en: The child pushed her scooter along the smooth path.
example1_zh: 那个孩子蹬着滑板车沿着平坦的小路前进。
example2_en: Shared electric scooter schemes may reduce short car journeys if cities provide safe routes and suitable parking areas.
example2_zh: 如果城市提供安全路线和合适的停车区域，共享电动滑板车项目可能减少短途驾车出行。
collocations: ride a scooter｜骑滑板车或踏板摩托车 ; an electric scooter｜电动滑板车 ; a motor scooter｜踏板式摩托车
tip_zh: 可指站着骑的滑板车，也可指踏板式小摩托。

meanings_zh: v. 跳；跳过 | v. 猛增；骤升 | n. 跳跃；猛增
definition_en: To push yourself off the ground into the air. | To increase suddenly by a large amount. | An act of jumping or a sudden large increase.
example1_en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
example1_zh: 狗跳过了大门旁的一摊积水。
example2_en: Housing costs have jumped sharply in cities where demand continues to exceed the supply of affordable homes.
example2_zh: 在住房需求持续超过可负担住房供应的城市，住房成本已大幅上涨。
collocations: jump over a fence｜跳过篱笆 ; jump at the chance｜欣然抓住机会 ; a sharp jump in prices｜价格的猛涨
tip_zh: jump at the chance意为欣然抓住机会。

meanings_zh: n. 记录；档案 | v. 记录；录音；录像 | n. 最高纪录
definition_en: Stored information about events, activities, or a person's history. | To store information, sounds, or images for future use. | The best result ever achieved in a particular activity.
example1_en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
example1_zh: 我把每一笔花费都记下来。
example2_en: Accurate medical records allow healthcare professionals to make informed decisions and avoid unnecessary treatments.
example2_zh: 准确的医疗记录让医护人员能够作出有依据的决定，避免不必要的治疗。
collocations: keep a record｜保留记录 ; medical records｜医疗档案 ; break a record｜打破纪录 ; record a conversation｜录下谈话
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: n. 十月
definition_en: The tenth month of the year, between September and November.
example1_en: Our local swimming pool will open again in October.
example1_zh: 我们当地的游泳池将在十月重新开放。
example2_en: The university begins its annual community research programme in October, giving students opportunities to investigate local environmental issues.
example2_zh: 这所大学每年十月启动社区研究项目，让学生有机会调查当地环境问题。
collocations: in October｜在十月 ; early October｜十月初 ; late October｜十月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

meanings_zh: n. 房间；室 | n. 空间；余地
definition_en: A part of a building separated by walls and doors. | Available space or opportunity for something.
example1_en: My room has a desk beside the window.
example1_zh: 我的房间里，窗边有一张书桌。
example2_en: Although public transport has improved significantly, there is still room for further investment in rural services.
example2_zh: 尽管公共交通已显著改善，农村交通服务仍有进一步投资的空间。
collocations: living room｜客厅 ; make room for｜为……腾地方 ; room for improvement｜改进的余地
tip_zh: 指房间时可数；指空间或余地时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 助手；助理 | adj. 助理的；副的
definition_en: A person who helps someone with their work. | Having a supporting role below the main person in charge.
example1_en: The assistant brought fresh towels into the treatment room.
example1_zh: 助手把干净的毛巾拿进了治疗室。
example2_en: Teaching assistants can provide additional support for children who need more individual attention in large classes.
example2_zh: 在大班教学中，助教可以为需要更多个别关注的孩子提供额外支持。
collocations: teaching assistant｜助教 ; personal assistant｜私人助理 ; shop assistant｜店员 ; assistant manager｜助理经理
tip_zh: assistant指人，assistance指帮助，通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 休息 | v. 休息；让…休息 | n. 其余部分；其他人
definition_en: a period of relaxing without working or being active | to relax or allow someone or something to recover | the people or things that remain
example1_en: Let's have a rest under that shady tree.
example1_zh: 我们在那棵树荫下休息一下吧。
example2_en: Regular periods of rest can help employees maintain concentration and reduce the risk of workplace accidents.
example2_zh: 定期休息有助于员工保持专注，并降低工作场所发生事故的风险。
collocations: have a rest｜休息一下 ; get some rest｜休息一会儿 ; the rest of｜其余的
tip_zh: the rest of后接名词，谓语单复数随所指内容变化。

meanings_zh: prep. 在（某处、某时间、某状态）
definition_en: used to show place, time or state
example1_en: We met at the bus stop at nine.
example1_zh: 我们九点在公交车站见面。
example2_en: She is good at drawing.
example2_zh: 她擅长画画。
collocations: at home｜在家 ; at school｜在学校
tip_zh: at 用于小地点和具体时间点；in 用于大地点和时段。

meanings_zh: adv. 清楚地；清晰地 | adv. 显然；明显地
definition_en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, or understand. | In a way that shows something is obviously true.
example1_en: Please speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
example1_zh: 请说清楚些，让大家都能听清。
example2_en: Public health information should clearly explain the benefits and potential risks of any recommended treatment.
example2_zh: 公共卫生信息应清楚说明任何推荐疗法的益处和潜在风险。
collocations: speak clearly｜说话清楚 ; clearly explain｜清楚解释 ; clearly visible｜清晰可见
tip_zh: 句首Clearly常表示“显然”，而非“清晰地”。

meanings_zh: n. 咖喱菜肴 | v. 用咖喱烹调
definition_en: A dish of vegetables or meat cooked with spices. | To cook food with curry spices.
example1_en: This vegetable curry tastes wonderful with rice and warm bread.
example1_zh: 这道蔬菜咖喱配米饭和热面包非常好吃。
example2_en: School cafeterias can offer vegetable curry as an affordable alternative to meals containing meat.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以提供蔬菜咖喱，作为价格实惠的非肉类餐食选择。
collocations: chicken curry｜咖喱鸡 ; vegetable curry｜蔬菜咖喱 ; curry powder｜咖喱粉 ; curry paste｜咖喱酱
tip_zh: curry常指菜肴；咖喱粉用curry powder。

meanings_zh: n. 护士 | v. 护理；照料
definition_en: A trained person who cares for ill or injured people. | To care for someone who is ill or injured.
example1_en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
example1_zh: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。
example2_en: Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.
example2_zh: 增聘社区护士可以改善农村老年人获得医疗服务的机会。
collocations: registered nurse｜注册护士 ; community nurse｜社区护士 ; nurse someone back to health｜照料某人直至康复
tip_zh: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。

meanings_zh: n. 姑妈；姨妈；舅妈；婶伯母
definition_en: Your parent's sister, or the wife of your parent's sibling.
example1_en: My aunt taught me how to bake bread.
example1_zh: 我姨妈教会了我如何烤面包。
example2_en: Extended family members, such as aunts and uncles, often provide valuable childcare support for working parents.
example2_zh: 姑姨叔舅等大家庭成员常为在职父母提供宝贵的育儿支持。
collocations: aunt and uncle｜姑姨叔舅等亲属 ; maternal aunt｜姨妈 ; paternal aunt｜姑妈
tip_zh: 不区分父系或母系；美音也常读/ɑːnt/。

meanings_zh: n. 迷；爱好者 | n. 风扇；扇子 | v. 扇风；煽动
definition_en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing | a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow | to move air towards something, or make a feeling stronger
example1_en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
example1_zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。
example2_en: Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.
example2_zh: 体育迷可以通过支持社区球队、参与共同活动来增强当地社区的凝聚力。
collocations: a fan of｜……的爱好者 ; football fan｜足球迷 ; electric fan｜电风扇 ; fan the flames｜煽风点火
tip_zh: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。

meanings_zh: adj. 户外的；露天的
definition_en: happening, used, or located outside a building
example1_en: We bought comfortable chairs for our outdoor dining area.
example1_zh: 我们给户外用餐区买了舒适的椅子。
example2_en: Regular outdoor activities can improve children's physical health while helping them develop an appreciation of nature.
example2_zh: 定期开展户外活动可以改善儿童的身体健康，同时培养他们对自然的欣赏。
collocations: outdoor activities｜户外活动 ; outdoor sports｜户外运动 ; outdoor swimming pool｜露天游泳池 ; outdoor clothing｜户外服装
tip_zh: outdoor是形容词；表示在户外用副词outdoors。

meanings_zh: v. 观看；注视 | n. 手表 | v. 照看；留意
definition_en: To look at something attentively for a period of time. | A small clock worn on the wrist or carried. | To take care of someone or look for possible danger.
example1_en: We watched the ducks swimming across the quiet pond.
example1_zh: 我们看着鸭子游过平静的池塘。
example2_en: Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.
example2_zh: 观看教育节目的学生可能获得实用知识，但积极讨论有助于加深理解。
collocations: watch television｜看电视 ; watch closely｜仔细观察 ; wear a watch｜戴手表 ; watch out｜小心
tip_zh: watch 强调持续观看；see 强调看见这一结果。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人兴奋的；刺激的
definition_en: Making someone feel eager, enthusiastic, or thrilled.
example1_en: The final minutes of the match were incredibly exciting.
example1_zh: 比赛最后几分钟精彩刺激极了。
example2_en: Advances in renewable energy offer exciting opportunities for young engineers seeking to address global environmental challenges.
example2_zh: 可再生能源的进步为希望应对全球环境挑战的年轻工程师提供了令人振奋的机会。
collocations: exciting opportunity｜令人振奋的机会 ; exciting development｜令人振奋的进展 ; exciting experience｜刺激的体验
tip_zh: exciting形容令人兴奋的事物；excited形容人的感受。

meanings_zh: n. 胃痛；肚子疼
definition_en: pain in your stomach
example1_en: I ate too much and now I have a stomach ache.
example1_zh: 我吃太多，现在肚子疼。
example2_en: She stayed home because of a stomach ache.
example2_zh: 她因为肚子疼待在家里。
collocations: have a stomach ache｜肚子疼
tip_zh: stomach ache 是胃/肚子疼；earache 耳朵疼，toothache 牙疼。

meanings_zh: n. 教练；培训师 | n. 运动鞋
definition_en: someone who teaches people or animals particular skills | a shoe designed for sport or casual wear
example1_en: My trainer showed me how to lift weights safely.
example1_zh: 我的教练教我如何安全地举重。
example2_en: A qualified trainer can help employees develop practical skills that improve their performance at work.
example2_zh: 合格的培训师可以帮助员工培养实用技能，从而改善工作表现。
collocations: personal trainer｜私人健身教练 ; fitness trainer｜健身教练 ; a pair of trainers｜一双运动鞋
tip_zh: 运动鞋英式常用trainers，美式常用sneakers。

meanings_zh: adv. 有时；偶尔
definition_en: on certain occasions, but not always or regularly
example1_en: I sometimes take the longer route home through the park.
example1_zh: 我有时会绕远路穿过公园回家。
example2_en: Working from home sometimes improves productivity, although its benefits depend on suitable equipment and a quiet environment.
example2_zh: 居家办公有时能提高效率，不过其益处取决于合适的设备和安静的环境。
collocations: sometimes feel｜有时感到 ; sometimes happen｜有时发生 ; only sometimes｜只是偶尔
tip_zh: sometimes是有时；some time是一段时间。

meanings_zh: n. 报纸 | n. 报社
definition_en: A publication containing news, articles, and advertisements, usually printed daily. | An organization that produces and publishes news in a newspaper.
example1_en: My grandfather reads the newspaper while eating breakfast.
example1_zh: 我爷爷一边吃早饭一边看报纸。
example2_en: Local newspapers provide valuable coverage of community issues that national media may overlook.
example2_zh: 地方报纸对全国性媒体可能忽略的社区问题提供了有价值的报道。
collocations: daily newspaper｜日报 ; local newspaper｜地方报纸 ; newspaper article｜报纸文章 ; read a newspaper｜看报纸
tip_zh: 一份报纸用a newspaper；作包装材料时可不可数。

meanings_zh: prep. 直到……为止 | conj. 直到……才；直到 | n. 收银机；现金抽屉
definition_en: up to a particular time | up to the time when something happens | a machine or drawer where a shop keeps cash
example1_en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
example1_zh: 这家小面包店每天晚上营业到六点。
example2_en: Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.
example2_zh: 有些家长工作到深夜，因此价格可负担的托育服务对城市家庭至关重要。
collocations: till late｜直到很晚 ; wait till｜等到 ; at the till｜在收银台
tip_zh: till与until意思相同；作连词谈将来时通常接一般现在时。

meanings_zh: adj. 好的；健康的；优质的 | adj. 细小的；纤细的 | n. 罚款
definition_en: Good, satisfactory, healthy, or of high quality. | Made of very small particles or having little thickness. | Money that must be paid as punishment for breaking rules.
example1_en: I feel fine now, so let's go for a walk.
example1_zh: 我现在感觉挺好的，我们去散步吧。
example2_en: A substantial fine may discourage companies from dumping industrial waste into rivers and damaging local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 高额罚款可能会阻止企业向河流倾倒工业废物、破坏当地生态系统。
collocations: feel fine｜感觉良好 ; fine sand｜细沙 ; pay a fine｜缴纳罚款 ; fine art｜美术
tip_zh: fine作动词也指罚款：fine sb for sth。

meanings_zh: n. 术语；用语 | n. 学期 | n. 期限；任期
definition_en: A word or expression with a particular meaning. | One of the periods into which a school year is divided. | A fixed period during which something lasts or someone serves.
example1_en: Our teacher explained a scientific term using a simple drawing.
example1_zh: 老师用一幅简单的画解释了一个科学术语。
example2_en: The term sustainability describes meeting present needs without limiting the opportunities available to future generations.
example2_zh: 可持续性这一术语指满足当代需求，同时不限制后代可获得的机会。
collocations: technical term｜专业术语 ; school term｜学期 ; in the long term｜从长远来看 ; terms and conditions｜条款与条件
tip_zh: in terms of意为就…而言；条款义常用复数terms。

meanings_zh: n. 船；小船
definition_en: a vessel for travelling on water, usually smaller than a ship
example1_en: We hired a small boat and explored the lake.
example1_zh: 我们租了一条小船，游览了湖面。
example2_en: In remote coastal communities, travelling by boat remains essential for accessing schools and medical services.
example2_zh: 在偏远的沿海社区，乘船出行仍是获得教育和医疗服务的重要方式。
collocations: fishing boat｜渔船 ; rowing boat｜划艇 ; by boat｜乘船 ; boat trip｜乘船游览
tip_zh: by boat不加冠词；on a boat表示在船上。

meanings_zh: n. 卡；卡片；证件 | n. 贺卡；明信片 | n. 纸牌
definition_en: A small stiff rectangle used for payment, identification, or information. | A decorated card sent with a greeting or personal message. | One of a set of small rectangles used in games.
example1_en: I tapped my card to pay for the groceries.
example1_zh: 我刷卡支付了买食品杂货的钱。
example2_en: Providing every student with a library card encourages independent reading and improves access to educational resources.
example2_zh: 为每位学生办理借书证，有助于鼓励自主阅读，并改善教育资源的获取条件。
collocations: a credit card｜信用卡 ; an identity card｜身份证件 ; a birthday card｜生日贺卡 ; play cards｜打牌
tip_zh: play cards指打牌，cards用复数，前面不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 大蒜
definition_en: A plant whose strong-smelling bulbs are used to flavour food.
example1_en: Crush the garlic before adding it to the soup.
example1_zh: 先把大蒜压碎，再放进汤里。
example2_en: Using garlic and herbs can add flavour to meals without increasing their salt content.
example2_zh: 使用大蒜和香草可以给饭菜增添风味，而不增加盐含量。
collocations: a clove of garlic｜一瓣大蒜 ; crushed garlic｜压碎的大蒜 ; garlic bread｜蒜香面包
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一瓣大蒜用a clove of garlic。

meanings_zh: adj. 害怕的；担心的 | adj. 恐怕；遗憾地认为
definition_en: feeling fear or worry about something | used to introduce unwelcome information politely
example1_en: The puppy was afraid of the noisy vacuum cleaner.
example1_zh: 那只小狗害怕吵闹的吸尘器。
example2_en: Some employees are afraid to report workplace problems because they worry about losing their jobs.
example2_zh: 有些员工不敢反映职场问题，因为他们担心失去工作。
collocations: afraid of｜害怕…… ; afraid to ask｜不敢问 ; afraid of making mistakes｜害怕犯错 ; I'm afraid that｜恐怕……
tip_zh: 通常作表语，不放名词前；用afraid of或afraid to do。

meanings_zh: n. 晚饭；睡前便餐
definition_en: An evening meal, sometimes a light meal before bed.
example1_en: We had soup and fresh bread for supper.
example1_zh: 我们晚饭喝了汤，吃了新鲜面包。
example2_en: Sharing supper regularly can help families maintain close relationships despite increasingly demanding work schedules.
example2_zh: 尽管工作安排日益繁忙，经常共进晚餐仍有助于家人维持亲密关系。
collocations: have supper｜吃晚饭 ; a light supper｜清淡的晚餐 ; after supper｜晚饭后
tip_zh: 常指较随意的晚饭，也可指睡前便餐。

meanings_zh: v. 开始；着手 | v. 启动；发动 | n. 开始；起点
definition_en: To begin doing something or cause something to begin. | To make a machine operate, or begin operating. | The moment or place where something begins.
example1_en: We started cooking dinner as soon as we got home.
example1_zh: 我们一到家就开始做晚饭。
example2_en: Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.
example2_zh: 学校应尽早开始教授理财技能，让年轻人能在充分了解情况后作出财务决定。
collocations: start a business｜创业 ; start the engine｜发动引擎 ; at the start of｜在……开始时 ; make a fresh start｜重新开始
tip_zh: start doing与start to do通常都可表示开始做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 医院
definition_en: A place where ill or injured people receive medical treatment.
example1_en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
example1_zh: 她在当地医院当护士。
example2_en: Building a new hospital in the region would improve access to specialist care for rural communities.
example2_zh: 在该地区新建一家医院将有助于农村居民获得专科医疗服务。
collocations: be admitted to hospital｜入院治疗 ; be discharged from hospital｜出院 ; a public hospital｜公立医院 ; hospital staff｜医院工作人员
tip_zh: 住院：英式in hospital，美式in the hospital。

meanings_zh: adj. 严重的；重大的 | adj. 认真的；严肃的
definition_en: causing harm or requiring careful attention | not joking, or thinking carefully about something
example1_en: The leaking pipe caused serious damage to our kitchen.
example1_zh: 漏水的管道给我们的厨房造成了严重损坏。
example2_en: Air pollution remains a serious threat to public health, especially in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 空气污染仍然严重威胁着公众健康，在人口稠密的城市尤其如此。
collocations: serious damage｜严重损坏 ; serious consequences｜严重后果 ; serious about｜认真对待 ; take something seriously｜认真对待某事
tip_zh: serious about 后接名词或动名词，表示认真对待。

meanings_zh: n. 识别；鉴定 | n. 身份证明 | n. 认同；共鸣
definition_en: the process of establishing who or what someone or something is | a document that proves who you are | a feeling of connection with another person or group
example1_en: The receptionist asked me to show some identification.
example1_zh: 接待员请我出示身份证明。
example2_en: Early identification of learning difficulties allows schools to provide appropriate support before students fall behind.
example2_zh: 及早识别学习困难，能让学校在学生掉队之前提供适当的支持。
collocations: proof of identification｜身份证明 ; species identification｜物种鉴定 ; early identification｜早期识别 ; identification with｜对……的认同
tip_zh: 表示身份证明时通常不可数，可简称 ID。

meanings_zh: n. 生活；人生 | n. 生命；生存 | n. 寿命；使用期限
definition_en: the experiences and activities of being alive | the state of being alive | the period during which someone lives or something works
example1_en: Life feels quieter since we moved to the countryside.
example1_zh: 自从搬到乡下，我们的生活感觉更安静了。
example2_en: Access to affordable housing can significantly improve the quality of life in large cities.
example2_zh: 获得负担得起的住房可以显著提高大城市居民的生活质量。
collocations: quality of life｜生活质量 ; daily life｜日常生活 ; save a life｜挽救生命 ; battery life｜电池续航时间
tip_zh: 复数是 lives；泛指生活时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 舒适的；舒服的 | adj. 自在的；安心的 | adj. 生活宽裕的
definition_en: physically pleasant and free from discomfort | feeling relaxed and confident in a situation | having enough money to live well without financial worry
example1_en: This soft chair is comfortable enough for an afternoon nap.
example1_zh: 这把柔软的椅子很舒服，足以让人午睡一会儿。
example2_en: Comfortable classrooms with adequate lighting can help students concentrate and participate more actively in lessons.
example2_zh: 舒适且照明充足的教室有助于学生集中注意力，更积极地参与课堂活动。
collocations: comfortable shoes｜舒适的鞋 ; feel comfortable｜感到自在 ; comfortable with something｜对某事感到自在 ; a comfortable income｜宽裕的收入
tip_zh: comfortable指舒服；convenient指方便。

meanings_zh: n. 攀岩；登山运动 | adj. 攀缘的
definition_en: The sport of going up rocks, mountains, or artificial walls. | Growing upwards by attaching to or winding around supports.
example1_en: I tried indoor climbing with my sister yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我和姐姐尝试了室内攀岩。
example2_en: Schools can use supervised climbing activities to develop students' confidence, physical coordination, and ability to assess risks.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过有人指导的攀岩活动，培养学生的自信、身体协调性和风险评估能力。
collocations: rock climbing｜攀岩 ; indoor climbing｜室内攀岩 ; climbing equipment｜攀登装备 ; climbing plants｜攀缘植物
tip_zh: climb中的b不发音；climbing plants指攀缘植物。

meanings_zh: n. 杂志；期刊
definition_en: A regularly published collection of articles and pictures.
example1_en: She bought a gardening magazine at the station.
example1_zh: 她在车站买了一本园艺杂志。
example2_en: A specialist magazine can provide practical career advice that general news websites may not offer.
example2_zh: 专业杂志可以提供综合新闻网站未必能提供的实用职业建议。
collocations: monthly magazine｜月刊 ; fashion magazine｜时尚杂志 ; magazine subscription｜杂志订阅 ; magazine article｜杂志文章
tip_zh: 可数名词；英式重音通常在末音节，美式在首音节。

meanings_zh: v. 练习 | v. 从事专业工作 | v. 践行；实行
definition_en: Do something repeatedly to improve your skill | Work in a profession such as medicine or law | Regularly follow a belief, custom, or method
example1_en: I practise the violin quietly after dinner each evening.
example1_zh: 我每天晚饭后都会轻声练习小提琴。
example2_en: Language learners should practise speaking regularly rather than rely entirely on memorising vocabulary and grammar rules.
example2_zh: 语言学习者应经常练习口语，而不是完全依赖背诵词汇和语法规则。
collocations: practise speaking｜练习口语 ; practise medicine｜行医 ; practise regularly｜定期练习 ; practise what you preach｜身体力行
tip_zh: 英式动词用practise、名词用practice；美式均用practice。

meanings_zh: n. 城市；都市
definition_en: A large town where many people live and work.
example1_en: We explored the city on foot all afternoon.
example1_zh: 我们整个下午都在步行游览这座城市。
example2_en: A well-designed city provides accessible public transport and green spaces that improve residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 一座规划良好的城市会提供便利的公共交通和绿地，改善居民的生活质量。
collocations: city centre｜市中心 ; a major city｜大城市 ; city life｜城市生活 ; city planning｜城市规划
tip_zh: 复数为cities；市中心英式用city centre。

meanings_zh: adj. 无聊的；乏味的
definition_en: Not interesting or exciting.
example1_en: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
example1_zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。
example2_en: Students may find repetitive exercises boring unless teachers explain their purpose and introduce variety.
example2_zh: 如果教师不解释练习的目的并增加变化，学生可能会觉得重复练习很乏味。
collocations: boring task｜乏味的任务 ; boring lecture｜枯燥的讲座 ; find something boring｜觉得某事无聊
tip_zh: boring指令人无聊；bored指人感到无聊。

meanings_zh: n. 方向；路线说明
definition_en: instructions about how to get somewhere
example1_en: Can you give me directions to the station?
example1_zh: 你能告诉我去车站怎么走吗？
example2_en: We followed the directions on the map.
example2_zh: 我们按照地图上的路线走。
collocations: ask for directions｜问路
tip_zh: ask for directions 是“问路”；lose your way 是“迷路”。

meanings_zh: n. 游览；参观；巡游 | n. 巡回演出；巡回比赛 | v. 游览；巡回演出
definition_en: A journey visiting several places, or a guided visit somewhere. | A series of performances or matches held in different places. | To travel around places for sightseeing, performances, or other activities.
example1_en: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
example1_zh: 我们在导游带领下参观了那座古堡。
example2_en: Organized tours can introduce visitors to local traditions while providing reliable income for community guides.
example2_zh: 有组织的游览既能让游客了解当地传统，也能为社区导游提供稳定收入。
collocations: guided tour｜有导游带领的游览 ; walking tour｜徒步游览 ; concert tour｜巡回演唱会 ; go on tour｜进行巡回活动
tip_zh: tour强调参观或多站行程；trip泛指一次出行。

meanings_zh: v. 完成；结束；吃完 | n. 结尾；终点 | n. 表面处理；光洁度
definition_en: to complete something or reach its end | the final part or end of something | the appearance or texture of a completed surface
example1_en: I'll finish washing the dishes before we go.
example1_zh: 我们出门前，我会把碗洗完。
example2_en: Students who finish their assignments early have more time to review feedback and improve their understanding.
example2_zh: 提前完成作业的学生有更多时间查看反馈并加深理解。
collocations: finish doing something｜做完某事 ; finish an assignment｜完成作业 ; finish line｜终点线 ; a smooth finish｜光滑的表面
tip_zh: 表示做完某事用finish doing，不用finish to do。

meanings_zh: det. 我们的
definition_en: Belonging to or connected with the speaker and other people.
example1_en: Our kitchen smells wonderful when Dad bakes fresh bread.
example1_zh: 爸爸烤新鲜面包时，我们的厨房里香气四溢。
example2_en: Investing in public transport could improve our quality of life and reduce urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通可以提高我们的生活质量，并减少城市空气污染。
collocations: our daily lives｜我们的日常生活 ; our local community｜我们所在的社区 ; our shared future｜我们共同的未来
tip_zh: our后须接名词；ours可独立使用。

meanings_zh: n. 公寓；套房
definition_en: A set of rooms forming one home within a building.
example1_en: Our apartment has a small balcony overlooking the park.
example1_zh: 我们的公寓有一个面向公园的小阳台。
example2_en: Building affordable apartments near railway stations can reduce commuting costs for young workers.
example2_zh: 在火车站附近建设价格可负担的公寓，可以降低年轻上班族的通勤成本。
collocations: rent an apartment｜租公寓 ; apartment block｜公寓楼 ; studio apartment｜单间公寓
tip_zh: 美式常用apartment，英式日常多用flat。

meanings_zh: n. 链条；链子 | n. 连锁店；一连串 | v. 用链条拴住
definition_en: a series of connected metal rings | connected shops, events, or other things forming a series | to fasten someone or something with a chain
example1_en: He secured his bicycle with a heavy metal chain.
example1_zh: 他用一条沉重的金属链锁好了自行车。
example2_en: Large supermarket chains can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten small independent shops.
example2_zh: 大型连锁超市可以提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁独立小商店。
collocations: a chain of events｜一连串事件 ; a supermarket chain｜连锁超市 ; a supply chain｜供应链 ; chain a bicycle to a railing｜用链条把自行车锁在栏杆上
tip_zh: a chain of后接复数名词，表示相连的一系列事物。

meanings_zh: n. 足球；足球运动 | n. 美式橄榄球运动
definition_en: a game where teams kick a ball into opposing goals | an American game involving carrying, throwing, and kicking an oval ball
example1_en: We play football in the park every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。
example2_en: Local football clubs can strengthen community relationships by bringing together people from different social backgrounds.
example2_zh: 地方足球俱乐部能够聚集不同社会背景的人，从而增进社区联系。
collocations: play football｜踢足球 ; football match｜足球比赛 ; football pitch｜足球场 ; football club｜足球俱乐部
tip_zh: 英式football指足球；美式通常指美式橄榄球。

meanings_zh: n. 沙漠；荒漠 | v. 抛弃；擅离
definition_en: a very dry area with little rain and few plants | to leave someone or somewhere you should stay with
example1_en: We crossed the desert before the afternoon heat arrived.
example1_zh: 我们在午后的酷热到来之前穿过了沙漠。
example2_en: As desert areas expand, nearby farming communities face increasing pressure on their water supplies and agricultural land.
example2_zh: 随着荒漠地区扩张，附近的农业社区在供水和耕地方面面临越来越大的压力。
collocations: a vast desert｜广袤的沙漠 ; desert plants｜沙漠植物 ; desert a post｜擅离岗位
tip_zh: 动词读/dɪˈzɜːt/；dessert意为甜点。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……中间 | prep. 在某群体之中
definition_en: surrounded by people or things | within or shared by a group
example1_en: We found a small wooden house among the trees.
example1_zh: 我们在树林中发现了一座小木屋。
example2_en: Regular exercise is increasingly popular among office workers who spend most of their day sitting.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼在一天大部分时间坐着的上班族中越来越受欢迎。
collocations: among friends｜在朋友之间 ; among other things｜除了别的以外还 ; divide among｜在……之间分配
tip_zh: among强调群体内部；between也可用于多者的明确关系。

meanings_zh: n. 烤面包片 | v. 烘烤；烤至焦黄 | n. 祝酒；敬酒
definition_en: Sliced bread browned and made crisp by heat. | To heat food until it becomes brown and crisp. | An occasion when people raise drinks to honour someone or something.
example1_en: I spread butter on my toast while it was warm.
example1_zh: 我趁烤面包片还热着，在上面抹了黄油。
example2_en: A simple breakfast of toast and fruit can help students maintain their energy during morning lessons.
example2_zh: 一顿由烤面包片和水果组成的简单早餐，有助于学生在上午上课时保持精力。
collocations: a slice of toast｜一片烤面包 ; toast bread｜烤面包 ; propose a toast｜提议干杯 ; a toast to someone｜为某人祝酒
tip_zh: 表示烤面包时不可数；表示一次祝酒时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 田地；牧场 | n. 领域；专业 | n. 运动场
definition_en: an area of land used for crops or farm animals | a particular area of study or work | an area of ground used for playing a sport
example1_en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
example1_zh: 我们看着羊群在小屋后面的牧场上吃草。
example2_en: Research in the field of renewable energy could create employment opportunities and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 可再生能源领域的研究可以创造就业机会，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: a wheat field｜麦田 ; in the field of｜在……领域 ; a football field｜足球场 ; field research｜实地研究
tip_zh: 表示研究或工作领域时，常用in the field of。

meanings_zh: n. 车站 | n. 工作站；台；所 | v. 派驻；安置
definition_en: A place where trains or buses stop for passengers. | A place or organisation providing a particular service. | To place someone somewhere to perform a duty.
example1_en: We hurried to the station with our heavy suitcases.
example1_zh: 我们提着沉重的行李箱匆忙赶往车站。
example2_en: Local authorities should station trained staff at busy transport hubs to assist passengers with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 地方政府应在繁忙的交通枢纽安排受过培训的工作人员，帮助行动不便的乘客。
collocations: railway station｜火车站 ; police station｜警察局 ; radio station｜广播电台 ; be stationed at｜被派驻在
tip_zh: 作动词常用被动式be stationed at，表示被派驻。

meanings_zh: adv. 在明天 | n. 明天；未来
definition_en: On the day after today. | The day after today, or the future more generally.
example1_en: We are meeting at the swimming pool tomorrow morning.
example1_zh: 我们明天早上在游泳池见面。
example2_en: The environmental decisions made today will shape the world that the children of tomorrow inherit.
example2_zh: 今天作出的环境决策将塑造未来孩子们继承的世界。
collocations: tomorrow morning｜明天早上 ; by tomorrow｜到明天为止 ; the day after tomorrow｜后天 ; tomorrow's world｜未来世界
tip_zh: tomorrow前通常不加on；明早是tomorrow morning。

meanings_zh: adj. 网上的；联网的 | adv. 在网上；联网地
definition_en: Available through the internet or connected to a computer network. | Using the internet or while connected to a computer network.
example1_en: I booked our train tickets online after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我在网上订了我们的火车票。
example2_en: Online courses can widen access to education, especially for learners who live far from universities.
example2_zh: 网络课程可以扩大受教育的机会，尤其有利于远离大学的学习者。
collocations: online shopping｜网上购物 ; online learning｜在线学习 ; go online｜上网 ; available online｜可在网上获取的
tip_zh: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：shop online。

meanings_zh: adv. 今天；现今 | n. 今天；当今
definition_en: on this day, or during the present period | the current day or the present period
example1_en: Let's eat outside today while the weather is warm.
example1_zh: 今天天气暖和，我们到外面吃饭吧。
example2_en: Today, many universities offer flexible courses that allow students to combine employment with further education.
example2_zh: 如今，许多大学开设灵活的课程，让学生能够兼顾工作和继续教育。
collocations: earlier today｜今天早些时候 ; today's society｜当今社会 ; from today｜从今天起
tip_zh: today既可指今天，也可泛指当今；前面不用on。

meanings_zh: n. 扶手椅 | adj. 无实践经验的；空谈的
definition_en: A comfortable chair with supports for your arms. | Giving opinions without direct experience or active involvement.
example1_en: Grandpa fell asleep in his armchair beside the window.
example1_zh: 爷爷在窗边的扶手椅上睡着了。
example2_en: Armchair critics may underestimate the practical challenges that teachers face when managing large classes with limited resources.
example2_zh: 缺乏实践经验的评论者可能低估教师在资源有限时管理大班所面临的实际困难。
collocations: comfortable armchair｜舒适的扶手椅 ; sit in an armchair｜坐在扶手椅里 ; armchair critic｜空谈的评论者
tip_zh: 坐在扶手椅里用in；作形容词时置于名词前，常含贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐家；乐手
definition_en: someone who plays music, especially professionally
example1_en: A musician played the violin outside the station.
example1_zh: 一位乐手在车站外拉小提琴。
example2_en: Local musicians can strengthen community identity by performing traditional songs at public festivals and cultural events.
example2_zh: 当地音乐人可以在公共节庆和文化活动中演奏传统歌曲，增强社区认同感。
collocations: professional musician｜职业音乐人 ; talented musician｜有才华的音乐家 ; street musician｜街头乐手
tip_zh: musician指音乐人；作曲家更具体地用composer。

meanings_zh: n. 飞机 | n. 平面 | v. 刨平
definition_en: a flying vehicle with wings and at least one engine | a flat surface extending in every direction | to make wood smooth using a special cutting tool
example1_en: Our plane landed just before the rain began.
example1_zh: 我们的飞机刚降落，雨就下起来了。
example2_en: Travelling by plane saves time, but its environmental impact should be considered when planning transport policy.
example2_zh: 乘飞机出行节省时间，但制定交通政策时应考虑其环境影响。
collocations: by plane｜乘飞机 ; board a plane｜登机 ; a horizontal plane｜水平面 ; plane a door｜刨平门板
tip_zh: by plane不加冠词；on a plane需加冠词。

meanings_zh: phr v. 照顾；照料
definition_en: to take care of someone or something
example1_en: My sister looks after our cat when we travel.
example1_zh: 我们旅行时，姐姐照顾我们的猫。
example2_en: Please look after your little brother.
example2_zh: 请照顾好你的小弟弟。
tip_zh: look after 等于 take care of，都表示“照顾”。

meanings_zh: prep. 自……以来 | conj. 自……以来；因为 | adv. 此后；从那时起
definition_en: from a past time until a later time, usually now | from when something happened; because something is true | at a time or throughout the period after that
example1_en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
example1_zh: 我从小就住在这个街区。
example2_en: Since public transport reduces traffic congestion, governments should invest in more reliable bus services.
example2_zh: 由于公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，政府应投资建设更可靠的公交服务。
collocations: ever since｜从那以后一直 ; since then｜从那时起 ; since childhood｜自幼 ; long since｜早已
tip_zh: 表时间时，since接起点，for接时长。

meanings_zh: n. 工作；职位 | n. 任务；活儿
definition_en: paid work that someone does regularly | a particular task or piece of work
example1_en: My sister found a job at the local library.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在当地图书馆找到了一份工作。
example2_en: Access to practical training can help young people secure a job in a competitive labour market.
example2_zh: 获得实用技能培训能帮助年轻人在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中找到工作。
collocations: apply for a job｜申请工作 ; a full-time job｜全职工作 ; job satisfaction｜工作满意度 ; do a good job｜干得出色
tip_zh: job指具体工作，可数；work泛指工作，通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；精彩的 | adj. 才华出众的；聪颖的 | adj. 明亮的；灿烂的
definition_en: Extremely good, impressive, or enjoyable. | Exceptionally intelligent or skilled. | Shining brightly or having a strong, vivid colour.
example1_en: Your brilliant idea saved us hours of work.
example1_zh: 你的绝妙主意为我们省下了好几个小时的工作。
example2_en: Brilliant teachers can inspire students to explore difficult subjects with confidence and genuine curiosity.
example2_zh: 出色的教师能激励学生带着信心和真正的好奇心探索难学的科目。
collocations: brilliant idea｜绝妙的主意 ; brilliant scientist｜杰出的科学家 ; brilliant sunshine｜灿烂的阳光
tip_zh: 英式口语中常用 brilliant 表示“太棒了”。

meanings_zh: n. 乐器 | n. 仪器；器械 | n. 手段；工具
definition_en: an object played to produce musical sounds | a tool or device for precise scientific or medical work | something used to achieve a particular purpose
example1_en: My sister plays a different instrument at each rehearsal.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每次排练都演奏不同的乐器。
example2_en: Learning a musical instrument can strengthen concentration and encourage cooperation among children from different backgrounds.
example2_zh: 学习乐器可以增强专注力，并促进不同背景的儿童之间的合作。
collocations: musical instrument｜乐器 ; scientific instrument｜科学仪器 ; surgical instrument｜外科器械 ; instrument of change｜推动变革的工具
tip_zh: 乐器和精密仪器均可用instrument；普通工具常用tool。

meanings_zh: n. 超级市场；超市
definition_en: a large shop selling food and other everyday goods
example1_en: We stopped at the supermarket to buy milk and rice.
example1_zh: 我们顺路去超市买了牛奶和大米。
example2_en: Large supermarkets can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten independent shops in smaller communities.
example2_zh: 大型超市能提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁小型社区里的独立商店。
collocations: supermarket chain｜连锁超市 ; supermarket checkout｜超市收银台 ; supermarket shelves｜超市货架
tip_zh: 在超市购物常说shop at a supermarket。

meanings_zh: n. 厨房
definition_en: A room where food is prepared and cooked
example1_en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread and roasted vegetables.
example1_zh: 厨房里飘着新鲜面包和烤蔬菜的香味。
example2_en: Shared kitchen facilities can encourage social interaction among students living in university accommodation away from home.
example2_zh: 共用厨房设施能促进离家住在大学宿舍的学生之间的社交互动。
collocations: kitchen appliances｜厨房电器 ; kitchen sink｜厨房水槽 ; shared kitchen｜共用厨房 ; kitchen utensils｜厨具
tip_zh: in the kitchen表示在厨房；ch读/tʃ/。

meanings_zh: n. 桥；桥梁 | v. 弥合；连接 | n. 桥牌
definition_en: A structure carrying people or vehicles over an obstacle. | To connect separated things or reduce differences between them. | A card game played by four people in two partnerships.
example1_en: We crossed the wooden bridge and entered the village.
example1_zh: 我们走过木桥，进了村子。
example2_en: Community language programmes can bridge cultural differences and help newcomers participate more fully in local life.
example2_zh: 社区语言项目可以弥合文化差异，帮助新来者更充分地参与当地生活。
collocations: cross a bridge｜过桥 ; suspension bridge｜悬索桥 ; bridge the gap｜缩小差距 ; play bridge｜打桥牌
tip_zh: bridge the gap常指缩小群体或事物间的差距。

meanings_zh: adj.&adv. 每天的；日常的；每天
definition_en: happening every day
example1_en: Walking to school is part of my daily routine.
example1_zh: 步行上学是我日常的一部分。
example2_en: She reads the daily news on her phone.
example2_zh: 她每天在手机上看新闻。
collocations: daily life｜日常生活
tip_zh: daily 既是形容词也是副词：daily exercise 每天锻炼。

meanings_zh: n. （外）孙子；（外）孙女
definition_en: the child of your son or daughter
example1_en: Their grandchild visits them every Sunday.
example1_zh: 他们的孙子每周日来看他们。
example2_en: Grandpa loves reading stories to his grandchild.
example2_zh: 爷爷喜欢给孙辈读故事。
tip_zh: grandchild 复数 grandchildren；分性别说 grandson/granddaughter。

meanings_zh: adv. 什么时候 | conj. 当……时；一……就 | conj. 既然；考虑到
definition_en: At what time. | At the time that something happens. | Considering that something is true.
example1_en: When does the next bus leave for town?
example1_zh: 下一班去镇上的公交车什么时候发车？
example2_en: When cities invest in reliable public transport, residents are more likely to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 当城市投资建设可靠的公共交通时，居民就更可能不开私家车出行。
collocations: when necessary｜必要时 ; when possible｜尽可能 ; since when｜从什么时候起
tip_zh: 表将来的时间从句中，when后通常用一般现在时。

meanings_zh: n. 北；北方；北部 | adj. 北部的；朝北的 | adv. 向北；在北方
definition_en: the direction opposite south, or an area's northern part | in the north or facing towards it | towards or in the north
example1_en: The north of the island gets snow every winter.
example1_zh: 这座岛的北部每年冬天都会下雪。
example2_en: Investment in rail connections could help towns in the north attract businesses and create more local jobs.
example2_zh: 投资铁路连接设施可以帮助北部城镇吸引企业，并创造更多本地就业岗位。
collocations: the north of｜……的北部 ; head north｜向北行进 ; north coast｜北部海岸 ; further north｜更往北
tip_zh: in the north of指在内部北部；north of指在其以北。

meanings_zh: n. 糖；食糖
definition_en: A sweet substance used to make food and drinks sweeter
example1_en: She stirred a spoonful of sugar into her tea.
example1_zh: 她往茶里加了一勺糖，搅拌均匀。
example2_en: Reducing sugar consumption can help prevent health problems associated with an unhealthy diet.
example2_zh: 减少糖的摄入有助于预防与不健康饮食有关的健康问题。
collocations: add sugar｜加糖 ; sugar intake｜糖的摄入量 ; blood sugar｜血糖 ; sugar content｜含糖量
tip_zh: 泛指食糖时通常不可数；a spoonful of sugar指一勺糖。

meanings_zh: pron. 他
definition_en: a male person or animal already mentioned
example1_en: He is my best friend at school.
example1_zh: 他是我在学校最好的朋友。
example2_en: Where is Tom? He is in the garden.
example2_zh: 汤姆在哪？他在花园里。
tip_zh: he 是主格；宾格是 him，形容词性物主代词是 his。

meanings_zh: n. 技术；科技
definition_en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.
example1_en: New technology lets us control the lights from our phones.
example1_zh: 新技术让我们可以用手机控制灯光。
example2_en: Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.
example2_zh: 投资清洁技术可以减少工业污染，同时在新兴领域创造技术岗位。
collocations: digital technology｜数字技术 ; advanced technology｜先进技术 ; information technology｜信息技术 ; develop new technologies｜开发新技术
tip_zh: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。

meanings_zh: n. 小路；小径 | n. 路线；轨迹 | n. 途径；发展道路
definition_en: A narrow track for people to walk along. | The route along which someone or something moves. | A way of achieving something or developing over time.
example1_en: We followed a narrow path down to the beach.
example1_zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走向海滩。
example2_en: Access to affordable education can provide a path out of poverty for disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 获得负担得起的教育可以为弱势社区提供一条摆脱贫困的道路。
collocations: follow a path｜沿小路走 ; career path｜职业发展道路 ; flight path｜飞行路线 ; a path to success｜通往成功的道路
tip_zh: 表示实现目标的途径，用a path to，to后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 丈夫 | v. 节约使用
definition_en: a married man considered in relation to his spouse | to use resources carefully so they last longer
example1_en: Her husband brought her lunch during a busy shift.
example1_zh: 她忙着上班时，丈夫给她送来了午饭。
example2_en: When husbands share household responsibilities equally, both partners have more opportunities to pursue their careers.
example2_zh: 当丈夫平等分担家务时，伴侣双方都有更多机会发展事业。
collocations: her husband｜她的丈夫 ; husband and wife｜夫妻 ; husband resources｜节约使用资源
tip_zh: 作动词时较正式，表示节约使用资源。

meanings_zh: adj. 正确的；准确的 | v. 改正；纠正；批改 | adj. 恰当的；合适的
definition_en: free from mistakes and matching the facts | to identify mistakes or change something to make it right | suitable or accepted as proper for a particular situation
example1_en: You were correct about the keys being under the sofa.
example1_zh: 你说钥匙在沙发下面，果然没错。
example2_en: Teachers should help students correct their mistakes rather than simply provide them with the right answers.
example2_zh: 教师应帮助学生纠正错误，而不是仅仅给他们正确答案。
collocations: the correct answer｜正确答案 ; correct a mistake｜纠正错误 ; correct procedure｜正确流程 ; factually correct｜符合事实的
tip_zh: 既是形容词也是动词；correctly才是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 动物 | adj. 动物的
definition_en: a living creature that feeds on plants or other creatures | relating to animals rather than plants
example1_en: My sister loves watching animals at the local farm.
example1_zh: 我妹妹喜欢在当地农场看动物。
example2_en: Protecting animal habitats is essential because biodiversity supports stable ecosystems and benefits human wellbeing.
example2_zh: 保护动物栖息地至关重要，因为生物多样性有助于维持生态系统稳定，并造福人类。
collocations: wild animal｜野生动物 ; animal welfare｜动物福利 ; animal behaviour｜动物行为 ; animal habitat｜动物栖息地
tip_zh: animal 不仅指哺乳动物；鸟、鱼和昆虫也属于动物。

meanings_zh: adj. 口渴的 | adj. 渴望的
definition_en: feeling that you need or want a drink | having a strong desire for something
example1_en: I felt thirsty after walking home in the sun.
example1_zh: 我顶着太阳走回家后觉得口渴。
example2_en: Children who are thirsty for knowledge benefit from lessons that encourage questions and independent exploration.
example2_zh: 渴求知识的孩子能从鼓励提问和自主探索的课程中受益。
collocations: feel thirsty｜感到口渴 ; thirsty for knowledge｜渴求知识 ; make someone thirsty｜使某人口渴
tip_zh: 表示渴望某物用thirsty for，不用thirsty of。

meanings_zh: n. 说明；指示
definition_en: information telling you how to do something
example1_en: Read the instructions before you use the machine.
example1_zh: 使用机器前请阅读说明书。
example2_en: The instructions on the box are easy to follow.
example2_zh: 盒子上的说明很容易照着做。
collocations: follow the instructions｜按说明操作
tip_zh: instructions 常用复数，指使用说明或操作指示。

meanings_zh: n. 笔；钢笔 | n. 动物围栏；圈 | v. 撰写
definition_en: A tool that uses ink to write or draw. | A small enclosed area where animals are kept. | To write a letter, story or other piece of writing.
example1_en: Could you lend me a pen for this form?
example1_zh: 你能借我一支笔填这张表吗？
example2_en: Some students prefer using a pen because writing by hand helps them organise their ideas.
example2_zh: 有些学生更喜欢用笔，因为手写有助于他们整理思路。
collocations: ballpoint pen｜圆珠笔 ; fountain pen｜钢笔 ; a sheep pen｜羊圈 ; pen a letter｜写一封信
tip_zh: pen泛指墨水笔；钢笔可明确说fountain pen。

meanings_zh: v. 离开；出发 | v. 留下；忘带 | n. 休假；假期
definition_en: To go away from a person or place. | To let something remain somewhere, deliberately or accidentally. | An officially allowed period away from work.
example1_en: We need to leave before the traffic gets worse.
example1_zh: 我们得在交通变得更拥堵之前出发。
example2_en: Paid parental leave allows new parents to care for their children without immediately returning to work.
example2_zh: 带薪育儿假让新手父母能够照顾孩子，而不必立即重返工作岗位。
collocations: leave home｜离家 ; leave a message｜留言 ; leave for｜动身前往 ; annual leave｜年假
tip_zh: leave 的过去式和过去分词均为 left。

meanings_zh: n. 足球运动员
definition_en: a person who plays football
example1_en: She is a talented footballer on the school team.
example1_zh: 她是校队里很有天赋的足球运动员。
example2_en: The footballer waved to the fans after the game.
example2_zh: 比赛结束后，这位足球运动员向球迷挥手。
tip_zh: footballer 是英式常用说法，即足球运动员。

meanings_zh: n. 窗；窗户 | n. 电脑窗口 | n. 可利用的短暂时机
definition_en: An opening with glass that lets light into a building | An area on a screen displaying a program or document | A limited period when something can be done
example1_en: Please open the window and let some fresh air in.
example1_zh: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。
example2_en: Installing larger windows can reduce the need for artificial lighting in homes during daylight hours.
example2_zh: 安装更大的窗户可以减少住宅在白天对人工照明的需求。
collocations: open a window｜打开窗户 ; window frame｜窗框 ; browser window｜浏览器窗口 ; a window of opportunity｜机会之窗
tip_zh: 电脑窗口也叫window；机会之窗强调时机有限。

meanings_zh: v. 骑；乘坐 | n. 乘车行程；骑行
definition_en: To travel on a bicycle, animal, or vehicle. | A journey on a bicycle, animal, or vehicle.
example1_en: We ride our bikes to the lake every weekend.
example1_zh: 我们每个周末都骑自行车去湖边。
example2_en: Safer cycling routes could encourage more residents to ride bicycles rather than drive for short urban journeys.
example2_zh: 更安全的自行车道可以鼓励更多居民在城市短途出行时骑车，而不是开车。
collocations: ride a bike｜骑自行车 ; ride a horse｜骑马 ; go for a ride｜骑车或乘车兜风 ; give someone a ride｜让某人搭车
tip_zh: 不规则变化：ride—rode—ridden。

meanings_zh: n. 腿 | n. 家具的腿；支脚 | n. 一段行程
definition_en: a body part used for standing and walking | a support beneath a table, chair, or similar object | one stage of a journey or race
example1_en: My legs felt tired after the long walk home.
example1_zh: 走了很长一段路回家后，我的双腿很累。
example2_en: Regular walking strengthens the muscles in our legs and can improve health without expensive equipment.
example2_zh: 经常步行能增强腿部肌肉，无需昂贵器材就能改善健康。
collocations: stretch your legs｜活动一下腿脚 ; a table leg｜桌腿 ; the final leg of a journey｜旅程的最后一段
tip_zh: leg也指桌椅的支脚或旅程中的一段。

meanings_zh: n. 番茄；西红柿
definition_en: a soft, juicy fruit often eaten as a vegetable
example1_en: She sliced a ripe tomato for her cheese sandwich.
example1_zh: 她切了一个熟番茄，放进奶酪三明治里。
example2_en: Growing tomatoes in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 在社区花园种植番茄，可以让城市居民更容易获得新鲜食物。
collocations: ripe tomato｜熟番茄 ; tomato sauce｜番茄酱汁 ; cherry tomato｜圣女果
tip_zh: 复数是tomatoes；英美发音的重读元音不同。

meanings_zh: v. 尝试；试图 | v. 试用；试验 | n. 尝试
definition_en: make an effort to do something | use or do something to see whether it works | an attempt to do something
example1_en: I'll try to fix the lamp before dinner.
example1_zh: 我会试着在晚饭前把灯修好。
example2_en: Schools should try different teaching methods to meet the needs of students with varying abilities.
example2_zh: 学校应尝试不同的教学方法，以满足能力各异的学生的需求。
collocations: try to do something｜努力做某事 ; try doing something｜试着做某事 ; give it a try｜试一试 ; try on clothes｜试穿衣服
tip_zh: try to do强调努力；try doing强调试试办法。

meanings_zh: n. 生物学 | n. 生物特征；生理机制
definition_en: the scientific study of living things | the natural processes and characteristics of a living thing
example1_en: We examined onion cells under microscopes in biology today.
example1_zh: 今天的生物课上，我们用显微镜观察了洋葱细胞。
example2_en: A basic understanding of biology helps people evaluate health information and make informed decisions about their lifestyles.
example2_zh: 掌握基础生物学知识有助于人们评估健康信息，并对生活方式作出明智决定。
collocations: study biology｜学习生物学 ; marine biology｜海洋生物学 ; human biology｜人体生物学 ; molecular biology｜分子生物学
tip_zh: 学科名称，通常不可数；生物学家是biologist。

meanings_zh: n. 画家 | n. 油漆工
definition_en: Someone who creates pictures using paint. | Someone whose job is painting buildings or other surfaces.
example1_en: The painter mixed blue and green on her palette.
example1_zh: 画家在调色板上混合蓝色和绿色。
example2_en: Local painters can preserve cultural traditions while introducing younger audiences to new artistic styles.
example2_zh: 当地画家既能传承文化传统，也能让年轻观众接触新的艺术风格。
collocations: a landscape painter｜风景画家 ; a portrait painter｜肖像画家 ; a house painter｜房屋油漆工
tip_zh: 既可指艺术画家，也可指刷墙的油漆工。

meanings_zh: n. 气球 | n. 热气球
definition_en: A thin rubber bag filled with air or gas. | A large gas-filled bag carrying people in a basket.
example1_en: A yellow balloon floated above the birthday cake.
example1_zh: 一只黄色气球飘在生日蛋糕上方。
example2_en: Releasing balloons outdoors can harm wildlife when the rubber fragments fall into rivers and oceans.
example2_zh: 在户外放飞气球可能危害野生动物，因为橡胶碎片会落入河流和海洋。
collocations: blow up a balloon｜吹气球 ; hot-air balloon｜热气球 ; release balloons｜放飞气球
