tip_zh: blow up a balloon指吹气球，不是炸毁气球。

meanings_zh: pron. 没有人
definition_en: not anybody
example1_en: No one was in the classroom after school.
example1_zh: 放学后教室里没有人。
example2_en: She called, but no one answered.
example2_zh: 她打了电话，但没人接。
tip_zh: no one 和 nobody 同义，都是“没有人”；谓语用单数。

meanings_zh: n. 餐馆；餐厅
definition_en: A place where people pay to eat prepared meals.
example1_en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边找到了一家安静的餐馆。
example2_en: Local restaurants can attract tourists by serving traditional dishes made with ingredients from nearby farms.
example2_zh: 当地餐馆可以用附近农场的食材制作传统菜肴，以此吸引游客。
collocations: book a table at a restaurant｜预订餐馆座位 ; run a restaurant｜经营餐馆 ; a seafood restaurant｜海鲜餐馆
tip_zh: restaurant指用餐场所；hotel主要指住宿的酒店。

meanings_zh: n. 公共汽车 | v. 用公共汽车运送
definition_en: a large road vehicle that carries passengers | to transport people somewhere by bus
example1_en: We caught the last bus home after the concert.
example1_zh: 音乐会结束后，我们赶上了回家的末班公交车。
example2_en: More frequent bus services could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in outer suburbs.
example2_zh: 增加公交班次可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善远郊居民的就业出行条件。
collocations: catch a bus｜赶上公交车 ; bus stop｜公交车站 ; bus route｜公交线路 ; by bus｜乘公共汽车
tip_zh: by bus不加冠词；take a bus需加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 父亲；爸爸 | n. 奠基人；创始人 | v. 成为…的生父
definition_en: A male parent. | A man who established or greatly influenced a field. | To become the biological father of a child.
example1_en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
example1_zh: 她爸爸教她骑自行车。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can allow fathers to take a more active role in raising their children.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排可以让父亲更积极地参与养育子女。
collocations: single father｜单亲父亲 ; father figure｜父亲般的人物 ; biological father｜生父 ; the father of modern medicine｜现代医学之父
tip_zh: father较正式，dad更口语化；父亲节用Father's Day。

meanings_zh: n. 脚；足 | n. 英尺 | n. 底部；下端
definition_en: the body part below the ankle used for standing and walking | a unit of length equal to twelve inches | the lowest part of something tall or sloping
example1_en: A tiny stone in my shoe hurt my foot.
example1_zh: 鞋里的一颗小石子硌疼了我的脚。
example2_en: Making essential services accessible on foot can encourage physical activity and reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 让人们步行就能获得基本服务，可以促进身体活动并减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: on foot｜步行 ; at the foot of｜在……底部 ; set foot in｜踏入 ; foot the bill｜支付账单
tip_zh: 脚和英尺的复数均为feet；步行用on foot。

meanings_zh: pron. 他（宾格）
definition_en: used for a male person receiving an action or following a preposition
example1_en: My brother forgot his lunch, so I brought it to him.
example1_zh: 我哥哥忘了带午饭，所以我给他送了过去。
example2_en: When a student struggles with reading, teachers can support him through regular practice and constructive feedback.
example2_zh: 当一名男学生阅读有困难时，教师可以通过定期练习和建设性反馈帮助他。
collocations: help him｜帮助他 ; with him｜和他一起 ; give him a chance｜给他一个机会
tip_zh: he作主语，him作动词或介词的宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 足球运动员
definition_en: a person who plays football
example1_en: His dream is to become a famous football player.
example1_zh: 他的梦想是成为著名的足球运动员。
example2_en: The football player scored two goals in the match.
example2_zh: 这名足球运动员在比赛中进了两个球。
tip_zh: football player 和 footballer 意思相同，都是足球运动员。

meanings_zh: adj. 成功的；有成效的 | adj. 事业有成的
definition_en: Achieving the result that was wanted or intended. | Having achieved wealth, respect, or a good position.
example1_en: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
example1_zh: 我们第一次尝试烤面包，出乎意料地成功了。
example2_en: Successful recycling programmes depend on convenient collection facilities and clear guidance for households and businesses.
example2_zh: 成功的回收计划依赖便利的收集设施，以及面向家庭和企业的明确指引。
collocations: successful career｜成功的职业生涯 ; successful outcome｜圆满的结果 ; highly successful｜非常成功 ; successful in doing something｜成功做成某事
tip_zh: 常用be successful in doing；动词为succeed。

meanings_zh: n. 话题；主题；学科 | adj. 受……影响的；取决于 | v. 使遭受；使经历
definition_en: Something discussed, studied, or taught. | Affected by something or dependent on a condition. | To make someone experience something, especially something unpleasant.
example1_en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
example1_zh: 我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。
example2_en: Schools should give creative subjects sufficient attention because they help students develop imagination and problem-solving skills.
example2_zh: 学校应给予创意类学科充分重视，因为这些学科有助于培养学生的想象力和解决问题的能力。
collocations: school subject｜学校科目 ; change the subject｜转移话题 ; subject to approval｜须经批准 ; subject someone to stress｜使某人承受压力
tip_zh: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

meanings_zh: phr. 下午；午后
definition_en: in the afternoon or evening, after midday
example1_en: The film starts at seven p.m.
example1_zh: 电影晚上七点开始。
example2_en: Classes end at five p.m.
example2_zh: 课程下午五点结束。
tip_zh: p.m. 表示下午/晚上（正午之后）；a.m. 表示上午。

meanings_zh: n. 开始；开端
definition_en: The first part or starting point of something.
example1_en: We missed the beginning of the film yesterday.
example1_zh: 我们昨天错过了电影的开头。
example2_en: The beginning of formal education marks an important stage in a child's social development.
example2_zh: 正规教育的开始标志着儿童社会性发展的一个重要阶段。
collocations: at the beginning of｜在……开始时 ; from beginning to end｜从头到尾 ; a new beginning｜新的开始
tip_zh: at the beginning of后接名词；in the beginning表示起初。

meanings_zh: adj. 脏的 | adj. 卑鄙的；不公平的 | v. 弄脏；变脏
definition_en: Covered with dirt or other unwanted substances. | Dishonest or unfair, especially when trying to gain an advantage. | To make something dirty or become dirty.
example1_en: Please leave your dirty boots outside the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 请把你的脏靴子放在厨房门外。
example2_en: Limited access to clean water forces many communities to rely on dirty sources that can spread disease.
example2_zh: 清洁水源不足迫使许多社区依赖可能传播疾病的污浊水源。
collocations: dirty clothes｜脏衣服 ; dirty water｜污水 ; get dirty｜弄脏 ; dirty tricks｜卑鄙伎俩
tip_zh: 比较级dirtier，最高级dirtiest。

meanings_zh: v. 适合；合心意 | v. 使显得好看；相配 | n. 一套西装；套装
definition_en: to be convenient or right for someone | to make someone look attractive | matching clothes consisting of a jacket and trousers or skirt
example1_en: Would an earlier appointment suit you better tomorrow?
example1_zh: 明天把预约时间提前一点会更适合你吗？
example2_en: Flexible working hours suit employees who need to balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间适合需要兼顾工作职责与家庭责任的员工。
collocations: suit your needs｜满足你的需求 ; suit everyone｜适合所有人 ; a business suit｜商务西装
tip_zh: suit强调合适或好看；fit强调尺寸合身。

meanings_zh: det. 那；那个 | pron. 那个；那件事；关系代词 | conj. 引导陈述性从句
definition_en: used before a noun to identify something farther away | refers to something indicated, or introduces a defining relative clause | introduces a clause expressing a statement, belief, or fact
example1_en: Could you pass me that bowl beside the window?
example1_zh: 你能把窗边的那个碗递给我吗？
example2_en: Research suggests that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
example2_zh: 研究表明，能够接触绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。
collocations: at that time｜在那时 ; that kind of｜那种 ; now that｜既然 ; so that｜以便
tip_zh: 作指示词时复数为those；引导宾语从句常可省略。

meanings_zh: adj. 害怕的；恐惧的
definition_en: Feeling afraid of something or worried that something bad might happen.
example1_en: The puppy looked scared when it heard the thunder.
example1_zh: 小狗听到雷声时显得很害怕。
example2_en: Students who are scared of making mistakes may avoid speaking during foreign language lessons.
example2_zh: 害怕犯错的学生可能会在外语课上避免开口。
collocations: scared of｜害怕…… ; scared to ask｜不敢问 ; scared stiff｜吓得僵住
tip_zh: scared形容感到害怕；scary形容令人害怕。

meanings_zh: phr v. 外出；出门
definition_en: to leave home to do something
example1_en: We are going out for dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 我们今晚出去吃晚饭。
example2_en: She goes out with her friends every Saturday.
example2_zh: 她每周六和朋友一起出去。
collocations: go out with someone｜和某人约会
tip_zh: go out 表示“外出”；go out with sb 表示“与某人交往”。

meanings_zh: n. 票；入场券 | n. 交通违章罚单 | v. 向……开交通罚单
definition_en: A paper or electronic pass allowing travel or entry. | An official notice requiring payment for a traffic offence. | To give someone an official notice for a traffic offence.
example1_en: I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
example1_zh: 我在车站的售票机上买了一张往返票。
example2_en: Lower ticket prices could encourage more commuters to choose trains instead of driving to work.
example2_zh: 降低票价可以鼓励更多通勤者选择乘火车而非开车上班。
collocations: return ticket｜往返票 ; single ticket｜单程票 ; parking ticket｜违章停车罚单 ; book a ticket｜订票
tip_zh: 英式single/return ticket分别指单程票和往返票。

meanings_zh: n. 点；小圆点 | v. 散布于；点缀 | n. 网址或邮箱中的点
definition_en: a small round mark | to appear in scattered places across an area | the spoken name for a full stop in online addresses
example1_en: Her yellow umbrella has a pattern of blue dots.
example1_zh: 她的黄色雨伞上有蓝色圆点图案。
example2_en: Small villages dot the coastline, attracting visitors who prefer quieter alternatives to crowded seaside resorts.
example2_zh: 小村庄散布在海岸线上，吸引了那些偏爱宁静而非拥挤海滨度假区的游客。
collocations: a red dot｜一个红点 ; on the dot｜准时 ; dotted line｜虚线 ; be dotted with｜散布着
tip_zh: on the dot表示准时，常接在具体时刻之后。

meanings_zh: n. 风筝 | n. 鸢
definition_en: A lightweight frame flown in the wind on a string | A bird of prey with long wings and often a forked tail
example1_en: We flew a bright kite on the windy beach.
example1_zh: 我们在风大的海滩上放了一只色彩鲜艳的风筝。
example2_en: Outdoor activities such as flying kites offer families affordable recreation and encourage children to spend time away from screens.
example2_zh: 放风筝等户外活动为家庭提供了经济实惠的娱乐方式，也鼓励孩子暂时远离屏幕。
collocations: fly a kite｜放风筝 ; kite string｜风筝线 ; kite flying｜放风筝活动
tip_zh: “放风筝”用 fly a kite，不用 play a kite。

meanings_zh: n. 行动；措施 | n. 行为；举动 | n. 精彩刺激的场面；剧情
definition_en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem. | A particular thing that someone does. | Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.
example1_en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
example1_zh: 我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。
example2_en: Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.
example2_zh: 政府必须紧急采取行动，保护沿海社区免受日益加剧的气候变化风险影响。
collocations: take action｜采取行动 ; urgent action｜紧急行动 ; course of action｜行动方案 ; action film｜动作片
tip_zh: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。

meanings_zh: num. 第二 | n. 秒；片刻 | v. 附议；支持提议
definition_en: Coming immediately after the first in an order. | A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute. | To formally support a proposal made by someone else.
example1_en: This is my second cup of tea today.
example1_zh: 这是我今天喝的第二杯茶。
example2_en: Learning a second language can broaden career opportunities and help students understand perspectives from other cultures.
example2_zh: 学习第二语言可以拓宽职业机会，并帮助学生理解其他文化的观点。
collocations: second place｜第二名 ; a second chance｜第二次机会 ; a split second｜一瞬间 ; second a motion｜附议动议
tip_zh: the second指第二个；a second可指又一个。

meanings_zh: n. 耳机（头戴式）
definition_en: earphones you wear over your head to listen to music
example1_en: She listens to English songs with headphones on.
example1_zh: 她戴着耳机听英文歌。
example2_en: He put on his headphones and started studying.
example2_zh: 他戴上耳机开始学习。
collocations: a pair of headphones｜一副耳机
tip_zh: headphones 常用复数；一副耳机说 a pair of headphones。

meanings_zh: n. 客人；受邀嘉宾 | n. 旅馆住客
definition_en: Someone invited to visit a home or attend an event. | Someone staying at a hotel or similar accommodation.
example1_en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
example1_zh: 每位客人都带了一道菜，在晚餐时与大家分享。
example2_en: Hotels can encourage guests to conserve water by offering towel replacement only when requested.
example2_zh: 酒店可以仅在住客提出要求时更换毛巾，以鼓励节水。
collocations: invite guests｜邀请客人 ; hotel guest｜酒店住客 ; guest speaker｜特邀演讲者 ; guest room｜客房
tip_zh: guest可指受邀客人，也可指付费的酒店住客。

meanings_zh: n. 屏幕；银幕 | v. 筛查；审查 | v. 放映；播出
definition_en: A surface on which electronic images or films appear. | To check people or things for problems or suitability. | To show a film or programme to an audience.
example1_en: I wiped the fingerprints off my laptop screen.
example1_zh: 我擦掉了笔记本电脑屏幕上的指纹。
example2_en: Health services should screen vulnerable patients regularly to detect diseases before serious symptoms develop.
example2_zh: 医疗服务机构应定期对易患病患者进行筛查，在严重症状出现前发现疾病。
collocations: screen time｜屏幕使用时间 ; touch screen｜触摸屏 ; screen for disease｜筛查疾病 ; screen a film｜放映电影
tip_zh: screen A for B表示检查A是否存在B问题。

meanings_zh: n. 潜水；潜水运动 | n. 跳水；跳水运动
definition_en: the activity of swimming underwater, often using special breathing equipment | the sport of jumping into water, often with controlled movements
example1_en: We went diving and saw colourful fish near the reef.
example1_zh: 我们去潜水，在礁石附近看到了色彩鲜艳的鱼。
example2_en: Diving tourism can support coastal economies, provided operators protect marine habitats and teach visitors responsible behaviour.
example2_zh: 潜水旅游可以促进沿海经济，前提是经营者保护海洋栖息地并教导游客负责任地行动。
collocations: scuba diving｜水肺潜水 ; a diving board｜跳板 ; diving equipment｜潜水装备 ; a diving instructor｜潜水教练
tip_zh: go diving 常指去潜水；跳水运动也叫 diving。

meanings_zh: n. 搭档；合作伙伴；合伙人 | n. 配偶；伴侣 | v. 与…搭档；合作
definition_en: Someone you work, play, or share a business with. | Someone you share a romantic relationship or married life with. | Work or take part in an activity with someone.
example1_en: My dance partner waited patiently while I practised.
example1_zh: 我练习时，我的舞伴耐心地等着。
example2_en: Universities can partner with local businesses to offer students practical experience before they enter the workforce.
example2_zh: 大学可以与当地企业合作，让学生在就业前获得实践经验。
collocations: business partner｜商业伙伴；合伙人 ; dance partner｜舞伴 ; life partner｜终身伴侣 ; partner with｜与…合作
tip_zh: partner不表明性别；作动词常用partner with。

meanings_zh: n. 羽毛球运动
definition_en: A sport involving hitting a shuttlecock over a net with rackets
example1_en: We play badminton at the sports centre every Saturday.
example1_zh: 我们每周六都在体育中心打羽毛球。
example2_en: Schools can encourage regular exercise by offering accessible activities such as badminton and swimming.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过提供羽毛球和游泳等易于参与的活动来鼓励学生经常锻炼。
collocations: play badminton｜打羽毛球 ; badminton court｜羽毛球场 ; badminton racket｜羽毛球拍
tip_zh: 运动名通常不可数；“打羽毛球”用play badminton。

meanings_zh: pron. 没有人 | n. 无名小卒
definition_en: not a single person | a person considered unimportant or unknown
example1_en: Nobody noticed the kitten sleeping behind the sofa.
example1_zh: 没人注意到睡在沙发后面的小猫。
example2_en: Nobody should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.
example2_zh: 任何人都不应因家庭付不起学费而被剥夺受教育的机会。
collocations: nobody else｜没有其他人 ; almost nobody｜几乎没有人 ; nobody knows｜无人知晓
tip_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数；本身含否定意义。

meanings_zh: n. 海岸；海滨 | v. 滑行；靠惯性前进 | v. 不费力地应付
definition_en: the land along the edge of the sea | to move without using power or much effort | to succeed or progress without trying very hard
example1_en: We walked along the coast and collected smooth stones.
example1_zh: 我们沿着海岸散步，捡了一些光滑的石头。
example2_en: Communities along the coast face increasing risks from rising sea levels and severe storms.
example2_zh: 沿海社区面临着海平面上升和强风暴带来的日益严重的风险。
collocations: along the coast｜沿着海岸 ; off the coast｜在近海海域 ; coast downhill｜顺坡滑行 ; coast through｜轻松应付
tip_zh: on the coast指在海边；off the coast指在近海。

meanings_zh: v. 进入 | v. 参加；加入 | v. 输入；录入
definition_en: To go or come into a place. | To become involved in a competition, activity, or organisation. | To put information into a computer or official record.
example1_en: Please wipe your shoes before you enter the kitchen.
example1_zh: 进入厨房前，请把鞋底擦干净。
example2_en: Young people often need practical training before they enter the workforce and take on professional responsibilities.
example2_zh: 年轻人在进入职场、承担职业责任之前，往往需要接受实践培训。
collocations: enter a competition｜参加比赛 ; enter the workforce｜进入职场 ; enter data｜输入数据 ; enter a room｜进入房间
tip_zh: 进入某地用enter a place，不加into。

meanings_zh: n. 地板；室内地面 | n. 楼层 | n. 海底；谷底
definition_en: The surface inside a building that people walk on. | A level of a building. | The bottom surface of a sea, valley, or similar area.
example1_en: My keys fell onto the kitchen floor again.
example1_zh: 我的钥匙又掉到厨房地板上了。
example2_en: Converting unused upper floors into apartments could help cities address housing shortages without expanding outwards.
example2_zh: 把闲置的较高楼层改建成公寓，有助于城市在不向外扩张的情况下缓解住房短缺。
collocations: wooden floor｜木地板 ; ground floor｜底层 ; top floor｜顶层 ; ocean floor｜海底
tip_zh: 英式first floor是二楼；美式first floor是一楼。

meanings_zh: n. 农场 | v. 务农；耕种；养殖
definition_en: land and buildings used for growing crops or raising animals | to grow crops or raise animals for food or other products
example1_en: We bought fresh eggs from a nearby farm.
example1_zh: 我们从附近的农场买了新鲜鸡蛋。
example2_en: Small farms can support local food supplies while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.
example2_zh: 小型农场既能支持当地食品供应，也能为农村社区创造就业机会。
collocations: a dairy farm｜奶牛场 ; work on a farm｜在农场工作 ; farm animals｜农场牲畜 ; farm the land｜耕种土地
tip_zh: 表示在农场通常用on a farm，不用in。

meanings_zh: adj. 低的；少的 | adj. 情绪低落的 | adv. 在低处；低声地
definition_en: Not high in position, amount, level, or degree. | Feeling sad or lacking confidence. | At a small height, level, or volume.
example1_en: The low shelf is easy for children to reach.
example1_zh: 这个低矮的架子很方便孩子们取东西。
example2_en: Low wages can prevent essential workers from finding affordable housing close to their places of employment.
example2_zh: 低工资可能让从事必要服务的劳动者难以在工作地点附近找到负担得起的住房。
collocations: low income｜低收入 ; low temperatures｜低温 ; feel low｜情绪低落 ; run low on｜所剩不多
tip_zh: 价格低用low，东西便宜用cheap。

meanings_zh: n. 城堡
definition_en: A large fortified building with thick walls and towers.
example1_en: We climbed the hill to explore the old castle.
example1_zh: 我们爬上山丘，去探索那座古堡。
example2_en: Restoring a historic castle can attract tourists while preserving valuable evidence of a region's architectural heritage.
example2_zh: 修复历史城堡既能吸引游客，也能保留体现当地建筑遗产的珍贵实物。
collocations: medieval castle｜中世纪城堡 ; castle walls｜城堡城墙 ; ruined castle｜残破的城堡
tip_zh: castle中的t不发音；palace指宫殿。

meanings_zh: adj. 糟糕的；令人难受的
definition_en: Extremely bad or unpleasant.
example1_en: The soup tasted awful, so I made a sandwich.
example1_zh: 这汤太难喝了，所以我做了个三明治。
example2_en: Residents described the awful conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter safety standards.
example2_zh: 居民描述了过度拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁制定更严格的安全标准。
collocations: awful weather｜糟糕的天气 ; feel awful｜感觉很难受 ; awful smell｜难闻的气味
tip_zh: feel awful可指身体难受，也可指内疚或心情差。

meanings_zh: n. 绘画作品；画 | n. 绘画；画画 | n. 刷漆；粉刷
definition_en: A picture made using paint. | The activity of creating pictures with paint. | The activity of covering a surface with paint.
example1_en: We hung a colourful painting above the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们在沙发上方挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。
example2_en: Public galleries make important paintings accessible to everyone, regardless of their income or educational background.
example2_zh: 公共美术馆让所有人都能欣赏重要画作，不受收入或教育背景的限制。
collocations: oil painting｜油画 ; landscape painting｜风景画 ; abstract painting｜抽象画 ; house painting｜房屋粉刷
tip_zh: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 文字；文本 | n. 短信 | v. 发短信
definition_en: Written words, especially the main written content of something. | A short written message sent using a phone. | Send someone a short written message using a phone.
example1_en: The text on this menu is too small.
example1_zh: 这份菜单上的字太小了。
example2_en: Teachers can combine text with images to help students understand complex scientific concepts more easily.
example2_zh: 教师可以将文字与图像结合，帮助学生更轻松地理解复杂的科学概念。
collocations: text message｜短信 ; plain text｜纯文本 ; text someone｜给某人发短信
tip_zh: 文字内容通常不可数；一条短信可说a text。

meanings_zh: n. 地图 | v. 绘制地图；标出分布
definition_en: A drawing showing where places or features are located | To draw or record the position of places or features
example1_en: We spread the map across the table before leaving.
example1_zh: 出发前，我们把地图铺在桌上。
example2_en: Researchers use satellite images to map changes in forest cover and identify areas needing urgent protection.
example2_zh: 研究人员利用卫星图像绘制森林覆盖变化图，并确定急需保护的区域。
collocations: read a map｜看地图 ; street map｜街道地图 ; map out a route｜规划路线 ; map changes｜绘制变化分布图
tip_zh: map作动词时，过去式mapped，分词mapping。

meanings_zh: v. 移动；搬家 | v. 使感动 | n. 行动；举措
definition_en: To change position or go to live somewhere else. | To make someone feel a strong emotion. | An action taken to achieve a particular result.
example1_en: Could you move this chair closer to the window?
example1_zh: 你能把这把椅子挪到靠窗一点的位置吗？
example2_en: The decision to expand public transport is a positive move towards reducing urban congestion.
example2_zh: 扩大公共交通的决定是缓解城市拥堵的一项积极举措。
collocations: move house｜搬家 ; move forward｜向前移动；取得进展 ; be deeply moved｜深受感动 ; a positive move｜积极举措
tip_zh: moving指令人感动的，moved指感到感动的。

meanings_zh: n. 浴缸
definition_en: A large container that you sit in to wash your body.
example1_en: The kitten watched water dripping into the empty bathtub.
example1_zh: 小猫看着水滴进空浴缸。
example2_en: Replacing a bathtub with a shower can save space in small urban apartments.
example2_zh: 在小型城市公寓中，用淋浴设施替换浴缸可以节省空间。
collocations: fill the bathtub｜往浴缸放水 ; an empty bathtub｜空浴缸 ; a freestanding bathtub｜独立式浴缸
tip_zh: bathtub尤常用于美式英语；英式常说bath。

meanings_zh: v. 发送；寄送 | v. 派遣；打发
definition_en: To make something go or be delivered to another place. | To arrange for someone to go somewhere.
example1_en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
example1_zh: 请发一张你家新养的小狗的照片给我。
example2_en: Governments should send medical teams to isolated communities that lack access to basic healthcare.
example2_zh: 政府应向缺乏基本医疗服务的偏远社区派遣医疗队。
collocations: send a message｜发送消息 ; send a parcel｜寄包裹 ; send someone to do something｜派某人去做某事
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sent；可用send sth to sb。

meanings_zh: n. 岩石；石块 | n. 摇滚乐 | v. 摇动；摇晃
definition_en: The hard natural material forming much of Earth's surface. | Popular music with a strong beat, often featuring electric guitars. | Move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.
example1_en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们坐在河边一块平坦的岩石上。
example2_en: Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
example2_zh: 研究古老的岩层有助于科学家了解地球气候随时间发生的变化。
collocations: solid rock｜坚硬的岩石 ; rock music｜摇滚乐 ; rock formation｜岩层；岩石构造 ; rock a baby｜轻摇婴儿
tip_zh: rock 作岩石材料不可数；指一块石头时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 抽屉
definition_en: a sliding storage compartment in a desk or other furniture
example1_en: I keep spare keys in the top kitchen drawer.
example1_zh: 我把备用钥匙放在厨房最上面的抽屉里。
example2_en: Office desks with lockable drawers help employees store personal belongings securely in shared working environments.
example2_zh: 配有可上锁抽屉的办公桌有助于员工在共享办公环境中安全存放私人物品。
collocations: open a drawer｜打开抽屉 ; top drawer｜最上层抽屉 ; desk drawer｜书桌抽屉 ; chest of drawers｜抽屉柜
tip_zh: 抽屉是drawer；衣橱是wardrobe。

meanings_zh: n. 橡胶 | n. 橡皮擦
definition_en: an elastic material used to make tyres and other products | a small object used to remove pencil marks
example1_en: These rubber boots keep my feet dry in puddles.
example1_zh: 这双橡胶靴让我踩水坑时双脚也不会湿。
example2_en: Recycling rubber from used tyres can reduce waste and provide material for safer playground surfaces.
example2_zh: 回收废旧轮胎中的橡胶可以减少废物，并为更安全的游乐场地面提供材料。
collocations: natural rubber｜天然橡胶 ; rubber band｜橡皮筋 ; rubber gloves｜橡胶手套 ; rubber boots｜橡胶靴
tip_zh: 橡胶不可数；橡皮擦可数，美式英语通常用eraser。

meanings_zh: v. 混合；拌和 | n. 混合物；组合 | v. 交往；相处
definition_en: To combine different substances or things. | A combination of different substances, people, or things. | To spend time socially with other people.
example1_en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
example1_zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋放进大碗里拌匀。
example2_en: Successful neighbourhoods often contain a mix of housing types that serve people with different incomes.
example2_zh: 成功的社区通常包含多种住房类型，以满足不同收入人群的需求。
collocations: mix ingredients｜混合原料 ; mix with others｜与他人交往 ; a diverse mix｜多样化的组合 ; mix things up｜把东西弄混
tip_zh: mix A with B指混合；mix A up with B指混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 电；电力
definition_en: Energy carried by charged particles, used to power devices
example1_en: The storm cut off electricity to our entire street.
example1_zh: 暴风雨导致我们整条街停电了。
example2_en: Generating electricity from renewable sources can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
example2_zh: 利用可再生能源发电可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低温室气体排放。
collocations: generate electricity｜发电 ; electricity supply｜电力供应 ; an electricity bill｜电费账单 ; save electricity｜节约用电
tip_zh: electricity不可数；electric多指用电的，electrical指电相关的。

meanings_zh: n. 斑马
definition_en: an African wild animal with black and white stripes
example1_en: A zebra stood quietly beside the watering hole.
example1_zh: 一匹斑马静静地站在水塘旁。
example2_en: Protecting grasslands helps zebra populations survive while preserving habitats for many other wild animals.
example2_zh: 保护草原有助于斑马种群生存，同时也为许多其他野生动物保留栖息地。
collocations: a herd of zebras｜一群斑马 ; zebra stripes｜斑马条纹 ; zebra crossing｜斑马线
tip_zh: zebra crossing 是英式英语中的斑马线。

meanings_zh: n. 清单；名单 | v. 列出
definition_en: Related items or names written one below another. | To write or state items one after another.
example1_en: I made a shopping list before leaving home.
example1_zh: 出门前，我列了一张购物清单。
example2_en: The report lists several practical measures that cities can adopt to reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 这份报告列出了城市可以采取的几项缓解交通拥堵的实用措施。
collocations: make a list｜列清单 ; shopping list｜购物清单 ; waiting list｜候补名单
tip_zh: 在名单上用on the list，不用in。

meanings_zh: n. 洗发水 | v. 用洗发水洗头
definition_en: a liquid product used to wash hair | to wash hair using shampoo
example1_en: I packed a small bottle of shampoo for our trip.
example1_zh: 我为这次旅行装了一小瓶洗发水。
example2_en: Using refillable shampoo containers can reduce plastic waste generated by households and the tourism industry.
example2_zh: 使用可补充装的洗发水容器可以减少家庭和旅游业产生的塑料垃圾。
collocations: a bottle of shampoo｜一瓶洗发水 ; mild shampoo｜温和洗发水 ; shampoo your hair｜用洗发水洗头 ; dry shampoo｜干洗洗发剂
tip_zh: 泛指洗发水通常不可数；一瓶用a bottle of shampoo。

meanings_zh: n. 网；网状物 | adj. 净的；扣除费用后的 | v. 净赚；获得
definition_en: material made of crossing threads with spaces between them | remaining after costs, taxes, or other amounts have been deducted | to earn as profit or successfully obtain something
example1_en: A small silver fish wriggled inside the fishing net.
example1_zh: 一条银色的小鱼在渔网里扭动。
example2_en: The company increased its net profit by reducing energy consumption rather than raising prices for customers.
example2_zh: 这家公司通过减少能源消耗而非提高售价来增加净利润。
collocations: fishing net｜渔网 ; net profit｜净利润 ; net income｜净收入 ; net gain｜净增益
tip_zh: net指扣除成本或税款后的净额；gross指扣除前的总额。

meanings_zh: v. 遇见；会面；结识 | v. 满足；达到
definition_en: come together with someone, by arrangement or chance | fulfil a need or reach a required standard
example1_en: Let's meet outside the library after lunch today.
example1_zh: 我们今天午饭后在图书馆外见吧。
example2_en: Public transport services must meet the needs of residents who cannot afford private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通服务必须满足那些买不起私家车的居民的需求。
collocations: meet someone for the first time｜初次见到某人 ; meet requirements｜符合要求 ; meet a deadline｜按期完成 ; meet demand｜满足需求
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为met；meet要求时意为满足。

meanings_zh: v. 停留；暂住 | v. 保持某种状态 | n. 停留；暂住期间
definition_en: To remain in a place or live somewhere temporarily. | To continue being in a particular condition. | A period spent living or visiting somewhere.
example1_en: We stayed at a small hotel beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们住在湖边的一家小旅馆里。
example2_en: Tourists who stay longer in rural areas may contribute more to local businesses than short-term visitors.
example2_zh: 比起短期游客，在乡村停留更久的游客可能为当地商家带来更多收益。
collocations: stay at a hotel｜住旅馆 ; stay healthy｜保持健康 ; stay in touch｜保持联系 ; a short stay｜短暂停留
tip_zh: stay后可直接接形容词，如stay calm保持冷静。

meanings_zh: adj. 快乐的；高兴的
definition_en: feeling pleased and cheerful
example1_en: The children look happy playing in the garden.
example1_zh: 孩子们在花园里玩得很开心。
example2_en: I am happy to help you with your homework.
example2_zh: 我很乐意帮你做作业。
collocations: be happy with｜对…满意
tip_zh: happy 的名词是 happiness；be happy with 表示“对…满意”。

meanings_zh: n. 成绩；等级 | n. 年级 | v. 评分；分级
definition_en: a mark showing achievement, or a level of quality | a school year level, especially in the American system | to assess work or sort things by quality
example1_en: I got a good grade on my science project.
example1_zh: 我的科学课项目得了个好成绩。
example2_en: Teachers should grade assignments consistently so that students understand how their performance is assessed across different subjects.
example2_zh: 教师应按一致的标准给作业评分，让学生了解不同学科如何评估他们的表现。
collocations: get a good grade｜取得好成绩 ; grade assignments｜给作业评分 ; in sixth grade｜在六年级 ; high-grade materials｜优质材料
tip_zh: 表示年级时多用于美式英语；英式英语常用year。

meanings_zh: n. 食物；食品
definition_en: Things people or animals eat to live and grow.
example1_en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
example1_zh: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。
example2_en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
example2_zh: 减少家庭食物浪费既能省钱，也能降低家庭消费对环境的影响。
collocations: fresh food｜新鲜食物 ; food waste｜食物浪费 ; food safety｜食品安全 ; processed food｜加工食品
tip_zh: 泛指食物时不可数；foods表示不同种类的食物。

meanings_zh: adj. 惊讶的；感到意外的
definition_en: Feeling that something unexpected has happened.
example1_en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
example1_zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。
example2_en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
example2_zh: 绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。
collocations: surprised at the result｜对结果感到惊讶 ; pleasantly surprised｜感到惊喜 ; surprised to hear｜听到后感到意外
tip_zh: surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人惊讶。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐；乐曲 | n. 乐谱
definition_en: Sounds arranged with rhythm or melody for people to enjoy | Written symbols showing how a piece should be played or sung
example1_en: Soft music drifted through the kitchen while we cooked.
example1_zh: 我们做饭时，轻柔的音乐在厨房里飘荡。
example2_en: Learning music at school can develop children's creativity and provide opportunities for cooperation through group performances.
example2_zh: 在学校学习音乐可以培养儿童的创造力，并通过集体表演提供合作机会。
collocations: listen to music｜听音乐 ; live music｜现场音乐 ; classical music｜古典音乐 ; a piece of music｜一首乐曲
tip_zh: music不可数；一首乐曲说a piece of music。

meanings_zh: n. 商店 | v. 储存；贮藏 | n. 储备；储存物
definition_en: a place where people buy goods | to keep something somewhere for future use | a supply of something kept for future use
example1_en: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
example1_zh: 我们家附近的商店卖新鲜面包。
example2_en: Modern batteries can store energy from solar panels for use when sunlight is no longer available.
example2_zh: 现代电池可以储存太阳能板产生的能量，以便在没有阳光时使用。
collocations: department store｜百货商店 ; store data｜存储数据 ; store food｜储存食物 ; a store of knowledge｜知识储备
tip_zh: 商店在美式中常用store，英式日常更常用shop。

meanings_zh: n. 北极熊
definition_en: a large white bear that lives in the Arctic
example1_en: Polar bears live in very cold places.
example1_zh: 北极熊生活在非常寒冷的地方。
example2_en: We saw a polar bear on the documentary.
example2_zh: 我们在纪录片里看到了一只北极熊。
tip_zh: polar bear 是北极熊，生活在北极，毛是白色的。

meanings_zh: n. 轮子；车轮 | n. 方向盘 | v. 推着有轮之物移动
definition_en: A round object that turns to move a vehicle. | The circular control used to steer a vehicle. | To move something along on its wheels.
example1_en: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
example1_zh: 我的自行车前轮需要更换。
example2_en: Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
example2_zh: 交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。
collocations: front wheel｜前轮 ; steering wheel｜方向盘 ; behind the wheel｜开车；掌舵 ; wheel a trolley｜推手推车
tip_zh: at或behind the wheel常表示正在开车。

meanings_zh: n. 冰箱
definition_en: An electrical appliance that keeps food and drinks cold.
example1_en: Put the milk back in the fridge, please.
example1_zh: 请把牛奶放回冰箱。
example2_en: Choosing an energy-efficient fridge can reduce household electricity consumption and lower costs over time.
example2_zh: 选择节能冰箱可以减少家庭用电量，并在长期内降低开支。
collocations: in the fridge｜在冰箱里 ; fridge door｜冰箱门 ; fridge freezer｜冷藏冷冻冰箱
tip_zh: fridge是refrigerator的常用简短说法。

meanings_zh: n. 网站
definition_en: A collection of connected web pages available on the internet
example1_en: I found the museum's opening hours on its website.
example1_zh: 我在博物馆的网站上查到了开放时间。
example2_en: A well-designed government website can make public services more accessible to people in remote areas.
example2_zh: 设计良好的政府网站能让偏远地区的居民更便捷地获取公共服务。
collocations: visit a website｜访问网站 ; official website｜官方网站 ; website design｜网站设计 ; launch a website｜上线网站
tip_zh: 在网站上用on a website；webpage指单个网页。

meanings_zh: n. 电话；电话机 | v. 打电话；打电话给
definition_en: A device or system for speaking to people far away. | To contact someone or speak to them using a phone.
example1_en: The telephone rang just as I opened the door.
example1_zh: 我刚打开门，电话就响了。
example2_en: Telephone consultations can improve access to healthcare for rural residents who live far from medical centres.
example2_zh: 电话问诊可以让远离医疗中心的农村居民更方便地获得医疗服务。
collocations: telephone call｜电话通话 ; telephone number｜电话号码 ; by telephone｜通过电话 ; answer the telephone｜接电话
tip_zh: telephone并非美式专用；日常通常简称phone。

meanings_zh: n. 问题；疑问 | n. 议题；待解决的问题 | v. 询问；质疑
definition_en: Something you ask to obtain information or an answer | An issue that needs discussion, consideration, or a decision | To ask someone for information or express doubt about something
example1_en: I raised my hand to ask the teacher a question.
example1_zh: 我举手向老师提了一个问题。
example2_en: Researchers increasingly question whether longer working hours actually improve productivity in modern office environments.
example2_zh: 研究人员越来越质疑，在现代办公环境中，延长工作时间是否真的能提高生产效率。
collocations: ask a question｜提问 ; answer a question｜回答问题 ; raise a question｜提出问题 ; question an assumption｜质疑假设
tip_zh: 动词question可直接接人，表示询问或盘问。

meanings_zh: n. 接待员；前台人员
definition_en: Someone who welcomes visitors and handles enquiries at a reception desk.
example1_en: The receptionist smiled and handed us our room keys.
example1_zh: 接待员微笑着把房间钥匙递给了我们。
example2_en: A skilled receptionist can improve patients' experiences by managing appointments efficiently and responding calmly to enquiries.
example2_zh: 熟练的接待员能够高效安排预约、沉着回应咨询，从而改善患者的就诊体验。
collocations: hotel receptionist｜酒店接待员 ; work as a receptionist｜担任接待员 ; ask the receptionist｜询问接待员
tip_zh: reception 是接待处；receptionist 是接待员。

meanings_zh: n. 身份证；证件卡
definition_en: a card with your name and photo to prove who you are
example1_en: She showed her ID card to the security guard.
example1_zh: 她向保安出示了身份证。
example2_en: Don't forget your ID card when you travel.
example2_zh: 出门旅行别忘了带身份证。
tip_zh: ID card 即身份证/证件卡；英美出行常带 passport 或 driving licence。

meanings_zh: n. 村庄 | n. 全村居民
definition_en: A small community of homes, usually in the countryside. | The people who live in a village, considered together.
example1_en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
example1_zh: 我们村的老桥旁有一家面包店。
example2_en: Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.
example2_zh: 可靠的公共交通可以帮助村民前往附近城镇就业、求学和就医。
collocations: a remote village｜偏远村庄 ; a fishing village｜渔村 ; village life｜乡村生活 ; village residents｜村民
tip_zh: the whole village可指全村居民，而非建筑。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；出色的 | adj. 奇幻的；异想天开的 | adj. 极大的；惊人的
definition_en: extremely good or enjoyable | strange and imaginative, rather than realistic | extremely large in amount or degree
example1_en: We had a fantastic view of the mountains from our balcony.
example1_zh: 从阳台望去，山景美极了。
example2_en: Community sports programmes offer young people a fantastic opportunity to develop teamwork skills and build confidence.
example2_zh: 社区体育项目为年轻人提供了培养团队合作技能和增强自信的绝佳机会。
collocations: fantastic opportunity｜绝佳机会 ; fantastic view｜极美的景色 ; fantastic achievement｜了不起的成就 ; fantastic creatures｜奇幻生物
tip_zh: 表示“极好的”偏口语；正式写作可用excellent。

meanings_zh: n. 跑步 | n. 管理；运作 | adj. 流动的；运转中的
definition_en: the activity or sport of moving quickly on foot | the work of managing or operating something | flowing continuously or operating rather than stopped
example1_en: Running along the beach always clears my head.
example1_zh: 沿着海滩跑步总能让我头脑清醒。
example2_en: Local volunteers play a crucial role in the daily running of community sports centres.
example2_zh: 当地志愿者在社区体育中心的日常管理中发挥着关键作用。
collocations: go running｜去跑步 ; day-to-day running｜日常管理 ; running water｜自来水；流动的水 ; running costs｜运营成本
tip_zh: 表示跑步活动时不可数；the running of指管理。

meanings_zh: n. 大门；栅栏门 | n. 登机口
definition_en: A movable barrier controlling entry through a fence or wall. | An airport area where passengers board a plane.
example1_en: She closed the garden gate to keep the dog inside.
example1_zh: 她关上花园的门，免得狗跑出去。
example2_en: Airports should provide clear directions so passengers can reach their departure gate without unnecessary stress.
example2_zh: 机场应提供清晰的指引，让乘客无需过度紧张就能找到登机口。
collocations: front gate｜前门 ; departure gate｜登机口 ; school gate｜校门 ; lock the gate｜锁上大门
tip_zh: gate多指围墙或栅栏上的门；房间的门通常用door。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻；消息 | n. 新闻节目；新闻报道
definition_en: information about recent events or something previously unknown | a broadcast or report presenting recent events
example1_en: She called her sister to share the good news.
example1_zh: 她给姐姐打电话，分享这个好消息。
example2_en: People should check several reliable sources before sharing news about health issues on social media.
example2_zh: 人们在社交媒体上分享健康问题的新闻前，应核实多个可靠来源。
collocations: good news｜好消息 ; breaking news｜突发新闻 ; watch the news｜看新闻 ; a piece of news｜一条消息
tip_zh: news不可数且接单数谓语：The news is good。

meanings_zh: n. 标题；书名；名称 | n. 头衔；职称 | n. 冠军称号
definition_en: the name given to a book, film, or other work | a name indicating someone's rank, position, or professional role | the position of winner in a sporting competition
example1_en: I remember the book's cover but not its title.
example1_zh: 我记得这本书的封面，却不记得书名了。
example2_en: An effective essay title should clearly indicate the main issue being discussed without revealing every detail.
example2_zh: 好的文章标题应清楚表明所讨论的主要问题，而不必透露所有细节。
collocations: book title｜书名 ; job title｜职位名称 ; win the title｜夺得冠军 ; defend a title｜卫冕
tip_zh: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。

meanings_zh: n. 站台；月台 | n. 讲台；高台 | n. 网络平台；交流平台
definition_en: The area beside railway tracks where passengers board trains. | A raised surface where people can stand or perform. | A service or system for sharing information or doing activities.
example1_en: We waited on the platform as the train approached.
example1_zh: 火车驶近时，我们正在站台上等候。
example2_en: Online learning platforms allow students in remote areas to access courses that are unavailable locally.
example2_zh: 在线学习平台让偏远地区的学生能够学习当地没有开设的课程。
collocations: railway platform｜火车站台 ; online platform｜网络平台 ; a platform for debate｜辩论的平台
tip_zh: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。

meanings_zh: exclam. 再见
definition_en: a word you say when leaving or finishing a call
example1_en: She waved goodbye to her grandparents.
example1_zh: 她向祖父母挥手告别。
example2_en: We said goodbye and got on the train.
example2_zh: 我们道别后上了火车。
collocations: say goodbye｜道别
tip_zh: goodbye 较正式；bye 更口语。道别用 say goodbye to。

meanings_zh: n. 百货商店
definition_en: a large shop that sells many different kinds of things
example1_en: The department store sells clothes, toys and food.
example1_zh: 这家百货商店卖衣服、玩具和食品。
example2_en: We bought a new lamp in the department store.
example2_zh: 我们在百货商店买了一盏新台灯。
tip_zh: department store 是大型综合商店，分成很多“部门”(department)。

meanings_zh: n. 单词；词 | n. 诺言；保证 | v. 措辞；用言语表达
definition_en: A unit of language with meaning. | A promise or assurance that someone gives. | To express something using particular language.
example1_en: I looked up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
example1_zh: 我在词典里查了那个不认识的单词。
example2_en: Students remember new words more effectively when they encounter them repeatedly in meaningful contexts.
example2_zh: 学生在有意义的语境中反复接触新词时，记忆效果会更好。
collocations: keep your word｜信守诺言 ; in other words｜换句话说 ; word choice｜用词选择 ; word a question carefully｜仔细斟酌问题的措辞
tip_zh: keep your word指守信，其中word不用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 黑暗的；昏暗的 | adj. 深色的 | n. 黑暗；夜色
definition_en: having little or no light | having a colour closer to black than white | the absence of light, especially at night
example1_en: The hallway was too dark to find my shoes.
example1_zh: 走廊太暗了，我找不到自己的鞋。
example2_en: Poorly lit streets can feel dark and unsafe, discouraging residents from walking after sunset.
example2_zh: 照明不足的街道会显得昏暗、不安全，使居民不愿在日落后步行。
collocations: get dark｜天色变暗 ; dark blue｜深蓝色 ; in the dark｜在黑暗中；不知情 ; after dark｜天黑以后
tip_zh: dark既指光线暗，也指颜色深；黑暗常用the dark。

meanings_zh: n. 打印机 | n. 印刷工；印刷商
definition_en: a machine that produces paper copies of digital documents or images | a person or business that prints books and other materials
example1_en: The printer ran out of paper halfway through my homework.
example1_zh: 我的作业打印到一半时，打印机没纸了。
example2_en: Schools can reduce paper waste by setting every printer to print on both sides automatically.
example2_zh: 学校可以将所有打印机设为自动双面打印，从而减少纸张浪费。
collocations: laser printer｜激光打印机 ; inkjet printer｜喷墨打印机 ; printer cartridge｜打印机墨盒
tip_zh: print是打印；printer可指机器，也可指印刷从业者。

meanings_zh: n. 长度 | n. 持续时间
definition_en: The distance from one end of something to the other. | The amount of time something lasts.
example1_en: We measured the length of the table before buying chairs.
example1_zh: 我们买椅子之前量了桌子的长度。
example2_en: The length of the school day can affect both student concentration and family routines.
example2_zh: 每天在校时间的长短既会影响学生的注意力，也会影响家庭的日常安排。
collocations: in length｜在长度上 ; the length of time｜时间的长短 ; at length｜详细地
tip_zh: at length常指“详细地”，不是“在长度上”。

meanings_zh: v. 看见 | v. 理解；明白 | v. 会见；探望
definition_en: to notice something using your eyes | to understand something | to meet or visit someone
example1_en: I can see a rainbow above the trees.
example1_zh: 我能看见树梢上方有一道彩虹。
example2_en: When students see how science applies to everyday life, they often become more interested in learning.
example2_zh: 当学生理解科学如何应用于日常生活时，他们往往会对学习更感兴趣。
collocations: see a doctor｜看医生 ; see the difference｜看出区别 ; see someone's point｜理解某人的意思
tip_zh: 过去式saw，过去分词seen；强调看见而非观看。

meanings_zh: n. 商人；男企业家
definition_en: A man who works in business, especially managing a company.
example1_en: A local businessman opened a bakery near our school.
example1_zh: 一位当地商人在我们学校附近开了一家面包店。
example2_en: A successful businessman can support local development by investing in training and creating stable employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 成功的商人可以通过投资培训和创造稳定就业机会来支持当地发展。
collocations: successful businessman｜成功的商人 ; local businessman｜当地商人 ; wealthy businessman｜富商
tip_zh: 复数为businessmen；不限定性别可用businessperson。

meanings_zh: adj. 高兴的；欣慰的 | adj. 乐意的
definition_en: Feeling happy or pleased about something. | Willing and pleased to do something.
example1_en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
example1_zh: 我很高兴你今晚来和我们一起吃饭。
example2_en: Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.
example2_zh: 许多居民都很高兴，地方议会决定保留当地的公园。
collocations: glad to hear｜很高兴听到 ; glad to help｜乐意帮忙 ; glad about｜为……高兴 ; glad that｜很高兴……
tip_zh: 常作表语；用be glad to do或be glad that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 深的
definition_en: going a long way down from the top
example1_en: Be careful, the water here is very deep.
example1_zh: 小心，这里的水很深。
example2_en: They dug a deep hole for the tree.
example2_zh: 他们为那棵树挖了一个深坑。
collocations: deep water｜深水
tip_zh: deep 的反义词是 shallow（浅的）；deeply 表示“深深地”。

meanings_zh: n. 梨
definition_en: A sweet, juicy fruit, often narrower at the top
example1_en: She sliced a ripe pear into her breakfast bowl.
example1_zh: 她把一个熟梨切成片，放进早餐碗里。
example2_en: Buying locally grown pears during their natural season may reduce the need for long-distance food transport.
example2_zh: 在自然成熟的季节购买本地种植的梨，可能减少长途食品运输的需求。
collocations: a ripe pear｜熟梨 ; a pear tree｜梨树 ; pear juice｜梨汁
tip_zh: pear与pair同音；一个梨用a pear。

meanings_zh: n. 土豆；马铃薯
definition_en: A round underground vegetable with brown, red, or yellow skin.
example1_en: I baked a potato and filled it with cheese.
example1_zh: 我烤了一个土豆，并在里面填上奶酪。
example2_en: Potato farming provides an important source of food and income for many rural communities worldwide.
example2_zh: 马铃薯种植为世界各地许多农村社区提供了重要的食物和收入来源。
collocations: baked potato｜烤土豆 ; mashed potato｜土豆泥 ; peel potatoes｜削土豆皮
tip_zh: 复数是 potatoes，词尾加 es。

meanings_zh: phr v. 下车；下（马、自行车等）
definition_en: to leave a bus, train, bike or horse
example1_en: We get off the bus at the next stop.
example1_zh: 我们在下一站下车。
example2_en: Please get off your bike at the gate.
example2_zh: 请在门口下车（自行车）。
collocations: get off the bus｜下公交车
tip_zh: get off 表示“下车/下马”；反义词是 get on（上车）。

meanings_zh: n. 喜剧；喜剧作品 | n. 滑稽；喜剧性
definition_en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh. | The humorous quality of a situation or event.
example1_en: We watched a comedy and laughed all evening.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部喜剧，整个晚上都笑个不停。
example2_en: Comedy can encourage audiences to question social attitudes by presenting familiar problems in unexpected and amusing ways.
example2_zh: 喜剧可以用出人意料又有趣的方式呈现常见问题，促使观众反思社会观念。
collocations: romantic comedy｜浪漫喜剧 ; stand-up comedy｜单口喜剧 ; a comedy series｜喜剧连续剧
tip_zh: 指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。

meanings_zh: adv. 立即；马上 | adv. 紧接地；紧邻地 | conj. 一……就
definition_en: without waiting or any delay | directly before, after, or next to something | as soon as something happens
example1_en: When the doorbell rang, I immediately opened the door.
example1_zh: 门铃一响，我就立刻打开了门。
example2_en: Schools should respond immediately to safety concerns rather than waiting for a serious incident to occur.
example2_zh: 学校应立即回应安全方面的担忧，而不是等到严重事件发生才采取行动。
collocations: respond immediately｜立即回应 ; immediately after｜紧接着……之后 ; immediately available｜可立即获得的
tip_zh: 作连词表示“一……就”主要见于英式英语。

meanings_zh: det. 我的
definition_en: Belonging to or connected with the person speaking.
example1_en: I left my umbrella beside the front door.
example1_zh: 我把我的伞放在前门旁边了。
example2_en: In my view, cities should prioritise affordable housing rather than invest heavily in prestigious construction projects.
example2_zh: 在我看来，城市应优先提供可负担住房，而非大量投资于彰显声望的建设项目。
collocations: my own｜我自己的 ; in my opinion｜在我看来 ; to my surprise｜令我惊讶的是
tip_zh: my后须接名词；mine可独立使用，表示“我的”。

meanings_zh: adv. 后来；稍后 | adj. 较晚的；后期的
definition_en: at a time after now or another mentioned time | happening or existing after another time or stage
example1_en: I'll wash the dishes later, after we finish eating.
example1_zh: 等我们吃完饭，我稍后再洗碗。
example2_en: Children who develop strong reading habits often achieve better academic results later in life.
example2_zh: 养成良好阅读习惯的孩子，往往在日后的学习中取得更好的成绩。
collocations: see you later｜回头见 ; later on｜以后；后来 ; later in life｜在人生后期 ; at a later stage｜在较后的阶段
tip_zh: later表示稍后；latter表示两者中的后者。

meanings_zh: n. 马戏团；马戏表演
definition_en: A group or show featuring acrobats, clowns, and other performers.
example1_en: We watched the circus performers juggle brightly coloured balls.
example1_zh: 我们看着马戏演员抛接色彩鲜艳的球。
example2_en: Modern circus performances can preserve traditional entertainment skills while creating opportunities for artists from diverse backgrounds.
example2_zh: 现代马戏表演既能保留传统娱乐技艺，也能为不同背景的艺术工作者创造机会。
collocations: circus performer｜马戏演员 ; circus tent｜马戏帐篷 ; circus act｜马戏节目 ; travelling circus｜巡回马戏团
tip_zh: 可指马戏团或表演；复数为circuses。

meanings_zh: n. 游客；观光者
definition_en: Someone who visits places for pleasure rather than work
example1_en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
example1_zh: 一位游客问我怎么去城堡。
example2_en: Large numbers of tourists support local businesses but can also place pressure on public transport.
example2_zh: 大量游客为当地企业带来生意，但也可能给公共交通造成压力。
collocations: tourist attraction｜旅游景点 ; tourist destination｜旅游目的地 ; tourist information｜旅游咨询信息 ; overseas tourists｜海外游客
tip_zh: tourist通常是名词，在tourist attraction中修饰名词。

meanings_zh: n. 电池；蓄电池 | n. 一系列；一组
definition_en: A device that stores energy and supplies electricity. | A large set of similar things, especially tests or questions.
example1_en: The torch needs a new battery before our trip.
example1_zh: 出发旅行前，这只手电筒需要换一节新电池。
example2_en: Improved battery technology could make electric vehicles more affordable and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 电池技术的进步可以降低电动汽车的价格，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: a rechargeable battery｜可充电电池 ; battery life｜电池续航时间 ; charge a battery｜给电池充电 ; a battery of tests｜一系列测试
tip_zh: 复数为batteries；a battery of可指一系列测试。

meanings_zh: n. 餐叉；叉子 | n. 岔路口；分叉处 | v. 分叉
definition_en: A tool with pointed prongs for picking up food | A place where a road or path divides | Divide into separate branches or directions
example1_en: She picked up a carrot with her fork.
example1_zh: 她用餐叉叉起了一块胡萝卜。
example2_en: Where a rural path forks, clear directions can prevent visitors from entering environmentally sensitive areas.
example2_zh: 在乡间小路分叉处提供清晰指引，可以防止游客进入生态敏感区域。
collocations: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉 ; a fork in the road｜道路岔口 ; fork left｜向左岔开
tip_zh: 道路forks表示分叉；a fork in the road指岔路口。

meanings_zh: n. 冰淇淋
definition_en: a cold sweet food made from milk and sugar
example1_en: I'd like a chocolate ice cream, please.
example1_zh: 请给我一个巧克力冰淇淋。
example2_en: The children ate ice cream in the summer sun.
example2_zh: 孩子们在夏日阳光下吃冰淇淋。
tip_zh: ice cream 是可数/不可数兼有：an ice cream 一个冰淇淋。

meanings_zh: adv. 不久；很快
definition_en: After a short time from now or another stated time.
example1_en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
example1_zh: 晚饭很快就好了，去洗手吧。
example2_en: Unless cities improve public transport soon, traffic congestion is likely to become increasingly severe.
example2_zh: 除非城市尽快改善公共交通，否则交通拥堵很可能日益严重。
collocations: as soon as possible｜尽快 ; soon after｜不久之后 ; too soon｜太早 ; see you soon｜回头见
tip_zh: as soon as引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

meanings_zh: n. 部分；零件；角色
definition_en: a piece of something, or a role in a play
example1_en: This is the best part of the film.
example1_zh: 这是电影最好的部分。
example2_en: She played the main part in the school play.
example2_zh: 她在学校演出中扮演主角。
collocations: take part in｜参加
tip_zh: take part in 是“参加活动”；play a part 是“扮演角色”。

meanings_zh: adj. ……岁的 | adj. 年迈的
definition_en: Having reached a particular age. | Very old, especially when describing people.
example1_en: The swimming class welcomes children aged six and above.
example1_zh: 这门游泳课欢迎六岁及以上的儿童参加。
example2_en: Public libraries can support children aged five to twelve by providing free reading activities during school holidays.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆可以在学校假期提供免费阅读活动，为五至十二岁的儿童提供支持。
collocations: children aged five｜五岁的儿童 ; aged eighteen and over｜年满十八岁的 ; aged relatives｜年迈的亲属
tip_zh: 表岁数读/eɪdʒd/；表年迈读/ˈeɪdʒɪd/。

meanings_zh: n. 雨伞；阳伞 | adj. 统括的；综合性的
definition_en: a folding cover on a stick protecting against rain or sun | including several different groups, activities, or ideas
example1_en: We shared an umbrella on the walk home.
example1_zh: 走路回家时，我们共撑一把伞。
example2_en: An umbrella organisation can help small charities coordinate their activities and share resources more effectively.
example2_zh: 一个联合组织可以帮助小型慈善机构协调活动，更有效地共享资源。
collocations: open an umbrella｜撑开伞 ; under an umbrella｜在伞下 ; umbrella organisation｜联合组织 ; umbrella term｜统称
tip_zh: umbrella term指涵盖多个相关概念的统称。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……之后 | conj. 在……之后 | prep. 在……后面；追赶
definition_en: later than an event or time | following the time when something happens | behind or following someone or something
example1_en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
example1_zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。
example2_en: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。
collocations: after school｜放学后 ; after a while｜过了一会儿 ; look after｜照顾 ; run after｜追赶
tip_zh: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。

meanings_zh: prep. 围绕；在…周围 | adv. 大约；左右 | adv. 四处；到处
definition_en: On different sides of something or surrounding it. | Approximately, rather than exactly. | In or to various places within an area.
example1_en: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
example1_zh: 我们围坐在火堆旁看星星。
example2_en: Planting trees around school buildings can provide shade and reduce indoor temperatures during hot weather.
example2_zh: 在教学楼周围种树可以提供遮阴，并在炎热天气下降低室内温度。
collocations: around the world｜世界各地 ; around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来 ; look around｜四处看看 ; around midday｜中午前后
tip_zh: around可表大约；around ten即十点或十个左右。

meanings_zh: prep. 由；被 | prep. 通过；以某种方式 | prep. 不迟于；在……之前
definition_en: Shows who or what performs an action in passive sentences. | Using a particular method or means. | No later than a particular time.
example1_en: This wooden bowl was made by my grandfather.
example1_zh: 这个木碗是我祖父做的。
example2_en: Urban air quality can be improved by expanding public transport and encouraging residents to cycle more often.
example2_zh: 扩大公共交通服务并鼓励居民更多骑车，可以改善城市空气质量。
collocations: by bus｜乘公交车 ; by doing something｜通过做某事 ; by the end of｜不迟于……结束时 ; by hand｜用手工
tip_zh: by表示截止时间；until表示状态持续到某时。

meanings_zh: n. 女王；王后 | n. 蜂王；蚁后 | n. 国际象棋中的后
definition_en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king. | The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony. | The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.
example1_en: The queen waved to the crowd from her carriage.
example1_zh: 女王从马车里向人群挥手。
example2_en: In some constitutional monarchies, the queen performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
example2_zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，女王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。
collocations: queen bee｜蜂王 ; the reigning queen｜在位女王 ; king and queen｜国王与王后
tip_zh: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。

meanings_zh: n. 祖父母或外祖父母之一
definition_en: The father or mother of one of your parents.
example1_en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
example1_zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。
example2_en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
example2_zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。
collocations: grandparents and grandchildren｜祖辈与孙辈 ; visit your grandparents｜探望祖父母或外祖父母 ; maternal grandparents｜外祖父母
tip_zh: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。

meanings_zh: prep. 从…里面；离开
definition_en: from inside to outside
example1_en: She took a book out of her bag.
example1_zh: 她从包里拿出一本书。
example2_en: He ran out of the room in a hurry.
example2_zh: 他匆忙跑出房间。
collocations: out of the window｜窗外
tip_zh: out of 表示“从…出来”；反义词是 into（进入）。

meanings_zh: adj. 友好的；亲切的 | n. 友谊赛
definition_en: Kind, welcoming, and pleasant towards other people. | A sports match played outside an official competition.
example1_en: Our new neighbour is friendly and always waves hello.
example1_zh: 我们的新邻居很友善，总是挥手打招呼。
example2_en: Friendly staff can improve patients' experiences and encourage them to seek medical advice earlier.
example2_zh: 亲切的工作人员能改善患者的就医体验，并鼓励他们更早寻求医疗建议。
collocations: friendly smile｜友善的微笑 ; friendly atmosphere｜友好的氛围 ; friendly match｜友谊赛 ; friendly towards newcomers｜对新来者友好
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词，不是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 物理学
definition_en: the science of matter, energy, forces, and their interactions
example1_en: Our physics teacher showed us how magnets attract iron.
example1_zh: 我们的物理老师演示了磁铁如何吸引铁。
example2_en: A strong understanding of physics can help engineers develop safer buildings and more efficient transport systems.
example2_zh: 扎实的物理学知识能帮助工程师设计更安全的建筑和更高效的交通系统。
collocations: study physics｜学习物理学 ; the laws of physics｜物理定律 ; nuclear physics｜核物理学
tip_zh: 虽以s结尾，仍作不可数名词，谓语用单数。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽的；宽阔的 | adj. 广泛的；种类多的 | adv. 充分地张开
definition_en: measuring a large distance from one side to the other | including many different people, things, or possibilities | as far open as possible
example1_en: The sofa will not fit through this wide doorway.
example1_zh: 即使门口这么宽，这张沙发也搬不进去。
example2_en: Universities should offer a wide range of courses to meet students' different interests and career goals.
example2_zh: 大学应提供种类丰富的课程，以满足学生不同的兴趣和职业目标。
collocations: a wide road｜宽阔的道路 ; a wide range of｜各种各样的 ; wide open｜完全敞开的 ; a wide gap｜巨大差距
tip_zh: wide表示张开程度；widely常表示广泛地。

meanings_zh: v. 准备；做好准备 | v. 制作；拟订
definition_en: Make someone or something ready for an activity or situation | Make food, a document, or a plan ready for use
example1_en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
example1_zh: 我每天早上出门前都会准备好午餐。
example2_en: Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
example2_zh: 学校应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，让学生为就业做好准备。
collocations: prepare for an exam｜准备考试 ; prepare a meal｜准备饭菜 ; prepare a report｜撰写报告 ; prepare to leave｜准备离开
tip_zh: prepare for后接名词；prepare to后接动词原形。

meanings_zh: v. 飞；飞行 | v. 乘飞机旅行；驾驶飞机 | n. 苍蝇
definition_en: to move through the air using wings | to travel in or control an aircraft | a small insect with two wings, often found near food
example1_en: Small birds fly over our garden every morning.
example1_zh: 每天早晨都有小鸟飞过我们的花园。
example2_en: Choosing to travel by train rather than fly can significantly reduce the environmental impact of short journeys.
example2_zh: 短途出行选择火车而非飞机，可以显著减少对环境的影响。
collocations: fly abroad｜乘飞机出国 ; fly a plane｜驾驶飞机 ; fly a kite｜放风筝 ; a swarm of flies｜一群苍蝇
tip_zh: 动词变化fly–flew–flown；苍蝇复数为flies。

meanings_zh: n. 大柄杯；马克杯 | v. 拦路抢劫
definition_en: a large cup with a handle, usually for hot drinks | to attack someone in public and steal from them
example1_en: I warmed my hands around a mug of tea.
example1_zh: 我双手捧着一大杯茶取暖。
example2_en: Providing reusable mugs in offices can reduce the waste generated by disposable cups each day.
example2_zh: 在办公室提供可重复使用的杯子，可以减少每天由一次性杯子产生的垃圾。
collocations: a mug of coffee｜一大杯咖啡 ; ceramic mug｜陶瓷马克杯 ; get mugged｜遭到抢劫
tip_zh: mug通常有柄、较大；作动词可指拦路抢劫。

meanings_zh: adj. 冷的；寒冷的 | n. 感冒 | adj. 冷淡的；不友好的
definition_en: Having a low temperature or feeling a lack of warmth. | A common illness causing sneezing, coughing, and a runny nose. | Showing little friendliness, affection, or sympathy.
example1_en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
example1_zh: 我的手很冷，于是戴上了手套。
example2_en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
example2_zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。
collocations: cold weather｜寒冷天气 ; catch a cold｜患感冒 ; have a cold｜感冒了 ; a cold welcome｜冷淡的迎接
tip_zh: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。

meanings_zh: n. 数码相机
definition_en: a camera that stores photos electronically
example1_en: She took lots of photos with her digital camera.
example1_zh: 她用数码相机拍了很多照片。
example2_en: A digital camera is easy to use for beginners.
example2_zh: 数码相机对初学者来说很容易使用。
tip_zh: digital camera 存照片用内存卡，不依赖胶卷。

meanings_zh: n. 雨衣
definition_en: A coat that keeps your clothes dry in the rain.
example1_en: I grabbed my raincoat before stepping into the rain.
example1_zh: 走进雨中之前，我一把拿起了雨衣。
example2_en: Travellers visiting regions with unpredictable weather should carry a lightweight raincoat to stay comfortable during outdoor activities.
example2_zh: 前往天气多变地区的旅行者应携带轻便雨衣，以便在户外活动时保持舒适。
collocations: waterproof raincoat｜防水雨衣 ; lightweight raincoat｜轻便雨衣 ; put on a raincoat｜穿上雨衣
tip_zh: 英美英语都使用raincoat，并非仅限美式。

meanings_zh: n. 裤子；长裤
definition_en: Clothing covering the waist and legs, with separate leg sections.
example1_en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
example1_zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要把它改短。
example2_en: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.
example2_zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式长裤，另一些则允许员工在工作场所穿得更休闲。
collocations: a pair of trousers｜一条长裤 ; formal trousers｜正装长裤 ; try on trousers｜试穿长裤
tip_zh: 用复数：trousers are；一条用a pair of trousers。

meanings_zh: n. 日记；日记簿 | n. 日程簿
definition_en: A book containing personal accounts of daily events and feelings. | A book used to record appointments and future plans.
example1_en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
example1_zh: 我睡前会写日记。
example2_en: Keeping a learning diary encourages students to reflect on their progress and identify difficulties.
example2_zh: 坚持写学习日记能鼓励学生反思自己的进步并发现困难。
collocations: keep a diary｜记日记 ; diary entry｜一篇日记 ; personal diary｜私人日记
tip_zh: diary是日记，dairy是乳制品；注意字母顺序。

meanings_zh: prep. 到；向；给；用于不定式
definition_en: used for direction, receiving, or with verbs
example1_en: We walked to the park.
example1_zh: 我们走到公园。
example2_en: I want to learn English.
example2_zh: 我想学英语。
tip_zh: to 表方向“到…”；也用于动词不定式 to do。

meanings_zh: v. 握住；拿着 | v. 举行；召开 | v. 容纳；装得下
definition_en: to keep something in your hands or arms | to organise an event or meeting | to have enough space for something or someone
example1_en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
example1_zh: 我系鞋带时，你能帮我拿一下包吗？
example2_en: Local councils should hold public meetings before making major changes to transport services.
example2_zh: 地方议会在对交通服务作出重大调整之前，应当召开公众会议。
collocations: hold hands｜手拉手 ; hold a meeting｜召开会议 ; hold your breath｜屏住呼吸 ; hold up to｜最多容纳
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为held；举行会议用hold。

meanings_zh: n. 校长
definition_en: the teacher in charge of a school
example1_en: The headteacher gave a speech at the school assembly.
example1_zh: 校长在全校集会上讲话。
example2_en: Our headteacher knows every student by name.
example2_zh: 我们的校长知道每个学生的名字。
tip_zh: headteacher 是英式说法，美式常说 principal。

meanings_zh: n. 农民；农场主
definition_en: someone who grows crops or raises animals on a farm
example1_en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
example1_zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。
example2_en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
example2_zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。
collocations: dairy farmer｜奶农 ; local farmers｜当地农民 ; small farmers｜小农户 ; sheep farmer｜养羊农场主
tip_zh: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。

meanings_zh: prep. 为了；给；持续（时间）
definition_en: used to show purpose, who receives, or duration
example1_en: This gift is for you.
example1_zh: 这份礼物是给你的。
example2_en: We stayed in London for three days.
example2_zh: 我们在伦敦待了三天。
collocations: for a long time｜很长时间
tip_zh: for 后接时间段表示“持续多久”；since 后接时间点表示“自从”。

meanings_zh: n. 小猫
definition_en: a young cat
example1_en: The kitten is playing with a ball of wool.
example1_zh: 小猫在玩毛线球。
example2_en: We adopted a kitten from the animal shelter.
example2_zh: 我们从动物收容所领养了一只小猫。
tip_zh: kitten 是小猫；成年猫是 cat。

meanings_zh: n. 咖啡；咖啡粉；咖啡豆
definition_en: A drink made from roasted beans, or the beans and powder.
example1_en: I drink coffee with milk before leaving for work.
example1_zh: 我上班出门前会喝一杯加奶咖啡。
example2_en: Rising temperatures may threaten coffee production, affecting the incomes of farmers in several developing countries.
example2_zh: 气温上升可能威胁咖啡生产，影响一些发展中国家农民的收入。
collocations: a cup of coffee｜一杯咖啡 ; black coffee｜黑咖啡 ; coffee beans｜咖啡豆 ; instant coffee｜速溶咖啡
tip_zh: 通常不可数；点单时two coffees指两杯咖啡。

meanings_zh: phr v. 关掉；关闭
definition_en: to stop a machine or light working
example1_en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
example1_zh: 离开时请关灯。
example2_en: He turned off the TV and went to bed.
example2_zh: 他关掉电视上床睡觉。
tip_zh: turn off 与 switch off 同义；反义 turn on。

meanings_zh: n. 鞋
definition_en: A covering for the foot, usually with a firm sole.
example1_en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
example1_zh: 我的鞋里有一颗小石子。
example2_en: Comfortable shoes are essential for workers who spend most of their working day standing.
example2_zh: 对于工作时大部分时间都站着的员工来说，舒适的鞋子至关重要。
collocations: a pair of shoes｜一双鞋 ; running shoes｜跑鞋 ; put on your shoes｜穿上鞋
tip_zh: 一双鞋用a pair of shoes，shoe为可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 外国的；来自国外的 | adj. 异物的；外来的 | adj. 陌生的；不相符的
definition_en: From or relating to a country other than your own. | Present where it does not naturally belong. | Unfamiliar to someone or inconsistent with something.
example1_en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
example1_zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。
example2_en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
example2_zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。
collocations: foreign language｜外语 ; foreign investment｜外国投资 ; foreign policy｜外交政策 ; foreign body｜异物
tip_zh: foreign to可指对某人陌生，或与某事不相符。

meanings_zh: n. 自行车；摩托车 | v. 骑自行车
definition_en: a bicycle or, informally, a motorcycle | to travel somewhere by bicycle
example1_en: I locked my bike outside the corner shop.
example1_zh: 我把自行车锁在街角商店外面。
example2_en: Encouraging commuters to travel by bike could reduce urban congestion and improve public health.
example2_zh: 鼓励通勤者骑自行车出行可以缓解城市拥堵，并改善公众健康。
collocations: ride a bike｜骑自行车 ; by bike｜骑自行车 ; bike lane｜自行车道 ; mountain bike｜山地自行车
tip_zh: by bike不加冠词；ride a bike中的a不能省。

meanings_zh: pron. 他们自己；她们自己
definition_en: used when people do something to themselves
example1_en: They made the dinner themselves.
example1_zh: 晚餐是他们自己做的。
example2_en: The children enjoyed themselves at the party.
example2_zh: 孩子们在聚会上玩得很开心。
collocations: by themselves｜独自
tip_zh: by themselves 表示“独自”；enjoy oneself 是“玩得开心”。

meanings_zh: adj. 小的；年幼的 | det. 很少的；几乎没有的 | adv. 很少；略微
definition_en: Small in size or young in age. | Not much; almost no amount of something. | Only slightly or not very much.
example1_en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。
example2_en: Many rural schools have little access to digital resources, which can widen existing educational inequalities.
example2_zh: 许多农村学校很难获得数字资源，这可能加剧现有的教育不平等。
collocations: a little child｜一个小孩子 ; little time｜很少的时间 ; a little water｜一点水 ; little by little｜逐渐地
tip_zh: little加不可数名词表示几乎没有；a little表示有一点。

meanings_zh: n. 滑板 | v. 玩滑板；滑行
definition_en: A narrow board with small wheels, ridden standing up. | To move or perform tricks on a skateboard.
example1_en: He carried his skateboard home when the rain started.
example1_zh: 开始下雨时，他抱着滑板回家了。
example2_en: Providing dedicated areas for skateboard users can encourage physical activity while reducing conflicts with pedestrians in public spaces.
example2_zh: 为滑板使用者提供专用区域，可以鼓励体育活动，同时减少公共空间中与行人的冲突。
collocations: ride a skateboard｜玩滑板 ; skateboard tricks｜滑板技巧 ; a skateboard park｜滑板公园
tip_zh: skateboard无扶手；scooter通常有扶手。

meanings_zh: n. 高速公路
definition_en: a wide road designed for fast travel over long distances
example1_en: We left the motorway and stopped for lunch.
example1_zh: 我们驶离高速公路，停下来吃午饭。
example2_en: Building a new motorway may reduce journey times, but it can also damage nearby wildlife habitats.
example2_zh: 修建新的高速公路可能缩短行程时间，但也会破坏附近的野生动物栖息地。
collocations: motorway junction｜高速公路交叉口 ; motorway services｜高速公路服务区 ; join the motorway｜驶入高速公路
tip_zh: 主要用于英式英语；美式常用freeway。

meanings_zh: adj. 甜的 | adj. 亲切的；贴心的 | n. 糖果
definition_en: Having a taste like sugar or honey. | Kind, gentle, or thoughtful. | A small piece of sugary food eaten as a treat.
example1_en: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
example1_zh: 这些草莓已经够甜了，不加糖也好吃。
example2_en: Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
example2_zh: 减少儿童含糖饮料的摄入，可能降低他们蛀牙和体重过度增长的风险。
collocations: sweet taste｜甜味 ; sweet tooth｜对甜食的喜爱 ; sweet smile｜甜美的微笑 ; sweet drinks｜甜饮料
tip_zh: 糖果英式常用sweets，美式常用candy。

meanings_zh: n. 疼痛 | n. 悲痛；痛苦 | v. 使痛苦；使难过
definition_en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness | strong emotional suffering caused by loss or distress | to cause someone emotional suffering
example1_en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
example1_zh: 我的左脚踝感到一阵剧痛。
example2_en: Regular exercise may reduce back pain among office workers who remain seated for long periods.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼可能减轻长时间久坐的办公室职员的背痛。
collocations: sharp pain｜剧痛；刺痛 ; chronic pain｜慢性疼痛 ; relieve pain｜缓解疼痛 ; emotional pain｜情感上的痛苦
tip_zh: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。

meanings_zh: prep. 靠近；接近
definition_en: near something
example1_en: My house is close to the station.
example1_zh: 我家离车站很近。
example2_en: The children sat close to the fire to get warm.
example2_zh: 孩子们靠近火坐着取暖。
tip_zh: close to 与 near 意思相近；far from 是它的反义表达。

meanings_zh: n. 早晨；上午
definition_en: The part of the day between midnight and noon
example1_en: I open the curtains every morning and water my plants.
example1_zh: 我每天早晨拉开窗帘，给植物浇水。
example2_en: Schools that start later in the morning may help teenagers get enough sleep and concentrate better.
example2_zh: 上午较晚上课的学校可能有助于青少年获得充足睡眠，更好地集中注意力。
collocations: early morning｜清晨 ; in the morning｜在早晨；在上午 ; on Monday morning｜在星期一早上 ; every morning｜每天早晨
tip_zh: 泛指用in the morning；具体某天早上用on。

meanings_zh: n. 骆驼
definition_en: a large desert animal with one or two humps
example1_en: We rode camels in the desert.
example1_zh: 我们在沙漠里骑了骆驼。
example2_en: The camel has two humps on its back.
example2_zh: 这头骆驼背上有两个驼峰。
tip_zh: 骆驼的驼峰叫 hump；单峰驼是 dromedary。

meanings_zh: n. 英里
definition_en: A unit of distance equal to approximately 1.61 kilometres.
example1_en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
example1_zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。
example2_en: Replacing short car journeys with walking even one mile could improve public health and reduce emissions.
example2_zh: 用步行替代短途驾车，哪怕只走一英里，也能改善公众健康并减少排放。
collocations: a mile away｜一英里远 ; square mile｜平方英里 ; miles per hour｜英里每小时
tip_zh: 英里是距离单位；mile可数，复数加s。

meanings_zh: adj. 风大的；多风的
definition_en: Having a lot of wind.
example1_en: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
example1_zh: 今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。
example2_en: Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.
example2_zh: 多风的沿海地区可以生产可再生电力，但风力涡轮机必须谨慎选址，以保护野生动物。
collocations: windy weather｜大风天气 ; a windy day｜刮大风的一天 ; windy conditions｜多风的环境
tip_zh: 天气义读/ˈwɪndi/；描述道路蜿蜒通常用winding。

meanings_zh: adv. 在外面；向外面 | prep. 在…外；超出…范围 | adj. 外面的；外部的
definition_en: In or towards a place that is not inside. | Beyond the boundaries or limits of something. | Located on the outer part or coming from elsewhere.
example1_en: The children played outside while their parents prepared lunch.
example1_zh: 父母准备午饭时，孩子们在外面玩耍。
example2_en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to learn outside the classroom through practical activities and community projects.
example2_zh: 学校应通过实践活动和社区项目，为学生提供课堂之外的学习机会。
collocations: go outside｜到外面去 ; outside the classroom｜在课堂之外 ; outside help｜外部帮助 ; the outside world｜外界
tip_zh: 后接地点用介词 outside；单独使用可作副词。

meanings_zh: adv. 在某处；到某处 | adv. 大约
definition_en: in or to a place that is not specified | approximately, when used before an amount or range
example1_en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
example1_zh: 我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。
example2_en: Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
example2_zh: 年轻人需要有负担得起的住所，才能充分参与当地的经济活动。
collocations: somewhere else｜别处 ; somewhere quiet｜某个安静的地方 ; somewhere around｜大约
tip_zh: 形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。

meanings_zh: prep. 在…前面
definition_en: ahead of; before something in position
example1_en: The school is in front of the park.
example1_zh: 学校在公园前面。
example2_en: She stood in front of the class and spoke.
example2_zh: 她站在全班面前发言。
tip_zh: in front of 指“在…前面”；反义词是 behind（在…后面）。

meanings_zh: n. 章鱼
definition_en: a sea animal with a soft body and eight arms
example1_en: An octopus squeezed through a narrow gap between rocks.
example1_zh: 一只章鱼从岩石间狭窄的缝隙挤了过去。
example2_en: Research into octopus behaviour has revealed remarkable learning abilities, challenging traditional assumptions about intelligence in marine animals.
example2_zh: 对章鱼行为的研究揭示了其非凡的学习能力，挑战了有关海洋动物智力的传统假设。
collocations: octopus arms｜章鱼的腕 ; octopus behaviour｜章鱼的行为 ; a giant octopus｜一只巨型章鱼
tip_zh: 常用复数是octopuses；腕通常称arms。

meanings_zh: n. 意大利面食
definition_en: food made from flour and water, shaped and usually boiled
example1_en: We cooked pasta with fresh tomatoes and mushrooms.
example1_zh: 我们用新鲜番茄和蘑菇做了意大利面。
example2_en: School canteens can serve wholegrain pasta with vegetables to provide affordable meals with more fibre.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以供应搭配蔬菜的全麦意大利面，提供价格实惠、膳食纤维更多的餐食。
collocations: cook pasta｜煮意大利面 ; pasta sauce｜意面酱 ; fresh pasta｜新鲜意面 ; wholegrain pasta｜全麦意面
tip_zh: 不可数；一份意面可说a bowl of pasta。

meanings_zh: adv. 哪里
definition_en: in or to which place
example1_en: Where do you live?
example1_zh: 你住在哪里？
example2_en: Do you know where the library is?
example2_zh: 你知道图书馆在哪里吗？
tip_zh: where 用于询问地点。

meanings_zh: adj. 黑色的 | n. 黑色 | adj. 黑人的
definition_en: having the darkest colour, like coal | the darkest colour | relating to people with ancestry from sub-Saharan Africa
example1_en: She wore a black coat and bright yellow boots.
example1_zh: 她穿着黑色外套和亮黄色靴子。
example2_en: Black roofs absorb more sunlight than pale roofs, potentially increasing the energy needed for cooling.
example2_zh: 黑色屋顶比浅色屋顶吸收更多阳光，可能增加制冷所需的能源。
collocations: black coffee｜不加奶的咖啡 ; black and white｜黑白的 ; turn black｜变黑
tip_zh: 指族裔时常大写为Black；避免用作单数名词称人。

meanings_zh: n. 篮球运动 | n. 篮球
definition_en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops | the large round ball used in this game
example1_en: We play basketball at the park after school.
example1_zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。
example2_en: Team sports such as basketball help young people develop cooperation skills while improving their physical fitness.
example2_zh: 篮球等团队运动有助于年轻人培养协作能力，同时增强体质。
collocations: play basketball｜打篮球 ; basketball court｜篮球场 ; basketball team｜篮球队 ; basketball hoop｜篮球筐
tip_zh: play basketball不加冠词；指一个球用a basketball。

meanings_zh: n. 月亮；月球 | n. 天然卫星
definition_en: the natural object that moves around Earth | a natural object that moves around a planet
example1_en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
example1_zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。
example2_en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
example2_zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。
collocations: full moon｜满月 ; crescent moon｜新月；月牙 ; the surface of the moon｜月球表面
tip_zh: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。

meanings_zh: n. 老虎
definition_en: A large wild cat with dark stripes on orange fur
example1_en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
example1_zh: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。
example2_en: Protecting tiger habitats also helps conserve other species that share the same forest ecosystems.
example2_zh: 保护老虎栖息地也有助于保护同一森林生态系统中的其他物种。
collocations: a wild tiger｜野生老虎 ; tiger conservation｜老虎保护 ; tiger habitat｜老虎栖息地
tip_zh: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。

meanings_zh: n. 书桌；办公桌 | n. 服务台；接待处
definition_en: A table used for studying, writing, or office work | A counter where people receive information or services
example1_en: I keep my pencils in the top desk drawer.
example1_zh: 我把铅笔放在书桌最上面的抽屉里。
example2_en: Providing every student with a suitable desk can improve comfort and concentration in the classroom.
example2_zh: 为每位学生提供合适的课桌可以提高课堂上的舒适度和专注度。
collocations: desk drawer｜书桌抽屉 ; reception desk｜接待处 ; sit at a desk｜坐在书桌前
tip_zh: 在书桌前用at a desk，不用on a desk。

meanings_zh: n. DVD播放机
definition_en: a machine that plays DVDs
example1_en: The DVD player is under the television.
example1_zh: DVD播放机在电视机下面。
example2_en: Put the film into the DVD player.
example2_zh: 把电影光盘放进DVD播放机里。
tip_zh: DVD player 用来播放 DVD 光盘。

meanings_zh: det. 这样的；这类的 | det. 如此的；这么的
definition_en: of the kind already mentioned or being described | used to emphasise a quality or degree before a noun
example1_en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
example1_zh: 天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。
example2_en: Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
example2_zh: 许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。
collocations: such as｜例如 ; such a pity｜真可惜 ; such problems｜这类问题 ; such ... that ...｜如此……以至于……
tip_zh: 单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 汽油
definition_en: a liquid fuel used in cars and other engines
example1_en: We stopped for petrol before driving into the mountains.
example1_zh: 开车进山前，我们停车加了汽油。
example2_en: Higher petrol prices may encourage commuters to use public transport rather than drive to work.
example2_zh: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者乘坐公共交通，而不是开车上班。
collocations: petrol station｜加油站 ; unleaded petrol｜无铅汽油 ; petrol prices｜汽油价格 ; run out of petrol｜汽油用尽
tip_zh: 不可数名词；英式用petrol，美式用gasoline或gas。

meanings_zh: v. 告诉；讲述 | v. 吩咐；命令 | v. 辨别；看出
definition_en: Give someone information or describe something in words. | Instruct someone to do something. | Recognise a difference or know something from available evidence.
example1_en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
example1_zh: 请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。
example2_en: Schools should tell parents how personal information about their children is collected and stored.
example2_zh: 学校应告知家长，孩子的个人信息是如何被收集和保存的。
collocations: tell a story｜讲故事 ; tell the truth｜说实话 ; tell someone to do something｜吩咐某人做某事 ; tell the difference｜辨别差异
tip_zh: tell常直接接人；say接人时通常用to。

meanings_zh: n. 工作时间
definition_en: the time when people work
example1_en: The shop's working hours are nine to six.
example1_zh: 这家店的工作时间是九点到六点。
example2_en: Please call us during working hours.
example2_zh: 请在上班时间给我们打电话。
tip_zh: working hours 是工作时间，即上班时段。

meanings_zh: n. 课程 | n. 路线；进程 | n. 一道菜
definition_en: A series of lessons about a particular subject. | The route something follows or the way events develop. | One part of a meal served separately from other parts.
example1_en: I joined a cooking course at the community centre.
example1_zh: 我报名参加了社区中心的烹饪课程。
example2_en: Universities should design each course to combine theoretical knowledge with practical skills relevant to future employment.
example2_zh: 大学应在设计每门课程时，将理论知识与未来就业所需的实用技能相结合。
collocations: take a course｜修读课程 ; training course｜培训课程 ; change course｜改变路线 ; main course｜主菜
tip_zh: course 是整门课程；lesson 是其中的一节课。

meanings_zh: n. 国王
definition_en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position
example1_en: The king waved to the crowd from his carriage.
example1_zh: 国王从马车上向人群挥手。
example2_en: In some countries, the king performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
example2_zh: 在一些国家，国王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。
collocations: become king｜成为国王 ; crown a king｜为国王加冕 ; the king's reign｜国王的统治时期
tip_zh: king指男性君主；queen可指女王或王后。

meanings_zh: pron. 我们的（所有物）
definition_en: something that belongs to us
example1_en: This garden is ours.
example1_zh: 这个花园是我们的。
example2_en: Their house is bigger than ours.
example2_zh: 他们的房子比我们的大。
tip_zh: ours 是名词性物主代词，后面不接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 海滩；湖滩 | v. 使上岸；使搁浅
definition_en: an area of sand or small stones beside water | to bring a boat onto a shore
example1_en: We collected smooth stones on the beach after breakfast.
example1_zh: 早餐后，我们在海滩上捡了些光滑的石头。
example2_en: Local authorities should protect beaches from plastic waste while ensuring that tourism benefits nearby communities.
example2_zh: 地方政府应保护海滩免受塑料垃圾污染，同时确保旅游业惠及附近社区。
collocations: sandy beach｜沙滩 ; a pebble beach｜卵石海滩 ; on the beach｜在海滩上 ; beach cleanup｜海滩清理活动
tip_zh: 在海滩上用on the beach；shore泛指岸边。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……下方；低于 | adv. 在下面；在下文
definition_en: At a lower position, level, or amount than something. | In a lower place or later in a piece of writing.
example1_en: Our cat sleeps on the shelf below the window.
example1_zh: 我们的猫睡在窗户下方的架子上。
example2_en: Households with incomes below the national average may struggle to afford adequate heating during winter.
example2_zh: 收入低于全国平均水平的家庭可能难以负担冬季充足供暖的费用。
collocations: below average｜低于平均水平 ; below sea level｜低于海平面 ; below freezing｜低于冰点
tip_zh: below强调位置或数值较低，不一定在正下方。

meanings_zh: n. 差异；不同之处 | n. 分歧；意见不合 | n. 差额；差值
definition_en: A way in which people or things are not alike | A disagreement between people or groups | The amount by which one quantity exceeds another
example1_en: The main difference between these jackets is their weight.
example1_zh: 这两件夹克的主要区别在于重量。
example2_en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
example2_zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。
collocations: the difference between｜……之间的区别 ; make a difference｜产生影响 ; a significant difference｜显著差异 ; settle differences｜解决分歧
tip_zh: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 妻子
definition_en: a woman who is married to someone
example1_en: His wife packed sandwiches for their afternoon walk.
example1_zh: 他的妻子为他们下午的散步准备了三明治。
example2_en: A husband and wife may share childcare responsibilities more equally when both have flexible working hours.
example2_zh: 如果夫妻双方的工作时间都很灵活，他们就可能更平等地分担育儿责任。
collocations: husband and wife｜夫妻 ; his wife｜他的妻子 ; future wife｜未来的妻子
tip_zh: 复数为wives；spouse指配偶，不限定性别。

meanings_zh: adv. 在那里；往那里 | pron. 用于表示存在的句式
definition_en: In, at, or towards that place. | Used before a verb to introduce something that exists.
example1_en: Leave your muddy boots there, beside the back door.
example1_zh: 把你沾满泥的靴子放在那儿，就在后门旁边。
