example2_en: There are several practical ways for cities to reduce waste without increasing household expenses.
example2_zh: 城市可以采取几种切实可行的办法，在不增加家庭开支的情况下减少垃圾。
collocations: over there｜在那边 ; there is｜有；存在 ; there are｜有；存在 ; from there｜从那里
tip_zh: there表地点或引出存在句；别与their混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 希望；期望 | n. 希望；期盼
definition_en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen | a feeling that something wanted may happen
example1_en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
example1_zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。
example2_en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生希望找到有意义的工作，使自己能够为社会作出积极贡献。
collocations: hope to do something｜希望做某事 ; hope for the best｜抱最好的希望 ; give up hope｜放弃希望 ; in the hope of｜怀着……的希望
tip_zh: 可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。

meanings_zh: n. 导游；向导 | n. 指南；入门书 | v. 引导；指导
definition_en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit | a book or resource giving useful information or instructions | to show someone the way or help them decide
example1_en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
example1_zh: 导游带我们穿过市场里狭窄的街道。
example2_en: Teachers should guide students towards reliable sources rather than simply provide answers to every question.
example2_zh: 教师应引导学生寻找可靠的信息来源，而不是直接给出每个问题的答案。
collocations: tour guide｜导游 ; a guide to｜……的指南 ; guide someone through｜引导某人完成 ; guided tour｜有导游带领的游览
tip_zh: 指南用a guide to；指导某人完成用guide someone through。

meanings_zh: n. 金属
definition_en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity
example1_en: The metal handle felt cold against my fingers.
example1_zh: 金属把手摸起来冰凉。
example2_en: Recycling metal reduces the demand for mining and can significantly lower energy consumption in manufacturing.
example2_zh: 回收金属可以减少采矿需求，并显著降低制造业的能源消耗。
collocations: scrap metal｜废金属 ; precious metal｜贵金属 ; metal frame｜金属框架 ; heavy metal｜重金属
tip_zh: 泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 驾驶；开车 | v. 推动；驱使 | n. 驾车出行；动力；驱动器
definition_en: to control a vehicle and make it move | to cause something to develop or someone to act | a car journey, strong motivation, or a computer storage device
example1_en: Can you drive me to the station after breakfast?
example1_zh: 早饭后你能开车送我去车站吗？
example2_en: Consumer demand can drive innovation by encouraging companies to develop products that use fewer natural resources.
example2_zh: 消费者需求可以鼓励企业开发消耗更少自然资源的产品，从而推动创新。
collocations: drive to work｜开车上班 ; drive economic growth｜推动经济增长 ; go for a drive｜开车兜风 ; hard drive｜硬盘
tip_zh: 不规则变化：drive—drove—driven；送某人用drive sb to。

meanings_zh: n. 柠檬水
definition_en: a cold drink made with lemons, sugar and water
example1_en: She made fresh lemonade for the picnic.
example1_zh: 她为野餐做了新鲜的柠檬水。
example2_en: Can I have a glass of lemonade, please?
example2_zh: 请给我一杯柠檬水好吗？
collocations: a glass of lemonade｜一杯柠檬水
tip_zh: lemonade 是柠檬饮料；英式常指气泡柠檬汽水。

meanings_zh: n. 脸；面部 | v. 面临；面对 | v. 面向；朝向
definition_en: The front of the head, including eyes, nose, and mouth. | To encounter or deal with a difficult situation. | To look or point in a particular direction.
example1_en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
example1_zh: 他洗了脸才坐下来吃早餐。
example2_en: Many coastal cities face increasing risks from flooding as sea levels rise and extreme weather becomes more frequent.
example2_zh: 随着海平面上升和极端天气日益频繁，许多沿海城市面临越来越大的洪水风险。
collocations: wash your face｜洗脸 ; face a challenge｜面对挑战 ; face south｜朝南 ; face to face｜面对面
tip_zh: 面对困难可说face difficulties或be faced with difficulties。

meanings_zh: n. 碗；盆 | v. 打保龄球；投球
definition_en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids | to roll a bowling ball or deliver a cricket ball
example1_en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
example1_zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。
example2_en: Serving meals in smaller bowls may help people control portions and reduce unnecessary food waste.
example2_zh: 用较小的碗盛饭可能有助于人们控制食量，减少不必要的食物浪费。
collocations: a bowl of soup｜一碗汤 ; mixing bowl｜搅拌碗 ; salad bowl｜沙拉碗 ; bowl a ball｜投球
tip_zh: a bowl of表示“一碗”；bowling指保龄球运动。

meanings_zh: adj. 古典音乐的 | adj. 古希腊罗马的；古典的 | adj. 传统理论的
definition_en: relating to formal Western music, such as symphonies and operas | relating to ancient Greece or Rome and their culture | based on established theories rather than newer approaches
example1_en: My sister listens to classical music while cooking.
example1_zh: 我姐姐做饭时听古典音乐。
example2_en: Studying classical architecture helps students understand how ancient design principles continue to influence modern public buildings.
example2_zh: 研究古典建筑有助于学生理解古代设计原则如何持续影响现代公共建筑。
collocations: classical music｜古典音乐 ; classical architecture｜古典建筑 ; classical civilisation｜古典文明 ; classical mechanics｜经典力学
tip_zh: 古典音乐用classical；经典作品常用classic。

meanings_zh: n. 购物者
definition_en: a person who is shopping
example1_en: The shoppers filled the supermarket on Saturday.
example1_zh: 周六超市里挤满了购物者。
example2_en: Shoppers can park free for two hours.
example2_zh: 购物者可免费停车两小时。
tip_zh: shopper 指正在购物的人；customer 是顾客。

meanings_zh: pron. 她
definition_en: a female person or animal already mentioned
example1_en: She is my sister.
example1_zh: 她是我妹妹。
example2_en: Where is Anna? She is in the kitchen.
example2_zh: 安娜在哪？她在厨房里。
tip_zh: she 是主格；宾格 her，物主代词 hers。

meanings_zh: n. 工作日；周一至周五
definition_en: any day from Monday to Friday
example1_en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
example1_zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。
example2_en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
example2_zh: 延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。
collocations: on weekdays｜在工作日 ; weekday mornings｜工作日早晨 ; a weekday service｜工作日班次
tip_zh: 指周一至周五，不保证当天实际上需要上班。

meanings_zh: n. 教师；老师
definition_en: someone whose job is to help people learn
example1_en: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
example1_zh: 我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。
example2_en: A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
example2_zh: 训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。
collocations: primary school teacher｜小学教师 ; qualified teacher｜具备资质的教师 ; teacher training｜教师培训
tip_zh: 英语中称呼老师通常用Mr、Ms等加姓，不直接喊Teacher。

meanings_zh: n. 快餐
definition_en: food that is made and served quickly
example1_en: We had fast food for lunch because we were in a hurry.
example1_zh: 因为赶时间，我们午饭吃了快餐。
example2_en: Eating too much fast food is not healthy.
example2_zh: 吃太多快餐不健康。
tip_zh: 常见的 fast food 有汉堡、炸鸡、薯条等。

meanings_zh: exclam. 晚上好
definition_en: a polite greeting used in the evening
example1_en: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen.
example1_zh: 女士们先生们，晚上好。
example2_en: We said good evening to the hotel manager.
example2_zh: 我们向酒店经理问晚上好。
tip_zh: good evening 用于傍晚及晚上的问候；晚安说 good night。

meanings_zh: n. 道路；公路 | n. 途径；进程
definition_en: a hard surface built for vehicles to travel along | a way of reaching a particular result or situation
example1_en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
example1_zh: 过马路前要向两边看。
example2_en: Investment in road maintenance can improve public safety and reduce transport costs for local businesses.
example2_zh: 投资道路养护能提高公共安全水平，并降低当地企业的运输成本。
collocations: road safety｜道路安全 ; a main road｜主干道 ; road maintenance｜道路养护 ; the road to recovery｜康复之路
tip_zh: on the road常指在旅途中；road to可比喻通往某结果的途径。

meanings_zh: n. 广告
definition_en: a public message promoting a product, service, or opportunity
example1_en: An ad for cooking classes caught my attention yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天，一则烹饪课广告吸引了我的注意。
example2_en: Online ads can influence consumer choices by presenting products that match users' browsing habits and interests.
example2_zh: 网络广告通过展示符合用户浏览习惯和兴趣的产品，可以影响消费者的选择。
collocations: online ad｜网络广告 ; job ad｜招聘广告 ; place an ad｜刊登广告 ; ad campaign｜广告宣传活动
tip_zh: ad是advertisement的非正式缩写，是可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 门厅；走廊 | n. 礼堂；大厅；会堂 | n. 大学学生宿舍
definition_en: an entrance area or passage connecting rooms in a building | a large room or building used for public gatherings | a building where university students live
example1_en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
example1_zh: 请把湿鞋留在门厅里。
example2_en: The community hall provides an affordable space where residents can attend classes and organise local events.
example2_zh: 社区会堂为居民提供了一个价格实惠的场所，供他们上课和组织当地活动。
collocations: an entrance hall｜门厅 ; a concert hall｜音乐厅 ; a town hall｜市政厅 ; halls of residence｜大学学生宿舍
tip_zh: 英式英语中，大学宿舍常称halls或halls of residence。

meanings_zh: n. 骑马（运动）
definition_en: the sport of riding a horse
example1_en: She goes riding every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 她每周六早上去骑马。
example2_en: Riding is a popular sport in the countryside.
example2_zh: 骑马是乡村很受欢迎的运动。
collocations: horse riding｜骑马
tip_zh: riding 指骑马运动；horse-riding 也是常见说法。

meanings_zh: adj. 有帮助的；有用的 | adj. 乐于助人的
definition_en: Making something easier to do or understand. | Willing to help other people.
example1_en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
example1_zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。
example2_en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
example2_zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。
collocations: helpful advice｜有用的建议 ; helpful information｜有用的信息 ; helpful staff｜乐于助人的员工 ; find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip_zh: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

meanings_zh: n. 海豚
definition_en: An intelligent aquatic mammal with a long snout and curved fin.
example1_en: A dolphin leapt beside our boat early this morning.
example1_zh: 今天一大早，一只海豚在我们的船边跃出水面。
example2_en: Underwater noise from shipping can disrupt dolphin communication and make it harder for these animals to find food.
example2_zh: 船运产生的水下噪声会干扰海豚交流，使它们更难找到食物。
collocations: a pod of dolphins｜一群海豚 ; bottlenose dolphin｜宽吻海豚 ; dolphin conservation｜海豚保护
tip_zh: 海豚是哺乳动物；一群海豚可说a pod of dolphins。

meanings_zh: adj. 热的；温度高的 | adj. 辣的 | adj. 热门的；备受关注的
definition_en: Having a high temperature. | Having a strong taste that burns your mouth. | Attracting a lot of interest or discussion.
example1_en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
example1_zh: 小心，汤还很烫。
example2_en: As summers become increasingly hot, cities need more shaded public spaces to protect residents from heat.
example2_zh: 随着夏季越来越炎热，城市需要更多有遮阴设施的公共空间来保护居民免受高温影响。
collocations: hot weather｜炎热天气 ; hot water｜热水 ; hot peppers｜辣椒 ; a hot topic｜热门话题
tip_zh: 形容食物时可指“烫”或“辣”，需结合语境。

meanings_zh: n. 动物园
definition_en: a place where animals are kept for people to see
example1_en: We saw lions and monkeys at the zoo.
example1_zh: 我们在动物园看到了狮子和猴子。
example2_en: The zoo is closed on Mondays.
example2_zh: 动物园周一闭园。
tip_zh: zoo 是动物园；go to the zoo 去动物园。

meanings_zh: n. 车库 | n. 汽车修理厂
definition_en: A building or part of a building for keeping vehicles. | A business where vehicles are repaired and serviced.
example1_en: We keep our car and bicycles in the garage.
example1_zh: 我们把汽车和自行车停在车库里。
example2_en: Converting an unused garage into living space can provide additional accommodation without requiring new land.
example2_zh: 将闲置车库改成居住空间，可以在不占用新土地的情况下增加住房。
collocations: double garage｜双车位车库 ; garage door｜车库门 ; local garage｜当地汽车修理厂
tip_zh: 英式英语也常用 garage 指汽车修理厂。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻记者；新闻工作者
definition_en: Someone who gathers and reports news for the media.
example1_en: The journalist interviewed our neighbour about the new park.
example1_zh: 那位记者就新公园的事采访了我们的邻居。
example2_en: A responsible journalist should verify information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion.
example2_zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众舆论的报道前，应仔细核实信息。
collocations: investigative journalist｜调查记者 ; freelance journalist｜自由撰稿记者 ; broadcast journalist｜广播电视记者
tip_zh: journalist泛指新闻工作者，reporter更侧重采访报道。

meanings_zh: adj. 蓝色的 | n. 蓝色 | adj. 忧郁的；沮丧的
definition_en: having the colour of a clear daytime sky | the colour of a clear daytime sky | feeling sad or unhappy
example1_en: He wore a blue jacket to the picnic.
example1_zh: 他穿了一件蓝色夹克去野餐。
example2_en: Urban designers often use blue surfaces to create a sense of calm in busy public spaces.
example2_zh: 城市设计师常使用蓝色的表面，在繁忙的公共空间营造宁静感。
collocations: bright blue｜亮蓝色 ; dark blue｜深蓝色 ; blue sky｜蓝天 ; feel blue｜感到忧郁
tip_zh: feel blue表示心情低落；颜色较浅用light blue。

meanings_zh: adv. 在今晚 | n. 今晚；今夜
definition_en: during the evening or night of today | the evening or night of today
example1_en: We are making vegetable soup for dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 我们今晚要做蔬菜汤当晚餐。
example2_en: Residents will meet tonight to discuss how public transport could better serve the local community.
example2_zh: 居民们今晚将开会讨论公共交通如何更好地服务当地社区。
collocations: tonight's meeting｜今晚的会议 ; late tonight｜今晚晚些时候 ; by tonight｜到今晚为止
tip_zh: 作时间状语时直接用tonight，前面不加介词。

meanings_zh: n. 互联网；因特网
definition_en: The worldwide network connecting computers and other devices.
example1_en: The internet stopped working halfway through our video call.
example1_zh: 我们视频通话进行到一半时断网了。
example2_en: Reliable internet access enables rural students to use educational resources that may be unavailable locally.
example2_zh: 可靠的互联网接入让农村学生能够使用当地可能缺乏的教育资源。
collocations: internet access｜互联网接入 ; an internet connection｜网络连接 ; on the internet｜在网上 ; internet users｜网民
tip_zh: 通常说 the internet；作定语时不用 the。

meanings_zh: n. 同班同学
definition_en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.
example1_en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
example1_zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。
example2_en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
example2_zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。
collocations: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学 ; help a classmate｜帮助同班同学 ; a new classmate｜新同学
tip_zh: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

meanings_zh: phr v. 躺下
definition_en: to put your body in a flat position to rest
example1_en: I need to lie down for a while; I feel tired.
example1_zh: 我需要躺一会儿，我感觉很累。
example2_en: The dog likes to lie down in the shade.
example2_zh: 狗喜欢躺在阴凉处。
tip_zh: lie down 是“躺下”休息；过去式 lay down。

meanings_zh: n. 出租车 | v. （飞机）在地面滑行
definition_en: A car with a driver whom you pay for a journey. | To move slowly on the ground before takeoff or after landing.
example1_en: We took a taxi home with our heavy bags.
example1_zh: 我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。
example2_en: Improving public transport could reduce dependence on taxis and private cars in crowded city centres.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以减少人们在拥挤的市中心对出租车和私家车的依赖。
collocations: take a taxi｜乘出租车 ; hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车 ; taxi fare｜出租车费 ; taxi rank｜出租车候车点
tip_zh: 乘出租车可说take a taxi或by taxi。

meanings_zh: n. 二月
definition_en: The second month of the year.
example1_en: My sister starts her new job in February.
example1_zh: 我姐姐二月份开始新工作。
example2_en: The community centre will introduce additional evening classes in February to meet growing demand.
example2_zh: 社区中心将在二月份增设夜间课程，以满足不断增长的需求。
collocations: in February｜在二月 ; early February｜二月初 ; late February｜二月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

meanings_zh: v. 丢失；遗失 | v. 失去；减少 | v. 输掉；失败
definition_en: to become unable to find something you had | to stop having something or have less of it | to fail to win a game or competition
example1_en: I always lose my keys inside this enormous bag.
example1_zh: 我总是在这个大包里找不到钥匙。
example2_en: Small businesses may lose customers when major retailers offer similar products at significantly lower prices.
example2_zh: 大型零售商以低得多的价格提供类似产品时，小企业可能会流失顾客。
collocations: lose weight｜体重减轻 ; lose touch｜失去联系 ; lose a match｜输掉比赛 ; lose your temper｜发脾气
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词都是lost；别与loose混淆。

meanings_zh: det. 你的；你们的
definition_en: Belonging or relating to the person or people being addressed
example1_en: Please leave your shoes by the door before entering.
example1_zh: 进来前请把你的鞋放在门边。
example2_en: Choosing a university near your home can reduce living expenses and make higher education more affordable.
example2_zh: 选择离家近的大学可以减少生活开支，让高等教育更负担得起。
collocations: your own｜你自己的 ; your family｜你的家人 ; do your best｜尽你最大的努力
tip_zh: your后接名词；yours独立使用；you're意为你是。

meanings_zh: n. 星；恒星 | n. 明星；杰出人物 | v. 主演；由…主演
definition_en: a huge ball of hot gas shining in space | a famous or exceptionally successful performer or other person | to play a leading role or feature someone doing so
example1_en: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。
example2_en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
example2_zh: 光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。
collocations: a bright star｜明亮的星星 ; a film star｜电影明星 ; a rising star｜冉冉升起的新星 ; star in a film｜主演电影
tip_zh: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。

meanings_zh: n. 旅行指南；指导手册
definition_en: a book giving information about a place or practical subject
example1_en: Our guidebook recommended a quiet beach near the village.
example1_zh: 我们的旅行指南推荐了村庄附近一处安静的海滩。
example2_en: Although digital maps are convenient, a detailed guidebook can provide valuable cultural context for independent travellers.
example2_zh: 虽然电子地图很方便，但详尽的旅行指南能为自由行旅客提供宝贵的文化背景信息。
collocations: a travel guidebook｜旅行指南 ; a guidebook to｜介绍……的指南 ; consult a guidebook｜查阅指南
tip_zh: 介绍某地的指南常用a guidebook to加地点。

meanings_zh: n. 访客；参观者；游客
definition_en: Someone who goes to see a person or place.
example1_en: A visitor left her umbrella beside our front door.
example1_zh: 一位访客把她的伞落在了我们前门旁。
example2_en: The museum attracts international visitors by offering exhibitions that explore local history and culture.
example2_zh: 这家博物馆通过举办探究当地历史与文化的展览吸引国际游客。
collocations: attract visitors｜吸引游客 ; overseas visitors｜海外游客 ; visitor centre｜游客中心
tip_zh: visitor指人；visit可作动词或名词。

meanings_zh: n. 演员 | n. 参与者；行动主体
definition_en: Someone who performs characters in plays, films, or television | A person or organisation involved in a particular situation
example1_en: The actor wore a silver crown on stage.
example1_zh: 那位演员在舞台上戴着一顶银色王冠。
example2_en: Professional actors can help students develop communication skills through drama workshops that encourage teamwork and creative expression.
example2_zh: 专业演员可以通过鼓励团队合作和创意表达的戏剧工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通能力。
collocations: a leading actor｜主演 ; a professional actor｜专业演员 ; a supporting actor｜配角演员 ; a key actor｜关键参与者
tip_zh: actor可指任何性别的演员；actress专指女演员。

meanings_zh: n. 流行音乐 | v. 爆开；发出砰声 | v. 短暂去；顺手放
definition_en: popular music with catchy tunes and usually simple structures | to burst or make a short, sharp sound | to go somewhere briefly or put something somewhere quickly
example1_en: My sister listens to pop while she cooks dinner.
example1_zh: 我姐姐做晚饭时会听流行音乐。
example2_en: Pop can introduce young listeners to other cultures, especially when artists combine different musical traditions.
example2_zh: 流行音乐可以让年轻听众了解其他文化，尤其是在艺人融合不同音乐传统时。
collocations: pop music｜流行音乐 ; pop a balloon｜弄爆气球 ; pop into a shop｜顺便进店 ; pop up｜突然出现
tip_zh: 表示短暂去或顺手放时属非正式用法。

meanings_zh: n. 艺术；美术 | n. 艺术作品 | n. 技巧；艺术性的方法
definition_en: creative expression through activities such as painting, sculpture, or drawing | objects or images created to express ideas or beauty | a skill developed through practice and careful understanding
example1_en: We spent the afternoon making art with coloured paper.
example1_zh: 我们花了一下午用彩纸创作艺术作品。
example2_en: Public funding for art can enrich community life and make cultural experiences accessible to a wider audience.
example2_zh: 公共艺术资助能丰富社区生活，让更多人有机会体验文化活动。
collocations: a work of art｜一件艺术作品 ; modern art｜现代艺术 ; an art gallery｜美术馆 ; the art of conversation｜交谈的艺术
tip_zh: art指艺术通常不可数；一件作品用a work of art。

meanings_zh: n. 奶奶；外婆（口语）
definition_en: another informal word for grandmother
example1_en: Granny knitted me a warm scarf.
example1_zh: 奶奶给我织了一条温暖的围巾。
example2_en: We are staying at granny's house for the holiday.
example2_zh: 假期我们住在奶奶家。
tip_zh: granny 与 grandma 都是对奶奶/外婆的亲昵称呼。

meanings_zh: n. 橱柜；壁橱
definition_en: A cabinet with doors and shelves for storing things
example1_en: The clean bowls are in the cupboard above the sink.
example1_zh: 干净的碗放在水槽上方的橱柜里。
example2_en: Well-designed cupboards can maximise storage space in small apartments without making living areas feel crowded.
example2_zh: 设计合理的橱柜可以充分利用小公寓的储物空间，又不会让起居区域显得拥挤。
collocations: kitchen cupboard｜厨房橱柜 ; built-in cupboard｜嵌入式橱柜 ; cupboard door｜橱柜门
tip_zh: cupboard中的p不发音；通常指带门的储物柜。

meanings_zh: adj. 更差的；更严重的 | adv. 更差地；更糟地
definition_en: Less good or more unpleasant, harmful, or serious. | Less well or more badly.
example1_en: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
example1_zh: 我们爬山时，天气变得更糟了。
example2_en: Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
example2_zh: 除非城市投资建设可靠且价格合理的公共交通，否则交通拥堵可能进一步恶化。
collocations: get worse｜变得更糟 ; even worse｜甚至更糟 ; make matters worse｜使情况更糟
tip_zh: bad和badly的比较级；最高级是worst。

meanings_zh: n. 文件；证件；文档 | v. 记录；记载
definition_en: a paper or digital record containing information | record information about something in writing, photographs, or other forms
example1_en: Please save the document before you close your laptop.
example1_zh: 合上笔记本电脑之前，请保存文档。
example2_en: Researchers should document changes in local wildlife to assess the environmental impact of urban development.
example2_zh: 研究人员应记录当地野生生物的变化，以评估城市开发对环境的影响。
collocations: official document｜正式文件 ; travel documents｜旅行证件 ; save a document｜保存文档 ; document changes｜记录变化
tip_zh: 动词末尾读/ment/，名词末尾读/mənt/。

meanings_zh: n. 板球运动 | n. 蟋蟀
definition_en: A team sport using a bat, ball, and wickets. | A jumping insect that makes a chirping sound.
example1_en: We played cricket in the park after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们在公园里打板球。
example2_en: Team sports such as cricket can help young people develop cooperation skills and build lasting friendships.
example2_zh: 板球等团队运动可以帮助年轻人培养合作能力，建立持久的友谊。
collocations: play cricket｜打板球 ; a cricket match｜一场板球比赛 ; a cricket bat｜板球球拍 ; crickets chirping｜蟋蟀鸣叫
tip_zh: 指板球运动时不可数；指蟋蟀时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 鲨鱼 | n. 骗子；敲诈者
definition_en: A fish with a cartilage skeleton and usually sharp teeth. | Someone who cheats others, especially to get their money.
example1_en: We watched a shark swim slowly behind the aquarium glass.
example1_zh: 我们看着一条鲨鱼在水族馆的玻璃后缓缓游动。
example2_en: Protecting shark populations helps maintain balanced marine ecosystems because many species regulate the numbers of other animals.
example2_zh: 保护鲨鱼种群有助于维持海洋生态平衡，因为许多鲨鱼物种能调节其他动物的数量。
collocations: shark fin｜鲨鱼鳍 ; whale shark｜鲸鲨 ; shark conservation｜鲨鱼保护 ; loan shark｜放高利贷者
tip_zh: loan shark指放高利贷者，不是某种鲨鱼。

meanings_zh: v. 打破；折断；破裂 | n. 休息；暂停 | v. 违反；违背
definition_en: To separate into pieces or damage something so it stops working. | A short period when an activity stops. | To fail to obey a rule or keep a promise.
example1_en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
example1_zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。
example2_en: Regular breaks during study sessions may improve concentration and help students retain new information.
example2_zh: 学习期间定时休息可能有助于提高注意力，并帮助学生记住新知识。
collocations: take a break｜休息一下 ; break the law｜违法 ; break a promise｜违背承诺 ; break a record｜打破纪录
tip_zh: 动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。

meanings_zh: n. 蛋；卵 | n. 卵细胞；卵子
definition_en: a rounded object laid by female birds and some other animals | a female reproductive cell that can develop after fertilisation
example1_en: She cracked an egg into the hot frying pan.
example1_zh: 她把一个鸡蛋打进了热煎锅。
example2_en: Eggs provide an affordable source of protein and can form part of a balanced diet.
example2_zh: 鸡蛋是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，可以成为均衡饮食的一部分。
collocations: boiled egg｜水煮蛋 ; lay eggs｜产卵 ; egg yolk｜蛋黄 ; egg cell｜卵细胞
tip_zh: scrambled eggs指炒蛋；egg white指蛋清。

meanings_zh: n. 年；一年 | n. 学年；年度
definition_en: A period of twelve months | An annual period organised for education, business, or another purpose
example1_en: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
example1_zh: 我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。
example2_en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
example2_zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。
collocations: academic year｜学年 ; every year｜每年 ; all year round｜全年 ; gap year｜间隔年
tip_zh: last year等时间短语前不加介词；年龄用years old。

meanings_zh: adj. 国际的；跨国的 | n. 国际比赛；国家队选手
definition_en: Involving two or more countries. | A match between countries, or a player representing a country.
example1_en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
example1_zh: 我姐姐明天早上要乘坐国际航班。
example2_en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
example2_zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。
collocations: international trade｜国际贸易 ; international cooperation｜国际合作 ; an international flight｜国际航班 ; international students｜国际学生
tip_zh: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

meanings_zh: adj. 免费的 | adj. 自由的；不受限制的 | v. 释放；使摆脱
definition_en: Costing no money. | Able to act or move without being controlled or restricted. | To release someone or something from control or confinement.
example1_en: The café offers free biscuits with every hot drink.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆每卖一杯热饮都会赠送饼干。
example2_en: Providing free public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment for disadvantaged residents.
example2_zh: 提供免费公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善弱势居民的就业可及性。
collocations: free admission｜免费入场 ; free of charge｜免费 ; free speech｜言论自由 ; free someone from｜使某人摆脱
tip_zh: be free to do表示可以自由做；for free表示免费。

meanings_zh: n. 活动；重大事件 | n. 比赛项目
definition_en: Something that happens, especially an important or planned occasion. | A particular contest within a sports competition.
example1_en: The outdoor concert was our town's biggest summer event.
example1_zh: 这场户外音乐会是我们镇上夏季最大的活动。
example2_en: Hosting a major cultural event can boost local tourism, although the financial benefits may be unevenly distributed.
example2_zh: 举办大型文化活动可以促进当地旅游业，但经济收益的分配可能不均。
collocations: organise an event｜组织活动 ; major event｜重大事件 ; sporting event｜体育赛事 ; in the event of｜万一发生
tip_zh: in the event of后接名词，意为“万一发生”。

meanings_zh: adv. 然而；不过 | adv. 无论多么 | conj. 无论以何种方式
definition_en: Used to introduce a contrasting statement. | No matter how much or to what degree. | In any way that someone chooses.
example1_en: The jacket looked warm; however, it felt surprisingly thin.
example1_zh: 这件夹克看起来很暖和，摸起来却出奇地薄。
example2_en: Online courses offer greater flexibility; however, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers.
example2_zh: 在线课程更加灵活；不过，有些学习者从与教师的直接互动中获益更多。
collocations: however difficult｜无论多困难 ; however much｜无论多少 ; however hard you try｜无论你多努力
tip_zh: 表转折时不是并列连词；勿仅用逗号连接两句。

meanings_zh: n. 博物馆
definition_en: a building displaying objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest
example1_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
example1_zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
example2_en: Museums can help young people understand local history by connecting everyday objects with the lives of previous generations.
example2_zh: 博物馆可以将日常物品与前人的生活联系起来，帮助年轻人了解当地历史。
collocations: visit a museum｜参观博物馆 ; natural history museum｜自然历史博物馆 ; museum collection｜博物馆藏品
tip_zh: museum是可数名词；参观博物馆说visit a museum。

meanings_zh: n. 商店；店铺 | v. 购物
definition_en: A place where people buy goods or services. | To visit stores or websites to look for and buy things.
example1_en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
example1_zh: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。
example2_en: Independent shops can strengthen local economies by creating jobs and keeping spending within the community.
example2_zh: 独立商店可以通过创造就业并让消费留在社区内，促进地方经济。
collocations: local shop｜本地商店 ; shop window｜商店橱窗 ; shop for clothes｜买衣服 ; shop around｜货比三家
tip_zh: 买某类商品用shop for；泛指去购物用go shopping。

meanings_zh: n. 周末
definition_en: Saturday and Sunday, often a time away from work.
example1_en: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
example1_zh: 我们通常在周末逛农贸市场。
example2_en: Affordable weekend activities can encourage families to spend more time together in their local communities.
example2_zh: 价格亲民的周末活动能鼓励家人在当地社区共度更多时光。
collocations: at the weekend｜在周末（英式） ; on the weekend｜在周末（美式） ; a long weekend｜连休的长周末 ; weekend break｜周末短途度假
tip_zh: 英式常说 at the weekend，美式常用 on。

meanings_zh: n. 毛衣；针织套衫
definition_en: A knitted garment worn over the upper body for warmth.
example1_en: I pulled on a warm sweater before going outside.
example1_zh: 出门前，我套上了一件暖和的毛衣。
example2_en: Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
example2_zh: 选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。
collocations: wool sweater｜羊毛衫 ; knitted sweater｜针织毛衣 ; thick sweater｜厚毛衣
tip_zh: 英式英语也常用jumper；sweatshirt指运动衫。

meanings_zh: adj. 在场的；目前的 | v. 展示；提出；颁发 | n. 礼物；现在
definition_en: being in a place; existing or happening now | to show, explain or formally give something | something given to someone; the time happening now
example1_en: All the children were present for the class photo.
example1_zh: 拍班级合照时，所有孩子都在场。
example2_en: Researchers should present their findings clearly so that policymakers can make informed decisions about public health.
example2_zh: 研究人员应清楚地展示研究结果，以便政策制定者就公共卫生作出有依据的决策。
collocations: be present at｜出席 ; at present｜目前 ; present evidence｜提供证据 ; birthday present｜生日礼物
tip_zh: 名词、形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: phr. 各种各样的
definition_en: many different types of something
example1_en: The toy shop has all sorts of board games.
example1_zh: 这家玩具店有各种各样的桌游。
example2_en: She likes reading all sorts of books.
example2_zh: 她喜欢读各种各样的书。
tip_zh: all sorts of 和 all kinds of 意思相近，都可以表示“各种各样的”。

meanings_zh: n. 红绿灯
definition_en: a signal with red, yellow and green lights for traffic
example1_en: Stop at the traffic light and wait for green.
example1_zh: 在红绿灯前停下，等绿灯。
example2_en: The traffic light turned red just as we arrived.
example2_zh: 我们到的时候红绿灯刚变红。
tip_zh: traffic light 红绿灯；green light 绿灯通行，red light 红灯停。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人惊讶的
definition_en: making you feel surprise
example1_en: It is surprising how fast the puppy grew.
example1_zh: 小狗长得这么快真令人惊讶。
example2_en: The surprising result shocked everyone.
example2_zh: 出人意料的结果震惊了所有人。
tip_zh: surprising 形容事物；surprised 形容人的感受。

meanings_zh: pron. 任何人；有人
definition_en: Any person, or someone whose identity is not specified.
example1_en: Does anybody know where I left my blue umbrella?
example1_zh: 有人知道我把蓝色雨伞放在哪里了吗？
example2_en: Public libraries should be accessible to anybody who wishes to learn, regardless of their income or background.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应向所有想学习的人开放，不论其收入或背景如何。
collocations: anybody else｜其他人 ; hardly anybody｜几乎没有人 ; anybody at all｜任何人
tip_zh: anybody作主语时，谓语用单数形式。

meanings_zh: n. 母亲；妈妈 | v. 像母亲般照顾
definition_en: A female parent. | Care for someone protectively, as a mother would.
example1_en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
example1_zh: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。
example2_en: Affordable childcare can help a mother return to work without placing excessive pressure on the family budget.
example2_zh: 负担得起的托育服务能帮助母亲重返职场，而不给家庭预算带来过大压力。
collocations: working mother｜在职母亲 ; single mother｜单亲母亲 ; expectant mother｜准妈妈 ; mother tongue｜母语
tip_zh: 英式口语常用mum，美式口语常用mom。

meanings_zh: phr. 首先
definition_en: before anything else
example1_en: First of all, let me thank everyone for coming.
example1_zh: 首先，感谢大家的到来。
example2_en: First of all, wash your hands.
example2_zh: 首先，洗一下手。
tip_zh: first of all 用于列举时的第一点，类似 firstly。

meanings_zh: n. 租金 | v. 租用；租借 | v. 出租
definition_en: money paid regularly to use someone else's property | to pay to use something owned by someone else | to let someone use your property in exchange for payment
example1_en: My monthly rent includes water but not electricity.
example1_zh: 我每月的租金包含水费，但不含电费。
example2_en: Rising rents in urban areas can force essential workers to live further from their workplaces.
example2_zh: 城市地区租金上涨可能迫使提供基本服务的劳动者住得离工作地点更远。
collocations: pay rent｜付租金 ; rent a flat｜租公寓 ; rent out a room｜出租房间 ; monthly rent｜月租
tip_zh: rent可指租入或出租；rent out明确表示出租。

meanings_zh: adj. 疲倦的；累的 | adj. 厌倦的；厌烦的
definition_en: needing rest or sleep because of physical or mental effort | annoyed or bored by something that continues or repeats
example1_en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
example1_zh: 散步后我累得不想做饭。
example2_en: Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
example2_zh: 经常长时间工作的员工可能会疲惫不堪，无法安全地履行职责。
collocations: feel tired｜感到疲倦 ; tired of waiting｜等得不耐烦 ; too tired to concentrate｜累得无法集中注意力
tip_zh: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。

meanings_zh: v. 玩耍；参加游戏或运动 | v. 演奏；播放；扮演 | n. 戏剧；剧本
definition_en: Enjoy an activity or take part in a game | Perform music or a role, or make a recording run | A story written for actors to perform
example1_en: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
example1_zh: 孩子们在地板上玩木制积木。
example2_en: Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
example2_zh: 学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。
collocations: play football｜踢足球 ; play the piano｜弹钢琴 ; play a role in｜在…中发挥作用 ; put on a play｜上演一部戏剧
tip_zh: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

meanings_zh: phr. 谢谢你
definition_en: a polite way to show thanks
example1_en: Thank you for the lovely birthday card.
example1_zh: 谢谢你送的美好生日贺卡。
example2_en: 'Thank you very much,' she said with a smile.
example2_zh: “非常感谢。”她笑着说。
tip_zh: thank you very much 是“非常感谢”；口语常说 thanks。

meanings_zh: adj. 不同的；不一样的 | adj. 各不相同的；各种的
definition_en: not the same as someone or something else | used to describe several separate people, things, or types
example1_en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
example1_zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。
example2_en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
example2_zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。
collocations: different from｜与……不同 ; different perspectives｜不同视角 ; completely different｜完全不同
tip_zh: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

meanings_zh: n. 游泳池；水塘 | n. 共同储备；备用资源 | v. 集中共用；合伙出资
definition_en: An artificial swimming basin or a small area of still water | A supply of money, people, or resources available for shared use | To combine resources so people can use them together
example1_en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
example1_zh: 我们整个下午都在室外游泳池游泳。
example2_en: Small businesses can pool their resources to purchase equipment that would otherwise be too expensive.
example2_zh: 小企业可以集中资源，购买单独承担会过于昂贵的设备。
collocations: a swimming pool｜游泳池 ; a pool of talent｜人才储备 ; pool resources｜集中资源 ; pool knowledge｜共享知识
tip_zh: pool resources指集中资源；play pool则指打美式台球。

meanings_zh: n. 说唱音乐；说唱歌曲 | v. 表演说唱 | v. 快速敲击
definition_en: music with words spoken rhythmically over a strong beat | to speak words rhythmically over a musical beat | to hit a surface with short, sharp blows
example1_en: My brother listens to rap while he cooks dinner.
example1_zh: 我哥哥做晚饭时会听说唱音乐。
example2_en: Rap can give young people a creative way to express their experiences and discuss social issues.
example2_zh: 说唱能为年轻人提供一种富有创意的方式，表达经历并讨论社会问题。
collocations: rap music｜说唱音乐 ; rap artist｜说唱艺人 ; rap on the door｜急促敲门
tip_zh: rap重读闭音节结尾：rapped、rapping双写p。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……之前 | conj. 在……以前 | adv. 以前；先前
definition_en: Earlier than a particular time or event. | Earlier than the time when something happens. | At an earlier time.
example1_en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
example1_zh: 请在晚饭前把鞋放到门边。
example2_en: Before introducing new transport policies, local authorities should consult residents about their daily travel needs.
example2_zh: 地方政府在推出新的交通政策之前，应就居民的日常出行需求征求意见。
collocations: before long｜不久以后 ; the day before｜前一天 ; before breakfast｜早餐前 ; before making a decision｜作决定之前
tip_zh: 时间从句表将来时，before后通常用一般现在时。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；令人愉快的
definition_en: Extremely good or enjoyable.
example1_en: We had a wonderful picnic beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边度过了一段美好的野餐时光。
example2_en: Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆为儿童发现新兴趣提供了极好的机会，又不会给家庭带来经济压力。
collocations: a wonderful experience｜美好的经历 ; a wonderful opportunity｜极好的机会 ; wonderful news｜令人高兴的消息
tip_zh: 表示极好或令人愉快，不等于奇怪的。

meanings_zh: n. 机械修理工；汽车修理工
definition_en: Someone whose job is repairing vehicles or machines.
example1_en: The mechanic found a leak under our car.
example1_zh: 修理工发现我们的汽车底部有一处泄漏。
example2_en: As electric vehicles become more common, mechanics need additional training to maintain their complex systems safely.
example2_zh: 随着电动汽车日益普及，修理工需要接受额外培训，以安全地维护其复杂系统。
collocations: car mechanic｜汽车修理工 ; a qualified mechanic｜合格的机械修理工 ; work as a mechanic｜当机械修理工
tip_zh: mechanic指修理工；mechanics可指力学。

meanings_zh: n. 笔记本；笔记簿 | n. 笔记本电脑
definition_en: A book of blank pages for writing notes. | A small portable computer with a folding screen.
example1_en: She keeps a small notebook beside her bed.
example1_zh: 她在床边放着一本小笔记本。
example2_en: Keeping a notebook during fieldwork allows researchers to record observations that photographs alone may not capture.
example2_zh: 实地研究时使用笔记本，有助于研究人员记录仅靠照片可能无法捕捉的观察结果。
collocations: write in a notebook｜在笔记本上写 ; a spiral notebook｜螺旋装订笔记本 ; a notebook computer｜笔记本电脑
tip_zh: 通常指纸质笔记本；电脑义也可说notebook computer。

meanings_zh: adj. 白色的 | n. 白色 | n. 蛋白；蛋清
definition_en: having the colour of fresh snow or milk | the colour of fresh snow or milk | the clear part of an egg that turns white when cooked
example1_en: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
example1_zh: 她穿着一件白色棉衬衫去野餐。
example2_en: Painting roofs white can help buildings reflect sunlight and reduce the energy needed for cooling.
example2_zh: 把屋顶刷成白色有助于建筑物反射阳光，并减少制冷所需的能源。
collocations: white paint｜白色油漆 ; egg white｜蛋清 ; black and white｜黑白的
tip_zh: egg white指蛋清；蛋黄是yolk。

meanings_zh: n. 滑板运动
definition_en: the activity of riding and performing tricks on a skateboard
example1_en: We went skateboarding at the park after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们去公园玩滑板了。
example2_en: Dedicated skateboarding facilities give young people safe spaces to exercise and develop their balance and coordination.
example2_zh: 专用滑板设施为年轻人提供了安全的锻炼空间，帮助他们提高平衡感和协调能力。
collocations: go skateboarding｜去玩滑板 ; skateboarding skills｜滑板技巧 ; skateboarding facilities｜滑板运动设施
tip_zh: 运动用skateboarding；滑板这件器材用skateboard。

meanings_zh: adj. 大的；大量的
definition_en: greater than usual in size, amount, or number
example1_en: A large dog was sleeping beside the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 一只大狗正睡在厨房门旁。
example2_en: Large cities often offer better employment opportunities, although high housing costs can reduce residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 大城市通常提供更好的就业机会，但高昂的住房成本可能降低居民的生活质量。
collocations: a large number of｜大量的 ; a large amount of｜大量的 ; large-scale development｜大规模开发 ; a large population｜众多人口
tip_zh: large number接可数名词，large amount接不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 小时 | n. 工作或营业时间
definition_en: a period of sixty minutes | the times when someone works or a service operates
example1_en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
example1_zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。
example2_en: Reducing working hours may improve employee wellbeing without necessarily lowering overall productivity in the workplace.
example2_zh: 缩短工作时间可能改善员工的身心健康，而不一定降低工作场所的整体生产率。
collocations: an hour｜一小时 ; working hours｜工作时间 ; opening hours｜营业时间 ; rush hour｜交通高峰期
tip_zh: h不发音，所以说an hour，而不是a hour。

meanings_zh: adj. 已婚的 | adj. 婚姻的；夫妻生活的
definition_en: Having a husband or wife. | Relating to marriage or life as a couple.
example1_en: My sister is married and lives near the coast.
example1_zh: 我姐姐已婚，住在海岸附近。
example2_en: Affordable housing can help newly married couples establish independent households without placing excessive pressure on their finances.
example2_zh: 可负担的住房有助于新婚夫妇独立成家，而不会给他们带来过重的经济压力。
collocations: get married｜结婚 ; be married to｜与……有婚姻关系 ; married couple｜已婚夫妇 ; married life｜婚后生活
tip_zh: 与某人结婚用 be/get married to，不用 with。

meanings_zh: adj. 满的；装满的 | adj. 完整的；全部的 | adj. 吃饱的
definition_en: Containing as much as possible, with no space left. | Including everything, with nothing missing. | Having eaten enough and not wanting more food.
example1_en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
example1_zh: 篮子已经满了，我们得再拿一个。
example2_en: Governments should publish the full results of environmental studies so that citizens can make informed decisions.
example2_zh: 政府应公布环境研究的完整结果，以便公民作出知情决策。
collocations: full of｜充满 ; full details｜完整细节 ; full potential｜全部潜力 ; feel full｜感觉饱了
tip_zh: full of表示“充满”；注意full与fool发音不同。

meanings_zh: v. 发生 | v. 碰巧；恰好
definition_en: to take place, often without being planned | to do or be something by chance
example1_en: What happened to the plant beside your window?
example1_zh: 你窗边那盆植物怎么了？
example2_en: Traffic accidents are more likely to happen when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
example2_zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，更容易发生交通事故。
collocations: happen to someone｜发生在某人身上 ; happen to do something｜碰巧做某事 ; happen by chance｜偶然发生
tip_zh: 不用于被动语态；happen to do表示碰巧做某事。

meanings_zh: phr. 完全；根本（用于否定句、疑问句）
definition_en: in any way; used in negatives and questions
example1_en: I don't like this film at all.
example1_zh: 我一点也不喜欢这部电影。
example2_en: Are you tired at all?
example2_zh: 你有一点累吗？
tip_zh: at all 用于否定句表示“一点也不”，用于疑问句表示“究竟、到底”。

meanings_zh: n. 成功；成就 | n. 成功的人或事物
definition_en: the achievement of an aim or a desired result | a person or thing that achieves a good result
example1_en: The school concert was a success despite the rain.
example1_zh: 尽管下了雨，学校音乐会还是很成功。
example2_en: Long-term success in education depends not only on funding but also on the quality of teaching.
example2_zh: 教育的长期成功不仅取决于资金投入，也取决于教学质量。
collocations: achieve success｜取得成功 ; a great success｜巨大的成功 ; the key to success｜成功的关键 ; success rate｜成功率
tip_zh: 泛指成功时不可数；a success指成功的人或事。

meanings_zh: n. 数；数字；号码 | n. 数量 | v. 给…编号；总计
definition_en: a value used for counting, measuring, or identifying something | the total amount of people or things | to assign identifying figures or add up to a total
example1_en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
example1_zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。
example2_en: The number of people working from home has increased as digital communication tools have improved.
example2_zh: 随着数字通信工具的改进，居家办公的人数有所增加。
collocations: phone number｜电话号码 ; a large number of｜大量 ; the number of｜…的数量 ; number the pages｜给页面编号
tip_zh: a number of接复数谓语；the number of接单数谓语。

meanings_zh: v. 拿；取；带走 | v. 花费；需要 | v. 乘坐；搭乘
definition_en: To pick up, hold, or carry something away. | To require a particular amount of time or effort. | To use a particular form of transport.
example1_en: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
example1_zh: 带把伞吧，今天下午可能会下雨。
example2_en: Developing reliable public transport networks takes considerable time and requires sustained investment from local authorities.
example2_zh: 建设可靠的公共交通网络需要相当长的时间，也需要地方政府持续投入资金。
collocations: take a bus｜乘公共汽车 ; take time｜花时间 ; take responsibility｜承担责任 ; take notes｜记笔记
tip_zh: 过去式took，过去分词taken；take带走，bring带来。

meanings_zh: n. 商务人士；生意人
definition_en: a person who works in business
example1_en: She is a business person who travels a lot.
example1_zh: 她是一位经常出差的商务人士。
example2_en: The hotel welcomes business people from all over the world.
example2_zh: 这家酒店欢迎来自世界各地的商务人士。
tip_zh: business person 是不分性别的说法，比 businessman/businesswoman 更中性。

meanings_zh: n. 套头毛衣（英） | n. 跳跃者；跳高或跳远运动员 | n. 无袖连衣裙（美）
definition_en: A knitted piece of clothing covering the upper body. | A person or animal that jumps, especially in sport. | A sleeveless dress worn over a shirt or blouse.
example1_en: I packed a warm jumper for the camping trip.
example1_zh: 我为这次露营带了一件暖和的套头毛衣。
example2_en: Wearing a jumper indoors can reduce the need for heating during colder months.
example2_zh: 在寒冷的月份，室内穿毛衣可以减少供暖需求。
collocations: woollen jumper｜羊毛套头衫 ; put on a jumper｜穿上套头毛衣 ; high jumper｜跳高运动员
tip_zh: 英式英语指套头毛衣；美式通常用sweater。

meanings_zh: v. 享受；喜爱 | v. 享有
definition_en: get pleasure from an activity or experience | have something good, such as a right or advantage
example1_en: We enjoy walking beside the river after dinner.
example1_zh: 我们喜欢晚饭后在河边散步。
example2_en: Residents enjoy better health when their neighbourhoods provide safe walking routes and accessible green spaces.
example2_zh: 社区提供安全的步行路线和便利的绿地时，居民的健康状况会更好。
collocations: enjoy doing something｜喜欢做某事 ; enjoy yourself｜玩得开心 ; enjoy good health｜身体健康 ; enjoy the benefits｜享有益处
tip_zh: 接动词时用-ing形式，不用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 床单 | n. 一张；薄片
definition_en: A large piece of cloth used to cover a bed. | A thin, flat piece of paper, metal, or another material.
example1_en: I spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
example1_zh: 我在床垫上铺了一条干净的床单。
example2_en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to use both sides of each sheet.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生使用每张纸的正反两面，以减少纸张浪费。
collocations: bed sheet｜床单 ; a sheet of paper｜一张纸 ; a sheet of glass｜一块玻璃 ; sheet metal｜金属薄板
tip_zh: sheet是可数名词；一张纸说a sheet of paper。

meanings_zh: n. 学童；小学生
definition_en: a child who goes to school
example1_en: Every schoolchild in the town got a free book.
example1_zh: 镇上的每个学童都得到了一本免费的书。
example2_en: The schoolchildren walked to the museum in a line.
example2_zh: 小学生们排着队走去博物馆。
tip_zh: schoolchild 复数 schoolchildren；pupil 也指学生。

meanings_zh: n. 一月
definition_en: the first month of the year
example1_en: Our swimming lessons begin in January this year.
example1_zh: 我们今年的游泳课从一月开始。
example2_en: Many people set health goals in January, but maintaining new habits requires consistent support.
example2_zh: 许多人在一月设定健康目标，但保持新习惯需要持续的支持。
collocations: in January｜在一月 ; early January｜一月初 ; late January｜一月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；在一月用in January。

meanings_zh: n. 业余爱好
definition_en: An activity you regularly do for pleasure in your free time
example1_en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
example1_zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。
example2_en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
example2_zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。
collocations: take up a hobby｜开始培养一种爱好 ; a creative hobby｜创造性的业余爱好 ; pursue a hobby｜从事业余爱好
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。

meanings_zh: n. 艺术家；画家 | n. 表演艺术家；艺人
definition_en: a person who creates paintings, sculptures, or other art | a person who performs music or other entertainment professionally
example1_en: The artist painted the harbour in soft blue colours.
example1_zh: 这位画家用柔和的蓝色描绘了港口。
example2_en: Public funding allows an artist to create work that enriches community life without depending entirely on sales.
example2_zh: 公共资助使艺术家能够创作丰富社区生活的作品，而不必完全依赖销售收入。
collocations: professional artist｜职业艺术家 ; local artist｜本地艺术家 ; recording artist｜录音艺人 ; talented artist｜有才华的艺术家
tip_zh: artist指艺术家；artistic是形容词“艺术的”。

meanings_zh: adv. 曾经；在任何时候 | adv. 始终；不断地 | adv. 究竟；到底
definition_en: At any time, especially in questions and negative statements. | Continuously or always, often describing an ongoing change. | Used to emphasize surprise in a question.
example1_en: Have you ever watched the sunrise from a mountain?
example1_zh: 你曾经在山上看过日出吗？
example2_en: Public transport is more important than ever as growing cities struggle with congestion and air pollution.
example2_zh: 随着不断扩张的城市面临交通拥堵和空气污染，公共交通比以往任何时候都更重要。
collocations: ever since｜自从……以来一直 ; hardly ever｜几乎从不 ; more than ever｜比以往任何时候都更 ; ever-growing demand｜不断增长的需求
tip_zh: 问经历常用Have you ever…；肯定句不随意代替always。

meanings_zh: adv. 不；没有
definition_en: used to make a word or sentence negative
example1_en: I am not hungry right now.
example1_zh: 我现在不饿。
example2_en: This is not my umbrella.
example2_zh: 这不是我的伞。
collocations: not at all｜一点也不
tip_zh: not 用于构成否定；can not 可缩为 can't，is not 缩为 isn't。

meanings_zh: n. 孙女；外孙女
definition_en: The daughter of someone's son or daughter
example1_en: Her granddaughter brought fresh flowers when she visited on Sunday.
example1_zh: 她的孙女星期天来看她时带来了鲜花。
example2_en: Regular contact with a granddaughter or grandson can help older adults feel more connected to family life.
example2_zh: 经常与孙辈联系，可以帮助老年人更好地融入家庭生活。
collocations: youngest granddaughter｜最小的孙女或外孙女 ; granddaughter's birthday｜孙女或外孙女的生日
tip_zh: 既指孙女也指外孙女，英语不区分父系与母系。

meanings_zh: n. 乘客；旅客
definition_en: Someone travelling in a vehicle without driving or operating it
example1_en: A passenger left a blue umbrella on the bus.
example1_zh: 一位乘客把一把蓝色雨伞落在了公交车上。
example2_en: Improved rail services could increase passenger numbers and reduce reliance on private cars.
example2_zh: 改善铁路服务可以增加乘客数量，减少人们对私家车的依赖。
collocations: passenger train｜客运列车 ; passenger seat｜乘客座位 ; passenger numbers｜乘客数量
tip_zh: 指乘坐交通工具的人，不包括驾驶员或机组人员。

meanings_zh: prep. 因为；由于
definition_en: as a result of something
example1_en: The match was cancelled because of the rain.
example1_zh: 比赛因为下雨被取消了。
example2_en: She stayed at home because of her cold.
example2_zh: 她因为感冒待在家里。
tip_zh: because of 后接名词/代词；because 后接完整句子。

meanings_zh: n. 文章；报道 | n. 物品；一件东西 | n. 冠词
definition_en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website. | A single item, especially one belonging to a particular group. | A word such as a, an, or the before a noun.
example1_en: I read an interesting article about growing tomatoes indoors.
example1_zh: 我读了一篇关于室内种植番茄的有趣文章。
example2_en: The article examines how access to green spaces influences mental health in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在密集人口城市中，绿地的可及性如何影响心理健康。
collocations: a newspaper article｜报纸文章 ; write an article｜写文章 ; an article of clothing｜一件衣物 ; the definite article｜定冠词
tip_zh: 一件衣物可说an article of clothing。

meanings_zh: v. 站立；起立 | v. 忍受；容忍 | n. 立场；坚决的态度
definition_en: To be upright on your feet, or get into this position. | To accept something unpleasant without becoming too upset. | A firm opinion or action supporting or opposing something.
example1_en: Please stand near the door until the bus stops.
example1_zh: 请站在车门附近，等公交车停稳。
example2_en: Local residents took a stand against the proposed road because it would destroy valuable woodland.
example2_zh: 当地居民坚决反对这条拟建道路，因为它会破坏珍贵的林地。
collocations: stand still｜站着不动 ; stand up｜站起来 ; can't stand doing something｜无法忍受做某事 ; take a stand｜表明坚定立场
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为stood；忍受常用can't stand。

meanings_zh: n. 十三至十九岁青少年
definition_en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.
example1_en: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
example1_zh: 我十几岁时每天骑自行车上学。
example2_en: Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.
example2_zh: 学校应提供场所，让青少年能够讨论自己的困扰，并获得受过培训的工作人员的支持。
collocations: a young teenager｜十三四岁的青少年 ; as a teenager｜在青少年时期 ; teenagers' needs｜青少年的需求
tip_zh: 特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。

meanings_zh: adv. 代替；反而
definition_en: in place of someone or something else
example1_en: The café was closed, so we went home instead.
example1_zh: 咖啡馆关门了，于是我们改为回家。
example2_en: Instead of expanding roads, cities should invest in public transport to reduce congestion and pollution.
example2_zh: 城市应投资公共交通，而不是拓宽道路，以减少拥堵和污染。
collocations: instead of｜而不是；代替 ; go instead｜改为去 ; use something instead｜改用某物
tip_zh: instead可单独作副词；instead of后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 必须 | v. 一定；想必 | n. 必需的事物
definition_en: used to express a strong obligation or requirement | used to express a confident conclusion | something considered essential
example1_en: You must wear a helmet when riding here.
example1_zh: 在这里骑车必须戴头盔。
example2_en: Governments must ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of their family income.
example2_zh: 政府必须确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不论其家庭收入如何。
collocations: must be｜一定是 ; must have done｜想必已经做过 ; an absolute must｜绝对必需的事物
tip_zh: must是情态动词；mustn't表禁止，不是“不必”。

meanings_zh: n. 天空
definition_en: The space above the earth where clouds and stars appear.
example1_en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
example1_zh: 我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。
example2_en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.
example2_zh: 光污染使许多城市居民无法清楚地看到夜空中的星星。
collocations: clear sky｜晴朗的天空 ; night sky｜夜空 ; blue sky｜蓝天 ; cloudy skies｜多云的天空
tip_zh: 通常用the sky；skies常用于描述天气或某地天空。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人惊叹的；极好的
definition_en: Causing great surprise or admiration.
example1_en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
example1_zh: 从山上望去的景色真是令人惊叹。
example2_en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
example2_zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。
collocations: absolutely amazing｜极其精彩的 ; amazing results｜惊人的成果 ; an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip_zh: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

meanings_zh: phr v. 穿上；戴上
definition_en: to get dressed or put something on your body
example1_en: Put on your coat, it's cold outside.
example1_zh: 穿上外套，外面很冷。
example2_en: She put on her glasses to read.
example2_zh: 她戴上眼镜看书。
tip_zh: put on 是“穿上/戴上”；反义短语是 take off（脱下）。

meanings_zh: prep. 关于 | adv. 大约；左右 | prep. 在…周围；在…各处
definition_en: concerning a particular subject | approximately, rather than exactly | in various places within or around somewhere
example1_en: We talked about our holiday plans over dinner.
example1_zh: 我们吃晚饭时聊了假期计划。
example2_en: Schools should teach children about the environmental consequences of their everyday choices and habits.
example2_zh: 学校应教导孩子了解日常选择和习惯对环境的影响。
collocations: talk about｜谈论 ; worry about｜担心 ; about an hour｜大约一小时
tip_zh: about可表示话题或约数；be about to表示即将。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭主妇
definition_en: A married woman managing her home rather than doing paid work.
example1_en: As a housewife, she manages a busy household.
example1_zh: 作为家庭主妇，她操持着一个忙碌家庭的日常事务。
example2_en: The unpaid work of a housewife contributes to family welfare but is often excluded from economic statistics.
example2_zh: 家庭主妇的无偿劳动有助于家庭福祉，却往往不被纳入经济统计。
collocations: a full-time housewife｜全职家庭主妇 ; work as a housewife｜做家庭主妇
tip_zh: 复数为housewives；homemaker不限定性别。

meanings_zh: n. 三明治 | v. 把……夹在中间
definition_en: Two slices of bread with a filling between them. | To place or squeeze something between two other things.
example1_en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
example1_zh: 我带了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果当午餐。
example2_en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating by offering sandwiches made with wholegrain bread and fresh vegetables.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以提供用全麦面包和新鲜蔬菜制作的三明治，促进更健康的饮食。
collocations: cheese sandwich｜奶酪三明治 ; make a sandwich｜做三明治 ; be sandwiched between｜被夹在……之间
tip_zh: 动词常用被动结构be sandwiched between。

meanings_zh: n. 连帽衫
definition_en: a sweatshirt with a hood
example1_en: He wears a grey hoodie every day.
example1_zh: 他每天都穿一件灰色连帽衫。
example2_en: My new hoodie has a pocket in the front.
example2_zh: 我的新连帽衫前面有个口袋。
tip_zh: hoodie 是带帽子的运动衫，学生中很流行。

meanings_zh: adj. 缓慢的；耗时的 | v. 减速；使放慢 | adj. 钟表走得慢的
definition_en: Moving, happening, or taking place at a low speed. | To move or happen less quickly, or make something do so. | Showing a time earlier than the correct time.
example1_en: We took a slow walk along the river.
example1_zh: 我们沿着河边慢慢散步。
example2_en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。
collocations: slow progress｜缓慢的进展 ; slow down｜减速；放慢 ; a slow pace｜缓慢的节奏 ; slow economic growth｜缓慢的经济增长
tip_zh: slow多作形容词；修饰一般动作通常用slowly。

meanings_zh: phr v. 捡起；拿起；接（人）
definition_en: to lift something up, or to collect someone
example1_en: Please pick up the litter and put it in the bin.
example1_zh: 请捡起垃圾放进垃圾桶。
example2_en: Mum will pick me up after school.
example2_zh: 妈妈放学后来接我。
tip_zh: pick up 有多种意思：捡起、接人、学会（pick up a language）。

meanings_zh: v. 制作；制造 | v. 使；迫使 | n. 品牌；型号
definition_en: to create or produce something | to cause a state or force an action | the brand or type of a manufactured product
example1_en: We made a small table from leftover pieces of wood.
example1_zh: 我们用剩下的木料做了一张小桌子。
example2_en: Schools can make science more accessible by allowing students to conduct simple experiments with everyday materials.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生用日常材料做简单实验，使科学更容易理解。
collocations: make a decision｜作决定 ; make progress｜取得进步 ; make a difference｜产生影响 ; make someone happy｜使某人开心
tip_zh: 主动式make sb do；被动式be made to do。

meanings_zh: n. 盘；碟 | n. 一道菜；菜肴 | n. 餐具（复数）
definition_en: A container used for serving or cooking food. | Food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal. | Plates, bowls, and other utensils used for meals.
example1_en: Please put the strawberries in that blue dish.
example1_zh: 请把草莓放进那个蓝色盘子里。
example2_en: Traditional dishes can attract international tourists while helping local communities preserve their distinctive food culture.
example2_zh: 传统菜肴既能吸引国际游客，也能帮助当地社区保留独特的饮食文化。
collocations: serving dish｜上菜用的盘子 ; traditional dish｜传统菜肴 ; do the dishes｜洗餐具 ; main dish｜主菜
tip_zh: a dish可指一道菜；do the dishes指洗餐具。

meanings_zh: det. 每个；每一 | det. 每隔；每逢 | det. 一切可能的；充分的
definition_en: referring to all members of a group individually | used to show how regularly something happens | used to emphasize all possibilities or a strong degree
example1_en: Every child brought a favourite toy to the picnic.
example1_zh: 每个孩子都带了一件最喜欢的玩具去野餐。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that every student has access to reliable internet services for learning.
example2_zh: 政府应确保每个学生都能使用可靠的互联网服务进行学习。
collocations: every day｜每天 ; every other week｜每隔一周 ; every effort｜一切努力 ; every reason to believe｜充分的理由相信
tip_zh: every后通常接单数可数名词，谓语也用单数。

meanings_zh: adv. 相当；颇 | adv. 完全；十分
definition_en: To a fairly large degree, but not extremely. | Completely or to the greatest possible degree.
example1_en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
example1_zh: 这汤挺辣的，不过我喜欢。
example2_en: Although cycling is quite popular among students, inadequate infrastructure prevents many commuters from choosing this sustainable option.
example2_zh: 虽然骑行在学生中颇受欢迎，但基础设施不足使许多通勤者无法选择这种可持续的出行方式。
collocations: quite good｜相当不错 ; quite a few｜相当多 ; quite different｜完全不同 ; not quite｜不完全；还差一点
tip_zh: quite good常指相当好；quite impossible指完全不可能。

meanings_zh: adj. 难过的；心烦的 | v. 使难过；使心烦 | v. 打乱；扰乱
definition_en: Unhappy, worried, or disappointed about something. | To make someone feel unhappy or worried. | To disturb the usual arrangement or balance of something.
example1_en: Lena felt upset when she lost her favourite scarf.
example1_zh: 莉娜丢了最喜欢的围巾，心里很难过。
example2_en: Sudden changes to school routines can upset younger children, who often rely on predictable daily activities.
example2_zh: 学校作息突然改变可能让年幼的孩子不安，因为他们往往依赖可预期的日常活动。
collocations: feel upset｜感到难过 ; upset about something｜为某事心烦 ; upset the balance｜打破平衡 ; upset someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划
tip_zh: 动词过去式、过去分词仍是upset；名词重音在前。

meanings_zh: adj. 安静的；轻声的 | adj. 平静的；不繁忙的 | n. 安静；宁静
definition_en: making little or no noise | having little activity or excitement | a state with little or no noise
example1_en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
example1_zh: 孩子们睡着后，屋子里安静了下来。
example2_en: Quiet study spaces in public libraries are essential for students who cannot concentrate at home.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆内安静的学习空间对无法在家集中注意力的学生至关重要。
collocations: keep quiet｜保持安静 ; a quiet neighbourhood｜安静的街区 ; peace and quiet｜平静与安宁
tip_zh: quiet是“安静的”，quite是“相当”，注意拼写。

meanings_zh: v. 添加；增加 | v. 相加；做加法 | v. 补充说
definition_en: to put something with something else or increase an amount | to combine numbers to find their total | to say something more after an earlier statement
example1_en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
example1_zh: 如果汤太稠，就加一点牛奶。
example2_en: Adding more green spaces to urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and provide habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 为城市社区增加绿地可以改善居民的身心健康，并为野生动物提供栖息地。
collocations: add something to｜把某物加入…… ; add up｜加起来 ; add value｜增加价值 ; add that｜补充说
tip_zh: add A to B表示把A加入B；add to还可表示增添。

meanings_zh: n. 事实；真实情况
definition_en: Something known or proved to be true.
example1_en: We checked the facts before booking our train tickets.
example1_zh: 我们核实了相关情况后才订火车票。
example2_en: Students should learn to distinguish facts from opinions when evaluating information shared through digital media.
example2_zh: 学生在评估数字媒体传播的信息时，应学会区分事实和观点。
collocations: in fact｜事实上 ; the fact that｜……这一事实 ; establish the facts｜查明事实 ; facts and figures｜事实与数据
tip_zh: the fact that后接完整从句，说明事实内容。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；美好的 | adj. 友善的；体贴的
definition_en: pleasant or enjoyable | kind and friendly towards other people
example1_en: We had a nice picnic beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边愉快地野餐了一次。
example2_en: Although nice surroundings matter, affordable housing and reliable transport are more important to many urban residents.
example2_zh: 虽然宜人的环境很重要，但对许多城市居民而言，可负担的住房和可靠的交通更为重要。
collocations: nice weather｜好天气 ; a nice time｜愉快的时光 ; be nice to someone｜友善地对待某人
tip_zh: nice含义较宽，正式写作宜换成更具体的形容词。

meanings_zh: prep. 减去；扣除 | adj. 负的；零下的 | n. 缺点；不利因素
definition_en: with a particular amount taken away | below zero | a disadvantage or negative feature
example1_en: Ten minus three leaves enough apples for everyone.
example1_zh: 十个苹果减去三个，剩下的仍够每人分一个。
example2_en: A household's disposable income is its total income minus taxes and other compulsory payments.
example2_zh: 家庭可支配收入是总收入扣除税款及其他强制性支出后剩余的部分。
collocations: minus ten degrees｜零下十度 ; minus sign｜减号；负号 ; pluses and minuses｜优缺点
tip_zh: minus可表减去，也可置于温度前表示零下。

meanings_zh: adj. 找不到的；失踪的 | adj. 缺少的；缺失的
definition_en: lost or absent, with whereabouts unknown | not present where something should be
example1_en: We found the missing kitten asleep behind the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们发现那只找不到的小猫正在沙发后面睡觉。
example2_en: Missing data can undermine the reliability of research findings and lead policymakers to draw inaccurate conclusions.
example2_zh: 数据缺失会削弱研究结果的可靠性，并导致政策制定者得出不准确的结论。
collocations: go missing｜失踪；不见 ; a missing person｜失踪者 ; missing data｜缺失数据 ; a missing piece｜缺失的一块
tip_zh: missing作形容词表不见或缺失；be missing from表缺少。

meanings_zh: adj. 左侧的；左手边的
definition_en: Located on the left side.
example1_en: Keep your ticket in the left-hand pocket of your jacket.
example1_zh: 把票放在夹克左侧的口袋里。
example2_en: Separating cyclists from vehicles in the left-hand lane could make this busy road safer for everyone.
example2_zh: 将骑行者与左侧车道的车辆隔开，可以让这条繁忙道路对所有人都更安全。
collocations: the left-hand side｜左侧 ; the left-hand corner｜左边的角落 ; the left-hand lane｜左侧车道
tip_zh: left-hand指左侧；left-handed指惯用左手的。

meanings_zh: n. 口袋 | v. 把…放入口袋；私吞 | adj. 袖珍的
definition_en: A small bag sewn into clothing for carrying things. | To put something in your pocket, or take money dishonestly. | Small enough to fit easily inside a pocket.
example1_en: I found my missing key in my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 我在外套口袋里找到了丢失的钥匙。
example2_en: Pocket dictionaries remain useful for language learners when internet access is unavailable or unreliable.
example2_zh: 当无法上网或网络不稳定时，袖珍词典对语言学习者仍然很有用。
collocations: coat pocket｜外套口袋 ; pocket money｜零花钱 ; out of pocket｜自掏腰包的；亏钱的 ; pocket dictionary｜袖珍词典
tip_zh: pocket money指零花钱，英式英语中常用。

meanings_zh: n. 花；开花植物 | v. 开花
definition_en: The often colourful part of a plant that produces seeds. | To produce flowers.
example1_en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
example1_zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。
example2_en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
example2_zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。
collocations: a bunch of flowers｜一束花 ; cut flowers｜鲜切花 ; in flower｜开着花
tip_zh: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。

meanings_zh: adj. 多云的；阴天的 | adj. 浑浊的；不透明的
definition_en: having many clouds in the sky | not clear or transparent
example1_en: It was cloudy, so we left our sunglasses at home.
example1_zh: 当时天阴着，所以我们把太阳镜留在了家里。
example2_en: Solar panels can still generate electricity on cloudy days, although their output is usually lower.
example2_zh: 太阳能电池板在阴天仍能发电，不过发电量通常较低。
collocations: cloudy sky｜多云的天空 ; cloudy weather｜多云天气 ; cloudy water｜浑浊的水
tip_zh: 既可形容天空多云，也可形容液体浑浊。

meanings_zh: adj. 总的；完全的 | n. 总数；总额 | v. 总计达；合计
definition_en: including everything, or complete in degree | the amount obtained by adding everything together | to reach a particular amount or add amounts together
example1_en: The total cost includes breakfast and a bus ticket.
example1_zh: 总费用包含早餐和一张公交车票。
example2_en: Improving home insulation can reduce total energy consumption while making housing more comfortable throughout the year.
example2_zh: 改善住宅隔热性能可以减少能源总消耗，同时让住房全年都更加舒适。
collocations: total cost｜总费用 ; in total｜总共 ; a total of｜总计…… ; total energy consumption｜能源总消耗
tip_zh: in total表示“总共”；totally常表示“完全地”。

meanings_zh: adj. 重要的；重大的 | adj. 有影响力的；有地位的
definition_en: Having great value or a significant effect. | Having considerable power, influence, or status.
example1_en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
example1_zh: 把你的重要文件放在这个防水文件夹里。
example2_en: Access to reliable information plays an important role in helping citizens make informed decisions about their health.
example2_zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民作出明智的健康决策起着重要作用。
collocations: an important role｜重要作用 ; an important factor｜重要因素 ; important to someone｜对某人很重要 ; equally important｜同样重要
tip_zh: 用It is important to do；importance是名词形式。

meanings_zh: n. 画廊；美术馆 | n. 楼座；旁听席 | n. 图片集；图库
definition_en: A room or building where artworks are displayed or sold. | A raised seating area overlooking a hall or theatre. | A collection of images available to view, especially online.
example1_en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring the local gallery.
example1_zh: 一个下雨的下午，我们逛了当地的美术馆。
example2_en: Free entry to a public gallery can make visual art accessible to people from different economic backgrounds.
example2_zh: 公共美术馆免费开放，可以让不同经济背景的人都有机会接触视觉艺术。
collocations: art gallery｜美术馆；画廊 ; public gallery｜公共美术馆；旁听席 ; photo gallery｜图片集
tip_zh: gallery主要展示艺术品；museum涵盖的展品范围更广。

meanings_zh: n. 脂肪；食用油脂 | adj. 肥胖的；肥的
definition_en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking | having a large amount of body fat
example1_en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
example1_zh: 让汤凉下来，再撇去油脂。
example2_en: Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.
example2_zh: 虽然人体需要一定的脂肪，但摄入过多会增加某些健康问题的风险。
collocations: body fat｜体脂 ; saturated fat｜饱和脂肪 ; low in fat｜脂肪含量低
tip_zh: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；谈健康宜用overweight。

meanings_zh: v. 齐步行进；坚定地走 | n. 游行；行军 | n. 进行曲
definition_en: Walk with firm, regular steps, often in a group. | An organised walk by a group, often to protest. | Music with a strong regular rhythm suitable for marching.
example1_en: The band marched through the square in bright uniforms.
example1_zh: 乐队身穿鲜艳的制服，齐步走过广场。
example2_en: Residents organised a peaceful march to demand safer roads and better public transport in their neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 居民组织了一场和平游行，要求改善社区道路安全和公共交通。
collocations: march through the streets｜列队穿过街道 ; a protest march｜抗议游行 ; a peaceful march｜和平游行 ; a military march｜军队进行曲
tip_zh: 小写march指行进；大写March指三月。

meanings_zh: phr v. 健身；变得健康
definition_en: to become healthy and strong through exercise
example1_en: She runs every day to get fit.
example1_zh: 她每天跑步来健身。
example2_en: Joining a sports club can help you get fit.
example2_zh: 加入体育俱乐部可以帮助你保持健康。
tip_zh: get fit 表示“变得健康强壮”；keep fit 表示“保持健康”。

meanings_zh: n. 出售；销售 | n. 降价促销 | n. 销售额；销量
definition_en: the act of exchanging something for money | a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices | the amount sold or money earned from selling goods
example1_en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
example1_zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。
example2_en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
example2_zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。
collocations: for sale｜待售 ; on sale｜出售中；降价出售 ; sales figures｜销售数据 ; a clearance sale｜清仓促销
tip_zh: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

meanings_zh: n. 滑雪运动
definition_en: The activity of moving over snow on skis.
example1_en: We went skiing together during our winter holiday.
example1_zh: 寒假期间，我们一起去滑雪了。
example2_en: Skiing attracts winter tourists to mountain regions, creating seasonal jobs but increasing demand for water.
example2_zh: 滑雪吸引冬季游客前往山区，创造了季节性工作，但也增加了用水需求。
collocations: go skiing｜去滑雪 ; cross-country skiing｜越野滑雪 ; downhill skiing｜高山速降滑雪 ; skiing lessons｜滑雪课程
tip_zh: 滑雪用go skiing；滑水需说water skiing。

meanings_zh: n. 密码；口令
definition_en: A secret word or sequence used to gain access.
example1_en: I forgot my password and couldn't open my account.
example1_zh: 我忘了密码，无法登录账户。
example2_en: Using a different password for each account can reduce the risk of personal information being stolen.
example2_zh: 为每个账户设置不同的密码，可以降低个人信息被盗的风险。
collocations: a strong password｜安全性高的密码 ; reset a password｜重置密码 ; enter a password｜输入密码 ; password protection｜密码保护
tip_zh: password是密码；passcode也可指数字口令。

meanings_zh: exclam. 哇（惊叹）
definition_en: used to show surprise or admiration
example1_en: Wow! What a beautiful painting!
example1_zh: 哇！多漂亮的画啊！
example2_en: Wow, that's a great idea!
example2_zh: 哇，那是个好主意！
tip_zh: wow 是表示惊叹的语气词。

meanings_zh: n. 房屋；住宅 | v. 为……提供住所；容纳
definition_en: A building where a person or family lives. | To provide a place for people or things to stay.
example1_en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
example1_zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。
example2_en: Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.
example2_zh: 地方政府可以将闲置办公楼改造成公寓，为需要可负担住房的家庭提供住所。
collocations: buy a house｜买房 ; move house｜搬家 ; house prices｜房价 ; house families｜为家庭提供住所
tip_zh: 名词读/haʊs/，动词读/haʊz/；home更强调家的归属感。

meanings_zh: n. 直升机
definition_en: An aircraft with rotating blades that can rise straight upwards.
example1_en: A helicopter landed in the field behind our house.
example1_zh: 一架直升机降落在我们屋后的田野里。
example2_en: A rescue helicopter can reach isolated communities when floods make roads unsafe for emergency vehicles.
example2_zh: 当洪水使道路无法供救援车辆安全通行时，救援直升机可以抵达被困的偏远社区。
collocations: rescue helicopter｜救援直升机 ; helicopter pilot｜直升机驾驶员 ; by helicopter｜乘直升机
tip_zh: 乘直升机用by helicopter，中间不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 钢琴
definition_en: A large musical instrument played by pressing black and white keys.
example1_en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。
example2_en: Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
example2_zh: 学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。
collocations: play the piano｜弹钢琴 ; piano lessons｜钢琴课 ; grand piano｜三角钢琴
tip_zh: 表示弹钢琴通常说play the piano。

meanings_zh: n. 足球运动
definition_en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.
example1_en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。
example2_en: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
example2_zh: 社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。
collocations: play soccer｜踢足球 ; soccer team｜足球队 ; soccer field｜足球场 ; soccer match｜足球比赛
tip_zh: 英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。

meanings_zh: n. 靴子 | n. 汽车后备箱 | v. 启动电脑
definition_en: footwear that covers the foot and part of the leg | the enclosed storage space at the back of a car | to start a computer and load its operating system
example1_en: My boots kept my feet dry in the rain.
example1_zh: 我的靴子让双脚在雨中保持干爽。
example2_en: Protective boots are essential for construction workers because they reduce the risk of serious foot injuries.
example2_zh: 防护靴对建筑工人至关重要，因为它们能降低脚部严重受伤的风险。
collocations: a pair of boots｜一双靴子 ; walking boots｜徒步靴 ; car boot｜汽车后备箱 ; boot up a computer｜启动电脑
tip_zh: 汽车后备箱英式说boot，美式说trunk。

meanings_zh: n. 戒指；环状物 | v. 响铃；使响铃 | v. 打电话给
definition_en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger | to make a bell sound or cause one to sound | to contact someone by telephone
example1_en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
example1_zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。
example2_en: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
example2_zh: 乘客应将手机调至静音，因为设备反复响铃会打扰公共交通工具上的其他人。
collocations: a wedding ring｜结婚戒指 ; ring the doorbell｜按门铃 ; give someone a ring｜给某人打电话 ; a ring of trees｜一圈树
tip_zh: 响铃、打电话的过去式为rang，过去分词为rung。

meanings_zh: n. 集市；市场 | n. 市场需求；交易领域 | v. 推销；营销
definition_en: a place where people buy and sell goods | the demand for something or the business of trading particular goods | to promote and offer a product for sale
example1_en: We bought fresh peaches at the market this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我们在集市买了新鲜桃子。
example2_en: Companies increasingly market environmentally friendly products to consumers who want to reduce their impact on the planet.
example2_zh: 企业越来越多地向希望减轻自身环境影响的消费者推销环保产品。
collocations: local market｜当地集市 ; job market｜就业市场 ; market research｜市场调查 ; market share｜市场份额
tip_zh: a market for sth指对某物的市场需求。

meanings_zh: n. 供暖；暖气系统 | n. 加热
definition_en: The system or process that keeps a building warm. | The process of making something warmer.
example1_en: We turned the heating on when the evening grew chilly.
example1_zh: 傍晚天凉起来时，我们打开了暖气。
example2_en: Improving home insulation can reduce heating costs and lower the environmental impact of household energy consumption.
example2_zh: 改善住宅保温可以降低供暖费用，并减轻家庭能源消耗对环境的影响。
collocations: central heating｜中央供暖 ; underfloor heating｜地板供暖 ; heating bills｜供暖账单 ; heating system｜供暖系统
tip_zh: 指供暖时通常不可数：turn on the heating。

meanings_zh: n. 烟；烟雾 | v. 吸烟 | v. 冒烟
definition_en: a mixture of gases and particles produced when something burns | to breathe in smoke from burning tobacco | to produce smoke
example1_en: Dark smoke rose from the toast in the kitchen.
example1_zh: 厨房里的吐司冒出了黑烟。
example2_en: Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.
example2_zh: 森林火灾产生的烟雾会降低数百公里外城市的空气质量。
collocations: thick smoke｜浓烟 ; smoke alarm｜烟雾报警器 ; smoke cigarettes｜吸香烟 ; give off smoke｜冒烟
tip_zh: smoke作“烟雾”通常不可数；smoky意为烟雾弥漫的。

meanings_zh: phr v. 起床；起身
definition_en: to get out of bed, or to stand up
example1_en: I get up at seven every morning.
example1_zh: 我每天早上七点起床。
example2_en: He got up from his chair to greet us.
example2_zh: 他从椅子上站起来迎接我们。
tip_zh: get up 是“起床并起身”；wake up 只是“醒来”。

meanings_zh: n. 小山；丘陵
definition_en: A raised area of land, usually lower than a mountain.
example1_en: We climbed the hill and watched the sunset.
example1_zh: 我们爬上小山，看了日落。
example2_en: Building houses on steep hills can increase construction costs and expose residents to the risk of landslides.
example2_zh: 在陡峭的山坡上建房会增加建设成本，并使居民面临滑坡风险。
collocations: climb a hill｜爬山 ; rolling hills｜连绵起伏的丘陵 ; a steep hill｜陡峭的小山
tip_zh: hill通常比mountain低矮，但没有统一高度界限。

meanings_zh: n. 循环；周期 | v. 骑自行车 | n. 自行车
definition_en: a series of events or stages that repeats | to travel by bicycle | a vehicle with two wheels powered by pedalling
example1_en: I usually cycle to the park on sunny mornings.
example1_zh: 晴朗的早晨，我通常骑自行车去公园。
example2_en: Climate change can disrupt the natural water cycle, increasing the frequency of droughts and floods in some regions.
example2_zh: 气候变化会扰乱自然水循环，使一些地区的干旱和洪水更频繁。
collocations: life cycle｜生命周期 ; water cycle｜水循环 ; vicious cycle｜恶性循环 ; cycle to work｜骑自行车上班
tip_zh: cycle作动词表示骑车；骑车上班用cycle to work。

meanings_zh: adj. 迟到的；晚期的 | adv. 迟；晚 | adj. 已故的
definition_en: after the expected time or near the end of a period | after the expected time or towards a period's end | used before mentioning a person who has died
example1_en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
example1_zh: 我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。
example2_en: Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.
example2_zh: 经常熬夜的学生在上午的课堂上可能难以集中注意力并取得良好表现。
collocations: be late for｜迟到 ; stay up late｜熬夜 ; late at night｜深夜 ; in the late stages｜在后期
tip_zh: late作副词指迟、晚；lately指最近，不能混用。

meanings_zh: n. 首都；首府；省会 | n. 资本；资金 | n. 大写字母
definition_en: the city where a country or region's government is based | money or assets used to start or operate a business | a letter in its large form
example1_en: We visited the capital and explored its busy markets.
example1_zh: 我们游览了首都，逛了那里热闹的市场。
example2_en: Small businesses often struggle to obtain enough capital to invest in new equipment and staff training.
example2_zh: 小企业往往难以筹集足够资金，用于购置新设备和培训员工。
collocations: the capital city｜首都 ; raise capital｜筹集资金 ; a capital letter｜大写字母
tip_zh: 表示资金时通常不可数；表示大写字母时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 年龄；存在年限 | n. 时代 | v. 变老；使衰老
definition_en: The length of time someone or something has existed. | A period of history with particular features. | To become older or make someone or something seem older.
example1_en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
example1_zh: 我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。
example2_en: As populations age, governments need to invest more in accessible housing and community healthcare services.
example2_zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府需要加大对无障碍住房和社区医疗服务的投入。
collocations: at the age of｜在……岁时 ; the digital age｜数字时代 ; people of all ages｜各年龄段的人 ; age gracefully｜优雅地老去
tip_zh: 表示在几岁时用at the age of，不用in。

meanings_zh: n. 蛋糕 | v. 厚厚覆盖；结块
definition_en: A sweet food baked from flour, eggs, sugar, and fat. | To cover with a thick layer or form hard lumps.
example1_en: We shared a slice of lemon cake after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们分着吃了一片柠檬蛋糕。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by offering fresh fruit instead of cake at school celebrations.
example2_zh: 学校可以在校内庆祝活动中提供新鲜水果而非蛋糕，以鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: a slice of cake｜一片蛋糕 ; bake a cake｜烤蛋糕 ; a birthday cake｜生日蛋糕 ; be caked in mud｜沾满厚厚的泥
tip_zh: 整个蛋糕可数；泛指蛋糕这种食物时常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 客厅；起居室
definition_en: the room in a house where people relax together
example1_en: We watch TV in the living room every evening.
example1_zh: 我们每天晚上在客厅看电视。
example2_en: The living room has a big sofa and a coffee table.
example2_zh: 客厅里有一张大沙发和一张茶几。
tip_zh: living room 与 sitting room 同义，都是客厅/起居室。

meanings_zh: n. 声音；声响 | v. 听起来；发出声音 | adj. 合理的；可靠的；完好的
definition_en: something you hear | to seem a certain way when heard, or produce noise | sensible, reliable, or in good condition
example1_en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
example1_zh: 天还没亮，雨声就把我吵醒了。
example2_en: Environmental policies should be based on sound scientific evidence rather than assumptions about public behaviour.
example2_zh: 环境政策应以可靠的科学证据为基础，而非对公众行为的假设。
collocations: sound advice｜合理的建议 ; sound evidence｜可靠的证据 ; sound like｜听起来像 ; sound the alarm｜拉响警报
tip_zh: sound后接形容词；sound like后接名词。

meanings_zh: v. 借出；贷出 | v. 给予；增添
definition_en: Let someone use something temporarily, expecting its return. | Give support or add a particular quality to something.
example1_en: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?
example1_zh: 你能把雨伞借给我用到明天吗？
example2_en: Local banks could lend small businesses money to invest in cleaner production methods.
example2_zh: 地方银行可以向小企业贷款，帮助它们投资更清洁的生产方式。
collocations: lend someone something｜把某物借给某人 ; lend money to｜借钱给 ; lend support to｜支持 ; lend a hand｜帮忙
tip_zh: lend是借出，borrow是借入；过去式为lent。

meanings_zh: v. 跳水；潜水 | v. 俯冲；急剧下降 | n. 跳水；潜水；骤降
definition_en: to enter water headfirst or swim beneath its surface | to move downwards suddenly and quickly | an act of diving or a sudden sharp fall
example1_en: We watched a swimmer dive smoothly into the pool.
example1_zh: 我们看着一名游泳者流畅地跃入泳池。
example2_en: Tourists who dive near coral reefs should avoid touching marine organisms to prevent damage to fragile ecosystems.
example2_zh: 在珊瑚礁附近潜水的游客应避免触碰海洋生物，以免破坏脆弱的生态系统。
collocations: dive into the water｜跃入水中 ; scuba dive｜水肺潜水 ; take a dive｜骤降
tip_zh: 过去式英式常用dived，美式也用dove。

meanings_zh: adj. 死的；枯死的 | adj. 没电的；无法运作的 | adv. 完全地；正好
definition_en: No longer alive | No longer working, often because power has run out | Completely or exactly, used for emphasis
example1_en: We removed the dead flowers from the balcony pots.
example1_zh: 我们清除了阳台花盆里枯死的花。
example2_en: Leaving dead trees in forests can support biodiversity by providing habitats for insects and small animals.
example2_zh: 将枯树留在森林中能为昆虫和小动物提供栖息地，从而促进生物多样性。
collocations: dead leaves｜枯叶 ; a dead battery｜没电的电池 ; dead silence｜一片死寂 ; dead centre｜正中心
tip_zh: dead是状态，die是动作，death是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 鸭；鸭肉 | v. 低头躲闪；弯身避开 | v. 逃避；回避
definition_en: A waterbird with a broad bill, or its meat | Lower your head or body quickly to avoid something | Avoid a difficult question, responsibility, or situation
example1_en: A duck paddled past us with several tiny ducklings.
example1_zh: 一只鸭子带着几只小鸭从我们身旁游过。
example2_en: Urban parks with healthy ponds provide valuable habitats for ducks and other wildlife throughout the year.
example2_zh: 拥有健康池塘的城市公园全年都能为鸭子和其他野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: wild duck｜野鸭 ; roast duck｜烤鸭 ; duck your head｜迅速低头 ; duck a question｜回避问题
