collocations: bright colours｜鲜艳的颜色 ; colour scheme｜配色方案 ; colour in a picture｜给图画涂色 ; change colour｜变色
tip_zh: 英式拼写为colour，美式为color。

meanings_zh: n. 眼睛 | n. 眼光；鉴赏力 | v. 注视；打量
definition_en: one of the two body parts used for seeing | an ability to notice or judge particular qualities | to look at someone or something with particular interest
example1_en: She closed her eyes and listened to the rain.
example1_zh: 她闭上眼睛，听着雨声。
example2_en: Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.
example2_zh: 设计师需要善于观察细节，才能打造既美观又便于所有人使用的公共空间。
collocations: eye contact｜目光接触 ; keep an eye on｜留意；照看 ; an eye for detail｜对细节的敏锐观察力 ; catch someone's eye｜引起某人的注意
tip_zh: an eye for表示鉴赏力；keep an eye on表示照看。

meanings_zh: phr v. 写下；记下
definition_en: to write something on paper so you remember it
example1_en: Write down the new words in your notebook.
example1_zh: 把新单词记在笔记本上。
example2_en: I wrote down her phone number.
example2_zh: 我记下了她的电话号码。
tip_zh: write down 是“写下”；write it down 中代词放中间。

meanings_zh: n. 下午
definition_en: The time between midday and evening.
example1_en: We spent the afternoon baking bread in the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我们整个下午都在厨房里烤面包。
example2_en: Schools could offer afternoon sports sessions to help students develop healthier habits and stronger friendships.
example2_zh: 学校可以在下午安排体育活动，帮助学生养成更健康的习惯并增进友谊。
collocations: in the afternoon｜在下午 ; this afternoon｜今天下午 ; late afternoon｜下午较晚的时候
tip_zh: 泛指下午用in；具体某天下午用on。

meanings_zh: n. T恤衫
definition_en: A casual shirt, usually with short sleeves and no collar.
example1_en: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
example1_zh: 我为野餐带了一件干净的T恤衫。
example2_en: Choosing a durable cotton T-shirt instead of disposable fashion can reduce waste and encourage more responsible consumption.
example2_zh: 选择耐穿的棉质T恤衫而非一次性时尚服饰，可以减少浪费并促进更负责任的消费。
collocations: cotton T-shirt｜棉质T恤衫 ; plain T-shirt｜纯色T恤衫 ; wear a T-shirt｜穿T恤衫
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为 T-shirts，保留连字符。

meanings_zh: phr v. 起飞；脱下
definition_en: to leave the ground, or to remove clothes
example1_en: The plane took off at nine o'clock.
example1_zh: 飞机九点起飞。
example2_en: Please take off your shoes before entering.
example2_zh: 进入前请脱鞋。
tip_zh: take off 指飞机“起飞”或脱衣“脱下”；反义 put on。

meanings_zh: n. 雨林；热带雨林
definition_en: a dense forest in an area receiving very heavy rainfall
example1_en: We spotted colourful birds high in the rainforest canopy.
example1_zh: 我们在雨林高高的树冠层中发现了色彩鲜艳的鸟儿。
example2_en: Protecting tropical rainforest helps preserve biodiversity and prevents large amounts of stored carbon from entering the atmosphere.
example2_zh: 保护热带雨林有助于维护生物多样性，并防止大量储存的碳进入大气。
collocations: tropical rainforest｜热带雨林 ; rainforest canopy｜雨林树冠层 ; rainforest conservation｜雨林保护 ; rainforest destruction｜雨林破坏
tip_zh: 常写作rainforest；rain forest也正确。

meanings_zh: n. 汉堡包；汉堡肉饼
definition_en: A flat food patty, often served inside a round bread roll
example1_en: I ordered a bean burger with salad for lunch.
example1_zh: 我午餐点了一个豆类汉堡配沙拉。
example2_en: Restaurants can reduce their environmental impact by offering plant-based burgers alongside traditional meat dishes.
example2_zh: 餐馆可以在供应传统肉类菜肴的同时提供植物基汉堡，以减少对环境的影响。
collocations: beef burger｜牛肉汉堡 ; veggie burger｜素食汉堡 ; burger bun｜汉堡面包
tip_zh: burger也可指肉饼本身，并非都以牛肉制成。

meanings_zh: n. 结束；末尾；尽头 | v. 结束；终止 | n. 目的；目标
definition_en: the final part or furthest point of something | to stop, or cause something to stop | a purpose that someone wants to achieve
example1_en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
example1_zh: 我们这条街的尽头有一家小面包店。
example2_en: Governments should aim to end extreme poverty by improving access to education and secure employment.
example2_zh: 政府应通过改善教育机会和稳定就业的可及性，努力消除极端贫困。
collocations: at the end of｜在……末尾 ; come to an end｜结束 ; put an end to｜终止 ; a means to an end｜达到目的的手段
tip_zh: at the end指末尾；in the end指最终。

meanings_zh: adj. 美味的；可口的
definition_en: Having a very pleasant taste.
example1_en: This delicious vegetable pie is still warm from the oven.
example1_zh: 这份美味的蔬菜派刚出炉，还热乎着。
example2_en: School meals should be both nutritious and delicious to encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
example2_zh: 学校餐食应兼顾营养与美味，以鼓励儿童养成更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: delicious meal｜美味的一餐 ; delicious food｜美味的食物 ; absolutely delicious｜美味极了
tip_zh: delicious本身语气较强，常用absolutely加强。

meanings_zh: v. 装满；充满 | v. 填补；满足
definition_en: Make or become full | Occupy an empty position or meet a particular need
example1_en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
example1_zh: 请把水壶装满水，给客人们喝。
example2_en: Local training programmes can help fill vacancies in essential services such as healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 地方培训项目可以帮助填补医疗和教育等基本服务领域的职位空缺。
collocations: fill with water｜装满水 ; fill in a form｜填写表格 ; fill a gap｜填补空缺 ; fill a vacancy｜填补职位空缺
tip_zh: fill A with B表示用B装满A；be filled with表示充满。

meanings_zh: n. 工厂
definition_en: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured.
example1_en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
example1_zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。
example2_en: Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.
example2_zh: 政府应要求工厂主减少有害排放，同时不损害工人的安全和生计。
collocations: factory worker｜工厂工人 ; factory owner｜工厂主 ; factory production｜工厂生产
tip_zh: 复数为factories；指制造产品的场所。

meanings_zh: adj. 可获得的；可使用的 | adj. 有空的
definition_en: Ready or possible to get, buy, or use. | Not busy and able to meet or help someone.
example1_en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
example1_zh: 下午那场演出的门票还有余票。
example2_en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
example2_zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。
collocations: readily available｜容易获得的 ; available to everyone｜人人都可获得的 ; available for use｜可供使用的 ; make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip_zh: available to接使用者；available for接用途。

meanings_zh: v. 但愿；希望 | n. 愿望；心愿 | v. 祝愿
definition_en: To want something, especially something unlikely or not currently true. | A strong desire for something to happen or be true. | To express hope for someone's happiness or success.
example1_en: I wish our flat had a bigger kitchen.
example1_zh: 要是我们的公寓有个更大的厨房就好了。
example2_en: Many residents wish their neighbourhoods had more green spaces where children could play safely and families could relax.
example2_zh: 许多居民希望社区有更多绿地，让孩子能够安全玩耍，让家人能够放松休息。
collocations: make a wish｜许愿 ; wish someone luck｜祝某人好运 ; best wishes｜美好祝愿 ; wish to do something｜希望做某事
tip_zh: wish后用过去式表现在的遗憾；过去完成式表过去的遗憾。

meanings_zh: n. 家具
definition_en: Movable objects such as chairs, tables, and beds in buildings.
example1_en: We moved the furniture to make room for dancing.
example1_zh: 我们挪开家具，腾出地方跳舞。
example2_en: Buying second-hand furniture can lower household expenses while reducing demand for raw materials and limiting waste.
example2_zh: 购买二手家具既能降低家庭开支，也能减少原材料需求和废弃物。
collocations: a piece of furniture｜一件家具 ; wooden furniture｜木制家具 ; second-hand furniture｜二手家具 ; office furniture｜办公家具
tip_zh: 不可数：一件家具说a piece of furniture。

meanings_zh: v. 变得；成为
definition_en: to start to be something or develop a particular quality
example1_en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
example1_zh: 商店关门后，街道变得安静起来。
example2_en: Public transport must become more reliable and affordable if cities want residents to drive less frequently.
example2_zh: 如果城市希望居民减少开车，公共交通就必须变得更可靠、更实惠。
collocations: become aware of｜开始意识到 ; become increasingly important｜变得日益重要 ; become a teacher｜成为教师
tip_zh: 变化形式：become—became—become；后接名词或形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 岛；岛屿
definition_en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.
example1_en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。
example2_en: Small island communities often depend on tourism, but increasing visitor numbers can threaten fragile coastal environments.
example2_zh: 小岛上的社区往往依赖旅游业，但游客数量的增加可能威胁脆弱的海岸环境。
collocations: remote island｜偏远岛屿 ; tropical island｜热带岛屿 ; island nation｜岛国 ; uninhabited island｜无人岛
tip_zh: s不发音；在岛上用on an island。

meanings_zh: n. 奶油；乳脂 | n. 护肤霜；药膏 | adj. 奶油色的；淡黄色的
definition_en: The thick, fatty part of milk, used in food. | A thick substance applied to skin for protection or treatment. | Having a pale yellowish-white colour.
example1_en: She poured fresh cream over a bowl of strawberries.
example1_zh: 她把新鲜奶油浇在一碗草莓上。
example2_en: Replacing cream with lower-fat ingredients can reduce the energy content of meals without greatly affecting flavour.
example2_zh: 用低脂食材替代奶油，可以降低餐食的热量，而不会明显影响风味。
collocations: whipped cream｜打发奶油 ; face cream｜面霜 ; apply cream｜涂抹乳霜 ; cream walls｜奶油色墙面
tip_zh: cream是奶油或乳霜；cheese才是奶酪。

meanings_zh: n. 社交媒体
definition_en: websites and apps where people share things online
example1_en: She shares photos of her dog on social media.
example1_zh: 她在社交媒体上分享她的狗的照片。
example2_en: Social media helps us keep in touch with friends.
example2_zh: 社交媒体帮助我们和朋友保持联系。
tip_zh: social media 是社交媒体，如微博、微信朋友圈等平台。

meanings_zh: n. 运气
definition_en: the good or bad things that happen by chance
example1_en: Good luck with your exam tomorrow!
example1_zh: 祝你明天考试好运！
example2_en: She had no luck finding a parking space.
example2_zh: 她运气不好，没找到停车位。
collocations: good luck｜祝你好运 ; bad luck｜倒霉
tip_zh: good luck 是祝福语；lucky 是形容词“幸运的”。

meanings_zh: adv. 向上；在高处 | prep. 沿……向上；顺着 | adj. 醒着的；起床的
definition_en: Towards or in a higher position. | Towards a higher point or further along something. | Awake and out of bed.
example1_en: The child looked up at the bright red balloon.
example1_zh: 孩子抬头看着那个鲜红的气球。
example2_en: As housing costs go up, many young adults find it harder to live independently.
example2_zh: 随着住房成本上涨，许多年轻人发现独立生活变得更加困难。
collocations: look up｜抬头看 ; go up｜上升；上涨 ; up the stairs｜沿楼梯向上 ; be up early｜很早起床
tip_zh: up后接地点名词可作介词，如up the hill。

meanings_zh: n. 世界；地球 | n. 领域；界
definition_en: The earth and all the people and things on it. | A particular area of activity and the people involved.
example1_en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
example1_zh: 她梦想乘火车环游世界。
example2_en: Countries around the world need to cooperate more closely to address climate change and protect shared natural resources.
example2_zh: 世界各国需要更紧密地合作，以应对气候变化并保护共享的自然资源。
collocations: around the world｜世界各地 ; the natural world｜自然界 ; the business world｜商界 ; world population｜世界人口
tip_zh: 指整个世界通常用the world；商界为the business world。

meanings_zh: phr. 各种各样的
definition_en: many different types of something
example1_en: The market sells all kinds of fruit and vegetables.
example1_zh: 这个市场卖各种各样的水果和蔬菜。
example2_en: People use computers for all kinds of things.
example2_zh: 人们用电脑做各种各样的事情。
tip_zh: all kinds of 后面接可数名词复数或不可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 担心的；焦虑的
definition_en: feeling anxious about problems or something that might happen
example1_en: She looked worried when her cat failed to return.
example1_zh: 猫没有回来时，她显得很担心。
example2_en: Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.
example2_zh: 许多家长担心过长的屏幕使用时间会影响孩子的睡眠。
collocations: worried about｜担心…… ; deeply worried｜深感忧虑的 ; a worried expression｜担忧的表情
tip_zh: worried形容人担忧；worrying形容事物令人担忧。

meanings_zh: adj. 小心的；谨慎的 | adj. 仔细的；细致的
definition_en: taking care to avoid danger, damage, or mistakes | giving close attention to details
example1_en: Be careful with that bowl; it belonged to Grandma.
example1_zh: 小心拿那个碗，那是奶奶以前用的。
example2_en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
example2_zh: 周密的规划可以帮助城市扩展公共交通，同时控制建设成本。
collocations: be careful with｜小心对待 ; careful planning｜周密规划 ; careful consideration｜慎重考虑 ; careful analysis｜细致分析
tip_zh: be careful with后接物；be careful to后接动词。

meanings_zh: v. 喝；饮 | n. 饮料；一杯饮品 | v. 喝酒
definition_en: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it | a liquid for swallowing or a serving of it | to consume alcoholic beverages
example1_en: I always drink some water after walking the dog.
example1_zh: 我遛完狗总会喝些水。
example2_en: Encouraging children to drink water instead of sugary beverages may improve their dental health over time.
example2_zh: 鼓励儿童喝水而非含糖饮料，长远来看可能改善他们的牙齿健康。
collocations: drink water｜喝水 ; a hot drink｜热饮 ; drinking water｜饮用水 ; soft drink｜不含酒精的饮料
tip_zh: 不规则变化：drink—drank—drunk。

meanings_zh: adj. 不寻常的；与众不同的
definition_en: Different from what is common, normal, or expected.
example1_en: This carrot has an unusual shape, like a tiny hand.
example1_zh: 这根胡萝卜的形状很特别，像一只小手。
example2_en: Scientists are investigating unusual weather patterns that may be linked to rising global temperatures.
example2_zh: 科学家正在研究可能与全球气温上升有关的异常天气模式。
collocations: unusual circumstances｜特殊情况 ; an unusual feature｜不寻常的特征 ; highly unusual｜极不寻常的
tip_zh: It is unusual for sb to do表示某人很少这样做。

meanings_zh: n. 应用程序
definition_en: A computer program designed for a particular task.
example1_en: This app reminds me to water my plants every Sunday.
example1_zh: 这个应用程序每周日提醒我给植物浇水。
example2_en: A language learning app can provide affordable practice, although it cannot fully replace interaction with a teacher.
example2_zh: 语言学习应用可以提供价格低廉的练习机会，但无法完全取代与教师的互动。
collocations: download an app｜下载应用程序 ; mobile app｜移动应用 ; install an app｜安装应用程序 ; language learning app｜语言学习应用
tip_zh: app是application的缩写；为可数名词，用an app。

meanings_zh: det. 许多；大量 | pron. 很多；大量 | adv. 很；非常；更为
definition_en: A large amount of something, used with uncountable nouns. | A large amount, without naming what is being discussed. | To a great degree, especially with comparisons and certain verbs.
example1_en: We do not have much milk left for breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们剩下的早餐牛奶不多了。
example2_en: Investing in preventive healthcare can be much more economical than treating illnesses after they become severe.
example2_zh: 投资预防性医疗可能比在疾病变得严重后再治疗经济得多。
collocations: too much｜太多 ; much more｜多得多；更为 ; much better｜好得多 ; as much as｜与……一样多
tip_zh: 修饰不可数名词；可数名词复数用many。

meanings_zh: n. 游客信息中心
definition_en: an office where tourists get maps and advice
example1_en: We got a city map at the tourist information centre.
example1_zh: 我们在游客信息中心拿到了一张城市地图。
example2_en: The tourist information centre is open every day.
example2_zh: 游客信息中心每天开放。
tip_zh: 游客信息中心提供地图、路线建议等服务。

meanings_zh: n. 袋鼠
definition_en: An Australian mammal with powerful hind legs; females carry pouch young.
example1_en: A young kangaroo peeked out of its mother's pouch.
example1_zh: 一只小袋鼠从妈妈的育儿袋里探出头来。
example2_en: Habitat loss can force kangaroo populations closer to roads, increasing the risk of collisions with vehicles.
example2_zh: 栖息地丧失可能迫使袋鼠种群靠近道路，增加它们与车辆相撞的风险。
collocations: a kangaroo's pouch｜袋鼠的育儿袋 ; red kangaroo｜赤袋鼠 ; kangaroo population｜袋鼠种群
tip_zh: 复数直接加-s：kangaroos；育儿袋叫pouch。

meanings_zh: n. 旅行；行程 | n. 发展历程 | v. 旅行
definition_en: an occasion of travelling from one place to another | a process of personal change or development over time | to travel from one place to another
example1_en: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
example1_zh: 这趟火车旅程带我们穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。
example2_en: Improved rail services could shorten the daily journey to work and encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 改善铁路服务可以缩短每日通勤时间，并鼓励通勤者不开车出门。
collocations: a long journey｜漫长的旅程 ; a return journey｜返程 ; a journey of discovery｜探索之旅 ; make a journey｜进行一次旅行
tip_zh: journey侧重路途；trip常指包含往返的出行。

meanings_zh: v. 学习；学会 | v. 得知；获悉
definition_en: To gain knowledge or a skill through study or experience. | To find out information about something.
example1_en: My grandfather is learning to swim at the local pool.
example1_zh: 我爷爷正在附近的游泳池学游泳。
example2_en: Students often learn more effectively when they apply new knowledge to practical problems rather than memorise isolated facts.
example2_zh: 与死记零散知识相比，学生将新知识用于实际问题时，往往学得更有效。
collocations: learn to drive｜学开车 ; learn from mistakes｜从错误中学习 ; learn by heart｜背熟 ; learn about｜了解
tip_zh: learn to do表示学会做；过去式可用learnt或learned。

meanings_zh: n. 手提包；女式手袋
definition_en: A small bag for carrying personal items, typically used by women.
example1_en: She found her keys at the bottom of her handbag.
example1_zh: 她在手提包底部找到了钥匙。
example2_en: Consumers can reduce waste by choosing a durable handbag rather than replacing inexpensive accessories every season.
example2_zh: 消费者可以选择耐用的手提包，而不是每季更换廉价配饰，从而减少浪费。
collocations: a leather handbag｜皮革手提包 ; a shoulder handbag｜单肩手提包 ; carry a handbag｜提着手袋
tip_zh: 美式常用purse指女式手袋；英式purse通常指零钱包。

meanings_zh: n. 南；南方 | adj. 南部的；朝南的 | adv. 向南；在南方
definition_en: the direction opposite north | in, towards, or facing the south | towards or in the south
example1_en: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
example1_zh: 我们的阳台朝南，阳光很充足。
example2_en: Many families move to the south because its warmer climate allows more outdoor activities throughout the year.
example2_zh: 许多家庭搬到南方，因为那里气候更温暖，全年都能进行更多户外活动。
collocations: in the south｜在南方 ; head south｜向南走 ; south coast｜南部海岸
tip_zh: 南部用in the south；向南用go south，不加to。

meanings_zh: adj. 沉重的 | adj. 大量的；强烈的 | adj. 繁重的；难以承受的
definition_en: Weighing a lot and often difficult to lift | Greater than usual in amount, strength, or intensity | Demanding considerable effort or causing serious difficulty
example1_en: This suitcase is too heavy for me to lift.
example1_zh: 这个行李箱太重了，我提不起来。
example2_en: Heavy traffic contributes to urban air pollution and increases the time people spend commuting.
example2_zh: 繁忙的交通加剧了城市空气污染，也增加了人们的通勤时间。
collocations: heavy rain｜大雨 ; heavy traffic｜繁忙的交通 ; heavy workload｜繁重的工作量 ; heavy lifting｜搬运重物
tip_zh: 大雨用heavy rain，不用big rain。

meanings_zh: v. 能；可以；可能 | n. 金属罐；罐头 | v. 将食品装罐保存
definition_en: Used to express ability, permission, or possibility. | A metal container for food, drinks, or other substances. | To preserve food by sealing it in cans.
example1_en: I can carry both bags if you open the door.
example1_zh: 你要是把门打开，我就能把两个袋子都提进去。
example2_en: Access to reliable internet can help rural students benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
example2_zh: 稳定的互联网接入能帮助农村学生利用更丰富的教育资源。
collocations: can afford｜负担得起 ; can of soup｜一罐汤 ; canned food｜罐装食品
tip_zh: 作情态动词后接动词原形，第三人称不加s。

meanings_zh: v. 闲聊；网聊 | n. 闲聊；聊天
definition_en: To talk informally, in person or through electronic messages. | A friendly, informal conversation.
example1_en: We chatted about our weekend while waiting for the bus.
example1_zh: 等公交车时，我们聊起了各自的周末。
example2_en: Community gardens allow neighbours to chat regularly, helping them build stronger relationships and reduce social isolation.
example2_zh: 社区花园让邻居能够经常闲聊，有助于加深彼此的关系，减少社交孤立。
collocations: chat with friends｜和朋友聊天 ; chat about work｜聊工作 ; have a chat｜聊一聊 ; online chat｜在线聊天
tip_zh: chat with人、about话题；过去式chatted双写t。

meanings_zh: v. 疼痛；使受伤 | v. 伤感情；损害 | adj. 受伤的；伤心的
definition_en: To feel pain or cause physical injury. | To cause emotional pain or damage something. | Physically injured or emotionally upset.
example1_en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
example1_zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是疼。
example2_en: Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.
example2_zh: 削减公共交通经费可能损害依赖公交出行办理必要事务的农村社区的利益。
collocations: hurt your back｜伤到背部 ; hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情 ; get hurt｜受伤
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。

meanings_zh: n. 爷爷；外公（口语）
definition_en: informal word for grandfather
example1_en: Grandpa tells funny stories about his childhood.
example1_zh: 爷爷讲他童年时的趣事。
example2_en: My grandpa grows vegetables in the garden.
example2_zh: 我爷爷在花园里种蔬菜。
tip_zh: grandpa 是 grandfather 的口语说法。

meanings_zh: int. 嘿；喂；嗨
definition_en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.
example1_en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
example1_zh: 喂，你把伞落在门边了！
example2_en: Informal greetings such as hey may be inappropriate when students first contact university staff by email.
example2_zh: 学生初次通过电子邮件联系大学教职员工时，使用hey这类非正式问候语可能不太合适。
collocations: hey there｜嗨，你好 ; hey everyone｜嗨，大家好
tip_zh: 适合熟人间打招呼；正式邮件避免使用。

meanings_zh: n. 四分之一 | n. 季度 | n. 城区；街区
definition_en: One of four equal parts of something. | A period of three months within a year. | An area of a town with a particular character.
example1_en: She cut the sandwich into quarters for the children.
example1_zh: 她把三明治切成四等份给孩子们吃。
example2_en: Almost a quarter of the city's residents depend on public transport for their daily commute.
example2_zh: 这座城市近四分之一的居民依靠公共交通日常通勤。
collocations: a quarter of｜……的四分之一 ; a quarter of an hour｜一刻钟 ; the first quarter｜第一季度 ; the historic quarter｜历史街区
tip_zh: a quarter of an hour是一刻钟；季度也是quarter。

meanings_zh: n. 可乐
definition_en: A sweet, dark, fizzy drink, usually containing caffeine.
example1_en: He poured cold cola into a glass with ice.
example1_zh: 他把冰可乐倒进一个放了冰块的玻璃杯。
example2_en: Reducing the consumption of sugary drinks such as cola may help prevent tooth decay in children.
example2_zh: 减少可乐等含糖饮料的摄入，可能有助于预防儿童龋齿。
collocations: a can of cola｜一罐可乐 ; diet cola｜低热量可乐 ; sugar-free cola｜无糖可乐
tip_zh: 泛指饮料时不可数；a cola可指一杯或一份可乐。

meanings_zh: n. 淋浴；淋浴器 | n. 阵雨 | v. 淋浴
definition_en: Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this | A short period of rain | Wash your body under water falling from a shower
example1_en: I always take a warm shower after cycling home.
example1_zh: 我骑车回家后总会洗个温水澡。
example2_en: Taking shorter showers is a simple way for households to reduce both water consumption and energy use.
example2_zh: 缩短淋浴时间是家庭减少用水和能源消耗的一种简单方法。
collocations: take a shower｜洗淋浴 ; have a shower｜洗淋浴 ; heavy showers｜强阵雨 ; a shower head｜淋浴喷头
tip_zh: 洗淋浴可用take或have a shower；阵雨也叫shower。

meanings_zh: n. 建议；忠告
definition_en: suggestions about what someone should do in a particular situation
example1_en: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
example1_zh: 你的建议帮我选到了一辆骑着舒服的自行车。
example2_en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
example2_zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。
collocations: give advice｜提供建议 ; seek advice｜寻求建议 ; follow advice｜听从建议 ; a piece of advice｜一条建议
tip_zh: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

meanings_zh: n. 陆龟
definition_en: A land reptile with a hard shell and short legs.
example1_en: The tortoise slowly stretched its neck towards a lettuce leaf.
example1_zh: 陆龟慢慢伸长脖子，探向一片生菜叶。
example2_en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for tortoise populations threatened by illegal trade and agricultural expansion.
example2_zh: 保护自然栖息地对受到非法贸易和农业扩张威胁的陆龟种群至关重要。
collocations: giant tortoise｜巨型陆龟 ; tortoise shell｜陆龟的壳 ; pet tortoise｜宠物陆龟
tip_zh: 通常指陆龟；英式英语中turtle多指海龟。

meanings_zh: pron. 我的（所有物）
definition_en: something that belongs to me
example1_en: This bicycle is mine, not yours.
example1_zh: 这辆自行车是我的，不是你的。
example2_en: My phone is black and hers is white. Wait, mine is blue.
example2_zh: 我的手机是黑色的，她的是白色的。等等，我的是蓝色的。
tip_zh: mine 是名词性物主代词，后面不接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 树；树木
definition_en: A tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches.
example1_en: A small bird built its nest in our tree.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟在我们家的树上筑了巢。
example2_en: Planting trees in urban areas provides shade, improves air quality, and creates valuable habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 在城市地区植树能提供树荫、改善空气质量，并为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: plant a tree｜种树 ; climb a tree｜爬树 ; tree trunk｜树干 ; family tree｜家谱
tip_zh: tree是树；wood可指木材，woods通常指树林。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；优秀的
definition_en: Extremely good or of very high quality.
example1_en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
example1_zh: 这汤好喝极了，所以我又点了一碗。
example2_en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
example2_zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。
collocations: excellent service｜优质服务 ; excellent results｜优异成绩 ; excellent opportunity｜绝佳机会
tip_zh: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

meanings_zh: v. 建造；建立 | n. 体形；体格
definition_en: to make structures or develop something over time | the size and shape of a person's body
example1_en: We built a small wooden shelter in the garden.
example1_zh: 我们在花园里搭了一个小木棚。
example2_en: Local authorities should build more affordable homes near public transport to support families on low incomes.
example2_zh: 地方政府应在公共交通设施附近建造更多经济适用住房，以帮助低收入家庭。
collocations: build a house｜建造房屋 ; build confidence｜建立信心 ; build relationships｜建立关系 ; a slim build｜苗条的体形
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为built；体格可用build。

meanings_zh: v. 沸腾；使煮沸 | v. 用沸水煮 | n. 疖子
definition_en: to reach, or heat liquid until it reaches, bubbling temperature | to cook food in water that is bubbling from heat | a painful swollen lump in the skin containing pus
example1_en: Boil the potatoes until you can pierce them easily.
example1_zh: 把土豆煮到能轻松戳穿为止。
example2_en: Residents should boil drinking water when flooding has damaged local supplies and increased the risk of infection.
example2_zh: 当洪水破坏当地供水并增加感染风险时，居民应将饮用水煮沸。
collocations: boil water｜烧开水 ; boil an egg｜煮鸡蛋 ; bring to the boil｜使煮沸 ; boil down to｜归结为
tip_zh: boil指沸腾或煮沸；simmer指小火慢煮。

meanings_zh: adj. 苗条的；纤细的 | adj. 微小的；渺茫的 | v. 减肥；使缩减
definition_en: having a thin, often attractive shape | very small in amount or likelihood | to lose weight or reduce something in size
example1_en: This slim lamp fits neatly on my small desk.
example1_zh: 这盏细长的灯放在我的小书桌上正合适。
example2_en: Without reliable public transport, there is only a slim chance that commuters will stop driving.
example2_zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，通勤者放弃开车的可能性就很小。
collocations: a slim figure｜苗条的身材 ; a slim chance｜渺茫的机会 ; a slim majority｜微弱多数 ; slim down｜减重；精简
tip_zh: 形容身材多含褒义；slim chance指机会渺茫。

meanings_zh: n. 酱；调味汁
definition_en: A liquid or thick mixture added to food for flavour.
example1_en: This tomato sauce tastes lovely with fresh pasta.
example1_zh: 这种番茄酱汁配新鲜意面很好吃。
example2_en: Preparing sauce at home allows families to control the amount of salt and sugar in their meals.
example2_zh: 在家制作酱汁，能让家庭控制饭菜中的盐和糖含量。
collocations: tomato sauce｜番茄酱汁 ; soy sauce｜酱油 ; pasta sauce｜意面酱 ; a rich sauce｜浓郁的酱汁
tip_zh: sauce泛指酱汁；酱油应说soy sauce。

meanings_zh: n. 制服；校服 | adj. 一致的；均匀的
definition_en: Special clothing worn by members of a particular group. | Remaining the same in form, quality, or amount.
example1_en: My school uniform is still drying by the window.
example1_zh: 我的校服还在窗边晾着。
example2_en: Uniform safety standards across all factories can help protect workers and improve overall working conditions.
example2_zh: 所有工厂实行统一的安全标准，有助于保护工人并改善整体工作条件。
collocations: school uniform｜校服 ; wear a uniform｜穿制服 ; uniform standards｜统一标准 ; uniform distribution｜均匀分布
tip_zh: 开头是辅音/j/，所以说a uniform，不用an。

meanings_zh: v. 下载 | n. 下载；下载的文件
definition_en: to copy data from the internet onto your device | the act of downloading, or a file obtained this way
example1_en: Download the map before you leave the hotel tomorrow.
example1_zh: 明天离开酒店前，先把地图下载好。
example2_en: Students can download course materials at home, allowing them to study even when internet access is unavailable.
example2_zh: 学生可以在家下载课程资料，这样即使无法联网也能学习。
collocations: download a file｜下载文件 ; download an app｜下载应用 ; free download｜免费下载 ; download speed｜下载速度
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；反义词是upload。

meanings_zh: n. 成年男子；男人 | n. 人类 | v. 为…配备人员；值守
definition_en: An adult male human | Human beings considered collectively | To provide people to operate or guard something
example1_en: A man in a blue coat held the door open.
example1_zh: 一位穿蓝色外套的男子扶着门，让别人通过。
example2_en: Additional volunteers are needed to man information desks during the city's annual cultural festival.
example2_zh: 该市举办一年一度的文化节期间，需要更多志愿者在咨询台值守。
collocations: young man｜年轻男子 ; man a desk｜在服务台值守 ; man a checkpoint｜在检查站执勤
tip_zh: 复数为men；泛指人类时现代写作更常用humankind。

meanings_zh: adj. 害怕的；受惊的
definition_en: Feeling afraid because of danger or something unexpected.
example1_en: The frightened kitten hid behind the sofa during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨中，受惊的小猫躲到了沙发后面。
example2_en: Children who feel frightened in unfamiliar environments may benefit from patient support and predictable routines.
example2_zh: 在陌生环境中感到害怕的儿童，可能会从耐心的支持和规律的日常安排中受益。
collocations: frightened of｜害怕…… ; frightened to death｜吓得要命 ; a frightened child｜受惊的孩子
tip_zh: frightened形容感到害怕；frightening形容令人害怕。

meanings_zh: pron. 它自己
definition_en: used when an animal or thing does something to itself
example1_en: The cat cleaned itself in the sun.
example1_zh: 猫在阳光下给自己梳理毛发。
example2_en: The door closes by itself.
example2_zh: 门自己会关上。
collocations: by itself｜自动地；独自
tip_zh: by itself 表示“自动地/独自地”，如门自动关上。

meanings_zh: n. 姓；姓氏
definition_en: the name shared by members of a family
example1_en: My surname is often difficult for strangers to pronounce.
example1_zh: 陌生人常常觉得我的姓很难念。
example2_en: Naming traditions vary across cultures, and a person's surname may reflect family history or regional origins.
example2_zh: 不同文化的命名传统各不相同，一个人的姓氏可能反映其家族历史或地域来源。
collocations: family surname｜家族姓氏 ; common surname｜常见姓氏 ; change your surname｜更改姓氏
tip_zh: surname指姓，given name指名；姓不一定在最后。

meanings_zh: adj. 早期的；较早的 | adv. 提前；在早期
definition_en: Near the beginning of a period or before the usual time | Before the expected time or near the beginning
example1_en: We caught an early train and arrived before breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们赶上了一班早车，在早餐前就到了。
example2_en: Early investment in childhood education can reduce inequality and improve employment prospects later in life.
example2_zh: 及早投资幼儿教育可以减少不平等，并改善孩子成年后的就业前景。
collocations: early childhood｜幼儿期 ; early stages｜早期阶段 ; arrive early｜提前到达 ; early detection｜早期发现
tip_zh: early兼作形容词和副词，不加-ly。

meanings_zh: det. 这些 | pron. 这些人；这些事物
definition_en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things. | Nearby people or things, or ones just mentioned.
example1_en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
example1_zh: 这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。
example2_en: These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
example2_zh: 这些研究结果表明，经常参加户外活动可以改善儿童的注意力和情绪健康。
collocations: these days｜如今 ; these things｜这些事物 ; in these circumstances｜在这些情况下
tip_zh: these是this的复数，后接复数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 记忆力；记忆 | n. 回忆 | n. 计算机内存
definition_en: the ability to store and recall information or experiences | something from the past that you remember | the part of a computer that stores information
example1_en: My grandmother has an excellent memory for faces.
example1_zh: 我奶奶特别善于记住别人的长相。
example2_en: Regular physical exercise may improve memory and help older adults maintain their independence for longer.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼可能改善记忆力，帮助老年人更长久地保持独立生活的能力。
collocations: short-term memory｜短期记忆 ; childhood memories｜童年回忆 ; from memory｜凭记忆 ; computer memory｜计算机内存
tip_zh: 记忆力通常不可数；一段段回忆用memories。

meanings_zh: n. 枕头
definition_en: A soft support for your head when resting or sleeping.
example1_en: She placed a fresh pillow on the guest bed.
example1_zh: 她在客床上放了一个干净的枕头。
example2_en: Choosing a supportive pillow may improve sleep quality by helping maintain a comfortable neck position.
example2_zh: 选择支撑性好的枕头，有助于保持舒适的颈部姿势，从而可能改善睡眠质量。
collocations: soft pillow｜柔软的枕头 ; feather pillow｜羽毛枕 ; pillow cover｜枕套
tip_zh: pillow主要用于睡觉；cushion多指靠垫或坐垫。

meanings_zh: n. 计算机程序 | v. 编写程序；设定运行 | n. 计划；课程；节目
definition_en: A set of instructions that tells a computer what to do. | Write computer instructions or set a machine to operate automatically. | An organised plan, course of activities, or broadcast show.
example1_en: This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
example1_zh: 这个程序帮我整理所有度假照片。
example2_en: Schools should teach students how to program computers rather than simply how to use existing software.
example2_zh: 学校应教学生如何给计算机编程，而不只是如何使用现有软件。
collocations: computer program｜计算机程序 ; run a program｜运行程序 ; program a computer｜给计算机编程 ; training program｜培训计划
tip_zh: 英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。

meanings_zh: n. 迹象；征兆 | n. 标牌；符号；手势 | v. 签名；签署
definition_en: Something indicating that a condition exists or may develop | An object, mark, or gesture that communicates information | Write your name to identify yourself or show agreement
example1_en: Those dark clouds are a sign of approaching rain.
example1_zh: 那些乌云预示着雨就要来了。
example2_en: A decline in local wildlife may be a sign of wider environmental damage caused by urban expansion.
example2_zh: 当地野生动物数量下降可能意味着城市扩张造成了更广泛的环境破坏。
collocations: a sign of improvement｜好转的迹象 ; warning signs｜警示信号 ; a road sign｜道路标牌 ; sign a contract｜签署合同
tip_zh: sign中的g不发音；a sign of后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: prep. 每；每一
definition_en: For each unit of something.
example1_en: The swimming pool costs five pounds per visit.
example1_zh: 这个游泳池每次收费五英镑。
example2_en: Reducing energy consumption per household is an important step towards lowering a country's carbon emissions.
example2_zh: 减少每户家庭的能源消耗是降低一个国家碳排放的重要一步。
collocations: per person｜每人 ; per hour｜每小时 ; per capita｜人均 ; per year｜每年
tip_zh: per后通常接单数名词，不加冠词，如per day。

meanings_zh: n. 化学 | n. 化学组成与变化 | n. 默契；相互吸引
definition_en: the science of substances and how they react | the chemical properties and processes of a substance | a natural connection or attraction between people
example1_en: We mixed two clear liquids in chemistry class today.
example1_zh: 今天化学课上，我们把两种透明液体混合在一起。
example2_en: Understanding the chemistry of seawater helps scientists explain how rising carbon emissions affect marine life.
example2_zh: 了解海水的化学特性有助于科学家解释碳排放增加如何影响海洋生物。
collocations: organic chemistry｜有机化学 ; study chemistry｜学习化学 ; soil chemistry｜土壤化学
tip_zh: 学科名通常不可数：study chemistry，不加a。

meanings_zh: adj. 最喜欢的 | n. 最喜爱的人或物 | n. 最有望获胜者
definition_en: liked more than any other of the same kind | a person or thing someone likes best | the competitor considered most likely to win
example1_en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
example1_zh: 这家小面包店卖我最喜欢的那种面包。
example2_en: Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆让读者无需额外花费，既能发现新作家，也能重读自己最喜爱的书。
collocations: favourite subject｜最喜欢的科目 ; a firm favourite｜一直备受喜爱的人或物 ; the favourite to win｜夺冠热门
tip_zh: 英式拼写favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修饰。

meanings_zh: adv. 尤其；特别
definition_en: more than usual, or more than other people or things
example1_en: I enjoy cooking, especially when friends come for dinner.
example1_zh: 我喜欢做饭，尤其是在朋友来吃晚饭的时候。
example2_en: Reliable public transport is especially important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
example2_zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通尤其重要。
collocations: especially important｜尤其重要 ; especially useful｜特别有用 ; especially for｜尤其是对
tip_zh: especially强调“尤其”；specially常指“专门地”。

meanings_zh: n. 成年人；成年动物 | adj. 成年的；成年人的
definition_en: A person or animal that has finished growing. | Fully grown, or relating to grown people.
example1_en: Children must visit the swimming pool with an adult.
example1_zh: 儿童必须由成年人陪同前往游泳池。
example2_en: Adult education programmes help people gain new qualifications and adapt to changes in the labour market.
example2_zh: 成人教育项目帮助人们获得新的资格，并适应劳动力市场的变化。
collocations: young adult｜年轻成年人 ; adult education｜成人教育 ; adult life｜成年生活 ; responsible adult｜负责任的成年人
tip_zh: 既可作可数名词，也可作形容词，如adult education。

meanings_zh: n. 乡村；农村地区
definition_en: land outside towns and cities, including fields, woods, and farms
example1_en: We spent the weekend cycling through the quiet countryside.
example1_zh: 我们周末在宁静的乡间骑车游玩。
example2_en: Reliable public transport in the countryside can improve access to employment and reduce rural residents' dependence on cars.
example2_zh: 乡村地区可靠的公共交通可以改善就业机会的可及性，并减少农村居民对汽车的依赖。
collocations: in the countryside｜在乡下 ; surrounding countryside｜周边乡村 ; unspoilt countryside｜未受破坏的乡村 ; protect the countryside｜保护乡村环境
tip_zh: 通常不可数，常说the countryside，不说a countryside。

meanings_zh: n. 健康；身体状况 | n. 良好状况；兴旺
definition_en: The condition of someone's body and mind. | How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.
example1_en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
example1_zh: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。
example2_en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过提供安全饮用水和可负担的医疗服务来改善公众健康。
collocations: mental health｜心理健康 ; public health｜公共卫生 ; in good health｜身体健康 ; economic health｜经济运行状况
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

meanings_zh: n. 时钟 | v. 测定速度；记录用时
definition_en: a device that shows the time | to measure or record the time or speed of something
example1_en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
example1_zh: 我们做午饭时，厨房的时钟停了。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.
example2_zh: 弹性工作安排让员工在效率最高时工作，而不是盯着时钟等下班。
collocations: alarm clock｜闹钟 ; around the clock｜日夜不停地 ; clock in｜打卡上班 ; watch the clock｜盯着时间等下班
tip_zh: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

meanings_zh: adv. 在楼下；往楼下 | adj. 楼下的
definition_en: On or towards a lower floor of a building | Located on a lower floor of a building
example1_en: I went downstairs when I smelled fresh bread.
example1_zh: 闻到新鲜面包的香味后，我下了楼。
example2_en: Providing a downstairs bedroom can help older residents remain independent in their own homes.
example2_zh: 在楼下设置卧室可以帮助老年住户在自己家中保持独立生活。
collocations: go downstairs｜下楼 ; downstairs bathroom｜楼下的浴室 ; downstairs neighbour｜楼下的邻居
tip_zh: 作副词时直接说go downstairs，不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 信息；资料
definition_en: Facts or details about someone or something
example1_en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
example1_zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。
example2_en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
example2_zh: 获取可靠信息能帮助患者就治疗和长期健康作出更好的决定。
collocations: reliable information｜可靠信息 ; access to information｜信息获取渠道 ; provide information｜提供信息 ; a piece of information｜一条信息
tip_zh: 不可数：说some information，不说an information。

meanings_zh: phr v. 带回；归还
definition_en: to take something back to where it was
example1_en: Please bring back my book tomorrow.
example1_zh: 请明天把我的书带回来。
example2_en: She brought back some gifts from her trip.
example2_zh: 她旅行带回来一些礼物。
tip_zh: bring back 和 take back 都表示“带回”，bring 强调带回来，take 强调带走。

meanings_zh: n. 黑板
definition_en: A dark classroom board used for writing or drawing with chalk.
example1_en: Our teacher drew a huge circle on the blackboard.
example1_zh: 老师在黑板上画了一个大圆圈。
example2_en: Although digital screens offer interactive features, a traditional blackboard remains an affordable teaching tool for many schools.
example2_zh: 尽管电子屏幕具有互动功能，传统黑板仍是许多学校负担得起的教学工具。
collocations: write on the blackboard｜在黑板上书写 ; clean the blackboard｜擦黑板 ; blackboard eraser｜黑板擦
tip_zh: 在黑板上用on the blackboard；配合粉笔使用。

meanings_zh: n. 便士（英镑分币）
definition_en: small British money; 100 pence in a pound
example1_en: The sweets cost fifty pence.
example1_zh: 这些糖果五十便士。
example2_en: I have one pound and twenty pence.
example2_zh: 我有一英镑二十便士。
tip_zh: pence 是 penny 的复数（金额时用），如 20 pence。

meanings_zh: n. 加油站
definition_en: a place where you buy petrol for cars
example1_en: We stopped at a petrol station to fill the car.
example1_zh: 我们在加油站停车加油。
example2_en: The petrol station is open all night.
example2_zh: 这家加油站通宵营业。
tip_zh: petrol station 是英式说法；美式说 gas station。

meanings_zh: n. 聚会；派对 | n. 政党 | n. 一方；当事人
definition_en: A social gathering where people celebrate or enjoy themselves. | An organised group seeking political power through shared policies. | A person or group involved in an agreement or dispute.
example1_en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在花园里办了一场小聚会。
example2_en: Each political party should explain how its education policies will benefit students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
example2_zh: 每个政党都应说明其教育政策将如何惠及弱势背景的学生。
collocations: a birthday party｜生日聚会 ; a political party｜政党 ; a third party｜第三方 ; throw a party｜举办派对
tip_zh: 合同中的party指当事方，不是聚会或政党。

meanings_zh: n. 一餐；一顿饭
definition_en: An occasion when you eat, or the food eaten then.
example1_en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
example1_zh: 我们长途步行回来后，爸爸做了一顿热乎乎的饭。
example2_en: Providing healthy school meals can improve children's concentration and support their physical development.
example2_zh: 提供健康的学校餐食能提高儿童的专注力，并促进他们的身体发育。
collocations: balanced meal｜营养均衡的一餐 ; prepare a meal｜准备饭菜 ; skip a meal｜不吃一顿饭 ; main meal｜正餐
tip_zh: meal指一顿饭；food泛指食物，通常不可数。

meanings_zh: phr v. 看；注视
definition_en: to direct your eyes towards something
example1_en: Look at the picture and answer the questions.
example1_zh: 看这幅图并回答问题。
example2_en: He looked at the clock and hurried out.
example2_zh: 他看了看钟，匆匆出去了。
tip_zh: look at 是“看着某物”；watch 是“注视动态画面”，如看电视。

meanings_zh: n. 椅子 | n. 会议主席；负责人 | v. 主持会议
definition_en: a seat for one person, usually with a back | the person responsible for leading a meeting or committee | to lead a meeting and manage its discussion
example1_en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
example1_zh: 她把一把椅子拉到离窗户更近的地方。
example2_en: An independent expert should chair the meeting to ensure that all participants can contribute fairly.
example2_zh: 应由一位独立专家主持会议，确保所有参与者都能公平地发表意见。
collocations: office chair｜办公椅 ; committee chair｜委员会主席 ; chair a meeting｜主持会议
tip_zh: chair作动词直接接meeting，表示主持会议。

meanings_zh: adv. 从不；从未 | adv. 决不
definition_en: Not at any time. | Certainly not, used to express strong refusal or intention.
example1_en: I never leave home without my water bottle.
example1_zh: 我出门从来都带着水瓶。
example2_en: Public transport can never fully replace walking and cycling as accessible forms of daily exercise.
example2_zh: 作为方便易行的日常运动方式，步行和骑行永远无法被公共交通完全取代。
collocations: never again｜再也不 ; almost never｜几乎从不 ; never before｜以前从未
tip_zh: 通常放在实义动词前，be动词或助动词后。

meanings_zh: n. 午餐时间
definition_en: The time around the middle of the day when people eat.
example1_en: At lunchtime, we sat outside and shared some sandwiches.
example1_zh: 午餐时，我们坐在外面分着吃了一些三明治。
example2_en: Providing quiet spaces at lunchtime may help employees relax and return to work with greater focus.
example2_zh: 在午餐时间提供安静的空间，可能有助于员工放松，并在重返工作时更加专注。
collocations: at lunchtime｜在午餐时间 ; a lunchtime walk｜午餐时段的散步 ; a lunchtime break｜午间休息
tip_zh: 表示“在午餐时间”通常用at lunchtime。

meanings_zh: n. 中间；中部 | adj. 中间的；居中的
definition_en: The central part, point, or position of something | Located between other things or between the beginning and end
example1_en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
example1_zh: 有人把一个行李箱放在了走廊正中央。
example2_en: Housing costs often force essential workers to live far from the middle of the cities they serve.
example2_zh: 住房成本常常迫使提供必要服务的工作者住在远离其服务城市中心的地方。
collocations: in the middle of｜在……中间 ; middle age｜中年 ; middle class｜中产阶级 ; middle ground｜折中立场
tip_zh: 名词常用the middle of；形容词直接修饰名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 凉的；凉爽的 | adj. 冷静的；沉着的 | v. 变凉；使冷却
definition_en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way | calm and able to think clearly under pressure | to become or make something less hot
example1_en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
example1_zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹了进来。
example2_en: Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.
example2_zh: 种植更多树木有助于为城市地区降温，并减少夏季的能源需求。
collocations: cool breeze｜凉爽的微风 ; keep cool｜保持冷静 ; cool down｜冷却；平静下来
tip_zh: cool 比 cold 温和；口语中还可表示“很酷的”。

meanings_zh: n. 九月
definition_en: The month after August and before October.
example1_en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
example1_zh: 我们今年的摄影夜课九月开课。
example2_en: In many countries, the academic year begins in September, creating seasonal demand for student accommodation near universities.
example2_zh: 许多国家的学年在九月开始，使大学附近的学生住宿出现季节性需求。
collocations: in September｜在九月 ; early September｜九月初 ; late September｜九月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；用 in September，但 next September 前不加 in。

meanings_zh: n. 获胜者；优胜者 | n. 成功的人或事物；受益者
definition_en: a person or team that wins a competition | someone or something successful or benefiting from a situation
example1_en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
example1_zh: 获胜者举起奖杯，人群欢呼起来。
example2_en: Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
example2_zh: 当更激烈的竞争促使企业降价并改善服务时，消费者可能成为主要受益者。
collocations: a prize winner｜获奖者 ; the overall winner｜总冠军 ; a clear winner｜明显的赢家
tip_zh: winner 指获胜者；winning 可作形容词修饰队伍。

meanings_zh: adj. 容易的；不费力的 | adj. 轻松的；自在的
definition_en: Not difficult and requiring little effort. | Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.
example1_en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
example1_zh: 用新鲜蔬菜做这道汤很容易。
example2_en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
example2_zh: 让人们方便地获取可靠的健康信息，有助于他们作出更好的生活方式选择。
collocations: easy to use｜易于使用 ; easy access to｜便于获取或到达…… ; take it easy｜放轻松 ; easy life｜安逸的生活
tip_zh: 常用easy to do；修饰动作通常用easily。

meanings_zh: n. 东西；物品 | n. 事情；情况 | n. 个人物品
definition_en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified | an action, event, fact, or situation | possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural
example1_en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
example1_zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？
example2_en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
example2_zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。
collocations: the right thing to do｜正确的做法 ; personal things｜个人物品 ; first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事 ; one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip_zh: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

meanings_zh: n. 无线网络；无线联网技术
definition_en: Technology connecting devices to a network without cables.
example1_en: The café offers free wifi near the window seats.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆靠窗的座位附近有免费无线网络。
example2_en: Providing reliable public wifi can help residents access essential services and participate in online learning.
example2_zh: 提供可靠的公共无线网络，有助于居民使用基本服务并参与在线学习。
collocations: free wifi｜免费无线网络 ; wifi connection｜无线网络连接 ; wifi password｜无线网络密码 ; wifi signal｜无线网络信号
tip_zh: 常规范写作Wi-Fi；通常不可数，不加a。

meanings_zh: adj. 备用的；空闲的 | v. 抽出；分出 | v. 使免遭；饶恕
definition_en: extra and available to use when needed | to give time or resources that you can make available | to prevent someone from experiencing harm or difficulty
example1_en: I keep a spare umbrella in my car.
example1_zh: 我在车里放了一把备用伞。
example2_en: People who can spare a few hours each week could support local charities through regular volunteering.
example2_zh: 每周能抽出几个小时的人，可以通过定期做志愿者来支持当地慈善机构。
collocations: spare time｜空闲时间 ; spare key｜备用钥匙 ; spare parts｜备件 ; spare a moment｜抽出一点时间
tip_zh: spare time是空闲时间；spare作动词可指抽出。

meanings_zh: n. 嘴；口腔 | n. 河口；入口 | v. 用口形无声地说
definition_en: the opening in your face used for eating and speaking | the opening of a cave or where a river meets the sea | to form words with your lips without making a sound
example1_en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
example1_zh: 牙医让我把嘴张大一点。
example2_en: Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.
example2_zh: 河口附近的湿地提供了宝贵的栖息地，也有助于保护沿海社区免遭洪灾。
collocations: open your mouth｜张嘴 ; the mouth of a river｜河口 ; word of mouth｜口口相传
tip_zh: 名词末音为/θ/；动词末音为/ð/。

meanings_zh: n. 壁橱；储藏间 | adj. 隐藏身份或兴趣的
definition_en: A cupboard or small enclosed space for storing clothes or belongings | Keeping a particular identity, belief, or interest secret
example1_en: I hung my winter coat in the hallway closet.
example1_zh: 我把冬季外套挂进了走廊的壁橱里。
example2_en: Small apartments can feel more spacious when residents organise belongings efficiently and make better use of closet space.
example2_zh: 如果住户高效整理物品，更充分地利用壁橱空间，小公寓也会显得更宽敞。
collocations: built-in closet｜嵌入式壁橱 ; walk-in closet｜步入式衣帽间 ; closet space｜壁橱空间
tip_zh: 衣物收纳义多见于美式英语；英式常用wardrobe。

meanings_zh: n. 身份证件
definition_en: a document that proves who you are
example1_en: You need your ID to open a bank account.
example1_zh: 开银行账户需要身份证件。
example2_en: Please show your ID at the gate.
example2_zh: 请在门口出示证件。
collocations: ID card｜身份证
tip_zh: ID 是 identification 的缩写，ID card 是身份证。

meanings_zh: v. 学习；研究 | n. 学习；研究 | n. 书房
definition_en: Spend time learning about or carefully examining a subject. | The activity of learning, or an investigation of a subject. | A room used for reading, writing, or working.
example1_en: I study English on the bus every morning.
example1_zh: 我每天早上在公交车上学英语。
example2_en: A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.
example2_zh: 最近一项研究表明，经常锻炼能提高学生在课堂活动中的专注力。
collocations: study abroad｜出国留学 ; a recent study｜最近的一项研究 ; study for an exam｜为考试学习
tip_zh: study强调学习过程，learn常强调学会或获得知识。

meanings_zh: n. 费用；成本 | v. 价钱为；使花费 | n. 代价；损失
definition_en: the money needed to buy or do something | to require a particular amount of money | something valuable lost to achieve or obtain something
example1_en: The cost of our weekly groceries keeps rising.
example1_zh: 我们每周购买食品杂货的费用不断上涨。
example2_en: Improving public transport can reduce the cost of commuting and make cities more accessible.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以降低通勤成本，并让城市出行更加便利。
collocations: the cost of living｜生活成本 ; cover the cost｜支付费用 ; at all costs｜不惜一切代价 ; cost a fortune｜花一大笔钱
tip_zh: 表示花费时，过去式和过去分词均为cost。

meanings_zh: pron. 任何事物 | pron. 某事物；什么东西
definition_en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice | Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements
example1_en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
example1_zh: 你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。
example2_en: Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.
example2_zh: 在推行新政策之前，政府应查明其他地方是否有类似的成功做法。
collocations: anything else｜其他东西 ; anything at all｜任何东西 ; anything but｜绝非
tip_zh: 疑问句中常指“什么”；陈述句中可指“任何事物”。

meanings_zh: n. 运动员；比赛参加者 | n. 演奏者 | n. 播放器
definition_en: someone who takes part in a sport or game | someone who plays a musical instrument | a device or program that plays recorded sound or video
example1_en: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
example1_zh: 足球比赛开始前，每位球员都握了手。
example2_en: Young players benefit from coaches who value teamwork and personal development rather than winning alone.
example2_zh: 教练若重视团队合作和个人成长，而非一味追求胜利，年轻运动员就能从中受益。
collocations: football player｜足球运动员 ; team player｜善于团队合作的人 ; piano player｜钢琴演奏者 ; media player｜媒体播放器
tip_zh: 乐器演奏者可用“乐器名＋player”，如piano player。

meanings_zh: n. 奶奶；外婆（口语）
definition_en: informal word for grandmother
example1_en: Grandma bakes the best apple pie.
example1_zh: 奶奶烤的苹果派最好吃。
example2_en: We visited my grandma in the countryside.
example2_zh: 我们去乡下看望了外婆。
tip_zh: grandma 是 grandmother 的口语说法；granny 也常用。

meanings_zh: n. 巧克力 | n. 巧克力糖
definition_en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often with milk and sugar. | An individual sweet made of chocolate, sometimes with a filling.
example1_en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
example1_zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。
example2_en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
example2_zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。
collocations: dark chocolate｜黑巧克力 ; milk chocolate｜牛奶巧克力 ; a bar of chocolate｜一块巧克力 ; a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip_zh: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。

meanings_zh: n. 大小；规模 | n. 尺码；号 | v. 按大小分类；确定尺寸
definition_en: How big or small someone or something is. | A standard measurement used for clothes and other products. | To sort by measurements or make something a particular size.
example1_en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
example1_zh: 这个行李箱的大小正适合周末出行。
example2_en: Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
example2_zh: 缩小班级规模或许能让教师为有学习困难的学生提供更多个别辅导。
collocations: class size｜班级规模 ; sample size｜样本量 ; shoe size｜鞋码 ; in size｜在大小上
tip_zh: 问尺码用What size，不用How much size。

meanings_zh: n. 光盘播放机
definition_en: a machine that plays CDs
example1_en: My old CD player still works well.
example1_zh: 我的旧光盘播放机还能用。
example2_en: She listened to music on her CD player.
example2_zh: 她用光盘播放机听音乐。
tip_zh: 现在大家多用手机听歌，CD player 是较旧的设备。

meanings_zh: n. 帐篷
definition_en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes
example1_en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
example1_zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。
example2_en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
example2_zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。
collocations: pitch a tent｜搭帐篷 ; put up a tent｜搭起帐篷 ; take down a tent｜拆帐篷 ; camping tent｜露营帐篷
tip_zh: “搭帐篷”用pitch或put up a tent。

meanings_zh: det. 谁的；其…的 | pron. 谁的东西
definition_en: used before a noun to ask or show who owns something | used to ask who something belongs to
example1_en: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
example1_zh: 谁的雨伞把水滴得满地都是？
example2_en: Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.
example2_zh: 父母经常在家阅读的孩子可能会对书籍产生更浓厚的兴趣。
collocations: whose turn｜轮到谁 ; whose idea｜谁的主意 ; whose responsibility｜谁的责任
tip_zh: whose表示所属；who’s是who is或who has的缩写。

meanings_zh: phr v. 锻炼；算出；解决
definition_en: to exercise, or to find the answer
example1_en: She works out at the gym three times a week.
example1_zh: 她每周去健身房锻炼三次。
example2_en: Can you work out the answer to this problem?
example2_zh: 你能算出这道题的答案吗？
tip_zh: work out 有“锻炼、算出、解决”等多个意思。

meanings_zh: adj. 小的；少的 | adj. 年幼的 | adj. 不重要的；轻微的
definition_en: Limited in size, amount, or degree. | Young and not yet fully grown. | Not very important or serious.
example1_en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
example1_zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。
example2_en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
example2_zh: 即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。
collocations: a small amount of｜少量的 ; small businesses｜小企业 ; small children｜幼儿 ; a small change｜小变化
tip_zh: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。

meanings_zh: adj. 穿着衣服的；穿戴整齐的
definition_en: wearing clothes
example1_en: Get dressed quickly, we are late!
example1_zh: 快点穿好衣服，我们要迟到了！
example2_en: She was dressed in a blue coat.
example2_zh: 她穿着一件蓝色外套。
collocations: get dressed｜穿好衣服
tip_zh: get dressed 表示“穿好衣服”这个动作；be dressed in 表示“穿着”。

meanings_zh: n. 体育运动 | v. 显眼地穿戴；展示
definition_en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition | To wear or display something in a noticeable way
example1_en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
example1_zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜欢的运动。
example2_en: Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
example2_zh: 经常参加体育运动能改善身体健康，并帮助年轻人培养团队合作能力。
collocations: take part in sport｜参加体育运动 ; competitive sport｜竞技体育 ; team sport｜团队运动 ; sporting event｜体育赛事
tip_zh: 泛指体育时英式常用sport，美式常用sports。

meanings_zh: adv. 进一步；更远地 | adj. 更多的；进一步的 | v. 促进；推进
definition_en: to a greater degree or a more distant place | additional or more advanced | to help something develop or succeed
example1_en: We walked further along the beach before stopping.
example1_zh: 我们沿着海滩又走了一段才停下。
example2_en: Further research is needed to understand how urban green spaces affect residents' mental health.
example2_zh: 还需要进一步研究，才能了解城市绿地如何影响居民的心理健康。
collocations: further information｜更多信息 ; further research｜进一步研究 ; discuss further｜进一步讨论 ; further your career｜促进职业发展
tip_zh: further可指程度或距离；farther主要指距离。

meanings_zh: pron. 你；你们
definition_en: the person or people spoken to
example1_en: You are my best friend.
example1_zh: 你是我最好的朋友。
example2_en: Are you coming to the party?
example2_zh: 你来参加聚会吗？
tip_zh: you 单复数同形；you 的形容词性物主代词是 your。

meanings_zh: n. 右手
definition_en: the hand on the right side of your body
example1_en: She writes with her right hand.
example1_zh: 她用右手写字。
example2_en: Hold the cup in your right hand.
example2_zh: 用右手拿着杯子。
tip_zh: right hand 是右手；反义 left hand 左手。

meanings_zh: n. 大脑；脑 | n. 智力；头脑
definition_en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity. | The ability to think clearly and understand things.
example1_en: A helmet helps protect your brain if you fall.
example1_zh: 跌倒时，头盔有助于保护你的大脑。
example2_en: Adequate sleep supports healthy brain function and helps learners remember information more effectively.
example2_zh: 充足的睡眠有助于大脑正常运作，并帮助学习者更有效地记忆信息。
collocations: brain function｜大脑功能 ; brain damage｜脑损伤 ; use your brain｜动动脑筋
tip_zh: 表示智力时常用复数brains；器官用brain。

meanings_zh: n. 母牛；奶牛 | v. 恐吓；威吓
definition_en: an adult female bovine, often kept for milk | to frighten someone into obeying or giving up resistance
example1_en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the farm gate.
example1_zh: 一头棕色母牛静静地站在农场门旁。
example2_en: Improving the diet of dairy cows can increase milk production while supporting animal health.
example2_zh: 改善奶牛的饮食可以在促进动物健康的同时提高产奶量。
collocations: dairy cow｜奶牛 ; milk a cow｜给奶牛挤奶 ; be cowed into silence｜被吓得不敢出声
tip_zh: cow指成年母牛；cattle统称牛，不能说a cattle。

meanings_zh: adj. 拥挤的；挤满的
definition_en: Containing so many people or things that little space remains
example1_en: The bus was so crowded that we stood all the way.
example1_zh: 公交车太拥挤了，我们一路都站着。
example2_en: Crowded urban neighbourhoods need accessible parks where residents can exercise and enjoy some personal space.
example2_zh: 拥挤的城市社区需要方便到达的公园，让居民能够锻炼并享有一些个人空间。
collocations: crowded bus｜拥挤的公交车 ; crowded with people｜挤满人的 ; crowded streets｜拥挤的街道
tip_zh: be crowded with 表示“挤满……”。

meanings_zh: n. 球；球状物 | n. 正式舞会
definition_en: A round object used in games or shaped like one. | A formal social event where people dance.
example1_en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
example1_zh: 那只狗追着球跑过草地。
example2_en: Simple ball games can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and regular physical activity.
example2_zh: 简单的球类游戏能帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作和日常体育锻炼。
collocations: throw a ball｜扔球 ; catch a ball｜接球 ; a ball of wool｜一团毛线 ; a charity ball｜慈善舞会
tip_zh: 球类运动前通常不用冠词，如play football。

meanings_zh: adj. 不快乐的；难过的 | adj. 不满意的
definition_en: Feeling sad or lacking happiness | Not satisfied with someone or something
example1_en: He looked unhappy when the picnic was cancelled.
example1_zh: 野餐取消后，他显得很不开心。
example2_en: Residents are unhappy with the proposed road expansion because it would remove valuable green space.
example2_zh: 居民对拟议中的道路扩建不满意，因为它会占用宝贵的绿地。
collocations: feel unhappy｜感到不快乐 ; unhappy with the service｜对服务不满意 ; an unhappy childhood｜不快乐的童年
tip_zh: unhappy with常表示“对……不满意”。

meanings_zh: n. 事情；问题 | v. 要紧；有关系 | n. 物质
definition_en: a subject, situation or problem needing thought or attention | to be important or make a difference | physical substance that occupies space and has mass
example1_en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
example1_zh: 我们可以今天午饭后讨论这件事。
example2_en: The quality of teaching matters more than expensive equipment when schools aim to improve student achievement.
example2_zh: 学校若想提高学生成绩，教学质量比昂贵的设备更重要。
collocations: a serious matter｜严重的问题 ; a matter of time｜时间问题 ; organic matter｜有机物 ; it doesn't matter｜没关系
tip_zh: 指事情时通常可数；指物质时不可数；作动词表示要紧。

meanings_zh: n. 野餐 | v. 去野餐
definition_en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home | to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure
example1_en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
example1_zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。
example2_en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
example2_zh: 公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。
collocations: have a picnic｜野餐 ; go on a picnic｜去野餐 ; picnic basket｜野餐篮
tip_zh: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。

meanings_zh: v. 开始；着手
definition_en: to start happening or start doing something
example1_en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
example1_zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。
example2_en: Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.
example2_zh: 学校应尽早开始教授网络安全知识，让孩子养成负责任地使用互联网的习惯。
collocations: begin with｜以……开始 ; begin to understand｜开始理解 ; begin a discussion｜开始讨论 ; to begin with｜首先；起初
tip_zh: 过去式began，过去分词begun；后接不定式或动名词。

meanings_zh: det. 足够的 | adv. 足够地 | pron. 足够的数量
definition_en: as much or as many as needed | to the degree that is needed | an amount that meets a need
example1_en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
example1_zh: 我们的米够今晚所有人吃。
example2_en: Many rural schools lack enough resources to provide students with a broad range of subjects.
example2_zh: 许多农村学校缺乏足够的资源，无法为学生开设广泛的课程。
collocations: enough time｜足够的时间 ; good enough｜足够好 ; enough to eat｜足够吃的东西
tip_zh: 修饰名词放前面，修饰形容词或副词放后面。

meanings_zh: n. 工程师 | v. 设计制造；策划促成
definition_en: Someone who designs or builds machines, structures, or technical systems. | To design something technical or skilfully arrange an outcome.
example1_en: An engineer checked the bridge before it opened.
example1_zh: 一位工程师在桥梁通车前进行了检查。
example2_en: Engineers can reduce urban energy consumption by designing buildings that require less heating and cooling.
example2_zh: 工程师可以通过设计供暖和制冷需求更低的建筑来减少城市能源消耗。
collocations: civil engineer｜土木工程师 ; software engineer｜软件工程师 ; engineer a solution｜精心设计解决方案
tip_zh: engineer也可作动词，表示设计或策划促成。

meanings_zh: n. 班级；课 | n. 社会阶层；类别 | v. 把…归类
definition_en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend. | A social group or category sharing particular characteristics. | To place someone or something in a particular category.
example1_en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
example1_zh: 我们班正在学习如何种蔬菜。
example2_en: Smaller class sizes may allow teachers to give more individual attention to students with learning difficulties.
example2_zh: 较小的班级规模可能让教师给予学习有困难的学生更多个别关注。
collocations: attend a class｜上课 ; class size｜班级规模 ; social class｜社会阶层 ; be classed as｜被归类为
tip_zh: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

meanings_zh: n. 中午；正午
definition_en: the middle of the day, around twelve o'clock
example1_en: We stopped for a picnic beside the lake at midday.
example1_zh: 中午，我们停下来在湖边野餐。
example2_en: Outdoor workers should avoid direct sunlight around midday to reduce the risk of heat exhaustion.
example2_zh: 户外工作者应避免在中午前后受到阳光直射，以降低热衰竭的风险。
collocations: at midday｜在中午 ; around midday｜中午前后 ; the midday sun｜正午的阳光
tip_zh: 时间前用at；也可置于名词前，如midday sun。

meanings_zh: det. 很少的；几个 | pron. 很少的人或事物
definition_en: Not many; a small number of countable things. | A small number of people or things.
example1_en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
example1_zh: 今天上午店里的顾客很少。
example2_en: Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.
example2_zh: 很少有农村社区能获得大城市所提供的专科医疗服务。
collocations: a few days｜几天 ; very few people｜极少的人 ; few and far between｜少之又少
tip_zh: few表几乎没有，a few表有几个；均接可数名词复数。

meanings_zh: n. 书架；书橱中的搁板
definition_en: a shelf used for storing books
example1_en: She placed her favourite novel on the wooden bookshelf.
example1_zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放到了木书架上。
example2_en: A well-stocked bookshelf in every classroom can encourage children to explore subjects beyond the school curriculum.
example2_zh: 每间教室都配备藏书丰富的书架，可以鼓励孩子探索学校课程以外的主题。
collocations: a wooden bookshelf｜木书架 ; on the bookshelf｜在书架上 ; a well-stocked bookshelf｜藏书丰富的书架
tip_zh: 复数为bookshelves，注意把f变为ves。

meanings_zh: n. 蜥蜴
definition_en: a reptile with a long tail, usually with four legs
example1_en: A tiny lizard rested on the warm garden wall.
example1_zh: 一只小蜥蜴趴在花园里温暖的墙上。
example2_en: Protecting rocky habitats helps preserve lizard populations, which play an important role in controlling insects.
example2_zh: 保护岩石栖息地有助于维持蜥蜴种群，它们在控制昆虫数量方面发挥着重要作用。
collocations: small lizard｜小蜥蜴 ; lizard species｜蜥蜴物种 ; lizard habitat｜蜥蜴栖息地
tip_zh: lizard是可数名词，复数为lizards。

meanings_zh: n. 国家 | n. 乡下；农村 | n. 乡村音乐
definition_en: An area of land governed as an independent political unit. | Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages. | A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.
example1_en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
example1_zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。
example2_en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
example2_zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。
collocations: a developing country｜发展中国家 ; a neighbouring country｜邻国 ; live in the country｜住在乡下 ; country music｜乡村音乐
tip_zh: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

meanings_zh: v. 理解；懂得 | v. 体谅；理解感受 | v. 获悉；认为
definition_en: to know what something means or how it works | to recognise why someone feels or behaves a certain way | to believe something is true based on available information
example1_en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
example1_zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。
example2_en: Schools should help students understand how their daily choices affect the natural environment.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生理解自己的日常选择如何影响自然环境。
collocations: understand the meaning｜理解含义 ; fully understand｜完全理解 ; understand how｜理解如何
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为understood。

meanings_zh: n. 先生（男性称谓）
definition_en: title used before a man's surname
example1_en: Mr Brown is our new English teacher.
example1_zh: 布朗先生是我们新的英语老师。
example2_en: Good morning, Mr Smith.
example2_zh: 早上好，史密斯先生。
tip_zh: Mr 用于男性姓氏前；Mrs 用于已婚女性，Ms 用于女性（不限婚否）。

meanings_zh: adj. 好看的；有魅力的 | adj. 有吸引力的
definition_en: Pleasant to look at | Having qualities that make people interested in choosing something
example1_en: The garden looks especially attractive when the roses bloom.
example1_zh: 玫瑰盛开时，这座花园显得格外美丽。
example2_en: Flexible working hours make teaching a more attractive career option for some university graduates.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作时间让教师职业对一些大学毕业生更具吸引力。
collocations: an attractive appearance｜好看的外表 ; an attractive salary｜诱人的薪资 ; an attractive option｜有吸引力的选择 ; attractive to visitors｜吸引游客的
tip_zh: 既可形容外表好看，也可形容方案、薪资诱人。

meanings_zh: n. 观点；看法 | n. 景色；视野 | v. 看待；观看
definition_en: An opinion or belief about something. | What you can see from a particular place. | To consider something in a particular way, or look at it.
example1_en: My view is that we should leave earlier.
example1_zh: 我的看法是我们应该早点出发。
example2_en: Many residents view investment in public transport as an effective way to reduce urban pollution.
example2_zh: 许多居民认为，投资公共交通是减少城市污染的有效方式。
collocations: express a view｜表达观点 ; in my view｜在我看来 ; a sea view｜海景 ; view something as｜将某事视为
tip_zh: 观点用view on；把某事视为用view…as…。

meanings_zh: adv. 终于 | adv. 最后
definition_en: After a long wait, delay, or effort. | Used to introduce the last point or action.
example1_en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
example1_zh: 找了一上午后，我终于找到了钥匙。
example2_en: Finally, governments should invest in reliable public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 最后，政府应投资建设可靠的公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。
collocations: finally arrive｜终于到达 ; finally succeed｜终于成功 ; finally agree｜终于同意
tip_zh: 表示终于常置于实义动词前；引出最后一点常置句首。

meanings_zh: v. 死亡；枯死 | v. 停止运转；逐渐消失 | n. 骰子
definition_en: Stop living. | Stop working or gradually become weaker and disappear. | A small cube with marked faces, thrown in games.
example1_en: These plants will die if we forget to water them.
example1_zh: 如果忘了浇水，这些植物就会枯死。
example2_en: Many marine animals die after swallowing plastic waste, highlighting the urgent need to reduce ocean pollution.
example2_zh: 许多海洋动物吞食塑料垃圾后死亡，这凸显了减少海洋污染的迫切需要。
collocations: die of cancer｜死于癌症 ; die out｜灭绝；消失 ; die down｜逐渐平息 ; die from injuries｜因伤死亡
tip_zh: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 玩偶；洋娃娃
definition_en: A toy shaped like a person.
example1_en: My little cousin tucked her doll into a tiny bed.
example1_zh: 我的小表妹把她的洋娃娃安顿在一张小床上。
example2_en: Playing with dolls can help young children develop communication skills and explore different social roles.
example2_zh: 玩玩偶可以帮助幼儿培养沟通能力，并探索不同的社会角色。
collocations: a rag doll｜布娃娃 ; play with dolls｜玩玩偶 ; a doll's house｜玩偶屋
tip_zh: 通常指人形玩具；用来称呼女性可能显得轻慢。

meanings_zh: n. 四月
definition_en: The fourth month of the year.
example1_en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
example1_zh: 我们将在四月搬进新公寓。
example2_en: The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.
example2_zh: 社区菜园将于四月开放，让当地居民有更多机会自己种菜。
collocations: in April｜在四月 ; early April｜四月初 ; late April｜四月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

meanings_zh: n. 借口；辩解理由 | v. 原谅；宽恕 | v. 准许免做；准许离开
definition_en: a reason given to explain or defend a fault | forgive someone for a mistake or impolite behaviour | allow someone to avoid a duty or leave
example1_en: He made an excuse for arriving late to dinner.
example1_zh: 他为晚餐迟到找了个借口。
example2_en: Limited funding should not become an excuse for neglecting essential maintenance in schools and public hospitals.
example2_zh: 资金有限不应成为忽视学校和公立医院必要维护工作的借口。
collocations: make an excuse｜找借口 ; an excuse for｜为……找的借口 ; excuse me｜劳驾；对不起 ; excuse someone from｜准许某人免于
tip_zh: 名词末尾读/s/，动词读/z/；excuse me常用于礼貌打断。

meanings_zh: prep. 和；与……一起 | prep. 有；带有 | prep. 用；借助
definition_en: Accompanied by another person or thing. | Having or including a particular feature or thing. | Using a particular tool, material, or means.
example1_en: I cooked dinner with my sister last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚我和姐姐一起做了晚饭。
example2_en: Schools should work with local communities to provide children with safe spaces for outdoor activities.
example2_zh: 学校应与当地社区合作，为儿童提供安全的户外活动空间。
collocations: work with someone｜与某人合作 ; with care｜小心地 ; agree with someone｜同意某人的看法 ; with the help of｜在……的帮助下
tip_zh: with后接名词或代词宾格，如with me。

meanings_zh: n. 国际象棋
definition_en: a two-player board game involving pieces with different permitted moves
example1_en: My grandfather taught me chess during the winter holidays.
example1_zh: 寒假期间，爷爷教我下国际象棋。
example2_en: Playing chess regularly may help children develop concentration and practise planning several steps ahead.
example2_zh: 经常下国际象棋可能有助于儿童提高专注力，并练习提前规划多个步骤。
collocations: play chess｜下国际象棋 ; chess board｜国际象棋棋盘 ; chess tournament｜国际象棋锦标赛 ; chess piece｜国际象棋棋子
tip_zh: 说play chess，不加冠词the。

meanings_zh: n. 盘子；碟子 | n. 薄板；金属板 | v. 给…镀上金属
definition_en: A flat, usually round dish used for serving food. | A flat piece of metal or another hard material. | To cover an object with a thin layer of metal.
example1_en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
example1_zh: 她在我的盘子里放了一张热乎乎的薄煎饼。
example2_en: Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
example2_zh: 餐馆可以提供较小的餐盘，并允许顾客要求加量，从而减少食物浪费。
collocations: dinner plate｜餐盘 ; a plate of rice｜一盘米饭 ; steel plate｜钢板 ; gold-plated jewellery｜镀金首饰
tip_zh: plate通常指浅盘，bowl指较深的碗。

meanings_zh: n. 头痛 | n. 令人头痛的难题
definition_en: Pain felt in the head. | A problem that causes worry or is difficult to manage.
example1_en: I have a headache, so I need some quiet.
example1_zh: 我头痛，需要安静一会儿。
example2_en: Ageing transport infrastructure has become a major headache for local authorities facing increasingly limited budgets.
example2_zh: 对于预算日益紧张的地方政府而言，老化的交通基础设施已成为一大难题。
collocations: have a headache｜头痛 ; a severe headache｜剧烈头痛 ; a major headache｜一大难题
tip_zh: 表示一次头痛用a headache，通常说have a headache。

meanings_zh: adv. 一起；共同 | adv. 合在一起；相互连接
definition_en: with another person or other people | joined or combined with something else
example1_en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
example1_zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。
example2_en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
example2_zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。
collocations: work together｜共同合作 ; get together｜相聚 ; put together｜组装；整理 ; live together｜一起生活
tip_zh: together通常作副词：一起做某事用动词加together。

meanings_zh: n. 蜗牛
definition_en: a small animal with a shell that moves very slowly
example1_en: The snail crawled slowly across the path.
example1_zh: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过小路。
example2_en: We found a snail in the garden after the rain.
example2_zh: 雨后我们在花园里发现了一只蜗牛。
tip_zh: snail 蜗牛以“慢”著称；slippery as a snail 之类的习语少见，记住词义即可。

meanings_zh: n. 自助餐厅；食堂
definition_en: A restaurant where customers collect food and carry it to tables.
example1_en: We carried our lunch trays to the cafeteria window.
example1_zh: 我们端着午餐托盘走到食堂窗边。
example2_en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating habits by offering affordable meals with fresh vegetables and fruit.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以提供价格实惠、含新鲜蔬菜水果的餐食，促进更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: a school cafeteria｜学校食堂 ; a hospital cafeteria｜医院食堂 ; a cafeteria tray｜食堂托盘
tip_zh: 强调自行取餐，不一定是不限量的自助餐。

meanings_zh: n. 星期六
definition_en: the day after Friday and before Sunday
example1_en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
example1_zh: 我们通常星期六去市场买新鲜蔬菜。
example2_en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆在星期六开放，让更多上班的家长能与孩子一起参加教育活动。
collocations: on Saturday｜在星期六 ; Saturday morning｜星期六早晨 ; every Saturday｜每星期六 ; this Saturday｜本周六
tip_zh: 首字母大写；on Saturday，但this Saturday前不用on。

meanings_zh: adj. 棕色的；褐色的 | n. 棕色；褐色 | v. 使变褐色；变褐色
definition_en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood. | The colour of chocolate or dark wood. | To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.
example1_en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
example1_zh: 一只棕色的小狗正在门边睡觉。
example2_en: During dry periods, grass often turns brown as plants conserve water and reduce their growth.
example2_zh: 在干旱时期，植物为了保存水分会减缓生长，草也常因此变成褐色。
collocations: dark brown｜深棕色 ; brown eyes｜棕色眼睛 ; brown rice｜糙米 ; golden brown｜金黄色的
tip_zh: brown作动词常用于烹饪，指把食物煎或烤至褐色。

meanings_zh: n. 蘑菇 | v. 迅速增长；迅速涌现
definition_en: A fungus often shaped like an umbrella; some are edible. | Grow or increase very quickly.
example1_en: I added sliced mushrooms to the soup for lunch.
example1_zh: 我在午餐的汤里加了切片蘑菇。
example2_en: Online learning platforms have mushroomed as demand for flexible and affordable education has increased worldwide.
example2_zh: 随着全球对灵活且价格可负担的教育需求上升，在线学习平台迅速涌现。
collocations: mushroom soup｜蘑菇汤 ; wild mushrooms｜野生蘑菇 ; mushroom into a large business｜迅速发展成大企业
tip_zh: 作动词表示迅速增长，不接直接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 蜜蜂
definition_en: a flying insect that collects pollen; some kinds make honey
example1_en: A bee landed gently on the yellow flower.
example1_zh: 一只蜜蜂轻轻落在那朵黄花上。
example2_en: Protecting bees is essential for agriculture because these insects pollinate many crops that humans depend on.
example2_zh: 保护蜜蜂对农业至关重要，因为它们为许多人类赖以生存的作物授粉。
collocations: honey bee｜蜜蜂 ; a swarm of bees｜一群蜜蜂 ; bee sting｜蜂蜇 ; bee colony｜蜂群
tip_zh: bee与be同音；蜂群可用a swarm of bees。

meanings_zh: adj. 奥运会的
definition_en: relating to the Olympic Games
example1_en: She watched the Olympic Games on TV.
example1_zh: 她在电视上观看奥运会。
example2_en: The Olympic torch arrived in the city.
example2_zh: 奥运圣火到达了这座城市。
collocations: the Olympic Games｜奥运会
tip_zh: the Olympic Games 是“奥运会”，也常说 the Olympics。

meanings_zh: v. 花费钱 | v. 度过；花费时间
definition_en: to use money to pay for something | to use time doing something or being somewhere
example1_en: We spent all our money on fresh fruit.
example1_zh: 我们把钱全花在了新鲜水果上。
example2_en: Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
example2_zh: 政府应增加预防保健方面的支出，以减少未来治疗慢性病的费用。
collocations: spend money on｜把钱花在……上 ; spend time doing｜花时间做…… ; spend the night｜过夜
tip_zh: 用spend时间doing或spend钱on；过去式spent。

meanings_zh: n. 购物中心
definition_en: a large building with many shops
example1_en: We spent the afternoon at the shopping centre.
example1_zh: 我们在购物中心待了一下午。
example2_en: The new shopping centre has a cinema inside.
example2_zh: 新购物中心里面有一家电影院。
tip_zh: shopping centre 是英式说法；美式常说 shopping mall。

meanings_zh: n. 秋天；秋季
definition_en: The season between summer and winter
example1_en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
example1_zh: 我们每年秋天都在公园里收集落叶。
example2_en: Warmer autumn temperatures may delay leaf fall and affect the seasonal behaviour of local wildlife.
example2_zh: 秋季气温升高可能推迟落叶，并影响当地野生动物的季节性行为。
collocations: in autumn｜在秋天 ; autumn leaves｜秋叶 ; early autumn｜初秋
tip_zh: 字母n不发音；美式英语常用fall表示秋天。

meanings_zh: v. 帮助；有助于 | n. 帮助；援助
definition_en: Make something easier or better for someone. | Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.
example1_en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
example1_zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？
example2_en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
example2_zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。
collocations: help someone with something｜帮助某人做某事 ; ask for help｜寻求帮助 ; help to reduce｜有助于减少
tip_zh: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

meanings_zh: pron. 你的；你们的（所有物）
definition_en: something that belongs to you
example1_en: This seat is yours.
example1_zh: 这个座位是你的。
example2_en: My umbrella is red; yours is black.
example2_zh: 我的伞是红色的，你的是黑色的。
tip_zh: yours 是名词性物主代词；yours sincerely 是信件结尾敬语。

meanings_zh: adj. 高的；高处的 | adj. 大量的；高水平的 | adv. 在高处；向高处
definition_en: extending far upwards or positioned far above the ground | greater than usual in amount, degree, or quality | at or to a position far above the ground
example1_en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
example1_zh: 架子太高了，我够不着。
example2_en: High housing costs can prevent young adults from living independently, particularly in major urban centres.
example2_zh: 高昂的住房成本可能使年轻人无法独立居住，在大城市中心尤其如此。
collocations: high standards｜高标准 ; high prices｜高价 ; high altitude｜高海拔 ; high above｜远在……上方
tip_zh: high常指位置或程度；人的身高用tall。

meanings_zh: n. 邀请；请帖
definition_en: a request for someone to attend or join something
example1_en: We received an invitation to our neighbour's garden party.
example1_zh: 我们收到了邻居花园聚会的邀请。
example2_en: An invitation to participate in local planning can encourage residents to take greater responsibility for their neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 邀请居民参与地方规划，可以鼓励他们为社区承担更多责任。
collocations: accept an invitation｜接受邀请 ; decline an invitation｜谢绝邀请 ; an invitation to dinner｜晚餐邀请 ; by invitation only｜仅限受邀者
tip_zh: 参加活动用invitation to；邀请做事用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 秘书 | n. 协会或组织的书记；干事 | n. 部长；大臣
definition_en: Someone who arranges meetings and handles office communication. | An official managing an organisation's records and routine business. | A senior government official responsible for a particular department.
example1_en: The secretary arranged a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
example1_zh: 秘书安排了明天下午的会议。
example2_en: A school secretary often provides essential support by coordinating appointments and communicating with parents throughout the day.
example2_zh: 学校秘书常常通过安排会面及全天与家长沟通，提供不可或缺的支持。
collocations: personal secretary｜私人秘书 ; club secretary｜俱乐部干事 ; foreign secretary｜外交大臣
tip_zh: 既可指办公室秘书，也可指某些政府部长。

meanings_zh: adj. 灭绝的 | adj. 死的；不再喷发的
definition_en: having no living members left | describing a volcano not expected to erupt again
example1_en: My little cousin asked why dinosaurs became extinct.
example1_zh: 我的小表弟问恐龙为什么灭绝了。
example2_en: Without stronger habitat protection, many endangered species could become extinct within the next few decades.
example2_zh: 如果不加强栖息地保护，许多濒危物种可能在未来几十年内灭绝。
collocations: become extinct｜灭绝 ; extinct species｜已灭绝物种 ; extinct volcano｜死火山
tip_zh: extinct指已灭绝；endangered指濒危，尚未灭绝。

meanings_zh: n. 奖品；奖金；奖项 | v. 珍视；高度重视
definition_en: something given for winning a competition or achieving something | to value something very highly
example1_en: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
example1_zh: 莉娜因她色彩缤纷的花园获了奖。
example2_en: Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.
example2_zh: 为创新设计设奖，可以鼓励学生提出解决环境问题的实用方案。
collocations: win a prize｜获奖 ; first prize｜一等奖 ; prize money｜奖金 ; highly prized｜备受珍视的
tip_zh: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

meanings_zh: n. 芒果
definition_en: A tropical fruit with sweet orange flesh and a large stone
example1_en: This mango is sweet enough to eat without sugar.
example1_zh: 这个芒果已经很甜了，不用加糖就能吃。
example2_en: Improved storage facilities can help mango farmers reduce food waste and earn more reliable incomes.
example2_zh: 改善储存设施可以帮助芒果种植户减少食物浪费，获得更稳定的收入。
collocations: a ripe mango｜熟芒果 ; mango juice｜芒果汁 ; mango flesh｜芒果果肉
tip_zh: 复数mangoes和mangos均正确。

meanings_zh: n. 名人；明星 | n. 名望；名气
definition_en: A person who is widely known by the public. | The state of being famous.
example1_en: A celebrity stopped outside the theatre to greet fans.
example1_zh: 一位明星在剧院外停下脚步，与粉丝打招呼。
example2_en: Celebrity endorsements can influence young consumers, so advertisements should clearly distinguish personal opinions from paid promotion.
example2_zh: 名人代言可能影响年轻消费者，因此广告应明确区分个人观点与付费推广。
