collocations: celebrity endorsement｜名人代言 ; celebrity culture｜名人文化 ; achieve celebrity｜成名
tip_zh: 指名人时可数；指名气时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 当地的；本地的 | n. 当地人 | adj. 局部的
definition_en: relating to the area where someone lives or something happens | a person who lives in a particular area | affecting only a limited part of something
example1_en: We buy fresh bread from our local bakery every morning.
example1_zh: 我们每天早晨都在附近的面包店买新鲜面包。
example2_en: Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.
example2_zh: 支持本地企业可以加强社区联系，并让更多资金在区域经济内部流通。
collocations: local community｜当地社区 ; local authorities｜地方当局 ; local residents｜当地居民 ; local anaesthetic｜局部麻醉药
tip_zh: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 汤；羹
definition_en: A liquid food made by cooking ingredients in water or stock.
example1_en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
example1_zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。
example2_en: Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
example2_zh: 社区厨房可以提供价格实惠的蔬菜汤，帮助居民在经济困难时期获得有营养的餐食。
collocations: a bowl of soup｜一碗汤 ; vegetable soup｜蔬菜汤 ; make soup｜煮汤 ; chicken soup｜鸡汤
tip_zh: 通常不可数；点餐时two soups可指两份汤。

meanings_zh: n. 动物；生物 | n. 虚构生物；怪物
definition_en: a living being, especially an animal | an imaginary being with unusual physical features
example1_en: A tiny creature crawled out from under the leaf.
example1_zh: 一只小生物从叶子底下爬了出来。
example2_en: Even the smallest marine creature can play an important role in maintaining a healthy ocean ecosystem.
example2_zh: 即使是最小的海洋生物，也能在维持健康的海洋生态系统方面发挥重要作用。
collocations: a sea creature｜海洋生物 ; a living creature｜活的生物 ; a mythical creature｜神话生物
tip_zh: creature常指动物，也可指想象中的生物。

meanings_zh: n. 噪音；响声
definition_en: a sound, especially one that is loud or unwanted
example1_en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
example1_zh: 外面的噪音在闹钟响之前就把我吵醒了。
example2_en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.
example2_zh: 长期接触交通噪音会影响睡眠质量，降低城市居民的身心健康水平。
collocations: noise pollution｜噪音污染 ; background noise｜背景噪音 ; make a noise｜发出声响 ; traffic noise｜交通噪音
tip_zh: 泛指噪音时不可数；指某个具体声响可用a noise。

meanings_zh: v. 选择；挑选 | v. 决定；选择去做
definition_en: to decide which person or thing you want | to decide to do something rather than something else
example1_en: You can choose a seat beside the window.
example1_zh: 你可以选一个靠窗的座位。
example2_en: Many students choose to study abroad because they want to experience different cultures and teaching methods.
example2_zh: 许多学生选择出国留学，因为他们想体验不同的文化和教学方法。
collocations: choose between｜在……之间选择 ; choose from｜从……中挑选 ; choose to do something｜选择做某事 ; choose wisely｜明智地选择
tip_zh: 过去式chose，过去分词chosen；后接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 发明物 | n. 发明；创造 | n. 虚构的事；编造
definition_en: something new that someone has designed or created | the act of creating something that did not exist before | a story or explanation created rather than based on facts
example1_en: Her latest invention waters the plants while she is away.
example1_zh: 她最新的发明能在她外出时给植物浇水。
example2_en: The invention of affordable water filters has improved public health in communities with limited access to clean water.
example2_zh: 价格低廉的滤水器的发明改善了难以获得清洁用水的社区的公共卫生状况。
collocations: a useful invention｜实用的发明 ; the invention of｜……的发明 ; a recent invention｜近期的发明
tip_zh: invention创造原本没有的东西；discovery发现已有事物。

meanings_zh: v. 相信；信以为真 | v. 认为；以为 | v. 信任；信仰
definition_en: To accept that something is true or someone is truthful. | To think that something is likely or correct. | To have confidence or faith in someone or something.
example1_en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
example1_zh: 我相信你，但你讲的事情听起来很不寻常。
example2_en: Some educators believe that practical experience is just as valuable as academic knowledge in preparing students for employment.
example2_zh: 一些教育工作者认为，在帮助学生为就业做准备方面，实践经验与学术知识同样重要。
collocations: believe that｜相信；认为…… ; believe in yourself｜相信自己 ; widely believed｜被普遍认为 ; hard to believe｜难以置信
tip_zh: believe someone指相信其话；believe in someone指信任其能力。

meanings_zh: n. 火车；列车 | v. 训练；培训
definition_en: Connected railway vehicles that carry passengers or goods. | Teach or practise skills needed for an activity or job.
example1_en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们赶上了回家的末班火车。
example2_en: Governments should train more healthcare workers to meet the needs of an ageing population.
example2_zh: 政府应培训更多医护人员，以满足老龄化人口的需求。
collocations: catch a train｜赶上火车 ; train station｜火车站 ; train staff｜培训员工 ; train for a marathon｜为马拉松训练
tip_zh: 交通方式用by train；在某列火车上用on the train。

meanings_zh: n. 纸；纸张 | n. 报纸 | n. 论文；试卷
definition_en: Thin material used for writing, printing, or wrapping. | A publication containing news, usually printed on large sheets. | An academic article or a written examination.
example1_en: She wrapped the small gift in bright yellow paper.
example1_zh: 她用鲜黄色的纸把小礼物包了起来。
example2_en: The university encourages students to submit assignments electronically to reduce paper consumption across its departments.
example2_zh: 这所大学鼓励学生以电子形式提交作业，以减少各院系的纸张消耗。
collocations: a sheet of paper｜一张纸 ; recycled paper｜再生纸 ; research paper｜研究论文 ; exam paper｜试卷
tip_zh: 纸不可数，用a piece of paper；论文、报纸可数。

meanings_zh: n. 聊天室
definition_en: a place on the internet where people chat
example1_en: They met in an online chatroom.
example1_zh: 他们在一个在线聊天室里认识。
example2_en: Be careful what you share in a chatroom.
example2_zh: 在聊天室里注意不要随意分享信息。
tip_zh: 在 chatroom 里要注意安全，不透露个人信息。

meanings_zh: conj. 如果；假如 | conj. 是否
definition_en: introduces a condition for something to happen | introduces an indirect question about whether something is true
example1_en: If it rains, we can play indoors instead.
example1_zh: 如果下雨，我们可以改在室内玩。
example2_en: If cities invest in safe cycling routes, more residents may choose bicycles for their daily journeys.
example2_zh: 如果城市投资建设安全的自行车道，更多居民可能会选择骑车进行日常出行。
collocations: even if｜即使 ; only if｜只有…才 ; as if｜仿佛 ; if necessary｜如有必要
tip_zh: 谈未来条件时，if从句通常用一般现在时。

meanings_zh: adj. 相反的；对面的 | prep. 在…对面 | n. 相反的人或事物
definition_en: completely different, or on the other side | facing someone or something from the other side | someone or something completely different from another
example1_en: We left the station and walked in opposite directions.
example1_zh: 我们离开车站，朝相反的方向走去。
example2_en: Although the policy aimed to reduce traffic, it had the opposite effect in several residential areas.
example2_zh: 尽管该政策旨在减少交通流量，却在几个住宅区产生了相反的效果。
collocations: opposite directions｜相反方向 ; the opposite effect｜相反的效果 ; the exact opposite｜截然相反的事物
tip_zh: 介词opposite后直接接地点；名词常用the opposite of。

meanings_zh: adj. 大的；大量的 | adj. 重要的；影响大的
definition_en: Large in size, amount, or degree. | Important or likely to have a strong effect.
example1_en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
example1_zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。
example2_en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
example2_zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。
collocations: a big difference｜很大的差别 ; a big decision｜重大决定 ; a big mistake｜严重错误
tip_zh: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

meanings_zh: n. 手 | n. 帮助 | v. 递给；交给
definition_en: The body part at the arm's end, with fingers and thumb. | Help with doing a task. | To give something to someone by holding it out.
example1_en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
example1_zh: 她用左手握着温热的杯子。
example2_en: Practical workshops allow students to develop skills by making objects with their own hands.
example2_zh: 实践工作坊让学生通过亲手制作物品来培养技能。
collocations: hold hands｜手拉手 ; give someone a hand｜帮某人一把 ; hand in an assignment｜提交作业 ; by hand｜用手；手工
tip_zh: give someone a hand表示帮忙；by hand表示手工。

meanings_zh: pron. 互相；彼此
definition_en: used when two people do the same thing to one another
example1_en: The twins help each other with homework.
example1_zh: 这对双胞胎互相帮助做作业。
example2_en: They looked at each other and smiled.
example2_zh: 他们相视而笑。
tip_zh: each other 表示两者或多者“互相”；常用于 help/look at 等动词后。

meanings_zh: adj. 黄色的 | n. 黄色 | v. 变黄；使变黄
definition_en: having the colour of lemons or ripe bananas | the colour of lemons or ripe bananas | to become yellow or make something yellow
example1_en: She picked a yellow umbrella for the rainy walk.
example1_zh: 她挑了一把黄色雨伞，准备在雨中散步。
example2_en: Yellow leaves may indicate that urban trees are suffering from water shortages or poor soil conditions.
example2_zh: 黄叶可能表明城市树木正受到缺水或土壤条件不佳的影响。
collocations: bright yellow｜明黄色 ; pale yellow｜淡黄色 ; turn yellow｜变黄
tip_zh: 可作动词表示变黄；不要用它描述人的种族。

meanings_zh: n. 文件；档案；文件夹 | v. 归档；提交 | n. 锉刀
definition_en: Stored information on a computer, or an organized collection of papers. | To store documents systematically or submit them to an authority. | A rough metal tool used to smooth or shape surfaces.
example1_en: I saved the file before switching off my laptop.
example1_zh: 我关掉笔记本电脑之前保存了文件。
example2_en: Public institutions should store confidential files securely to prevent unauthorized access and protect citizens' personal information.
example2_zh: 公共机构应安全存储机密文件，以防止未经授权的访问并保护公民的个人信息。
collocations: save a file｜保存文件 ; attach a file｜附加文件 ; file a complaint｜正式提出投诉 ; file documents｜将文件归档
tip_zh: file a complaint 指正式投诉，不是把投诉归档。

meanings_zh: adj. 富有的；富裕的 | adj. 富含的；丰富的 | adj. 油腻的；浓厚的
definition_en: Having a lot of money or valuable possessions. | Containing a large amount or variety of something valuable. | Containing plenty of fat, cream, sugar, or strong flavour.
example1_en: Their rich uncle owns a large house by the sea.
example1_zh: 他们富有的叔叔在海边拥有一栋大房子。
example2_en: Rich countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
example2_zh: 富裕国家可以通过投资贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。
collocations: rich countries｜富裕国家 ; rich in nutrients｜富含营养成分 ; rich cultural heritage｜丰富的文化遗产 ; rich food｜油腻的食物
tip_zh: “富含……”用 rich in，不用 rich of。

meanings_zh: v. 知道；懂得 | v. 认识；熟悉
definition_en: To have information or understanding about something | To be familiar with a person, place, or thing
example1_en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
example1_zh: 你知道怎么修这辆自行车吗？
example2_en: Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.
example2_zh: 消费者需要了解个人信息的收集方式，才能在网上作出知情选择。
collocations: know how to｜知道如何 ; know the answer｜知道答案 ; know someone well｜很了解某人 ; know for sure｜确切知道
tip_zh: 过去式knew，过去分词known；通常不用进行时。

meanings_zh: n. 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
definition_en: A child of your aunt or uncle
example1_en: My cousin taught me to ride a bicycle yesterday.
example1_zh: 我的表姐昨天教我骑自行车。
example2_en: Children who regularly spend time with their cousins may develop strong family bonds beyond their immediate household.
example2_zh: 经常与堂表兄弟姐妹相处的孩子，可能与小家庭之外的亲人建立深厚感情。
collocations: a first cousin｜堂亲或表亲 ; a distant cousin｜远房堂亲或表亲 ; a younger cousin｜年幼的堂表亲
tip_zh: 不区分堂表、性别或长幼；需要时另加说明。

meanings_zh: pron. 我们自己 | pron. 我们亲自
definition_en: used when we are both doing and receiving an action | used to emphasize that we do something, not others
example1_en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
example1_zh: 我们看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。
example2_en: By involving ourselves in community projects, we can develop practical skills and strengthen local relationships.
example2_zh: 通过参与社区项目，我们可以培养实用技能并增进邻里关系。
collocations: by ourselves｜独自；靠我们自己 ; enjoy ourselves｜玩得开心 ; pride ourselves on｜我们以……为傲 ; for ourselves｜为我们自己
tip_zh: by ourselves可指独自，也可指不靠别人。

meanings_zh: n. 十一月
definition_en: The eleventh month of the year.
example1_en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
example1_zh: 我们将在十一月搬进新公寓。
example2_en: The university plans to launch its new scholarship programme in November, allowing more international students to apply.
example2_zh: 该大学计划在十一月推出新的奖学金项目，让更多国际学生能够申请。
collocations: in November｜在十一月 ; early November｜十一月初 ; late November｜十一月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

meanings_zh: adj. 油炸的；油煎的
definition_en: cooked in hot oil or fat
example1_en: We had fried eggs and toast for breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们早餐吃了煎蛋和烤面包。
example2_en: Eating fried foods too frequently can increase calorie intake and make maintaining a healthy weight more difficult.
example2_zh: 过于频繁地吃油炸食品会增加热量摄入，使维持健康体重更加困难。
collocations: fried rice｜炒饭 ; fried eggs｜煎蛋 ; deep-fried food｜油炸食品
tip_zh: fried是fry的过去式和过去分词，也作形容词；不限于油炸。

meanings_zh: v. 主动提供；提议 | n. 提议；录用或录取通知 | v. 出价
definition_en: Say you are willing to give something or do something. | A proposal of help, an opportunity, or a place. | Say how much you are willing to pay.
example1_en: Our neighbour offered to carry the heavy bags upstairs.
example1_zh: 邻居主动提出帮我们把沉重的袋子搬上楼。
example2_en: Universities should offer practical training that helps students develop skills relevant to the workplace.
example2_zh: 大学应提供实践培训，帮助学生培养与职场相关的技能。
collocations: offer help｜主动提供帮助 ; offer someone a job｜给某人提供工作 ; accept an offer｜接受提议 ; make an offer｜出价；提出提议
tip_zh: 主动做某事用offer to do，不用offer doing。

meanings_zh: n. 店员；售货员
definition_en: a person who works in a shop helping customers
example1_en: The shop assistant helped me find the right size.
example1_zh: 店员帮我找到了合适的尺码。
example2_en: Ask the shop assistant how much this costs.
example2_zh: 问问店员这个多少钱。
tip_zh: shop assistant 是英式说法，指商店里的服务员。

meanings_zh: v. 是；在；成为
definition_en: to exist; used with names, ages, feelings
example1_en: I am twelve years old.
example1_zh: 我十二岁。
example2_en: They are my best friends.
example2_zh: 他们是我最好的朋友。
collocations: be quiet｜安静 ; be careful｜小心
tip_zh: be 的现在时形式是 am/is/are，过去时是 was/were。

meanings_zh: pron. 他们；她们；它们（宾格）
definition_en: the people or things already mentioned, as objects
example1_en: I called them yesterday evening.
example1_zh: 我昨晚给他们打了电话。
example2_en: Please give the books to them.
example2_zh: 请把书给他们。
tip_zh: them 是 they 的宾格，作宾语用。

meanings_zh: v. 居住；生活；活着 | adj. 现场直播的；现场的 | adj. 活的
definition_en: to have your home somewhere, lead a life, or remain alive | broadcast or performed as it happens, rather than recorded | alive rather than dead
example1_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。
example2_en: People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.
example2_zh: 住在公共交通设施附近的人日常出行往往较少依赖私家车。
collocations: live alone｜独自居住 ; live a healthy life｜过健康的生活 ; live music｜现场音乐 ; live broadcast｜现场直播
tip_zh: 动词读/lɪv/；形容词及表示现场直播的副词读/laɪv/。

meanings_zh: n. 种类；类型 | v. 分类；整理；排序 | v. 处理妥当；解决
definition_en: a group of things sharing similar characteristics | to arrange things in groups or a particular order | to deal successfully with a problem or practical matter
example1_en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
example1_zh: 你在家听哪种音乐？
example2_en: Households should sort their waste carefully so that recyclable materials can be processed more efficiently.
example2_zh: 家庭应仔细将垃圾分类，以便更高效地处理可回收材料。
collocations: all sorts of｜各种各样的 ; sort by size｜按大小分类 ; sort out a problem｜解决问题 ; sort of｜有点；算是
tip_zh: a sort of表示“一种”；sort of也可口语表示“有点”。

meanings_zh: n. 项目；工程；课题 | v. 预计；预测 | v. 投射；放映
definition_en: A planned piece of work with a particular purpose. | To estimate a future amount or situation using current information. | To send light or images onto a surface.
example1_en: Our garden project started with three pots of herbs.
example1_zh: 我们的园艺项目是从三盆香草开始的。
example2_en: Researchers project that demand for electricity will increase as more households switch to electric vehicles.
example2_zh: 研究人员预计，随着更多家庭改用电动汽车，电力需求将会增加。
collocations: a research project｜研究项目 ; carry out a project｜开展项目 ; be projected to rise｜预计会上升 ; project an image｜投射图像
tip_zh: 名词重音在前，动词重音在后；音标按此顺序列出。

meanings_zh: pron. 她（宾格） | det. 她的
definition_en: the female person or animal receiving an action | belonging to or connected with a female person or animal
example1_en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
example1_zh: 午饭后我给她打了电话，约好一起散步。
example2_en: When a student requests additional support, teachers should help her access appropriate learning resources.
example2_zh: 当一名女学生请求额外支持时，教师应帮助她获取合适的学习资源。
collocations: with her｜和她一起 ; for her｜为她 ; her own｜她自己的
tip_zh: her可作宾语或接名词表所属；hers独立使用。

meanings_zh: adj. 受欢迎的；流行的 | adj. 大众的；通俗的
definition_en: Liked or enjoyed by many people. | Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.
example1_en: This small café is popular with local students.
example1_zh: 这家小咖啡馆很受当地学生欢迎。
example2_en: Popular science books can encourage public interest in research by explaining discoveries in accessible language.
example2_zh: 通俗科普书籍通过用易懂的语言解释科学发现，可以激发公众对研究的兴趣。
collocations: popular with students｜受学生欢迎 ; increasingly popular｜越来越受欢迎 ; popular culture｜大众文化 ; popular science｜通俗科学
tip_zh: 表示受某群体欢迎，常用popular with或among。

meanings_zh: v. 修理；解决 | v. 固定；安装 | v. 确定；安排
definition_en: Make something work properly or solve a problem. | Attach something firmly in a particular place. | Decide an exact time, price, or arrangement.
example1_en: My neighbour helped me fix the broken kitchen tap.
example1_zh: 邻居帮我修好了厨房里坏掉的水龙头。
example2_en: Governments should fix weaknesses in existing transport networks before investing in expensive new infrastructure.
example2_zh: 政府应先解决现有交通网络的薄弱环节，再投资昂贵的新基础设施。
collocations: fix a problem｜解决问题 ; fix a date｜确定日期 ; fix something to a wall｜把某物固定在墙上 ; fix a leak｜修补漏处
tip_zh: fix既可修理物品，也可解决问题或确定日期。

meanings_zh: n. 迪斯科舞会；迪斯科音乐
definition_en: a place or party where people dance to pop music
example1_en: There is a school disco on Friday night.
example1_zh: 周五晚上有一场学校舞会。
example2_en: They danced at the disco until ten o'clock.
example2_zh: 他们在舞会上跳到十点。
tip_zh: disco 指跳流行音乐的舞会/舞厅；go to a disco 去跳舞。

meanings_zh: adj. 迅速的；敏捷的 | adj. 短暂的；用时少的
definition_en: moving or acting fast, without much delay | taking only a short time
example1_en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
example1_zh: 她反应敏捷，及时接住了差点掉落的玻璃杯。
example2_en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
example2_zh: 对水污染报告作出迅速回应，可以防止附近生态系统遭受严重破坏。
collocations: quick response｜迅速的回应 ; quick decision｜迅速的决定 ; quick look｜匆匆一看 ; quick to react｜反应敏捷
tip_zh: 正式表达中用副词quickly修饰动作。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾桶；储物箱 | v. 扔掉；丢弃
definition_en: A container used for rubbish or for storing things. | To throw something away, especially into a rubbish container.
example1_en: Please put the banana skin in the kitchen bin.
example1_zh: 请把香蕉皮放进厨房的垃圾桶。
example2_en: Providing a separate bin for food waste can help households recycle more effectively and reduce landfill use.
example2_zh: 提供单独的厨余垃圾桶有助于家庭更有效地回收废物，并减少垃圾填埋量。
collocations: rubbish bin｜垃圾桶 ; recycling bin｜回收桶 ; storage bin｜储物箱 ; empty the bin｜清空垃圾桶
tip_zh: “垃圾桶”英式常说bin，美式常说trash can。

meanings_zh: adj. 烤制的；炙烤的
definition_en: Cooked using strong direct heat, often on a metal rack.
example1_en: We shared grilled vegetables and warm bread for lunch.
example1_zh: 午餐我们一起吃了烤蔬菜和热面包。
example2_en: Offering grilled fish alongside plant-based dishes can help school cafeterias provide a wider range of nutritious meals.
example2_zh: 学校食堂同时供应烤鱼和植物性菜肴，有助于提供更多种类的营养餐。
collocations: grilled chicken｜烤鸡肉 ; grilled fish｜烤鱼 ; grilled vegetables｜烤蔬菜
tip_zh: grilled强调直接高温烤制；不表示“有格子的”。

meanings_zh: prep. 穿过；横过 | prep. 在……对面；遍及 | adv. 从一边到另一边；在对面
definition_en: From one side of something to the other. | On the opposite side of, or throughout, an area. | From one side to another, or on the opposite side.
example1_en: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
example1_zh: 下雨前，我们走过了那座桥。
example2_en: Improved internet access allows students across rural regions to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
example2_zh: 互联网接入条件的改善，让广大农村地区的学生能够利用更丰富的教育资源。
collocations: across the road｜在马路对面 ; across the country｜遍及全国 ; walk across a bridge｜走过桥
tip_zh: across强调横跨表面；through强调从内部穿过。

meanings_zh: n. 摄影；摄影术
definition_en: The activity or skill of taking photographs.
example1_en: My sister enjoys photography and carries her camera everywhere.
example1_zh: 我姐姐喜欢摄影，走到哪儿都带着相机。
example2_en: Digital photography allows researchers to document environmental changes and share visual evidence with a wider audience.
example2_zh: 数码摄影让研究人员能够记录环境变化，并向更广泛的受众分享影像证据。
collocations: digital photography｜数码摄影 ; wildlife photography｜野生动物摄影 ; portrait photography｜人像摄影 ; take up photography｜开始学习摄影
tip_zh: photography不可数；一张照片用a photograph。

meanings_zh: n. 八月
definition_en: the eighth month of the year
example1_en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
example1_zh: 我们通常八月去看望住在海边的祖父母。
example2_en: Tourist destinations often experience increased demand in August, putting pressure on local transport and accommodation.
example2_zh: 旅游目的地的需求往往在八月增加，给当地交通和住宿带来压力。
collocations: in August｜在八月 ; early August｜八月初 ; late August｜八月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

meanings_zh: n. 电子游戏
definition_en: a game played on a screen or computer
example1_en: He plays video games for an hour after school.
example1_zh: 他放学后玩一小时电子游戏。
example2_en: This video game is popular with children.
example2_zh: 这款电子游戏很受孩子们欢迎。
tip_zh: video game 是电子/视频游戏；play a video game 玩游戏。

meanings_zh: n. 邮件；邮政 | v. 邮寄；发布 | n. 职位；岗位
definition_en: Letters and parcels, or the system used to deliver them. | To send something by mail or share it publicly. | A job or position in an organisation.
example1_en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上寄来了一个包裹。
example2_en: Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.
example2_zh: 地方政府应定期在网上发布最新消息，让居民了解公共服务的变化。
collocations: by post｜通过邮寄 ; post a letter｜寄信 ; post online｜在网上发布 ; apply for a post｜申请职位
tip_zh: 邮寄义中，英式常用post，美式常用mail。

meanings_zh: n. 包；袋 | v. 把……装进袋子
definition_en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things. | To put something into a bag.
example1_en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
example1_zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。
example2_en: Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.
example2_zh: 向顾客收取塑料袋费用，可以鼓励购物者养成更环保的习惯。
collocations: a shopping bag｜购物袋 ; a reusable bag｜可重复使用的袋子 ; pack a bag｜收拾行李包
tip_zh: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

meanings_zh: n. 蝙蝠 | n. 球棒；球拍 | v. 用球棒击球
definition_en: A flying mammal usually active at night. | An object used to hit the ball in certain sports. | To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.
example1_en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
example1_zh: 黄昏时，一只蝙蝠从我们花园上方飞过。
example2_en: Protecting bat habitats can benefit agriculture because many species feed on insects that damage crops.
example2_zh: 保护蝙蝠栖息地能使农业受益，因为许多蝙蝠以危害农作物的昆虫为食。
collocations: a cricket bat｜板球拍 ; a baseball bat｜棒球棒 ; bat wings｜蝙蝠翅膀
tip_zh: 网球拍用racket，棒球棒和板球拍用bat。

meanings_zh: v. 合身；装得下；适合 | adj. 健康强健的 | adj. 适合的；合格的
definition_en: To be the right size, shape, or type for something. | Physically healthy and strong, especially through exercise. | Suitable or good enough for a particular purpose.
example1_en: These boots fit perfectly, even with my thick socks.
example1_zh: 即使穿着厚袜子，这双靴子也非常合脚。
example2_en: Public exercise facilities can help older adults stay fit while strengthening social connections within their communities.
example2_zh: 公共健身设施可以帮助老年人保持健康，同时加强他们与社区内其他人的联系。
collocations: keep fit｜保持健康 ; fit perfectly｜完全合身 ; fit for purpose｜符合用途 ; fit in with｜适应；与……协调
tip_zh: 衣物fit指尺寸合适；suit多指款式或颜色适合。

meanings_zh: adj. 正常的；通常的 | n. 常态；正常水平
definition_en: usual, expected, or typical in a particular situation | the usual state or level of something
example1_en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
example1_zh: 面试前感到紧张是正常的。
example2_en: Flexible working hours are becoming a normal feature of employment in many sectors of the economy.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间正成为许多经济领域中常见的用工安排。
collocations: normal life｜正常生活 ; return to normal｜恢复正常 ; perfectly normal｜完全正常 ; normal working hours｜正常工作时间
tip_zh: normal强调符合常态；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

meanings_zh: n. 排球运动；排球
definition_en: A game of hitting a ball over a high net.
example1_en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
example1_zh: 我们在沙滩上打排球，一直打到日落。
example2_en: Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
example2_zh: 排球等团队运动既能帮助学生培养沟通能力，也能鼓励他们定期锻炼。
collocations: play volleyball｜打排球 ; beach volleyball｜沙滩排球 ; volleyball court｜排球场 ; volleyball team｜排球队
tip_zh: 指运动时不可数，play volleyball中不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 网球运动
definition_en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets
example1_en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
example1_zh: 我们每逢周日都在公园打网球。
example2_en: Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
example2_zh: 提供价格实惠的网球课程，可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼并提高身体协调能力。
collocations: play tennis｜打网球 ; tennis court｜网球场 ; tennis racket｜网球拍 ; tennis match｜网球比赛
tip_zh: 说 play tennis，不加冠词；球拍用 racket。

meanings_zh: n. 感情；感受
definition_en: emotions such as happiness or sadness
example1_en: Don't hurt her feelings with those words.
example1_zh: 别说那些话伤她的感情。
example2_en: He has strong feelings about the environment.
example2_zh: 他对环境有很强烈的感受。
collocations: hurt someone's feelings｜伤某人的感情
tip_zh: feelings 常用复数表示“情感”；hurt one's feelings 是伤感情。

meanings_zh: n. 摄影师
definition_en: a person who takes photos as a job or hobby
example1_en: The photographer took our class photo.
example1_zh: 摄影师给我们拍了班级合影。
example2_en: She wants to be a nature photographer.
example2_zh: 她想成为一名自然摄影师。
tip_zh: photographer 是“摄影师”；photography 是“摄影（艺术）”。

meanings_zh: n. 自拍照
definition_en: A photograph you take of yourself, usually with a phone.
example1_en: We took a selfie beside the lake after our walk.
example1_zh: 散步后，我们在湖边拍了一张自拍照。
example2_en: Sharing a selfie online can express personal identity, but users should consider their privacy settings first.
example2_zh: 在网上分享自拍照可以展现个人身份，但用户应先考虑隐私设置。
collocations: take a selfie｜拍自拍照 ; post a selfie｜发布自拍照 ; selfie stick｜自拍杆
tip_zh: 拍自拍照用take a selfie，不用make a selfie。

meanings_zh: v. 经过；通过 | v. 传递；递给 | v. 通过考试；及格
definition_en: To move past something or through a place. | To give something to another person. | To achieve the required standard in an examination or test.
example1_en: We pass a small bakery on our way home.
example1_zh: 我们回家的路上会经过一家小面包店。
example2_en: Students must pass a practical assessment before they can begin working independently in the laboratory.
example2_zh: 学生必须通过实践考核，才能开始在实验室独立工作。
collocations: pass an exam｜通过考试 ; pass the ball｜传球 ; pass through｜穿过
tip_zh: pass是动词；past可作介词：walk past。

meanings_zh: n. 蜂蜜
definition_en: a sweet, sticky food made by bees
example1_en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
example1_zh: 她往茶里加了一勺蜂蜜，搅拌均匀。
example2_en: Local honey production can provide rural income while encouraging farmers to protect habitats for bees.
example2_zh: 本地蜂蜜生产能为农村带来收入，同时鼓励农民保护蜜蜂的栖息地。
collocations: a spoonful of honey｜一勺蜂蜜 ; a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜 ; honey production｜蜂蜜生产
tip_zh: 表示蜂蜜时不可数；一罐蜂蜜说a jar of honey。

meanings_zh: n. 滑雪板
definition_en: a board you stand on to slide down snow
example1_en: He rides his snowboard down the mountain.
example1_zh: 他踩着滑雪板从山上滑下来。
example2_en: My new snowboard is blue and white.
example2_zh: 我的新滑雪板是蓝白色的。
tip_zh: snowboard 是滑雪板；运动本身叫 snowboarding。

meanings_zh: n. 猫 | n. 猫科动物
definition_en: A small furry animal often kept as a pet. | An animal belonging to the same family as lions.
example1_en: Our cat sleeps in a sunny spot by the window.
example1_zh: 我们家的猫睡在窗边阳光照得到的地方。
example2_en: Keeping pet cats indoors can help protect native birds, particularly in areas with vulnerable wildlife populations.
example2_zh: 将宠物猫养在室内有助于保护本地鸟类，尤其是在野生动物种群脆弱的地区。
collocations: a pet cat｜宠物猫 ; a stray cat｜流浪猫 ; big cats｜大型猫科动物
tip_zh: big cats指狮、虎等大型猫科动物。

meanings_zh: n. 地方；地点 | v. 放置 | n. 座位；名额
definition_en: A particular area, position, or location. | To put something in a particular position. | A space available for someone to sit, study, or participate.
example1_en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
example1_zh: 这处阴凉的地方很适合野餐。
example2_en: Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.
example2_zh: 城市规划者应将公共设施设在住宅区附近，让所有人都能方便地获得基本服务。
collocations: a public place｜公共场所 ; place an order｜下订单 ; take place｜发生；举行 ; a university place｜大学录取名额
tip_zh: take place表示发生或举行，不用被动语态。

meanings_zh: n. 连衣裙 | v. 穿衣；给……穿衣 | n. 服装；衣着
definition_en: a one-piece garment with a top and a skirt | to put clothes on yourself or someone else | clothing of a particular type or worn for a particular occasion
example1_en: She wore a blue dress to her sister's party.
example1_zh: 她穿了一条蓝色连衣裙去参加姐姐的聚会。
example2_en: Some employers require formal dress, while others allow staff to wear casual clothing at work.
example2_zh: 有些雇主要求穿正装，而另一些则允许员工上班时穿便装。
collocations: a summer dress｜夏季连衣裙 ; get dressed｜穿好衣服 ; dress code｜着装规定 ; dress up｜盛装打扮
tip_zh: a dress指连衣裙；get dressed指穿好衣服。

meanings_zh: v. 探索；探访 | v. 探讨；研究
definition_en: Travel around a place to discover what it is like | Examine an idea or issue carefully to learn more
example1_en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
example1_zh: 我们花了一下午探访港口附近的狭窄街巷。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生在选择深造科目前探索不同的职业方向。
collocations: explore the area｜探访该地区 ; explore possibilities｜探索各种可能性 ; explore an issue｜探讨问题
tip_zh: 作及物动词时直接接地点或问题，不加about。

meanings_zh: n. 老鼠 | n. 鼠标
definition_en: A small rodent with a pointed nose and long thin tail. | A handheld device for moving a pointer on a computer screen.
example1_en: A tiny mouse slipped behind the cupboard before breakfast.
example1_zh: 早饭前，一只小老鼠溜到了橱柜后面。
example2_en: Using a mouse for long periods may cause wrist discomfort, so office workers should take regular breaks.
example2_zh: 长时间使用鼠标可能引起手腕不适，因此办公室职员应定时休息。
collocations: a field mouse｜田鼠 ; a wireless mouse｜无线鼠标 ; a mouse click｜鼠标单击
tip_zh: 老鼠的复数是mice；鼠标的复数可用mice或mouses。

meanings_zh: n. 计划；方案；课程 | n. 电视或广播节目 | v. 安排；设定运行方式
definition_en: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose | a show broadcast on television or radio | to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically
example1_en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
example1_zh: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。
example2_en: A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
example2_zh: 设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。
collocations: training programme｜培训项目 ; television programme｜电视节目 ; degree programme｜学位课程 ; launch a programme｜启动一项计划
tip_zh: 英式通常用programme，计算机程序用program；美式均用program。

meanings_zh: n. 汽车；轿车 | n. 火车车厢
definition_en: a road vehicle with wheels, usually carrying a few people | one of the separate sections of a train
example1_en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
example1_zh: 我们的汽车停在外面的树下。
example2_en: Reducing private car use could improve urban air quality and make streets safer for pedestrians.
example2_zh: 减少私家车使用可以改善城市空气质量，让街道对行人更安全。
collocations: by car｜乘汽车 ; electric car｜电动汽车 ; car park｜停车场 ; dining car｜餐车
tip_zh: by car不加冠词；in a car需要冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 短裤
definition_en: trousers with legs ending above or near the knees
example1_en: I packed shorts and sandals for our beach holiday.
example1_zh: 我为这次海滨度假打包了短裤和凉鞋。
example2_en: In hot weather, lightweight shorts can help people stay comfortable while taking part in outdoor exercise.
example2_zh: 天气炎热时，轻薄的短裤能帮助人们在户外锻炼时保持舒适。
collocations: a pair of shorts｜一条短裤 ; wear shorts｜穿短裤 ; denim shorts｜牛仔短裤 ; running shorts｜跑步短裤
tip_zh: shorts用复数；一条短裤说a pair of shorts。

meanings_zh: n. 手镯；手链
definition_en: A piece of jewellery worn around the wrist.
example1_en: She wears a silver bracelet that her grandmother gave her.
example1_zh: 她戴着祖母送给她的一条银手链。
example2_en: A handmade bracelet can reflect local artistic traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.
example2_zh: 手工手链既能体现当地艺术传统，又能为农村社区的手艺人带来收入。
collocations: silver bracelet｜银手镯；银手链 ; charm bracelet｜吊饰手链 ; wear a bracelet｜戴手镯
tip_zh: bracelet戴在手腕；anklet戴在脚踝。

meanings_zh: n. 早餐；早饭
definition_en: the meal you eat at the start of the day
example1_en: I usually have breakfast before taking the bus.
example1_zh: 我通常吃完早餐再去坐公交车。
example2_en: Schools that provide a healthy breakfast may help students concentrate better during morning lessons.
example2_zh: 提供健康早餐的学校可能有助于学生在上午的课堂上更加专注。
collocations: have breakfast｜吃早餐 ; skip breakfast｜不吃早餐 ; a balanced breakfast｜营养均衡的早餐
tip_zh: 泛指吃早餐用have breakfast，不加冠词。

meanings_zh: v. 拼写 | n. 一段时间 | n. 咒语；魔法
definition_en: To write or say the letters of a word in order. | A period during which a particular condition or activity continues. | Words or magic believed to have special powers.
example1_en: Could you spell your surname slowly for me, please?
example1_zh: 请你把姓氏慢慢拼给我听，好吗？
example2_en: A prolonged spell of dry weather can reduce crop yields and increase pressure on local water supplies.
example2_zh: 持续的干旱天气会降低农作物产量，并加大当地供水压力。
collocations: spell a word｜拼写单词 ; a dry spell｜一段干旱期 ; a spell of illness｜一段患病期 ; cast a spell｜施咒
tip_zh: 过去式及过去分词英式可用spelt或spelled。

meanings_zh: n. 木板；板 | n. 董事会；委员会 | v. 登上交通工具
definition_en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material. | A group responsible for managing an organisation or making decisions. | Get onto a ship, aircraft, train, or bus.
example1_en: She placed a wooden board across the muddy path.
example1_zh: 她在泥泞的小路上横放了一块木板。
example2_en: The board approved a plan to reduce factory emissions without cutting jobs or lowering wages.
example2_zh: 董事会批准了一项在不裁员、不降薪的前提下减少工厂排放的计划。
collocations: a wooden board｜一块木板 ; board of directors｜董事会 ; board a plane｜登机 ; on board｜在船、飞机等上
tip_zh: board作动词可直接接交通工具：board a train。

meanings_zh: v. 接住；抓住 | v. 赶上；搭乘 | v. 感染；患上
definition_en: to stop and hold something moving, or capture someone | to reach a bus, train, or plane in time | to become ill with an infectious disease
example1_en: Can you catch the ball with just one hand?
example1_zh: 你能只用一只手接住球吗？
example2_en: More frequent bus services would help commuters catch connecting trains without relying on private cars.
example2_zh: 增加公交班次将帮助通勤者赶上接续列车，而不必依赖私家车。
collocations: catch a ball｜接住球 ; catch a train｜赶上火车 ; catch a cold｜感冒 ; catch someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为caught；感冒用catch a cold。

meanings_zh: n. 演讲者；发言者 | n. 说某种语言的人 | n. 扬声器；音箱
definition_en: a person who gives a talk or addresses others | a person who speaks a particular language | a device that produces sound from electrical signals
example1_en: The speaker made everyone laugh with her opening story.
example1_zh: 演讲者开场讲的故事把大家都逗笑了。
example2_en: Inviting a guest speaker from the scientific community can help students understand how classroom knowledge applies to real problems.
example2_zh: 邀请科学界的嘉宾来演讲，可以帮助学生理解课堂知识如何应用于实际问题。
collocations: guest speaker｜特邀演讲者 ; native speaker｜母语使用者 ; fluent speaker｜说话流利的人 ; wireless speaker｜无线音箱
tip_zh: a native speaker of English指英语母语者。

meanings_zh: n. 太阳镜；墨镜
definition_en: glasses with dark lenses that protect eyes from bright sunlight
example1_en: I put on my sunglasses before leaving the house.
example1_zh: 出门前，我戴上了太阳镜。
example2_en: Wearing sunglasses with adequate ultraviolet protection can reduce the risk of eye damage during outdoor activities.
example2_zh: 在户外活动时，佩戴具有充分紫外线防护功能的太阳镜可以降低眼睛受损的风险。
collocations: a pair of sunglasses｜一副太阳镜 ; wear sunglasses｜戴太阳镜 ; put on sunglasses｜戴上太阳镜
tip_zh: 通常用复数；一副说a pair of sunglasses。

meanings_zh: v. 爱；热爱；非常喜欢 | n. 爱；爱情；热爱
definition_en: feel deep affection for someone or enjoy something very much | a strong feeling of affection or great enjoyment
example1_en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
example1_zh: 我很喜欢晚饭后沿着河边散步。
example2_en: Schools can develop children's love of reading by providing diverse books and regular library visits.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过提供多样化的图书和安排定期参观图书馆，培养孩子对阅读的热爱。
collocations: fall in love｜爱上 ; love of learning｜对学习的热爱 ; love doing something｜喜欢做某事
tip_zh: love doing和love to do均可表示喜欢做某事。

meanings_zh: v. 展示；给……看 | v. 表明；证明 | n. 演出；节目；展览
definition_en: To let someone see something or demonstrate how something works. | To provide information or evidence that something is true. | A performance, programme, or public display intended for an audience.
example1_en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
example1_zh: 请教我怎么折这只纸鸟。
example2_en: Recent studies show that access to green spaces can improve mental wellbeing in urban populations.
example2_zh: 近期研究表明，能够使用绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。
collocations: show someone how to｜教某人如何 ; show that｜表明 ; show an improvement｜显示出改善 ; a live show｜现场演出
tip_zh: 过去式showed，过去分词通常用shown。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上方 | prep. 超过；高于 | adv. 在上方；在上文
definition_en: In a higher position than something else. | Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard. | In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.
example1_en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
example1_zh: 厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。
example2_en: Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.
example2_zh: 高于当季平均水平的气温会增加用水需求，给城市供水带来压力。
collocations: above sea level｜高于海平面 ; above average｜高于平均水平 ; above all｜最重要的是 ; as mentioned above｜如上所述
tip_zh: above 表示位置更高，不一定正上方，也不表示接触。

meanings_zh: n. 初学者；新手
definition_en: someone who has just started learning or doing something
example1_en: This swimming class is perfect for a complete beginner.
example1_zh: 这堂游泳课非常适合完全没有基础的初学者。
example2_en: Courses designed for beginners should provide clear guidance and regular opportunities to practise new skills.
example2_zh: 为初学者设计的课程应提供清晰的指导，以及定期练习新技能的机会。
collocations: a complete beginner｜零基础初学者 ; suitable for beginners｜适合初学者 ; a beginner's guide｜入门指南
tip_zh: beginner是可数名词，单数前通常要有限定词。

meanings_zh: adj. 勇敢的 | v. 勇敢面对；冒着
definition_en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid. | To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.
example1_en: You were brave to speak in front of everyone.
example1_zh: 你敢在大家面前发言，真勇敢。
example2_en: It takes brave leadership to introduce necessary environmental reforms when powerful groups strongly oppose them.
example2_zh: 当强势群体激烈反对时，推行必要的环境改革需要勇敢的领导力。
collocations: a brave decision｜勇敢的决定 ; brave enough to｜有足够勇气做 ; brave the cold｜冒着严寒
tip_zh: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。

meanings_zh: n. 化妆品 | n. 组成；构成
definition_en: Products applied to the face to change or enhance appearance. | The parts or qualities that together form something.
example1_en: She keeps her make-up in a small blue bag.
example1_zh: 她把化妆品放在一个蓝色小包里。
example2_en: The social make-up of a neighbourhood can change significantly as new housing attracts different residents.
example2_zh: 随着新建住房吸引不同的居民，一个社区的社会构成可能显著改变。
collocations: wear make-up｜化着妆 ; apply make-up｜化妆 ; remove make-up｜卸妆 ; genetic make-up｜基因构成
tip_zh: 名词也写作makeup；动词短语make up不加连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐会；演唱会
definition_en: a live musical performance given before an audience
example1_en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。
example2_en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
example2_zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。
collocations: attend a concert｜出席音乐会 ; give a concert｜举办音乐会 ; concert hall｜音乐厅 ; live concert｜现场音乐会
tip_zh: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

meanings_zh: v. 冲浪 | v. 浏览互联网 | n. 拍岸浪花
definition_en: to ride ocean waves while standing or lying on a board | to browse websites, often without a specific purpose | waves and white foam breaking near the shore
example1_en: My cousin learned to surf during our beach holiday.
example1_zh: 我们在海滨度假时，我的表亲学会了冲浪。
example2_en: Students who surf the internet for research need skills to distinguish reliable sources from misleading information.
example2_zh: 上网查找研究资料的学生需要具备辨别可靠来源与误导性信息的能力。
collocations: learn to surf｜学习冲浪 ; surf the internet｜浏览互联网 ; surf the waves｜踏浪冲浪
tip_zh: surf the internet指上网浏览，不一定有明确搜索目标。

meanings_zh: v. 哭；流泪 | v. 喊叫；呼喊 | n. 叫声；喊声
definition_en: Produce tears because of sadness, pain, or strong emotion. | Call out loudly because of strong emotion or urgent need. | A loud sound expressing emotion or attracting attention.
example1_en: The baby began to cry when her toy fell.
example1_zh: 玩具掉了，宝宝就哭了起来。
example2_en: Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.
example2_zh: 幼儿与父母分开时可能会哭，因此学校应营造亲切友好的环境。
collocations: cry for help｜呼救 ; cry with joy｜喜极而泣 ; a loud cry｜一声大喊 ; have a good cry｜痛哭一场
tip_zh: 过去式cried；现在分词crying；表示喊叫常用cry out。

meanings_zh: v. 购买 | v. 相信；接受 | n. 买到的东西；合算的购买
definition_en: to obtain something by paying money for it | to believe an explanation or accept an idea | something bought, especially something offering good value
example1_en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
example1_zh: 我需要在吃早饭前买些面包。
example2_en: Consumers can reduce packaging waste when they buy fresh produce from local markets.
example2_zh: 消费者在当地市场购买新鲜农产品时，可以减少包装废弃物。
collocations: buy in bulk｜批量购买 ; buy second-hand｜购买二手物品 ; buy time｜争取时间 ; a good buy｜合算的购买
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为bought；不要写成buyed。

meanings_zh: adj. 短的；短暂的；矮的 | adj. 不足的；短缺的 | adv. 未达到；突然停止
definition_en: Having little length, height, or duration. | Not having as much of something as is needed. | Before reaching a target, or with a sudden stop.
example1_en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚晚饭前，我们散了一小会儿步。
example2_en: Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.
example2_zh: 短期培训课程能帮助失业成年人获得实用技能，而不必投入数年时间学习。
collocations: a short distance｜一小段距离 ; short of time｜时间不足 ; in the short term｜短期内 ; fall short of｜未达到
tip_zh: short of表示缺少；shortly通常意为“不久”。

meanings_zh: adj. 半价的 | adv. 以半价
definition_en: costing half the usual price | at half the usual price
example1_en: We bought half-price tickets for the afternoon boat trip.
example1_zh: 我们买了下午游船的半价票。
example2_en: Offering half-price public transport to students could improve access to education and reduce car use.
example2_zh: 向学生提供半价公共交通服务可以改善受教育机会，并减少汽车使用。
collocations: half-price tickets｜半价票 ; half-price sale｜半价促销 ; buy something half-price｜以半价购买某物
tip_zh: 名词前常写half-price；at half price不加连字符。

meanings_zh: pron.&adv. 什么
definition_en: used in questions about things
example1_en: What is your name?
example1_zh: 你叫什么名字？
example2_en: What do you want for breakfast?
example2_zh: 早餐你想吃什么？
tip_zh: what 用于提问事物；What's this? 这是什么？

meanings_zh: n. 句子 | n. 刑罚；判决 | v. 判刑；宣判
definition_en: a group of words expressing a complete statement, question, or command | a punishment officially given by a court | to officially give someone a punishment in court
example1_en: Our teacher asked us to write one sentence about autumn.
example1_zh: 老师让我们写一个关于秋天的句子。
example2_en: Learning to vary sentence length can help students express complex ideas more clearly in academic essays.
example2_zh: 学会变化句子长度，可以帮助学生在学术文章中更清晰地表达复杂观点。
collocations: complete sentence｜完整的句子 ; sentence structure｜句子结构 ; prison sentence｜监禁刑罚 ; sentence someone to｜判处某人……刑罚
tip_zh: 判某人某种刑罚用sentence sb to sth。

meanings_zh: v. 穿；戴 | v. 磨损；用旧 | n. 磨损；损耗
definition_en: to have clothes, jewellery, or accessories on your body | to damage or become damaged through repeated use | damage caused by regular use over time
example1_en: I always wear thick socks when the floor feels cold.
example1_zh: 地板凉的时候，我总会穿上厚袜子。
example2_en: Encouraging employees to wear protective equipment can significantly reduce the risk of injuries in industrial workplaces.
example2_zh: 鼓励员工穿戴防护装备，可以显著降低工业场所的工伤风险。
collocations: wear glasses｜戴眼镜 ; wear a uniform｜穿制服 ; wear out｜磨坏；用坏 ; wear and tear｜日常磨损
tip_zh: wear强调穿戴状态，put on强调动作；过去式wore。

meanings_zh: adj. 好看的；漂亮的
definition_en: pleasant to look at; attractive
example1_en: He is a good-looking young man.
example1_zh: 他是个好看的年轻人。
example2_en: The good-looking actress smiled at the camera.
example2_zh: 漂亮的女演员对着镜头微笑。
tip_zh: good-looking 用于形容人长相好看；比较级 more good-looking。

meanings_zh: n. 一天；一日 | n. 白天；白昼 | n. 时期；年代
definition_en: a period of twenty-four hours | the part of each day when there is natural light | a particular period in the past or present
example1_en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
example1_zh: 我们一整天都在海滩上堆沙堡。
example2_en: Shorter working days may improve employee wellbeing while allowing parents to spend more time with their children.
example2_zh: 缩短每日工作时间可能改善员工的身心状态，同时让家长有更多时间陪伴孩子。
collocations: every day｜每天 ; during the day｜在白天 ; a day off｜休息的一天 ; these days｜如今
tip_zh: every day意为每天；everyday是形容词，意为日常的。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭作业 | n. 事前准备工作
definition_en: Schoolwork that students are asked to complete outside lessons. | Research or preparation done before making a decision.
example1_en: I finished my homework before dinner and went outside.
example1_zh: 我在晚饭前做完了作业，然后出门了。
example2_en: Schools should limit homework so that children have enough time for exercise and family activities.
example2_zh: 学校应限制家庭作业量，让孩子有足够的时间锻炼和参加家庭活动。
collocations: do homework｜做家庭作业 ; hand in homework｜交作业 ; do your homework｜做好事前准备
tip_zh: 不可数名词；一项作业用a piece of homework。

meanings_zh: n. 人行横道；穿越处 | n. 横渡；渡程
definition_en: A designated place where people or vehicles cross. | A journey across water or another geographical barrier.
example1_en: We waited at the crossing until the cars stopped.
example1_zh: 我们在人行横道前等到车辆停下才过马路。
example2_en: Installing a pedestrian crossing near every school can help protect children and encourage more families to walk.
example2_zh: 在每所学校附近设置人行横道，有助于保护儿童并鼓励更多家庭步行。
collocations: pedestrian crossing｜人行横道 ; level crossing｜铁路平交道口 ; border crossing｜边境口岸 ; ferry crossing｜渡轮航程
tip_zh: 作名词可指过街地点，也可指乘船横渡的行程。

meanings_zh: v. 覆盖；遮盖 | v. 包括；涉及；足以支付 | n. 盖子；封面；保护套
definition_en: To put something over a surface or object. | To include something, deal with it, or pay its cost. | An outer layer that protects or encloses something.
example1_en: Cover the bread with a cloth while it cools.
example1_zh: 面包冷却时，用一块布盖住它。
example2_en: University scholarships should cover living expenses as well as tuition fees for students from low-income families.
example2_zh: 大学奖学金应为低收入家庭的学生支付生活费和学费。
collocations: cover something with｜用……盖住某物 ; cover the cost｜支付费用 ; cover a topic｜涉及某个话题 ; a book cover｜书籍封面
tip_zh: cover A with B表示用B盖住A；cover费用指足以支付。

meanings_zh: n. 棒球运动 | n. 棒球
definition_en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases | The small, hard ball used in this sport
example1_en: We played baseball in the park after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们在公园打棒球。
example2_en: Team sports such as baseball can help young people develop cooperation skills and maintain physical fitness.
example2_zh: 棒球等团队运动能帮助年轻人培养合作能力并保持身体健康。
collocations: play baseball｜打棒球 ; baseball bat｜棒球棒 ; baseball glove｜棒球手套 ; baseball field｜棒球场
tip_zh: 运动名称不可数；表示一个棒球时用a baseball。

meanings_zh: phr. 必须；不得不
definition_en: must; it is necessary to do something
example1_en: I have got to finish my homework before dinner.
example1_zh: 我必须在晚饭前完成作业。
example2_en: You have got to be careful on the road.
example2_zh: 你过马路必须小心。
tip_zh: have got to 与 have to 意思相同，都表示“必须”，口语常用。

meanings_zh: adj. 聪明的；机灵的 | adj. 巧妙的
definition_en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions. | Showing skill or an original way of solving a problem.
example1_en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
example1_zh: 那个聪明的孩子午饭前就解开了这道谜题。
example2_en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
example2_zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。
collocations: clever idea｜巧妙的主意 ; clever at｜擅长 ; clever solution｜巧妙的解决办法
tip_zh: 比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

meanings_zh: adj. 更好的；更合适的 | adv. 更好地 | adj. 身体好转的
definition_en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else. | In a more effective or satisfactory way. | Less ill than before.
example1_en: This backpack is better than my old one.
example1_zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。
example2_en: Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
example2_zh: 更好的公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，并改善发展中城市的就业可达性。
collocations: better than｜比……更好 ; feel better｜感觉好些 ; better understanding｜更深入的理解 ; much better｜好得多
tip_zh: 是good和well的比较级，不说more better。

meanings_zh: adv. 到处；处处
definition_en: in, at, or to all places
example1_en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们到处找，结果小猫就在沙发底下。
example2_en: Although digital services are expanding rapidly, reliable internet access is not yet available everywhere.
example2_zh: 尽管数字服务正在迅速扩展，可靠的互联网接入仍未覆盖所有地方。
collocations: look everywhere｜到处找 ; almost everywhere｜几乎到处 ; everywhere else｜其他所有地方
tip_zh: everywhere是副词，前面通常不加in或at。

meanings_zh: n. 护照 | n. 通往成功等的途径
definition_en: an official document identifying you when travelling between countries | something that makes success or an opportunity possible
example1_en: I checked my bag twice to find my passport.
example1_zh: 我翻了两遍包才找到护照。
example2_en: A university degree is often viewed as a passport to better employment, although practical experience also matters.
example2_zh: 大学学位常被视为获得更好工作的通行证，不过实践经验也很重要。
collocations: valid passport｜有效护照 ; renew a passport｜换发护照 ; passport control｜护照查验处 ; a passport to success｜成功的通行证
tip_zh: 比喻用法a passport to中，to后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 现金；现款 | v. 将支票兑现
definition_en: Money in the form of coins and banknotes | Exchange a cheque for money
example1_en: I keep some cash in my wallet for emergencies.
example1_zh: 我在钱包里放了一些现金，以备急用。
example2_en: Although digital payments are increasingly common, many small businesses still prefer customers to pay in cash.
example2_zh: 尽管电子支付日益普及，许多小商家仍然更希望顾客用现金付款。
collocations: pay in cash｜用现金付款 ; withdraw cash｜提取现金 ; cash a cheque｜兑现支票 ; cash flow｜现金流
tip_zh: cash作现金讲不可数；用现金付款是pay in cash。

meanings_zh: prep. 进入；到……里面 | prep. 变成 | prep. 对……很感兴趣
definition_en: towards and then inside something | used to show the result of a change | interested in or enthusiastic about something
example1_en: The kitten jumped into the basket beside my chair.
example1_zh: 小猫跳进了我椅子旁的篮子里。
example2_en: Converting unused offices into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
example2_zh: 将闲置办公室改造成经济适用住房，可帮助城市缓解住房短缺，而不必向周边乡村扩张。
collocations: walk into a room｜走进房间 ; turn into｜变成 ; be into music｜热衷音乐 ; look into a problem｜调查问题
tip_zh: into强调进入的过程；in通常表示在里面。

meanings_zh: n. 围巾；头巾
definition_en: Cloth worn around the neck or head.
example1_en: She wrapped a wool scarf around her neck.
example1_zh: 她在脖子上围了一条羊毛围巾。
example2_en: In colder regions, a locally woven scarf can reflect traditional craftsmanship while providing essential warmth.
example2_zh: 在较寒冷的地区，当地织造的围巾既能体现传统手艺，又能提供必要的保暖。
collocations: wear a scarf｜戴围巾 ; a wool scarf｜羊毛围巾 ; wrap a scarf around your neck｜在脖子上围围巾
tip_zh: 复数可用scarves或scarfs，前者更常见。

meanings_zh: n. 自行车 | v. 骑自行车
definition_en: a two-wheeled vehicle moved by pushing pedals | to travel by bicycle
example1_en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
example1_zh: 我把自行车锁在那家小面包店外面。
example2_en: Travelling by bicycle can reduce urban air pollution while providing residents with regular physical exercise.
example2_zh: 骑自行车出行既能减少城市空气污染，也能让居民经常锻炼身体。
collocations: ride a bicycle｜骑自行车 ; by bicycle｜骑自行车出行 ; bicycle lane｜自行车道 ; bicycle helmet｜自行车头盔
tip_zh: by bicycle不加冠词；ride a bicycle要加冠词。

meanings_zh: v. 拜访；参观；游览 | n. 拜访；参观；逗留
definition_en: To go to see a person or place. | An occasion when someone goes to see someone or somewhere.
example1_en: We visited our neighbours and shared some homemade soup.
example1_zh: 我们去拜访邻居，和他们分享了一些自制的汤。
example2_en: Students who visit science museums can connect classroom theories with practical examples from everyday life.
example2_zh: 参观科学博物馆的学生能够把课堂理论与日常生活中的实际例子联系起来。
collocations: visit relatives｜探望亲戚 ; pay a visit to｜拜访；参观 ; a guided visit｜有导游陪同的参观
tip_zh: 动词visit后直接接宾语；名词用a visit to。

meanings_zh: n. 冰箱；冷藏柜
definition_en: an appliance that keeps food and drinks cold
example1_en: Put the milk in the refrigerator before it spoils.
example1_zh: 把牛奶放进冰箱，免得变质。
example2_en: Replacing an old refrigerator with an efficient model can reduce household electricity consumption significantly.
example2_zh: 用节能型号替换旧冰箱，可以显著减少家庭用电量。
collocations: open the refrigerator｜打开冰箱 ; store food in the refrigerator｜把食物存放在冰箱里 ; refrigerator door｜冰箱门
tip_zh: 日常口语常用fridge；freezer专指冷冻柜或冷冻室。

meanings_zh: pron. 每个人；所有人
definition_en: Every person in a group, or all people.
example1_en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
example1_zh: 每个人都带了一道菜，在野餐时一起分享。
example2_en: Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应确保每个人都能获取可靠信息，不论收入或教育背景如何。
collocations: everyone else｜其他所有人 ; almost everyone｜几乎所有人 ; everyone involved｜所有相关人员
tip_zh: everyone接单数谓语；every one强调逐个。

meanings_zh: adj. 错误的；不合适的 | adj. 不道德的；不正当的 | adv. 错误地；出差错地
definition_en: Not correct, accurate, or suitable. | Not morally acceptable or fair. | In an incorrect way, or with an unsuccessful result.
example1_en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
example1_zh: 我坐错了公交车，结果到了机场附近。
example2_en: It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
example2_zh: 仅仅因为家庭付不起学费就剥夺儿童受教育的机会，是不正当的。
collocations: the wrong answer｜错误答案 ; go wrong｜出问题 ; get something wrong｜把某事弄错 ; something is wrong with｜……出了问题
tip_zh: go wrong表示出问题；wrong的词首w不发音。

meanings_zh: n. 帆船运动；帆船航行 | n. 船舶航班
definition_en: The activity of travelling in a boat powered by wind. | A scheduled journey or departure by a ship or ferry.
example1_en: We went sailing on the lake last weekend.
example1_zh: 上周末我们去湖上玩帆船了。
example2_en: Sailing clubs can encourage outdoor exercise while teaching young people teamwork and respect for marine environments.
example2_zh: 帆船俱乐部能鼓励户外锻炼，同时培养年轻人的团队合作精神和对海洋环境的尊重。
collocations: go sailing｜去玩帆船 ; a sailing club｜帆船俱乐部 ; a sailing boat｜帆船 ; regular sailings｜定期船舶航班
tip_zh: 运动义不可数；航班义可数，如daily sailings。

meanings_zh: n. 学习；学业；研究
definition_en: the act of learning, or work at school or university
example1_en: Her studies are going well this term.
example1_zh: 这学期她的学业进展顺利。
example2_en: He gave up his studies to work abroad.
example2_zh: 他放弃学业去国外工作。
tip_zh: studies 常用复数表示“学业/学习”；单数 study 是学习行为。

meanings_zh: n. 大自然；自然界 | n. 性质；本质 | n. 天性；性格
definition_en: The physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes. | The basic qualities that make something what it is. | The qualities that shape how a person usually behaves.
example1_en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
example1_zh: 露营让我们远离繁忙的街道，享受大自然。
example2_en: Understanding the nature of urban poverty is essential for developing policies that address its underlying causes.
example2_zh: 了解城市贫困的本质，对制定解决其根本原因的政策至关重要。
collocations: protect nature｜保护自然 ; the nature of｜……的本质 ; human nature｜人性 ; by nature｜天生地
tip_zh: 指大自然时通常不加the；某事的性质用the nature of。

meanings_zh: exclam. 下午好
definition_en: a polite greeting used in the afternoon
example1_en: Good afternoon, everyone. Welcome to our school.
example1_zh: 大家下午好，欢迎来到我们学校。
example2_en: 'Good afternoon,' said the shop assistant.
example2_zh: “下午好，”店员说。
tip_zh: good afternoon 用于下午的正式问候（12点后至傍晚）。

meanings_zh: n. 问题；困难 | n. 习题；待解答的问题
definition_en: a situation that causes difficulty and needs a solution | a question requiring thought or calculation to answer
example1_en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
example1_zh: 厨房的水龙头有问题：它一直滴水。
example2_en: Traffic congestion is a growing problem that requires investment in reliable public transport rather than additional roads.
example2_zh: 交通拥堵是日益严重的问题，需要投资建设可靠的公共交通，而不是增建道路。
collocations: solve a problem｜解决问题 ; a major problem｜重大问题 ; a maths problem｜数学题 ; a problem with｜……存在的问题
tip_zh: ……有问题用a problem with；问题的解决办法用to。

meanings_zh: n. 叔伯；舅舅；姑姨父
definition_en: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband
example1_en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
example1_zh: 我叔叔教过我怎样修自行车。
example2_en: An uncle or aunt can provide valuable emotional support when parents are busy with work commitments.
example2_zh: 父母忙于工作时，叔伯姑姨等亲属可以提供宝贵的情感支持。
collocations: maternal uncle｜舅舅 ; paternal uncle｜伯父或叔父 ; uncle and aunt｜叔伯姑姨等亲属
tip_zh: uncle不区分父母哪一方，也不区分长幼。

meanings_zh: n. 石油；原油 | n. 油；食用油；润滑油 | v. 给…加润滑油
definition_en: A thick underground liquid used to produce fuel and chemicals. | A slippery liquid used for cooking, lubrication or other purposes. | To apply oil so that something moves smoothly.
example1_en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
example1_zh: 卡车把原油从油井运往炼油厂。
example2_en: Reducing dependence on oil requires sustained investment in renewable energy and more efficient public transport.
example2_zh: 减少对石油的依赖，需要持续投资于可再生能源和更高效的公共交通。
collocations: crude oil｜原油 ; oil prices｜石油价格 ; cooking oil｜食用油 ; oil a hinge｜给铰链加润滑油
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示不同种类的油时可用oils。

meanings_zh: n. 豆；豆类植物
definition_en: An edible seed, or the plant that produces it.
example1_en: I added some beans to the vegetable soup.
example1_zh: 我在蔬菜汤里加了些豆子。
example2_en: Beans provide an affordable source of protein and can support a balanced plant-based diet.
example2_zh: 豆类是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，有助于形成均衡的植物性饮食。
collocations: green beans｜四季豆 ; kidney beans｜芸豆 ; coffee beans｜咖啡豆 ; baked beans｜茄汁焗豆
tip_zh: 可数名词；泛指食用豆类时通常用beans。

meanings_zh: v. 失败；未能做到 | v. 不及格；使不及格 | v. 失灵；衰退
definition_en: to be unsuccessful or not do something required | to not pass a test, or give an unsuccessful grade | to stop working properly or become weaker
example1_en: The cake failed to rise despite an extra egg.
example1_zh: 尽管多加了一个鸡蛋，蛋糕还是没发起来。
example2_en: Recycling programmes often fail when local authorities do not provide clear guidance or convenient collection services.
example2_zh: 地方政府若不提供清晰指导或便捷的收集服务，回收计划往往会失败。
collocations: fail to do something｜未能做某事 ; fail an exam｜考试不及格 ; fail to meet expectations｜未达到预期
tip_zh: fail to do表示未能做；fail an exam表示考试不及格。

meanings_zh: n. 数字影碟；DVD光盘
definition_en: a disc that stores films or data
example1_en: We watched a DVD at home last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚我们在家看了一张DVD。
example2_en: This DVD has a special bonus film on it.
example2_zh: 这张DVD里有一部特别附加电影。
tip_zh: DVD 是 digital versatile disc 的缩写，比 CD 容量更大。

meanings_zh: v. 说话；交谈 | v. 会说；使用某种语言 | v. 发言；演讲
definition_en: Use your voice to say words or communicate with someone. | Be able to communicate in a particular language. | Address an audience about a subject.
example1_en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
example1_zh: 下课后我能和你谈谈吗？
example2_en: Students who speak more than one language may find it easier to communicate across cultural boundaries.
example2_zh: 会说多种语言的学生可能更容易进行跨文化交流。
collocations: speak fluently｜流利地说 ; speak in public｜公开发言 ; speak to someone｜与某人交谈 ; speak up｜大声说；发表意见
tip_zh: 过去式spoke，过去分词spoken；语言前不用介词。

meanings_zh: n. 舞者；舞蹈演员
definition_en: someone who dances, especially as a job
example1_en: The dancer spun gracefully across the small stage.
example1_zh: 那位舞者在小舞台上优雅地旋转。
example2_en: Professional dancers require regular physical training and adequate rest to maintain performance quality and prevent injuries.
example2_zh: 专业舞蹈演员需要定期体能训练和充分休息，以保持表演水平并预防受伤。
collocations: professional dancer｜专业舞蹈演员 ; ballet dancer｜芭蕾舞演员 ; talented dancer｜有天赋的舞者
tip_zh: dancer不限定性别，也不一定指职业舞者。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可能的 | adj. 极难应付的
definition_en: unable to happen, exist, or be done | extremely difficult to deal with or satisfy
example1_en: It is impossible to fit this sofa through the doorway.
example1_zh: 这张沙发根本无法从门口搬进去。
example2_en: Without reliable public transport, it is almost impossible for some rural residents to access essential services.
example2_zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，一些农村居民几乎无法获得基本服务。
collocations: almost impossible｜几乎不可能 ; impossible task｜不可能完成的任务 ; make it impossible to｜使……无法做到
tip_zh: 常用it is impossible to do，表示不可能做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 行李
definition_en: bags and cases that hold your belongings when travelling
example1_en: Our luggage barely fitted into the small taxi.
example1_zh: 我们的行李勉强塞进了那辆小出租车。
example2_en: Providing secure luggage storage at railway stations can encourage tourists to explore nearby attractions on foot.
example2_zh: 在火车站提供安全的行李寄存服务，可以鼓励游客步行游览附近景点。
collocations: hand luggage｜手提行李 ; luggage storage｜行李寄存 ; a piece of luggage｜一件行李 ; luggage allowance｜行李限额
tip_zh: 不可数；一件行李用a piece of luggage。

meanings_zh: n. 牛排；肉排；鱼排
definition_en: A thick slice of meat, especially beef, or fish.
example1_en: She served the steak with potatoes and green beans.
example1_zh: 她端上牛排，配了土豆和四季豆。
example2_en: Replacing beef steak with plant proteins occasionally can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.
example2_zh: 偶尔用植物蛋白代替牛排，可以减少个人饮食对环境的影响。
collocations: grilled steak｜烤牛排 ; sirloin steak｜西冷牛排 ; tuna steak｜金枪鱼排 ; well-done steak｜全熟牛排
tip_zh: steak与stake同音；单说steak通常指牛排。

meanings_zh: adj. 整洁的；整齐的 | v. 整理；收拾
definition_en: Neatly arranged, with everything in its proper place. | To put things in order and make a place neat.
example1_en: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
example1_zh: 即使在最忙的几周里，她的书桌也保持整洁。
example2_en: Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.
example2_zh: 保持共用工作场所整洁，有助于员工迅速找到设备，并营造更舒适的环境。
collocations: keep tidy｜保持整洁 ; tidy up｜收拾整齐 ; neat and tidy｜干净整齐
tip_zh: tidy强调摆放整齐；clean强调没有污垢。

meanings_zh: n. 羊毛；毛线；毛料
definition_en: Sheep's soft hair, or yarn and cloth made from it.
example1_en: This wool scarf keeps my neck warm on windy mornings.
example1_zh: 这条羊毛围巾让我的脖子在刮风的早晨保持温暖。
example2_en: Wool provides natural insulation, making it a useful material for clothing designed for cold climates.
example2_zh: 羊毛具有天然保温性能，因此适合用来制作寒冷气候下穿着的衣物。
collocations: pure wool｜纯羊毛 ; a ball of wool｜一团毛线 ; wool blanket｜羊毛毯 ; wool production｜羊毛生产
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一团毛线说a ball of wool。

meanings_zh: v. 阅读；读懂 | v. 朗读 | v. 看懂；解读
definition_en: to look at written words and understand their meaning | to say written words aloud | to understand information shown by something
example1_en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
example1_zh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。
example2_en: Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.
example2_zh: 经常阅读的儿童通常能培养更强的语言能力，对世界也有更广泛的了解。
collocations: read aloud｜大声朗读 ; read a map｜看地图 ; read widely｜广泛阅读
tip_zh: 原形读/riːd/；过去式及过去分词读/red/。

meanings_zh: n. 零钱包；女式手提包 | n. 资金；财力 | v. 噘起；撮拢嘴唇
definition_en: a small money holder; in American English, a handbag | money available to a person, organisation, or government | to press your lips together into a small rounded shape
example1_en: She opened her purse and took out a coin.
example1_zh: 她打开零钱包，取出一枚硬币。
example2_en: Investment in preventive healthcare could reduce the long-term burden on the public purse.
example2_zh: 投资预防性医疗可以减轻公共财政的长期负担。
collocations: a leather purse｜皮质零钱包 ; the public purse｜公共财政 ; purse your lips｜噘起嘴唇
tip_zh: 英式purse多指零钱包，美式常指女式手提包。

meanings_zh: v. 注意到；察觉 | n. 通知；告示 | n. 提前通知
definition_en: to become aware of something through your senses | a written statement giving information or instructions | information given before something happens or ends
example1_en: Did you notice the tiny bird outside our window?
example1_zh: 你注意到窗外那只小鸟了吗？
example2_en: Residents often notice improvements in air quality when cities restrict traffic in central areas.
example2_zh: 城市限制中心区域的交通时，居民常会察觉空气质量有所改善。
collocations: notice a difference｜察觉差异 ; take notice of｜留意 ; give notice｜提前通知 ; at short notice｜在通知很仓促的情况下
tip_zh: notice sb do强调全过程；notice sb doing强调正在发生。

meanings_zh: adv. 很可能；大概
definition_en: Used when something is likely but not certain.
example1_en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
example1_zh: 我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。
example2_en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport will probably experience less traffic congestion over time.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市，交通拥堵很可能会逐渐减轻。
collocations: will probably｜很可能会 ; probably not｜大概不会 ; probably because｜很可能是因为
tip_zh: 通常置于实义动词前、be动词后或第一个助动词后。

meanings_zh: n. 电子邮件；电子邮件通信 | v. 给……发电子邮件
definition_en: An electronic message, or the system used to send it | Send someone a message using email
example1_en: Please email me the photos from our camping trip.
example1_zh: 请把我们露营旅行的照片通过电子邮件发给我。
example2_en: Although email enables rapid communication, excessive messages can distract employees and reduce productivity at work.
example2_zh: 虽然电子邮件可以实现快速沟通，但过多的邮件会分散员工注意力，降低工作效率。
collocations: send an email｜发送电子邮件 ; check your email｜查看电子邮件 ; an email address｜电子邮箱地址 ; by email｜通过电子邮件
tip_zh: 指一封邮件时可数；指通信方式时不可数，如by email。

meanings_zh: n. 警车
definition_en: a car used by the police
example1_en: A police car drove past with its lights flashing.
example1_zh: 一辆警车闪着灯开了过去。
example2_en: The police car stopped outside the bank.
example2_zh: 警车停在银行外面。
tip_zh: police car 是警车，配有警灯和警报器。

meanings_zh: n. 交通运输；交通工具 | v. 运输；运送
definition_en: Vehicles or systems used to move people and goods. | To move people or goods from one place to another.
example1_en: We rely on public transport to get around town.
example1_zh: 我们在城里出行靠公共交通。
example2_en: Better transport links between rural areas and cities can expand employment opportunities for local residents.
example2_zh: 改善乡村与城市之间的交通联系可以为当地居民增加就业机会。
collocations: public transport｜公共交通 ; transport links｜交通联系 ; transport goods｜运输货物 ; transport network｜交通网络
tip_zh: 上列为名词音标；动词重音后移，英/t/前为/n/。

meanings_zh: n. 测验；测试；检查 | v. 测验；检测；检验
definition_en: a procedure that checks knowledge, ability, condition, or performance | to check what someone knows or how something performs
example1_en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我明天在学校有拼写测验。
example2_en: Researchers must test new materials under different conditions before recommending their use in public buildings.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须在不同条件下测试新材料，才能建议将其用于公共建筑。
collocations: take a test｜参加测验 ; blood test｜血液检查 ; test a theory｜检验理论 ; test results｜测试结果
tip_zh: 参加测验用take a test；通过测验用pass a test。

meanings_zh: n. 夫人；太太（已婚女性称谓）
definition_en: title used before a married woman's surname
example1_en: Mrs Jones lives next door to us.
example1_zh: 琼斯太太住在我们隔壁。
example2_en: Hello, Mrs Green. How are you today?
example2_zh: 你好，格林太太，你今天好吗？
tip_zh: Mrs 用于已婚女性姓氏前；不确定婚否用 Ms。

meanings_zh: n. 七月
definition_en: The seventh month of the year, following June
example1_en: We usually visit our cousins for a week in July.
example1_zh: 我们通常在七月去表亲家住一周。
example2_en: In many northern countries, tourism peaks in July, creating seasonal jobs but increasing pressure on local services.
example2_zh: 在许多北方国家，旅游业在七月达到高峰，创造了季节性岗位，却也增加了当地公共服务的压力。
collocations: in July｜在七月 ; early July｜七月初 ; late July｜七月下旬 ; by the end of July｜到七月底之前
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；表示在七月用in July。

meanings_zh: v. 落下；使掉落；下降 | n. 滴；少量液体 | v. 停止；放弃
definition_en: to fall, let something fall, or become lower | a very small, rounded amount of liquid | to stop doing or considering something
example1_en: I dropped my keys while reaching for my phone.
example1_zh: 我伸手拿手机时，钥匙掉了。
example2_en: If public transport becomes more reliable, the number of people driving to work may drop significantly.
example2_zh: 如果公共交通变得更可靠，开车上班的人数可能会显著下降。
collocations: a drop in prices｜价格下降 ; a drop of water｜一滴水 ; drop a course｜退选一门课 ; drop sharply｜急剧下降
tip_zh: drop by表示下降了多少；drop to表示降至多少。

meanings_zh: adj. 感到无聊的
definition_en: feeling tired and unhappy because nothing is interesting
example1_en: I was bored during the long train journey.
example1_zh: 漫长的火车旅途中我感到很无聊。
example2_en: The children are bored because it's raining.
example2_zh: 因为下雨，孩子们觉得很无聊。
collocations: get bored｜感到无聊 ; be bored with｜对…厌烦
tip_zh: bored 形容人的感受（感到无聊）；boring 形容事物（令人无聊的）。

meanings_zh: num. 零 | n. 零度；零点
definition_en: The number representing no quantity. | The point marked as nothing on a measuring scale.
example1_en: The temperature fell below zero while we were sleeping.
example1_zh: 我们睡觉时，气温降到了零度以下。
example2_en: Achieving zero carbon emissions will require substantial investment in renewable energy, public transport, and more efficient buildings.
example2_zh: 实现零碳排放需要对可再生能源、公共交通和能效更高的建筑进行大量投资。
collocations: below zero｜零度以下 ; zero emissions｜零排放 ; zero tolerance｜零容忍 ; absolute zero｜绝对零度
tip_zh: 读电话号码时零也常读作oh；温度用zero。

meanings_zh: adv. 再一次；又
definition_en: One more time, or on another occasion.
example1_en: Could you say that again a little more slowly?
example1_zh: 你能再说一遍，稍微慢一点吗？
example2_en: If cities fail to address the causes of congestion, the same transport problems will occur again.
example2_zh: 如果城市不解决交通拥堵的成因，同样的交通问题就会再次出现。
collocations: try again｜再试一次 ; once again｜再一次 ; again and again｜一再；反复 ; never again｜再也不
tip_zh: again表示重复；again and again强调反复多次。

meanings_zh: v. 分享；共用；分担 | n. 一份；份额 | n. 股份
definition_en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others. | One part of something divided among people or groups. | One of the equal units of ownership in a company.
example1_en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
example1_zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。
example2_en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
example2_zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。
collocations: share something with someone｜与某人分享某物 ; share responsibility｜分担责任 ; market share｜市场份额 ; buy shares｜购买股份
tip_zh: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

meanings_zh: n. 有轨电车
definition_en: An electric passenger vehicle running on tracks along city streets.
example1_en: We caught the tram outside the library this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我们在图书馆外乘上了有轨电车。
example2_en: Investing in tram networks can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to busy city centres.
example2_zh: 投资建设有轨电车网络可以缓解交通拥堵，让人们更方便地前往繁忙的市中心。
collocations: catch a tram｜赶上有轨电车 ; tram stop｜有轨电车站 ; tram network｜有轨电车网络
tip_zh: 指车辆，不是轨道；美式英语常用streetcar。

meanings_zh: int. 你好；喂 | n. 问候；招呼
definition_en: used to greet someone or begin a phone conversation | a greeting spoken when meeting someone
example1_en: Hello, would you like to sit next to me?
example1_zh: 你好，你愿意坐在我旁边吗？
example2_en: A simple hello between neighbours can encourage social contact and help newcomers feel welcome in a community.
example2_zh: 邻里之间一句简单的问候就能促进交往，让新来者感受到社区的欢迎。
collocations: say hello｜打招呼 ; hello there｜你好呀 ; a friendly hello｜友好的问候
tip_zh: 电话开头的hello可译为“喂”；say hello to表示向某人问好。

meanings_zh: n. 信封
definition_en: A flat paper container used for sending a letter.
example1_en: She slipped the birthday card into a blue envelope.
example1_zh: 她把生日贺卡放进了一个蓝色信封。
example2_en: Although digital communication is widespread, official documents are still sometimes delivered in a sealed envelope for privacy.
example2_zh: 尽管数字通信十分普及，官方文件有时仍会装在密封信封里送达，以保护隐私。
collocations: a sealed envelope｜密封的信封 ; open an envelope｜拆信封 ; a padded envelope｜有衬垫的信封
tip_zh: envelope是“信封”；envelop是“包围”的动词。

meanings_zh: n. 条纹
definition_en: Long narrow bands differing in colour from the surrounding surface
example1_en: My favourite shirt has blue stripes across the front.
example1_zh: 我最喜欢的衬衫正面有蓝色条纹。
example2_en: Researchers investigate how zebra stripes may discourage biting insects, potentially revealing useful strategies for protecting livestock.
example2_zh: 研究人员探究斑马条纹如何阻止叮咬昆虫，这可能为保护牲畜提供有用策略。
collocations: vertical stripes｜竖条纹 ; horizontal stripes｜横条纹 ; narrow stripes｜细条纹 ; black and white stripes｜黑白条纹
tip_zh: stripes是stripe的复数；“条纹的”用striped。

meanings_zh: n. 人；人们 | n. 民族
definition_en: Human beings considered together or referred to in general. | A group sharing a culture, history, or national identity.
example1_en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。
example2_en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that people of all ages can travel independently.
example2_zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让各年龄段的人都能独立出行。
collocations: local people｜当地人 ; young people｜年轻人 ; indigenous peoples｜原住民族 ; people from all walks of life｜各行各业的人
tip_zh: 表示人们时用people；peoples指多个民族。

meanings_zh: v. 推迟；使耽搁 | n. 延误；耽搁的时间
definition_en: To make something happen later than expected or planned. | A period of waiting before something happens or continues.
example1_en: Heavy snow delayed our flight until the next morning.
example1_zh: 大雪使我们的航班延误到第二天早上。
example2_en: Delays in public transport can reduce productivity and discourage people from leaving their cars at home.
example2_zh: 公共交通的延误会降低生产效率，并使人们不愿放弃开车出行。
collocations: delay a decision｜推迟决定 ; a lengthy delay｜长时间延误 ; without delay｜立即；毫不耽搁 ; delay doing something｜推迟做某事
tip_zh: 动词后接动名词：delay doing，不用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 猴子
definition_en: A primate that usually has a tail and climbs trees.
example1_en: A little monkey swung between branches above our heads.
example1_zh: 一只小猴子在我们头顶的树枝间荡来荡去。
example2_en: Protecting tropical forests helps preserve monkey populations and the complex ecosystems on which they depend.
example2_zh: 保护热带森林有助于保护猴类种群及其赖以生存的复杂生态系统。
collocations: a troop of monkeys｜一群猴子 ; wild monkeys｜野生猴子 ; monkey around｜胡闹
tip_zh: monkey通常有尾巴；ape指猿类，通常无尾。

meanings_zh: n. 鹦鹉 | v. 机械地重复；鹦鹉学舌
definition_en: a tropical bird with a curved beak, sometimes copying speech | to repeat someone's words without understanding or considering them
example1_en: The green parrot cracked a seed with its beak.
example1_zh: 那只绿色鹦鹉用喙啄开了一粒种子。
example2_en: Students who merely parrot their teachers' explanations may struggle to apply knowledge to unfamiliar situations.
example2_zh: 只会机械重复教师讲解的学生，可能难以将知识应用于陌生情境。
collocations: pet parrot｜宠物鹦鹉 ; parrot someone's words｜机械重复某人的话 ; parrot fashion｜鹦鹉学舌般地
tip_zh: 作动词常带贬义，强调不加理解或思考地重复。

meanings_zh: v. 坐；坐下 | v. 位于；坐落于 | v. 参加考试
definition_en: to rest with your weight supported by your bottom | to be in a particular place or position | to take an examination
example1_en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
example1_zh: 过来坐在花园长椅上，坐我旁边。
example2_en: Students who sit for long periods should take regular breaks to support their physical health.
example2_zh: 长时间坐着的学生应定期休息，以维护身体健康。
collocations: sit down｜坐下 ; sit still｜坐着不动 ; sit an exam｜参加考试 ; sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sat；现在分词为sitting。

meanings_zh: n. 帆板运动
definition_en: A water sport using a board with an attached sail.
example1_en: My sister tried windsurfing during our holiday by the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边度假时，我姐姐尝试了帆板运动。
example2_en: Windsurfing schools can attract visitors to coastal towns, provided that local authorities establish clear water safety guidelines.
example2_zh: 只要地方政府制定明确的水上安全准则，帆板学校就能吸引游客前往沿海城镇。
collocations: go windsurfing｜去玩帆板 ; windsurfing equipment｜帆板运动装备 ; windsurfing lessons｜帆板课程
tip_zh: windsurfing借帆利用风力；surfing主要借海浪滑行。

meanings_zh: v. 穿过；横渡；交叉 | n. 十字形；十字架 | adj. 生气的；恼怒的
definition_en: to go from one side to another, or intersect | a shape made by two intersecting lines, or a religious symbol | annoyed or slightly angry
example1_en: We waited for the traffic to stop before crossing.
example1_zh: 我们等车辆停下后才过马路。
example2_en: Safer pedestrian routes encourage residents to cross busy roads on foot rather than drive short distances.
example2_zh: 更安全的步行路线鼓励居民步行穿过繁忙道路，而不是短途开车。
collocations: cross the road｜过马路 ; cross a bridge｜过桥 ; cross with someone｜生某人的气
tip_zh: cross是动词；across是介词或副词。

meanings_zh: n. 便帽；鸭舌帽 | n. 瓶盖；保护盖 | v. 限制上限
definition_en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part | a cover fitted over the end or opening of something | to set a maximum amount or level for something
example1_en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
example1_zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。
example2_en: Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.
example2_zh: 政府可以限制年度租金涨幅，以保护家庭免受住房成本骤增的影响。
collocations: baseball cap｜棒球帽 ; bottle cap｜瓶盖 ; cap spending｜限制支出 ; a cap on fees｜费用上限
tip_zh: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。

meanings_zh: n. 阶段；时期 | n. 舞台 | v. 上演；举办；组织
definition_en: A particular period or step in a process. | A raised area where performers appear before an audience. | To organise and present a performance or public event.
example1_en: The cake is cooling at this stage of preparation.
example1_zh: 制作进行到这个阶段，蛋糕正在冷却。
example2_en: Early intervention at a critical stage of childhood can significantly improve educational outcomes later in life.
example2_zh: 在童年的关键阶段及早干预，能显著改善日后的教育成果。
collocations: at an early stage｜在早期阶段 ; a stage of development｜发展阶段 ; on stage｜在舞台上 ; stage a play｜上演戏剧
tip_zh: 表示阶段常用at a stage；表示在舞台上用on stage。

meanings_zh: n. 座位 | v. 使就座；容纳……就座 | n. 议席；席位
definition_en: A place or object for someone to sit on. | To provide a sitting place or have room for seated people. | A position as a member of an elected body.
example1_en: She saved me a seat near the front.
example1_zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。
example2_en: Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.
example2_zh: 在公共交通工具上增加座位，会让老年乘客和家庭的日常出行更方便。
collocations: take a seat｜坐下 ; a window seat｜靠窗座位 ; reserve a seat｜预订座位 ; win a seat｜赢得议席
tip_zh: sit是不及物动词；seat常接人，be seated表就座。

meanings_zh: n. 同事；同僚
definition_en: Someone you work with, especially in a professional job.
example1_en: My colleague brought homemade soup to the office today.
example1_zh: 我的同事今天把自制的汤带到了办公室。
example2_en: Sharing knowledge with colleagues can improve workplace efficiency and help new employees develop essential skills.
example2_zh: 与同事分享知识可以提高工作效率，并帮助新员工培养必要技能。
collocations: work colleague｜工作同事 ; former colleague｜前同事 ; a close colleague｜关系密切的同事
tip_zh: colleague指同事，不一定是朋友或同级员工。

meanings_zh: n. 杯子；一杯的量 | n. 奖杯 | v. 使呈杯状；捧住
definition_en: A small drinking container, or the amount it holds. | A decorative container awarded for winning a competition. | To curve your hands into a hollow shape to hold something.
example1_en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
example1_zh: 我双手捧着一杯茶取暖。
example2_en: Encouraging customers to bring a reusable cup can help cafés reduce waste from disposable packaging.
example2_zh: 鼓励顾客自带可重复使用的杯子，可以帮助咖啡馆减少一次性包装垃圾。
collocations: a cup of tea｜一杯茶 ; a reusable cup｜可重复使用的杯子 ; win the cup｜赢得奖杯 ; cup your hands｜将双手拢成杯状
tip_zh: a cup of后接饮品；cup作动词可表示用手捧住。

meanings_zh: n. 电影 | v. 拍摄 | n. 薄膜；胶卷
definition_en: a story or events recorded as moving pictures | to record moving pictures using a camera | a thin layer, or material used to record photographs
example1_en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。
example2_en: Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.
example2_zh: 纪录片可以通过展示环境问题对当地社区的影响，提高公众的环保意识。
collocations: watch a film｜看电影 ; film industry｜电影业 ; a thin film of oil｜一层薄薄的油膜
tip_zh: 表示电影时，film偏英式，movie偏美式。

meanings_zh: n. 水平；程度；高度 | adj. 平坦的；同高的 | v. 使平坦；使相等
definition_en: A particular standard, amount, or height of something. | Flat and even, or at the same height. | To make a surface flat or things equal.
example1_en: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
example1_zh: 昨晚的大雨过后，水位上升了。
example2_en: Improving the level of public transport can encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 提高公共交通服务水平可以鼓励更多居民不开私家车出行。
collocations: sea level｜海平面 ; a high level of｜高水平的；大量的 ; level ground｜平坦的地面 ; level the playing field｜创造公平竞争环境
tip_zh: at表示所处水平；on the same level可指同一楼层。

meanings_zh: adv. 后来；之后
definition_en: At a later time, following an event.
example1_en: We watched a film and had dinner afterwards.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部电影，之后吃了晚饭。
example2_en: Students who discuss a lecture afterwards may remember its key ideas more clearly than those who do not.
example2_zh: 课后讨论讲座内容的学生，可能比不讨论的学生更清楚地记住其中的要点。
collocations: shortly afterwards｜不久之后 ; soon afterwards｜随后不久 ; immediately afterwards｜紧接着
tip_zh: 是副词，后面不直接接宾语；after可接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 星期一
definition_en: the day after Sunday and before Tuesday
example1_en: We usually buy fresh fruit at the market on Monday.
example1_zh: 我们通常在星期一去市场买新鲜水果。
