example2_en: Many employees find Monday mornings stressful because they must deal with tasks accumulated over the weekend.
example2_zh: 许多员工觉得星期一早上压力很大，因为他们必须处理周末积压的任务。
collocations: on Monday｜在星期一 ; Monday morning｜星期一早上 ; every Monday｜每周一 ; from Monday to Friday｜从星期一到星期五
tip_zh: 星期首字母大写；用on Monday，但next Monday前不加on。

meanings_zh: adj. 空的；无人的 | v. 倒空；清空 | adj. 空洞的；无诚意的
definition_en: Containing nothing or having no people inside. | To remove everything from a container or place. | Lacking real meaning, value, or sincere intention.
example1_en: The biscuit tin was empty when I opened it.
example1_zh: 我打开饼干盒时，里面已经空了。
example2_en: Converting empty office buildings into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
example2_zh: 将空置办公楼改造成可负担住房，可以帮助城市缓解住房短缺，而不必向周边乡村扩张。
collocations: empty room｜空房间 ; empty promises｜空头承诺 ; empty the bin｜倒空垃圾桶 ; on an empty stomach｜空腹
tip_zh: empty强调里面没有东西；vacant常指房屋或职位空缺。

meanings_zh: n. 药店；药房 | n. 药剂学
definition_en: A shop or hospital department that prepares and supplies medicines. | The study and practice of preparing and supplying medicines.
example1_en: I collected my medicine from the pharmacy after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我去药店取了药。
example2_en: A community pharmacy can improve access to healthcare by offering professional advice close to people's homes.
example2_zh: 社区药店能在居民家附近提供专业建议，使医疗保健服务更易获得。
collocations: community pharmacy｜社区药店 ; hospital pharmacy｜医院药房 ; study pharmacy｜学习药剂学
tip_zh: 药店可数，药剂学不可数；药剂师是pharmacist。

meanings_zh: adv. 其他；另外 | adv. 否则；要不然
definition_en: In addition to or different from someone or something mentioned | Used after or to introduce an alternative or consequence
example1_en: Would you like anything else with your soup?
example1_zh: 除了汤，你还想要点别的吗？
example2_en: Governments must improve public transport, or else growing traffic congestion may undermine the economic benefits of urban development.
example2_zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则日益严重的交通拥堵可能削弱城市发展带来的经济效益。
collocations: someone else｜其他人 ; anything else｜其他东西 ; what else｜还有什么 ; or else｜否则
tip_zh: 放在不定代词或疑问词后，如someone else。

meanings_zh: phr. 顺便说一下；对了
definition_en: used to add something new to a conversation
example1_en: By the way, do you know the homework for today?
example1_zh: 顺便问一下，你知道今天的作业吗？
example2_en: Oh, by the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
example2_zh: 哦对了，我昨天看到你哥哥了。
tip_zh: by the way 常用于口语，在交谈中引出新话题，可缩写为 BTW。

meanings_zh: v. 挣得；赚取 | v. 赢得；博得
definition_en: To receive money in return for work. | To gain something deserved through your actions or qualities.
example1_en: She earns extra money by walking dogs after school.
example1_zh: 她放学后帮人遛狗，赚些零花钱。
example2_en: Companies can earn public trust by reporting their environmental impact honestly and taking responsibility for their mistakes.
example2_zh: 企业可以通过如实报告环境影响并为自身错误负责来赢得公众信任。
collocations: earn a living｜谋生 ; earn money｜挣钱 ; earn respect｜赢得尊重 ; earn a reputation｜赢得声誉
tip_zh: earn强调劳动或表现所得；win多指比赛获胜。

meanings_zh: n. 冒险；奇遇 | n. 冒险精神
definition_en: An exciting experience involving uncertainty or possible danger | Willingness to explore unfamiliar or exciting situations
example1_en: Our camping trip turned into an adventure after dark.
example1_zh: 天黑后，我们的露营之旅变成了一次冒险。
example2_en: Outdoor adventure activities can help young people develop confidence and learn to cooperate with others.
example2_zh: 户外探险活动能帮助年轻人建立自信，并学会与他人合作。
collocations: go on an adventure｜去探险 ; a sense of adventure｜冒险精神 ; adventure tourism｜探险旅游
tip_zh: adventure指具体经历时可数，指冒险精神时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 腰带；皮带 | n. 带状区域；地带 | n. 传动带；输送带
definition_en: a strip worn around the waist to hold clothes | a long area with a particular feature | a continuous strip that moves machinery or carries objects
example1_en: This belt keeps my trousers from slipping down.
example1_zh: 这条腰带能防止我的裤子往下滑。
example2_en: A green belt around a city can limit urban expansion and protect nearby farmland from development.
example2_zh: 城市周边的绿化带可以限制城市扩张，保护附近农田免遭开发。
collocations: leather belt｜皮腰带 ; fasten a belt｜系好腰带 ; green belt｜城市周边绿化带 ; conveyor belt｜传送带
tip_zh: belt除腰带外也指带状区域，如green belt。

meanings_zh: phr v. 填写；填上
definition_en: to write information in a form
example1_en: Please fill in this form with your name.
example1_zh: 请在这张表格上填上你的名字。
example2_en: She filled in the answers in pen.
example2_zh: 她用钢笔填写了答案。
collocations: fill in a form｜填表
tip_zh: fill in 用于“填表”；fill out 也是美式常见说法。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……里面；在……中 | prep. 在……期间；在……之后 | adv. 在里面；进入；在家
definition_en: Inside a place, container, or larger area. | During a period or after a stated amount of time. | Inside a place, moving inside, or at home.
example1_en: Your keys are in the bowl beside the door.
example1_zh: 你的钥匙在门边的碗里。
example2_en: Investment in public libraries can help reduce educational inequality and strengthen connections within local communities.
example2_zh: 对公共图书馆的投资有助于减少教育不平等，并加强当地社区内部的联系。
collocations: in advance｜提前 ; in the morning｜在早上 ; in public｜公开地；在公共场合 ; in time｜及时
tip_zh: in two days常指两天后；月份、年份前也用in。

meanings_zh: n. 顶部；顶端 | adj. 最高的；最好的 | v. 位居……之首；超过
definition_en: the highest part or surface of something | highest in position, rank, or quality | to rank highest or be greater than something
example1_en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
example1_zh: 她把那颗星星放在树顶上。
example2_en: Improving access to affordable housing should be a top priority for governments facing rapid urban population growth.
example2_zh: 对于面临城市人口快速增长的政府来说，改善居民获得可负担住房的机会应是首要任务。
collocations: at the top of｜在……顶端 ; top priority｜首要任务 ; top marks｜最高分 ; top the list｜位居榜首
tip_zh: on top of指在上面；at the top of指在顶端。

meanings_zh: n. 文具盒；铅笔盒
definition_en: a small box or bag for pens and pencils
example1_en: My pencil case has two pens and three pencils.
example1_zh: 我的文具盒里有两支钢笔和三支铅笔。
example2_en: Don't forget your pencil case for the exam.
example2_zh: 考试别忘了带文具盒。
tip_zh: pencil case 是装笔的文具盒/袋。

meanings_zh: adj. 相似的；类似的
definition_en: Almost the same, but not exactly alike.
example1_en: Your jacket looks similar to mine, but slightly darker.
example1_zh: 你的夹克看起来和我的相似，不过颜色稍深一点。
example2_en: Cities with similar population sizes may require different transport policies because of their geographical features.
example2_zh: 人口规模相近的城市可能因地理特征不同而需要不同的交通政策。
collocations: similar to｜与……相似 ; similar characteristics｜相似的特征 ; broadly similar｜大致相似
tip_zh: 用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。

meanings_zh: adj. 整个的；完整的 | n. 整体；全部
definition_en: Complete, with no part missing or left out. | A complete thing made up of connected parts.
example1_en: We spent the whole afternoon baking bread together.
example1_zh: 我们整个下午都在一起烤面包。
example2_en: Transport policies should consider the needs of the whole community rather than focusing only on car owners.
example2_zh: 交通政策应考虑整个社区的需求，而不应只关注汽车拥有者。
collocations: the whole day｜一整天 ; as a whole｜作为整体 ; on the whole｜总的来说 ; a whole range of｜各种各样的
tip_zh: 注意语序：the whole day＝all the day。

meanings_zh: adj. 紫色的 | n. 紫色
definition_en: Having a colour made by mixing red and blue | A colour between red and blue
example1_en: He wore a purple scarf with his grey coat.
example1_zh: 他穿着灰色外套，围了一条紫色围巾。
example2_en: Garden designers often combine purple flowers with yellow varieties to create a striking visual contrast.
example2_zh: 花园设计师常将紫色花卉与黄色品种搭配，形成鲜明的视觉反差。
collocations: dark purple｜深紫色 ; pale purple｜浅紫色 ; purple flowers｜紫色花朵
tip_zh: purple可作形容词或名词；purplish表示“略带紫色的”。

meanings_zh: n. 瓶子；一瓶的量 | v. 把……装瓶
definition_en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds. | To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.
example1_en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
example1_zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。
example2_en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
example2_zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。
collocations: a bottle of water｜一瓶水 ; reusable bottle｜可重复使用的瓶子 ; bottle cap｜瓶盖 ; bottled water｜瓶装水
tip_zh: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。

meanings_zh: n. 辣椒 | n. 辣味肉末豆子炖菜
definition_en: a small pepper with a strong, hot taste | a spicy dish usually made with meat, beans, and tomatoes
example1_en: Add one chopped chilli if you like spicy food.
example1_zh: 如果你喜欢吃辣，就加一根切碎的辣椒。
example2_en: Farmers growing chilli peppers may need reliable irrigation systems as rising temperatures increase water demand.
example2_zh: 随着气温上升导致需水量增加，辣椒种植户可能需要可靠的灌溉系统。
collocations: fresh chilli｜新鲜辣椒 ; chilli powder｜辣椒粉 ; chilli sauce｜辣椒酱
tip_zh: 英式拼写chilli，美式通常写chili。

meanings_zh: n. 文件夹；纸夹 | n. 电脑文件夹
definition_en: A folded cover used to hold loose papers. | A place on a computer where files are grouped together.
example1_en: Keep your receipts in this folder beside the desk.
example1_zh: 把收据放在桌子旁的这个文件夹里。
example2_en: Organising digital resources into clearly named folders can help students locate information efficiently during research projects.
example2_zh: 将数字资源整理到命名清晰的文件夹中，可以帮助学生在研究项目中高效查找信息。
collocations: create a folder｜创建文件夹 ; a shared folder｜共享文件夹 ; save files in a folder｜将文件存入文件夹
tip_zh: file是文件；folder是存放文件的文件夹。

meanings_zh: n. 六月
definition_en: The sixth month of the year, between May and July.
example1_en: My sister is getting married in June this year.
example1_zh: 我姐姐今年六月要结婚了。
example2_en: The community centre will open in June, providing local residents with affordable exercise classes.
example2_zh: 社区中心将于六月开放，为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身课程。
collocations: in June｜在六月 ; early June｜六月上旬 ; by the end of June｜到六月底为止
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；在六月用in June。

meanings_zh: v. 偷窃；盗用 | v. 偷偷移动 | n. 极便宜的东西
definition_en: to take something without permission and keep or use it | to move quietly without attracting attention | something bought for much less than its usual price
example1_en: Someone stole my bicycle while I was buying bread.
example1_zh: 我买面包的时候，有人偷走了我的自行车。
example2_en: Companies must protect customer information because criminals may steal personal data from insecure websites.
example2_zh: 企业必须保护客户信息，因为犯罪分子可能从不安全的网站窃取个人数据。
collocations: steal from someone｜偷某人的东西 ; steal an idea｜盗用创意 ; steal the show｜抢尽风头
tip_zh: 过去式stole，过去分词stolen；宾语通常是物。

meanings_zh: n. 网页
definition_en: a page of information on the internet
example1_en: This web page has pictures of animals.
example1_zh: 这个网页有动物的图片。
example2_en: She found the information on a school web page.
example2_zh: 她在一个学校网页上找到了信息。
tip_zh: web page 是网页；website 是网站（由多个网页组成）。

meanings_zh: adj. 现代的；近代的 | adj. 新式的；时髦的
definition_en: Relating to the present or relatively recent times. | Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.
example1_en: Our flat has a modern kitchen with large windows.
example1_zh: 我们的公寓有一间新式厨房，窗户很大。
example2_en: Modern technology allows students in remote areas to access educational resources previously available only in cities.
example2_zh: 现代技术让偏远地区的学生能够获取过去只有城市才有的教育资源。
collocations: modern society｜现代社会 ; modern technology｜现代技术 ; modern architecture｜现代建筑
tip_zh: modern强调现代或新式；不一定表示刚刚制造。

meanings_zh: v. 转动；转向 | v. 变得；变成 | n. 轮到的机会；轮次
definition_en: Move around a centre or change direction. | Change to a different state, colour, or condition. | An opportunity to do something in an agreed order.
example1_en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
example1_zh: 轻轻转动把手，然后朝自己这边拉门。
example2_en: As populations age, governments must turn their attention to accessible housing and community healthcare.
example2_zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府必须将注意力转向无障碍住房和社区医疗。
collocations: turn left｜向左转 ; turn red｜变红 ; take turns｜轮流 ; turn into｜变成
tip_zh: 表示变得时，turn后接形容词；turn into后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 块；片；件 | n. 文章；艺术作品 | v. 拼合；拼凑
definition_en: a part of something or a single item | a work of writing, music, or art | to join separate parts to make something complete
example1_en: She saved the last piece of cake for her brother.
example1_zh: 她把最后一块蛋糕留给了弟弟。
example2_en: Each piece of evidence should be carefully assessed before researchers draw conclusions about environmental change.
example2_zh: 研究人员在对环境变化作出结论前，应仔细评估每一项证据。
collocations: a piece of advice｜一条建议 ; a piece of equipment｜一件设备 ; a piece of music｜一首乐曲 ; piece together｜拼凑；拼合
tip_zh: a piece of可量化advice等不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 意见；看法
definition_en: a belief or judgement about someone or something
example1_en: What is your opinion of our new kitchen?
example1_zh: 你觉得我们的新厨房怎么样？
example2_en: In my opinion, public transport should be affordable enough to encourage people to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 在我看来，公共交通的价格应足够实惠，从而鼓励人们不开私家车出门。
collocations: in my opinion｜在我看来 ; public opinion｜公众舆论 ; express an opinion｜表达意见 ; a difference of opinion｜意见分歧
tip_zh: 表达“在我看来”用in my opinion，不用according to me。

meanings_zh: adj. 粉红色的 | n. 粉红色
definition_en: having a pale red colour | a colour made by mixing red with white
example1_en: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
example1_zh: 我们窗外的树开着粉红色的花。
example2_en: Designers often use soft colours such as pink to create a welcoming atmosphere in children's healthcare facilities.
example2_zh: 设计师常用粉红色等柔和色彩，为儿童医疗机构营造温馨的氛围。
collocations: pale pink｜浅粉色 ; bright pink｜亮粉色 ; turn pink｜变成粉红色
tip_zh: pink既可作形容词，也可作名词表示粉红色。

meanings_zh: n. 课；一节课 | n. 教训；经验
definition_en: A period of teaching or learning a particular subject. | Something useful learned from an experience, especially a mistake.
example1_en: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
example1_zh: 我们的游泳课在周四放学后开始。
example2_en: A key lesson from previous environmental policies is that effective regulation requires consistent monitoring and public support.
example2_zh: 以往环境政策带来的一条重要经验是，有效监管需要持续监测和公众支持。
collocations: take lessons｜上课学习 ; piano lesson｜钢琴课 ; learn a lesson｜吸取教训 ; a valuable lesson｜宝贵的经验
tip_zh: learn a lesson常指吸取教训，不只是学习课程。

meanings_zh: n. 成套工具；装备 | n. 组装套件
definition_en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity | A set of parts used to build something
example1_en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
example1_zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。
example2_en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
example2_zh: 学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。
collocations: first aid kit｜急救包 ; tool kit｜成套工具 ; repair kit｜修理工具包 ; kit someone out｜给某人配齐装备
tip_zh: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

meanings_zh: pron. 他的
definition_en: belonging to a male person
example1_en: This is his bicycle.
example1_zh: 这是他的自行车。
example2_en: He left his jacket at school.
example2_zh: 他把夹克落在学校了。
tip_zh: his 既是形容词性物主代词（his bike），也是名词性物主代词（it's his）。

meanings_zh: n. 花园；菜园 | v. 从事园艺
definition_en: an area of land where flowers or vegetables are grown | to grow and care for plants in a garden
example1_en: We picked fresh beans from the garden before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们从菜园里摘了新鲜的豆角。
example2_en: Community gardens can strengthen neighbourhood relationships while giving urban residents access to fresh vegetables and green space.
example2_zh: 社区花园既能加强邻里关系，又能让城市居民获得新鲜蔬菜和绿色空间。
collocations: vegetable garden｜菜园 ; community garden｜社区花园 ; botanical garden｜植物园 ; garden tools｜园艺工具
tip_zh: 英式garden可指住宅庭院；美式常用yard。

meanings_zh: pron. 我（宾格）
definition_en: the person speaking, when someone does something to them
example1_en: Can you help me with my bag?
example1_zh: 你能帮我拿一下包吗？
example2_en: The teacher gave me a book.
example2_zh: 老师给了我一本书。
tip_zh: me 是 I 的宾格，作动词/介词的宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 地理学 | n. 地理特征；地形
definition_en: the study of Earth's places, environments, and human activity | the physical features and arrangement of a particular area
example1_en: In geography today, we learned how rivers shape valleys.
example1_zh: 今天的地理课上，我们学习了河流如何塑造河谷。
example2_en: The geography of coastal regions influences settlement patterns and determines how communities respond to rising sea levels.
example2_zh: 沿海地区的地理特征影响聚居格局，并决定当地社区如何应对海平面上升。
collocations: physical geography｜自然地理学 ; human geography｜人文地理学 ; study geography｜学习地理
tip_zh: geography是地理学；geology是地质学。

meanings_zh: adj. 高兴的；满意的
definition_en: feeling happy or satisfied about something
example1_en: I'm really pleased with how the cake turned out.
example1_zh: 我对这个蛋糕做出来的效果非常满意。
example2_en: Residents were pleased that the council had created more green spaces for children to play safely.
example2_zh: 居民们很高兴，市政部门增设了更多绿地，让孩子们可以安全地玩耍。
collocations: pleased with｜对……满意 ; pleased to hear｜听到……很高兴 ; pleased to meet you｜很高兴认识你
tip_zh: 对结果满意用pleased with；听到喜讯用pleased to hear。

meanings_zh: n. 盐；食盐 | v. 给……加盐；用盐腌
definition_en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food | to add salt to food or preserve it with salt
example1_en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
example1_zh: 趁汤还没凉，请把盐递过来。
example2_en: Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.
example2_zh: 减少盐的摄入量是降低高血压风险的有效方法。
collocations: a pinch of salt｜一小撮盐 ; salt intake｜盐摄入量 ; sea salt｜海盐 ; add salt｜加盐
tip_zh: 食盐通常不可数；“一小撮盐”用a pinch of salt。

meanings_zh: det. 几个；数个 | pron. 几个；数个
definition_en: More than two but not many | A few people or things already mentioned or understood
example1_en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
example1_zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。
example2_en: Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
example2_zh: 几项研究表明，能够接触绿地可能改善城市居民的心理健康。
collocations: several times｜几次 ; several years｜数年 ; several of them｜他们中的几个 ; for several reasons｜出于几个原因
tip_zh: 后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

meanings_zh: prep. 直到……为止 | conj. 直到……时
definition_en: Up to a particular time or event. | Up to the time when something happens.
example1_en: We waited outside until the rain finally stopped.
example1_zh: 我们在外面一直等到雨终于停了。
example2_en: Governments should continue supporting renewable energy until cleaner technologies become affordable for the majority of households.
example2_zh: 政府应持续支持可再生能源，直到大多数家庭都能负担得起更清洁的技术。
collocations: until recently｜直到最近 ; until further notice｜直至另行通知 ; not until｜直到……才
tip_zh: until强调持续到某时；by强调不迟于某时。

meanings_zh: det. 每个；各个 | pron. 每一个；各自 | adv. 每人；每个
definition_en: Every individual member of a group, considered separately. | Every person or thing in a group, taken separately. | For every individual person or thing.
example1_en: Each child carried a small basket into the garden.
example1_zh: 每个孩子都提着一个小篮子走进花园。
example2_en: Each household can reduce its environmental impact by conserving water and choosing products with less packaging.
example2_zh: 每个家庭都可以通过节约用水和选择包装较少的产品来减少对环境的影响。
collocations: each student｜每个学生 ; each of us｜我们每个人 ; each time｜每次 ; each other｜彼此
tip_zh: each后接单数名词；each of后接复数名词或代词。

meanings_zh: n. 顾客；客户
definition_en: A person or organisation that buys goods or services.
example1_en: The customer asked for a larger pair of shoes.
example1_zh: 这位顾客想要一双大一点的鞋。
example2_en: Businesses can build customer loyalty by providing reliable products and responding quickly to complaints.
example2_zh: 企业可以通过提供可靠的产品并迅速回应投诉来培养客户忠诚度。
collocations: customer service｜客户服务 ; regular customer｜常客 ; customer satisfaction｜客户满意度 ; customer loyalty｜客户忠诚度
tip_zh: customer泛指顾客；client常指专业服务的客户。

meanings_zh: v. 收集；收藏 | v. 领取；接走 | v. 募集；收取
definition_en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby | To go somewhere and bring someone or something away | To receive or gather money from people
example1_en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
example1_zh: 每次去海边，我都会收集光滑的石头。
example2_en: Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.
example2_zh: 研究人员收集当地家庭的数据，以评估交通政策如何影响日常出行习惯。
collocations: collect data｜收集数据 ; collect a parcel｜领取包裹 ; collect donations｜募集捐款 ; collect stamps｜集邮
tip_zh: 英式英语collect someone可指去接某人。

meanings_zh: n. 闹钟
definition_en: a clock that makes a noise to wake you up
example1_en: My alarm clock rings at seven every morning.
example1_zh: 我的闹钟每天早上七点响。
example2_en: He set the alarm clock for six o'clock.
example2_zh: 他把闹钟定在六点。
collocations: set an alarm clock｜定闹钟
tip_zh: set the alarm clock 表示“定闹钟”，wake up 表示“醒来”。

meanings_zh: n. 青蛙
definition_en: A small amphibian with long back legs for jumping.
example1_en: A green frog jumped from the stone into our pond.
example1_zh: 一只绿色的青蛙从石头上跳进了我们的池塘。
example2_en: Declining frog populations can indicate environmental damage because these animals are sensitive to changes in water quality.
example2_zh: 青蛙数量下降可能表明环境遭到破坏，因为它们对水质变化十分敏感。
collocations: tree frog｜树蛙 ; frog population｜青蛙种群 ; frog spawn｜蛙卵
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为frogs；toad指蟾蜍。

meanings_zh: n. 话题；主题
definition_en: a subject that people discuss, write about, or study
example1_en: Food is always a popular topic in our house.
example1_zh: 食物在我们家一直是个热门话题。
example2_en: Climate change has become a central topic in school discussions about the future of our planet.
example2_zh: 气候变化已成为学校讨论地球未来时的核心话题。
collocations: a topic of discussion｜讨论的话题 ; a controversial topic｜有争议的话题 ; change the topic｜转换话题 ; research topic｜研究课题
tip_zh: topic指讨论或写作的主题；title指文章等的标题。

meanings_zh: adj. 糟糕的；令人厌恶的 | adj. 可怕的；令人震惊的
definition_en: very unpleasant or bad | causing strong fear or shock
example1_en: A horrible smell came from the forgotten lunch box.
example1_zh: 那个被遗忘的午餐盒散发出难闻的气味。
example2_en: Residents described the horrible conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter enforcement of safety standards.
example2_zh: 居民描述了拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁更严格地执行安全标准。
collocations: a horrible smell｜难闻的气味 ; a horrible experience｜糟糕的经历 ; horrible weather｜恶劣的天气
tip_zh: horrible常指很糟糕；horrific多指骇人、惨烈。

meanings_zh: adj. 额外的；附加的 | adv. 额外地；格外地 | n. 额外项目；群众演员
definition_en: added to the usual or necessary amount | more than usual, or in addition to the normal amount | an additional item, or a background actor in a film
example1_en: I packed an extra sweater because the evenings get cold.
example1_zh: 我多带了一件毛衣，因为晚上会冷。
example2_en: Schools should provide extra support for students who struggle to access learning materials at home.
example2_zh: 学校应为在家难以获取学习资料的学生提供额外支持。
collocations: extra time｜额外时间 ; extra charge｜额外费用 ; extra care｜格外小心 ; pay extra｜额外付费
tip_zh: 形容词指额外的；pay extra中作副词。

meanings_zh: n. 洗澡；泡澡 | n. 浴缸
definition_en: Washing your body while sitting or lying in water. | A large container that you fill with water for washing yourself.
example1_en: A warm bath helped me relax after the hike.
example1_zh: 徒步之后，泡个温水澡让我放松了下来。
example2_en: Taking shorter showers instead of a daily bath can reduce household water consumption significantly.
example2_zh: 用较短时间的淋浴代替每天泡澡，可以显著减少家庭用水量。
collocations: have a bath｜洗澡 ; take a bath｜洗澡 ; run a bath｜给浴缸放水 ; hot bath｜热水澡
tip_zh: 英式常说have a bath；美式常说take a bath。

meanings_zh: adj. 悲伤的；难过的
definition_en: feeling unhappy
example1_en: She felt sad when her friend moved away.
example1_zh: 朋友搬走时她很难过。
example2_en: The sad film made everyone cry.
example2_zh: 这部悲伤的电影让大家都哭了。
collocations: feel sad｜感到难过
tip_zh: sad 形容悲伤；名词 sadness 悲伤，副词 sadly 悲伤地。

meanings_zh: prep. 反对；与……对抗 | prep. 靠着；紧贴 | prep. 防备；抵御
definition_en: Opposing someone or something, or competing with them. | Touching or supported by a surface. | For protection from something harmful or unwanted.
example1_en: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
example1_zh: 今天下午我们队要和邻居们比赛。
example2_en: Some residents are against airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to nearby habitats.
example2_zh: 一些居民反对机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声增加以及附近栖息地遭到破坏。
collocations: vote against｜投票反对 ; lean against｜倚靠 ; protect against｜防护；抵御 ; against the law｜违法
tip_zh: against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 片刻；一会儿 | n. 时刻；时机
definition_en: A very short period of time. | A particular point in time, sometimes especially important.
example1_en: Wait a moment while I put my shoes on.
example1_zh: 等一会儿，我穿上鞋就好。
example2_en: The opening of the new railway marked a significant moment in the region's economic development.
example2_zh: 新铁路的开通标志着该地区经济发展中的一个重要时刻。
collocations: at the moment｜目前；此刻 ; in a moment｜马上；一会儿后 ; a brief moment｜短暂的一瞬 ; a turning point moment｜转折时刻
tip_zh: at the moment指现在；in a moment指马上。

meanings_zh: n. 吸烟
definition_en: The activity or habit of breathing in smoke from tobacco.
example1_en: My uncle gave up smoking and now enjoys long walks.
example1_zh: 我叔叔戒了烟，现在很喜欢长距离散步。
example2_en: Banning smoking in public buildings can protect workers and visitors from the harmful effects of tobacco smoke.
example2_zh: 禁止在公共建筑内吸烟可以保护工作人员和访客免受烟草烟雾的危害。
collocations: give up smoking｜戒烟 ; passive smoking｜被动吸烟 ; smoking ban｜禁烟令
tip_zh: 表示吸烟活动时不可数；戒烟可用give up smoking。

meanings_zh: n. 男人；小伙子
definition_en: An informal word for a man.
example1_en: The guy next door helped carry my groceries.
example1_zh: 隔壁那位小伙子帮我提了买回来的东西。
example2_en: Calling a colleague a guy may sound friendly, but informal vocabulary is usually inappropriate in academic writing.
example2_zh: 称同事为guy可能显得亲切，但非正式词汇通常不适合学术写作。
collocations: a nice guy｜友善的男人 ; a young guy｜年轻小伙子 ; a regular guy｜普通人
tip_zh: guy属口语；正式写作通常用man或person。

meanings_zh: v. 想要；希望 | n. 缺乏；贫困
definition_en: To desire something or wish for something to happen. | A lack of something needed, especially basic necessities.
example1_en: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
example1_zh: 我想在我们的阳台上种番茄。
example2_en: Many young adults want governments to invest more in affordable housing rather than expensive urban redevelopment projects.
example2_zh: 许多年轻人希望政府更多投资于可负担住房，而不是昂贵的城市重建项目。
collocations: want to do something｜想做某事 ; want someone to do something｜想让某人做某事 ; for want of｜由于缺少
tip_zh: 用want to do或want sb to do，不用want doing表想做。

meanings_zh: n. 手提箱；行李箱
definition_en: A case with a handle for carrying clothes when travelling.
example1_en: Her suitcase was too heavy to lift onto the train.
example1_zh: 她的行李箱太重，搬不上火车。
example2_en: Travellers can reduce transport emissions by packing a lighter suitcase and choosing public transport whenever possible.
example2_zh: 旅客可以通过减轻行李箱的重量，并尽量选择公共交通来减少交通排放。
collocations: pack a suitcase｜收拾行李箱 ; unpack a suitcase｜打开行李箱取出物品 ; a wheeled suitcase｜带轮行李箱
tip_zh: suitcase可数；统称行李的luggage不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 海报；招贴画
definition_en: A large printed picture or announcement displayed on a surface
example1_en: She hung a colourful poster above her desk.
example1_zh: 她在书桌上方挂了一张色彩鲜艳的海报。
example2_en: A well-designed poster can encourage people to recycle by presenting environmental messages clearly and attractively.
example2_zh: 设计精良的海报可以清晰而有吸引力地传达环保信息，鼓励人们回收利用。
collocations: put up a poster｜张贴海报 ; design a poster｜设计海报 ; advertising poster｜广告海报 ; poster campaign｜海报宣传活动
tip_zh: poster 是海报；postcard 是明信片，注意区分。

meanings_zh: pron. 谁
definition_en: used in questions about people
example1_en: Who is that girl over there?
example1_zh: 那边那个女孩是谁？
example2_en: Who helped you with the homework?
example2_zh: 谁帮你做作业了？
tip_zh: who 用于询问人；Whose 是询问“谁的”。

meanings_zh: n. 礼物；赠品 | n. 天赋；才能 | v. 赠送
definition_en: Something given freely to another person | A natural ability to do something well | To give something to someone as a present
example1_en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
example1_zh: 姐姐用鲜黄色的纸把礼物包了起来。
example2_en: Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.
example2_zh: 学校应培养每个孩子的天赋，而不是用同一套狭隘的标准评判所有人。
collocations: birthday gift｜生日礼物 ; a gift for languages｜语言天赋 ; gift shop｜礼品店
tip_zh: 表示天赋时常用 a gift for，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 认为；觉得 | v. 思考；考虑
definition_en: To have an opinion or belief about something. | To use your mind to consider ideas or solve problems.
example1_en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
example1_zh: 我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。
example2_en: Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.
example2_zh: 一些人认为，学校应将更多时间用于实用技能，而不是备考。
collocations: think about｜思考；考虑 ; think of｜想到 ; think carefully｜仔细思考 ; think critically｜批判性思考
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为thought；认为时通常不用进行时。

meanings_zh: det. 又一；另一 | pron. 另一个；再一个
definition_en: one more, or a different one | one more person or thing, or a different one
example1_en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
example1_zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。
example2_en: Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。
collocations: another chance｜再一次机会 ; another option｜另一个选择 ; one after another｜一个接一个 ; another two days｜再过两天
tip_zh: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

meanings_zh: n. 女式衬衫
definition_en: A shirt traditionally worn by women, often made from light fabric
example1_en: She wore a blue blouse with her favourite grey trousers.
example1_zh: 她穿了一件蓝色女式衬衫，搭配最喜欢的灰色长裤。
example2_en: Choosing a durable blouse rather than a cheaply made alternative may reduce clothing waste over time.
example2_zh: 选择耐穿的女式衬衫而非制作廉价的替代品，长期来看可能减少衣物浪费。
collocations: silk blouse｜丝绸女式衬衫 ; long-sleeved blouse｜长袖女式衬衫 ; loose-fitting blouse｜宽松女式衬衫
tip_zh: 通常指女式衬衫；shirt的适用范围更广。

meanings_zh: n. 警察
definition_en: a member of the police force
example1_en: The police officer helped the lost child.
example1_zh: 警察帮助了迷路的孩子。
example2_en: Ask a police officer if you need directions.
example2_zh: 需要问路可以找警察。
tip_zh: police officer 是不分性别的说法；policeman 是男警。

meanings_zh: n. 建筑物；楼房 | n. 建筑；建造
definition_en: a structure with walls and a roof | the activity of constructing houses or other structures
example1_en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
example1_zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。
example2_en: Improving insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and lower heating costs for residents.
example2_zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，降低居民的取暖费用。
collocations: office building｜办公楼 ; building materials｜建筑材料 ; building site｜建筑工地 ; historic building｜历史建筑
tip_zh: 指建筑物时可数，指建造活动时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adv. 也许；可能 | adv. 或许（委婉建议或请求）
definition_en: Used when something is possible but not certain. | Used to make a suggestion or request sound less direct.
example1_en: Perhaps we should take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
example1_zh: 也许我们该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。
example2_en: Perhaps governments could encourage healthier diets by making fresh produce more affordable for low-income households.
example2_zh: 政府或许可以让低收入家庭更买得起新鲜农产品，以鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: perhaps not｜也许不是 ; perhaps the best｜或许是最好的 ; perhaps we could｜或许我们可以
tip_zh: perhaps比maybe略正式，可放句首使建议更委婉。

meanings_zh: prep. 紧挨着；在…旁边
definition_en: very close to something, beside it
example1_en: The bank is next to the supermarket.
example1_zh: 银行紧挨着超市。
example2_en: She sat next to me in the cinema.
example2_zh: 她在电影院里坐在我旁边。
tip_zh: next to 表示“紧挨着”；near 是“附近”，距离更远。

meanings_zh: v. 端上；供应；接待 | v. 为……服务；履行职责 | v. 用作；起……作用
definition_en: To give food or drink, or assist customers. | To work for people, an organisation, or your country. | To be used for a particular purpose.
example1_en: This little café serves fresh soup with warm bread.
example1_zh: 这家小咖啡馆供应新鲜的汤和温热的面包。
example2_en: Public libraries serve as community spaces where residents can access information, attend workshops, and meet other learners.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆是社区活动空间，居民可以在那里获取信息、参加工作坊并结识其他学习者。
collocations: serve a meal｜上餐 ; serve customers｜接待顾客 ; serve the community｜服务社区 ; serve as｜用作；充当
tip_zh: serve as后接角色或用途；serve for不这样用。

meanings_zh: adj. 阳光充足的；晴朗的 | adj. 开朗的；乐观的
definition_en: having plenty of bright sunlight | cheerful and positive in character or mood
example1_en: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，我们在阳光充足的阳台上吃了早餐。
example2_en: Regions with sunny climates can generate substantial amounts of electricity through well-planned solar energy projects.
example2_zh: 阳光充足的地区可以通过规划合理的太阳能项目产生大量电力。
collocations: sunny weather｜晴朗的天气 ; sunny day｜晴天 ; sunny spot｜阳光充足的地方 ; sunny disposition｜开朗的性格
tip_zh: sunny强调阳光足，不一定表示气温高。

meanings_zh: v. 游泳；游过 | n. 一次游泳
definition_en: To move through water using your body. | An occasion when you move through water for exercise or pleasure.
example1_en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。
example2_en: Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
example2_zh: 学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。
collocations: go for a swim｜去游泳 ; learn to swim｜学习游泳 ; swim across｜游过
tip_zh: 不规则变化：swim—swam—swum。

meanings_zh: n. 邻居；邻近的人或事物
definition_en: someone living nearby, or something located next to another
example1_en: Our neighbour watered the plants while we were away.
example1_zh: 我们不在家时，邻居帮忙给植物浇了水。
example2_en: Shared gardens can strengthen relationships between neighbours and create a greater sense of belonging in urban communities.
example2_zh: 共享花园可以增进邻里关系，增强城市社区居民的归属感。
collocations: next-door neighbour｜隔壁邻居 ; close neighbours｜近邻 ; neighbouring countries｜邻国
tip_zh: 英式拼写neighbour，美式拼写neighbor。

meanings_zh: n. 科学；自然科学 | n. 科学学科
definition_en: Study of the natural world through observation and experiments | A particular field of study using scientific methods
example1_en: We grew tiny crystals in our science class today.
example1_zh: 今天的科学课上，我们培育了微小的晶体。
example2_en: Investment in science can help countries develop cleaner energy sources and improve public health.
example2_zh: 科学投入能帮助各国开发更清洁的能源，并改善公共健康。
collocations: science education｜科学教育 ; natural sciences｜自然科学 ; advances in science｜科学进展 ; computer science｜计算机科学
tip_zh: 泛指科学通常不可数；指具体学科可用a science。

meanings_zh: v. 点击 | n. 咔嗒声；点击 | v. 突然明白；恍然大悟
definition_en: to press a mouse button or select something on screen | a short sharp sound, or an action selecting something onscreen | to suddenly become clear or understood
example1_en: Click on the picture to see a larger version.
example1_zh: 点击图片即可查看大图。
example2_en: Students should check whether a website is trustworthy before they click on links or share personal information.
example2_zh: 学生在点击链接或分享个人信息前，应检查网站是否可信。
collocations: click on a link｜点击链接 ; a mouse click｜一次鼠标点击 ; a sharp click｜清脆的咔嗒声
tip_zh: 点击链接常用click on；it clicked可指突然想通了。

meanings_zh: n. 雪；积雪 | v. 下雪
definition_en: Soft white frozen flakes falling from clouds or covering the ground. | For snow to fall from the sky.
example1_en: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
example1_zh: 我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。
example2_en: Heavy snow can disrupt public transport and prevent rural communities from accessing essential services.
example2_zh: 大雪可能扰乱公共交通，使农村社区无法获得基本服务。
collocations: heavy snow｜大雪 ; fresh snow｜新下的雪 ; snow heavily｜下大雪
tip_zh: snow作名词通常不可数；下雪用it snows。

meanings_zh: v. 忘记；记不起 | v. 忘记做；忘带
definition_en: to fail to remember a fact, person, or experience | to fail to do or bring something through not remembering
example1_en: I always forget where I put my reading glasses.
example1_zh: 我总是忘记把老花镜放在哪里了。
example2_en: Students may quickly forget new vocabulary unless they review it regularly and use it in meaningful contexts.
example2_zh: 如果学生不定期复习新词，并在有意义的语境中运用，就可能很快忘记。
collocations: forget to do something｜忘记做某事 ; forget about｜忘记；不再考虑 ; completely forget｜完全忘记
tip_zh: forget to do忘记去做；forget doing忘记做过。

meanings_zh: adv. 缓慢地；慢慢地
definition_en: At a low speed or over a long time.
example1_en: She slowly poured the hot soup into bowls.
example1_zh: 她慢慢地把热汤倒进碗里。
example2_en: Although public attitudes are changing slowly, more consumers are choosing products with less plastic packaging.
example2_zh: 尽管公众观念改变得较慢，但越来越多的消费者正在选择塑料包装更少的产品。
collocations: move slowly｜缓慢移动 ; speak slowly｜慢慢说 ; slowly but surely｜缓慢而稳步地
tip_zh: slowly是副词，修饰动作；slow通常作形容词。

meanings_zh: phr v. 查明；发现
definition_en: to learn or discover something
example1_en: I called the cinema to find out the film times.
example1_zh: 我打电话给电影院查放映时间。
example2_en: She found out the answer in the book.
example2_zh: 她在书里找到了答案。
tip_zh: find out 强调“经过打听/查询后得知”；find 更强调“找到”。

meanings_zh: n. 公寓；一套住房 | adj. 平的；平坦的 | adj. 瘪了的；没气的
definition_en: a set of rooms forming a home within a building | level and smooth, without raised or curved parts | having too little air inside, especially a tyre
example1_en: We rent a small flat above a busy bakery.
example1_zh: 我们在一家生意兴隆的面包店楼上租了一套小公寓。
example2_en: Building affordable flats near public transport could reduce commuting costs for many urban workers.
example2_zh: 在公共交通设施附近建造价格合理的公寓，可以降低许多城市工作者的通勤成本。
collocations: rent a flat｜租公寓 ; flat surface｜平坦的表面 ; flat tyre｜瘪了的轮胎
tip_zh: “公寓”英式常用 flat，美式常用 apartment。

meanings_zh: det. 最少的；最小量的 | adv. 最少；程度最低 | pron. 最少量；最小程度
definition_en: the smallest amount of something | to the smallest degree or extent | the smallest amount or degree
example1_en: This soup needs the least salt of all.
example1_zh: 这些汤里，这道汤需要的盐最少。
example2_en: Public transport often causes the least pollution per passenger when compared with private car travel.
example2_zh: 与私家车出行相比，公共交通的人均污染通常最少。
collocations: at least｜至少 ; the least expensive｜最便宜的 ; least of all｜最不；尤其不
tip_zh: least是little的最高级；修饰可数名词用fewest。

meanings_zh: adj. 国家的；全国的 | n. 某国国民
definition_en: relating to a whole country or its people | a person who is a citizen of a particular country
example1_en: My sister hopes to join the national swimming team.
example1_zh: 我姐姐希望加入国家游泳队。
example2_en: National policies can help reduce regional differences in access to healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 国家政策有助于缩小医疗和教育机会方面的地区差异。
collocations: national identity｜国家认同 ; national park｜国家公园 ; national government｜中央政府 ; foreign national｜外国公民
tip_zh: national侧重一国整体；international指国际的。

meanings_zh: n. 眼镜 | n. 玻璃杯（复数）
definition_en: Two lenses in a frame worn to improve sight. | Containers made of glass, usually used for drinking.
example1_en: I left my glasses beside the bed last night.
example1_zh: 我昨晚把眼镜落在床边了。
example2_en: Regular eye examinations help students obtain suitable glasses, allowing them to read comfortably and participate fully in lessons.
example2_zh: 定期眼部检查有助于学生配到合适的眼镜，让他们舒适阅读并充分参与课堂。
collocations: a pair of glasses｜一副眼镜 ; wear glasses｜戴眼镜 ; reading glasses｜老花镜 ; drinking glasses｜饮水玻璃杯
tip_zh: 指眼镜时用复数；一副眼镜用a pair of glasses。

meanings_zh: adj. 特别的；特殊的 | adj. 专门的；专用的 | n. 特价品；特色菜
definition_en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way. | Intended for a particular purpose or person. | A specially priced product or a featured restaurant dish.
example1_en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
example1_zh: 我们把这个特别的蛋糕留到了你生日时享用。
example2_en: Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.
example2_zh: 学校应提供专用设备，让残障学生能够充分参与课堂活动。
collocations: special occasion｜特别的场合 ; special offer｜特价优惠 ; special equipment｜专用设备 ; special attention｜特别关注
tip_zh: specially强调专门；especially常表示尤其。

meanings_zh: phr v. （机器、车辆）出故障；抛锚
definition_en: to stop working (about a machine or car)
example1_en: Our car broke down on the way to the beach.
example1_zh: 我们的车在去海滩的路上抛锚了。
example2_en: The washing machine has broken down again.
example2_zh: 洗衣机又坏了。
tip_zh: break down 指机器、汽车等“出故障”；人崩溃也说 break down。

meanings_zh: n. 支票
definition_en: a printed piece of paper you sign to pay money
example1_en: He paid the rent by cheque.
example1_zh: 他用支票付房租。
example2_en: Can I write you a cheque for the ticket?
example2_zh: 我能给你开张支票付票钱吗？
collocations: pay by cheque｜用支票付款
tip_zh: cheque 是英式拼写，美式拼写是 check。

meanings_zh: n. 蝴蝶 | n. 蝶泳
definition_en: An insect with broad, often colourful wings and a thin body. | A swimming stroke with both arms moving forward together above water.
example1_en: A yellow butterfly landed gently on my sleeve.
example1_zh: 一只黄色蝴蝶轻轻落在我的袖子上。
example2_en: Planting native flowers in urban gardens can support butterfly populations and contribute to greater local biodiversity.
example2_zh: 在城市花园中种植本地花卉可以帮助维持蝴蝶种群，并提升当地的生物多样性。
collocations: butterfly wings｜蝴蝶翅膀 ; butterfly species｜蝴蝶物种 ; swim butterfly｜游蝶泳
tip_zh: 复数为butterflies；蝶泳义通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 天花板 | n. 上限；最高限额
definition_en: the inside surface at the top of a room | the highest amount or level that is allowed
example1_en: A small spider was crawling across the ceiling.
example1_zh: 一只小蜘蛛正爬过天花板。
example2_en: A ceiling on annual rent increases could protect tenants, although it might discourage investment in housing.
example2_zh: 限制年度租金涨幅可以保护租户，但也可能抑制住房投资。
collocations: high ceiling｜高天花板 ; ceiling fan｜吊扇 ; price ceiling｜价格上限 ; set a ceiling on｜为……设定上限
tip_zh: ceiling是室内天花板；roof是建筑外部的屋顶。

meanings_zh: n. 植物 | v. 种植；栽种 | n. 工厂；工业设施
definition_en: a living thing that usually grows in soil and has leaves | to put seeds or young plants into soil to grow | a factory or facility where industrial processes take place
example1_en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
example1_zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。
example2_en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。
collocations: water a plant｜给植物浇水 ; plant trees｜种树 ; power plant｜发电厂 ; manufacturing plant｜制造厂
tip_zh: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

meanings_zh: n. 肉；食用肉类
definition_en: The flesh of animals eaten as food.
example1_en: We keep raw meat separate from vegetables in the fridge.
example1_zh: 我们把生肉和蔬菜分开放在冰箱里。
example2_en: Reducing meat consumption may lower the environmental impact of food production in many countries.
example2_zh: 在许多国家，减少肉类消费可能降低食品生产对环境的影响。
collocations: raw meat｜生肉 ; lean meat｜瘦肉 ; red meat｜红肉 ; meat consumption｜肉类消费
tip_zh: 泛指食用肉时不可数；meats指不同种类的肉。

meanings_zh: n. 脖子；颈部 | n. 瓶颈；狭长部分
definition_en: the body part connecting the head to the shoulders | a narrow part of an object, such as a bottle
example1_en: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
example1_zh: 他在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。
example2_en: Office workers may experience neck pain if their computer screens are positioned at an unsuitable height.
example2_zh: 如果电脑屏幕的高度不合适，办公室职员可能会感到颈部疼痛。
collocations: neck pain｜颈部疼痛 ; a stiff neck｜脖子僵硬 ; the neck of a bottle｜瓶颈
tip_zh: neck指脖子；throat指喉咙，勿混用。

meanings_zh: n. 游泳
definition_en: The activity of moving through water using your body.
example1_en: We go swimming at the indoor pool every Saturday.
example1_zh: 我们每周六都去室内泳池游泳。
example2_en: Regular swimming can improve physical fitness while placing relatively little stress on the joints.
example2_zh: 经常游泳可以增强体质，同时对关节造成的压力相对较小。
collocations: go swimming｜去游泳 ; swimming pool｜游泳池 ; swimming lessons｜游泳课
tip_zh: 表示运动时不可数；去游泳用go swimming。

meanings_zh: n. 棋盘游戏；桌游
definition_en: a game played with pieces on a board
example1_en: We played a board game together last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚我们一起玩了一个桌游。
example2_en: This board game is easy to learn.
example2_zh: 这个桌游很容易学会。
collocations: play a board game｜玩桌游
tip_zh: 常见的 board game 有 chess（国际象棋）和 Monopoly 这类游戏。

meanings_zh: v. 上传 | n. 上传；上传的文件
definition_en: to transfer files from a device to an online system | the transfer of a file online, or the file itself
example1_en: I uploaded our picnic photos to a shared folder.
example1_zh: 我把我们野餐的照片上传到了共享文件夹。
example2_en: Students can upload their assignments to a secure platform, allowing teachers to provide timely feedback.
example2_zh: 学生可以将作业上传至安全平台，方便教师及时提供反馈。
collocations: upload a file｜上传文件 ; upload photos｜上传照片 ; upload to a server｜上传至服务器
tip_zh: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

meanings_zh: n. 草；草地
definition_en: A low plant with narrow green leaves covering the ground.
example1_en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边的草地上铺了一条毯子。
example2_en: Replacing natural grass with artificial surfaces can reduce habitats for insects and increase local temperatures.
example2_zh: 用人造地面取代天然草地可能减少昆虫的栖息地，并使当地气温升高。
collocations: cut the grass｜割草 ; a blade of grass｜一片草叶 ; long grass｜长草 ; wet grass｜湿草地
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一片草叶用a blade of grass。

meanings_zh: art. 这；那（定冠词）
definition_en: used before a noun when it is clear which one
example1_en: The sun is shining today.
example1_zh: 今天阳光明媚。
example2_en: Close the door, please.
example2_zh: 请关上门。
tip_zh: the 用在特指的名词前；元音音素前读 /ðiː/。

meanings_zh: v. 教；教授；教导
definition_en: Help someone learn knowledge, skills, or ways of behaving
example1_en: My aunt taught me how to mend a shirt.
example1_zh: 姑姑教会了我如何缝补衬衫。
example2_en: Schools should teach children how to evaluate online information rather than simply memorise facts.
example2_zh: 学校应教孩子如何评估网上的信息，而非只是死记事实。
collocations: teach a subject｜教授一门学科 ; teach someone to swim｜教某人游泳 ; teach a lesson｜授课；给以教训
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为taught；教某人做用teach sb to do。

meanings_zh: v. 拿；提；搬运 | v. 随身携带 | v. 传播；携带病菌
definition_en: Hold or support something while moving it somewhere | Have something with you wherever you go | Contain and potentially pass on a disease or infection
example1_en: Could you carry this heavy bag upstairs for me?
example1_zh: 你能帮我把这个沉重的袋子拿上楼吗？
example2_en: Reusable bottles allow commuters to carry drinking water without purchasing disposable plastic containers every day.
example2_zh: 可重复使用的水瓶让通勤者能随身带水，无须每天购买一次性塑料容器。
collocations: carry a bag｜提包 ; carry passengers｜运送乘客 ; carry a virus｜携带病毒 ; carry out research｜开展研究
tip_zh: carry强调携带或搬运；bring和take还体现方向。

meanings_zh: n. 灯
definition_en: A device that produces light, often on a table.
example1_en: She switched on the lamp beside her bed.
example1_zh: 她打开了床边的灯。
example2_en: Using an adjustable desk lamp can improve comfort for students who study in poorly lit rooms.
example2_zh: 对于在光线不足的房间里学习的学生，使用可调节台灯可以提高舒适度。
collocations: desk lamp｜书桌台灯 ; bedside lamp｜床头灯 ; floor lamp｜落地灯 ; switch on a lamp｜开灯
tip_zh: lamp指灯具；light也可指光或光线。

meanings_zh: n. 头发；毛发 | n. 一根头发；一根毛
definition_en: Thin strands growing on the skin of people and animals. | A single strand growing from skin.
example1_en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
example1_zh: 她做午饭前把头发扎了起来。
example2_en: Some workplaces are relaxing rules about hair and clothing to create a more inclusive environment.
example2_zh: 一些工作场所正在放宽对发型和服装的规定，以营造更包容的环境。
collocations: brush your hair｜梳头 ; have your hair cut｜理发 ; a strand of hair｜一缕头发 ; hair loss｜脱发
tip_zh: 整体头发不可数；一根头发用a hair。

meanings_zh: adj. 绿色的 | adj. 环保的 | n. 绿色
definition_en: Having the colour of grass and most leaves. | Causing little harm to the environment. | The colour of grass and most leaves.
example1_en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
example1_zh: 她穿了一件绿色夹克来搭配鞋子。
example2_en: Governments can encourage green transport by improving public services and building safer routes for cyclists.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过改善公共服务和修建更安全的自行车道来鼓励绿色出行。
collocations: green vegetables｜绿色蔬菜 ; green energy｜绿色能源 ; green spaces｜绿地 ; go green｜采取环保生活方式
tip_zh: 除颜色外，green常表示环保；形容人还可指缺乏经验。

meanings_zh: n. 葡萄
definition_en: A small round fruit growing in bunches on vines.
example1_en: She packed some grapes in my lunch box.
example1_zh: 她在我的午餐盒里装了一些葡萄。
example2_en: Farmers growing grapes may need more efficient irrigation systems as summers become hotter and drier.
example2_zh: 随着夏季变得更炎热、更干燥，葡萄种植者可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。
collocations: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄 ; seedless grapes｜无籽葡萄 ; grape juice｜葡萄汁
tip_zh: 单颗葡萄用a grape，一串用a bunch of grapes。

meanings_zh: v. 打电话；呼叫 | v. 称呼；把…叫作 | n. 电话；呼吁
definition_en: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention. | To give someone or something a particular name. | A telephone conversation or a public request for action.
example1_en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚到家后我会给你打电话。
example2_en: Environmental groups call for stricter regulations to reduce plastic waste entering rivers and oceans.
example2_zh: 环保团体呼吁制定更严格的法规，减少流入河流和海洋的塑料垃圾。
collocations: make a call｜打电话 ; call for action｜呼吁采取行动 ; call someone back｜给某人回电话
tip_zh: call sb表示给某人打电话，不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 奶酪；干酪
definition_en: A food made by pressing or ripening the solids of milk.
example1_en: I added some cheese to my warm vegetable sandwich.
example1_zh: 我在热乎乎的蔬菜三明治里加了些奶酪。
example2_en: Although cheese provides protein and calcium, some varieties contain high levels of salt and saturated fat.
example2_zh: 虽然奶酪能提供蛋白质和钙，但有些品种的盐和饱和脂肪含量较高。
collocations: a slice of cheese｜一片奶酪 ; grated cheese｜奶酪碎 ; cream cheese｜奶油奶酪 ; cheese sandwich｜奶酪三明治
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一块奶酪用a piece of cheese。

meanings_zh: adj. 长的；长时间的 | adv. 长时间地；很久 | v. 渴望；盼望
definition_en: Extending a great distance or lasting a great time. | For a great amount of time. | To want something very strongly, especially something unavailable.
example1_en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
example1_zh: 她的长围巾差点碰到湿漉漉的人行道。
example2_en: Long commuting times can reduce workers' leisure opportunities and negatively affect their overall quality of life.
example2_zh: 长时间通勤会减少劳动者的休闲机会，并对其整体生活质量产生负面影响。
collocations: a long time｜很长时间 ; long hours｜长时间的工作 ; long for｜渴望 ; long to do something｜渴望做某事
tip_zh: 动词long后接for加名词，或to加动词原形。

meanings_zh: n. 翅膀；机翼 | n. 建筑物的侧翼 | n. 组织内的派别
definition_en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight. | A section extending from the main part of a building. | A group within an organisation sharing particular views or aims.
example1_en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
example1_zh: 那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。
example2_en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
example2_zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。
collocations: spread your wings｜展开翅膀；拓展自我 ; aircraft wing｜飞机机翼 ; hospital wing｜医院侧楼 ; left wing｜左翼
tip_zh: 鸟的翅膀和飞机机翼都用wing，通常成对用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 会议 | n. 会面；碰面
definition_en: an occasion when people gather to discuss something | an occasion when people come together, by arrangement or chance
example1_en: Our team meeting starts right after lunch today.
example1_zh: 我们团队今天午饭后马上开会。
example2_en: Regular meetings between teachers and parents can help identify learning difficulties at an early stage.
example2_zh: 教师与家长定期会面有助于及早发现学习困难。
collocations: hold a meeting｜召开会议 ; attend a meeting｜参加会议 ; arrange a meeting｜安排会面 ; staff meeting｜员工会议
tip_zh: 参加会议用attend a meeting；meeting也可指会面。

meanings_zh: adv.&int. 好地；很好地；嗯
definition_en: in a good way; also used to start a sentence
example1_en: She sings very well.
example1_zh: 她唱歌唱得很好。
example2_en: Well, let's start the lesson.
example2_zh: 好了，我们开始上课吧。
collocations: well done｜做得好
tip_zh: well 作副词“很好地”；作感叹词引出话题。

meanings_zh: n. 餐厅服务员；男侍者
definition_en: A person, traditionally male, who serves food in a restaurant
example1_en: The waiter brought our soup and two warm rolls.
example1_zh: 服务员端来了我们的汤和两个热乎乎的小面包。
example2_en: A well-trained waiter can improve the dining experience by responding patiently to customers with different needs.
example2_zh: 训练有素的服务员可以耐心回应不同顾客的需求，提升用餐体验。
collocations: work as a waiter｜当餐厅服务员 ; head waiter｜餐厅领班 ; ask the waiter｜询问服务员
tip_zh: waiter传统上指男服务员；server更不强调性别。

meanings_zh: adj. 有雾的；雾蒙蒙的 | adj. 模糊的；迷糊的
definition_en: filled with fog, making things difficult to see | unclear or difficult to remember or understand
example1_en: The road was so foggy that we drove slowly.
example1_zh: 路上雾很大，我们只好慢慢开车。
example2_en: Foggy conditions can disrupt air travel, causing delays that affect both passengers and airport operations.
example2_zh: 大雾天气可能扰乱航空出行，造成延误，影响乘客和机场运营。
collocations: foggy weather｜雾天 ; a foggy morning｜雾蒙蒙的早晨 ; foggy conditions｜大雾天气
tip_zh: foggy既可形容天气，也可形容记忆模糊。

meanings_zh: adj. 两倍的；双份的 | v. 加倍；使翻倍 | n. 两倍；双倍量
definition_en: twice the usual amount, size, or quantity | become twice as much, or make something twice as much | an amount that is twice as large as another
example1_en: I ordered a double portion of rice for lunch.
example1_zh: 我午饭点了双份米饭。
example2_en: The city plans to double its investment in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 该市计划将自行车基础设施投资增加一倍，以缓解交通拥堵。
collocations: double the amount｜两倍的量 ; double in size｜规模扩大一倍 ; double check｜仔细复核 ; double room｜双人房
tip_zh: double表示变为原来的两倍，即增加一倍。

meanings_zh: n. 银行 | n. 河岸；湖岸 | v. 把钱存入银行
definition_en: an organisation that holds money and provides financial services | land along the edge of a river or lake | put money into an account at a bank
example1_en: I went to the bank to open an account.
example1_zh: 我去银行开了一个账户。
example2_en: Banks can support local economic development by offering affordable loans to small businesses and new entrepreneurs.
example2_zh: 银行可以向小企业和初创创业者提供低成本贷款，以支持当地经济发展。
collocations: bank account｜银行账户 ; bank loan｜银行贷款 ; river bank｜河岸 ; bank statement｜银行对账单
tip_zh: 岸边用on the bank；银行里用at或in the bank。

meanings_zh: n. 野生动物；野生生物
definition_en: Animals and other living things in their natural surroundings.
example1_en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
example1_zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。
example2_en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
example2_zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。
collocations: protect wildlife｜保护野生生物 ; wildlife conservation｜野生生物保护 ; a wildlife reserve｜野生生物保护区
tip_zh: 不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

meanings_zh: n. 地毯
definition_en: A thick woven covering for a floor.
example1_en: We sat on the carpet and played cards.
example1_zh: 我们坐在地毯上打牌。
example2_en: Installing carpet in classrooms can reduce noise, although regular cleaning is necessary to maintain good hygiene.
example2_zh: 在教室里铺地毯可以降低噪声，但需要定期清洁以保持良好卫生。
collocations: lay a carpet｜铺地毯 ; fitted carpet｜满铺地毯 ; carpet cleaning｜地毯清洁
tip_zh: carpet常指大面积地毯；rug多指可移动的小块地毯。

meanings_zh: n. 教室
definition_en: a room where students are taught
example1_en: Sunlight filled the classroom as we opened our books.
example1_zh: 我们打开书本时，阳光洒满了教室。
example2_en: A well-designed classroom should provide adequate lighting, comfortable furniture, and enough space for students to work together.
example2_zh: 设计良好的教室应有充足的照明、舒适的家具，以及供学生合作学习的足够空间。
collocations: classroom management｜课堂管理 ; classroom activities｜课堂活动 ; classroom teaching｜课堂教学
tip_zh: in the classroom强调教室内；in class强调上课中。

meanings_zh: prep. 穿过；贯穿 | prep. 通过；凭借 | adv. 从头到尾；通过
definition_en: From one side or end to the other, within something. | By using a particular method, person, or process. | From beginning to end, or from one side to another.
example1_en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
example1_zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。
example2_en: Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
example2_zh: 学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。
collocations: walk through｜穿过 ; through experience｜通过经验 ; read through｜通读 ; all through the night｜整夜
tip_zh: through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

meanings_zh: n. 计划；方案 | v. 计划；打算 | n. 平面图
definition_en: An arrangement or idea for what to do in future. | To decide what to do and how to do it. | A drawing showing the layout of a building or area.
example1_en: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
example1_zh: 我们的计划是早点出发，避开拥堵。
example2_en: Cities need a clear plan for expanding public transport before introducing restrictions on private vehicles.
example2_zh: 城市在实施私家车限制措施之前，需要制定明确的公共交通扩展计划。
collocations: make a plan｜制定计划 ; plan to do something｜计划做某事 ; floor plan｜楼层平面图 ; long-term plan｜长期规划
tip_zh: plan to do表示打算做；过去式planned双写n。

meanings_zh: n. 设备；器材；装备
definition_en: the tools and other items needed for a particular activity
example1_en: Please put the camping equipment back in the garage.
example1_zh: 请把露营装备放回车库。
example2_en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
example2_zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。
collocations: sports equipment｜体育器材 ; medical equipment｜医疗设备 ; safety equipment｜安全装备 ; a piece of equipment｜一件设备
tip_zh: 不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。

meanings_zh: n. 麻烦；困难；故障 | v. 使烦恼；麻烦
definition_en: problems or difficulties that cause worry or inconvenience | to cause someone worry or ask them for help
example1_en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
example1_zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。
example2_en: Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.
example2_zh: 许多老年人难以使用那些仅通过数字平台提供的公共服务。
collocations: have trouble doing something｜做某事有困难 ; get into trouble｜惹上麻烦 ; engine trouble｜发动机故障 ; take the trouble to do something｜费心做某事
tip_zh: 表示做某事有困难，用have trouble doing。

meanings_zh: exclam. 晚安
definition_en: said when you say goodbye at night or go to bed
example1_en: Good night, sleep well.
example1_zh: 晚安，睡个好觉。
example2_en: Mum kissed me and said good night.
example2_zh: 妈妈亲了我一下，说了晚安。
tip_zh: good night 用于道别或睡前；即使天黑见面也用 good evening。

meanings_zh: n. 展览；展览会
definition_en: A public display of art, objects, or products.
example1_en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
example1_zh: 我们参观了当地博物馆的一场摄影展。
example2_en: An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.
example2_zh: 互动展览能让儿童更容易理解科学发现，并激发他们对研究的兴趣。
collocations: art exhibition｜艺术展 ; hold an exhibition｜举办展览 ; on exhibition｜在展出
tip_zh: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。

meanings_zh: adj. 安全的；无危险的 | adj. 稳妥的；风险小的 | n. 保险箱
definition_en: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm. | Unlikely to fail or lead to loss. | A strong locked container for money and valuable objects.
example1_en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
example1_zh: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.
example2_zh: 政府应确保所有社区都能获得安全饮用水和可靠的卫生设施。
collocations: safe and sound｜安然无恙 ; safe drinking water｜安全饮用水 ; a safe investment｜稳妥的投资 ; keep someone safe｜保护某人安全
tip_zh: safe是形容词，safety是名词；注意词性区别。

meanings_zh: adj. 美味的；可口的
definition_en: having a pleasant flavour
example1_en: This tasty soup is perfect for a cold evening.
example1_zh: 这道美味的汤很适合寒冷的夜晚。
example2_en: School canteens can encourage healthier eating by offering tasty meals made with fresh vegetables and whole grains.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以提供用新鲜蔬菜和全谷物制作的美味餐食，鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: tasty meal｜美味的饭菜 ; tasty snack｜可口的小吃 ; tasty dish｜美味的菜肴
tip_zh: tasty指食物美味；tasteful指有品位。

meanings_zh: n. 水母
definition_en: a soft sea animal with hanging tentacles that can sting
example1_en: A translucent jellyfish drifted past our boat this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，一只半透明的水母从我们船边漂过。
example2_en: Rising ocean temperatures may encourage jellyfish populations to grow, potentially disrupting marine ecosystems and coastal tourism.
example2_zh: 海洋温度上升可能促使水母数量增加，进而扰乱海洋生态系统并影响沿海旅游业。
collocations: a jellyfish sting｜水母蜇伤 ; a swarm of jellyfish｜一大群水母 ; jellyfish populations｜水母种群
tip_zh: 复数通常仍用 jellyfish；它不是鱼类。

meanings_zh: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的 | adj. 奇怪的；反常的
definition_en: making you laugh or smile | unusual or difficult to explain
example1_en: That funny story made everyone at the table laugh.
example1_zh: 那个好笑的故事逗得桌边的人都笑了。
example2_en: Teachers sometimes use funny examples to make difficult concepts more memorable and encourage students to participate.
example2_zh: 教师有时会用有趣的例子，让复杂概念更容易记住，并鼓励学生参与。
collocations: a funny story｜好笑的故事 ; a funny joke｜好笑的笑话 ; a funny smell｜奇怪的气味 ; find something funny｜觉得某事好笑
tip_zh: funny侧重好笑或奇怪；fun侧重令人愉快、有趣。

meanings_zh: n. 惊恐；震惊；厌恶 | n. 恐怖作品类型
definition_en: a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust | a type of fiction intended to frighten its audience
example1_en: She watched in horror as her laptop fell downstairs.
example1_zh: 她惊恐地看着自己的笔记本电脑掉下楼梯。
example2_en: Horror films often use music and lighting to create tension rather than relying entirely on frightening images.
example2_zh: 恐怖电影常用音乐和灯光制造紧张气氛，而非完全依赖吓人的画面。
collocations: in horror｜惊恐地 ; a horror film｜恐怖片 ; a sense of horror｜恐惧感
tip_zh: 情绪义通常不可数；in horror表示惊恐地。

meanings_zh: n. 邮票 | n. 印章；印记 | v. 盖章；跺脚
definition_en: A small official sticker showing that postage has been paid. | A tool that presses a mark, or the mark it leaves. | Press a mark onto something, or bring a foot down hard.
example1_en: She put a stamp on the envelope before leaving.
example1_zh: 她出门前在信封上贴了一张邮票。
example2_en: Although digital communication has reduced letter writing, collecting stamps remains a way to explore history and culture.
example2_zh: 尽管数字通信减少了书信往来，集邮仍是一种探索历史与文化的方式。
collocations: postage stamp｜邮票 ; collect stamps｜集邮 ; stamp a passport｜在护照上盖章 ; stamp your feet｜跺脚
tip_zh: 邮票用a stamp；“在信封上贴邮票”用put a stamp on。

meanings_zh: adv. 不幸的是；遗憾的是
definition_en: used to say that something is disappointing or unlucky
example1_en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
example1_zh: 遗憾的是，面包店的新鲜面包已经卖完了。
example2_en: Unfortunately, many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with reliable internet access.
example2_zh: 遗憾的是，许多乡村学校缺乏为学生提供可靠网络连接所需的资源。
collocations: unfortunately for someone｜对某人来说不幸的是 ; unfortunately not｜遗憾的是并非如此
tip_zh: 常置于句首并加逗号，对整件事表示遗憾。

meanings_zh: adj. 通常的；惯常的
definition_en: happening or done most often in a particular situation
example1_en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
example1_zh: 我们平时坐的窗边那张桌子已经有人了。
example2_en: Working from home has become the usual arrangement for some employees in the technology sector.
example2_zh: 对科技行业的一些员工来说，居家办公已成为常规安排。
collocations: as usual｜像往常一样 ; the usual routine｜惯常的生活规律 ; than usual｜比平时
tip_zh: as usual意为“照常”；than usual意为“比平时”。

meanings_zh: v. 支付；付工资 | n. 工资；薪酬 | v. 值得；划算
definition_en: To give money for something or for someone's work | Money received regularly for doing a job | To bring a benefit or be worth doing
example1_en: Can I pay for these apples by card?
example1_zh: 这些苹果可以刷卡付款吗？
example2_en: Employers should pay workers fairly to improve staff morale and reduce the number of people leaving.
example2_zh: 雇主应公平支付员工薪酬，以提高士气并减少人员流失。
collocations: pay a bill｜付账单 ; pay for something｜为某物付款 ; pay attention to｜注意 ; equal pay｜同等报酬
tip_zh: pay for接所购物品；pay接账单或款额；过去式paid。

meanings_zh: n. 正方形 | n. 广场 | adj. 正方形的；平方的
definition_en: a shape with four equal sides and four right angles | an open public area surrounded by buildings | shaped like a square, or expressing area in squared units
example1_en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
example1_zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。
example2_en: Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.
example2_zh: 在拥挤的城市中，建设公共广场可以促进社交互动，并为文化活动提供空间。
collocations: town square｜城镇广场 ; square metre｜平方米 ; square root｜平方根 ; square table｜方桌
tip_zh: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 年老的；古老的；旧的 | adj. ……岁的；有……年历史的 | adj. 以前的；原来的
definition_en: Having lived or existed for a long time. | Having a particular age. | Belonging to an earlier period of someone's life.
example1_en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
example1_zh: 我们家的老狗睡在温暖的厨房炉子旁。
example2_en: Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.
example2_zh: 保护古老建筑既能保护文化遗产，也能吸引游客并支持当地经济。
collocations: old age｜老年 ; years old｜……岁 ; old friend｜老朋友 ; old buildings｜古老建筑
tip_zh: an old friend通常指相识已久，不一定年纪大。

meanings_zh: n. 底部；最下端 | n. 臀部 | adj. 最下面的
definition_en: The lowest part of something. | The part of your body that you sit on. | In the lowest position.
example1_en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
example1_zh: 我的钥匙在包的最底下。
example2_en: Waste often collects at the bottom of rivers, damaging habitats and threatening aquatic life.
example2_zh: 废弃物经常堆积在河底，破坏栖息地并威胁水生生物。
collocations: at the bottom of｜在……底部 ; bottom shelf｜最下层架子 ; from top to bottom｜从上到下
tip_zh: 在某物底部用at the bottom of。

meanings_zh: phr v. 试穿
definition_en: to put on clothes to see if they fit
example1_en: Can I try on this jacket, please?
example1_zh: 请问我可以试穿这件夹克吗？
example2_en: She tried on three dresses before choosing one.
example2_zh: 她试了三件裙子才选了一件。
tip_zh: try on 是“试穿”；try it on 中代词放中间。

meanings_zh: n. 错误；失误 | v. 认错；误以为
definition_en: Something incorrect that you do, say, or believe. | To wrongly identify someone or understand something incorrectly.
example1_en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我误拿了你的伞。
example2_en: Teachers should encourage students to learn from mistakes rather than feel ashamed of making them.
example2_zh: 教师应鼓励学生从错误中学习，而不是因为犯错而感到羞愧。
collocations: make a mistake｜犯错 ; by mistake｜错误地；无意中 ; learn from mistakes｜从错误中学习 ; mistake A for B｜把A误认成B
tip_zh: 说make a mistake，不说do；动词过去式为mistook。

meanings_zh: n. 地点；场址；遗址 | n. 网站 | v. 为……选址；设置
definition_en: A place where something is built, happens, or once existed. | A collection of connected web pages. | Place or build something in a particular location.
example1_en: Workers put a fence around the building site.
example1_zh: 工人们在建筑工地周围围起了围栏。
example2_en: The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.
example2_zh: 拟建医院的选址靠近公共交通，方便居民获得医疗服务。
collocations: building site｜建筑工地 ; historic site｜历史遗址 ; on site｜在现场 ; site a factory｜为工厂选址
tip_zh: site指地点或网站；sight指视力或景象，二者同音。

meanings_zh: v. 重复；重说；重做 | n. 重复；重演；重播
definition_en: To say or do something again. | Something that happens or is shown again.
example1_en: Could you repeat the address a little more slowly?
example1_zh: 你能把地址再慢一点说一遍吗？
example2_en: Students who repeat new vocabulary aloud regularly may develop greater confidence when speaking a foreign language.
example2_zh: 经常大声重复新词汇的学生，在说外语时可能会更有信心。
collocations: repeat a mistake｜重犯错误 ; repeat a question｜重复问题 ; repeat after someone｜跟着某人复述 ; a repeat performance｜再次演出
tip_zh: repeat已含“再次”之意，通常不必再加again。

meanings_zh: v. 欢迎；欣然接受 | adj. 受欢迎的；令人欣喜的 | n. 欢迎；迎接
definition_en: to greet someone warmly or accept something with pleasure | wanted, appreciated, or gladly accepted | the way someone is greeted when they arrive
example1_en: Our neighbours came outside to welcome us home.
example1_zh: 邻居们走到外面，欢迎我们回家。
example2_en: Many communities welcome new cultural festivals because they encourage social interaction and support local businesses.
example2_zh: 许多社区欢迎新的文化节庆活动，因为这些活动能促进社交互动并支持当地商家。
collocations: welcome visitors｜欢迎来访者 ; a warm welcome｜热情的欢迎 ; a welcome change｜令人欣喜的变化 ; you're welcome｜不客气
tip_zh: be welcome to do表示可随意做；You're welcome用于回应感谢。

meanings_zh: n. 草莓
definition_en: a soft red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface
example1_en: I picked a ripe strawberry and put it in my basket.
example1_zh: 我摘了一颗熟透的草莓，放进篮子里。
example2_en: Growing strawberries locally can reduce transport distances, although heated greenhouses may increase overall energy consumption.
example2_zh: 在本地种植草莓可以缩短运输距离，但加温温室可能增加总体能源消耗。
collocations: strawberry jam｜草莓酱 ; ripe strawberries｜成熟的草莓 ; strawberry plants｜草莓植株
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为strawberries。

meanings_zh: n. 周；星期 | n. 工作周
definition_en: a period of seven days | the days or hours normally spent working each week
example1_en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
example1_zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。
example2_en: A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
example2_zh: 缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。
collocations: last week｜上周 ; once a week｜每周一次 ; working week｜工作周 ; a week off｜一周假期
tip_zh: last/next/this week前不加介词。

meanings_zh: n. 鳄鱼
definition_en: a large reptile with tough skin, long jaws and tail
example1_en: We watched a crocodile slide into the river.
example1_zh: 我们看着一条鳄鱼滑入河中。
example2_en: Wetland conservation protects crocodile habitats while also supporting the fish and birds that depend on these ecosystems.
example2_zh: 湿地保护既能保护鳄鱼的栖息地，也有利于依赖这些生态系统的鱼类和鸟类。
collocations: crocodile habitat｜鳄鱼栖息地 ; crocodile eggs｜鳄鱼蛋 ; crocodile tears｜假慈悲；虚假的眼泪
tip_zh: alligator指短吻鳄，与crocodile并非同一种动物。

meanings_zh: n. 星期三
definition_en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday
example1_en: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
example1_zh: 我们每周三在图书馆附近一起吃午饭。
example2_en: The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.
example2_zh: 社区中心每周三提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者融入当地生活。
collocations: on Wednesday｜在星期三 ; Wednesday morning｜星期三上午 ; every Wednesday｜每周三
tip_zh: 首字母大写；on Wednesday，但every Wednesday前不加on。

meanings_zh: adj. 苍白的；浅色的 | adj. 暗淡的；微弱的 | v. 变苍白；相形见绌
definition_en: Having little colour, or less colour than usual. | Giving only a weak light. | To lose colour or seem less impressive in comparison.
example1_en: You look pale; sit down and have some water.
example1_zh: 你脸色苍白，坐下来喝点水吧。
example2_en: The financial benefits of tourism may pale in comparison with its long-term environmental costs.
example2_zh: 与旅游业带来的长期环境代价相比，其经济收益可能显得微不足道。
collocations: pale blue｜浅蓝色 ; look pale｜脸色苍白 ; pale in comparison｜相比之下相形见绌
tip_zh: pale可指脸色苍白或颜色浅，不等于白色。

meanings_zh: n. 中午；正午
definition_en: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.
example1_en: Let's meet outside the library at noon tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我们明天中午在图书馆外见吧。
example2_en: Outdoor workers should avoid intense physical activity around noon, when temperatures and sunlight can be particularly strong.
example2_zh: 户外工作者应避免在正午前后进行高强度体力活动，此时气温可能很高，阳光也可能特别强烈。
collocations: at noon｜在中午 ; around noon｜中午前后 ; by noon｜到中午之前
tip_zh: 说at noon，不说in noon；正午是12 p.m.。

meanings_zh: phr. 上午；午前
definition_en: in the morning, before midday
example1_en: The shop opens at nine a.m.
example1_zh: 商店上午九点开门。
example2_en: She gets up at six a.m. every day.
example2_zh: 她每天早上六点起床。
tip_zh: a.m. 表示上午（午夜后至正午前）；p.m. 表示下午。

meanings_zh: exclam. 嗨；你好
definition_en: an informal greeting
example1_en: Hi, how are you today?
example1_zh: 嗨，你今天好吗？
example2_en: She said hi to everyone in the class.
example2_zh: 她向班里的每个人打招呼。
tip_zh: hi 比 hello 更随意，朋友间常用。

meanings_zh: pron.&det. 这；这个
definition_en: the thing or person here or now
example1_en: This is my favourite book.
example1_zh: 这是我最喜欢的书。
example2_en: This cake tastes wonderful.
example2_zh: 这个蛋糕尝起来很美味。
tip_zh: this 指近处/当前的事物；that 指远处。复数 these。

meanings_zh: phr v. 坐下
definition_en: to move to a sitting position
example1_en: Please sit down and open your books.
example1_zh: 请坐下，打开课本。
example2_en: He sat down next to his friend on the bench.
example2_zh: 他坐在长椅上朋友旁边。
tip_zh: sit down 是“坐下”的动作；反义 stand up（起立）。

meanings_zh: n. 许可证；执照 | n. 自由发挥的许可
definition_en: an official document allowing someone to do something | freedom to depart from usual rules or factual accuracy
example1_en: I keep my driving licence in my wallet.
example1_zh: 我把驾驶执照放在钱包里。
example2_en: Requiring a licence to operate tourist boats can help authorities maintain safety standards on busy waterways.
example2_zh: 要求旅游船持证运营，可以帮助主管部门维持繁忙水道的安全标准。
collocations: driving licence｜驾驶执照 ; apply for a licence｜申请许可证 ; renew a licence｜续办许可证 ; poetic licence｜诗意的自由发挥
tip_zh: 英式名词用licence，动词用license；美式都用license。

meanings_zh: n. 鹰；雕
definition_en: A large hunting bird with powerful claws and sharp eyesight
example1_en: An eagle circled slowly above the rocky valley.
example1_zh: 一只鹰在岩石遍布的山谷上方缓缓盘旋。
example2_en: Protecting mountain forests helps preserve the hunting grounds and nesting sites of the eagle.
example2_zh: 保护山地森林有助于保全鹰的猎食区和筑巢地。
collocations: a golden eagle｜金雕 ; a bald eagle｜白头海雕 ; an eagle's nest｜鹰巢
tip_zh: eagle通常指大型猛禽；eagle-eyed形容眼力敏锐。

meanings_zh: adj. 新的；新近出现的 | adj. 新买的；新接触的 | adj. 不熟悉的；初来乍到的
definition_en: Recently made, discovered, introduced, or begun. | Recently obtained or experienced by someone, though possibly already existing. | Not yet familiar with a place, activity, or situation.
example1_en: Our new neighbours brought us a basket of apples.
example1_zh: 我们的新邻居送来了一篮苹果。
example2_en: New technologies can make healthcare more accessible, but their benefits must be shared across different income groups.
example2_zh: 新技术能让医疗服务更易获得，但不同收入群体都应能享受到这些益处。
collocations: brand new｜全新的 ; new technology｜新技术 ; new to the job｜刚接触这份工作 ; a new approach｜一种新方法
tip_zh: be new to表示初次接触、不熟悉，to是介词。

meanings_zh: n. 毕业文凭；课程证书
definition_en: an official document showing successful completion of a course
example1_en: She proudly showed her diploma to her grandparents.
example1_zh: 她自豪地向祖父母展示了自己的毕业文凭。
example2_en: A vocational diploma can provide practical skills that help graduates find employment in specialised industries.
example2_zh: 职业教育文凭课程可以提供实用技能，帮助毕业生在专业行业中找到工作。
collocations: earn a diploma｜取得文凭 ; high school diploma｜高中文凭 ; diploma in nursing｜护理专业文凭
tip_zh: diploma多指毕业或课程文凭，不等同于degree学位。

meanings_zh: n. 烹饪；烹调 | adj. 烹调用的
definition_en: The activity of preparing food by heating it. | Intended for use in preparing food.
example1_en: My brother does the cooking while I wash dishes.
example1_zh: 我哥哥做饭，我洗碗。
example2_en: Teaching basic cooking skills at school can help young people develop healthier eating habits.
example2_zh: 在学校教授基本烹饪技能，有助于年轻人养成更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: do the cooking｜做饭 ; cooking skills｜烹饪技能 ; cooking oil｜食用油 ; home cooking｜家常烹饪
tip_zh: cooking指烹饪活动；cook可指厨师，cooker指炊具。

meanings_zh: n. 血；血液 | n. 血缘；家世
definition_en: the red liquid that carries oxygen around your body | family relationships or origins
example1_en: The nurse took some blood from my arm.
example1_zh: 护士从我的手臂抽了一些血。
example2_en: Regular physical activity can lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease.
example2_zh: 经常进行体育活动可以降低血压，并减少患心脏病的风险。
collocations: blood pressure｜血压 ; blood test｜血液检查 ; donate blood｜献血 ; blood vessel｜血管
tip_zh: blood通常不可数；一次验血用a blood test。

meanings_zh: n. 钱包；皮夹
definition_en: A small folding case for carrying money and cards.
example1_en: I left my wallet beside the kitchen sink.
example1_zh: 我把钱包落在厨房水槽旁了。
example2_en: As digital payments become more common, fewer consumers need to carry cash in a wallet.
example2_zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，需要在钱包里携带现金的消费者越来越少。
collocations: leather wallet｜皮钱包 ; digital wallet｜数字钱包 ; lost wallet｜遗失的钱包
tip_zh: wallet通常指放纸币和卡片的折叠式钱包。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭旅馆；招待所
definition_en: a small hotel or house where people pay to stay
example1_en: We stayed at a lovely guest-house by the beach.
example1_zh: 我们住在海边一家可爱的家庭旅馆。
example2_en: The guest-house serves breakfast every morning.
example2_zh: 这家家庭旅馆每天早上提供早餐。
tip_zh: guest-house 是小型旅馆，通常比酒店便宜、更温馨。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭；家人；亲属 | n. 科；语族；同类群
definition_en: a group of people related to one another | a group of related animals, plants, languages, or other things
example1_en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
example1_zh: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。
example2_en: Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助父母平衡家庭责任与有偿工作的要求。
collocations: extended family｜大家庭 ; family member｜家庭成员 ; family responsibilities｜家庭责任 ; language family｜语族
tip_zh: family作整体用单数；英式英语强调成员时可用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 例子；实例 | n. 榜样
definition_en: Something specific that shows what a general idea means | A person or action that others can learn from or copy
example1_en: Could you give me an example of a healthy breakfast?
example1_zh: 你能给我举一个健康早餐的例子吗？
example2_en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
example2_zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。
collocations: for example｜例如 ; give an example｜举例 ; set an example｜树立榜样 ; a typical example｜典型例子
tip_zh: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

meanings_zh: n. 十二月
definition_en: the final month of the year, following November
example1_en: My cousin is coming to stay with us in December.
example1_zh: 我表亲十二月要来我们家住。
example2_en: In many northern countries, energy demand increases in December as households need more heating during colder weather.
example2_zh: 在许多北方国家，十二月天气更冷，家庭需要更多供暖，因此能源需求增加。
collocations: in December｜在十二月 ; early December｜十二月初 ; late December｜十二月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；在十二月用in December。

meanings_zh: v. 递送；送达 | v. 发表；讲授 | v. 兑现；实现
definition_en: to take goods or messages to their intended destination | to give a speech, lecture, or presentation | to produce the results or benefits that were promised
example1_en: The bakery delivers warm bread to our door every morning.
example1_zh: 面包店每天早上把热乎乎的面包送到我们家门口。
example2_en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
example2_zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。
collocations: deliver a parcel｜递送包裹 ; deliver a speech｜发表演讲 ; deliver results｜取得成效 ; deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip_zh: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

meanings_zh: v. 憎恨；非常讨厌 | n. 憎恨；强烈厌恶
definition_en: To dislike someone or something very strongly. | A very strong feeling of dislike towards someone or something.
example1_en: I hate finding wet socks on the bathroom floor.
example1_zh: 我特别讨厌在浴室地板上发现湿袜子。
example2_en: Although many commuters hate crowded trains, affordable public transport remains essential for reducing urban traffic.
example2_zh: 虽然许多通勤者讨厌拥挤的列车，但价格实惠的公共交通对于缓解城市交通拥堵仍然至关重要。
collocations: hate doing something｜讨厌做某事 ; hate to admit｜不愿承认 ; full of hate｜充满仇恨
tip_zh: hate后可接动名词或不定式，语气比dislike强。

meanings_zh: n. 人群；观众 | v. 挤满；聚集
definition_en: A large group of people gathered in one place. | To gather closely together or fill a place with people.
example1_en: A crowd gathered around the musicians in the square.
example1_zh: 一群人聚在广场上的乐手周围。
example2_en: Large crowds at popular attractions can damage historic sites unless visitor numbers are carefully managed.
example2_zh: 热门景点的大量游客可能破坏历史遗址，除非游客数量得到妥善管理。
collocations: a large crowd｜一大群人 ; attract a crowd｜吸引人群 ; crowd into｜挤进 ; crowd control｜人群管控
tip_zh: a crowd of后接复数名词；crowded表示拥挤的。

meanings_zh: v. 睡觉 | n. 睡眠
definition_en: to rest with eyes closed and awareness reduced | the natural resting state in which awareness is reduced
example1_en: Our cat likes to sleep beside the warm radiator.
example1_zh: 我们的猫喜欢睡在温暖的暖气片旁边。
example2_en: Regular sleep supports memory and concentration, making it particularly important for students preparing for examinations.
example2_zh: 规律的睡眠有助于记忆和注意力，因此对备考学生尤其重要。
collocations: get enough sleep｜获得充足睡眠 ; fall asleep｜入睡 ; sleep well｜睡得好 ; lack of sleep｜睡眠不足
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为slept；入睡用fall asleep。

meanings_zh: n. 牙刷
definition_en: A small brush used for cleaning your teeth.
example1_en: I packed my toothbrush in the side pocket.
example1_zh: 我把牙刷装进了侧面的口袋。
example2_en: Replacing a worn toothbrush regularly helps maintain oral hygiene by ensuring that teeth are cleaned effectively.
example2_zh: 定期更换磨损的牙刷有助于确保牙齿得到有效清洁，从而保持口腔卫生。
collocations: electric toothbrush｜电动牙刷 ; soft toothbrush｜软毛牙刷 ; toothbrush holder｜牙刷架
tip_zh: 复数是toothbrushes，不是teethbrushes。

meanings_zh: n. 桌子 | n. 表格
definition_en: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs | information arranged in rows and columns
example1_en: We gathered around the table to share fresh bread.
example1_zh: 我们围坐在桌边，一起吃新鲜面包。
example2_en: The table compares average household spending on transport in three cities over a ten-year period.
example2_zh: 该表比较了三个城市十年间的家庭平均交通支出。
collocations: dining table｜餐桌 ; set the table｜摆好餐具 ; clear the table｜收拾餐桌 ; a table of results｜结果表
tip_zh: set the table指摆餐具，不是摆放桌子。

meanings_zh: n. 名；名字（名字中的第一个词）
definition_en: your personal name, not your family name
example1_en: My first name is Anna and my surname is Green.
example1_zh: 我的名字叫安娜，姓格林。
example2_en: Please write your first name in the box.
example2_zh: 请在方框里写下你的名字。
tip_zh: first name 是“名”，surname/family name 是“姓”。

meanings_zh: v. 感谢
definition_en: to tell someone you are grateful
example1_en: I want to thank you for your help.
example1_zh: 我想感谢你的帮助。
example2_en: She thanked the teacher for the present.
example2_zh: 她感谢老师送的礼物。
collocations: thank you｜谢谢你
tip_zh: thank sb for sth 是“为某事感谢某人”；thank you 是谢谢。

meanings_zh: v. 加入；参加 | v. 连接；接合 | v. 与……会合；一起做
definition_en: To become a member or take part with others. | To connect things or become connected. | To go where someone is and spend time with them.
example1_en: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
example1_zh: 你今天愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？
example2_en: Students who join local volunteer groups can develop practical skills while contributing to their communities.
example2_zh: 加入当地志愿者团体的学生可以在服务社区的同时培养实用技能。
collocations: join a club｜加入俱乐部 ; join in｜参与 ; join forces｜联合行动 ; join together｜连接起来
tip_zh: join a club指加入组织；join in指参与活动。

meanings_zh: n. 滑冰；溜冰
definition_en: the sport of moving on skates
example1_en: Skating on the frozen lake is great fun.
example1_zh: 在结冰的湖面上滑冰很好玩。
example2_en: She learned skating when she was six.
example2_zh: 她六岁就学会了滑冰。
collocations: ice skating｜滑冰
tip_zh: skating 指溜冰运动；ice skating 特指滑冰。

meanings_zh: n. 折扣 | v. 打折出售 | v. 不予考虑；低估
definition_en: a reduction in the usual price | to sell something at a reduced price | to consider something unlikely or less important
example1_en: The shop offers a discount on winter coats.
