example1_zh: 这家店的冬季外套有折扣。
example2_en: Public transport discounts can encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 公共交通票价优惠能鼓励更多通勤者不开车出门。
collocations: offer a discount｜提供折扣 ; at a discount｜以折扣价 ; discount the possibility｜不考虑这种可能性
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词通常读/dɪsˈkaʊnt/。

meanings_zh: adj. 有用的；有帮助的
definition_en: Helping you do something or achieve a purpose
example1_en: This little torch is useful when the power fails.
example1_zh: 停电时，这个小手电筒很有用。
example2_en: Reliable online resources can be useful for learners who lack access to well-equipped libraries.
example2_zh: 对于无法使用设备完善的图书馆的学习者来说，可靠的网络资源可能很有帮助。
collocations: useful advice｜有用的建议 ; useful information｜有用的信息 ; useful for learning｜对学习有用 ; a useful tool｜实用工具
tip_zh: 首音是辅音/j/，所以说a useful tool，不用an。

meanings_zh: v. 喜欢；喜爱 | prep. 像；与……相似 | prep. 例如；比如
definition_en: to enjoy something or feel positively about someone | similar to someone or something | used to introduce an example
example1_en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
example1_zh: 我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。
example2_en: Many residents like having green spaces nearby because they provide opportunities for exercise and relaxation.
example2_zh: 许多居民喜欢附近有绿地，因为绿地提供了锻炼和放松的机会。
collocations: like doing something｜喜欢做某事 ; would like to｜想要 ; look like｜看起来像 ; feel like doing something｜想做某事
tip_zh: would like to do 比 want to do 更礼貌。

meanings_zh: n. 便条；笔记 | v. 注意到；记下 | n. 音符；单音
definition_en: A short written message or record of useful information. | To notice something or record it in writing. | A single musical sound or a symbol representing it.
example1_en: I left a note beside your breakfast bowl.
example1_zh: 我在你的早餐碗旁留了一张便条。
example2_en: Students who take notes in their own words may develop a deeper understanding of complex material.
example2_zh: 用自己的话记笔记的学生可能会对复杂的学习材料形成更深入的理解。
collocations: take notes｜记笔记 ; leave a note｜留便条 ; note that｜注意到…… ; musical note｜音符
tip_zh: 记笔记用take notes；note that后接完整句子。

meanings_zh: v. 落下；跌倒；下降 | n. 跌落；下降 | n. 秋天（美式）
definition_en: To move downward, lose balance, or decrease. | An act of falling or a decrease in amount. | The season between summer and winter, especially in American English.
example1_en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
example1_zh: 金黄的叶子落在我们屋外的小路上。
example2_en: Energy consumption may fall if governments encourage households to install better insulation and efficient heating systems.
example2_zh: 如果政府鼓励家庭改善隔热条件并安装高效供暖系统，能源消耗可能会下降。
collocations: fall asleep｜入睡 ; fall in prices｜价格下降 ; fall sharply｜急剧下降 ; in the fall｜在秋天
tip_zh: 过去式fell，过去分词fallen；秋天英式常用autumn。

meanings_zh: n. 烤箱；烤炉
definition_en: an enclosed appliance used to bake or roast food
example1_en: The bread is still warm from the oven.
example1_zh: 面包刚出烤箱，还热乎着。
example2_en: Using an energy-efficient oven can reduce household electricity consumption without changing cooking habits significantly.
example2_zh: 使用节能烤箱可以减少家庭用电量，而不必大幅改变烹饪习惯。
collocations: preheat the oven｜预热烤箱 ; bake in the oven｜放入烤箱烘烤 ; oven temperature｜烤箱温度
tip_zh: oven指封闭烤箱；炉顶灶具通常叫hob或stove。

meanings_zh: n. 冲浪板
definition_en: a long board used for surfing on waves
example1_en: He carried his surfboard to the beach.
example1_zh: 他把冲浪板带到海滩。
example2_en: The surfboard floats on the water easily.
example2_zh: 冲浪板很容易浮在水上。
tip_zh: surfboard 是冲浪板；surfing 是冲浪运动。

meanings_zh: adj. 最差的；最严重的 | adv. 最差地；最严重地 | n. 最坏的情况；最糟的部分
definition_en: Worse than all others in quality, condition, or effect. | More badly or severely than anyone or anything else. | The most unpleasant situation, outcome, or part.
example1_en: That was the worst meal I have ever cooked.
example1_zh: 那是我做过的最糟糕的一顿饭。
example2_en: The worst effects of air pollution are often experienced by children and older people in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 在人口密集的城市，儿童和老年人往往受到空气污染最严重的影响。
collocations: the worst possible outcome｜最坏的可能结果 ; at worst｜在最坏的情况下 ; prepare for the worst｜做最坏的打算 ; worst affected｜受影响最严重的
tip_zh: worst是bad和badly的最高级；比较级是worse。

meanings_zh: adj. 最好的；最佳的 | adv. 最好地；最 | n. 最佳表现；最好事物
definition_en: Better than all others in quality or suitability. | In the most successful way or to the greatest degree. | The finest performance, effort, or thing available.
example1_en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
example1_zh: 这家面包店做的面包是我们街区最好的。
example2_en: Investing in early education may be the best way to reduce inequality over time.
example2_zh: 投资早期教育可能是逐步减少不平等的最佳方式。
collocations: the best option｜最佳选择 ; do your best｜尽最大努力 ; at its best｜处于最佳状态 ; like something best｜最喜欢某物
tip_zh: best是good和well的最高级；形容词前通常加the。

meanings_zh: det. 一些；任何一个 | pron. 一些；任何一个 | adv. 丝毫；一点
definition_en: Some in questions or negatives; whichever one, without restriction. | Some or whichever ones, without naming the people or things. | At all, used mainly with comparisons in questions or negatives.
example1_en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
example1_zh: 这个书架上的书，你想借哪本都可以。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that all children can attend school without facing any financial barriers.
example2_zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能上学，不受任何经济障碍的阻碍。
collocations: any questions｜任何问题 ; at any time｜随时 ; any of these｜这些中的任何一个 ; hardly any｜几乎没有
tip_zh: 疑问、否定句中常表“一些”；肯定句中常表“任何”。

meanings_zh: n. 计算机；电脑
definition_en: An electronic machine that stores and processes information using programs.
example1_en: My computer froze while I was editing holiday photos.
example1_zh: 我编辑度假照片时，电脑卡住了。
example2_en: Access to a computer at home can help students complete assignments and develop essential digital skills.
example2_zh: 在家能使用电脑可以帮助学生完成作业，并培养必要的数字技能。
collocations: computer software｜计算机软件 ; computer skills｜计算机操作技能 ; computer network｜计算机网络 ; computer science｜计算机科学
tip_zh: 在电脑上工作用work on a computer。

meanings_zh: n. 教练 | n. 长途客车 | v. 训练；辅导
definition_en: someone who trains people to improve their sporting skills | a comfortable bus used for longer journeys | to train or teach someone to improve particular skills
example1_en: Our coach showed us how to hold the racket.
example1_zh: 我们的教练示范了如何握球拍。
example2_en: A skilled coach can help young athletes build confidence while developing healthy attitudes towards competition.
example2_zh: 优秀的教练能帮助年轻运动员建立信心，同时培养他们对竞争的健康态度。
collocations: sports coach｜体育教练 ; travel by coach｜乘长途客车出行 ; coach a team｜训练一支队伍 ; coach someone for an exam｜辅导某人备考
tip_zh: 英式英语中coach也指长途客车，bus多指公交车。

meanings_zh: n. 发动机；引擎 | n. 推动力 | n. 专用软件引擎
definition_en: a machine that produces power to make something move | something that strongly drives growth or change | software that performs a particular core task within a system
example1_en: The engine stopped just as we reached the driveway.
example1_zh: 我们刚到车道入口，发动机就熄火了。
example2_en: Cleaner engine technology can reduce air pollution, although expanding public transport remains essential for sustainable urban travel.
example2_zh: 更清洁的发动机技术可以减少空气污染，但扩大公共交通仍是实现城市可持续出行的关键。
collocations: start the engine｜启动发动机 ; jet engine｜喷气发动机 ; search engine｜搜索引擎 ; an engine of growth｜增长的推动力
tip_zh: engine多指燃料发动机；电动机通常用motor。

meanings_zh: n. 购物 | n. 买来的物品（英）
definition_en: The activity of looking for and buying things. | The things you have bought during a shopping trip.
example1_en: We usually do our shopping early on Saturday mornings.
example1_zh: 我们通常在星期六一早去购物。
example2_en: The growth of online shopping has changed consumer habits and increased demand for home delivery services.
example2_zh: 网上购物的发展改变了消费者习惯，也增加了对送货上门服务的需求。
collocations: go shopping｜去购物 ; do the shopping｜采购日用品 ; online shopping｜网上购物 ; shopping centre｜购物中心
tip_zh: shopping作名词不可数；“去购物”用go shopping。

meanings_zh: n. 地址；网址 | v. 处理；设法解决 | v. 向…讲话；致辞
definition_en: Details identifying where someone lives or something can be found. | To give attention to a problem and try to solve it. | To speak directly to a person or group.
example1_en: Please send me your address before I post the parcel.
example1_zh: 请在我寄包裹之前把你的地址发给我。
example2_en: Governments need to address housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
example2_zh: 政府需要通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通连接来应对住房短缺。
collocations: postal address｜邮寄地址 ; email address｜电子邮箱地址 ; address a problem｜处理问题 ; address an audience｜向听众讲话
tip_zh: 美音动词读/əˈdres/；address问题不等于已解决。

meanings_zh: n. 账单 | n. 法案 | n. 钞票
definition_en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services | a proposed law being considered by a lawmaking body | a piece of paper money, especially in American English
example1_en: We asked for the bill after finishing our lunch.
example1_zh: 吃完午饭后，我们请服务员拿来账单。
example2_en: The proposed bill would require companies to disclose more information about their impact on the environment.
example2_zh: 这项拟议法案将要求企业披露更多有关其环境影响的信息。
collocations: pay a bill｜支付账单 ; electricity bill｜电费账单 ; pass a bill｜通过法案 ; a dollar bill｜一张美元钞票
tip_zh: bill是待审议的法案；通过并生效后才成为法律。

meanings_zh: v. 应该；应当 | v. 按理会；应该会 | v. 本应该
definition_en: used to give advice or say what is right | used to say something is expected or likely | used with have to describe an unfulfilled duty or expectation
example1_en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
example1_zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。
example2_en: Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 政府应该投资于价格实惠的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: should do something｜应该做某事 ; should have done｜本应该做过 ; should be able to｜应该能够
tip_zh: 情态动词，后接动词原形；should have done常指本该做却未做。

meanings_zh: n. 自然环境 | n. 生活或工作环境
definition_en: The natural world, including land, water, air, and living things. | The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.
example1_en: We cycle to school to help protect the environment.
example1_zh: 我们骑车上学，为保护环境出一份力。
example2_en: A supportive learning environment can improve students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively.
example2_zh: 支持性的学习环境能够增强学生的信心，鼓励他们更加积极地参与。
collocations: protect the environment｜保护环境 ; natural environment｜自然环境 ; working environment｜工作环境 ; learning environment｜学习环境
tip_zh: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。

meanings_zh: phr. 通过邮寄
definition_en: sent through the mail
example1_en: I sent the birthday card by post.
example1_zh: 我把生日贺卡寄出去了。
example2_en: You can pay by post or online.
example2_zh: 你可以邮寄付款或在线付款。
tip_zh: by post 是英式说法，美式常说 by mail。

meanings_zh: adj. 完美的；最合适的 | v. 使完善；使精通 | adj. 完成时的
definition_en: without faults, or exactly right for a particular purpose | to improve something until it is as good as possible | describing verb forms using have with a past participle
example1_en: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
example1_zh: 这个安静的角落特别适合午饭后看书。
example2_en: Although no transport system is perfect, reliable public services can significantly reduce a city's dependence on cars.
example2_zh: 尽管没有完美的交通系统，可靠的公共交通服务仍能显著减少城市对汽车的依赖。
collocations: perfect timing｜恰到好处的时机 ; perfect for｜非常适合 ; perfect a technique｜完善一项技术 ; present perfect｜现在完成时
tip_zh: 形容词重音在前；动词读/pəˈfekt/（英）。

meanings_zh: v. 获胜；赢得 | v. 争取到；获得 | n. 胜利
definition_en: To succeed in a competition or receive a prize. | To gain something through effort or personal qualities. | A successful result in a competition or contest.
example1_en: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
example1_zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们队还是赢得了比赛。
example2_en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
example2_zh: 为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。
collocations: win a prize｜获奖 ; win a match｜赢得比赛 ; win support｜赢得支持 ; win someone's trust｜赢得某人的信任
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为won；赢比赛用win，击败人用beat。

meanings_zh: v. 生长；增长；发展 | v. 种植 | v. 逐渐变得
definition_en: To become bigger or develop over time. | To raise plants for food or other purposes. | To gradually become different in condition or feeling.
example1_en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房窗边的花盆里种新鲜香草。
example2_en: As cities grow, local authorities must invest in transport systems that serve expanding populations.
example2_zh: 随着城市发展，地方政府必须投资建设满足不断增长的人口需求的交通系统。
collocations: grow rapidly｜迅速增长 ; grow vegetables｜种蔬菜 ; grow older｜年龄渐长 ; grow increasingly concerned｜变得越来越担忧
tip_zh: 过去式grew，过去分词grown；表变得后接形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 盒子；箱子 | v. 把…装箱 | v. 打拳击
definition_en: a container with firm sides, often with a lid | to put something into a box | to compete in a sport using punches and protective gloves
example1_en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
example1_zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。
example2_en: Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.
example2_zh: 零售商可以选择与每件商品大小相近的箱子，以减少包装浪费。
collocations: cardboard box｜纸箱 ; a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力 ; box up｜装箱
tip_zh: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。

meanings_zh: adj. 每周的；每周一次的 | adv. 每周一次地 | n. 周刊；周报
definition_en: Happening once a week or relating to one week | Once every week | A newspaper or magazine published once a week
example1_en: Our weekly shopping trip usually ends at the bakery.
example1_zh: 我们每周的购物之行通常以去面包店收尾。
example2_en: Weekly exercise classes at community centres can help older residents stay active and build social connections.
example2_zh: 社区中心每周开设的健身课可以帮助老年居民保持活力并建立社交联系。
collocations: a weekly meeting｜每周例会 ; weekly earnings｜周收入 ; published weekly｜每周出版
tip_zh: 既可作形容词也可作副词：a weekly meeting；meet weekly。

meanings_zh: n. 窗帘；帘子 | n. 舞台幕布
definition_en: hanging fabric used to cover a window or divide space | a large hanging cloth that hides or reveals a stage
example1_en: She pulled the curtain aside to watch the rain.
example1_zh: 她把窗帘拉到一边，看着外面的雨。
example2_en: Installing a thick curtain over each window can reduce heat loss and improve comfort in older homes.
example2_zh: 在每扇窗户上安装厚窗帘，可以减少热量流失，提升老房屋的居住舒适度。
collocations: draw the curtains｜拉上或拉开窗帘 ; shower curtain｜浴帘 ; stage curtain｜舞台幕布 ; curtain rail｜窗帘轨道
tip_zh: draw the curtains可指拉开或拉上，需看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 广告（英式口语）
definition_en: a short announcement or film that tells people about a product
example1_en: I saw an advert for the new phone on TV.
example1_zh: 我在电视上看到新手机的广告。
example2_en: The shop put an advert in the local newspaper.
example2_zh: 这家商店在本地报纸上登了广告。
collocations: TV advert｜电视广告
tip_zh: advert 是英式口语说法，等于 advertisement。

meanings_zh: n. 乐趣；快乐 | adj. 有趣的；令人愉快的
definition_en: Enjoyment or pleasure from an activity or experience. | Enjoyable and entertaining.
example1_en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们一起堆沙堡，玩得特别开心。
example2_en: Making physical activity fun can encourage children to exercise regularly and develop healthier habits throughout their lives.
example2_zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童经常锻炼，并养成终身受益的健康习惯。
collocations: have fun｜玩得开心 ; for fun｜为了好玩 ; make fun of｜取笑 ; good fun｜很有趣
tip_zh: fun作名词不可数；funny多指好笑的或奇怪的。

meanings_zh: v. 拉；拖；拔 | n. 拉；拉力 | v. 拉伤肌肉
definition_en: to move something towards you or along by holding it | an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer | to injure a muscle by stretching it too much
example1_en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
example1_zh: 请轻轻拉门，不要推。
example2_en: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.
example2_zh: 马匹曾在城市中拉运重物，但机动车最终取代了它们的大部分运输职能。
collocations: pull a muscle｜拉伤肌肉 ; pull a door open｜把门拉开 ; pull out a tooth｜拔牙 ; gravitational pull｜引力
tip_zh: pull是朝自己方向拉；push是向外推。

meanings_zh: n. 交通；路上车辆 | n. 通信量；网络流量
definition_en: Vehicles moving along roads in a particular area | The amount of data or messages passing through a system
example1_en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
example1_zh: 交通拥堵又让我们吃晚饭迟到了。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: heavy traffic｜繁忙的交通 ; traffic congestion｜交通拥堵 ; traffic lights｜交通信号灯 ; internet traffic｜互联网流量
tip_zh: 表示交通或车流时不可数，不说a traffic。

meanings_zh: n. 胡须；络腮胡子
definition_en: Hair growing on a person's chin and cheeks.
example1_en: He trimmed his beard before leaving for work.
example1_zh: 他上班出门前修剪了胡须。
example2_en: In some workplaces, employees with beards must use special coverings to maintain food hygiene standards.
example2_zh: 在一些工作场所，蓄胡须的员工必须佩戴专用罩具，以符合食品卫生标准。
collocations: grow a beard｜蓄胡须 ; trim a beard｜修剪胡须 ; a thick beard｜浓密的胡须
tip_zh: beard指下巴及两颊胡须；moustache指上唇胡须。

meanings_zh: adj. 湿的；潮湿的 | adj. 多雨的；下雨的 | v. 弄湿
definition_en: Covered with or containing water or another liquid | Having rain or frequent rainfall | To put water or another liquid onto something
example1_en: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
example1_zh: 我踩进水坑，把袜子弄湿了。
example2_en: Prolonged wet weather can damage crops and make it harder for farmers to harvest them efficiently.
example2_zh: 持续的阴雨天气会损害庄稼，使农民更难高效收获。
collocations: get wet｜变湿 ; wet weather｜阴雨天气 ; soaking wet｜湿透的 ; wet the cloth｜把布弄湿
tip_zh: damp指微湿；soaking wet表示湿透。

meanings_zh: n. 钱；货币 | n. 财富；财产
definition_en: What people use to pay for goods and services. | The wealth that a person or organisation owns.
example1_en: I saved enough money to buy a new bicycle.
example1_zh: 我攒够了买一辆新自行车的钱。
example2_en: Governments should invest more money in public transport to reduce congestion and improve air quality.
example2_zh: 政府应该向公共交通投入更多资金，以缓解拥堵并改善空气质量。
collocations: save money｜省钱；存钱 ; spend money on｜花钱买 ; value for money｜物有所值 ; raise money｜筹款
tip_zh: 通常不可数：说much money，不说many money。

meanings_zh: v. 同意；赞成 | v. 商定；答应
definition_en: Have the same opinion or accept someone else's view | Decide something together or promise to do something
example1_en: I agree with you that this soup needs salt.
example1_zh: 我同意你的看法，这汤需要加盐。
example2_en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
example2_zh: 大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。
collocations: agree with someone｜同意某人的观点 ; agree on a plan｜就计划达成一致 ; agree to do something｜答应做某事 ; agree to a proposal｜同意一项提议
tip_zh: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 软件
definition_en: programs that tell a computer how to perform tasks
example1_en: This software helps me edit photos on my laptop.
example1_zh: 这个软件帮助我在笔记本电脑上编辑照片。
example2_en: Schools need reliable software and adequate teacher training to make effective use of digital learning tools.
example2_zh: 学校需要可靠的软件和充分的教师培训，才能有效利用数字学习工具。
collocations: install software｜安装软件 ; software development｜软件开发 ; software update｜软件更新 ; open-source software｜开源软件
tip_zh: 不可数：说some software，不说a software。

meanings_zh: v. 要不要；好吗 | v. 将会；必将 | v. 必须；应当
definition_en: Used with I or we to offer or suggest something. | Used with I or we to express future intentions formally. | Used in formal rules to state a requirement.
example1_en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
example1_zh: 我们晚饭后去散一会儿步好吗？
example2_en: Under the proposed regulations, employers shall provide appropriate safety equipment for all workers handling hazardous materials.
example2_zh: 根据拟议规定，雇主必须为所有接触危险材料的工人提供适当的安全装备。
collocations: shall we｜我们要不要 ; shall I｜要我来……吗 ; shall not｜不得
tip_zh: 情态动词，后接动词原形；Shall we常用于提议。

meanings_zh: adv. 现在；如今 | adv. 马上；立刻 | conj. 既然；由于
definition_en: at the present time | immediately, without waiting | because a situation has changed or become true
example1_en: We live near the station now, so walking is easy.
example1_zh: 我们现在住在车站附近，步行过去很方便。
example2_en: Now that online courses are widely available, more adults can continue their education while working.
example2_zh: 既然在线课程已广泛普及，更多成年人就能在工作的同时继续接受教育。
collocations: right now｜现在；马上 ; by now｜到现在为止 ; from now on｜从现在起 ; now that｜既然
tip_zh: now that引导原因从句，强调情况已发生变化。

meanings_zh: adj. 真实的；实际存在的 | adj. 真的；非仿制的 | adj. 实际的；扣除通胀的
definition_en: existing in fact rather than being imagined | genuine rather than copied or artificial | measured after allowing for changes in prices
example1_en: I thought the bird was plastic, but it was real.
example1_zh: 我以为那只鸟是塑料的，没想到是真的。
example2_en: Although average salaries have increased, rising prices mean that many workers have experienced a fall in real income.
example2_zh: 虽然平均工资上涨了，但物价上涨意味着许多劳动者的实际收入有所下降。
collocations: real life｜现实生活 ; real leather｜真皮 ; real income｜实际收入 ; real danger｜真正的危险
tip_zh: real修饰名词；表示“很、真正地”通常用really。

meanings_zh: pron. 某人；有人
definition_en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated
example1_en: Someone left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
example1_zh: 有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。
example2_en: Students may feel more confident seeking help when someone they trust is available to discuss their concerns.
example2_zh: 如果有信任的人可以倾听他们的困扰，学生求助时可能会更有信心。
collocations: someone else｜别人 ; someone special｜特别的人 ; someone to talk to｜可以倾诉的人
tip_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数；后文可用they指代。

meanings_zh: v. 听见；听到 | v. 听说；得知 | v. 审理；听取
definition_en: notice a sound through your ears | receive information about something | listen formally to evidence or arguments
example1_en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
example1_zh: 我能听见卧室窗外的鸟鸣声。
example2_en: Local councils should hear residents' concerns before making decisions about major changes to public transport.
example2_zh: 地方议会在对公共交通作出重大调整前，应听取居民的顾虑。
collocations: hear from someone｜收到某人的消息 ; hear about something｜听说某事 ; hear a case｜审理案件 ; hear both sides｜听取双方意见
tip_zh: hear强调听见；listen to强调主动听。过去式heard。

meanings_zh: n. 万维网 | n. 蜘蛛网 | n. 复杂网络；错综关系
definition_en: The system of connected pages accessed through the internet. | A structure of fine threads a spider makes to catch insects. | A complicated network of connected things or relationships.
example1_en: I found a simple soup recipe on the web.
example1_zh: 我在网上找到了一份简单的汤谱。
example2_en: Although the web provides convenient access to information, students must learn to evaluate the reliability of online sources.
example2_zh: 虽然万维网让获取信息更方便，但学生必须学会评估网络来源的可靠性。
collocations: browse the web｜浏览网页 ; a spider's web｜蜘蛛网 ; a web of relationships｜错综复杂的关系网
tip_zh: 上网常用on the web；web不完全等同于internet。

meanings_zh: n. 滑冰
definition_en: the sport of moving on ice wearing skates
example1_en: We go ice skating every winter.
example1_zh: 我们每年冬天都去滑冰。
example2_en: Ice skating is fun but you have to be careful.
example2_zh: 滑冰很有趣，但要小心。
tip_zh: ice skating 是“滑冰”运动；ice skates 是冰鞋。

meanings_zh: adv. 请；劳驾 | v. 使高兴；使满意
definition_en: Used to make a request or offer more polite. | To make someone feel happy or satisfied.
example1_en: Could you please hold the door for me?
example1_zh: 你能帮我扶一下门吗？
example2_en: Public policies designed to please every group may fail to address the most urgent social problems.
example2_zh: 旨在取悦所有群体的公共政策，可能无法解决最紧迫的社会问题。
collocations: please do｜请吧；请务必 ; please everyone｜让所有人满意 ; hard to please｜难以取悦 ; as you please｜随你的意愿
tip_zh: please是动词；感到满意用be pleased。

meanings_zh: adj. 坚硬的 | adj. 困难的；艰苦的 | adv. 努力地；猛烈地
definition_en: Firm and not easily bent, cut, or pressed | Requiring considerable effort or being difficult to endure | With great effort, force, or intensity
example1_en: This bread is too hard to bite into.
example1_zh: 这块面包太硬了，咬不动。
example2_en: Many students work hard to gain qualifications, yet still find it difficult to secure stable employment.
example2_zh: 许多学生努力取得学历或资格，却仍然难以找到稳定的工作。
collocations: hard work｜艰苦的工作 ; work hard｜努力工作 ; hard evidence｜确凿的证据 ; hard surface｜坚硬的表面
tip_zh: hard可作副词“努力地”；hardly意为“几乎不”。

meanings_zh: n. 航班；空中旅程 | n. 飞行 | n. 一段楼梯
definition_en: A journey through the air, especially in an aircraft. | The act or ability of moving through the air. | A continuous set of stairs between floors or landings.
example1_en: Our flight leaves early, so we should pack tonight.
example1_zh: 我们的航班出发很早，所以今晚应该收拾好行李。
example2_en: Reducing the number of short domestic flights could lower emissions where reliable rail alternatives already exist.
example2_zh: 在已有可靠铁路替代方案的地区，减少短途国内航班可以降低排放。
collocations: book a flight｜预订航班 ; direct flight｜直达航班 ; in flight｜飞行中 ; a flight of stairs｜一段楼梯
tip_zh: a flight of stairs指两层或平台之间的一段楼梯。

meanings_zh: n. 顺序；秩序 | v. 订购；点餐；命令 | n. 订单；命令
definition_en: the arrangement of things or a controlled, peaceful situation | to request goods or food, or tell someone what to do | a request for goods or an instruction that must be obeyed
example1_en: Please put these photos in the correct order.
example1_zh: 请把这些照片按正确顺序排列。
example2_en: Online shoppers can now order fresh produce directly from local farms, supporting regional economies.
example2_zh: 网购者如今可以直接向当地农场订购新鲜农产品，从而支持地区经济。
collocations: in alphabetical order｜按字母顺序 ; place an order｜下订单 ; order a meal｜点餐 ; order someone to do something｜命令某人做某事
tip_zh: in order指按顺序；in order to后接动词，表示为了。

meanings_zh: adj. 糟糕的；令人不快的 | adj. 可怕的；严重的
definition_en: Very bad or unpleasant. | Causing great fear, suffering, or harm.
example1_en: The soup tasted terrible, so I made a sandwich.
example1_zh: 汤很难喝，于是我做了个三明治。
example2_en: Poor waste management can have terrible consequences for public health, especially in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 垃圾管理不善可能给公共健康带来严重后果，在人口密集的城市尤其如此。
collocations: terrible weather｜糟糕的天气 ; a terrible mistake｜严重的错误 ; feel terrible｜感觉很难受
tip_zh: terrible是形容词；表示“非常”通常用terribly。

meanings_zh: v. 感到；觉得 | v. 触摸；摸索 | n. 触感；氛围
definition_en: Experience an emotion, physical sensation, or personal belief. | Touch something to discover its texture, shape, or position. | The quality something has when touched or experienced.
example1_en: I feel much warmer with this soft blanket.
example1_zh: 盖着这条柔软的毯子，我觉得暖和多了。
example2_en: Residents often feel safer when public spaces are well lit and regularly maintained by local authorities.
example2_zh: 当公共空间照明充足且由地方政府定期维护时，居民往往更有安全感。
collocations: feel comfortable｜感到舒适 ; feel strongly about｜对……有强烈看法 ; feel like doing something｜想做某事 ; get a feel for｜逐渐了解
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为felt；feel后可直接接形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 地面；土地 | n. 理由；根据 | v. 使停飞
definition_en: The solid surface of the earth. | Reasons or evidence supporting a belief, decision, or action. | To prevent an aircraft from flying.
example1_en: We spread a blanket on the ground beneath a tree.
example1_zh: 我们在树下的地面上铺了一条毯子。
example2_en: Planting trees helps the ground retain moisture and reduces the risk of soil erosion.
example2_zh: 植树有助于土地保持水分，并降低水土流失的风险。
collocations: on the ground｜在地面上 ; grounds for complaint｜投诉的理由 ; common ground｜共同点 ; ground a plane｜使飞机停飞
tip_zh: 表示理由常用复数grounds；ground也是grind的过去式。

meanings_zh: n. 玩具 | v. 摆弄；漫不经心地考虑
definition_en: An object that children use for play. | To handle casually or consider without serious commitment.
example1_en: The baby dropped her toy behind the sofa.
example1_zh: 宝宝把她的玩具掉到了沙发后面。
example2_en: Well-designed toys can encourage young children to develop practical skills through creative play and exploration.
example2_zh: 设计精良的玩具可以鼓励幼儿通过创意游戏和探索来培养实践技能。
collocations: soft toy｜毛绒玩具 ; toy car｜玩具汽车 ; toy with an idea｜随意考虑一个想法
tip_zh: 动词常用toy with；toy with an idea指并不认真地考虑。

meanings_zh: adv. 这么；如此；非常 | conj. 所以；因此 | adv. 这样；如此
definition_en: to such a degree or extent | used to introduce a result or consequence | used instead of repeating an idea already mentioned
example1_en: The soup was so hot that I had to wait.
example1_zh: 汤太烫了，我只好等一会儿。
example2_en: Public transport is limited in rural areas, so many residents rely on private cars for essential journeys.
example2_zh: 农村地区的公共交通有限，因此许多居民依靠私家车进行必要的出行。
collocations: so much｜这么多 ; so far｜到目前为止 ; so that｜以便；因此 ; think so｜认为如此
tip_zh: so修饰形容词或副词；such通常修饰名词短语。

meanings_zh: v. 攀登；爬 | v. 上升；增加 | n. 攀登；上升
definition_en: to move upwards using your feet and often your hands | to increase in amount or level | an act of moving upwards or an increase in level
example1_en: We climbed the hill before stopping for a picnic.
example1_zh: 我们爬上山坡，然后停下来野餐。
example2_en: As housing costs continue to climb, many young adults struggle to live independently in major cities.
example2_zh: 随着住房成本持续上涨，许多年轻人难以在大城市独立生活。
collocations: climb a mountain｜登山 ; climb stairs｜爬楼梯 ; a steep climb｜陡峭的攀登路段 ; climb steadily｜稳步上升
tip_zh: 词尾b不发音；climb a mountain不加介词。

meanings_zh: n. 鸟
definition_en: an animal with feathers, wings, and a beak that lays eggs
example1_en: A small bird built a nest above our window.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟在我们窗户上方筑了巢。
example2_en: Protecting native bird species requires preserving their habitats and reducing pollution in both rural and urban areas.
example2_zh: 保护本土鸟类需要维护其栖息地，并减少乡村和城市地区的污染。
collocations: a flock of birds｜一群鸟 ; a migratory bird｜候鸟 ; bird watching｜观鸟 ; a bird of prey｜猛禽
tip_zh: 鸟群用a flock of birds；bird本身是可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 游戏；比赛 | n. 猎物；野味 | adj. 愿意尝试的；有胆量的
definition_en: an activity or contest played according to rules | wild animals hunted for food or sport, or their meat | willing to try something difficult or unfamiliar
example1_en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天晚饭后我们玩了一个桌游。
example2_en: Cooperative games can help children develop communication skills and learn to solve problems together.
example2_zh: 合作型游戏能帮助儿童培养沟通能力，并学会共同解决问题。
collocations: board game｜桌游 ; team game｜团队运动 ; video game｜电子游戏 ; be game for｜愿意尝试
tip_zh: 猎物义不可数；be game for表示愿意尝试。

meanings_zh: adj. 单个的；仅一个的 | adj. 单身的；未婚的 | adj. 单程的
definition_en: Only one, rather than several or many. | Not married or not in a romantic relationship. | For travel to a destination without a return journey.
example1_en: A single candle lit the room during the power cut.
example1_zh: 停电时，房间里只有一支蜡烛照明。
example2_en: No single policy can solve urban congestion without improvements to public transport and local planning.
example2_zh: 如果不改善公共交通和地方规划，任何单一政策都无法解决城市拥堵。
collocations: a single person｜一个人；单身人士 ; every single day｜每一天 ; a single ticket｜单程票 ; a single parent｜单亲家长
tip_zh: 单程票英式常说single ticket，美式用one-way ticket。

meanings_zh: n. 卡车；货车
definition_en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.
example1_en: A lorry delivered fresh vegetables to the shop.
example1_zh: 一辆货车把新鲜蔬菜送到了店里。
example2_en: Restricting lorry deliveries during peak hours could reduce congestion and improve road safety in city centres.
example2_zh: 限制货车在高峰时段送货，可以缓解市中心的拥堵并改善道路安全。
collocations: lorry driver｜货车司机 ; delivery lorry｜送货卡车 ; load a lorry｜给卡车装货
tip_zh: lorry主要用于英式英语，美式英语通常用truck。

meanings_zh: n. 公园 | v. 停车；泊车 | n. 专用园区
definition_en: An open area with grass and trees for public enjoyment. | To stop a vehicle somewhere and leave it there. | An area set aside for a particular activity or purpose.
example1_en: We shared a picnic under the trees in the park.
example1_zh: 我们在公园的树下共进了野餐。
example2_en: Providing a park within walking distance of every neighbourhood can encourage exercise and strengthen community ties.
example2_zh: 让每个社区步行可达公园，有助于鼓励锻炼并加强社区联系。
collocations: public park｜公共公园 ; park a car｜停车 ; business park｜商务园区 ; national park｜国家公园
tip_zh: 公园用park；英式英语中停车场用car park。

meanings_zh: v. 赶紧；催促 | n. 匆忙；仓促
definition_en: To move or act quickly, or make someone do so. | A need to act quickly because time is limited.
example1_en: We hurried home before the rain began to fall.
example1_zh: 我们赶在下雨前匆忙回家了。
example2_en: When teachers hurry through difficult material, students may struggle to develop a clear understanding of key concepts.
example2_zh: 教师匆忙讲解难点内容时，学生可能难以清楚理解核心概念。
collocations: hurry up｜快点 ; in a hurry｜匆忙地 ; hurry home｜匆忙回家 ; hurry through something｜匆忙做完某事
tip_zh: hurry up表示催促；in a hurry表示匆忙。

meanings_zh: n. 男孩
definition_en: a male child or young male person
example1_en: The boy carefully carried his puppy across the puddle.
example1_zh: 那个男孩小心地抱着小狗跨过水坑。
example2_en: Every boy and girl should have equal access to education, regardless of their family's income.
example2_zh: 无论家庭收入如何，每个男孩和女孩都应享有平等的受教育机会。
collocations: a little boy｜小男孩 ; a teenage boy｜十几岁的男孩 ; a baby boy｜男婴
tip_zh: 通常指未成年男性；称成年男性为boy可能不礼貌。

meanings_zh: n. 兽毛；软毛 | n. 毛皮；裘皮
definition_en: the thick soft hair covering some animals | animal skin with hair attached, used for making clothing
example1_en: The cat's wet fur dried quickly in the sunshine.
example1_zh: 猫湿漉漉的毛在阳光下很快就干了。
example2_en: Thick fur helps many mammals survive in cold climates by trapping a layer of warm air.
example2_zh: 浓密的毛通过留住一层暖空气，帮助许多哺乳动物在寒冷气候中生存。
collocations: thick fur｜浓密的毛 ; soft fur｜柔软的毛 ; faux fur｜人造毛皮 ; fur coat｜裘皮大衣
tip_zh: 指动物身上的毛通常不可数；羽毛用feather。

meanings_zh: n. 鸡 | n. 鸡肉
definition_en: A bird kept for its eggs or meat. | Meat from a chicken, eaten as food.
example1_en: The chickens scratched the soil beside our vegetable patch.
example1_zh: 那些鸡在我们的菜地旁刨土。
example2_en: Replacing some red meat with chicken can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.
example2_zh: 用鸡肉替代部分红肉，可以减少个人饮食对环境的影响。
collocations: keep chickens｜养鸡 ; roast chicken｜烤鸡 ; chicken breast｜鸡胸肉 ; chicken soup｜鸡汤
tip_zh: 指活鸡时可数，指鸡肉时不可数；小鸡常用chick。

meanings_zh: n. 女商人；女企业家
definition_en: a woman who works in business
example1_en: My aunt is a successful businesswoman.
example1_zh: 我姑姑是一位成功的女企业家。
example2_en: The businesswoman held a meeting with her team.
example2_zh: 这位女商人召集团队开了会。
tip_zh: businesswoman 复数形式是 businesswomen。

meanings_zh: n. 奶；牛奶 | v. 挤奶
definition_en: A white liquid female mammals produce to feed their young. | Take milk from an animal, especially a cow.
example1_en: I poured some cold milk over my cereal.
example1_zh: 我往麦片上倒了些冷牛奶。
example2_en: Milk provides calcium and protein, although people with certain dietary needs may choose suitable alternatives.
example2_zh: 牛奶提供钙和蛋白质，但有特殊饮食需求的人可以选择合适的替代品。
collocations: a glass of milk｜一杯牛奶 ; skimmed milk｜脱脂牛奶 ; milk a cow｜给奶牛挤奶
tip_zh: milk通常不可数；说a glass of milk，不说a milk。

meanings_zh: n. 胃；腹部 | v. 忍受；容忍
definition_en: The organ that digests food, or the surrounding body area | To accept something unpleasant without feeling upset or disgusted
example1_en: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
example1_zh: 我做晚饭时，肚子开始咕咕叫。
example2_en: Eating regular meals may help prevent stomach discomfort and support healthy eating habits among students.
example2_zh: 规律进餐可能有助于预防胃部不适，并帮助学生养成健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: an empty stomach｜空腹 ; stomach ache｜胃痛；肚子痛 ; stomach pain｜胃痛
tip_zh: 表示“忍受”时，常用于 can't stomach 结构。

meanings_zh: conj. 和；并且 | conj. 然后；就
definition_en: Connects words or statements that belong together. | Connects an action with what follows or results from it.
example1_en: I bought fresh bread and cheese for our picnic.
example1_zh: 我为我们的野餐买了新鲜面包和奶酪。
example2_en: Governments should invest in public transport and encourage cycling to reduce congestion in growing cities.
example2_zh: 政府应投资公共交通并鼓励骑行，以缓解发展中城市的交通拥堵。
collocations: both ... and ...｜……和……都 ; and so on｜等等 ; more and more｜越来越多 ; again and again｜一次又一次
tip_zh: 连接并列成分时注意结构一致；口语常弱读/ən/。

meanings_zh: n. 类型；形式；形状 | n. 表格 | v. 形成；组成；建立
definition_en: a type, arrangement, or shape of something | a document with spaces for providing requested information | to develop, create, or combine into something
example1_en: The clouds took the form of a giant rabbit.
example1_zh: 那些云呈现出一只巨兔的形状。
example2_en: Online learning has become a popular form of education because it offers flexibility for working adults.
example2_zh: 在线学习已成为一种受欢迎的教育形式，因为它为在职成年人提供了灵活性。
collocations: a form of｜一种…… ; in the form of｜以……的形式 ; fill in a form｜填写表格 ; form a habit｜养成习惯
tip_zh: fill in a form是英式说法；美式常用fill out a form。

meanings_zh: det. 大多数的；最多的 | pron. 大多数；最大部分 | adv. 最；非常
definition_en: the majority of something, or the greatest amount or number | the majority or greatest part of a group or amount | to the greatest degree; sometimes used to mean very
example1_en: Most shops here close before we finish work.
example1_zh: 这里大多数商店在我们下班前就关门了。
example2_en: Most urban residents would benefit from reliable public transport that connects residential areas with major employment centres.
example2_zh: 大多数城市居民都会受益于连接住宅区与主要就业中心的可靠公共交通。
collocations: most people｜大多数人 ; most of the time｜大部分时间 ; at most｜至多 ; the most important｜最重要的
tip_zh: 泛指用most people；特指用most of the people。

meanings_zh: n. 故事；经历的叙述 | n. 新闻报道 | n. 楼层（美式）
definition_en: an account of real or imagined events | a report about an event in the news | one level of a building, in American English
example1_en: Grandma told us a funny story about her childhood.
example1_zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个她童年的趣事。
example2_en: Sharing a personal story can help students understand historical events from a more human perspective.
example2_zh: 分享个人经历可以帮助学生从更有人情味的角度理解历史事件。
collocations: tell a story｜讲故事 ; short story｜短篇小说 ; news story｜新闻报道 ; true story｜真实故事
tip_zh: 楼层英式写storey，美式写story；高度不固定。

meanings_zh: n. 救护车
definition_en: A vehicle that transports sick or injured people for medical care.
example1_en: An ambulance arrived quickly and took him to hospital.
example1_zh: 救护车很快赶到，把他送去了医院。
example2_en: Improving ambulance access in remote communities can reduce delays in treatment and increase patients' chances of recovery.
example2_zh: 改善偏远社区的救护车服务可以减少治疗延误，提高患者康复的机会。
collocations: call an ambulance｜叫救护车 ; ambulance service｜救护车服务 ; ambulance crew｜救护车急救人员
tip_zh: 以元音音素开头，前用an；叫救护车用call an ambulance。

meanings_zh: phr. 待售；出售中
definition_en: available to be bought
example1_en: There is a sign that says 'for sale' outside the house.
example1_zh: 房子外面有一块写着“出售”的牌子。
example2_en: These paintings are not for sale.
example2_zh: 这些画是非卖品。
tip_zh: for sale 是“待出售”；on sale 是“打折促销中”。

meanings_zh: det. 其他的；另外的 | pron. 另外的人或事物
definition_en: Different from or additional to those already mentioned. | A remaining or different person or thing.
example1_en: This shoe fits, but where is the other one?
example1_zh: 这只鞋合脚，但另一只在哪里？
example2_en: Schools should teach practical skills alongside other subjects to prepare students for the demands of adult life.
example2_zh: 学校应在教授其他科目的同时传授实用技能，让学生为成年生活的要求做好准备。
collocations: other people｜其他人 ; the other day｜前几天 ; each other｜彼此 ; on the other hand｜另一方面
tip_zh: other后接名词；others独立使用；两者中另一个用the other。

meanings_zh: n. 类型；种类 | v. 打字
definition_en: a group of things sharing particular features | to enter words using a keyboard
example1_en: What type of bread would you like today?
example1_zh: 你今天想要哪种面包？
example2_en: Different types of public transport are needed to serve both urban and rural communities.
example2_zh: 城市和农村社区都需要不同类型的公共交通服务。
collocations: a type of｜一种 ; blood type｜血型 ; type a message｜打字输入消息
tip_zh: type of后接名词；表示多种类型用types of。

meanings_zh: n. 苹果
definition_en: a round fruit with firm flesh and red or green skin
example1_en: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
example1_zh: 我装了一个苹果和一个三明治当午餐。
example2_en: Providing fresh fruit, such as apples, in schools may encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
example2_zh: 在学校提供苹果等新鲜水果，可能有助于鼓励儿童养成更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: apple juice｜苹果汁 ; apple pie｜苹果派 ; an apple core｜苹果核 ; a crisp apple｜脆苹果
tip_zh: 可数名词；“一个苹果”用an apple。

meanings_zh: v. 决定；选定 | v. 决定结果
definition_en: To choose what to do after considering the possibilities. | To determine the result of something.
example1_en: We decided to walk home after the film.
example1_zh: 看完电影后，我们决定走路回家。
example2_en: Governments must decide how to distribute limited resources between healthcare, education and public transport.
example2_zh: 政府必须决定如何在医疗、教育和公共交通之间分配有限资源。
collocations: decide to do something｜决定做某事 ; decide on｜选定 ; decide against｜决定不采用 ; decide the outcome｜决定结果
tip_zh: 用decide to do，不用decide doing。

meanings_zh: phr v. 整理；收拾
definition_en: to make a place clean and neat
example1_en: Please tidy up your room before dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭前请整理好你的房间。
example2_en: We tidied up the classroom after the party.
example2_zh: 聚会后我们收拾了教室。
tip_zh: tidy up 是“收拾整理”；tidy 是形容词“整洁的”。

meanings_zh: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的
definition_en: The one or ones belonging to them
example1_en: Our garden is small, but theirs has several trees.
example1_zh: 我们的花园很小，但他们的花园里有好几棵树。
example2_en: Some families own their homes, while others rent theirs because property prices remain beyond their reach.
example2_zh: 有些家庭拥有自己的住房，另一些则因房价仍超出承受能力而租房居住。
collocations: a friend of theirs｜他们的一位朋友 ; theirs to keep｜归他们所有 ; ours and theirs｜我们的和他们的
tip_zh: theirs独立使用，后不接名词，也不加撇号。

meanings_zh: n. 儿童游乐场；操场
definition_en: An outdoor area where children play, often with special equipment.
example1_en: The children raced to the playground after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，孩子们跑向了游乐场。
example2_en: Every neighbourhood should provide a safe playground where children can exercise and develop social skills.
example2_zh: 每个社区都应提供安全的儿童游乐场，让孩子锻炼身体并培养社交能力。
collocations: school playground｜学校操场 ; playground equipment｜游乐场设施 ; adventure playground｜探险游乐场
tip_zh: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。

meanings_zh: adj. 响亮的；大声的 | adv. 大声地
definition_en: Making or having a strong sound that is easily heard. | With a strong sound that is easily heard.
example1_en: A loud crash woke everyone in the house.
example1_zh: 一声巨响惊醒了屋里的所有人。
example2_en: Frequent exposure to loud music can damage hearing, particularly among young people who use headphones.
example2_zh: 经常接触高音量的音乐可能损伤听力，使用耳机的年轻人尤其如此。
collocations: loud noise｜很大的噪声 ; loud music｜高音量的音乐 ; out loud｜出声地 ; loud and clear｜响亮而清楚地
tip_zh: read out loud指读出声；loudly也可表示大声地。

meanings_zh: v. 喊叫；大声说 | n. 喊声；呼喊
definition_en: To speak or call out in a very loud voice. | A loud call or cry made with the voice.
example1_en: We shouted across the river, but nobody heard us.
example1_zh: 我们朝河对岸大喊，却没有人听见。
example2_en: In noisy classrooms, teachers may need to shout, which can strain their voices over time.
example2_zh: 在嘈杂的教室里，教师可能需要大声说话，长期如此会损伤嗓音。
collocations: shout for help｜大声求助 ; shout at someone｜冲某人大喊 ; shout to someone｜向某人高声说话 ; a shout of joy｜欢呼声
tip_zh: shout at常含生气意味；shout to重在让远处的人听见。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……旁边
definition_en: At the side of someone or something.
example1_en: Please leave your wet boots beside the door.
example1_zh: 请把你的湿靴子放在门旁边。
example2_en: Creating walking paths beside urban rivers can encourage physical activity and improve residents' access to nature.
example2_zh: 在城市河流旁修建步道可以鼓励身体活动，并让居民更容易亲近自然。
collocations: sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边 ; beside the river｜在河边 ; beside the point｜离题；不相关
tip_zh: beside表示“在旁边”；besides表示“此外；除……之外”。

meanings_zh: n. 空气 | n. 神态；气氛 | v. 使通风；公开表达
definition_en: The mixture of gases surrounding Earth that people breathe. | A particular quality that someone or something seems to have. | To let fresh air in, or express views publicly.
example1_en: I opened the window to let fresh air in.
example1_zh: 我打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。
example2_en: Improving air quality in cities requires cleaner transport and stricter controls on industrial emissions.
example2_zh: 改善城市空气质量需要更清洁的交通方式，以及对工业排放更严格的管控。
collocations: fresh air｜新鲜空气 ; air pollution｜空气污染 ; an air of confidence｜自信的神态 ; air concerns｜公开表达担忧
tip_zh: 表示空气时不可数；an air of表示“带有某种气质”。

meanings_zh: conj. 因为；由于
definition_en: Introduces the reason why something happens or is true.
example1_en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
example1_zh: 我关上了窗户，因为房间里有点冷。
example2_en: Many commuters choose public transport because it is cheaper and produces fewer emissions than driving alone.
example2_zh: 许多通勤者选择公共交通，因为它比独自开车更省钱，排放也更少。
collocations: because of the weather｜由于天气原因 ; because of this｜因此 ; partly because｜部分原因是
tip_zh: because 后接从句；because of 后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 队；团队 | v. 合作；组成团队
definition_en: a group working together or playing a sport together | to join someone to work together, usually with up
example1_en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
example1_zh: 我们队赢得比赛后，吃披萨庆祝了一番。
example2_en: Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
example2_zh: 团队合作有助于学生培养未来就业所必需的沟通能力。
collocations: team member｜团队成员 ; team spirit｜团队精神 ; team up with｜与……合作 ; research team｜研究团队
tip_zh: 英式英语中team可接单数或复数谓语。

meanings_zh: adj. 正确的；合适的 | n. 权利 | adj. 右边的；右侧的
definition_en: Correct, true, or suitable for a particular purpose. | Something you are legally or morally entitled to. | On the side opposite to the left.
example1_en: You picked the right key to open the door.
example1_zh: 你选对了开门的钥匙。
example2_en: Every child has the right to receive an education, regardless of their family's financial circumstances.
example2_zh: 每个孩子都有受教育的权利，无论其家庭经济状况如何。
collocations: the right answer｜正确答案 ; the right to education｜受教育权 ; on the right｜在右边 ; make the right decision｜作出正确决定
tip_zh: 表示权利用a right to；表示在右边用on the right。

meanings_zh: adj. 困难的；费力的 | adj. 难相处的；难应付的
definition_en: Needing considerable effort or skill to do or understand. | Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.
example1_en: This heavy suitcase is difficult to carry upstairs.
example1_zh: 这个沉重的行李箱很难搬上楼。
example2_en: Many graduates find it difficult to secure stable employment without previous experience in their chosen field.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生发现，如果没有所选领域的工作经验，就很难找到稳定的工作。
collocations: a difficult decision｜艰难的决定 ; difficult to understand｜难以理解 ; a difficult customer｜难应付的顾客
tip_zh: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty当形容词。

meanings_zh: v. 系；绑；打结 | n. 领带 | n. 联系；关系
definition_en: to fasten something using string, rope, or a knot | a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the collar | a connection between people, groups, or places
example1_en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
example1_zh: 跑出去之前，请先系好鞋带。
example2_en: Strong ties between schools and local employers can help young people make a smoother transition into work.
example2_zh: 学校与当地雇主之间的紧密联系，可以帮助年轻人更顺利地进入职场。
collocations: tie a knot｜打结 ; wear a tie｜戴领带 ; family ties｜家庭纽带 ; strengthen ties｜加强联系
tip_zh: tie的现在分词是tying；表示关系时通常用复数ties。

meanings_zh: n. 铅笔 | v. 用铅笔写或画
definition_en: A tool with a solid core for writing or drawing. | To write or draw something with a pencil.
example1_en: She sharpened her pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
example1_zh: 她削好铅笔，开始画那只熟睡的猫。
example2_en: Using a pencil allows students to revise diagrams easily as their understanding of scientific concepts develops.
example2_zh: 使用铅笔让学生能随着对科学概念理解的加深，轻松修改图示。
collocations: sharpen a pencil｜削铅笔 ; in pencil｜用铅笔 ; coloured pencil｜彩色铅笔 ; pencil case｜铅笔盒
tip_zh: 用铅笔写说in pencil；pencil in指暂定安排。

meanings_zh: pron. 某人；有人
definition_en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated
example1_en: Somebody left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
example1_zh: 有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。
example2_en: Students are more likely to seek help when they know somebody will listen without judging them.
example2_zh: 如果学生知道有人会倾听而不评判他们，就更有可能寻求帮助。
collocations: somebody else｜别人 ; somebody to talk to｜可以倾诉的人 ; somebody special｜特别的人
tip_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数；回指常用they。

meanings_zh: prep. 包括；包含
definition_en: With someone or something as part of a larger group.
example1_en: Everyone came to the picnic, including our new neighbours.
example1_zh: 大家都来野餐了，包括我们的新邻居。
example2_en: Cities should provide accessible public spaces for all residents, including older people and those with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 城市应为所有居民提供无障碍公共空间，包括老年人和行动不便者。
collocations: including tax｜含税 ; including delivery｜包含配送 ; including children｜包括儿童
tip_zh: including后接名词或代词；included通常放其后。

meanings_zh: n. 手机
definition_en: a telephone you can carry with you
example1_en: My cell phone battery is dead.
example1_zh: 我的手机没电了。
example2_en: She checks her cell phone every morning.
example2_zh: 她每天早上看手机。
tip_zh: cell phone 是美式说法；英式常说 mobile phone。

meanings_zh: phr v. 洗碗；（美）洗手洗脸
definition_en: to wash the dishes, or wash yourself
example1_en: After dinner, we wash up the plates.
example1_zh: 晚饭后我们洗盘子。
example2_en: He washed up before lunch.
example2_zh: 他午饭前洗了手脸。
tip_zh: 英式 wash up 是“洗碗”；美式 wash up 是“洗手洗脸”。

meanings_zh: n. 人；个人 | n. 语法人称
definition_en: an individual human being | a grammatical category distinguishing speakers, listeners, and others
example1_en: Only one person was waiting outside the bakery.
example1_zh: 只有一个人在面包店外等候。
example2_en: Every person should have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of income or employment status.
example2_zh: 每个人都应享有负担得起的医疗服务，无论其收入或就业状况如何。
collocations: in person｜亲自；当面 ; a young person｜一个年轻人 ; the average person｜普通人 ; first person｜第一人称
tip_zh: 普通复数用people；persons多见于正式法律语境。

meanings_zh: n. 街道
definition_en: a public road in a town, usually lined with buildings
example1_en: We crossed the street to reach the bakery.
example1_zh: 我们穿过街道来到面包店。
example2_en: Planting trees along busy streets can improve air quality and make urban neighbourhoods more pleasant for pedestrians.
example2_zh: 沿繁忙街道植树可以改善空气质量，让城市街区更适宜步行。
collocations: cross the street｜过马路 ; busy street｜繁忙的街道 ; residential street｜住宅区街道 ; street lighting｜街道照明
tip_zh: street多指城镇中两旁有建筑的道路。

meanings_zh: n. 拼写；拼写能力 | n. 拼法
definition_en: forming words correctly using their written characters | the particular way a word is written
example1_en: My sister checks my spelling before I send emails.
example1_zh: 我发邮件前，姐姐会帮我检查拼写。
example2_en: Although digital tools can correct spelling, students still need to develop accurate writing skills.
example2_zh: 虽然数字工具可以纠正拼写，学生仍需培养准确书写的能力。
collocations: spelling mistake｜拼写错误 ; check your spelling｜检查拼写 ; correct spelling｜正确拼写
tip_zh: 指拼写能力通常不可数；指具体拼法可数。

meanings_zh: v. 包括；包含 | v. 使加入；把…列入
definition_en: have someone or something as part of a whole | make someone or something part of a group or activity
example1_en: Does the price include breakfast and a clean towel?
example1_zh: 这个价格包含早餐和一条干净毛巾吗？
example2_en: Urban development plans should include affordable housing and reliable public transport to support low-income residents.
example2_zh: 城市发展规划应包含经济适用住房和可靠的公共交通，以支持低收入居民。
collocations: include someone in｜让某人参与 ; include a range of｜包含一系列 ; price includes｜价格包含
tip_zh: include常列出部分内容，不表示完整清单。

meanings_zh: n. 泳衣
definition_en: a piece of clothing you wear for swimming
example1_en: She bought a new bathing suit for the beach holiday.
example1_zh: 她为海滩度假买了一件新泳衣。
example2_en: Don't forget your bathing suit and towel.
example2_zh: 别忘了带泳衣和毛巾。
tip_zh: bathing suit 常见于美式英语；英式常说 swimsuit。

meanings_zh: n. 头脑；心智；思维 | v. 介意；反对 | v. 留意；小心；照看
definition_en: The part of you that thinks, feels, and remembers. | To feel annoyed or uncomfortable about something. | To pay attention to something or take care of someone.
example1_en: Would you mind closing the window before you leave?
example1_zh: 你介意离开前把窗户关上吗？
example2_en: Regular physical activity can benefit both the body and the mind by reducing stress and improving concentration.
example2_zh: 规律的体育活动能减轻压力、提高专注力，从而有益于身心健康。
collocations: change your mind｜改变主意 ; keep in mind｜牢记 ; mind doing something｜介意做某事 ; peace of mind｜内心安宁
tip_zh: 表示介意做某事用mind doing，不用mind to do。

meanings_zh: n. 收音机 | n. 无线电广播；无线电通信 | v. 用无线电联系或发送
definition_en: a device used to receive and play broadcast sound | broadcasting or communication using electromagnetic waves | to contact someone or send information using radio equipment
example1_en: Dad keeps a small radio on the kitchen shelf.
example1_zh: 爸爸在厨房架子上放着一台小收音机。
example2_en: Radio remains an important source of information in remote communities where reliable internet access is limited.
example2_zh: 在难以稳定上网的偏远社区，广播仍是重要的信息来源。
collocations: listen to the radio｜听广播 ; radio station｜广播电台 ; radio programme｜广播节目 ; radio signal｜无线电信号
tip_zh: 听广播常说listen to the radio；在广播中用on the radio。

meanings_zh: n. 嘻哈音乐；街舞
definition_en: a style of music and dance from the city
example1_en: He loves listening to hip hop music.
example1_zh: 他喜欢听嘻哈音乐。
example2_en: They learned hip hop dance at the club.
example2_zh: 他们在俱乐部学街舞。
tip_zh: hip hop 既指嘻哈音乐，也指嘻哈文化/街舞。

meanings_zh: n. 邮局
definition_en: a place where people send mail and buy stamps
example1_en: I took the parcel to the post office before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我把包裹送到了邮局。
example2_en: A local post office can provide essential services for rural residents who lack reliable internet access.
example2_zh: 当地邮局可以为缺乏可靠网络连接的农村居民提供基本服务。
collocations: local post office｜当地邮局 ; post office counter｜邮局柜台 ; post office branch｜邮局支局
tip_zh: 标准拼写为post office，两词之间不加连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 双肩背包 | v. 背包旅行
definition_en: A bag carried on the back using two shoulder straps. | To travel carrying your belongings in a backpack.
example1_en: I packed my lunch and jacket in my backpack.
example1_zh: 我把午餐和外套装进了双肩背包。
example2_en: Young adults often backpack through rural regions, supporting small businesses and learning about local traditions.
example2_zh: 年轻人常背包穿行于乡村地区，支持小型商家并了解当地传统。
collocations: carry a backpack｜背着双肩包 ; pack a backpack｜整理背包装行李 ; a hiking backpack｜徒步背包
tip_zh: 指双肩背包；英式英语也常用rucksack。

meanings_zh: n. 羞愧；耻辱 | n. 遗憾的事 | v. 使羞愧；使蒙羞
definition_en: A painful feeling caused by doing something wrong or embarrassing. | Something that causes disappointment or regret. | To make someone feel guilty or embarrassed about their behaviour.
example1_en: He felt shame after lying to his closest friend.
example1_zh: 对最亲近的朋友撒谎后，他感到羞愧。
example2_en: Schools should address bullying without creating a culture of shame that prevents pupils from seeking help.
example2_zh: 学校应处理欺凌问题，同时避免形成让学生因羞耻而不敢求助的氛围。
collocations: feel shame｜感到羞愧 ; a sense of shame｜羞耻感 ; a real shame｜真遗憾 ; shame someone into doing something｜使某人因羞愧而做某事
tip_zh: 羞愧义通常不可数；It's a shame表示真遗憾。

meanings_zh: n. 小测验；知识问答 | v. 测验；详细询问
definition_en: A short test or game involving questions. | To test someone's knowledge or ask them detailed questions.
example1_en: We played a music quiz after dinner yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们玩了音乐知识问答游戏。
example2_en: A short quiz at the beginning of each lesson can help teachers identify gaps in students' understanding.
example2_zh: 每节课开始时的小测验可以帮助教师发现学生理解上的不足。
collocations: take a quiz｜参加小测验 ; general knowledge quiz｜常识问答 ; quiz someone on｜就……测问某人
tip_zh: 复数为quizzes；过去式为quizzed。

meanings_zh: n. 动画片 | n. 漫画；讽刺画
definition_en: a film or programme made using animated drawings or images | a humorous drawing, often commenting on society or politics
example1_en: We watched a funny cartoon about a dancing penguin.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于跳舞企鹅的搞笑动画片。
example2_en: Political cartoons can communicate complex social criticism through simple images that appeal to a wide audience.
example2_zh: 政治漫画可以通过简单的图像传达复杂的社会批评，吸引广泛的受众。
collocations: cartoon character｜卡通人物 ; animated cartoon｜动画片 ; political cartoon｜政治讽刺漫画
tip_zh: cartoon 可指动画片或单幅漫画；漫画书常用 comic。

meanings_zh: n. 冰 | v. 给糕点覆糖霜
definition_en: water that has frozen solid | to cover a cake or biscuit with icing
example1_en: She dropped a few cubes of ice into her juice.
example1_zh: 她往果汁里放了几块冰。
example2_en: The loss of polar ice threatens wildlife habitats and can accelerate warming by reducing the reflection of sunlight.
example2_zh: 极地冰层的消失威胁野生动物栖息地，还可能因减少阳光反射而加速变暖。
collocations: ice cube｜冰块 ; sea ice｜海冰 ; melt the ice｜融化冰 ; ice a cake｜给蛋糕覆糖霜
tip_zh: ice指冰时通常不可数；一块冰用an ice cube。

meanings_zh: n. 戏服；装扮服装 | n. 民族服装；时代服饰
definition_en: clothes worn to look like a particular character or creature | clothing typical of a particular country, culture, or historical period
example1_en: Lena wore a butterfly costume in the school play.
example1_zh: 莉娜在学校话剧里穿了一套蝴蝶戏服。
example2_en: Traditional costume can express cultural identity and help younger generations understand the history of their communities.
example2_zh: 传统服饰能够表达文化认同，并帮助年轻一代理解自己社区的历史。
collocations: traditional costume｜传统服饰 ; a costume designer｜戏服设计师 ; a costume party｜化装舞会
tip_zh: 指特定角色或文化的服装，不泛指日常衣服。

meanings_zh: v. 检查；核对
definition_en: to look at something to make sure it is right
example1_en: Check your answers before you hand in the paper.
example1_zh: 交卷前检查一下你的答案。
example2_en: I need to check the train times online.
example2_zh: 我需要在网上查一下火车时间。
collocations: check in｜办理登机/入住手续
tip_zh: check 常与 in 搭配：check in 表示办理登机或入住手续。

meanings_zh: n. 傍晚；晚上
definition_en: The part of the day between afternoon and bedtime.
example1_en: We spent the evening cooking and listening to music.
example1_zh: 我们做饭、听音乐，度过了这个晚上。
example2_en: Evening classes allow working adults to gain new qualifications without giving up their current employment.
example2_zh: 晚间课程让在职成年人无需辞去现有工作，也能获得新的资格证书。
collocations: in the evening｜在晚上 ; this evening｜今晚 ; evening classes｜晚间课程 ; early evening｜傍晚时分
tip_zh: 泛指晚上用in the evening；this evening前不加介词。

meanings_zh: adj. 最后的；最终的 | adj. 不可更改的；决定性的 | n. 决赛；期末考试
definition_en: coming last in a series or process | settled and not open to further change or discussion | a competition's last match, or an examination ending a course
example1_en: We packed the final box and locked the door.
example1_zh: 我们装好最后一个箱子，锁上了门。
example2_en: The final stage of the research involved comparing energy consumption across several types of housing.
example2_zh: 研究的最后阶段是比较几种不同类型住房的能源消耗。
collocations: final decision｜最终决定 ; final stage｜最后阶段 ; reach the final｜进入决赛 ; final exams｜期末考试
tip_zh: finally是副词；final作名词可指决赛或期末考试。

meanings_zh: pron. 一切；所有事物 | pron. 最重要的东西
definition_en: All things or all the things in a particular situation. | The most important thing in someone's life or situation.
example1_en: Everything in my bag got wet during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨把我包里的东西全弄湿了。
example2_en: Although digital resources are valuable, students should not assume that everything they read online is accurate.
example2_zh: 虽然数字资源很有价值，但学生不应认为自己在网上读到的一切都准确无误。
collocations: everything else｜其他所有事物 ; everything possible｜一切可能的事 ; mean everything to someone｜对某人无比重要
tip_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数：Everything is ready。

meanings_zh: phr v. 归还；送回
definition_en: to return something to its owner
example1_en: Don't forget to give back the library book.
example1_zh: 别忘了把图书馆的书还回去。
example2_en: She gave back the money she borrowed.
example2_zh: 她把借的钱还了。
tip_zh: give back 强调“归还给别人”；give it back 中 it 放中间。

meanings_zh: n. 甜瓜
definition_en: A large round fruit with thick skin and sweet, juicy flesh.
example1_en: She sliced a ripe melon for our picnic.
example1_zh: 她切了一个熟甜瓜，供我们野餐时吃。
example2_en: Farmers growing melons in dry regions often use efficient irrigation systems to reduce water consumption.
example2_zh: 干旱地区种植甜瓜的农民常使用高效灌溉系统来减少用水量。
collocations: ripe melon｜熟甜瓜 ; a slice of melon｜一片甜瓜 ; melon seeds｜瓜子
tip_zh: melon泛指甜瓜类；watermelon专指西瓜。

meanings_zh: adj. 著名的；众所周知的
definition_en: known by many people
example1_en: This is a well-known restaurant in the city.
example1_zh: 这是城里一家著名的餐厅。
example2_en: She is well known for her cooking.
example2_zh: 她以厨艺闻名。
tip_zh: well known 是“著名的”；be well known for 因…而闻名。

meanings_zh: n. 专业厨师；主厨
definition_en: A trained cook working in a restaurant or hotel.
example1_en: The chef added fresh herbs to the steaming soup.
example1_zh: 厨师往热气腾腾的汤里加入了新鲜香草。
example2_en: A skilled chef can design nutritious school meals that appeal to children while staying within a limited budget.
example2_zh: 技艺娴熟的厨师可以在有限预算内，设计出既营养又受孩子欢迎的学校餐食。
collocations: head chef｜主厨 ; pastry chef｜糕点师 ; train as a chef｜接受专业厨师培训
tip_zh: chef 的 ch 发 /ʃ/；通常指餐馆或酒店的专业厨师。

meanings_zh: adv. 实际上；其实
definition_en: in fact, often surprisingly or contrary to what was expected
example1_en: I thought this soup was spicy, but it is actually sweet.
example1_zh: 我以为这汤很辣，其实是甜的。
example2_en: Although online courses seem convenient, some students actually learn more effectively through face-to-face interaction.
example2_zh: 虽然在线课程似乎很方便，但有些学生实际上通过面对面交流学得更好。
collocations: actually happen｜实际发生 ; actually mean｜真正的意思是 ; actually work｜确实奏效
tip_zh: actually表示“其实”，不表示“目前”。

meanings_zh: n. 毛巾；浴巾 | v. 用毛巾擦干
definition_en: a piece of absorbent cloth used for drying things | to dry someone or something with a towel
example1_en: He wrapped a warm towel around his wet shoulders.
example1_zh: 他把一条温暖的毛巾裹在湿漉漉的肩膀上。
example2_en: Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse their towels during their stay.
example2_zh: 酒店可以鼓励住客在入住期间重复使用毛巾，以减少用水量。
collocations: bath towel｜浴巾 ; hand towel｜擦手巾 ; paper towel｜厨房纸巾；擦手纸 ; towel dry｜用毛巾擦干
tip_zh: 可数名词；paper towel指吸水纸巾，不是布毛巾。

meanings_zh: n. 西；西方；西部 | adj. 西部的；朝西的 | adv. 向西；在西方
definition_en: the direction where the sun sets, opposite east | in or facing the direction where the sun sets | towards or in the west
example1_en: Our kitchen window faces west, catching the evening sunshine.
example1_zh: 我们厨房的窗户朝西，能照到傍晚的阳光。
example2_en: Investment in the west of the country could reduce regional inequalities and create employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 对该国西部的投资可以缩小地区差距，并创造就业机会。
collocations: in the west｜在西部 ; head west｜向西行进 ; west coast｜西海岸 ; due west｜正西方
tip_zh: 方位一般小写；the West指西方国家时大写。

meanings_zh: n. 兄；弟
definition_en: A male who has one or both parents in common with you.
example1_en: My younger brother borrowed my bicycle this morning.
example1_zh: 我弟弟今天早上借用了我的自行车。
example2_en: Older brothers and sisters can support younger children's learning by reading with them regularly at home.
example2_zh: 哥哥姐姐可以通过经常在家陪弟弟妹妹阅读来帮助他们学习。
collocations: older brother｜哥哥 ; younger brother｜弟弟 ; twin brother｜双胞胎兄弟
tip_zh: brother不区分兄弟；用older或younger说明长幼。

meanings_zh: n. 脚趾 | n. 鞋尖；袜尖
definition_en: One of the five separate parts at the foot's end | The part of a shoe or sock covering the toes
example1_en: There is a little sand stuck between my toes.
example1_zh: 我的脚趾缝里沾了一点沙子。
example2_en: Wearing shoes that restrict toe movement may affect balance and contribute to foot problems over time.
example2_zh: 穿限制脚趾活动的鞋子可能影响平衡，长此以往还可能导致足部问题。
collocations: big toe｜大脚趾 ; little toe｜小脚趾 ; stub your toe｜脚趾撞到硬物 ; from head to toe｜从头到脚
tip_zh: 手指是finger，脚趾是toe；大脚趾用big toe。

meanings_zh: n. 泳衣
definition_en: a piece of clothing worn for swimming
example1_en: She packed her swimsuit for the holiday.
example1_zh: 她把泳衣装进行李去度假。
example2_en: This swimsuit is perfect for the beach.
example2_zh: 这件泳衣很适合去海滩。
tip_zh: swimsuit 是泳衣；男士泳裤说 swimming trunks。

meanings_zh: n. 山；高山 | n. 大量；一大堆
definition_en: a very high area of land with steep sides | a very large amount of something
example1_en: Snow covered the mountain even in the middle of summer.
example1_zh: 即使在盛夏，那座山仍被白雪覆盖。
example2_en: Mountain communities often face higher transport costs because steep terrain makes road construction more difficult.
example2_zh: 山区社区往往面临更高的运输成本，因为陡峭的地形增加了修路的难度。
collocations: mountain range｜山脉 ; mountain peak｜山峰 ; climb a mountain｜登山 ; a mountain of work｜堆积如山的工作
tip_zh: 一座山用 mountain；山脉通常用 mountain range。

meanings_zh: v. 击打；碰撞 | v. 严重影响；打击 | n. 大获成功的人或事物
definition_en: Strike someone or something with force. | Affect someone or something badly, often suddenly. | Someone or something that becomes very popular or successful.
example1_en: The ball hit the fence and bounced towards me.
example1_zh: 球撞上围栏，又朝我弹了过来。
example2_en: Rising energy prices have hit small businesses particularly hard, forcing many owners to reduce their operating hours.
example2_zh: 能源价格上涨对小企业的打击尤其严重，迫使许多经营者缩短营业时间。
collocations: hit the ball｜击球 ; be hit hard｜遭受重创 ; a big hit｜大受欢迎的事物 ; hit a target｜击中目标
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词仍为hit；现在分词为hitting。

meanings_zh: prep. 比 | conj. 比
definition_en: used to introduce the second thing in a comparison | used before a clause expressing the other side of a comparison
example1_en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
example1_zh: 我的新背包比旧的轻。
example2_en: Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.
example2_zh: 在拥挤的城市，投资公共交通可能比增建道路更有效。
collocations: more than｜多于 ; less than｜少于 ; rather than｜而不是 ; other than｜除……以外
tip_zh: than用于比较；then表示“然后”，注意拼写。

meanings_zh: adj. 温暖的；暖和的 | adj. 热情的；友好的 | v. 使暖和；变暖
definition_en: having a comfortable temperature that is not hot | showing kindness, friendliness, or affection | to become warmer or make something warmer
example1_en: This thick blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
example1_zh: 这条厚毯子让我在凉飕飕的夜晚保持暖和。
example2_en: A warm welcome at school can help new students feel included and develop confidence.
example2_zh: 学校的热情欢迎能帮助新生获得归属感，并建立自信。
collocations: keep warm｜保暖 ; a warm welcome｜热情欢迎 ; warm up｜热身；使变暖 ; warm to someone｜渐渐喜欢上某人
tip_zh: warm比hot温度低；warm to某人指渐渐喜欢对方。

meanings_zh: n. 未来；前途 | adj. 未来的；将来的
definition_en: The time ahead, or what will happen to someone or something. | Happening or existing at a time after the present.
example1_en: We talked about our future while walking home.
example1_zh: 我们走路回家时聊了聊我们的未来。
example2_en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to protect the environment for future generations worldwide.
example2_zh: 各国政府应投资可再生能源，为世界各地的子孙后代保护环境。
collocations: in the future｜在将来 ; near future｜不久的将来 ; future generations｜子孙后代 ; bright future｜光明的前途
tip_zh: in the future指将来；英式in future常指从今以后。

meanings_zh: det. 所有的；整个的 | pron. 全部；所有人或事物 | adv. 完全地
definition_en: the whole amount of something or every member of a group | everything or everyone in a particular group | completely or entirely
example1_en: All the children brought fruit for the picnic.
example1_zh: 所有孩子都带了水果来野餐。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of their income.
example2_zh: 政府应确保所有公民无论收入如何，都能获得负担得起的医疗服务。
collocations: all day｜一整天 ; all of us｜我们所有人 ; all the time｜一直 ; after all｜毕竟
tip_zh: all可接复数或不可数名词；every接单数可数名词。

meanings_zh: v. 来；来到 | v. 到来；发生 | v. 来自；源于
definition_en: Move towards the speaker or a particular place. | Arrive in time or happen. | Have a particular origin or source.
example1_en: Come inside and warm your hands by the fire.
example1_zh: 进来在火边暖暖手吧。
example2_en: Much of the funding for public libraries comes from local government rather than private donations.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆的大部分资金来自地方政府，而非私人捐赠。
collocations: come home｜回家 ; come from｜来自 ; come true｜实现 ; come to an end｜结束
tip_zh: 不规则变化：come–came–come；come from表示来自。

meanings_zh: v. 吃；进食
definition_en: To put food in your mouth, chew it, and swallow
example1_en: We usually eat breakfast together before leaving the house.
example1_zh: 我们通常一起吃完早饭再出门。
example2_en: Schools can encourage children to eat more vegetables by providing affordable meals with a variety of fresh ingredients.
example2_zh: 学校可以提供价格实惠、包含多种新鲜食材的餐食，鼓励孩子多吃蔬菜。
collocations: eat breakfast｜吃早饭 ; eat out｜外出就餐 ; eat a balanced diet｜均衡饮食 ; eat well｜吃得健康
tip_zh: 不规则变化：eat—ate—eaten。

meanings_zh: n. 胡萝卜 | n. 诱因；奖励
definition_en: A long, usually orange root vegetable. | A reward offered to encourage someone to do something.
example1_en: She sliced a carrot and added it to the soup.
example1_zh: 她把一根胡萝卜切片，放进汤里。
example2_en: Governments can use tax reductions as a carrot to encourage businesses to invest in renewable energy.
example2_zh: 政府可以用减税作为激励，鼓励企业投资可再生能源。
collocations: raw carrot｜生胡萝卜 ; grated carrot｜胡萝卜丝 ; carrot and stick｜奖惩并用
tip_zh: 比喻奖励或诱因；carrot and stick指奖惩并用。

meanings_zh: prep. 在附近；接近 | adv. 在附近；临近 | adj. 近的；不久的
definition_en: close to a place, time, or state | at or towards a short distance away in space or time | not far away in distance or time
example1_en: We found a quiet café near the station.
example1_zh: 我们在车站附近找到了一家安静的咖啡馆。
example2_en: Building affordable housing near public transport can reduce commuting costs and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 在公共交通设施附近建设经济适用住房，可以降低通勤成本并增加就业机会。
collocations: near the station｜在车站附近 ; in the near future｜在不久的将来 ; come near｜走近 ; nowhere near｜远远不及
tip_zh: near可直接接地点；nearly通常表示“几乎”。

meanings_zh: n. 父亲或母亲 | n. 母公司 | v. 养育；教养
definition_en: a person's mother or father | a company that owns or controls another company | to raise and care for a child as a parent
example1_en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
example1_zh: 每位家长都为学校野餐带了一份点心。
example2_en: Schools should involve parents in educational decisions because family support plays an important role in children's learning.
example2_zh: 学校应让家长参与教育决策，因为家庭支持在孩子的学习中发挥着重要作用。
collocations: single parent｜单亲家长 ; working parents｜在职父母 ; parent company｜母公司 ; parent involvement｜家长参与
tip_zh: parent指父母中的一位；parents通常指父母双方。

meanings_zh: v. 举起；抬高 | n. 电梯 | n. 搭便车
definition_en: To move someone or something to a higher position. | A machine carrying people or goods between floors. | A ride in someone else's vehicle.
example1_en: Can you help me lift this box onto the shelf?
example1_zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子抬到架子上吗？
example2_en: Installing lifts in older public buildings can improve access for wheelchair users and people with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 在较老的公共建筑中安装电梯，可以方便轮椅使用者和行动不便的人进出。
collocations: lift weights｜举重 ; take the lift｜乘电梯 ; give someone a lift｜让某人搭便车 ; lift a ban｜解除禁令
tip_zh: 电梯英式用lift，美式用elevator。

meanings_zh: adj. 著名的；出名的
definition_en: Known by many people.
example1_en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
example1_zh: 这个村庄以美味的苹果派闻名。
example2_en: Famous landmarks attract international visitors, but tourism revenue should also support the communities surrounding them.
example2_zh: 著名地标吸引着国际游客，但旅游收入也应惠及周边社区。
collocations: famous for｜因……而出名 ; famous as｜作为……而出名 ; world famous｜世界闻名的
tip_zh: famous for接出名的原因，famous as接身份。

meanings_zh: n. 预约；约定会面 | n. 任命；委任
definition_en: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time. | The act of choosing someone for a job or position.
example1_en: I have a dental appointment early tomorrow morning.
example1_zh: 我预约了明天一早看牙医。
example2_en: Flexible working hours allow employees to attend medical appointments without taking an entire day off.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间让员工无需请一整天假就能按预约就医。
collocations: make an appointment｜预约 ; cancel an appointment｜取消预约 ; by appointment only｜仅接受预约 ; appointment of a director｜董事的任命
tip_zh: 与某人预约用appointment with；任命某人用appointment of。

meanings_zh: adv. 仅仅；只是 | adv. 刚刚；正好 | adj. 公正的；正当的
definition_en: Only; no more than a particular amount or thing. | Very recently, or exactly at a particular point or degree. | Fair and morally right.
example1_en: I need just one more minute to finish packing.
example1_zh: 我只需要再一分钟就能收拾好行李。
example2_en: A just society should ensure that all children can access quality education, regardless of family income.
example2_zh: 一个公正的社会应确保所有儿童都能获得优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。
collocations: just a moment｜稍等片刻 ; just in time｜刚好赶上 ; just enough｜刚好足够 ; a just society｜公正的社会
tip_zh: 作副词可指仅仅、刚刚；作形容词指公正的。

meanings_zh: n. 便士；一便士硬币 | n. 一美分硬币
definition_en: A British coin or unit worth one hundredth of a pound. | An American coin worth one hundredth of a dollar.
example1_en: I found a penny underneath the sofa this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我在沙发底下发现了一枚便士硬币。
example2_en: For families on low incomes, every penny saved on energy bills can make a difference.
example2_zh: 对于低收入家庭，能源账单上省下的每一分钱都可能有所帮助。
collocations: every penny｜每一分钱 ; not a penny｜一分钱也没有 ; worth every penny｜物有所值
tip_zh: 英国金额复数用pence；指多枚硬币用pennies。

meanings_zh: n. 生日
definition_en: The yearly anniversary of the day someone was born.
example1_en: My sister baked a lemon cake for my birthday.
example1_zh: 姐姐为我的生日烤了一个柠檬蛋糕。
example2_en: Although birthday celebrations vary across cultures, they often provide opportunities for families to spend time together.
example2_zh: 虽然不同文化中的生日庆祝方式各异，但它们往往能让家人有机会相聚。
collocations: a birthday cake｜生日蛋糕 ; a birthday present｜生日礼物 ; celebrate a birthday｜庆祝生日
tip_zh: 在某人生日当天用on，不用in或at。

meanings_zh: n. 黄油 | v. 涂黄油于
definition_en: a pale yellow fat made from cream, used in food | to spread butter on food
example1_en: She spread some butter on a slice of warm bread.
example1_zh: 她在一片温热的面包上抹了些黄油。
example2_en: Replacing some butter with unsaturated oils can help people reduce their overall intake of saturated fat.
example2_zh: 用不饱和油脂替代部分黄油，有助于减少饱和脂肪的总体摄入量。
collocations: spread butter｜涂黄油 ; melted butter｜融化的黄油 ; a knob of butter｜一小块黄油 ; butter toast｜给吐司涂黄油
tip_zh: butter是黄油，cream是奶油；作食品名通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 学院；高等专科学校 | n. 大学的学院
definition_en: An institution offering education beyond school, including practical or academic courses. | A constituent institution or division within a university.
example1_en: My cousin is studying nursing at a local college.
example1_zh: 我表姐正在当地一所学院学习护理。
example2_en: Making college education more affordable could improve social mobility and provide employers with a more skilled workforce.
example2_zh: 降低高等教育费用可以促进社会流动，并为雇主提供技能更强的劳动力。
collocations: go to college｜上大学或学院 ; college student｜大学生；学院学生 ; college education｜大学教育 ; community college｜社区学院
tip_zh: 美式常泛指大学；英式多指学院或继续教育院校。

meanings_zh: pron. 我们（宾格）
definition_en: the people speaking, as objects
example1_en: Our teacher told us an interesting story.
example1_zh: 老师给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。
example2_en: Come with us to the cinema.
example2_zh: 和我们一起去看电影吧。
tip_zh: us 是 we 的宾格，作宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 关上；关闭；结束 | adj. 近的；亲密的 | adv. 靠近；接近
definition_en: Shut something or bring an activity to an end | Near in distance or connected by a strong personal relationship | At a short distance from someone or something
example1_en: Please close the window before the rain comes in.
example1_zh: 请在雨飘进来之前关上窗户。
example2_en: When local libraries close, residents lose valuable spaces for independent learning and community activities.
example2_zh: 当本地图书馆关闭时，居民就失去了自主学习和开展社区活动的宝贵场所。
collocations: close a door｜关门 ; close to home｜离家近 ; a close friend｜亲密的朋友 ; stay close｜待在近处
tip_zh: 动词读/z/；形容词和副词读/s/。

meanings_zh: n. 果酱 | n. 拥堵；堵塞 | v. 卡住；塞进
definition_en: A sweet spread made by cooking fruit with sugar. | A situation where movement stops because things are packed together. | To become stuck, or force something into a tight space.
example1_en: I spread strawberry jam on my toast this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我在吐司上抹了草莓酱。
example2_en: Frequent traffic jams increase air pollution and make daily journeys more stressful for urban residents.
example2_zh: 频繁的交通拥堵加剧空气污染，也让城市居民的日常出行更加令人焦虑。
collocations: strawberry jam｜草莓酱 ; traffic jam｜交通堵塞 ; get jammed｜被卡住 ; jam something into｜把某物硬塞进
tip_zh: 果酱通常不可数；一次交通堵塞用a traffic jam。

meanings_zh: adv. 离开；脱离 | prep. 从……离开；离开……表面 | adj. 关闭的；不工作的
definition_en: away from a place or position | away from or no longer touching something | not operating or not working at a particular time
example1_en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
example1_zh: 门一开，那只狗就跑走了。
example2_en: Keeping unnecessary lights off in public buildings can reduce electricity consumption and lower operating costs.
example2_zh: 关闭公共建筑内不必要的照明可以减少耗电量并降低运营成本。
collocations: turn off｜关掉 ; take off｜起飞；脱下 ; off duty｜不值班 ; day off｜休息日
tip_zh: off强调离开或关闭；of常表示所属，勿混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 等待；等候 | v. 暂缓；推迟 | n. 等待；等候时间
definition_en: To let time pass until something happens or someone arrives. | To be left until a later time. | A period spent expecting something to happen.
example1_en: Please wait here while I find my keys.
example1_zh: 请在这里等一下，我去找钥匙。
example2_en: Patients in rural areas often wait longer for specialist treatment because local medical services are limited.
example2_zh: 由于当地医疗服务有限，农村地区的患者往往需要等待更久才能接受专科治疗。
collocations: wait for someone｜等某人 ; wait patiently｜耐心等待 ; a long wait｜漫长的等待 ; wait and see｜等等看
tip_zh: 等人用wait for someone；等着做用wait to do。

meanings_zh: prep. 在…下面 | prep. 少于；低于 | prep. 在…状态或控制下
definition_en: in or into a position below something | less than a particular amount, age, or level | experiencing a condition or being controlled by someone or something
example1_en: The cat curled up under the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 猫蜷缩在厨房的桌子下面。
example2_en: Under the new policy, local authorities must provide safer cycling routes near schools and residential areas.
example2_zh: 根据新政策，地方政府必须在学校和住宅区附近提供更安全的骑行路线。
collocations: under pressure｜承受压力 ; under control｜受控 ; under construction｜在建 ; under the age of｜年龄不满
tip_zh: under可表位置、数量或状态：under pressure。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上 | prep. 在某日；关于 | adv. 开着；运行中
definition_en: Touching and supported by a surface. | Used for days and dates, or to introduce a topic. | Operating or receiving power.
example1_en: Your keys are on the table beside the door.
example1_zh: 你的钥匙在门旁的桌子上。
example2_en: Installing solar panels on public buildings can reduce energy costs and demonstrate a government's commitment to sustainability.
example2_zh: 在公共建筑上安装太阳能板可以降低能源成本，并展现政府对可持续发展的重视。
collocations: on the table｜在桌上 ; on Monday｜在星期一 ; a report on education｜一份关于教育的报告 ; switch on｜打开
tip_zh: 具体某天用on；月份用in；钟点用at。

meanings_zh: adj. 可能的；可实现的 | adj. 或许合适的；潜在的
definition_en: able to happen, exist, or be done | worth considering as a choice or explanation
example1_en: Is it possible to book a table for tonight?
example1_zh: 可以预订今晚的餐桌吗？
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy makes it possible for countries to reduce their dependence on imported fuels.
example2_zh: 对可再生能源的投资使各国有可能减少对进口燃料的依赖。
collocations: as soon as possible｜尽快 ; possible explanation｜可能的解释 ; make it possible｜使之成为可能
tip_zh: 常用it is possible to do；不说人is possible to do。

meanings_zh: n. 分（货币单位） | n. 一分硬币
definition_en: a monetary unit worth one hundredth of a dollar or euro | a coin worth one cent
example1_en: I found a cent under the sofa cushion.
example1_zh: 我在沙发坐垫下面找到了一枚一分硬币。
example2_en: For households with limited incomes, every cent saved on essential goods can contribute to greater financial security.
example2_zh: 对收入有限的家庭而言，购买必需品时省下的每一分钱都能增强经济保障。
collocations: every cent｜每一分钱 ; not a cent｜一分钱也没有 ; a fifty-cent coin｜一枚五十分硬币
tip_zh: cent是可数名词；金额超过一分通常用cents。

meanings_zh: n. 目标 | n. 进球；进球得分 | n. 球门
definition_en: Something you want to accomplish through effort. | A score made by sending a ball into a goal. | A frame or area players aim to send a ball into.
example1_en: My goal is to swim across the pool unaided.
example1_zh: 我的目标是不靠帮助游到泳池对面。
example2_en: Setting realistic goals can help university students manage their time and maintain motivation during demanding courses.
example2_zh: 设定切合实际的目标能帮助大学生管理时间，并在繁重的课程学习中保持动力。
collocations: set a goal｜设定目标 ; achieve a goal｜实现目标 ; a long-term goal｜长期目标 ; score a goal｜进球得分
tip_zh: 目标用set或achieve；进球用score a goal。

meanings_zh: v. 描述；形容
definition_en: to explain what someone or something is like
example1_en: Can you describe the bag you left on the bus?
example1_zh: 你能描述一下你落在公交车上的包吗？
example2_en: The report describes how access to public parks influences physical activity among residents of crowded cities.
example2_zh: 该报告描述了公共公园的可达性如何影响人口密集城市居民的体育活动。
collocations: describe something in detail｜详细描述某事物 ; describe something as｜把某事物形容为 ; describe a process｜描述一个过程
tip_zh: 说describe something to someone，不说describe someone something。

meanings_zh: v. 说；表达 | v. 写着；表明 | n. 发言权；决定权
definition_en: To express something using words. | To give information in writing or through other evidence. | The opportunity to influence a decision.
example1_en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
example1_zh: 请再说一遍你的名字，好让我记住。
example2_en: Residents should have a say in planning decisions that directly affect their neighbourhoods and daily lives.
example2_zh: 居民应当对直接影响其社区和日常生活的规划决策拥有发言权。
collocations: say hello｜打招呼 ; say something to someone｜对某人说某事 ; have a say in｜对……有发言权 ; say for certain｜肯定地说
tip_zh: 说某事用say something；告诉某人用tell someone。

meanings_zh: prep.&n. 经过；过去；晚于
definition_en: beyond a place; time before now
example1_en: It's half past two.
example1_zh: 现在两点半。
example2_en: We walked past the library on the way home.
example2_zh: 回家路上我们经过了图书馆。
collocations: half past two｜两点半
tip_zh: past 指时间“过了”；half past five 是五点半。

meanings_zh: v. 推；按 | v. 敦促；迫使 | n. 推动；大力争取
definition_en: to press something or move it away by applying force | to strongly encourage or force someone to act | an act of pushing or a determined effort
example1_en: Could you push the trolley while I carry these bags?
example1_zh: 我来拿这些袋子，你能推一下手推车吗？
example2_en: Schools should encourage academic progress without pushing students to compete constantly with their classmates.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生在学业上进步，而不是迫使他们不断与同学竞争。
collocations: push a button｜按按钮 ; push someone to do something｜敦促某人做某事 ; push for reform｜力争改革 ; push up prices｜推高价格
tip_zh: push表示推，pull表示拉；push for意为力争。

meanings_zh: n. 恐龙 | n. 守旧者；过时事物
definition_en: a prehistoric reptile, often large, known mainly from fossils | a person or thing considered outdated and resistant to change
example1_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
example1_zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
example2_en: Studying dinosaur fossils helps researchers understand how ancient environments differed from those of the present day.
example2_zh: 研究恐龙化石有助于科研人员了解古代环境与当今环境的差异。
collocations: dinosaur fossils｜恐龙化石 ; dinosaur skeleton｜恐龙骨架 ; dinosaur extinction｜恐龙灭绝
tip_zh: 比喻人或机构落伍时带贬义，正式交流慎用。

meanings_zh: n. 科学家
definition_en: Someone who studies the natural world through research and experiments
