example1_en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
example1_zh: 这位科学家用显微镜观察了一滴水。
example2_en: Scientists are developing more efficient batteries to support the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
example2_zh: 科学家正在研发效率更高的电池，以支持从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型。
collocations: research scientist｜科研人员 ; leading scientist｜顶尖科学家 ; environmental scientist｜环境科学家
tip_zh: scientist指人，science指科学，scientific是形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 祖父；外祖父
definition_en: The father of your mother or father.
example1_en: My grandfather taught me how to grow tomatoes.
example1_zh: 我的祖父教过我如何种番茄。
example2_en: A grandfather who provides regular childcare can strengthen family bonds and support working parents.
example2_zh: 经常帮忙照顾孩子的祖父或外祖父能够增进家庭感情，并为在职父母提供支持。
collocations: maternal grandfather｜外祖父 ; paternal grandfather｜祖父
tip_zh: 不区分父系母系；外祖父可说maternal grandfather。

meanings_zh: adj. 亲爱的；珍爱的 | adj. 昂贵的 | int. 哎呀；天哪
definition_en: loved or valued very much | costing a lot of money | used to express surprise, worry, or disappointment
example1_en: This little garden is very dear to my grandmother.
example1_zh: 祖母十分珍爱这座小花园。
example2_en: Places that are dear to local residents deserve consideration when urban redevelopment plans are prepared.
example2_zh: 制定城市改造计划时，应顾及当地居民珍爱的场所。
collocations: a dear friend｜挚友 ; dear to someone｜为某人所珍爱 ; oh dear｜哎呀
tip_zh: dear表“贵”主要用于英式口语；称呼常用Dear。

meanings_zh: adj. 抱歉的；后悔的 | adj. 难过的；同情的
definition_en: feeling regret about something you did or something that happened | feeling sadness or sympathy because of someone's difficulties
example1_en: I'm sorry I spilled juice on your clean shirt.
example1_zh: 很抱歉，我把果汁洒在了你的干净衬衫上。
example2_en: Although companies may say they are sorry for environmental damage, meaningful action is needed to restore public trust.
example2_zh: 尽管企业可能对环境破坏表示歉意，但恢复公众信任需要切实行动。
collocations: sorry for being late｜为迟到感到抱歉 ; sorry about the mistake｜为错误感到抱歉 ; feel sorry for someone｜同情某人 ; sorry to hear that｜听到那件事很难过
tip_zh: sorry for doing表示为所做之事道歉。

meanings_zh: adv. 幸好；幸运地
definition_en: By good fortune, often avoiding an unpleasant result.
example1_en: My bag fell open, but luckily nothing dropped out.
example1_zh: 我的包掉下来摔开了，幸好没有东西掉出来。
example2_en: The storm damaged several classrooms, but luckily the school had already moved its students to a safer building.
example2_zh: 暴风雨损坏了几间教室，但幸好学校已将学生转移到一栋更安全的建筑中。
collocations: luckily for us｜对我们来说幸好 ; luckily enough｜很幸运 ; luckily no one was hurt｜幸好无人受伤
tip_zh: 常修饰整个句子，放句首时通常后接逗号。

meanings_zh: v. 打扰；使烦恼 | v. 费心；花工夫 | n. 麻烦；烦扰
definition_en: to interrupt, annoy, or worry someone | to make the effort to do something | trouble or effort that causes inconvenience
example1_en: Please do not bother your sister while she studies.
example1_zh: 你姐姐学习时，请不要打扰她。
example2_en: Constant notifications can bother students during lessons and reduce their ability to concentrate on complex tasks.
example2_zh: 持续不断的通知会在课堂上干扰学生，降低他们专注于复杂任务的能力。
collocations: bother someone with something｜拿某事打扰某人 ; bother to do something｜费心做某事 ; cannot be bothered｜懒得费事 ; a lot of bother｜很多麻烦
tip_zh: bother to do常用于否定或疑问，表示费心做。

meanings_zh: n. 耳朵 | n. 辨音能力；听觉 | n. 谷穗
definition_en: One of the organs on your head used for hearing. | The ability to recognise and distinguish sounds. | The grain-bearing part of a cereal plant, such as wheat.
example1_en: My ears felt cold, so I pulled on a hat.
example1_zh: 我的耳朵觉得冷，于是我戴上了帽子。
example2_en: Regular exposure to loud music can damage the ears and lead to permanent hearing loss.
example2_zh: 经常接触高音量音乐可能损伤耳朵，并导致永久性听力损失。
collocations: an ear for music｜音乐辨音能力 ; ear infection｜耳部感染 ; an ear of wheat｜一穗小麦 ; ear protection｜护耳用品
tip_zh: have an ear for表示善于辨听音乐、语言等。

meanings_zh: n. 益智游戏；拼图 | n. 谜；难以理解的事 | v. 使困惑
definition_en: A game or problem that tests your thinking skills. | Something that is difficult to understand or explain. | To make someone feel confused because something is difficult to understand.
example1_en: We finished the puzzle together on the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房桌上一起完成了拼图。
example2_en: The relationship between income and personal happiness remains a puzzle that researchers approach from several different perspectives.
example2_zh: 收入与个人幸福感之间的关系仍是一个谜，研究人员正从多个不同角度探索它。
collocations: solve a puzzle｜解开谜题 ; a jigsaw puzzle｜拼图 ; puzzle over something｜苦思某事 ; a crossword puzzle｜填字游戏
tip_zh: puzzled形容人感到困惑；puzzling形容事物令人困惑。

meanings_zh: prep. …的；属于
definition_en: used to show possession or connection
example1_en: This is a photo of my family.
example1_zh: 这是一张我全家的照片。
example2_en: The door of the shop is open.
example2_zh: 商店的门开着。
collocations: a cup of tea｜一杯茶
tip_zh: of 表示所属关系或数量；a glass of water 一杯水。

meanings_zh: adj. 健康的 | adj. 有益健康的 | adj. 良好的；兴旺的
definition_en: physically well and not suffering from illness | helping to maintain or improve health | successful, strong, or developing in a positive way
example1_en: Our cat stays healthy with regular exercise and checkups.
example1_zh: 我们家的猫通过经常运动和定期检查保持健康。
example2_en: Schools should provide healthy meals to support children's physical development and encourage better eating habits from an early age.
example2_zh: 学校应提供健康膳食，以促进儿童身体发育，并鼓励他们从小养成更好的饮食习惯。
collocations: a healthy diet｜健康饮食 ; a healthy lifestyle｜健康的生活方式 ; stay healthy｜保持健康 ; a healthy economy｜繁荣的经济
tip_zh: 既可形容身体健康，也可形容饮食等有益健康。

meanings_zh: adj. 美丽的；可爱的 | adj. 令人愉快的；友善的
definition_en: beautiful or attractive in a pleasing way | very pleasant, enjoyable, or kind
example1_en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
example1_zh: 厨房窗边有一些漂亮的黄色花朵。
example2_en: Preserving lovely coastal landscapes can attract visitors while giving local residents valuable spaces for outdoor recreation.
example2_zh: 保护美丽的海岸景观既能吸引游客，也能为当地居民提供宝贵的户外休闲空间。
collocations: a lovely view｜美丽的景色 ; have a lovely time｜玩得愉快 ; a lovely person｜友善可亲的人
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词；英式口语中很常见。

meanings_zh: n. 出口；通道 | v. 离开；退出
definition_en: a door or passage used to leave a place | to leave a place or close a computer program
example1_en: We found the exit at the back of the cinema.
example1_zh: 我们在电影院后部找到了出口。
example2_en: Public buildings must have clearly visible emergency exits so that occupants can leave safely during an evacuation.
example2_zh: 公共建筑必须设有清晰可见的紧急出口，以便楼内人员在疏散时安全离开。
collocations: emergency exit｜紧急出口 ; fire exit｜消防出口 ; nearest exit｜最近的出口 ; exit a program｜退出程序
tip_zh: 名词指“出口”，动词指“离开”；不要与 exist 混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 速度比赛；赛跑 | n. 种族 | v. 竞速；飞奔
definition_en: A competition to see who finishes a course fastest. | A social grouping based on perceived shared ancestry and physical characteristics. | To compete in speed or move very quickly.
example1_en: We watched the boat race from the bridge.
example1_zh: 我们在桥上观看了划船比赛。
example2_en: Schools should ensure that all children receive equal educational opportunities, regardless of their race or family income.
example2_zh: 学校应确保所有儿童都享有平等的教育机会，不论其种族或家庭收入。
collocations: win a race｜赢得比赛 ; a relay race｜接力赛 ; regardless of race｜不分种族 ; race against time｜争分夺秒
tip_zh: race可指竞速比赛或种族；不要与民族混同。

meanings_zh: art. 一个（用于元音音素开头的词前）
definition_en: one; used before vowel sounds
example1_en: She ate an apple after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后她吃了一个苹果。
example2_en: It takes an hour to get there by bus.
example2_zh: 坐公交车到那里要一个小时。
tip_zh: an 用在元音音素开头的词前，如 an apple、an hour（h 不发音）。

meanings_zh: n. 唱歌（活动）
definition_en: the activity of making music with your voice
example1_en: Singing in the choir makes her happy.
example1_zh: 在合唱团唱歌让她很开心。
example2_en: We heard beautiful singing from the music room.
example2_zh: 我们听到音乐教室传来美妙的歌声。
tip_zh: singing 是名词“唱歌”；singer 是歌手。

meanings_zh: v. 笑；发笑 | n. 笑；笑声
definition_en: To make sounds showing amusement or happiness. | The sound or act of expressing amusement.
example1_en: The baby's funny dance made everyone laugh at dinner.
example1_zh: 宝宝滑稽的舞蹈让吃晚饭的每个人都笑了。
example2_en: People who laugh together regularly may develop stronger social bonds and cope better with everyday stress.
example2_zh: 经常一起欢笑的人可能建立更牢固的社会联系，并更好地应对日常压力。
collocations: laugh out loud｜大声笑出来 ; make someone laugh｜逗某人笑 ; laugh at a joke｜听了笑话发笑 ; a hearty laugh｜开怀大笑
tip_zh: laugh at人常指嘲笑；laugh with人指一起笑。

meanings_zh: v. 找到；发现 | v. 觉得；认为 | n. 发现物
definition_en: To discover something or locate what you were looking for. | To have a particular opinion or experience of something. | Something useful or valuable that someone discovers.
example1_en: I finally found my keys inside my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 我终于在外套口袋里找到了钥匙。
example2_en: Many students find online courses convenient, although some struggle to stay motivated without classroom interaction.
example2_zh: 许多学生觉得网络课程很方便，但有些人在缺少课堂互动时难以保持学习动力。
collocations: find a solution｜找到解决办法 ; find out｜查明；弄清 ; find it difficult to｜觉得做某事困难 ; a valuable find｜有价值的发现物
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为found；find＋宾语＋形容词。

meanings_zh: v. 卖；出售 | v. 有销路；卖得 | v. 使人接受；推销
definition_en: to give something to someone in exchange for money | to be bought in a particular quantity or way | to persuade someone to accept an idea or proposal
example1_en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
example1_zh: 他们每周六都在市场卖新鲜面包。
example2_en: Small businesses increasingly sell their products online to reach customers beyond their local communities.
example2_zh: 小企业越来越多地在线销售产品，以吸引本地社区以外的顾客。
collocations: sell out｜售罄 ; sell well｜畅销 ; sell something to someone｜把某物卖给某人 ; sell an idea｜推销一个想法
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sold；sell well常用主动形式。

meanings_zh: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的
definition_en: belonging to them
example1_en: The children left their bags in the classroom.
example1_zh: 孩子们把书包落在教室里了。
example2_en: Their house is next to the river.
example2_zh: 他们的房子在河边。
tip_zh: their 是形容词性物主代词；theirs 是名词性物主代词。

meanings_zh: v. 走；步行 | n. 散步；步行路程
definition_en: To move on foot at a pace slower than running | A journey made on foot, often for pleasure
example1_en: We walk to the bakery every Sunday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每个星期天早上都步行去面包店。
example2_en: Safe pavements and attractive public spaces encourage residents to walk rather than drive for short journeys.
example2_zh: 安全的人行道和宜人的公共空间能鼓励居民短途出行时步行而不开车。
collocations: go for a walk｜去散步 ; walk to school｜步行上学 ; walk the dog｜遛狗 ; a brisk walk｜快步走
tip_zh: 字母l不发音；walk the dog意为遛狗。

meanings_zh: prep. 作为；以……身份 | conj. 当……时；因为；如同 | adv. 同样地；一样地
definition_en: used to indicate someone's role or something's purpose | introduces a time, reason, or way something happens | used in comparisons to show an equal degree
example1_en: She works as a guide at the local museum.
example1_zh: 她在当地博物馆担任讲解员。
example2_en: As public transport becomes more reliable, fewer commuters may choose to drive to work.
example2_zh: 随着公共交通变得更加可靠，选择开车上班的通勤者可能会减少。
collocations: work as｜担任 ; as a result｜因此 ; as soon as｜一……就…… ; as well as｜除……之外还
tip_zh: as表示实际身份；like表示相似。重读时读/æz/。

meanings_zh: n. 入口；大门 | n. 进入；入学资格
definition_en: An opening or place through which people enter. | The act of entering or the right to join.
example1_en: I'll meet you at the entrance after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后我在入口处与你碰面。
example2_en: Universities should ensure that entrance requirements recognise different educational backgrounds while maintaining appropriate academic standards.
example2_zh: 大学应确保入学要求兼顾不同教育背景，同时维持适当的学术标准。
collocations: the main entrance｜正门 ; an entrance exam｜入学考试 ; entrance requirements｜入学要求 ; an entrance fee｜入场费
tip_zh: 某处的入口用entrance to，不用entrance of。

meanings_zh: adj. 害羞的；腼腆的 | v. 因受惊而退缩
definition_en: nervous or uncomfortable when meeting or speaking to people | to move away suddenly in fear, especially of a horse
example1_en: Lina felt shy when she joined the new club.
example1_zh: 莉娜刚加入这个新社团时有些害羞。
example2_en: Small group discussions can help shy students gain confidence before speaking in front of the whole class.
example2_zh: 小组讨论可以帮助害羞的学生建立信心，为在全班面前发言做准备。
collocations: feel shy｜感到害羞 ; painfully shy｜极其腼腆 ; shy away from｜回避
tip_zh: shy away from后接名词或动名词，表示回避。

meanings_zh: v. 跑；奔跑 | v. 经营；管理 | v. 运转；运行
definition_en: move quickly on foot, lifting both feet between steps | manage a business, organisation, or activity | operate, or make a machine or program operate
example1_en: We ran through the park before breakfast today.
example1_zh: 今天早饭前，我们跑步穿过了公园。
example2_en: Local councils often run training programmes to help unemployed residents develop skills needed by employers.
example2_zh: 地方议会经常开办培训项目，帮助失业居民培养雇主所需的技能。
collocations: run a business｜经营企业 ; run a programme｜开展项目 ; run smoothly｜运行顺畅 ; run a marathon｜跑马拉松
tip_zh: 过去式ran，过去分词run；现在分词running。

meanings_zh: v. 航行；驾驶帆船 | n. 帆
definition_en: Travel across water in a boat or ship. | A large sheet of material that catches wind to move boats.
example1_en: We sailed across the lake on a sunny afternoon.
example1_zh: 一个晴朗的下午，我们乘船驶过湖面。
example2_en: Ships that sail through sensitive marine habitats should follow strict rules to protect wildlife.
example2_zh: 驶经敏感海洋栖息地的船只应遵守严格规定，以保护野生动物。
collocations: set sail｜启航 ; sail across the ocean｜航行穿越大洋 ; raise the sails｜升帆
tip_zh: 作动词不限于帆船，也可指轮船航行。

meanings_zh: n. 光；光线；灯 | adj. 轻的；明亮的；浅色的 | v. 点燃；照亮
definition_en: brightness that enables sight, or a device producing it | not heavy, bright, or pale in colour | make something burn or provide brightness
example1_en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
example1_zh: 温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。
example2_en: Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
example2_zh: 让自然光进入教室可能有助于提高学生的专注力，并减少用电量。
collocations: natural light｜自然光 ; turn on the light｜开灯 ; light a candle｜点蜡烛 ; light luggage｜轻便行李
tip_zh: 光线通常不可数；一盏灯用a light；动词过去式常用lit。

meanings_zh: n. 柠檬 | adj. 浅黄色的；柠檬色的
definition_en: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice | having a pale yellow colour
example1_en: I squeezed half a lemon over the grilled fish.
example1_zh: 我把半个柠檬的汁挤在烤鱼上。
example2_en: Adding lemon juice to meals can improve flavour without increasing the amount of salt consumed.
example2_zh: 在餐食中加入柠檬汁可以增添风味，而不增加盐的摄入量。
collocations: lemon juice｜柠檬汁 ; a slice of lemon｜一片柠檬 ; lemon zest｜柠檬皮屑
tip_zh: 整个柠檬可数；lemon juice中的juice不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 雾 | v. 使蒙上雾气；变模糊
definition_en: a thick cloud near the ground that limits visibility | to become or make a surface covered with fine droplets
example1_en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
example1_zh: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。
example2_en: Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.
example2_zh: 浓雾可能扰乱交通网络，导致航班取消，并增加道路事故的风险。
collocations: thick fog｜浓雾 ; dense fog｜浓雾 ; fog lifts｜雾散了 ; fog up｜蒙上雾气
tip_zh: fog比mist更浓；fog up常指玻璃蒙上雾气。

meanings_zh: v. 看；注视 | v. 看起来；显得 | n. 看；神情；外观
definition_en: direct your eyes towards someone or something | appear to have a particular quality or condition | an act of looking, or someone's expression or appearance
example1_en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
example1_zh: 看窗边那只小鸟。
example2_en: Public parks often look more attractive when local residents help maintain their gardens and pathways.
example2_zh: 当当地居民协助维护花园和步道时，公共公园往往显得更有吸引力。
collocations: look at｜看 ; look forward to｜期待 ; take a look｜看一看 ; look like｜看起来像
tip_zh: look at后接看的对象；look作系动词后接形容词。

meanings_zh: num. 第一 | adv. 首先；最初；优先
definition_en: coming before all others in order or time | before anything or anyone else
example1_en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
example1_zh: 这是我第一次到海边来。
example2_en: Governments should first improve public transport before encouraging residents to give up private cars.
example2_zh: 政府应先改善公共交通，再鼓励居民放弃私家车。
collocations: first place｜第一名 ; at first｜起初 ; first of all｜首先 ; first aid｜急救
tip_zh: at first指起初；first可用于列举第一点。

meanings_zh: adj. 昂贵的；花钱多的
definition_en: costing a large amount of money
example1_en: These boots are too expensive for my budget.
example1_zh: 这双靴子太贵，超出了我的预算。
example2_en: Housing in major cities is becoming increasingly expensive, forcing many young workers to live farther from their workplaces.
example2_zh: 大城市的住房越来越贵，迫使许多年轻职工住到离工作地点更远的地方。
collocations: too expensive｜太贵 ; increasingly expensive｜日益昂贵 ; expensive to maintain｜维护费用高 ; an expensive mistake｜代价高昂的错误
tip_zh: 物品贵用expensive，价格高用high。

meanings_zh: n. 牙医
definition_en: a professional who examines and treats teeth and gums
example1_en: The dentist checked my teeth and recommended a softer toothbrush.
example1_zh: 牙医检查了我的牙齿，并建议我用更软的牙刷。
example2_en: Regular visits to a dentist can prevent minor dental problems from developing into serious health conditions.
example2_zh: 定期看牙医可以防止小的牙齿问题发展成严重的健康问题。
collocations: see a dentist｜看牙医 ; a dentist's appointment｜牙科预约 ; a qualified dentist｜有执业资格的牙医
tip_zh: dentist指牙医；the dentist's可指牙医诊所。

meanings_zh: n. 语言 | n. 措辞；表达方式
definition_en: a system of words or gestures used for communication | the words and style used in a particular context
example1_en: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
example1_zh: 邻居教我一点她的语言。
example2_en: Learning a foreign language can broaden students' cultural understanding and improve their future employment prospects.
example2_zh: 学习外语可以拓宽学生的文化视野，并改善他们未来的就业前景。
collocations: foreign language｜外语 ; body language｜肢体语言 ; language barrier｜语言障碍 ; formal language｜正式用语
tip_zh: 指某种语言时可数；泛指语言能力时常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 紧张的；忐忑不安的 | adj. 神经的；神经系统的
definition_en: worried or uneasy about what might happen | relating to the nerves in the body
example1_en: I felt nervous before my first swimming lesson yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天第一次上游泳课前，我感到很紧张。
example2_en: Students who feel nervous about examinations may benefit from regular practice and supportive feedback from teachers.
example2_zh: 对考试感到紧张的学生可以从定期练习和教师的鼓励性反馈中获益。
collocations: nervous about｜对……感到紧张 ; feel nervous｜感到紧张 ; nervous system｜神经系统 ; nervous laugh｜紧张的笑声
tip_zh: nervous about后接名词或动名词，表示对某事紧张。

meanings_zh: n. 屋顶；顶部 | v. 给……盖屋顶
definition_en: the top covering of a building or vehicle | to cover a building with a roof
example1_en: Rain drummed on the roof throughout the night.
example1_zh: 雨点整夜敲打着屋顶。
example2_en: Installing solar panels on the roof can help households lower electricity bills and reduce their environmental impact.
example2_zh: 在屋顶安装太阳能板，可以帮助家庭降低电费并减少对环境的影响。
collocations: flat roof｜平屋顶 ; roof tiles｜屋顶瓦片 ; under one roof｜在同一屋檐下 ; roof leak｜屋顶漏水
tip_zh: 复数是roofs；roof指外部屋顶，ceiling指室内天花板。

meanings_zh: adj. 忙碌的 | adj. 繁忙的；人来车往的 | adj. 占线的
definition_en: Having many things to do or being actively occupied. | Full of people, traffic, or activity. | Already being used, especially a telephone line.
example1_en: I am busy making soup for dinner right now.
example1_zh: 我现在正忙着做晚餐要喝的汤。
example2_en: Busy urban roads can discourage cycling unless local authorities provide safe routes separated from motor traffic.
example2_zh: 繁忙的城市道路可能让人不愿骑车，除非地方政府提供与机动车流隔离的安全路线。
collocations: busy doing something｜忙着做某事 ; busy with work｜忙于工作 ; a busy street｜繁忙的街道 ; a busy schedule｜紧凑的日程
tip_zh: 用busy doing或busy with，不用busy to do。

meanings_zh: adv. 再也（不）；（不）再
definition_en: Any longer, usually in negative statements.
example1_en: I don't take the bus to school anymore.
example1_zh: 我不再坐公交车上学了。
example2_en: Many employees do not commute every day anymore because their employers now offer flexible working arrangements.
example2_zh: 许多员工不再每天通勤，因为雇主如今提供灵活的工作安排。
collocations: not live here anymore｜不再住在这里 ; not need it anymore｜不再需要它
tip_zh: 表示“不再”；英式常写any more，数量“更多”须分写。

meanings_zh: v. 写；书写 | v. 创作；写作 | v. 写信
definition_en: To form words on paper or a screen. | To create a story, article, or piece of music. | To send someone a letter or written message.
example1_en: Please write your address on this small card.
example1_zh: 请把你的地址写在这张小卡片上。
example2_en: Students who write regularly often develop stronger reasoning skills and express complex ideas more clearly.
example2_zh: 经常写作的学生往往能培养更强的推理能力，并更清晰地表达复杂观点。
collocations: write an essay｜写文章 ; write to someone｜给某人写信 ; write down｜写下；记下
tip_zh: 不规则变化：write—wrote—written。

meanings_zh: adj. 生病的；身体不适的 | adv. 恶劣地；不友善地
definition_en: Suffering from a disease or feeling unwell. | In a bad or unkind way.
example1_en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
example1_zh: 长途乘车后，我感到身体不适。
example2_en: Employees who are ill should be encouraged to rest rather than return to work immediately.
example2_zh: 应鼓励生病的员工休息，而不是立即返岗。
collocations: seriously ill｜病得很重 ; fall ill｜生病 ; speak ill of｜说……的坏话
tip_zh: 表示生病时通常作表语：be ill。

meanings_zh: v.&n. 工作；干活；起作用
definition_en: to do a job, or to function
example1_en: My father works in a hospital.
example1_zh: 我爸爸在医院工作。
example2_en: The lift is not working today.
example2_zh: 电梯今天不能用。
collocations: go to work｜去上班
tip_zh: work 作动词“工作/运转”，作名词“工作”；job 是可数名词“工作”。

meanings_zh: n. 信用卡
definition_en: a small plastic card used to pay for things later
example1_en: I paid for the jacket with my credit card.
example1_zh: 我用信用卡买了这件夹克。
example2_en: You can pay by credit card in most shops.
example2_zh: 大多数商店都可以用信用卡付款。
tip_zh: credit card 是信用卡（先消费后还款）；debit card 是借记卡。

meanings_zh: n. 食谱；烹饪方法 | n. 促成某结果的方法或因素
definition_en: instructions explaining how to prepare and cook a dish | a method or situation likely to produce a particular result
example1_en: This soup recipe needs only a few simple ingredients.
example1_zh: 这个汤的食谱只需要几种简单的食材。
example2_en: Investment in teacher training and accessible learning materials provides a recipe for educational success.
example2_zh: 投资教师培训并提供易于获取的学习材料，是推动教育成功的有效方法。
collocations: follow a recipe｜按照食谱做菜 ; a recipe for success｜成功之道 ; a recipe for disaster｜招致灾难的做法
tip_zh: recipe指做菜方法；menu是菜单，prescription是处方。

meanings_zh: mv. 能；可以；（can 的过去式）
definition_en: past form of can; used to ask politely
example1_en: Could you help me with this bag?
example1_zh: 你能帮我拿一下这个包吗？
example2_en: When I was five, I could ride a bike.
example2_zh: 我五岁的时候就会骑自行车了。
tip_zh: could 用于请求时比 can 更礼貌，也表示 can 的过去式。

meanings_zh: n. 出生；分娩 | n. 起源；诞生
definition_en: The event or process of a baby being born. | The beginning of something new.
example1_en: The whole family celebrated the birth of our daughter.
example1_zh: 全家人都庆祝了我们女儿的出生。
example2_en: Access to skilled medical care during birth significantly improves health outcomes for both mothers and newborn babies.
example2_zh: 分娩时获得专业医疗护理能显著改善母亲和新生儿的健康状况。
collocations: give birth to｜生下；产生 ; date of birth｜出生日期 ; birth rate｜出生率 ; the birth of a movement｜一场运动的诞生
tip_zh: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。

meanings_zh: n. 狗；犬 | v. 长期困扰；纠缠
definition_en: An animal often kept as a pet or trained for work. | To cause persistent problems for someone or something.
example1_en: Our dog waits by the door every afternoon.
example1_zh: 我们的狗每天下午都守在门边。
example2_en: Training a guide dog requires considerable time, but it can greatly improve someone's independence.
example2_zh: 训练一只导盲犬需要大量时间，但它能显著增强使用者的独立生活能力。
collocations: walk the dog｜遛狗 ; a guide dog｜导盲犬 ; a stray dog｜流浪狗 ; be dogged by problems｜长期受问题困扰
tip_zh: 动词常见被动式be dogged by，表示长期受困扰。

meanings_zh: n. 日历；日程表 | n. 历法
definition_en: A chart of dates or a schedule of events. | A system for dividing time into years, months, and days.
example1_en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
example1_zh: 我在厨房的日历上标出了周末露营的日子。
example2_en: Schools should publish an annual calendar so families can plan holidays around important educational events.
example2_zh: 学校应公布年度日程表，方便家庭避开重要教学活动来安排假期。
collocations: academic calendar｜校历 ; calendar year｜公历年 ; lunar calendar｜阴历
tip_zh: calendar year指一月至十二月，不等于学年。

meanings_zh: adj. 有条纹的
definition_en: Having a pattern of long, narrow bands.
example1_en: She wore a striped shirt and dark blue jeans.
example1_zh: 她穿着一件条纹衬衫和深蓝色牛仔裤。
example2_en: The striped coats of certain animals may help them avoid detection in their natural habitats.
example2_zh: 某些动物带条纹的皮毛可能有助于它们在自然栖息地中避免被发现。
collocations: striped shirt｜条纹衬衫 ; striped fabric｜条纹布料 ; striped pattern｜条纹图案
tip_zh: striped意为有条纹的；strip的过去式是stripped。

meanings_zh: n. 梳子 | v. 梳理；仔细搜寻
definition_en: A toothed tool used to arrange or tidy hair. | To tidy hair with a comb, or search an area thoroughly.
example1_en: She pulled a comb from her bag and tidied her hair.
example1_zh: 她从包里拿出梳子，梳理了一下头发。
example2_en: Volunteers combed the beach for plastic waste before the start of the summer tourist season.
example2_zh: 暑期旅游季开始前，志愿者仔细搜寻海滩上的塑料垃圾。
collocations: comb your hair｜梳头 ; a fine-toothed comb｜细齿梳 ; comb through｜仔细搜查
tip_zh: 词尾b不发音；comb through表示仔细搜查。

meanings_zh: n. 高尔夫球运动
definition_en: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs
example1_en: My grandfather plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
example1_zh: 我祖父每周日都和朋友打高尔夫球。
example2_en: Golf courses can attract tourists, but maintaining their grass may require considerable amounts of water.
example2_zh: 高尔夫球场可以吸引游客，但养护草坪可能需要大量用水。
collocations: play golf｜打高尔夫球 ; a golf course｜高尔夫球场 ; a golf club｜高尔夫球杆；高尔夫俱乐部 ; a round of golf｜一轮高尔夫球
tip_zh: 球类运动前通常不加冠词：play golf。

meanings_zh: v. 说话；交谈；谈论 | n. 谈话；会谈 | n. 演讲；讲座
definition_en: to speak to someone or discuss something | a conversation or discussion between people | a speech given to an audience about a subject
example1_en: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们吃早饭时聊了聊周末的计划。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生坦诚谈论压力，并在需要时寻求帮助。
collocations: talk about something｜谈论某事 ; talk to someone｜与某人交谈 ; give a talk｜作演讲 ; hold talks｜举行会谈
tip_zh: talk about接话题；talk to或with接人。

meanings_zh: adj. 嘈杂的；吵闹的
definition_en: making a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds
example1_en: Our noisy washing machine woke everyone up this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，吵闹的洗衣机把大家都吵醒了。
example2_en: Living near noisy roads can affect sleep quality and increase stress among urban residents.
example2_zh: 住在嘈杂的道路附近可能影响城市居民的睡眠质量并加重压力。
collocations: a noisy neighbour｜吵闹的邻居 ; a noisy environment｜嘈杂的环境 ; a noisy crowd｜喧闹的人群
tip_zh: noisy是形容词，noise是名词；注意不是nosy。

meanings_zh: adj. 先进的 | adj. 高级的；高阶的 | adj. 后期的；晚期的
definition_en: using highly developed technology or methods | requiring knowledge or skills beyond a basic level | having reached a late stage of development or progress
example1_en: This advanced camera takes clear pictures even at night.
example1_zh: 这台先进的相机即使在夜间也能拍出清晰的照片。
example2_en: Advanced medical technology can improve patient outcomes, but its high cost may increase inequalities in healthcare access.
example2_zh: 先进的医疗技术可以改善治疗效果，但其高昂成本可能加剧医疗服务获取方面的不平等。
collocations: advanced technology｜先进技术 ; advanced learners｜高阶学习者 ; at an advanced stage｜处于后期阶段 ; advanced level｜高级水平
tip_zh: advanced表示先进或高级；预先通知用advance notice。

meanings_zh: n. 办公室；办公楼 | n. 办事处；服务处 | n. 公职；官职
definition_en: a room or building where people do administrative work | a place providing a particular service or handling official business | an official position of responsibility, especially in government
example1_en: I left my umbrella under the desk at the office.
example1_zh: 我把伞落在办公室的桌子下面了。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to divide their time between the office and home.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排让员工能够把工作时间分配在办公室和家中。
collocations: office hours｜办公时间 ; head office｜总部 ; hold office｜担任公职 ; take office｜就职
tip_zh: 在办公室用in the office；任公职用in office。

meanings_zh: n. 朋友；友人
definition_en: someone you know well, like, and enjoy spending time with
example1_en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
example1_zh: 我昨天在市场遇到了一位老朋友。
example2_en: Maintaining close friendships can improve mental wellbeing, as friends often provide emotional support during difficult periods.
example2_zh: 维持亲密友谊可以改善心理健康，因为朋友常在困难时期提供情感支持。
collocations: close friend｜亲密的朋友 ; childhood friend｜儿时的朋友 ; make friends with｜与……交朋友 ; keep in touch with friends｜与朋友保持联系
tip_zh: “与某人交朋友”用make friends with，friends用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 风 | v. 缠绕；卷绕 | v. 蜿蜒；曲折延伸
definition_en: Air moving naturally outdoors. | To wrap something around an object or itself. | To follow a route with many bends and turns.
example1_en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
example1_zh: 突然一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。
example2_en: Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.
example2_zh: 投资风能可以帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低碳排放。
collocations: a gust of wind｜一阵风 ; wind power｜风能 ; wind a clock｜给钟上发条 ; wind through｜蜿蜒穿过
tip_zh: 风读/wɪnd/；缠绕读/waɪnd/，过去式wound。

meanings_zh: adj. 确信的；有把握的 | adj. 一定会的；必然的 | adv. 当然；确实
definition_en: Feeling no doubt that something is true or correct. | Certain to happen or do something. | Used informally to agree or strongly confirm something.
example1_en: Are you sure you left your keys here?
example1_zh: 你确定把钥匙落在这里了吗？
example2_en: Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
example2_zh: 政府必须确保农村社区能够稳定地获得基本医疗服务。
collocations: make sure｜确保；确认 ; be sure of｜确信 ; be sure to｜一定会；务必 ; for sure｜确切地；肯定
tip_zh: be sure of表确信；be sure to可表必然或叮嘱。

meanings_zh: adv. 很；非常 | adj. 正是的；恰好的
definition_en: Used to make an adjective or adverb stronger. | Used to emphasize an exact person, thing, place, or time.
example1_en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
example1_zh: 汤很烫，先让它凉一凉。
example2_en: Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
example2_zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通非常重要。
collocations: very important｜非常重要 ; very carefully｜非常仔细地 ; the very beginning｜最开始 ; the very same｜完全相同的
tip_zh: very通常修饰形容词或副词；修饰动词常用very much。

meanings_zh: v. 认为；推测 | v. 假设；设想
definition_en: To think something is probably true without being certain. | To imagine a situation in order to consider its consequences.
example1_en: I suppose we can eat outside if it stays warm.
example1_zh: 我想，如果天气一直这么暖和，我们可以在外面吃饭。
example2_en: Suppose every household used less electricity; the combined reduction in demand could significantly benefit the environment.
example2_zh: 假设每户家庭都减少用电，需求的总体下降就可能为环境带来显著益处。
collocations: I suppose so｜我想是吧 ; suppose that｜假设；认为 ; be supposed to do｜应该做；按安排做
tip_zh: be supposed to表示应该或按安排做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 跳舞；舞蹈
definition_en: the activity of moving your body rhythmically, usually to music
example1_en: We go dancing together at the community centre every Saturday.
example1_zh: 我们每周六都一起去社区中心跳舞。
example2_en: Regular dancing can improve physical fitness while providing opportunities for social interaction across different age groups.
example2_zh: 经常跳舞可以改善体能，同时为不同年龄群体提供社交机会。
collocations: go dancing｜去跳舞 ; ballroom dancing｜交谊舞 ; folk dancing｜民间舞蹈
tip_zh: 作活动名词通常不可数；去跳舞用go dancing。

meanings_zh: det. 更多的；额外的 | adv. 更；更加 | pron. 更多；额外的数量
definition_en: A greater or additional amount or number of something. | To a greater degree or extent. | A greater or additional amount or number.
example1_en: Could you add more rice to my bowl, please?
example1_zh: 请再给我的碗里添点米饭，好吗？
example2_en: Governments should invest more resources in preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
example2_zh: 政府应加大对预防保健的资源投入，以长期减轻医院的压力。
collocations: more than｜多于 ; more and more｜越来越多 ; more likely｜更有可能 ; more information｜更多信息
tip_zh: 可修饰可数或不可数名词；是 many、much 的比较级。

meanings_zh: n. 书；书籍 | v. 预订；预约
definition_en: A set of pages joined together for reading | To arrange in advance to use a service or attend something
example1_en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我把书落在厨房的桌子上了。
example2_en: Public libraries provide free access to books, helping people continue learning regardless of their income.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆提供免费借阅书籍的机会，让不同收入的人都能持续学习。
collocations: read a book｜读书 ; borrow a book｜借书 ; book a flight｜预订航班 ; book an appointment｜预约
tip_zh: book 作动词表示预订，可直接接房间、机票等。

meanings_zh: n. 木材；木头 | n. 树林
definition_en: the hard material forming tree trunks and branches | an area of land covered with trees
example1_en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
example1_zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。
example2_en: Using wood from responsibly managed forests can reduce the environmental impact of constructing new homes.
example2_zh: 使用来自负责任管理的森林的木材，可以减少建造新住宅对环境的影响。
collocations: solid wood｜实木 ; wood carving｜木雕 ; a piece of wood｜一块木头 ; walk in the woods｜在树林中散步
tip_zh: 木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。

meanings_zh: n. 家；住所；家乡 | adv. 在家；回家 | adj. 家庭的；国内的
definition_en: The place where someone lives or feels they belong. | At or towards the place where you live. | Relating to your house or your own country.
example1_en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
example1_zh: 在咖啡馆吃过晚饭后，我们一起走回家。
example2_en: Working from home can reduce commuting costs, but it may also limit social interaction among colleagues.
example2_zh: 居家办公可以降低通勤成本，但也可能限制同事之间的社交互动。
collocations: feel at home｜感到自在 ; return home｜回家 ; home country｜祖国 ; leave home｜离家
tip_zh: home作副词时前面不加to：go home。

meanings_zh: num. 一百万
definition_en: the number equal to a thousand thousands
example1_en: The city now has more than a million residents.
example1_zh: 这座城市如今有一百多万居民。
example2_en: The government plans to invest several million pounds in renewable energy projects over the next decade.
example2_zh: 政府计划在未来十年向可再生能源项目投入数百万英镑。
collocations: a million people｜一百万人 ; two million pounds｜两百万英镑 ; millions of people｜数百万人
tip_zh: 具体数词后million不加s；millions of表示数百万。

meanings_zh: v. 修理；修复 | n. 修理；维修 | v. 补救；修复关系
definition_en: To make something damaged or broken work properly again | Work done to restore something damaged or broken | To improve a damaged relationship or put a situation right
example1_en: Can you repair the broken zip on my jacket?
example1_zh: 你能修好我夹克上坏掉的拉链吗？
example2_en: Encouraging consumers to repair household appliances rather than replace them could significantly reduce electronic waste.
example2_zh: 鼓励消费者维修而非更换家用电器，可以显著减少电子垃圾。
collocations: repair damage｜修复损坏 ; carry out repairs｜进行维修 ; beyond repair｜无法修复 ; in good repair｜保养良好
tip_zh: 具体维修常用复数repairs；beyond repair表示无法修复。

meanings_zh: n. 日期 | n. 约会 | v. 确定年代；始于
definition_en: A particular day of a month or year. | An arranged meeting, especially with someone you find romantically attractive. | To establish something's age, or originate in a particular period.
example1_en: Have you chosen a date for the picnic?
example1_zh: 你选好野餐的日期了吗？
example2_en: Researchers used wooden tools found nearby to date the remains of this ancient village.
example2_zh: 研究人员利用附近发现的木制工具确定这座古村落遗迹的年代。
collocations: set a date｜定日期 ; go on a date｜去约会 ; date back to｜追溯到 ; expiry date｜到期日
tip_zh: date back to表示始于某时期，不用被动语态。

meanings_zh: v. 关闭；关上；停业 | adj. 关闭的；不营业的
definition_en: to close something or stop being open for business | closed or not open for business
example1_en: Please shut the window before the rain gets in.
example1_zh: 请在雨飘进来之前把窗户关上。
example2_en: When local libraries shut, residents lose valuable access to free learning resources and shared community spaces.
example2_zh: 当本地图书馆关闭时，居民便失去了宝贵的免费学习资源和共享社区空间。
collocations: shut the door｜关门 ; shut your eyes｜闭上眼睛 ; shut down a factory｜关闭工厂 ; keep something shut｜让某物保持关闭
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为shut；现在分词为shutting。

meanings_zh: n. 细节；详细信息
definition_en: small facts or pieces of information
example1_en: Please send me the details of the trip.
example1_zh: 请把行程的详细信息发给我。
example2_en: She knows all the details about the project.
example2_zh: 她了解这个项目的所有细节。
collocations: personal details｜个人信息
tip_zh: details 常用复数，指具体信息；personal details 是个人信息。

meanings_zh: n. 俱乐部；社团 | n. 夜总会 | n. 高尔夫球杆；棍棒
definition_en: an organisation whose members share an interest or activity | a place where people dance and socialise at night | a stick used to hit a golf ball or strike something
example1_en: I joined a chess club to meet new people.
example1_zh: 我加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部，想认识些新朋友。
example2_en: A school sports club can help students develop teamwork skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
example2_zh: 学校体育社团可以帮助学生培养团队合作能力，同时鼓励他们经常锻炼。
collocations: join a club｜加入俱乐部 ; a sports club｜体育俱乐部 ; a club member｜俱乐部成员 ; a golf club｜高尔夫球杆
tip_zh: join a club表示加入社团，不用join in a club。

meanings_zh: pron. 我自己 | pron. 我亲自；我本人
definition_en: Used when I am both the person acting and receiving. | Used to emphasize that I personally do something.
example1_en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
example1_zh: 散步前，我给自己做了个三明治。
example2_en: By volunteering at a community garden, I taught myself practical skills that formal education rarely provides.
example2_zh: 通过在社区花园做志愿者，我自学了正规教育很少传授的实用技能。
collocations: by myself｜独自；独立地 ; teach myself｜自学 ; enjoy myself｜玩得开心 ; not feel myself｜感觉不在状态
tip_zh: by myself表示独自或独立；不能用myself代替主语I。

meanings_zh: adv. 已经；早已
definition_en: before now or earlier than expected
example1_en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我已经收拾好明天要用的包了。
example2_en: Many cities have already introduced cycling schemes to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
example2_zh: 许多城市已经推出骑行计划，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。
collocations: have already done｜已经做过 ; already available｜已经可以获得 ; already in place｜已经就位；已落实
tip_zh: 常置于助动词后、实义动词前；表示已经或比预期早。

meanings_zh: n. 马桶；便器 | n. 厕所；洗手间
definition_en: a bowl-shaped fixture used for getting rid of bodily waste | a room containing a toilet
example1_en: The toilet upstairs keeps making a strange dripping sound.
example1_zh: 楼上的马桶一直发出奇怪的滴水声。
example2_en: Access to clean public toilets is essential for protecting health and making urban spaces welcoming to everyone.
example2_zh: 提供干净的公共厕所，对保障健康和打造人人友好的城市空间至关重要。
collocations: flush the toilet｜冲厕所 ; public toilets｜公共厕所 ; toilet paper｜卫生纸 ; toilet seat｜马桶座圈
tip_zh: 美式toilet通常指马桶；问公共洗手间常用restroom。

meanings_zh: n. 祖母；外祖母
definition_en: The mother of your father or mother.
example1_en: My grandmother grows fresh herbs on her kitchen windowsill.
example1_zh: 我的祖母在厨房窗台上种新鲜的香草。
example2_en: For many working parents, a grandmother provides essential childcare and helps maintain strong family connections.
example2_zh: 对许多在职父母来说，祖母或外祖母提供了不可或缺的育儿帮助，也有助于维系紧密的家庭关系。
collocations: maternal grandmother｜外祖母 ; paternal grandmother｜祖母 ; great-grandmother｜曾祖母；曾外祖母
tip_zh: 可指祖母或外祖母；口语常用grandma。

meanings_zh: n. 药；药物 | n. 医学；医术
definition_en: A substance used to treat or prevent illness. | The study and practice of treating and preventing illness.
example1_en: The pharmacist explained how often to take the medicine.
example1_zh: 药剂师解释了这种药应该多久服用一次。
example2_en: Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.
example2_zh: 医学进步延长了预期寿命，但各地区获得有效治疗的机会仍不平等。
collocations: take medicine｜服药 ; study medicine｜学医 ; preventive medicine｜预防医学 ; prescribe medicine｜开药
tip_zh: 服药用take medicine；表示医学时不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 关着的；闭合的 | adj. 停止营业的 | adj. 不接受新思想的
definition_en: not open | not available for business or public use | unwilling to consider different ideas
example1_en: Keep the window closed while the heating is on.
example1_zh: 开着暖气时，请把窗户关好。
example2_en: When local libraries remain closed at weekends, working families have fewer opportunities to access educational resources.
example2_zh: 如果当地图书馆周末不开放，上班族家庭获取教育资源的机会就会减少。
collocations: keep something closed｜使某物保持关闭 ; closed for repairs｜停业维修 ; a closed mind｜封闭的思想
tip_zh: 形容词意为“关着的”；也是close的过去式和过去分词。

meanings_zh: n. 钓鱼；捕鱼
definition_en: the activity of catching fish for pleasure or food
example1_en: We went fishing by the lake before breakfast.
example1_zh: 早饭前，我们去湖边钓鱼了。
example2_en: Strict limits on commercial fishing can help marine ecosystems recover and support coastal communities in the long term.
example2_zh: 严格限制商业捕鱼能帮助海洋生态系统恢复，并长期支持沿海社区的生计。
collocations: go fishing｜去钓鱼 ; fishing rod｜钓竿 ; commercial fishing｜商业捕鱼 ; fishing village｜渔村
tip_zh: 说“去钓鱼”用go fishing，不用go to fishing。

meanings_zh: v. 踢 | n. 踢；踢击
definition_en: to hit something with your foot | an act of hitting something with your foot
example1_en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
example1_zh: 她轻轻地把球踢向弟弟。
example2_en: Children learn to kick and throw balls through activities that improve coordination and encourage teamwork.
example2_zh: 孩子们通过能够改善协调能力、培养团队精神的活动学习踢球和投球。
collocations: kick a ball｜踢球 ; kick a habit｜戒掉习惯 ; free kick｜任意球
tip_zh: kick用脚踢；hit泛指击打，不限定用什么。

meanings_zh: n. 歌曲
definition_en: a piece of music with words
example1_en: This song is my favourite at the moment.
example1_zh: 这首歌是我现在最喜欢的。
example2_en: They sang a happy song at the party.
example2_zh: 他们在聚会上唱了一首欢快的歌。
tip_zh: song 是“歌曲”；sing a song 是“唱歌”。

meanings_zh: v. 做；干
definition_en: to perform an action or activity
example1_en: What do you do at the weekend?
example1_zh: 你周末做什么？
example2_en: I have a lot of homework to do.
example2_zh: 我有很多作业要做。
collocations: do homework｜做作业 ; do the dishes｜洗碗
tip_zh: do 也用作助动词构成疑问句和否定句：Do you like tea?

meanings_zh: n. 狮子
definition_en: A large wild cat, whose males usually have thick neck hair.
example1_en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
example1_zh: 那头狮子在树荫下休息。
example2_en: Protecting lions requires large habitats where they can hunt naturally without coming into conflict with farmers.
example2_zh: 保护狮子需要大片栖息地，让它们能够自然捕猎而不与农民发生冲突。
collocations: a pride of lions｜一群狮子 ; a lion's mane｜狮子的鬃毛 ; the lion's share｜最大的一份
tip_zh: 狮群用a pride of lions；母狮称lioness。

meanings_zh: n. 部门；司局；系 | n. 商店的商品部
definition_en: a division of an organisation responsible for a particular subject | an area of a shop selling a particular type of product
example1_en: Please ask our sales department about the delivery date.
example1_zh: 请向我们的销售部门询问送货日期。
example2_en: Each university department should review its courses regularly to ensure they reflect developments in the relevant field.
example2_zh: 大学各系应定期审查课程，确保课程反映相关领域的发展。
collocations: sales department｜销售部 ; government department｜政府部门 ; department head｜部门负责人 ; department store｜百货商店
tip_zh: 大学的系可用department；学院通常用faculty或school。

meanings_zh: n. 项链
definition_en: a piece of jewellery worn around the neck
example1_en: She wore a silver necklace with a tiny bird.
example1_zh: 她戴着一条带有小鸟吊坠的银项链。
example2_en: A handmade necklace can reflect local traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.
example2_zh: 一条手工项链既能体现当地传统，也能为农村社区的手工艺人带来收入。
collocations: wear a necklace｜戴项链 ; a pearl necklace｜珍珠项链 ; a silver necklace｜银项链
tip_zh: 结尾-lace读/ləs/，不是单词lace的读音。

meanings_zh: n. 角落；拐角 | v. 逼入困境；使无路可逃
definition_en: A place where two sides, walls, or streets meet. | To trap someone so they cannot escape or avoid answering.
example1_en: We put a small lamp in the corner.
example1_zh: 我们在角落里放了一盏小灯。
example2_en: Shops on street corners can encourage walking by making everyday services more accessible to local residents.
example2_zh: 街角商店让当地居民更方便地获得日常服务，从而鼓励人们步行。
collocations: street corner｜街角 ; around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来 ; in the corner｜在角落里 ; corner the market｜垄断市场
tip_zh: 室内角落用in the corner；街道拐角常用on或at。

meanings_zh: n. 运动；练习 | v. 锻炼；运动 | v. 行使；运用
definition_en: Physical activity for health, or a task for practising skills. | To do physical activity to stay healthy or become stronger. | To use a right, power, ability, or quality.
example1_en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
example1_zh: 我步行去商店，顺便锻炼一下。
example2_en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
example2_zh: 经常运动能够改善心理健康，并降低几种常见慢性病的患病风险。
collocations: regular exercise｜经常运动 ; do exercises｜做练习 ; exercise caution｜谨慎行事 ; exercise your rights｜行使权利
tip_zh: 泛指运动时不可数；一项练习或一套动作中的动作可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 柔软的；软的 | adj. 轻柔的；柔和的 | adj. 不严厉的；心软的
definition_en: easy to press, bend, or change in shape | gentle and not loud, bright, or harsh | not strict or severe enough
example1_en: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
example1_zh: 这条柔软的毯子让我在寒冷的夜晚保持温暖。
example2_en: Soft lighting and comfortable furniture can make hospital waiting areas feel less stressful for patients.
example2_zh: 柔和的灯光和舒适的家具可以减轻患者在医院候诊区的紧张感。
collocations: soft skin｜柔软的皮肤 ; a soft voice｜轻柔的声音 ; soft lighting｜柔和的灯光 ; be soft on｜对……宽容
tip_zh: soft是形容词；修饰说话等动作通常用softly。

meanings_zh: n. 墙；围墙 | v. 用墙围住；用墙隔开
definition_en: An upright structure enclosing, dividing, or supporting a space. | To surround or separate an area with a wall.
example1_en: We hung a colourful painting on the kitchen wall.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房墙上挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。
example2_en: Green walls covered with plants can improve air quality and reduce heat in crowded urban areas.
example2_zh: 覆盖植物的绿墙可以改善空气质量，并减少拥挤城区的热量。
collocations: stone wall｜石墙 ; boundary wall｜界墙 ; wall off｜用墙隔开
tip_zh: 图片挂在墙上用on；嵌在墙内用in。

meanings_zh: det. 一些；若干 | pron. 一些人；一些事物 | adv. 大约
definition_en: An unspecified amount or number of something. | An unspecified number or amount of people or things. | Approximately, used before an amount or number.
example1_en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
example1_zh: 我在回家的路上买了些新鲜面包。
example2_en: Some residents support the proposed cycle lanes, while others worry about losing parking spaces.
example2_zh: 一些居民支持拟建的自行车道，另一些人则担心停车位会减少。
collocations: some of｜……中的一些 ; some time｜一段时间 ; some advice｜一些建议 ; some twenty years｜大约二十年
tip_zh: 可修饰复数名词或不可数名词；弱读常为/səm/。

meanings_zh: adj. 感兴趣的 | adj. 有利害关系的
definition_en: Wanting to learn about or take part in something. | Likely to be affected by a situation or decision.
example1_en: My sister is interested in learning to grow vegetables.
example1_zh: 我姐姐对学习种菜很感兴趣。
example2_en: Students who are interested in science should have regular opportunities to conduct practical experiments.
example2_zh: 对科学感兴趣的学生应该经常有机会开展实际实验。
collocations: interested in｜对……感兴趣 ; interested to hear｜有兴趣听到 ; interested parties｜利益相关方
tip_zh: 人感到有兴趣用interested；后接in加名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 金色的 | adj. 绝佳的；珍贵的
definition_en: Having the warm yellow colour of gold. | Especially valuable, favourable, or successful.
example1_en: The bread turned golden after twenty minutes in the oven.
example1_zh: 面包在烤箱里烤了二十分钟后变成了金黄色。
example2_en: International exchange programmes offer students a golden opportunity to develop language skills and understand different cultures.
example2_zh: 国际交流项目为学生提供了提高语言能力、了解不同文化的绝佳机会。
collocations: golden brown｜金黄偏褐色的 ; golden opportunity｜绝佳机会 ; golden age｜黄金时代 ; golden rule｜重要准则
tip_zh: golden多形容颜色；表示金制的通常用gold。

meanings_zh: n. 手指 | v. 用手指触摸或拨弄
definition_en: one of the long movable parts of a hand | to touch or handle something with your fingers
example1_en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
example1_zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。
example2_en: Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.
example2_zh: 需要手指精细动作的任务可以帮助幼儿在学习写字前发展协调能力。
collocations: index finger｜食指 ; middle finger｜中指 ; point a finger at｜用手指指向；指责
tip_zh: 通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。

meanings_zh: v. 担心；使担忧 | n. 担忧；令人担忧的事
definition_en: To feel anxious, or make someone feel anxious. | An anxious feeling or something that causes it.
example1_en: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
example1_zh: 猫待在外面时，我会担心她。
example2_en: Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.
example2_zh: 许多家长担心，过长的屏幕使用时间可能影响孩子的睡眠和注意力。
collocations: worry about｜担心 ; a major worry｜一大忧虑 ; cause worry｜引起担忧 ; financial worries｜经济方面的忧虑
tip_zh: worry about表示担心某事；worried描述人的状态。

meanings_zh: phr v. 醒来；叫醒
definition_en: to stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping
example1_en: I wake up at six thirty on school days.
example1_zh: 上学日我六点半醒来。
example2_en: Please wake me up at seven tomorrow.
example2_zh: 明天七点请叫醒我。
tip_zh: wake up 是“醒来”；叫醒某人说 wake sb up。

meanings_zh: det. 哪一个；哪些 | pron. 哪一个；哪些 | pron. ……的那个；这件事
definition_en: Used before a noun to ask about a limited choice. | Used to ask about a choice without repeating the noun. | Introduces information about a thing or a previous statement.
example1_en: Which jacket should I wear to dinner tonight?
example1_zh: 今晚去吃饭我该穿哪件夹克？
example2_en: Governments must decide which policies will improve air quality without placing excessive financial pressure on households.
example2_zh: 政府必须决定哪些政策能改善空气质量，又不会给家庭造成过大的经济压力。
collocations: which of｜……中的哪一个 ; which one｜哪一个 ; in which case｜如果是那样的话
tip_zh: which常用于限定范围内的选择；what范围更开放。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；方式 | n. 路线；方向 | adv. 远远地；大大地
definition_en: A method of doing something. | A route or direction leading somewhere. | By a large amount or distance.
example1_en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
example1_zh: 教我一个更简单的叠床单方法吧。
example2_en: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通是减少交通拥堵和城市空气污染的有效方法。
collocations: an effective way｜一种有效的方法 ; find a way｜找到办法 ; on the way｜在途中 ; way too expensive｜贵得多
tip_zh: “做某事的方法”可用way to do或way of doing。

meanings_zh: n. 时尚；流行款式 | n. 方式 | v. 制作；塑造
definition_en: A style of clothing or behaviour popular at a particular time | A particular way of doing something | Make or shape something, often using simple materials
example1_en: My sister follows fashion but rarely buys expensive clothes.
example1_zh: 我姐姐关注时尚，但很少买昂贵的衣服。
example2_en: The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.
example2_zh: 时装行业可以通过生产耐穿的衣服和使用回收材料来减少对环境的影响。
collocations: in fashion｜流行的 ; out of fashion｜过时的 ; fashion industry｜时装行业 ; in a similar fashion｜以类似的方式
tip_zh: 表方式时常用in a ... fashion，语气较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 大船；海船 | v. 运输；运送
definition_en: A large boat carrying people or goods, especially at sea. | To send goods somewhere by sea, air, or land.
example1_en: We watched a huge ship glide into the harbour.
example1_zh: 我们看着一艘巨轮缓缓驶入港口。
example2_en: Many countries ship agricultural products overseas, making reliable transport networks essential for economic growth.
example2_zh: 许多国家向海外运送农产品，因此可靠的运输网络对经济增长至关重要。
collocations: cargo ship｜货船 ; cruise ship｜游轮 ; ship goods｜运送货物 ; on board a ship｜在船上
tip_zh: ship作动词不只指海运，也可指陆运或空运。

meanings_zh: n. 手臂 | n. 扶手；臂状部件 | v. 武装；提供装备
definition_en: The body part connecting your shoulder to your hand. | A projecting part of an object, especially a chair. | To provide weapons or useful tools for a task.
example1_en: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
example1_zh: 她轻轻地把熟睡的宝宝抱在怀里。
example2_en: Schools should arm students with practical skills that help them adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.
example2_zh: 学校应让学生掌握实用技能，帮助他们适应快速变化的职场。
collocations: fold your arms｜双臂交叉 ; a chair arm｜椅子扶手 ; arm someone with knowledge｜用知识充实某人
tip_zh: 表“武器”用复数arms；arm还可作动词。

meanings_zh: n. 成年女性；女子
definition_en: An adult female person.
example1_en: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers on her balcony.
example1_zh: 隔壁那位女士在阳台上种了漂亮的花。
example2_en: Ensuring that every woman has access to education can improve health and economic opportunities across generations.
example2_zh: 确保每位女性都能接受教育，可以改善几代人的健康状况和经济机会。
collocations: young woman｜年轻女性 ; working woman｜职业女性 ; women's rights｜女性权利
tip_zh: 复数women读/ˈwɪmɪn/，注意首音节变化。

meanings_zh: adj. 下一个的；紧接着的 | adv. 接下来；下次
definition_en: coming immediately after the present one | immediately after this; on the following occasion
example1_en: Our next bus leaves in about ten minutes.
example1_zh: 我们要坐的下一班公交车大约十分钟后发车。
example2_en: Over the next decade, governments will need to invest more heavily in affordable public transport.
example2_zh: 未来十年，各国政府需要加大对价格可负担的公共交通的投入。
collocations: next week｜下周 ; the next step｜下一步 ; next time｜下次 ; next to｜紧挨着
tip_zh: “下周”用next week，不加the；the next week指随后一周。

meanings_zh: n. 洗衣机
definition_en: a machine that washes clothes
example1_en: The washing machine is making a strange noise.
example1_zh: 洗衣机发出奇怪的声音。
example2_en: She put the dirty clothes into the washing machine.
example2_zh: 她把脏衣服放进洗衣机。
tip_zh: washing machine 是洗衣机；do the washing 是洗衣服。

meanings_zh: n. 警察；警方 | v. 维持治安；监督执行
definition_en: The official organisation responsible for preventing crime and maintaining order. | To maintain order somewhere or ensure rules are obeyed.
example1_en: The police helped us find our missing bicycle.
example1_zh: 警方帮我们找到了丢失的自行车。
example2_en: Effective cooperation between police and local residents can improve public safety and build trust within communities.
example2_zh: 警方与当地居民的有效合作可以改善公共安全，并建立社区内部的信任。
collocations: police officer｜警察 ; police station｜警察局 ; call the police｜报警 ; police an event｜维持活动秩序
tip_zh: the police作主语用复数；一名警察用a police officer。

meanings_zh: adv. 差劲地；糟糕地 | adv. 严重地 | adv. 非常；迫切地
definition_en: In a way that is poor, unsuccessful, or unacceptable | To a serious or harmful degree | Very much, especially when wanting or needing something
example1_en: I slept badly because the room was too hot.
example1_zh: 房间太热，我睡得很不好。
example2_en: Poorly maintained roads can badly affect rural communities by limiting access to schools, hospitals, and markets.
example2_zh: 维护不善的道路会限制人们前往学校、医院和市场，严重影响农村社区。
collocations: perform badly｜表现不佳 ; badly damaged｜严重受损 ; badly needed｜急需的
tip_zh: 比较级worse，最高级worst；不是bad的形容词用法。

meanings_zh: adj. 年轻的；幼小的 | n. 幼崽；幼鸟
definition_en: Having lived or existed for only a short time | The babies of an animal
example1_en: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
example1_zh: 一只小猫在我空着的鞋子里睡着了。
example2_en: Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.
example2_zh: 年轻人需要负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，才能在大城市独立生活。
collocations: young people｜年轻人 ; young children｜幼儿 ; from a young age｜从小 ; raise their young｜养育幼崽
tip_zh: the young指年轻人群体；动物的幼崽也可用young。

meanings_zh: pron. 每个人；所有人
definition_en: Every person in a group, or all people generally.
example1_en: Everybody is waiting outside for the doors to open.
example1_zh: 所有人都在外面等着开门。
example2_en: Public libraries should offer accessible services so that everybody can benefit from opportunities for lifelong learning.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应提供无障碍服务，让每个人都能受益于终身学习的机会。
collocations: everybody else｜其他所有人 ; almost everybody｜几乎所有人 ; everybody involved｜所有相关人员
tip_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数：Everybody is ready。

meanings_zh: n. 飞行员 | adj. 试点的；试验性的 | v. 驾驶飞机；试行
definition_en: a person who flies an aircraft | done on a small scale to test whether something works | to fly an aircraft or test a new plan
example1_en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly despite strong winds.
example1_zh: 尽管风很大，飞行员还是平稳地让飞机着陆了。
example2_en: The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 地方议会推出了一项试点计划，以评估免费乘坐公交车能否缓解交通拥堵。
collocations: airline pilot｜民航飞行员 ; pilot scheme｜试点计划 ; pilot study｜初步试验研究 ; pilot a programme｜试行一个项目
tip_zh: pilot作定语常表示试点，如pilot project。

meanings_zh: n. 网球运动员
definition_en: a person who plays tennis
example1_en: She is a promising young tennis player.
example1_zh: 她是一名有前途的年轻网球运动员。
example2_en: The tennis player served the ball very fast.
example2_zh: 这名网球运动员发球很快。
tip_zh: tennis player 是网球选手；play tennis 是打网球。

meanings_zh: v. 继续；持续 | v. 重新开始；接着说
definition_en: To keep doing something or keep happening. | To start again after a pause or interruption.
example1_en: We continued walking along the beach despite the rain.
example1_zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是继续沿着海滩走。
example2_en: If housing costs continue to rise, more young adults may struggle to live independently in major cities.
example2_zh: 如果住房成本持续上涨，更多年轻人可能难以在大城市独立生活。
collocations: continue to grow｜继续增长 ; continue working｜继续工作 ; continue a discussion｜继续讨论 ; continue as planned｜按计划继续
tip_zh: 可接to do或doing，通常都表示继续做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 橙；橙子 | adj. 橙色的 | n. 橙色
definition_en: A round citrus fruit with orange skin and juicy flesh. | Having a colour between red and yellow. | The colour between red and yellow.
example1_en: I peeled an orange and shared it with my sister.
example1_zh: 我剥了一个橙子，和妹妹分着吃。
example2_en: An orange provides vitamin C, but a balanced diet requires a variety of foods.
example2_zh: 橙子能提供维生素C，但均衡饮食需要多种食物。
collocations: orange juice｜橙汁 ; orange peel｜橙皮 ; bright orange｜鲜橙色
tip_zh: 橙子可数；表示橙色时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 电影院 | n. 电影艺术；电影业
definition_en: A place where people pay to watch films. | Films considered as an art form or industry.
example1_en: We met outside the cinema and bought some popcorn.
example1_zh: 我们在电影院外碰面，买了些爆米花。
example2_en: International cinema allows audiences to explore unfamiliar cultures and consider social issues from different perspectives.
example2_zh: 国际电影让观众能够了解陌生的文化，并从不同角度思考社会问题。
collocations: go to the cinema｜去看电影 ; a cinema ticket｜电影票 ; world cinema｜世界电影 ; independent cinema｜独立电影
tip_zh: 英式常说go to the cinema，美式常说go to the movies。

meanings_zh: n. 比赛 | v. 相配；匹配；比得上 | n. 火柴
definition_en: a sports contest between two people or teams | to go well together, correspond, or equal something | a small stick that produces fire when rubbed
example1_en: We watched a football match at the local park.
example1_zh: 我们在附近的公园看了一场足球比赛。
example2_en: Training programmes should match the skills taught in colleges with the needs of local employers.
example2_zh: 培训项目应使院校教授的技能与当地雇主的需求相匹配。
collocations: win a match｜赢得比赛 ; match A with B｜将A与B匹配 ; strike a match｜划火柴 ; a perfect match｜绝配
tip_zh: match强调搭配协调；fit常指尺寸合适。

meanings_zh: n. 心脏 | n. 内心；感情 | n. 核心；中心
definition_en: The organ that pumps blood around the body. | The part of someone associated with feelings and love. | The central or most important part of something.
example1_en: My heart beats faster when I run uphill.
example1_zh: 我跑上坡时，心跳会加快。
example2_en: Regular physical activity strengthens the heart and can reduce the risk of serious illness.
example2_zh: 经常运动能增强心脏功能，并降低患严重疾病的风险。
collocations: heart disease｜心脏病 ; at the heart of｜处于……的核心 ; learn by heart｜背熟 ; lose heart｜灰心
tip_zh: by heart表示熟记；lose heart表示灰心。

meanings_zh: n. 餐厅；饭厅
definition_en: a room in a house where people eat meals
example1_en: We have dinner in the dining room every evening.
example1_zh: 我们每天晚上在饭厅吃晚饭。
example2_en: The dining room table can seat six people.
example2_zh: 饭厅的桌子可以坐六个人。
tip_zh: dining room 是家里吃饭的房间；restaurant 是外面的餐馆。

meanings_zh: adj. 干的；干燥的 | v. 使变干；变干 | adj. 枯燥的；乏味的
definition_en: not wet or containing very little moisture | to remove moisture or become free from moisture | not interesting or entertaining
example1_en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
example1_zh: 毛巾在阳光下晾过后已经干了。
example2_en: Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.
example2_zh: 长期干旱天气会损害农作物，并威胁农业社区的粮食安全。
collocations: dry weather｜干旱天气 ; dry skin｜干燥的皮肤 ; dry your hands｜擦干双手 ; dry up｜干涸
tip_zh: 形容词比较级drier；名词dryer指烘干设备。

meanings_zh: phr v. 上车；登上
definition_en: to enter a bus, train, plane or bike
example1_en: We got on the train just before it left.
example1_zh: 我们正好在火车开走前上了车。
example2_en: She got on her bike and rode away.
example2_zh: 她骑上自行车走了。
collocations: get on with someone｜和某人相处
tip_zh: get on 表示“上车”；get on with sb 是“与某人相处融洽”。

meanings_zh: v. 需要；必须 | n. 需要；需求 | n. 贫困；困境
definition_en: To require something because it is necessary or important | Something necessary or the condition of requiring it | A situation in which essential things are lacking
example1_en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
example1_zh: 天气炎热时，这些植物需要更多的水。
example2_en: Cities need to improve public transport if they want to reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 城市若想减少人们对私家车的依赖，就需要改善公共交通。
collocations: need to do something｜需要做某事 ; meet basic needs｜满足基本需求 ; in need｜处于困境中 ; an urgent need｜迫切的需要
tip_zh: need to do表需要做；need doing表需要被做。

meanings_zh: adj. 饥饿的 | adj. 渴望的
definition_en: Feeling the need or desire to eat. | Having a strong desire for something.
example1_en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
example1_zh: 在河边走了很久之后，我觉得饿了。
example2_en: School meal programmes help hungry children concentrate in class and participate more actively in learning.
example2_zh: 学校供餐计划帮助饥饿的孩子集中课堂注意力，更积极地参与学习。
collocations: feel hungry｜感到饿 ; go hungry｜挨饿 ; hungry for success｜渴望成功
tip_zh: hungry for后接名词，表示渴望某物。

meanings_zh: adv. 以前
definition_en: Before the present time, following an expression of time
example1_en: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
example1_zh: 一小时前，我把雨伞落在了公交车上。
example2_en: Many jobs that seemed secure a decade ago now require workers to develop new digital skills.
example2_zh: 许多十年前看似稳定的工作，如今要求员工掌握新的数字技能。
collocations: a few days ago｜几天前 ; a long time ago｜很久以前 ; not long ago｜不久前 ; as recently as a year ago｜就在一年前
tip_zh: ago放在时间段后，通常搭配一般过去时。

meanings_zh: n. 水果；果实 | n. 成果；结果 | v. 结果实
definition_en: Plant products containing seeds, often sweet and eaten as food. | The useful results of work or effort. | To produce fruit.
example1_en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
example1_zh: 她在我的午餐盒里放了新鲜水果。
example2_en: Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.
example2_zh: 让新鲜水果价格更亲民，可以鼓励低收入家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: fresh fruit｜新鲜水果 ; fruit juice｜果汁 ; bear fruit｜结果实；取得成果 ; the fruits of your labour｜劳动成果
tip_zh: 泛指水果通常不可数；fruits可指种类或成果。

meanings_zh: adj. 圆形的；球形的 | n. 一轮；一回合 | prep. 围绕；绕过
definition_en: shaped like a circle or ball | one stage in a repeated series of activities | around something or on all sides of it
example1_en: We placed a round table beside the kitchen window.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房窗边放了一张圆桌。
example2_en: A further round of negotiations may help governments reach an agreement on reducing industrial emissions.
example2_zh: 新一轮谈判可能有助于各国政府就减少工业排放达成协议。
collocations: round table｜圆桌 ; a round of talks｜一轮会谈 ; walk round the lake｜绕湖散步
tip_zh: round作介词常见于英式英语，美式多用around。

meanings_zh: n. 儿子
definition_en: A male child in relation to his parents.
example1_en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
example1_zh: 他们的儿子帮他们在花园里种花。
example2_en: Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.
example2_zh: 父母应给予儿子和女儿平等的机会，让他们接受教育并培养实用技能。
collocations: an only son｜独生子 ; an eldest son｜长子 ; raise a son｜养育儿子
tip_zh: son与sun同音；成年男性也仍是父母的son。

meanings_zh: n. 性格；品质；特色 | n. 角色；人物 | n. 字符；文字
definition_en: the qualities that make someone or something distinctive | a person represented in a story, play, or film | a written or printed symbol, such as a letter
example1_en: Her cheerful character makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
example1_zh: 她开朗的性格让阴雨的早晨也显得明朗起来。
example2_en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
example2_zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。
collocations: main character｜主要角色 ; strength of character｜坚强品格 ; distinctive character｜独特风貌 ; Chinese characters｜汉字
tip_zh: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上方；越过 | prep. 超过 | adv. 结束
definition_en: above something or from one side to the other | more than a particular amount, age, or level | finished or no longer happening
example1_en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟飞过了花园的围墙。
example2_en: Over half of the residents surveyed supported plans to create more green spaces in their neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 受访居民中有超过一半支持在社区内增设绿地的计划。
collocations: over the bridge｜越过桥梁 ; over half｜超过一半 ; be over｜结束 ; all over the world｜世界各地
tip_zh: over可指越过或超过；be over表示结束。

meanings_zh: n. 节日；庆祝活动 | n. 艺术节；系列展演活动
definition_en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event | An organised series of performances or other cultural events
example1_en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
example1_zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。
example2_en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
example2_zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。
collocations: celebrate a festival｜庆祝节日 ; music festival｜音乐节 ; film festival｜电影节 ; hold a festival｜举办节庆活动
tip_zh: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

meanings_zh: n. 蔬菜
definition_en: a plant or plant part eaten as food
example1_en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
example1_zh: 我们今天早上在市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving a wider variety of vegetables at lunchtime.
example2_zh: 学校可以在午餐时供应更多种类的蔬菜，鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: fresh vegetables｜新鲜蔬菜 ; leafy vegetables｜叶菜 ; vegetable soup｜蔬菜汤 ; vegetable garden｜菜园
tip_zh: 通常为可数名词；泛指多种蔬菜用vegetables。

meanings_zh: v. 收到；得到 | v. 接待；迎接
definition_en: To get something that someone sends, gives, or provides. | To welcome someone arriving at a place.
example1_en: Did you receive the photos I sent yesterday?
example1_zh: 你收到我昨天发的照片了吗？
example2_en: All residents should receive clear information about changes to public transport before new routes are introduced.
example2_zh: 在新线路开通之前，所有居民都应获得有关公共交通调整的明确信息。
collocations: receive an email｜收到电子邮件 ; receive treatment｜接受治疗 ; receive a warm welcome｜受到热烈欢迎
tip_zh: receive侧重收到；accept侧重愿意接受。

meanings_zh: n. 词典；字典
definition_en: a resource listing words with their meanings, pronunciations, or translations
example1_en: I checked the pronunciation of this word in a dictionary.
example1_zh: 我查了词典，确认这个词的发音。
example2_en: Using a bilingual dictionary can help language learners understand unfamiliar vocabulary without relying entirely on their teachers.
example2_zh: 使用双语词典能帮助语言学习者理解陌生词汇，而不必完全依赖教师。
collocations: bilingual dictionary｜双语词典 ; online dictionary｜在线词典 ; consult a dictionary｜查阅词典 ; dictionary entry｜词典条目
tip_zh: 查词用look up a word in a dictionary。

meanings_zh: adv. 也许；可能
definition_en: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
example1_en: Maybe we can have a picnic if the weather improves.
example1_zh: 如果天气好转，也许我们可以去野餐。
example2_en: Maybe cities could reduce traffic congestion by offering cheaper public transport rather than building more roads.
example2_zh: 也许城市可以通过提供更便宜的公共交通，而非修建更多道路，来缓解交通拥堵。
collocations: maybe later｜也许晚点 ; maybe not｜也许不会 ; maybe next time｜也许下次
tip_zh: maybe是副词；may be是情态动词加be。

meanings_zh: n. 痕迹；记号 | n. 分数；成绩 | v. 做标记；批改评分
definition_en: a visible spot, line, or symbol on a surface | a score showing the quality of a student's work | to indicate something visibly or assess a student's work
example1_en: Your wet glass left a mark on the table.
example1_zh: 你的湿杯子在桌上留下了一道印子。
example2_en: Teachers should mark assignments consistently so that students receive fair and useful feedback.
example2_zh: 教师批改作业时应采用一致的标准，让学生获得公平且有用的反馈。
collocations: leave a mark｜留下痕迹 ; get high marks｜获得高分 ; mark an exam｜批改试卷 ; full marks｜满分
tip_zh: 表示考试分数常用复数marks，尤其在英式英语中。

meanings_zh: pron. 他们；她们；它们 | pron. 指性别未知或非二元者
definition_en: Used for people or things already mentioned or understood. | Used for someone of unknown or nonbinary gender.
example1_en: The children waved as they boarded the bus.
example1_zh: 孩子们一边上公交车一边挥手。
example2_en: When a student receives constructive feedback, they are more likely to identify weaknesses and improve their performance.
example2_zh: 学生收到建设性反馈后，更有可能发现不足并改善表现。
collocations: they are｜他们是 ; they have｜他们有 ; they say｜据说
tip_zh: 单数they也搭配are、have，不用is、has。

meanings_zh: adj. 巨大的；大量的
definition_en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree
example1_en: A huge dog was sleeping beside the tiny kitten.
example1_zh: 一只大狗正睡在那只小猫旁边。
example2_en: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.
example2_zh: 对于饱受交通拥堵和空气污染困扰的城市，投资公共交通可以带来巨大益处。
collocations: huge amount｜巨大的数量 ; huge difference｜巨大差异 ; huge impact｜巨大影响 ; huge success｜巨大成功
tip_zh: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。

meanings_zh: det. 许多的 | pron. 许多；许多人或物
definition_en: a large number of, used with plural countable nouns | a large number of people or things
example1_en: How many apples do we need for the pie?
example1_zh: 做这个派需要多少个苹果？
example2_en: Many cities are investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
example2_zh: 许多城市正在投资自行车基础设施，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。
collocations: how many｜多少 ; too many｜太多 ; many of｜……中的许多 ; a great many｜大量的
tip_zh: many 接可数名词复数；much 接不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 广告
definition_en: A public message promoting a product, service, event, or opportunity.
example1_en: I saw an advertisement for bicycles at the station.
example1_zh: 我在车站看到了一则自行车广告。
example2_en: Advertisements aimed at young consumers should present accurate information rather than encourage unnecessary spending.
example2_zh: 面向年轻消费者的广告应提供准确信息，而不是鼓励不必要的消费。
collocations: an advertisement for｜关于……的广告 ; place an advertisement｜刊登广告 ; online advertisement｜网络广告
tip_zh: 广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。

meanings_zh: n. 曲棍球；冰球
definition_en: A team sport using sticks to hit a ball or puck
example1_en: We practised hockey on the school field yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在学校运动场练习了曲棍球。
example2_en: Making hockey facilities more accessible could encourage greater participation in team sports among young people.
example2_zh: 让曲棍球设施更便于使用，可以鼓励更多年轻人参加团队运动。
collocations: field hockey｜草地曲棍球 ; ice hockey｜冰球 ; hockey stick｜曲棍球棒；冰球杆 ; play hockey｜打曲棍球；打冰球
tip_zh: 英国通常指草地曲棍球；美国通常指冰球。

meanings_zh: n. 事故 | n. 意外；偶然发生的事
definition_en: An unexpected event that causes injury or damage. | Something that happens without being planned or intended.
example1_en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
example1_zh: 幸好，我们家外面发生的事故没有造成人员受伤。
example2_en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
example2_zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。
collocations: a road accident｜道路交通事故 ; by accident｜偶然；无意中 ; prevent accidents｜预防事故
tip_zh: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

meanings_zh: n. 游泳池
definition_en: a place filled with water for swimming
example1_en: We go to the swimming pool every Friday.
example1_zh: 我们每周五去游泳池。
example2_en: The hotel has a big outdoor swimming pool.
example2_zh: 这家酒店有一个很大的室外游泳池。
tip_zh: swimming pool 是游泳池；go swimming 是去游泳。

meanings_zh: adj. 非常惊讶的
definition_en: Very surprised by something unexpected.
example1_en: I was amazed to find flowers growing through concrete.
example1_zh: 发现花从混凝土缝里长出来，我十分惊讶。
example2_en: Researchers were amazed by how quickly children learned new vocabulary through interactive games.
example2_zh: 研究人员惊讶地发现，孩子们通过互动游戏学习新词汇的速度如此之快。
collocations: be amazed at｜对……感到惊讶 ; be amazed by｜因……而惊讶 ; be amazed to discover｜惊讶地发现
tip_zh: amazed描述人的感受；amazing描述令人惊讶的事物。

meanings_zh: prep. 代替；而不是
definition_en: in place of something
example1_en: Let's walk instead of taking the bus.
example1_zh: 我们走路吧，别坐公交车了。
example2_en: She had tea instead of coffee.
example2_zh: 她喝了茶而不是咖啡。
tip_zh: instead of 后接名词/动名词；instead 单独用放在句尾。

meanings_zh: n. 雷暴；雷雨
definition_en: A storm with thunder, lightning, and usually heavy rain.
example1_en: We stayed indoors while the thunderstorm shook the windows.
example1_zh: 雷雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。
example2_en: Severe thunderstorms can disrupt transport networks and cause sudden flooding, particularly in cities with inadequate drainage.
example2_zh: 强雷暴会扰乱交通网络并引发突发洪水，排水设施不足的城市尤其如此。
collocations: a severe thunderstorm｜强雷暴 ; a thunderstorm warning｜雷暴预警 ; scattered thunderstorms｜局部雷雨
tip_zh: thunder是雷声，lightning是闪电；雷暴用thunderstorm。

meanings_zh: v. 烹调；煮；烧 | n. 做饭的人；厨师
definition_en: to prepare food by heating it, or become ready through heating | someone who prepares and cooks food
example1_en: I usually cook vegetable soup when the weather turns cold.
example1_zh: 天气变冷时，我通常会煮蔬菜汤。
example2_en: Teaching children to cook simple meals can encourage healthier eating habits and greater independence later in life.
example2_zh: 教孩子做简单饭菜，可以培养更健康的饮食习惯，让他们日后更加独立。
collocations: cook a meal｜做一顿饭 ; cook from scratch｜从原材料开始做饭 ; a good cook｜做饭好吃的人 ; cook over low heat｜用小火烹调
tip_zh: cook可指厨师；cooker在英式英语中指炉灶。

meanings_zh: n. 湖；湖泊
definition_en: A large area of water surrounded by land.
example1_en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
example1_zh: 我们租了一条小船，划到了湖对岸。
example2_en: Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.
example2_zh: 农业污染会破坏湖泊生态系统，并威胁依靠湖水获取饮用水的社区。
collocations: freshwater lake｜淡水湖 ; saltwater lake｜咸水湖 ; the shore of a lake｜湖岸
tip_zh: on the lake 指在湖面上；in the lake 指在湖水中。

meanings_zh: n. 段落
definition_en: A section of writing dealing with one main idea.
example1_en: This paragraph is too long for a quick email.
example1_zh: 对于一封简短的邮件来说，这一段太长了。
example2_en: Each paragraph in an academic essay should develop a clear argument supported by relevant evidence.
example2_zh: 学术文章的每一段都应展开一个清晰的论点，并以相关证据加以支持。
collocations: opening paragraph｜开头段 ; concluding paragraph｜结尾段 ; a short paragraph｜一个短段落
tip_zh: 可数名词；写作中通常一段围绕一个中心意思。

meanings_zh: adv. 离开；远离 | adv. 不在；外出
definition_en: Moving or staying at a distance from someone or something. | Not at home or at the usual place.
example1_en: The little bird flew away when I opened the window.
example1_zh: 我打开窗户时，小鸟飞走了。
example2_en: Moving away from crowded cities can improve wellbeing, but may reduce access to employment.
example2_zh: 搬离拥挤的城市可能改善身心健康，但也可能减少就业机会。
collocations: go away｜离开 ; far away｜在远处 ; away from home｜不在家 ; put away｜收好
tip_zh: away是副词；表示“远离某处”用away from。

meanings_zh: n. 沙拉；凉拌菜
definition_en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients
example1_en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
example1_zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。
example2_en: Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.
example2_zh: 学校食堂供应新鲜沙拉，有助于鼓励儿童摄入更多种类的蔬菜。
collocations: green salad｜绿叶蔬菜沙拉 ; fruit salad｜水果沙拉 ; salad dressing｜沙拉酱
tip_zh: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。

meanings_zh: mv. 可以；可能
definition_en: used to ask permission or say something is possible
example1_en: May I use your pen, please?
example1_zh: 请问我可以用你的钢笔吗？
example2_en: It may rain later, so take an umbrella.
example2_zh: 待会儿可能下雨，带把伞吧。
tip_zh: may 用于请求更正式礼貌；表示可能性时比 might 更可能。

meanings_zh: n. 实验；试验 | v. 做实验；尝试
definition_en: a test designed to discover something or check an idea | test ideas or methods to see what happens
example1_en: Our science experiment showed how roots grow towards water.
example1_zh: 我们的科学实验展示了植物根部如何朝水源生长。
example2_en: Schools should allow students to experiment with different materials before explaining the scientific principles involved.
example2_zh: 学校应让学生先尝试使用不同材料，再讲解其中的科学原理。
collocations: conduct an experiment｜进行实验 ; a controlled experiment｜对照实验 ; experiment with materials｜尝试使用各种材料
tip_zh: 动词接with表示尝试；名词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: adv. 在外；向外；不在家 | adv. 熄灭；停止运转 | adv. 公开；问世
definition_en: Away from the inside of a place, or from home. | No longer burning, shining, or working. | Available to the public or no longer secret.
example1_en: We went out for a walk after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后我们出去散步了。
example2_en: When a new research report comes out, journalists should examine its evidence before reporting its conclusions.
example2_zh: 新的研究报告发布时，记者应先审查其证据，再报道其结论。
collocations: go out｜外出 ; eat out｜在外就餐 ; come out｜出版；发布 ; put out a fire｜灭火
tip_zh: out 常作副词；在某物外面可用 outside。

meanings_zh: n. 观光；游览
definition_en: the activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist
example1_en: We spent the morning sightseeing around the old harbour.
example1_zh: 我们花了一上午在老港口一带观光。
example2_en: Sightseeing tours can support local economies, especially when visitors choose guides and businesses from the community.
example2_zh: 观光游览能促进当地经济，尤其是在游客选择当地社区的导游和商家时。
collocations: go sightseeing｜去观光 ; a sightseeing tour｜观光之旅 ; a sightseeing bus｜观光巴士
tip_zh: 不可数名词；说go sightseeing，不加a。

meanings_zh: n. 图画；素描 | n. 绘画；素描技法
definition_en: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or similar tool. | The activity or skill of making pictures with lines.
example1_en: He showed me a drawing of his cat.
example1_zh: 他给我看了一幅他画的猫。
example2_en: Drawing can help children express emotions that they may find difficult to communicate through spoken language.
example2_zh: 绘画可以帮助儿童表达那些难以用口头语言传达的情感。
collocations: pencil drawing｜铅笔画 ; drawing skills｜绘画技巧 ; drawing class｜绘画课
tip_zh: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 餐后甜点
definition_en: Sweet food eaten at the end of a meal.
example1_en: We shared a bowl of ice cream for dessert.
example1_zh: 我们分吃了一碗冰淇淋作为餐后甜点。
example2_en: Offering fresh fruit for dessert can help school cafeterias encourage healthier eating habits among children.
example2_zh: 学校食堂提供新鲜水果作为餐后甜点，有助于培养儿童更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: for dessert｜作为餐后甜点 ; dessert menu｜甜点菜单 ; fruit dessert｜水果甜点
tip_zh: dessert有两个s，重音在后；desert作沙漠时重音在前。

meanings_zh: adj. 兴奋的；激动的
definition_en: Feeling very happy and enthusiastic about something.
example1_en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
example1_zh: 孩子们对第一次露营旅行感到兴奋。
example2_en: Students are often more excited about learning when lessons involve practical experiments and opportunities for discovery.
example2_zh: 当课程包含实践实验和探索机会时，学生往往对学习更有热情。
collocations: excited about｜对……感到兴奋 ; excited to hear｜听到……很激动 ; get excited｜兴奋起来
tip_zh: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

meanings_zh: v. 邀请 | v. 征求；引起
definition_en: to ask someone to attend something or do something | to request a response or make a reaction likely
example1_en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
example1_zh: 我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。
example2_en: Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.
example2_zh: 地方议会在就公共空间作出决定前，应邀请居民讨论拟议的改动。
collocations: invite someone to dinner｜邀请某人吃晚饭 ; invite someone to do something｜邀请某人做某事 ; invite feedback｜征求反馈 ; invite criticism｜招致批评
tip_zh: invite sb to＋活动；invite sb to do＋动作。

meanings_zh: n. 匙；勺子 | v. 用勺舀
definition_en: A utensil with a small bowl for eating or serving. | To move or serve food using a spoon.
example1_en: She stirred her soup with a wooden spoon.
example1_zh: 她用木勺搅了搅汤。
example2_en: Teaching children to use a spoon independently can help develop their coordination and confidence.
example2_zh: 教孩子独立使用勺子有助于培养他们的协调能力和自信心。
collocations: wooden spoon｜木勺 ; soup spoon｜汤匙 ; spoon into a bowl｜用勺舀入碗中
tip_zh: 一勺的量通常用 a spoonful of 表达。

meanings_zh: n. 公交车站（站牌）
definition_en: a place where buses stop for passengers
example1_en: Wait for me at the bus stop near the school.
example1_zh: 在学校附近的公交车站等我。
example2_en: The bus stop is just across the road.
example2_zh: 公交车站就在马路对面。
tip_zh: bus stop 是沿途停车点；bus station 是始发/终点总站。

meanings_zh: n. 探险者；勘探者
definition_en: someone who travels through unfamiliar places to discover more about them
example1_en: The explorer carried a compass through the dense forest.
example1_zh: 探险者带着指南针穿过茂密的森林。
example2_en: An explorer can contribute valuable observations, but expeditions should avoid disturbing local wildlife and communities.
example2_zh: 探险者可以提供宝贵的观察资料，但探险活动应避免干扰当地野生动物和社区。
collocations: polar explorer｜极地探险者 ; intrepid explorer｜无畏的探险者 ; early explorers｜早期探险者
tip_zh: explorer指探险的人，exploration指探索活动。

meanings_zh: n. 电话；手机 | v. 给……打电话
definition_en: a device used to speak to people at a distance | to contact someone using a telephone
example1_en: My phone rang while I was washing the dishes.
example1_zh: 我洗碗时，电话响了。
example2_en: Limiting phone use in classrooms may help students concentrate more effectively on lessons and group activities.
example2_zh: 限制课堂上的手机使用，可能有助于学生更专注于课程和小组活动。
collocations: answer the phone｜接电话 ; on the phone｜在通话 ; mobile phone｜手机 ; phone someone back｜给某人回电话
tip_zh: 动词直接接人：phone someone，不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 肥皂 | n. 肥皂剧 | v. 用肥皂擦洗
definition_en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects. | A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships. | To rub or wash something with soap.
example1_en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前请用肥皂洗手。
example2_en: Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
example2_zh: 在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。
collocations: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂 ; liquid soap｜洗手液；液体皂 ; soap and water｜肥皂和水 ; soap opera｜肥皂剧
tip_zh: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

meanings_zh: v. 错过；未赶上 | v. 想念 | v. 未击中；未察觉
definition_en: to fail to catch, attend, or experience something | to feel sad because someone or something is absent | to fail to hit a target or notice something
example1_en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last bus.
example1_zh: 快点，否则我们会错过末班公交车。
example2_en: Students who miss several lessons may need additional support to keep up with their classmates.
example2_zh: 缺了几节课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的进度。
collocations: miss the bus｜没赶上公交车 ; miss an opportunity｜错失机会 ; miss someone｜想念某人 ; miss the point｜没理解要点
tip_zh: miss后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

meanings_zh: v. 扔；投；掷 | v. 举办聚会 | n. 投掷；投掷距离
