example2_en: Clear rules on industrial waste disposal are essential for protecting rivers and ensuring safe drinking water.
example2_zh: 关于工业废物处理的明确规定对于保护河流和保障饮用水安全至关重要。
collocations: follow the rules｜遵守规则 ; break a rule｜违反规定 ; as a rule｜通常 ; rule out｜排除
tip_zh: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

meanings_zh: adj. 羞愧的；内疚的 | adj. 因难堪而不愿意的
definition_en: feeling guilty or embarrassed about something wrong or disappointing | unwilling to do something because it feels embarrassing
example1_en: I felt ashamed after laughing at my friend's mistake.
example1_zh: 嘲笑朋友的错误后，我感到很羞愧。
example2_en: Students should never feel ashamed to ask for help when they struggle with difficult subjects.
example2_zh: 学生在学习较难的科目遇到困难时，绝不应因求助而感到难堪。
collocations: feel ashamed｜感到羞愧 ; ashamed of yourself｜为自己感到羞愧 ; ashamed to admit｜羞于承认
tip_zh: 常作表语：be ashamed of或be ashamed to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 自豪的；骄傲的 | adj. 自负的；高傲的
definition_en: Feeling pleased about achievements or people you care about. | Believing you are better or more important than others.
example1_en: He felt proud of the cake he baked himself.
example1_zh: 他为自己亲手烤出的蛋糕感到自豪。
example2_en: Residents are often proud of their cultural heritage and support efforts to preserve historic buildings.
example2_zh: 居民往往为自己的文化遗产感到自豪，并支持保护历史建筑的行动。
collocations: proud of｜为……自豪 ; proud to be｜以身为……而自豪 ; make someone proud｜让某人自豪 ; too proud to ask｜太好面子而不肯问
tip_zh: be proud of后接名词或动名词，表示为……自豪。

meanings_zh: n. 帮忙；善意的举动 | n. 赞同；偏爱 | v. 偏爱；支持；有利于
definition_en: Something helpful you do for someone. | Approval, support, or preference shown towards someone or something. | To prefer, support, or give an advantage to someone or something.
example1_en: Could you do me a favour and water my plants?
example1_zh: 你能帮我一个忙，给我的植物浇浇水吗？
example2_en: Many residents favour investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion and improve air quality.
example2_zh: 许多居民支持投资公共交通，因为这有助于缓解拥堵并改善空气质量。
collocations: do someone a favour｜帮某人一个忙 ; in favour of｜支持；赞成 ; return the favour｜回报帮助 ; favour one option over another｜更倾向于某个选项
tip_zh: 英式拼写为favour，美式为favor；帮忙用do。

meanings_zh: adj. 无趣的；乏味的
definition_en: not interesting
example1_en: The lecture was long and uninteresting.
example1_zh: 讲座又长又无聊。
example2_en: He found the book uninteresting and put it down.
example2_zh: 他觉得这本书无趣就放下了。
tip_zh: uninteresting 等于 boring“无趣的”。

meanings_zh: n. 故事情节 | n. 小块土地 | v. 密谋；秘密策划
definition_en: the connected events that make up a story | a small piece of land used for a particular purpose | secretly plan something harmful or dishonest
example1_en: The film had a simple but exciting plot.
example1_zh: 这部电影的情节简单却扣人心弦。
example2_en: Community gardens allow residents to grow vegetables on a small plot, improving access to fresh food.
example2_zh: 社区花园让居民可以在一小块土地上种菜，更方便地获得新鲜食物。
collocations: a complex plot｜复杂的情节 ; a plot of land｜一小块土地 ; a garden plot｜一小块菜园地 ; plot against someone｜密谋对付某人
tip_zh: plot指情节；作动词还可表示标绘数据。

meanings_zh: n. 噩梦 | n. 极其糟糕的经历
definition_en: a frightening or deeply unpleasant dream | an experience or situation that is extremely unpleasant or difficult
example1_en: I woke from a nightmare and switched on the lamp.
example1_zh: 我从噩梦中惊醒，打开了灯。
example2_en: Without reliable public transport, commuting can become a nightmare for people living outside major cities.
example2_zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，通勤对住在大城市外围的人来说可能十分煎熬。
collocations: have a nightmare｜做噩梦 ; recurring nightmare｜反复出现的噩梦 ; logistical nightmare｜组织协调上的大难题
tip_zh: 通常作可数名词；形容词形式为nightmarish。

meanings_zh: n. 面试官；采访者
definition_en: a person who asks questions in an interview
example1_en: The interviewer asked about my work experience.
example1_zh: 面试官问了我的工作经历。
example2_en: She is an interviewer for a radio station.
example2_zh: 她是电台的采访者。
tip_zh: interviewer 是提问方；interviewee 是被采访/面试者。

meanings_zh: n. 唱片骑师；音乐节目主持人
definition_en: a person who plays music on radio or at parties
example1_en: The DJ played our favourite songs at the party.
example1_zh: DJ在聚会上播放了我们最喜欢的歌。
example2_en: She wants to become a radio DJ.
example2_zh: 她想成为电台DJ。
tip_zh: DJ 是 disc jockey 的缩写，指音乐播放/主持人。

meanings_zh: n. 内衣；贴身衣物
definition_en: Clothes worn next to the skin beneath other clothes.
example1_en: I packed clean underwear in my travel bag.
example1_zh: 我把干净的内衣装进了旅行包。
example2_en: Consumers increasingly prefer underwear made from breathable fabrics, encouraging manufacturers to improve comfort and durability.
example2_zh: 消费者越来越偏爱透气面料制成的内衣，这促使制造商提升舒适度和耐用性。
collocations: cotton underwear｜棉质内衣 ; thermal underwear｜保暖内衣 ; a change of underwear｜一套替换内衣
tip_zh: 不可数名词，不说an underwear或underwears。

meanings_zh: n. 等候的队伍 | v. 排队等候
definition_en: A line of people or vehicles waiting for something. | To wait in a line for your turn.
example1_en: We joined the queue outside the bakery this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我们加入了面包店外的队伍。
example2_en: Improved ticketing systems can reduce the time passengers spend waiting in a queue at busy stations.
example2_zh: 改进售票系统可以减少乘客在繁忙车站排队等候的时间。
collocations: join the queue｜加入队伍 ; queue for tickets｜排队买票 ; jump the queue｜插队 ; a long queue｜长队
tip_zh: 英式常用queue，美式常用line；queue for后接所等之物。

meanings_zh: n. 距离；间距 | n. 疏远；隔阂 | v. 使疏远；撇清关系
definition_en: The amount of space between two places or things | A lack of emotional closeness between people | To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views
example1_en: The distance from our house to school is quite short.
example1_zh: 从我们家到学校的距离很短。
example2_en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
example2_zh: 缩短住宅区与工作地点之间的距离，可以减少交通排放并改善城市生活质量。
collocations: walking distance｜步行可达的距离 ; in the distance｜在远处 ; keep your distance｜保持距离 ; distance yourself from｜与……划清界限
tip_zh: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

meanings_zh: v. 拒绝；谢绝 | n. 垃圾；废弃物
definition_en: to say that you will not do or accept something | unwanted waste material that people throw away
example1_en: She refused to leave without her favourite blue umbrella.
example1_zh: 不带上她最喜欢的蓝色雨伞，她就不肯走。
example2_en: Local authorities may refuse permission for developments that threaten wildlife habitats or increase flood risks.
example2_zh: 地方政府可能拒绝批准威胁野生动物栖息地或增加洪灾风险的开发项目。
collocations: refuse to do something｜拒绝做某事 ; refuse an offer｜谢绝提议 ; refuse permission｜不予许可 ; refuse collection｜垃圾收运
tip_zh: 名词读/ˈrefjuːs/；动词后接to do，不接doing。

meanings_zh: n. 打火机；点火器
definition_en: A small device that produces a flame to light things.
example1_en: Dad used a long lighter to light the candle.
example1_zh: 爸爸用长柄点火器点燃了蜡烛。
example2_en: A refillable lighter may produce less plastic waste than disposable alternatives when used over a long period.
example2_zh: 长期使用时，可补充燃料的打火机可能比一次性产品产生更少的塑料垃圾。
collocations: a refillable lighter｜可充气或加油的打火机 ; a disposable lighter｜一次性打火机 ; a gas lighter｜燃气打火机
tip_zh: 作名词指打火机；也可为light的比较级，意为更轻的。

meanings_zh: n. 电影配乐；影视声轨
definition_en: The recorded music, speech, and sounds accompanying a film or programme.
example1_en: I listened to the film's soundtrack on the bus.
example1_zh: 我在公交车上听了那部电影的原声音乐。
example2_en: A carefully chosen soundtrack can strengthen a documentary's emotional impact without distracting viewers from its central message.
example2_zh: 精心挑选的配乐可以增强纪录片的情感感染力，又不分散观众对核心信息的注意力。
collocations: a film soundtrack｜电影原声 ; an original soundtrack｜原创影视配乐 ; compose a soundtrack｜创作影视配乐
tip_zh: 不仅指配乐，也可指含对白和音效的完整声轨。

meanings_zh: n. 树枝 | n. 分店；分支机构；分支 | v. 分岔；分支
definition_en: a woody part growing from a tree's trunk | a local office or division of a larger organization or subject | to divide into separate routes or parts
example1_en: A small bird landed on the lowest branch.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟落在了最低的树枝上。
example2_en: Opening a local branch allows banks to provide essential services to communities with limited internet access.
example2_zh: 开设当地分行能让银行为互联网接入有限的社区提供必要服务。
collocations: tree branch｜树枝 ; local branch｜当地分支机构 ; a branch of science｜科学的一个分支 ; branch out into｜拓展到
tip_zh: branch既指树枝，也指机构或学科的分支。

meanings_zh: v. 减少；降低 | n. 减少；减少量
definition_en: To become smaller or make something smaller in amount. | A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.
example1_en: Our electricity bills decreased after we replaced the old heater.
example1_zh: 我们换掉旧取暖器后，电费减少了。
example2_en: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。
collocations: a decrease in demand｜需求下降 ; decrease significantly｜显著减少 ; decrease by half｜减少一半 ; a steady decrease｜持续下降
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

meanings_zh: n. 旗；旗帜 | v. 标记；提醒注意 | v. 衰退；减弱
definition_en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation | to mark something as needing attention | to become weaker or less energetic
example1_en: A bright flag fluttered above the school gate.
example1_zh: 一面鲜艳的旗帜在校门上方飘扬。
example2_en: Teachers should flag potential learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support.
example2_zh: 教师应尽早指出潜在的学习困难，以便学生获得适当的支持。
collocations: raise a flag｜升旗 ; national flag｜国旗 ; flag an issue｜标记问题 ; flagging energy｜逐渐减退的精力
tip_zh: 动词过去式flagged，进行式flagging，双写g。

meanings_zh: v. 与……结婚；结婚 | v. 为……主持婚礼
definition_en: To become someone's husband or wife. | To perform the ceremony that makes two people legally married.
example1_en: My cousin plans to marry her partner next spring.
example1_zh: 我表姐计划明年春天与伴侣结婚。
example2_en: Many young adults choose to marry later because they want financial stability before starting a family.
example2_zh: 许多年轻人选择晚婚，因为他们希望在组建家庭前拥有稳定的经济基础。
collocations: marry someone｜与某人结婚 ; get married｜结婚 ; marry young｜年纪轻轻就结婚
tip_zh: 说marry someone或get married to，不说marry with。

meanings_zh: n. 评论；意见 | v. 评论；发表意见
definition_en: something said or written to express an opinion or observation | to express an opinion or observation about something
example1_en: Her kind comment about my painting made me smile.
example1_zh: 她对我画作的友善评价让我笑了。
example2_en: Residents should have opportunities to comment on development proposals before local authorities make final decisions.
example2_zh: 地方政府作出最终决定前，居民应有机会对开发提案发表意见。
collocations: make a comment｜发表评论 ; comment on something｜评论某事 ; constructive comments｜建设性意见 ; no comment｜无可奉告
tip_zh: 动词comment后接on再接评论对象，不直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；处理方式 | v. 接近；靠近 | v. 着手处理；接洽
definition_en: A way of dealing with a task or problem. | To move nearer to someone or something. | To begin dealing with something or contact someone about it.
example1_en: We tried a different approach to training our puppy.
example1_zh: 我们试着用另一种方法训练小狗。
example2_en: A balanced approach to urban planning should consider both economic growth and the protection of green spaces.
example2_zh: 均衡的城市规划方法应兼顾经济增长和绿地保护。
collocations: an approach to learning｜学习方法 ; adopt an approach｜采用一种方法 ; approach a problem｜着手处理问题 ; approach someone for advice｜找某人征求建议
tip_zh: 名词“方法”后用to加名词或动名词；动词后直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: adv. 偶尔；有时
definition_en: sometimes, but not often or regularly
example1_en: We occasionally buy fresh bread from the market.
example1_zh: 我们偶尔会在市场买新鲜面包。
example2_en: Employees who occasionally work from home may benefit from greater flexibility without losing regular contact with colleagues.
example2_zh: 偶尔在家办公的员工可以享有更大的灵活性，同时保持与同事的经常联系。
collocations: only occasionally｜只是偶尔 ; occasionally visit｜偶尔拜访 ; occasionally occur｜偶尔发生
tip_zh: 常放实义动词前、be动词后，也可放句首。

meanings_zh: adj. 英俊的 | adj. 可观的；丰厚的
definition_en: Attractive in appearance, especially describing a man. | Large and impressive in amount.
example1_en: My brother looks handsome in his new blue jacket.
example1_zh: 我哥哥穿着新的蓝色夹克，看起来很英俊。
example2_en: Companies investing in renewable energy may earn handsome profits as demand for cleaner alternatives continues to grow.
example2_zh: 随着对更清洁替代能源的需求持续增长，投资可再生能源的企业可能获得丰厚利润。
collocations: handsome man｜英俊的男子 ; handsome profit｜丰厚的利润 ; handsome reward｜丰厚的报酬
tip_zh: 常形容男子英俊；形容利润或报酬时意为丰厚的。

meanings_zh: adj. 天然的；自然界的 | adj. 天生的 | adj. 正常的；合乎常理的
definition_en: existing in nature rather than made by people | having an ability from birth rather than through training | normal and expected in a particular situation
example1_en: This soap is made entirely from natural ingredients.
example1_zh: 这块肥皂完全由天然原料制成。
example2_en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining biodiversity and supporting communities that depend on local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持生物多样性、支持依赖当地生态系统的社区至关重要。
collocations: natural resources｜自然资源 ; natural habitat｜自然栖息地 ; natural talent｜天赋 ; perfectly natural｜完全正常的
tip_zh: natural指天然的；nature是名词，指自然。

meanings_zh: n. 小牛；某些大型动物的幼崽 | n. 小腿肚
definition_en: A young cow or another large mammal, such as an elephant. | The fleshy back part of the leg below the knee.
example1_en: The calf stayed close to its mother in the field.
example1_zh: 那头小牛在田野里紧紧跟着妈妈。
example2_en: Farmers must provide each calf with adequate nutrition and shelter to support healthy growth.
example2_zh: 农民必须为每头小牛提供充足的营养和遮蔽场所，以支持其健康生长。
collocations: a newborn calf｜刚出生的小牛 ; calf muscles｜小腿肌肉 ; raise a calf｜饲养小牛
tip_zh: 复数为calves；字母l不发音。

meanings_zh: adv. 非常；极其 | adv. 糟糕地；很差地
definition_en: To a very great degree. | In a very bad or unsuccessful way.
example1_en: I'm terribly sorry I spilled juice on your jacket.
example1_zh: 我把果汁洒在了你的夹克上，实在抱歉。
example2_en: Without reliable public transport, elderly residents may feel terribly isolated in remote rural communities.
example2_zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，偏远农村社区的老年居民可能会感到非常孤立。
collocations: terribly sorry｜非常抱歉 ; terribly worried｜十分担忧 ; behave terribly｜表现很差
tip_zh: 常作口语强调词，不一定表示“可怕地”。

meanings_zh: n. 使用者；用户
definition_en: A person who uses a product, service, or facility.
example1_en: Each user can choose a different colour for their profile.
example1_zh: 每位用户都可以为自己的个人资料选择不同的颜色。
example2_en: Software developers should consider the needs of every user, including people with limited technical skills.
example2_zh: 软件开发者应考虑每位用户的需求，包括技术能力有限的人。
collocations: user account｜用户账户 ; user feedback｜用户反馈 ; road user｜道路使用者 ; regular user｜经常使用者
tip_zh: use作动词及user中的s读/z/。

meanings_zh: n. 祈祷；祷告 | n. 祷词；祈祷文
definition_en: the act of speaking to God or a god | words spoken to God or a god
example1_en: She closed her eyes and said a quiet prayer.
example1_zh: 她闭上眼睛，轻声祈祷。
example2_en: For many communities, prayer provides comfort during difficult times and strengthens a sense of belonging.
example2_zh: 对许多群体而言，祈祷能在艰难时期带来慰藉，并增强归属感。
collocations: say a prayer｜祈祷 ; daily prayer｜每日祈祷 ; a prayer for peace｜祈求和平的祷告
tip_zh: 表示祈祷活动常不可数；一段祷词可数。

meanings_zh: v. 修补；修理 | v. 愈合；恢复 | v. 改善；修复关系
definition_en: To make something broken or damaged usable again. | To become healthy again after injury or illness. | To improve a damaged relationship or a difficult situation.
example1_en: Grandpa showed me how to mend a torn pocket.
example1_zh: 爷爷教我如何补好撕破的口袋。
example2_en: Teaching children to mend their clothes can reduce textile waste and encourage more responsible attitudes towards consumption.
example2_zh: 教孩子修补衣物可以减少纺织废料，并培养更负责任的消费态度。
collocations: mend clothes｜修补衣物 ; mend a fence｜修理围栏 ; mend relations｜修复关系 ; on the mend｜正在康复
tip_zh: on the mend表示正在康复或情况正在好转。

meanings_zh: n. 景点；吸引人的事物 | n. 吸引力；吸引
definition_en: A place or feature that people want to visit or experience. | The power to interest someone or draw them towards something.
example1_en: The old castle is the town's most popular attraction.
example1_zh: 那座古堡是镇上最受欢迎的景点。
example2_en: Although tourism creates jobs, overcrowding at major attractions can damage historic buildings and disrupt local life.
example2_zh: 虽然旅游业创造就业机会，但主要景点过度拥挤可能损坏历史建筑，扰乱当地生活。
collocations: tourist attraction｜旅游景点 ; main attraction｜主要看点 ; mutual attraction｜相互吸引 ; gravitational attraction｜万有引力
tip_zh: 指景点时可数；指吸引力时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 公牛 | n. 看涨的投资者
definition_en: an adult male animal of the cattle family | an investor who expects market prices to rise
example1_en: A large bull stood quietly beside the farm gate.
example1_zh: 一头大公牛静静地站在农场门旁。
example2_en: During a bull market, rising share prices may encourage households to invest more of their savings.
example2_zh: 在牛市期间，股价上涨可能促使家庭将更多储蓄用于投资。
collocations: a breeding bull｜种公牛 ; a bull market｜牛市 ; take the bull by the horns｜勇敢面对难题
tip_zh: 金融中bull指看涨者，与bear（看跌者）相对。

meanings_zh: v. 埋；埋葬 | v. 掩藏；使埋在下面
definition_en: to put something in the ground and cover it | to hide or cover something beneath other things
example1_en: Our dog buried its favourite toy beside the fence.
example1_zh: 我们的狗把最喜欢的玩具埋在了篱笆旁。
example2_en: Instead of burying household waste, local authorities should invest in recycling facilities and public education.
example2_zh: 地方政府不应只是填埋生活垃圾，而应投资建设回收设施并开展公众教育。
collocations: bury treasure｜埋藏宝藏 ; bury waste｜填埋废弃物 ; be buried under｜被埋在……下面 ; bury your face in｜把脸埋进
tip_zh: 发音同berry；过去式buried，动名词burying。

meanings_zh: v. 登记；注册 | n. 登记簿；名册 | v. 显示；记录测量结果
definition_en: To put information on an official list | An official list or record of people or things | To show or record an amount on a measuring instrument
example1_en: You can register for swimming lessons at the pool.
example1_zh: 你可以在泳池报名参加游泳课。
example2_en: Residents should be able to register for local healthcare services online, reducing unnecessary travel and administrative delays.
example2_zh: 居民应能在线登记使用当地医疗服务，以减少不必要的出行和行政延误。
collocations: register for a course｜报名课程 ; register to vote｜登记成为选民 ; an attendance register｜出勤登记簿 ; register a complaint｜正式提出投诉
tip_zh: 报名课程用register for；登记做某事用register to do。

meanings_zh: v. 固定；系上；附上 | v. 赋予；认为具有
definition_en: Join or fasten something to something else | Consider something to have a particular value or importance
example1_en: Attach the little bell to your bicycle's handlebars.
example1_zh: 把这个小铃铛装在自行车的车把上。
example2_en: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
example2_zh: 许多雇主招聘新员工时，更看重实际经验而非学历。
collocations: attach a file｜附上文件 ; attach something to something｜把某物固定到某物上 ; attach importance to｜重视
tip_zh: 常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。

meanings_zh: n. 尊重；敬佩 | v. 尊重；遵守 | n. 方面
definition_en: Admiration for someone or consideration for their rights and feelings. | To value someone or follow a rule or agreement. | A particular feature or aspect of something.
example1_en: She showed respect by listening without interrupting her colleague.
example1_zh: 她认真倾听，没有打断同事，以此表达尊重。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to respect different opinions while evaluating the evidence behind each argument.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生尊重不同观点，同时评估每种论点背后的证据。
collocations: show respect for｜对……表示尊重 ; mutual respect｜相互尊重 ; respect privacy｜尊重隐私 ; in this respect｜在这方面
tip_zh: 名词常接for；动词直接接宾语，不加for。

meanings_zh: n. 西兰花
definition_en: A green vegetable with thick stems and tightly clustered flower buds.
example1_en: We steamed the broccoli until it turned bright green.
example1_zh: 我们把西兰花蒸到颜色变得鲜绿。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving vegetables such as broccoli alongside familiar dishes.
example2_zh: 学校可以在常见菜肴旁搭配西兰花等蔬菜，鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: broccoli florets｜西兰花小朵 ; steamed broccoli｜蒸西兰花 ; a head of broccoli｜一整颗西兰花
tip_zh: 通常不可数；小朵西兰花可说broccoli florets。

meanings_zh: v. 保护；防护
definition_en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage
example1_en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
example1_zh: 戴上厚手套，保护双手不被刺扎伤。
example2_en: Governments should protect endangered species by preserving natural habitats and restricting activities that threaten their survival.
example2_zh: 政府应通过保护自然栖息地并限制威胁生存的活动，来保护濒危物种。
collocations: protect the environment｜保护环境 ; protect against disease｜预防疾病 ; protect from harm｜保护……免受伤害 ; protect privacy｜保护隐私
tip_zh: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

meanings_zh: v. 离开；出发 | v. 背离；偏离
definition_en: to leave a place, especially to start a journey | to act differently from an established rule or practice
example1_en: Our train departs at dawn, so pack your bag tonight.
example1_zh: 我们的火车黎明时出发，所以今晚就收拾好行李吧。
example2_en: Buses that depart regularly from residential areas can reduce commuters' dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 从住宅区定时发车的公交车可以减少通勤者对私家车的依赖。
collocations: depart from｜从…出发；背离 ; depart for｜动身前往 ; depart on time｜准时出发
tip_zh: depart from后接出发地，depart for后接目的地。

meanings_zh: v. 询问；打听
definition_en: To ask for information about something.
example1_en: I called the hotel to enquire about available rooms.
example1_zh: 我打电话给酒店，询问是否有空房。
example2_en: Prospective students should enquire about financial support before deciding which university course best suits their needs.
example2_zh: 有意申请的学生应先询问资助情况，再决定哪门大学课程最适合自己。
collocations: enquire about prices｜询问价格 ; enquire whether｜询问是否 ; enquire into a matter｜调查某事
tip_zh: 英式常用enquire，美式通常用inquire。

meanings_zh: n. 可选方案；选项 | n. 选择权；选择机会
definition_en: Something you can choose from a range of possibilities. | The right or opportunity to choose whether to do something.
example1_en: Taking the bus is our cheapest option today.
example1_zh: 今天乘公交车是我们最便宜的选择。
example2_en: Remote working gives employees the option to live further from expensive city centres without changing jobs.
example2_zh: 远程办公让员工可以选择住在远离高房价市中心的地方，而不必换工作。
collocations: the best option｜最佳选择 ; have no option but to｜别无选择只能 ; keep your options open｜保留选择余地 ; the option to buy｜购买的选择权
tip_zh: option指可选方案；have no option but to后接动词原形。

meanings_zh: n. 人行道（英式） | n. 硬质路面（美式）
definition_en: A path beside a road for people to walk on. | The hard surface covering a road or other outdoor area.
example1_en: We walked along the pavement beside the busy road.
example1_zh: 我们沿着繁忙道路旁的人行道走。
example2_en: Wider pavements can improve pedestrian safety and make urban neighbourhoods more accessible for wheelchair users.
example2_zh: 更宽的人行道可以提高行人安全性，并让轮椅使用者更方便地在城市社区出行。
collocations: walk on the pavement｜在人行道上走 ; uneven pavement｜不平整的人行道 ; pavement café｜路边露天咖啡馆
tip_zh: 英式指人行道；美式常指道路的硬质表面。

meanings_zh: n. 刻度盘；调节旋钮 | v. 拨打电话号码
definition_en: A marked face or rotating control on an instrument | Enter a telephone number to make a call
example1_en: Turn the dial clockwise to make the room warmer.
example1_zh: 顺时针转动旋钮，让房间暖和一些。
example2_en: People who struggle with touchscreens may find a physical dial easier to use when adjusting household appliances.
example2_zh: 不擅长使用触摸屏的人在调节家用电器时，可能觉得实体旋钮更方便。
collocations: turn the dial｜转动旋钮 ; a clock dial｜钟面 ; dial a number｜拨打号码 ; a dial tone｜拨号音
tip_zh: 过去式英式常用dialled，美式常用dialed。

meanings_zh: adj. 聪明的；明智的 | adj. 整洁时髦的 | adj. 智能的
definition_en: intelligent or showing good judgment | neat, stylish, and suitable for a formal occasion | using computer technology to perform tasks automatically
example1_en: That was a smart way to fix the shelf.
example1_zh: 用那个办法修好架子真聪明。
example2_en: Smart irrigation systems can reduce water waste by adjusting supply according to soil conditions.
example2_zh: 智能灌溉系统可根据土壤状况调节供水，从而减少水资源浪费。
collocations: a smart choice｜明智的选择 ; smart clothes｜整洁时髦的衣服 ; smart technology｜智能技术 ; look smart｜看起来整洁得体
tip_zh: 英式常指衣着整洁时髦；美式常指聪明。

meanings_zh: n. 洲；大陆
definition_en: one of the Earth's main large areas of land
example1_en: Our teacher pointed to the African continent on a globe.
example1_zh: 老师指着地球仪上的非洲大陆。
example2_en: Climate change affects every continent, although its consequences vary considerably between regions and communities.
example2_zh: 气候变化影响每一个洲，但其后果因地区和群体而有很大差异。
collocations: the African continent｜非洲大陆 ; across continents｜跨越各洲 ; continental climate｜大陆性气候
tip_zh: continent是洲或大陆，country是国家。

meanings_zh: phr v. 出发；着手；摆放
definition_en: to start a journey or task, or to arrange
example1_en: She set out to learn Spanish last year.
example1_zh: 她去年开始学西班牙语。
example2_en: We set out the picnic food on the blanket.
example2_zh: 我们把野餐食物摆到毯子上。
tip_zh: set out 表示“出发/着手”；set out to do 是“开始做”。

meanings_zh: v. 买得起；承担得起 | v. 提供；给予
definition_en: to have enough money or resources for something | to provide something useful or desirable
example1_en: We cannot afford a new sofa this month.
example1_zh: 我们这个月买不起新沙发。
example2_en: Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
example2_zh: 如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。
collocations: can afford to do｜有能力负担做某事 ; cannot afford to lose｜承受不起失去 ; afford protection｜提供保护
tip_zh: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

meanings_zh: n. 物体；东西 | v. 反对 | n. 目的；目标
definition_en: a thing that can be seen or touched | to express disagreement with something | the aim of an action or activity
example1_en: A shiny object was lying beneath the sofa.
example1_zh: 沙发下面有个闪闪发亮的东西。
example2_en: Many residents object to the proposed airport expansion because it could increase noise pollution.
example2_zh: 许多居民反对拟议中的机场扩建，因为这可能加剧噪声污染。
collocations: a physical object｜实物 ; object to a proposal｜反对一项提议 ; the object of the exercise｜这项活动的目的
tip_zh: 名词重音在前，动词在后；object to后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 精神压力；紧张 | v. 强调 | n. 重音
definition_en: Mental strain caused by difficult situations or too many demands | To give particular importance to something when speaking or writing | Extra force used when pronouncing a syllable or word
example1_en: A short walk helps me deal with work stress.
example1_zh: 散一小会儿步有助于我缓解工作压力。
example2_en: Schools should teach students practical strategies for managing stress during examinations and other demanding periods.
example2_zh: 学校应教给学生实用的方法，帮助他们应对考试及其他紧张时期的压力。
collocations: under stress｜承受压力 ; reduce stress｜减轻压力 ; stress the importance of｜强调…的重要性 ; word stress｜单词重音
tip_zh: 人感到压力用stressed；事情令人紧张用stressful。

meanings_zh: adj. 缺席的；不在的 | adj. 缺少的；不存在的
definition_en: Not present where someone is expected to be. | Not existing or found in a particular place or situation.
example1_en: Lina was absent from class because she felt ill.
example1_zh: 莉娜因身体不适没有来上课。
example2_en: Students who are frequently absent from school may require additional support to keep up with their classmates.
example2_zh: 经常缺课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的学习进度。
collocations: absent from school｜缺课 ; absent from work｜缺勤 ; conspicuously absent｜明显缺席的
tip_zh: 表示缺席某场合用absent from，不用absent in。

meanings_zh: n. 诗人
definition_en: a person who writes poems
example1_en: The poet read her latest work beside the fireplace.
example1_zh: 这位诗人在壁炉旁朗读了她的最新作品。
example2_en: A poet can challenge social attitudes by expressing familiar experiences in unexpected and emotionally powerful ways.
example2_zh: 诗人可以用出人意料且富有感染力的方式表达日常体验，从而挑战社会观念。
collocations: a celebrated poet｜著名诗人 ; a contemporary poet｜当代诗人 ; a poet's work｜诗人的作品
tip_zh: poet指诗人，poem指一首诗，poetry统称诗歌。

meanings_zh: adj. 必不可少的；必要的 | adj. 本质的；基本的 | n. 必需品；基本要点
definition_en: Completely necessary for a particular purpose or situation | Relating to the most important characteristics of something | A necessary item or basic fact, usually mentioned in plural
example1_en: A warm coat is essential for this winter walk.
example1_zh: 这次冬日散步必须穿一件暖和的外套。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
example2_zh: 获得清洁饮用水对预防疾病和改善公共卫生至关重要。
collocations: essential for survival｜生存所必需的 ; essential services｜基本公共服务 ; essential equipment｜必需设备 ; daily essentials｜日常必需品
tip_zh: 名词常用复数 essentials，表示必需品或基本要点。

meanings_zh: n. 男警察
definition_en: a male police officer
example1_en: A policeman helped us cross the busy road.
example1_zh: 一位男警察帮我们穿过了繁忙的马路。
example2_en: A local policeman visited the school to explain how children can stay safe online.
example2_zh: 当地一位男警察到学校讲解儿童如何保障上网安全。
collocations: traffic policeman｜交通警察 ; uniformed policeman｜穿制服的男警察
tip_zh: policeman指男性；不强调性别用police officer。

meanings_zh: n. 精力；活力 | n. 能量；能源
definition_en: The strength and enthusiasm needed for physical or mental activity | Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity
example1_en: After a short nap, I had energy to cook.
example1_zh: 小睡一会儿后，我有精力做饭了。
example2_en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。
collocations: full of energy｜精力充沛 ; renewable energy｜可再生能源 ; energy consumption｜能源消耗 ; save energy｜节约能源
tip_zh: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

meanings_zh: n. 政府 | n. 治理；政体
definition_en: the group of people officially controlling a country or region | the activity or system of controlling a country
example1_en: The government plans to build a new hospital nearby.
example1_zh: 政府计划在附近建一所新医院。
example2_en: Local government plays a crucial role in providing affordable housing and maintaining essential public services.
example2_zh: 地方政府在提供可负担住房和维持基本公共服务方面发挥着关键作用。
collocations: local government｜地方政府 ; central government｜中央政府 ; government policy｜政府政策 ; a system of government｜政体
tip_zh: 英国英语中，指政府群体时可接单数或复数谓语。

meanings_zh: v. 组织；筹办 | v. 整理；有序安排
definition_en: plan and arrange an event or activity | put things into a clear and useful order
example1_en: We organise a picnic for our neighbours every summer.
example1_zh: 我们每年夏天都会为邻居们组织一次野餐。
example2_en: Local councils can organise community workshops to teach residents practical ways to reduce household waste.
example2_zh: 地方议会可以组织社区工作坊，教居民减少家庭垃圾的实用方法。
collocations: organise an event｜筹办活动 ; organise a meeting｜组织会议 ; organise your time｜安排时间 ; organise files｜整理文件
tip_zh: organise常见于英式英语；美式通常写organize。

meanings_zh: n. 经济学 | n. 经济因素；经济可行性
definition_en: The study of how societies produce, distribute, and use resources. | The financial factors affecting whether an activity is practical.
example1_en: My sister studies economics and enjoys discussing food prices.
example1_zh: 我姐姐学经济学，喜欢讨论食品价格。
example2_en: Studying economics helps students understand how government policies influence employment, inflation, and the distribution of wealth.
example2_zh: 学习经济学有助于学生理解政府政策如何影响就业、通货膨胀和财富分配。
collocations: study economics｜学习经济学 ; behavioural economics｜行为经济学 ; the economics of recycling｜回收利用的经济可行性
tip_zh: 指学科时虽以s结尾，仍接单数谓语。

meanings_zh: adj. 非常高兴的；欣喜的
definition_en: very pleased about something
example1_en: Lina was delighted to find her missing bracelet.
example1_zh: 莉娜找到丢失的手链，非常高兴。
example2_en: Residents were delighted with the new library, which offered free internet access and a welcoming space for study.
example2_zh: 居民对新图书馆感到十分满意，那里提供免费上网服务和舒适宜人的学习空间。
collocations: delighted with the result｜对结果非常满意 ; delighted to hear｜听到后很高兴 ; absolutely delighted｜欣喜万分
tip_zh: 人感到高兴用delighted；事物令人愉快用delightful。

meanings_zh: n. 内裤
definition_en: clothes worn under trousers
example1_en: He bought three pairs of underpants.
example1_zh: 他买了三条内裤。
example2_en: Underpants are usually worn under trousers.
example2_zh: 内裤通常穿在裤子里面。
collocations: a pair of underpants｜一条内裤
tip_zh: underpants 常用复数；一条说 a pair of underpants。

meanings_zh: v. 治愈；治好 | n. 疗法；治愈方法
definition_en: to make a disease disappear or someone healthy again | a treatment that makes a disease or condition disappear
example1_en: The doctor said these tablets could cure the infection.
example1_zh: 医生说这些药片可以治好这种感染。
example2_en: Although medical research has advanced considerably, scientists have not yet found a cure for every disease.
example2_zh: 尽管医学研究已取得显著进展，科学家仍未找到治愈所有疾病的方法。
collocations: cure a disease｜治愈疾病 ; a cure for｜……的疗法 ; cure someone of｜治好某人的……病
tip_zh: cure强调治好；treat只表示治疗，不保证痊愈。

meanings_zh: adj. 专业的；职业的 | adj. 专业得体的；称职的 | n. 专业人士；职业选手
definition_en: Relating to skilled work or an activity done for payment. | Showing the skill and behaviour expected of a trained worker. | Someone trained for skilled work or paid to perform.
example1_en: We hired a professional photographer for our wedding.
example1_zh: 我们为婚礼聘请了一位专业摄影师。
example2_en: Continuous professional development helps teachers adapt their methods to changing student needs and new educational technologies.
example2_zh: 持续的专业发展帮助教师调整教学方法，以适应学生需求的变化和新的教育技术。
collocations: professional advice｜专业建议 ; professional development｜专业发展 ; professional athlete｜职业运动员 ; healthcare professional｜医疗专业人员
tip_zh: 与amateur对比强调职业；形容态度时强调专业得体。

meanings_zh: adj. 非凡的；出色的 | adj. 异乎寻常的；奇特的
definition_en: Much better or more impressive than usual. | Very unusual or surprising.
example1_en: My grandmother has an extraordinary memory for people's birthdays.
example1_zh: 我奶奶记别人生日的本领特别出众。
example2_en: Recent advances in medical technology demonstrate the extraordinary potential of cooperation between scientists and engineers.
example2_zh: 医疗技术的最新进展展现了科学家与工程师合作的非凡潜力。
collocations: extraordinary achievement｜非凡成就 ; extraordinary ability｜非凡能力 ; extraordinary circumstances｜特殊情况
tip_zh: 比very good更强调超出寻常，也可指奇特。

meanings_zh: v. 搅拌 | v. 激起；唤起 | n. 轰动；骚动
definition_en: To mix something by moving a spoon or similar object around. | To cause a strong feeling or reaction. | Excitement or surprise caused by an event or action.
example1_en: Stir the soup gently so it does not stick.
example1_zh: 轻轻搅拌汤，免得粘锅。
example2_en: Documentaries about endangered animals can stir public concern and encourage stronger support for wildlife conservation.
example2_zh: 关于濒危动物的纪录片能够唤起公众的关注，促使人们更加支持野生动物保护。
collocations: stir well｜充分搅拌 ; stir in｜搅拌着加入 ; cause a stir｜引起轰动 ; stir up trouble｜挑起事端
tip_zh: 过去式stirred、现在分词stirring均双写r。

meanings_zh: n. 算术
definition_en: mathematics involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division
example1_en: We practised mental arithmetic while waiting for the bus.
example1_zh: 等公交车时，我们练习了心算。
example2_en: Strong arithmetic skills help young adults manage personal budgets and make informed financial decisions.
example2_zh: 扎实的算术能力有助于年轻人管理个人预算，并作出明智的财务决策。
collocations: mental arithmetic｜心算 ; basic arithmetic｜基础算术 ; arithmetic skills｜算术能力
tip_zh: 作名词通常不可数；范围比mathematics窄。

meanings_zh: phr v. 建立；设立；安装
definition_en: to start a business or arrange equipment
example1_en: They set up a small company last year.
example1_zh: 他们去年创办了一家小公司。
example2_en: Help me set up the tent, please.
example2_zh: 请帮我搭帐篷。
collocations: set up a business｜创业
tip_zh: set up 表示“建立、安装、创办”。

meanings_zh: v. 射击；射中 | v. 拍摄 | n. 嫩芽；新枝
definition_en: Fire a gun or another weapon; hit with a bullet | Take photographs or record a film | A new part growing from a plant
example1_en: She learned to shoot arrows at a local club.
example1_zh: 她在当地一家俱乐部学会了射箭。
example2_en: Film crews often shoot documentaries in remote locations to highlight the effects of climate change.
example2_zh: 摄制组常在偏远地区拍摄纪录片，以突出气候变化的影响。
collocations: shoot a film｜拍摄电影 ; shoot an arrow｜射箭 ; a young shoot｜嫩芽
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为shot；shoot at指朝……射击。

meanings_zh: v. 滑倒；滑落 | v. 悄悄移动；迅速塞入 | n. 小纸片；小错误
definition_en: To slide accidentally, losing balance or leaving a position. | To move or put something somewhere quietly or quickly. | A small piece of paper, or a minor mistake.
example1_en: I slipped on the wet floor but stayed upright.
example1_zh: 我在湿地板上滑了一下，但没有摔倒。
example2_en: Hospitals should keep floors dry to reduce the risk of patients slipping and injuring themselves.
example2_zh: 医院应保持地面干燥，以降低病人滑倒受伤的风险。
collocations: slip on ice｜在冰上滑倒 ; slip into a room｜悄悄进入房间 ; a slip of paper｜一张小纸条 ; a slip of the tongue｜口误
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为slipped，双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 工业；制造业 | n. 行业 | n. 勤奋；勤勉
definition_en: the production of goods in factories | businesses that provide a particular type of product or service | steady effort and hard work
example1_en: The fishing industry provides jobs for many local families.
example1_zh: 渔业为当地许多家庭提供了工作。
example2_en: Investment in cleaner technology could help heavy industry reduce emissions without significantly lowering production levels.
example2_zh: 投资更清洁的技术可帮助重工业减少排放，同时不显著降低生产水平。
collocations: heavy industry｜重工业 ; the tourism industry｜旅游业 ; the manufacturing industry｜制造业 ; industrial development｜工业发展
tip_zh: 工业用industrial；勤奋的用industrious。

meanings_zh: n. 机会；时机
definition_en: A situation that makes it possible to do something.
example1_en: The school trip gave me an opportunity to try climbing.
example1_zh: 学校旅行让我有机会尝试攀岩。
example2_en: Public libraries provide an important opportunity for residents to develop skills without paying expensive course fees.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆为居民提供了培养技能的重要机会，无须支付昂贵的课程费用。
collocations: an opportunity to learn｜学习的机会 ; seize an opportunity｜抓住机会 ; equal opportunities｜平等机会
tip_zh: 常用an opportunity to do，表示做某事的机会。

meanings_zh: adv. 紧急地；迫切地
definition_en: in a way that requires immediate action or attention
example1_en: We urgently need a plumber to fix this leak.
example1_zh: 我们急需一位水管工来修好这处漏水。
example2_en: Governments must urgently address water shortages through improved infrastructure and policies that encourage responsible consumption.
example2_zh: 政府必须通过改善基础设施和鼓励合理用水的政策，紧急应对缺水问题。
collocations: urgently needed｜急需的 ; urgently require｜迫切需要 ; act urgently｜立即采取行动
tip_zh: 强调事情需要立即处理，而不只是动作做得快。

meanings_zh: n. 脚踝；踝关节
definition_en: the joint connecting your foot to your leg
example1_en: She twisted her ankle while walking down the steps.
example1_zh: 她下台阶时扭伤了脚踝。
example2_en: Appropriate footwear can reduce the risk of ankle injuries during physical exercise and outdoor activities.
example2_zh: 合适的鞋子可以降低体育锻炼和户外活动中脚踝受伤的风险。
collocations: sprain an ankle｜扭伤脚踝 ; a swollen ankle｜肿胀的脚踝 ; ankle support｜护踝
tip_zh: ankle指脚与小腿连接处，不是脚后跟heel。

meanings_zh: n. 洗脸盆；盆 | n. 流域 | n. 盆地
definition_en: A wide, open container for water or washing. | The land drained by a river and its smaller rivers. | A broad area of low land surrounded by higher ground.
example1_en: She filled the basin with water to wash her face.
example1_zh: 她往盆里倒满水，准备洗脸。
example2_en: Agricultural expansion across the river basin has increased pressure on freshwater supplies and damaged natural habitats.
example2_zh: 整个流域内的农业扩张加大了淡水供应压力，并破坏了自然栖息地。
collocations: wash basin｜洗脸盆 ; river basin｜河流流域 ; drainage basin｜集水区
tip_zh: river basin指整个流域，不只是河道。

meanings_zh: v. 预防；防止；阻止
definition_en: To stop something happening or someone doing something.
example1_en: This tight lid will prevent the soup from spilling.
example1_zh: 这个严实的盖子能防止汤洒出来。
example2_en: Investing in early health education can help prevent chronic diseases and reduce future pressure on public healthcare services.
example2_zh: 投资早期健康教育有助于预防慢性病，并减轻公共医疗服务未来的压力。
collocations: prevent accidents｜预防事故 ; prevent disease｜预防疾病 ; prevent someone from doing｜阻止某人做某事
tip_zh: 用prevent sb from doing，不用prevent sb to do。

meanings_zh: n. 牛肉
definition_en: meat from cattle, eaten as food
example1_en: We cooked the beef slowly with carrots and potatoes.
example1_zh: 我们把牛肉和胡萝卜、土豆一起慢炖。
example2_en: Reducing beef consumption could lower greenhouse gas emissions because raising cattle requires substantial land and resources.
example2_zh: 减少牛肉消费可能降低温室气体排放，因为养牛需要大量土地和资源。
collocations: roast beef｜烤牛肉 ; minced beef｜牛肉末 ; beef stew｜炖牛肉 ; lean beef｜瘦牛肉
tip_zh: 表示食物时通常不可数：some beef，不用a beef。

meanings_zh: n. 不利条件；缺点
definition_en: something that makes success harder or reduces something's value
example1_en: The main disadvantage of this flat is the noise.
example1_zh: 这套公寓的主要缺点是噪声大。
example2_en: Students without reliable internet access face a significant disadvantage when schools rely heavily on online learning.
example2_zh: 当学校高度依赖线上学习时，无法稳定上网的学生会明显处于不利地位。
collocations: at a disadvantage｜处于不利地位 ; a major disadvantage｜重大弊端 ; advantages and disadvantages｜优点和缺点
tip_zh: 表示处于不利地位用at a disadvantage。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；绝妙的 | adj. 令人惊叹的
definition_en: Extremely good and very enjoyable. | Causing great surprise or admiration.
example1_en: We had a marvellous picnic beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边度过了一段美妙的野餐时光。
example2_en: Public gardens offer marvellous opportunities for urban residents to relax and reconnect with nature.
example2_zh: 公共花园为城市居民提供了放松身心、重新亲近自然的绝佳机会。
collocations: a marvellous idea｜绝妙的主意 ; a marvellous opportunity｜极好的机会 ; a marvellous achievement｜了不起的成就
tip_zh: 英式拼写为marvellous，美式通常为marvelous。

meanings_zh: v. 咳嗽 | n. 咳嗽；咳嗽声
definition_en: Force air suddenly from your throat with a rough sound. | The act or sound of coughing, or an illness causing it.
example1_en: The dusty room made me cough several times.
example1_zh: 房间里的灰尘让我咳嗽了好几次。
example2_en: People with a persistent cough should seek medical advice, particularly if symptoms interfere with sleep or daily activities.
example2_zh: 持续咳嗽的人应就医咨询，尤其是在症状影响睡眠或日常活动时。
collocations: a persistent cough｜持续咳嗽 ; a dry cough｜干咳 ; cough medicine｜止咳药 ; cough up｜咳出
tip_zh: gh在此发/f/；have a cough表示有咳嗽症状。

meanings_zh: phr v. 需要；要求；去接（人）
definition_en: to need, to demand, or to collect someone
example1_en: This difficult task calls for great patience.
example1_zh: 这项艰巨的任务需要极大的耐心。
example2_en: I'll call for you at eight before the party.
example2_zh: 聚会前我八点来接你。
tip_zh: call for 表示“需要/要求”，也可表示“去接某人”。

meanings_zh: n. 有柄水壶；大罐 | n. 一壶的量
definition_en: A handled container used for holding and pouring liquids. | The amount of liquid a jug holds.
example1_en: Please bring a jug of water to the table.
example1_zh: 请拿一壶水到餐桌上。
example2_en: Serving tap water in a reusable jug can help restaurants reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bottles.
example2_zh: 用可重复使用的水壶供应自来水，有助于餐馆减少对一次性塑料瓶的依赖。
collocations: a jug of water｜一壶水 ; milk jug｜牛奶壶 ; fill a jug｜装满一壶
tip_zh: 英式常指有嘴敞口壶；美式常指窄口带柄罐。

meanings_zh: adj. 时髦的；流行的
definition_en: Popular or considered attractive at a particular time.
example1_en: Those colourful trainers are fashionable among my friends.
example1_zh: 那种彩色运动鞋在我的朋友中很流行。
example2_en: Consumers often replace fashionable clothing quickly, increasing textile waste and placing pressure on natural resources.
example2_zh: 消费者往往很快就更换时髦的服装，增加了纺织废料，也给自然资源带来压力。
collocations: fashionable clothes｜时髦的衣服 ; a fashionable district｜时尚街区 ; become fashionable｜流行起来
tip_zh: 不仅形容衣服，也可形容观念、活动或地区。

meanings_zh: n. 诡计；恶作剧 | n. 窍门；戏法 | v. 欺骗；哄骗
definition_en: an action intended to deceive someone or make them look foolish | a clever technique or an act that seems magical | to deceive someone into believing or doing something
example1_en: Someone played a trick on me with a plastic spider.
example1_zh: 有人用一只塑料蜘蛛捉弄了我。
example2_en: Some online advertisements trick consumers into paying for services they initially believed were free.
example2_zh: 一些网络广告诱骗消费者为他们起初以为免费的服务付费。
collocations: play a trick on someone｜捉弄某人 ; trick someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事 ; a magic trick｜魔术戏法 ; the trick to doing something｜做某事的窍门
tip_zh: trick sb into doing sth表示“骗某人做某事”。

meanings_zh: adj. 手持的；便携的
definition_en: small enough to hold in your hand
example1_en: He played games on a hand-held device.
example1_zh: 他在手持设备上玩游戏。
example2_en: A hand-held camera filmed the street scenes.
example2_zh: 一台手持摄像机拍摄了街景。
tip_zh: hand-held 是“手持的”，如掌上游戏机。

meanings_zh: v. 建议；劝告 | v. 正式通知
definition_en: Tell someone what you think they should do | Officially give someone information about something
example1_en: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
example1_zh: 医生建议我休息几天。
example2_en: Schools should advise students on career options before they choose subjects for further study.
example2_zh: 学校应在学生选择进修科目之前，就职业选择向他们提供建议。
collocations: advise someone to do something｜建议某人做某事 ; advise against｜劝告不要 ; advise on｜就……提供建议 ; strongly advise｜强烈建议
tip_zh: advise是动词；advice是不可数名词，词尾发/s/。

meanings_zh: n. 现实；实际情况 | n. 事实；现实存在的事物
definition_en: The way things actually are, rather than imagined or wished. | Something that actually exists or happens.
example1_en: The holiday looked perfect, but reality was quite different.
example1_zh: 这次假期看起来很完美，但实际情况却大不相同。
example2_en: Although remote work offers flexibility, the reality is that many employees struggle to separate work from personal life.
example2_zh: 虽然远程工作带来了灵活性，但现实是许多员工难以将工作与个人生活分开。
collocations: in reality｜实际上 ; face reality｜面对现实 ; become a reality｜成为现实 ; virtual reality｜虚拟现实
tip_zh: in reality意为“实际上”；a reality指已实现的事。

meanings_zh: adj. 虚弱的；无力的 | adj. 薄弱的；缺乏说服力的 | adj. 淡的；微弱的
definition_en: lacking physical strength or energy | not effective, convincing, or well supported | having little intensity, flavour, or power
example1_en: I felt too weak to carry the shopping upstairs.
example1_zh: 我觉得浑身无力，没法把买来的东西提上楼。
example2_en: Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
example2_zh: 依据薄弱证据制定的政策可能无法解决失业的根本原因。
collocations: feel weak｜感到虚弱 ; weak evidence｜薄弱的证据 ; weak signal｜微弱的信号 ; weak tea｜淡茶
tip_zh: weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。

meanings_zh: n. 大学讲师；讲课者
definition_en: Someone who teaches at a university or gives educational talks
example1_en: Our lecturer stayed after class to explain the diagram.
example1_zh: 我们的讲师课后留下来讲解那张图。
example2_en: A university lecturer can encourage critical thinking by asking students to compare evidence from different sources.
example2_zh: 大学讲师可以要求学生比较不同来源的证据，从而培养批判性思维。
collocations: university lecturer｜大学讲师 ; senior lecturer｜高级讲师 ; lecturer in economics｜经济学讲师 ; guest lecturer｜客座讲课者
tip_zh: 某学科的讲师用lecturer in；不等同于教授。

meanings_zh: v. 称……的重量 | v. 重量为 | v. 权衡；仔细考虑
definition_en: to measure how heavy someone or something is | to have a particular weight | to consider something carefully before making a decision
example1_en: Please weigh these apples before putting them in the bag.
example1_zh: 请先称一下这些苹果，再装进袋子。
example2_en: Governments must weigh the economic benefits of tourism against its potential damage to local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 政府必须权衡旅游业的经济收益与其可能对当地生态系统造成的损害。
collocations: weigh yourself｜称体重 ; weigh the options｜权衡各种选择 ; weigh up the evidence｜仔细考虑证据 ; weigh the benefits against the costs｜权衡收益与成本
tip_zh: weigh是动词，weight是名词；表示重多少不用被动语态。

meanings_zh: adj. 有限的；受限制的
definition_en: Small in amount or restricted in range
example1_en: We have limited space, so choose a smaller sofa.
example1_zh: 我们空间有限，所以选一张小一点的沙发吧。
example2_en: Students with limited access to reliable internet may struggle to participate fully in online learning.
example2_zh: 难以获得稳定网络连接的学生可能无法充分参与在线学习。
collocations: limited resources｜有限的资源 ; limited access｜受限的使用机会 ; a limited range｜有限的范围 ; be limited to｜仅限于
tip_zh: be limited to表示“仅限于”，to后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 设计师；设计者 | adj. 名牌设计师设计的
definition_en: Someone who plans how something will look or work. | Made by a famous fashion designer, usually expensive.
example1_en: The designer showed us a model of our kitchen.
example1_zh: 设计师给我们看了我们厨房的模型。
example2_en: A skilled designer can make public spaces more accessible to people with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 技艺娴熟的设计师能够让行动不便的人更方便地使用公共空间。
collocations: fashion designer｜时装设计师 ; graphic designer｜平面设计师 ; interior designer｜室内设计师 ; designer clothes｜设计师品牌服装
tip_zh: 作形容词常置于衣物等名词前，强调设计师品牌。

meanings_zh: n. 蚕丝；丝绸
definition_en: Fine thread produced by silkworms, or fabric made from it.
example1_en: She wrapped a soft silk scarf around her neck.
example1_zh: 她把一条柔软的丝巾围在脖子上。
example2_en: Traditional silk production provides employment in rural communities while preserving skills passed down through generations.
example2_zh: 传统丝绸生产为农村社区提供就业机会，同时保留了代代相传的技艺。
collocations: silk scarf｜丝巾 ; pure silk｜真丝 ; silk production｜丝绸生产
tip_zh: silk通常不可数；silky指柔滑如丝，不一定是丝制。

meanings_zh: v. 应得；值得
definition_en: To have earned something because of your actions or qualities.
example1_en: You deserve a rest after carrying those heavy boxes.
example1_zh: 搬了那些沉重的箱子后，你该休息一下了。
example2_en: Healthcare workers deserve greater recognition because their dedication contributes directly to the wellbeing of society.
example2_zh: 医护人员值得获得更多认可，因为他们的奉献直接促进了社会福祉。
collocations: deserve praise｜值得表扬 ; deserve attention｜值得关注 ; deserve to win｜理应获胜
tip_zh: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。

meanings_zh: v. 推荐；介绍 | v. 建议；劝告
definition_en: To suggest someone or something as a good choice. | To advise someone that a particular action would be beneficial.
example1_en: Can you recommend a quiet café near the station?
example1_zh: 你能推荐一家车站附近安静的咖啡馆吗？
example2_en: Health experts recommend regular exercise to reduce stress and improve overall physical and mental wellbeing.
example2_zh: 健康专家建议经常运动，以减轻压力并改善整体身心健康。
collocations: highly recommend｜强烈推荐 ; recommend a book｜推荐一本书 ; recommend doing something｜建议做某事 ; recommend someone for a job｜推荐某人担任某职
tip_zh: 用recommend doing或recommend that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 订金；押金；存款 | v. 存入；放置；使沉积 | n. 沉积物；矿床
definition_en: money paid in advance, held as security, or banked | to put money or material somewhere for keeping or accumulation | material that builds up naturally in a place
example1_en: We paid a deposit before moving into the flat.
example1_zh: 我们搬进公寓前交了押金。
example2_en: Requiring a refundable deposit on drink containers can encourage recycling and reduce waste in public spaces.
example2_zh: 对饮料容器收取可退还的押金，可以鼓励回收利用，减少公共场所的垃圾。
collocations: pay a deposit｜支付订金或押金 ; refundable deposit｜可退还的押金 ; deposit money｜存钱 ; mineral deposits｜矿床
tip_zh: 订金是预付款；押金作担保；银行存款也用deposit。

meanings_zh: n. 部分；章节；区域 | n. 截面；切片 | v. 划分；切成片
definition_en: A distinct part of something larger. | A surface or thin piece exposed by cutting through something. | To divide something into parts or cut it into slices.
example1_en: You'll find fresh bread in the bakery section.
example1_zh: 你可以在烘焙区找到新鲜面包。
example2_en: The final section of the report examines how urban design can encourage healthier lifestyles.
example2_zh: 报告的最后一部分探讨了城市设计如何促进更健康的生活方式。
collocations: a section of｜…的一部分 ; final section｜最后一部分 ; cross section｜横截面 ; section off｜隔开
tip_zh: section可指文章章节，也可指商店等场所的区域。

meanings_zh: n. 收藏品；一批物品 | n. 收集；收取 | n. 募捐；募集的款项
definition_en: a group of objects kept or presented together | the act of gathering or taking things away | the gathering of money from people for a purpose
example1_en: My aunt keeps her shell collection in a cabinet.
example1_zh: 我姑姑把她收藏的贝壳放在柜子里。
example2_en: Regular household waste collection is essential for protecting public health and maintaining a clean urban environment.
example2_zh: 定期收运生活垃圾对于保护公众健康和保持城市环境整洁至关重要。
collocations: a collection of｜一批；一组 ; data collection｜数据收集 ; waste collection｜垃圾收运 ; make a collection｜进行募捐
tip_zh: a collection of后接复数名词，表示一批相关物品。

meanings_zh: phr v. 出现；露面
definition_en: to arrive or appear somewhere
example1_en: He didn't show up for the meeting.
example1_zh: 他没有出现在会议上。
example2_en: She showed up ten minutes late.
example2_zh: 她迟到了十分钟才露面。
tip_zh: show up 是口语“出现/露面”，等于 turn up。

meanings_zh: n. 预订；预约
definition_en: An arrangement to reserve a room, seat, or service.
example1_en: I called the hotel to confirm our booking.
example1_zh: 我打电话给酒店确认我们的预订。
example2_en: Online booking systems allow tourists to compare accommodation prices and plan their journeys more efficiently.
example2_zh: 在线预订系统让游客能够比较住宿价格，更高效地规划行程。
collocations: make a booking｜进行预订 ; confirm a booking｜确认预订 ; cancel a booking｜取消预订 ; advance booking｜提前预订
tip_zh: booking是可数名词；预订某项服务常用booking for。

meanings_zh: adj. 中等的 | n. 媒介；传播手段
definition_en: Between small and large, or between low and high. | A means of communicating information or expressing ideas.
example1_en: Cook the vegetables over medium heat until soft.
example1_zh: 用中火把蔬菜煮软。
example2_en: Film is an effective medium for exploring social issues and encouraging discussion among young people.
example2_zh: 电影是探索社会问题并促进年轻人讨论的有效媒介。
collocations: medium heat｜中火 ; medium size｜中等尺寸 ; a medium of communication｜传播媒介
tip_zh: 作“媒介”时，复数通常为media。

meanings_zh: adj. 难以忘怀的
definition_en: so special or powerful that you will always remember it
example1_en: Watching whales from the boat was an unforgettable experience.
example1_zh: 在船上看鲸鱼是一次难忘的经历。
example2_en: School trips can provide unforgettable experiences that strengthen students' understanding of history beyond the classroom.
example2_zh: 学校组织的旅行能带来难忘的体验，让学生在课堂之外加深对历史的理解。
collocations: an unforgettable experience｜难忘的经历 ; an unforgettable moment｜难忘的时刻 ; an unforgettable journey｜难忘的旅程
tip_zh: 形容经历令人难忘；forgetful指人健忘。

meanings_zh: v. 为…做广告；登广告 | v. 登广告征求或招聘
definition_en: To promote products, services or events through public messages. | To announce publicly that someone or something is wanted.
example1_en: The bakery advertises its fresh bread on local radio.
example1_zh: 这家面包店在当地电台为自家的新鲜面包做广告。
example2_en: Governments should restrict how companies advertise sugary snacks to children, who may not recognise persuasive marketing techniques.
example2_zh: 政府应限制企业向儿童宣传高糖零食的方式，因为儿童可能无法识别具有诱导性的营销手法。
collocations: advertise a product｜为产品做广告 ; advertise for staff｜登广告招聘员工 ; advertise online｜在网上做广告
tip_zh: advertise产品指宣传；advertise for人指登广告招聘。

meanings_zh: n. 绷带 | v. 用绷带包扎
definition_en: A strip of material wrapped around an injury for protection. | To wrap an injured body part in a bandage.
example1_en: The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around my ankle.
example1_zh: 护士用干净的绷带包住了我的脚踝。
example2_en: Basic first aid courses teach people how to apply a bandage safely before professional help arrives.
example2_zh: 基础急救课程教人们如何在专业救援到来前安全地使用绷带。
collocations: apply a bandage｜包扎绷带 ; change a bandage｜更换绷带 ; bandage a wound｜包扎伤口
tip_zh: 既是名词也是动词；bandage a wound意为包扎伤口。

meanings_zh: n. 椰子 | n. 椰肉
definition_en: A large tropical fruit with a hard shell and white flesh. | The white flesh of a coconut, used as food.
example1_en: We shared a fresh coconut beside the beach.
example1_zh: 我们在海滩边分着吃了一个新鲜椰子。
example2_en: Coastal farmers can earn additional income by processing coconut shells into useful household products.
example2_zh: 沿海农民可以通过将椰壳加工成实用的家居用品来增加收入。
collocations: coconut milk｜椰奶 ; coconut water｜椰子水 ; coconut oil｜椰子油 ; coconut shell｜椰壳
tip_zh: 指整颗椰子可数，指椰肉通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 好处；益处 | v. 使受益；得益于 | n. 福利金；补助金
definition_en: a helpful or positive effect of something | to help someone or receive help or an advantage | money provided by the government to people needing support
example1_en: One benefit of cycling is arriving home feeling refreshed.
example1_zh: 骑车的一个好处是到家时感觉神清气爽。
example2_en: Rural communities can benefit from improved internet access through greater opportunities for education and employment.
example2_zh: 更好的互联网接入能增加教育和就业机会，让农村社区受益。
collocations: health benefits｜健康益处 ; benefit from｜从……中受益 ; unemployment benefit｜失业救济金 ; mutual benefit｜互利
tip_zh: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

meanings_zh: adj.&adv. 兼职的；非全日
definition_en: working fewer hours than full time
example1_en: She has a part-time job in a café.
example1_zh: 她在咖啡馆做兼职。
example2_en: He works part time while studying.
example2_zh: 他边学习边兼职。
tip_zh: part time 是“兼职”；反义 full time 全职。

meanings_zh: v. 听；倾听 | v. 听从；听取
definition_en: to pay attention to sounds or what someone is saying | to take someone's advice or warnings seriously
example1_en: I listen to music while cooking dinner every evening.
example1_zh: 每天晚上做饭时，我都会听音乐。
example2_en: Local authorities should listen to residents before making decisions that significantly affect their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 地方政府在作出对社区有重大影响的决定前，应听取居民的意见。
collocations: listen to music｜听音乐 ; listen carefully｜仔细听 ; listen to advice｜听取建议
tip_zh: 接对象须用listen to；hear侧重听到的结果。

meanings_zh: pron. 大量；充足 | adv. 很；足够地 | n. 富足；丰裕
definition_en: Enough or more than enough of something. | To a sufficient degree or a large extent. | A state in which resources are abundant.
example1_en: There is plenty of soup left for everyone.
example1_zh: 剩下的汤足够大家喝。
example2_en: Although cities offer plenty of employment opportunities, high housing costs can discourage young workers from moving there.
example2_zh: 尽管城市提供大量就业机会，高昂的住房成本仍可能让年轻劳动者不愿迁入。
collocations: plenty of time｜充裕的时间 ; plenty of opportunities｜大量机会 ; plenty more｜多得多 ; a time of plenty｜富足的时期
tip_zh: plenty of后接复数可数名词或不可数名词，无须加a。

meanings_zh: adv. 但愿；希望如此 | adv. 满怀希望地
definition_en: Used to express what you hope will happen. | In a way that shows hope.
example1_en: Hopefully, the weather will stay dry for our walk.
example1_zh: 但愿我们散步时天气能保持晴好。
example2_en: Hopefully, improvements in cycling infrastructure will encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 希望自行车基础设施的改善能鼓励更多居民放弃开车出行。
collocations: hopefully soon｜但愿很快 ; look hopefully at｜满怀希望地看着 ; wait hopefully｜满怀希望地等待
tip_zh: 句首常表示“但愿”，不表示某事一定会发生。

meanings_zh: n. 奖品；奖金（复数）
definition_en: things given for winning
example1_en: The winners received their prizes at the ceremony.
example1_zh: 获奖者在典礼上领了奖。
example2_en: There are three prizes for the best projects.
example2_zh: 最佳项目有三个奖项。
tip_zh: prizes 是 prize 的复数，奖品/奖金。

meanings_zh: n. 牙膏
definition_en: A substance used with a toothbrush to clean teeth.
example1_en: I squeezed some toothpaste onto my brush before breakfast.
example1_zh: 早餐前，我往牙刷上挤了些牙膏。
example2_en: Regular brushing with fluoride toothpaste helps prevent tooth decay and can reduce the need for costly dental treatment.
example2_zh: 经常使用含氟牙膏刷牙有助于预防蛀牙，并可减少昂贵牙科治疗的需求。
collocations: a tube of toothpaste｜一管牙膏 ; fluoride toothpaste｜含氟牙膏 ; squeeze out toothpaste｜挤出牙膏
tip_zh: toothpaste不可数；一管牙膏用a tube of toothpaste。

meanings_zh: n. 目的；用途 | n. 目标感；使命感
definition_en: the reason for doing something or what something is intended for | a feeling of having meaningful aims in life
example1_en: What is the purpose of this tiny kitchen tool?
example1_zh: 这个小小的厨房工具是做什么用的？
example2_en: The main purpose of public libraries is to provide equal access to information and learning opportunities.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆的主要目的是让人们平等地获取信息和学习机会。
collocations: main purpose｜主要目的 ; serve a purpose｜起作用 ; on purpose｜故意地 ; a sense of purpose｜目标感
tip_zh: on purpose意为“故意地”，不是“有目的地”。

meanings_zh: n. 污染
definition_en: damage to the environment caused by harmful substances or energy
example1_en: Air pollution makes the distant hills difficult to see.
example1_zh: 空气污染让远处的山丘难以看清。
example2_en: Reducing pollution requires governments to regulate industrial emissions while encouraging cleaner transport and more sustainable production methods.
example2_zh: 减少污染需要政府监管工业排放，同时鼓励更清洁的交通方式和更可持续的生产方式。
collocations: air pollution｜空气污染 ; water pollution｜水污染 ; noise pollution｜噪声污染 ; reduce pollution｜减少污染
tip_zh: pollution不可数；具体污染物用pollutant。

meanings_zh: adj. 中心的；中央的 | adj. 核心的；最重要的
definition_en: in or near the middle of a place | extremely important or essential to something
example1_en: Our apartment is central, so we walk to most places.
example1_zh: 我们的公寓位于市中心，因此去大多数地方都步行。
example2_en: Access to reliable information is central to helping citizens make informed decisions about public health.
example2_zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民就公共卫生作出明智决定至关重要。
collocations: central location｜中心位置 ; central government｜中央政府 ; a central role｜核心作用 ; central to｜对……至关重要
tip_zh: central to表示“对……至关重要”，介词用to。

meanings_zh: n. 主管；负责人；董事 | n. 导演
definition_en: Someone who manages an organisation, department, or company. | Someone who guides actors and controls a film or play.
example1_en: Our director welcomed the new staff at breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们的主管在早餐时欢迎了新员工。
example2_en: A museum director must balance the need to attract visitors with the responsibility to preserve valuable collections.
example2_zh: 博物馆馆长必须在吸引参观者的需求与保护珍贵藏品的责任之间取得平衡。
collocations: managing director｜总经理 ; board of directors｜董事会 ; film director｜电影导演 ; director of operations｜运营总监
tip_zh: 既可指机构主管或董事，也可指影视、戏剧导演。

meanings_zh: n. 轮椅
definition_en: A wheeled chair used by someone who has difficulty walking.
example1_en: She rolled her wheelchair up the ramp into the library.
example1_zh: 她推着轮椅沿坡道进入了图书馆。
example2_en: Public buildings should provide step-free entrances and spacious lifts so that wheelchair users can move around independently.
example2_zh: 公共建筑应提供无台阶入口和宽敞的电梯，让轮椅使用者能够独立通行。
collocations: wheelchair user｜轮椅使用者 ; electric wheelchair｜电动轮椅 ; wheelchair access｜轮椅通行条件
tip_zh: 说a wheelchair user，避免用带有束缚意味的表达。

meanings_zh: adj. 方便的；合适的 | adj. 附近的；便于到达的
definition_en: Easy to use or suitable for your needs and plans. | Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.
example1_en: Is Saturday morning a convenient time for your visit?
example1_zh: 你周六上午来方便吗？
example2_en: Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.
example2_zh: 在线学习为在职成年人提供了无需前往校园就能提升技能的便捷途径。
collocations: a convenient time｜合适的时间 ; convenient for someone｜对某人方便 ; a convenient location｜便利的位置 ; a convenient way to｜做……的便捷方式
tip_zh: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

meanings_zh: adj. 苦的 | adj. 愤愤不平的；怨恨的 | adj. 激烈的；充满敌意的
definition_en: having a sharp taste like strong unsweetened coffee | angry and resentful because of unfair treatment or disappointment | involving strong anger and hostility
example1_en: The coffee tasted too bitter without milk or sugar.
example1_zh: 这咖啡不加奶或糖，喝起来太苦了。
example2_en: Proposals to close local libraries have sparked bitter disputes between residents and local authorities.
example2_zh: 关闭当地图书馆的提议引发了居民与地方政府之间的激烈争议。
collocations: a bitter taste｜苦味 ; bitter about｜对……耿耿于怀 ; a bitter dispute｜激烈的争议 ; bitter disappointment｜极度失望
tip_zh: 味觉上的bitter是苦，sour是酸，别混淆。

meanings_zh: adv. 在夜间；过夜 | adv. 突然；一夜之间 | adj. 夜间的；供一夜的
definition_en: during the night or for one night | very quickly or suddenly | happening during or lasting for one night
example1_en: We stayed overnight at a small hotel near the station.
example1_zh: 我们在车站附近的一家小旅馆住了一夜。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can improve urban mobility, but meaningful changes rarely happen overnight.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通可以改善城市出行，但实质性变化很少能一夜实现。
collocations: stay overnight｜过夜 ; overnight success｜一夜成名 ; overnight flight｜夜间航班
tip_zh: 表“一夜之间”时，常强调变化快，不一定真是一夜。

meanings_zh: n. 宇宙 | n. 独特的世界；体系
definition_en: All space and everything that exists within it | A complete world of experiences, ideas, or imagined events
example1_en: We watched a film about stars and the universe.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于恒星和宇宙的电影。
example2_en: Research into the origins of the universe has driven advances in telescope technology and data analysis.
example2_zh: 对宇宙起源的研究推动了望远镜技术和数据分析的进步。
collocations: the expanding universe｜不断膨胀的宇宙 ; the origins of the universe｜宇宙的起源 ; a parallel universe｜平行宇宙 ; the observable universe｜可观测宇宙
tip_zh: 指宇宙通常用the universe；开头是辅音音素/j/。

meanings_zh: n. 出身；经历；背景 | n. 背景情况 | n. 背景；后景
definition_en: The family, education, and experience that shape someone's life | Information or events needed to understand a situation | The part of a scene behind the main subject
example1_en: Her background in nursing helped her care for Grandpa.
example1_zh: 她的护理经历帮助她照顾爷爷。
example2_en: Universities should provide equal opportunities for applicants from different social backgrounds, regardless of their family income.
example2_zh: 大学应为来自不同社会背景的申请者提供平等机会，不论其家庭收入如何。
collocations: a professional background｜职业背景 ; background information｜背景资料 ; in the background｜在背景中 ; a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip_zh: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

meanings_zh: adj. 直接的；直达的 | v. 指导；指挥；导演 | v. 指路；将……指向
definition_en: Without anything or anyone coming between. | To guide or control an activity, performance, or group. | To show the way or aim something towards a place.
example1_en: There is a direct train from here to the airport.
example1_zh: 这里有直达机场的火车。
example2_en: Improved public transport can have a direct impact on employment by connecting residents with more job opportunities.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通能让居民获得更多就业机会，从而对就业产生直接影响。
collocations: direct contact｜直接接触 ; a direct flight｜直达航班 ; direct a film｜导演电影 ; direct attention to｜将注意力转向
tip_zh: direct可作形容词或动词；常见读音也有/daɪˈrekt/。

meanings_zh: n. 战争 | n. 斗争；对抗
definition_en: armed fighting between countries or groups | a determined effort to defeat something harmful
example1_en: The museum displays uniforms worn during the war.
example1_zh: 博物馆展出了战争期间穿过的军服。
example2_en: War can disrupt children's education and force families to leave their homes in search of safety.
example2_zh: 战争可能打断儿童的学业，迫使家庭离开家园寻求安全。
collocations: civil war｜内战 ; at war｜处于交战状态 ; declare war｜宣战 ; war on poverty｜消除贫困的斗争
tip_zh: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 读者；阅读者 | n. 阅读器；读卡器 | n. 分级读物；阅读课本
definition_en: A person who reads, especially books, newspapers, or magazines | A device that displays written material or reads stored information | A book designed to help learners develop reading skills
example1_en: An eager reader, Lina always carries a book.
example1_zh: 莉娜热爱阅读，总是随身带着一本书。
example2_en: Digital libraries allow readers in remote communities to access educational resources without travelling to larger towns.
example2_zh: 数字图书馆让偏远社区的读者无需前往较大的城镇，就能获取教育资源。
collocations: an avid reader｜热衷阅读的人 ; a card reader｜读卡器 ; a graded reader｜分级读物
tip_zh: reader既可指人，也可指设备或供学习的读物。

meanings_zh: n. 岸；滨 | v. 支撑；支持
definition_en: the land along the edge of a sea or lake | to support something weak or likely to fail, with up
example1_en: We left our shoes on the shore and went swimming.
example1_zh: 我们把鞋留在岸边，然后去游泳了。
example2_en: Construction near the shore should be carefully controlled to protect coastal habitats from permanent damage.
example2_zh: 应严格管控岸边的建设活动，以保护沿海栖息地免受永久性破坏。
collocations: on the shore｜在岸边 ; reach the shore｜到达岸边 ; shore up confidence｜增强信心
tip_zh: shore多指海、湖岸；河岸通常用bank。

meanings_zh: n. 教育；受教育过程
definition_en: The process of learning or teaching knowledge and skills.
example1_en: Her grandparents saved money to pay for her education.
example1_zh: 她的祖父母攒钱供她读书。
example2_en: Access to quality education can improve employment prospects and reduce inequality across different social groups.
example2_zh: 获得优质教育的机会能够改善就业前景，并缩小不同社会群体之间的不平等。
collocations: higher education｜高等教育 ; compulsory education｜义务教育 ; access to education｜受教育的机会 ; education system｜教育体系
tip_zh: 通常不可数；但可说a good education（良好教育）。

meanings_zh: n. 妈妈（口语）
definition_en: informal word for mother
example1_en: Mum makes the best soup in the world.
example1_zh: 妈妈做的汤是世界上最好喝的。
example2_en: I told my mum about the school trip.
example2_zh: 我把学校旅行的事告诉了妈妈。
tip_zh: mum 是英式说法；美式说 mom。

meanings_zh: v. 营救；解救 | n. 营救；救援行动
definition_en: To save someone or something from danger or difficulty. | An act of saving someone or something from danger.
example1_en: Firefighters rescued a kitten from the roof this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，消防员从屋顶救下了一只小猫。
example2_en: Coastal communities need well-equipped teams to rescue residents when severe flooding blocks roads and damages homes.
example2_zh: 沿海社区需要装备精良的队伍，在严重洪灾阻断道路、损坏房屋时营救居民。
collocations: rescue someone from｜从……中救出某人 ; a rescue team｜救援队 ; a rescue operation｜救援行动 ; come to the rescue｜前来解围
tip_zh: 常用rescue sb from sth，表示从险境中救出某人。

meanings_zh: adj. 光滑的；平整的 | adj. 顺利的；平稳的 | v. 使平整；抚平
definition_en: having an even surface without rough areas or bumps | happening without problems, interruptions, or sudden movements | to make a surface even or remove its wrinkles
example1_en: This stone feels smooth and cool in my hand.
example1_zh: 这块石头握在手里又光滑又凉。
example2_en: Clear communication between departments is essential for a smooth transition to a new working system.
example2_zh: 部门之间清晰的沟通对于顺利过渡到新的工作制度至关重要。
collocations: smooth surface｜光滑表面 ; smooth transition｜平稳过渡 ; smooth operation｜顺畅运转 ; smooth out wrinkles｜抚平褶皱
tip_zh: 末尾th读浊音/ð/；smoothly常形容事情进展顺利。

meanings_zh: phr v. 期待；盼望
definition_en: to feel excited about something in the future
example1_en: I look forward to seeing you next week.
example1_zh: 我期待下周见到你。
example2_en: The children look forward to the school trip.
example2_zh: 孩子们期待学校旅行。
tip_zh: look forward to + 名词/动名词，注意 to 后接动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 水龙头 | v. 轻敲；轻拍 | v. 开发利用
definition_en: a device that controls water flowing from a pipe | to touch or hit something lightly | to use an available source of energy, knowledge, or resources
example1_en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
example1_zh: 刷牙时请关上水龙头。
example2_en: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
example2_zh: 大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。
collocations: tap water｜自来水 ; turn off the tap｜关上水龙头 ; tap someone on the shoulder｜轻拍某人的肩膀 ; tap into resources｜利用资源
tip_zh: 水龙头在美式英语中常称faucet。

meanings_zh: n. 候选人；求职者 | n. 应试者
definition_en: Someone competing for a job or an elected position. | Someone taking an examination.
example1_en: Each candidate waited outside the office before their interview.
example1_zh: 每位求职者都在面试前等候在办公室外。
example2_en: Employers should assess each candidate fairly rather than rely on assumptions about their educational or cultural background.
example2_zh: 雇主应公平评估每位求职者，而不是依赖对其教育或文化背景的主观推断。
collocations: candidate for a position｜某职位的候选人 ; suitable candidate｜合适的人选 ; election candidate｜竞选候选人 ; exam candidate｜考生
tip_zh: candidate for后接所竞聘的职位或所竞选的职务。

meanings_zh: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的 | adj. 偏僻的；荒凉的
definition_en: Unhappy because you lack companionship or close connections. | Far from people or rarely visited.
example1_en: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
example1_zh: 我一直觉得孤单，直到邻居邀请我去喝茶。
example2_en: Older adults may feel lonely after retirement, so community centres should provide regular opportunities for social interaction.
example2_zh: 老年人退休后可能感到孤独，因此社区中心应定期提供社交机会。
collocations: feel lonely｜感到孤独 ; a lonely life｜孤独的生活 ; a lonely road｜偏僻的道路
tip_zh: alone强调独自一人；lonely强调内心孤独。

meanings_zh: n. 财产；所有物 | n. 房产；地产 | n. 性质；特性
definition_en: things that belong to a person or organisation | land or buildings that someone owns | a quality of a substance or material
example1_en: Please keep your personal property safe while you swim.
example1_zh: 游泳时，请妥善保管个人财物。
example2_en: Understanding the thermal properties of building materials helps architects design homes that require less heating.
example2_zh: 了解建筑材料的热学性能，有助于建筑师设计供暖需求更低的住宅。
collocations: private property｜私人财产 ; property prices｜房产价格 ; physical properties｜物理性质 ; intellectual property｜知识产权
tip_zh: 财产义不可数；房产和性质义可数。

meanings_zh: phr. 错误地；不小心
definition_en: not on purpose
example1_en: I took your umbrella by mistake.
example1_zh: 我不小心拿错了你的伞。
example2_en: She deleted the file by mistake.
example2_zh: 她不小心删除了文件。
tip_zh: by mistake 与 by accident 都表示“意外地”；on purpose 是“故意”。

meanings_zh: n. 电影制作人；导演
definition_en: a person who makes films
example1_en: The film maker won an award for the movie.
example1_zh: 这位电影制作人因这部电影获奖。
example2_en: She is a young film maker from London.
example2_zh: 她是一位来自伦敦的年轻电影制作人。
tip_zh: film maker 是电影制作者，可指导演/制片人。

meanings_zh: adj. 东部的；东方的
definition_en: In or relating to the east of an area.
example1_en: Our hotel overlooks the island's quiet eastern coast.
example1_zh: 我们的酒店俯瞰着岛上宁静的东海岸。
example2_en: Improved railway connections could help eastern regions attract investment and reduce economic differences within the country.
example2_zh: 改善铁路连接有助于东部地区吸引投资，缩小国内经济差距。
collocations: eastern coast｜东海岸 ; eastern region｜东部地区 ; eastern boundary｜东部边界
tip_zh: eastern通常只作形容词，不表示“东方人”。

meanings_zh: n. 风格；方式 | n. 款式；时尚 | v. 设计造型
definition_en: A distinctive way of doing something or expressing ideas. | The design of something or a fashionable appearance. | To arrange or design something to achieve a particular look.
example1_en: Her colourful paintings have a cheerful, playful style.
example1_zh: 她色彩丰富的画作有一种欢快、俏皮的风格。
example2_en: Modern architects often adapt traditional building styles to preserve local identity while meeting contemporary housing needs.
example2_zh: 现代建筑师常改良传统建筑风格，在满足当代住房需求的同时保留地方特色。
collocations: writing style｜写作风格 ; architectural style｜建筑风格 ; in style｜流行的 ; style your hair｜给头发做造型
tip_zh: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

meanings_zh: v. 微笑 | n. 微笑；笑容
definition_en: To raise the corners of your mouth, showing happiness or friendliness. | A facial expression with raised mouth corners, often showing happiness.
example1_en: The baby smiled when I waved across the room.
example1_zh: 我在房间另一头挥手时，宝宝笑了。
example2_en: A friendly smile can help patients feel more comfortable when discussing their concerns with healthcare professionals.
example2_zh: 友善的微笑能让患者在与医护人员讨论自己的顾虑时感到更自在。
collocations: smile at someone｜对某人微笑 ; a warm smile｜温暖的笑容 ; a broad smile｜灿烂的笑容
tip_zh: 对某人微笑用smile at，不用smile to。

meanings_zh: n. 味道；味觉 | v. 品尝；尝起来 | n. 品味；喜好
definition_en: A food's flavour, or the sense that detects it. | To try food or drink, or have a particular flavour. | Someone's preferences or ability to judge what is attractive.
example1_en: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
example1_zh: 这汤有浓郁的烤番茄味。
example2_en: Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.
example2_zh: 学校提供多样且诱人的餐食，可能会让孩子逐渐喜欢上更健康的食物。
collocations: taste delicious｜尝起来很美味 ; a bitter taste｜苦味 ; a taste for｜对……的喜好 ; good taste｜好品味
tip_zh: taste表示“尝起来”时接形容词，不接副词。

meanings_zh: n. 束；串 | n. 一群；一帮 | v. 聚拢；使聚成一团
definition_en: a group of similar things held or growing together | a group of people, described informally | to gather closely together, or make things gather together
example1_en: He brought a bunch of flowers for the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 他带来一束花，准备放在厨房的餐桌上。
example2_en: When passengers bunch together near train doors, boarding becomes slower and less comfortable for everyone.
example2_zh: 当乘客聚集在列车门附近时，上车速度会变慢，所有人的乘车体验也会变差。
collocations: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄 ; a bunch of flowers｜一束花 ; a bunch of friends｜一帮朋友 ; bunch up｜挤在一起
tip_zh: a bunch of可指一束或一串；指人时较口语化。

meanings_zh: adj. 明智的；合乎情理的
definition_en: Showing good judgement and practical understanding.
example1_en: Taking an umbrella was sensible in this weather.
example1_zh: 这种天气带把伞是明智的。
example2_en: Investing in preventive healthcare is a sensible way to reduce pressure on public hospitals over time.
example2_zh: 投资预防性医疗是逐步减轻公立医院压力的明智之举。
collocations: a sensible decision｜明智的决定 ; a sensible approach｜合理的方法 ; sensible advice｜合理的建议
tip_zh: sensible指明智的；sensitive指敏感的。

meanings_zh: adj. 不确定的；没把握的
definition_en: not certain about something
example1_en: I am unsure about the answer to this question.
example1_zh: 我不确定这道题的答案。
example2_en: She felt unsure about taking the job.
example2_zh: 她不确定是否接受这份工作。
collocations: be unsure of/about｜对…不确定
tip_zh: be unsure about/of 是“对…没把握”。

meanings_zh: n. 肥皂剧
definition_en: a TV drama shown regularly about people's lives
example1_en: My grandmother watches a soap opera every evening.
example1_zh: 我奶奶每天晚上看肥皂剧。
example2_en: The soap opera has been on TV for twenty years.
example2_zh: 这部肥皂剧已经播了二十年。
tip_zh: soap opera 是肥皂剧，剧情连续、贴近生活。

meanings_zh: n. 运动员
definition_en: A person trained to compete in sports requiring physical skill.
example1_en: The athlete stretched her legs before the morning race.
example1_zh: 那位运动员在早上的比赛前伸展了双腿。
example2_en: Young athletes need balanced training programmes that protect their health while allowing them to pursue sporting excellence.
example2_zh: 年轻运动员需要均衡的训练计划，在追求卓越运动表现的同时保护健康。
collocations: professional athlete｜职业运动员 ; elite athlete｜顶尖运动员 ; a promising young athlete｜有潜力的年轻运动员
tip_zh: athlete常泛指运动员，不只指田径选手。

meanings_zh: adj.&adv. 最远的
definition_en: at the greatest distance
example1_en: The furthest town is about fifty kilometres away.
example1_zh: 最远的城镇大约五十公里远。
example2_en: Who can throw the ball the furthest?
example2_zh: 谁能把球扔得最远？
tip_zh: furthest 是 far 的最高级之一（far-farther-furthest）。

meanings_zh: n. 花瓶
definition_en: a container used to hold flowers or for decoration
example1_en: I put fresh flowers in the vase by the window.
example1_zh: 我把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。
example2_en: Traditional pottery, including decorative vases, can provide valuable insights into the artistic practices of past societies.
example2_zh: 包括装饰花瓶在内的传统陶器，可以为了解过去社会的艺术实践提供宝贵线索。
collocations: a vase of flowers｜一瓶花 ; a glass vase｜玻璃花瓶 ; a ceramic vase｜陶瓷花瓶
tip_zh: 英式通常读/vɑːz/；美式常读/veɪs/。

meanings_zh: adj. 好奇的；求知欲强的 | adj. 奇怪的；不寻常的
definition_en: Wanting to learn or know more about something. | Unusual or strange in a way that attracts attention.
example1_en: The curious kitten peered into my open shopping bag.
example1_zh: 那只好奇的小猫探头看我敞开的购物袋。
example2_en: Teachers can encourage curious students to explore scientific questions through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
example2_zh: 教师可以鼓励求知欲强的学生通过动手实验探索科学问题，而不只是死记硬背。
collocations: curious about｜对……好奇 ; curious to know｜很想知道 ; a curious mixture｜奇特的混合物
tip_zh: be curious about表示“对……好奇”。

meanings_zh: v. 梳洗；梳理毛发 | n. 新郎 | v. 培养；使做好准备
definition_en: To clean and brush an animal or make yourself neat. | A man who is getting married or has just married. | To prepare someone for a particular role or responsibility.
example1_en: We groom our pony every morning before riding.
example1_zh: 我们每天早上骑马前都会给小马梳毛。
example2_en: Some organisations groom promising employees for leadership roles through structured training and regular mentoring.
example2_zh: 一些机构通过系统培训和定期指导，培养有潜力的员工担任领导职务。
collocations: groom a horse｜给马梳洗 ; bride and groom｜新娘与新郎 ; groom someone for leadership｜培养某人担任领导
tip_zh: 培养某人任职用groom someone for a role。

meanings_zh: n. 意思；含义 | n. 意义；价值
definition_en: The idea that a word, action, or message communicates. | The importance or purpose that makes something worthwhile.
example1_en: Could you explain the meaning of this unusual word?
example1_zh: 你能解释一下这个不常见的词是什么意思吗？
example2_en: Volunteering can give people a sense of meaning while strengthening connections within their local communities.
example2_zh: 志愿服务既能让人感到生活有意义，也能加强当地社区内部的联系。
collocations: the meaning of a word｜词义 ; literal meaning｜字面意思 ; convey meaning｜传达含义 ; give meaning to life｜赋予生活意义
tip_zh: 问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 控制；管理 | v. 控制；管理；抑制 | n. 操纵装置
definition_en: The power to direct or limit someone or something. | To direct, manage, or limit someone or something. | A device used to operate a machine or vehicle.
example1_en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
example1_zh: 抓紧风筝线，控制好风筝。
example2_en: Stricter control of industrial emissions could improve air quality and reduce health risks in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 更严格地控制工业排放可以改善空气质量，并降低人口密集城市的健康风险。
collocations: take control of｜掌控 ; under control｜处于控制之下 ; lose control｜失去控制 ; control pollution｜控制污染
tip_zh: 过去式controlled、现在分词controlling均双写l。

meanings_zh: phr v. 执行；实施
definition_en: to do or complete a task
example1_en: The team carried out the plan successfully.
example1_zh: 团队成功执行了计划。
example2_en: Scientists carried out a survey of local birds.
example2_zh: 科学家对当地鸟类进行了调查。
collocations: carry out a survey｜进行调查
tip_zh: carry out 表示“执行计划、进行调查”等。

meanings_zh: adj. 温暖舒适的 | adj. 亲密愉快的
definition_en: warm, comfortable, and pleasant, often in a small space | friendly and relaxed in a private setting
example1_en: We spent a cosy evening beside the fire.
example1_zh: 我们在炉火旁度过了一个温暖惬意的夜晚。
example2_en: Small libraries can provide cosy spaces where residents read, relax, and build connections with their neighbours.
example2_zh: 小型图书馆可以提供舒适的空间，让居民阅读、放松并与邻里建立联系。
collocations: a cosy room｜温暖舒适的房间 ; a cosy atmosphere｜温馨的氛围 ; a cosy chat｜亲切闲聊
tip_zh: 英式拼写cosy，美式通常写cozy。

meanings_zh: n. 防御；保护 | n. 辩护；答辩 | n. 防守；防守队员
definition_en: Action taken to protect someone or something from attack or harm. | An argument or explanation supporting someone accused or criticized. | Players or actions that stop opponents from scoring in sport.
example1_en: The thick walls provided a strong defence against attackers.
example1_zh: 厚实的城墙为抵御进攻者提供了坚固的屏障。
example2_en: Restoring coastal wetlands offers a natural defence against flooding while creating valuable habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 恢复沿海湿地既能形成防洪的天然屏障，也能为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: defence against｜对……的防御 ; in defence of｜为……辩护 ; self-defence｜自卫 ; defence spending｜国防开支
tip_zh: 英式拼写 defence；美式拼写 defense。

meanings_zh: adj. 活跃的；积极参与的 | adj. 运作中的；起作用的 | adj. 主动语态的
definition_en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part | currently working or producing an effect | describing a verb whose subject performs the action
example1_en: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
example1_zh: 我祖父每天早晨游泳，保持活力。
example2_en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。
collocations: stay active｜保持活力 ; an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式 ; play an active role｜发挥积极作用 ; active ingredient｜有效成分
tip_zh: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

meanings_zh: n. 冰鞋；溜冰鞋
definition_en: boots with blades for ice skating
example1_en: She laced up her ice skates carefully.
example1_zh: 她仔细系好冰鞋鞋带。
example2_en: My ice skates are a bit tight.
example2_zh: 我的冰鞋有点紧。
collocations: a pair of ice skates｜一双冰鞋
tip_zh: ice skates 是滑冰冰鞋，常用复数。
