meanings_zh: n. 工资；工钱 | v. 开展；发动
definition_en: money earned for work, often calculated by the hour or week | to carry on a war or organised campaign
example1_en: The café pays a decent wage for weekend work.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆给周末上班的员工支付不错的工资。
example2_en: Raising the minimum wage may improve living standards, but small businesses could face higher operating costs.
example2_zh: 提高最低工资可能改善生活水平，但小企业可能面临更高的经营成本。
collocations: minimum wage｜最低工资 ; earn a wage｜挣工资 ; wage increase｜加薪 ; wage a campaign｜开展运动
tip_zh: wage常按小时或周计算；salary通常指固定薪金。

meanings_zh: v. 使失望
definition_en: To make someone unhappy by failing to meet their expectations.
example1_en: I knew cancelling our picnic would disappoint the children.
example1_zh: 我知道取消野餐会让孩子们失望。
example2_en: Public transport improvements may disappoint commuters if services remain unreliable despite substantial investment in new vehicles.
example2_zh: 尽管大量资金投入了新车辆，若服务仍不可靠，公共交通的改善可能会让通勤者失望。
collocations: disappoint customers｜让顾客失望 ; disappoint expectations｜辜负期望 ; never disappoint｜从不让人失望
tip_zh: 人感到失望用disappointed；事物令人失望用disappointing。

meanings_zh: adj. 恼怒的；不耐烦的
definition_en: slightly angry about something unpleasant or inconvenient
example1_en: Leila looked annoyed when the printer jammed again.
example1_zh: 打印机又卡纸了，莱拉显得有些恼火。
example2_en: Residents often become annoyed when construction noise continues late into the evening without prior warning.
example2_zh: 如果施工噪声持续到深夜且事先没有通知，居民往往会感到恼火。
collocations: annoyed with someone｜生某人的气 ; annoyed about something｜因某事恼火 ; visibly annoyed｜明显感到恼火
tip_zh: annoyed形容人的感受；annoying形容令人恼火的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 大学毕业生 | v. 毕业；获得学位
definition_en: someone who has successfully completed a university degree | to successfully complete a course at a school or university
example1_en: My sister graduated from university and started work nearby.
example1_zh: 我姐姐大学毕业后，在附近开始工作。
example2_en: Many recent graduates struggle to find employment that matches their qualifications in an increasingly competitive labour market.
example2_zh: 在竞争日益激烈的劳动力市场中，许多应届毕业生难以找到符合自身资历的工作。
collocations: university graduate｜大学毕业生 ; recent graduate｜应届毕业生 ; graduate from university｜大学毕业 ; graduate with honours｜以优等成绩毕业
tip_zh: 名词尾音/ət/，动词/eɪt/；毕业于用graduate from。

meanings_zh: n. 研究；调查 | v. 研究；调查
definition_en: Careful study aimed at discovering facts or developing knowledge. | To study a subject carefully to discover information.
example1_en: I did some research before choosing my new bicycle.
example1_zh: 挑选新自行车之前，我做了一番调查。
example2_en: Research into renewable energy can help governments develop cleaner and more reliable sources of electricity.
example2_zh: 对可再生能源的研究可以帮助政府开发更清洁、更可靠的电力来源。
collocations: conduct research｜开展研究 ; research into｜对……的研究 ; research findings｜研究结果 ; scientific research｜科学研究
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；说a study，不说a research。

meanings_zh: n. 转弯处；岔路口 | n. 转动；旋转
definition_en: a place where a road branches off another road | the action of moving around a central point
example1_en: Take the next turning after the small bakery.
example1_zh: 过了那家小面包店，在下一个路口转弯。
example2_en: Poor visibility at this turning increases the risk of accidents for cyclists and other road users.
example2_zh: 这个转弯处视野不佳，增加了骑车者和其他道路使用者发生事故的风险。
collocations: miss a turning｜错过转弯路口 ; take a turning｜在路口转弯 ; a turning on the left｜左侧的岔路口
tip_zh: 表示岔路口时主要用于英式英语；也是turn的-ing形式。

meanings_zh: n. 银行业；银行业务
definition_en: the business of running a bank
example1_en: He works in banking in the city centre.
example1_zh: 他在市中心从事银行业。
example2_en: Online banking makes it easy to pay bills.
example2_zh: 网上银行让支付账单变得简单。
collocations: online banking｜网上银行
tip_zh: banking 是银行业；online banking 是网上银行。

meanings_zh: n. 猪
definition_en: A farm animal with a broad snout and short legs.
example1_en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
example1_zh: 一头粉色的猪正睡在木栅栏旁。
example2_en: Farmers can improve animal welfare by giving pigs enough space to move freely and explore.
example2_zh: 农民可以给猪足够的自由活动和探索空间，以改善动物福利。
collocations: pig farm｜养猪场 ; raise pigs｜养猪 ; wild pig｜野猪
tip_zh: pig指动物；作为食物的猪肉通常用pork。

meanings_zh: phr v. 推迟；拖延
definition_en: to delay something to a later time
example1_en: They put off the meeting until Friday.
example1_zh: 他们把会议推迟到周五。
example2_en: Don't put off your homework till the last minute.
example2_zh: 别把作业拖到最后一刻。
tip_zh: put off 表示“推迟”；put off doing 是“拖延做某事”。

meanings_zh: n. 人们 | adj. 民间的；传统的 | n. 民间音乐；民谣
definition_en: People, especially those belonging to a particular group. | Connected with the traditional culture of ordinary people. | Music rooted in the traditions of a community.
example1_en: Local folk gather here to chat every evening.
example1_zh: 当地人每晚都聚在这里聊天。
example2_en: Traditional folk music can help younger generations understand the cultural heritage of their communities.
example2_zh: 传统民间音乐能帮助年轻一代理解自己社区的文化遗产。
collocations: local folk｜当地人 ; folk music｜民间音乐 ; folk tale｜民间故事 ; folk dance｜民间舞蹈
tip_zh: 指人们时用复数动词；my folks口语指父母。

meanings_zh: adj. 累人的；令人疲倦的
definition_en: making someone feel that they need rest
example1_en: Carrying these heavy bags upstairs is tiring work.
example1_zh: 把这些沉重的袋子搬上楼是件累人的活。
example2_en: Long and tiring commutes can reduce workers' productivity and leave them with less time for family activities.
example2_zh: 漫长而累人的通勤会降低员工的工作效率，也会减少他们参与家庭活动的时间。
collocations: a tiring day｜劳累的一天 ; a tiring journey｜令人疲惫的旅程 ; physically tiring｜耗费体力的
tip_zh: tiring形容事物令人累；tired形容人感到累。

meanings_zh: n. 玻璃瓶回收箱
definition_en: a container for recycling glass bottles
example1_en: We take our old bottles to the bottle bank.
example1_zh: 我们把旧瓶子送到回收箱。
example2_en: The bottle bank is full; we'll come back later.
example2_zh: 回收箱满了，我们晚点再来。
tip_zh: bottle bank 是街边的玻璃瓶回收点。

meanings_zh: n. 联系；关系 | n. 亲属；亲戚
definition_en: a connection between people, things, or ideas | a person who belongs to your family
example1_en: The price seems to bear no relation to quality.
example1_zh: 这个价格似乎与质量毫无关系。
example2_en: Researchers are examining the relation between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
example2_zh: 研究人员正在考察城市社区中绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。
collocations: in relation to｜关于；相对于 ; bear no relation to｜与……无关 ; relations between countries｜国家间的关系 ; a close relation｜近亲
tip_zh: 国家或群体间的关系常用复数relations。

meanings_zh: v. 重建；重新建造 | v. 恢复；重建关系或信心
definition_en: to build something again after damage or destruction | to make something strong or successful again
example1_en: We plan to rebuild the garden wall this weekend.
example1_zh: 我们打算这周末重建花园围墙。
example2_en: After severe flooding, local authorities must rebuild essential infrastructure and help affected communities recover.
example2_zh: 严重洪灾过后，地方政府必须重建重要基础设施，帮助受灾社区恢复。
collocations: rebuild a house｜重建房屋 ; rebuild trust｜重建信任 ; rebuild the economy｜重振经济
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为 rebuilt。

meanings_zh: adv. 尤其；特别
definition_en: especially; more than usual
example1_en: I particularly enjoyed the music at the concert.
example1_zh: 我特别喜欢音乐会上的音乐。
example2_en: It was particularly cold this winter.
example2_zh: 今年冬天特别冷。
tip_zh: particularly 表示“尤其、特别地”。

meanings_zh: n. 体育联赛；联赛组织 | n. 联盟；联合会 | n. 水平；等级
definition_en: A group of sports teams that regularly compete against one another. | An association of people or groups sharing a common purpose. | A level of quality, ability, or achievement.
example1_en: Our team finished top of the league this season.
example1_zh: 我们队本赛季在联赛中排名第一。
example2_en: A local sports league can strengthen community ties by bringing together players from different social backgrounds.
example2_zh: 地方体育联赛可以让不同社会背景的球员聚在一起，从而加强社区联系。
collocations: a football league｜足球联赛 ; top of the league｜联赛榜首 ; in a different league｜远高于一般水平 ; out of my league｜超出我的能力范围
tip_zh: in a different league常指水平远胜一筹。

meanings_zh: n. 守门员
definition_en: the player who guards the goal
example1_en: The goalkeeper saved two important shots.
example1_zh: 守门员扑救了两次关键射门。
example2_en: He is the best goalkeeper in our school team.
example2_zh: 他是我们校队最好的守门员。
tip_zh: goalkeeper 是守门员，口语常简称 keeper。

meanings_zh: adj. 镇静的；平静的 | v. 使镇静；平静下来 | n. 平静；宁静
definition_en: Not worried or excited; without strong movement or disturbance. | To become less upset, or make someone feel more relaxed. | A peaceful state without worry, noise, or disturbance.
example1_en: She stayed calm when the lights suddenly went out.
example1_zh: 灯突然熄灭时，她依然保持镇静。
example2_en: A calm classroom atmosphere can help students concentrate and feel more confident about asking questions.
example2_zh: 平静的课堂氛围有助于学生集中注意力，也让他们更有信心提问。
collocations: stay calm｜保持镇静 ; calm down｜平静下来 ; calm waters｜平静的水面 ; a sense of calm｜宁静感
tip_zh: calm中的l不发音；calm down表示平静下来。

meanings_zh: n. 消防员
definition_en: A person trained to put out fires and rescue people
example1_en: The firefighter showed us how to use the hose.
example1_zh: 那位消防员向我们演示了如何使用消防水带。
example2_en: Every firefighter requires regular training to respond safely and effectively to emergencies in increasingly complex urban environments.
example2_zh: 每位消防员都需要定期接受培训，以便在日益复杂的城市环境中安全、有效地应对紧急情况。
collocations: a trained firefighter｜训练有素的消防员 ; a volunteer firefighter｜志愿消防员 ; firefighter training｜消防员培训
tip_zh: firefighter不区分性别，比fireman更通用。

meanings_zh: n. 王宫；高级官邸
definition_en: A grand official home for a royal or important leader.
example1_en: We walked through the palace gardens before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们在王宫花园里散了步。
example2_en: Opening a historic palace to visitors can generate income for conservation and support local tourism.
example2_zh: 向游客开放历史悠久的宫殿，可以筹集保护资金并支持当地旅游业。
collocations: royal palace｜王宫 ; presidential palace｜总统府 ; palace grounds｜宫殿庭园
tip_zh: 主要用作名词；palace gardens中作名词定语。

meanings_zh: adj. 抑郁的；沮丧的 | adj. 经济萧条的；不景气的
definition_en: very unhappy, sometimes persistently as part of a mental illness | having little economic activity or few opportunities
example1_en: He felt depressed after weeks of unsuccessful job hunting.
example1_zh: 连续数周求职无果后，他感到很沮丧。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can connect economically depressed areas with employment opportunities and essential services.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通可以让经济萧条地区的居民获得就业机会和基本服务。
collocations: feel depressed｜感到沮丧 ; severely depressed｜严重抑郁的 ; economically depressed area｜经济萧条地区
tip_zh: depressed形容人的感受；depressing形容令人沮丧的事。

meanings_zh: adj. 无袖的
definition_en: without sleeves
example1_en: She wore a sleeveless dress in summer.
example1_zh: 夏天她穿无袖连衣裙。
example2_en: The sleeveless shirt is cool and light.
example2_zh: 这件无袖衬衫凉爽轻便。
tip_zh: sleeveless 是“无袖的”；-less 表示“没有”。

meanings_zh: n. 移民入境；移居 | n. 入境检查；入境检查处
definition_en: The process of entering another country to live there. | The official checks or checkpoint for people entering a country.
example1_en: We showed our passports at immigration after the flight.
example1_zh: 下飞机后，我们在入境检查处出示了护照。
example2_en: Immigration can help address labour shortages, particularly when newcomers receive language training and employment support.
example2_zh: 移民可以帮助缓解劳动力短缺，尤其是在新移民获得语言培训和就业支持的情况下。
collocations: immigration policy｜移民政策 ; immigration control｜入境管制 ; immigration officer｜入境事务官员 ; go through immigration｜接受入境检查
tip_zh: immigration强调迁入；emigration强调迁出。

meanings_zh: n. 喷气式飞机 | n. 喷流；喷射流
definition_en: An aircraft powered by jet engines. | A narrow, forceful stream of liquid or gas.
example1_en: A jet flew low over the beach this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上一架喷气式飞机低空飞过海滩。
example2_en: Replacing older passenger jets with more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption across the aviation industry.
example2_zh: 用效率更高的飞机替换老旧客机，可以降低整个航空业的燃料消耗。
collocations: passenger jet｜喷气式客机 ; jet engine｜喷气发动机 ; a jet of water｜一股喷射的水流
tip_zh: a jet of water指一股喷射的水流。

meanings_zh: n. 撞车；坠毁；碰撞 | v. 碰撞；坠毁 | v. 崩溃；暴跌
definition_en: an accident in which a vehicle hits something or falls | to hit something violently or fall and be badly damaged | to stop working suddenly or lose value very quickly
example1_en: Nobody was hurt in the crash outside our house.
example1_zh: 我们家外面的那起撞车事故没有造成人员受伤。
example2_en: Financial markets can crash when investors suddenly lose confidence in the stability of the economy.
example2_zh: 当投资者突然对经济的稳定性失去信心时，金融市场可能暴跌。
collocations: a car crash｜车祸 ; crash into a wall｜撞上墙 ; a computer crash｜电脑崩溃 ; a stock market crash｜股市崩盘
tip_zh: crash into后接撞上的物体；电脑崩溃也可用crash。

meanings_zh: n. 条纹
definition_en: a long narrow line of colour
example1_en: The T-shirt has blue and white stripes.
example1_zh: 这件T恤有蓝白条纹。
example2_en: A zebra has black and white stripes.
example2_zh: 斑马有黑白条纹。
tip_zh: stripe 是条纹；striped 是“有条纹的”。

meanings_zh: v. 想要；想做 | adj. 精致的；豪华的 | v. 爱慕；觉得有吸引力
definition_en: To want something or feel like doing something. | Decorative, elaborate, or expensive rather than plain. | To feel romantically attracted to someone.
example1_en: Do you fancy a walk by the river after lunch?
example1_zh: 午饭后你想去河边散步吗？
example2_en: Some tourists prefer simple local accommodation to fancy hotels because it offers more opportunities for cultural exchange.
example2_zh: 一些游客更喜欢简朴的当地住宿，而非豪华酒店，因为前者提供更多文化交流机会。
collocations: fancy doing something｜想做某事 ; fancy a drink｜想喝点东西 ; a fancy restaurant｜一家豪华餐厅
tip_zh: 表示“想做”时用fancy doing，不用fancy to do。

meanings_zh: n. 实用建议；窍门 | n. 尖端；末端 | n. 小费
definition_en: a useful piece of advice | the narrow or pointed end of something | extra money given to someone for providing a service
example1_en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
example1_zh: 邻居分享了一个种番茄的实用窍门。
example2_en: Schools can offer practical tips on managing money to help young people develop responsible spending habits.
example2_zh: 学校可以提供实用的理财建议，帮助年轻人养成负责任的消费习惯。
collocations: a useful tip｜实用建议 ; the tip of the tongue｜舌尖 ; leave a tip｜留下小费
tip_zh: tip作“建议”可数，advice不可数：a tip。

meanings_zh: n. 囚犯；被拘禁者 | n. 战俘；俘虏
definition_en: A person kept in prison or prevented from leaving. | A person captured and held by an enemy during war.
example1_en: The prisoner borrowed a novel from the prison library.
example1_zh: 那名囚犯从监狱图书馆借了一本小说。
example2_en: Providing prisoners with education and vocational training may improve their chances of finding employment after release.
example2_zh: 为囚犯提供教育和职业培训，可能提高他们获释后找到工作的机会。
collocations: release a prisoner｜释放囚犯 ; prisoner of war｜战俘 ; take someone prisoner｜俘虏某人
tip_zh: prisoner 不一定已被定罪，也可指被俘或被拘禁者。

meanings_zh: adj. 到期应付的；应交的 | adj. 预期的；预计到达的 | adj. 应得的；应有的
definition_en: Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time. | Expected to happen or arrive at a particular time. | Deserved or appropriate in a particular situation.
example1_en: Our rent is due at the end of the week.
example1_zh: 我们的房租本周末到期应付。
example2_en: When tuition fees are due, some students struggle to cover both educational expenses and basic living costs.
example2_zh: 学费到期应缴时，一些学生难以同时承担教育支出和基本生活费用。
collocations: payment due｜到期应付款项 ; due to arrive｜预计到达 ; due consideration｜应有的考虑 ; due to｜由于
tip_zh: be due to do表示预计做；due to＋名词表示由于。

meanings_zh: n. 宇航员；航天员
definition_en: a person trained to travel and work in space
example1_en: The astronaut floated gently through the small space station.
example1_zh: 那名宇航员轻轻地飘过小型空间站。
example2_en: Astronauts conduct experiments in space that help scientists understand how the human body responds to weightlessness.
example2_zh: 宇航员在太空中开展实验，帮助科学家了解人体对失重的反应。
collocations: astronaut training｜宇航员训练 ; a team of astronauts｜一队宇航员 ; astronaut crew｜宇航员乘组
tip_zh: astronaut是宇航员；astronomer是天文学家。

meanings_zh: v. 围绕；包围 | v. 与……密切相关；围绕
definition_en: be or move into positions on every side of something | be closely connected with an event, situation, or subject
example1_en: Tall trees surround the cottage and shade its windows.
example1_zh: 高大的树木环绕着小屋，为窗户遮阴。
example2_en: Uncertainty continues to surround the proposed transport scheme, making it difficult for local businesses to plan ahead.
example2_zh: 拟议中的交通方案仍存在不确定性，使当地企业难以提前规划。
collocations: be surrounded by｜被……包围 ; surround yourself with｜使自己身边充满 ; the circumstances surrounding｜与……有关的情况
tip_zh: 常用be surrounded by；surroundings指周围环境。

meanings_zh: n. 系统 | n. 制度；体制 | n. 方法；成套程序
definition_en: A set of connected parts that work together. | An organised structure through which services or institutions operate. | An organised way of doing something.
example1_en: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
example1_zh: 在一个寒冷的夜晚，供暖系统停止了运行。
example2_en: An effective education system should support students with different abilities and prepare them for future employment.
example2_zh: 有效的教育体系应支持能力各异的学生，并帮助他们为未来就业做好准备。
collocations: heating system｜供暖系统 ; education system｜教育体系 ; public transport system｜公共交通系统 ; immune system｜免疫系统
tip_zh: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。

meanings_zh: n. 东北；东北部 | adj. 东北的；来自东北的 | adv. 向东北；在东北
definition_en: The direction between north and east, or an area's northeastern part. | Located in, facing, or coming from the northeast. | Towards or in the direction between north and east.
example1_en: The storm is moving northeast towards the coastal villages.
example1_zh: 暴风雨正向东北方向的沿海村庄移动。
example2_en: Investment in rail connections could improve access to employment for communities in the northeast of the country.
example2_zh: 投资铁路交通可以为该国东北部的社区居民提供更多就业便利。
collocations: in the northeast｜在东北部 ; head northeast｜向东北行进 ; the northeast coast｜东北海岸
tip_zh: northeast of表示在……东北方；英式也写north-east。

meanings_zh: n. 外国人
definition_en: A person from a country other than the one being discussed.
example1_en: As a foreigner, I needed help understanding local customs.
example1_zh: 作为外国人，我需要别人帮助我了解当地习俗。
example2_en: Language courses can help foreigners participate more fully in community life and access essential public services.
example2_zh: 语言课程可以帮助外国人更充分地参与社区生活，并获得必要的公共服务。
collocations: as a foreigner｜作为外国人 ; foreigners living abroad｜在海外生活的外国人 ; welcome foreigners｜欢迎外国人
tip_zh: 泛指外国人；特指游客时用visitor更自然。

meanings_zh: adj. 已订婚的 | adj. 忙于；参与的 | adj. 占线的；使用中的
definition_en: Having formally agreed to marry someone. | Actively involved in an activity or task. | Currently being used and therefore unavailable.
example1_en: My sister got engaged during her holiday by the sea.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在海边度假时订婚了。
example2_en: Students who are actively engaged in classroom discussions often develop stronger communication and critical thinking skills.
example2_zh: 积极参与课堂讨论的学生往往能培养更强的沟通和批判性思维能力。
collocations: get engaged｜订婚 ; engaged to someone｜与某人订婚 ; engaged in research｜从事研究 ; the line is engaged｜电话占线
tip_zh: 订婚对象前用to；参与的活动前用in。

meanings_zh: n. 傻瓜；蠢人 | v. 欺骗；愚弄
definition_en: someone who behaves without good sense or judgment | to make someone believe something that is not true
example1_en: The realistic plastic spider fooled everyone at the party.
example1_zh: 那只逼真的塑料蜘蛛骗过了聚会上的所有人。
example2_en: Misleading advertisements can fool consumers into buying products that offer little practical benefit.
example2_zh: 误导性广告可能诱使消费者购买几乎没有实际用处的产品。
collocations: fool someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事 ; make a fool of yourself｜出洋相 ; fool around｜胡闹
tip_zh: fool作名词称呼别人有贬义；动词可接into doing。

meanings_zh: n. 语法；语法规则
definition_en: The rules for combining words and changing their forms.
example1_en: Our teacher explains grammar using examples from everyday conversations.
example1_zh: 我们的老师用日常对话中的例子讲解语法。
example2_en: Although grammar instruction is important, language courses should also give learners opportunities to communicate in realistic situations.
example2_zh: 虽然语法教学很重要，语言课程也应让学习者有机会在真实情境中交流。
collocations: grammar rules｜语法规则 ; English grammar｜英语语法 ; correct grammar｜正确的语法 ; a grammar exercise｜语法练习
tip_zh: 表示语法知识时不可数；一个语法错误用a grammar mistake。

meanings_zh: prep. 多达；直到；取决于
definition_en: as many as; until; depending on
example1_en: The bus can carry up to fifty passengers.
example1_zh: 这辆公交车最多可载五十名乘客。
example2_en: It's up to you to decide.
example2_zh: 由你决定。
tip_zh: up to 表示“多达/直到”；be up to sb 是“由某人决定”。

meanings_zh: n. 夫妇；情侣 | n. 两个；几个 | v. 连接；结合
definition_en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship. | Two things or people, or a small number of them. | To join two things or consider them together.
example1_en: The couple next door invited us over for dinner.
example1_zh: 隔壁那对夫妇邀请我们去吃晚饭。
example2_en: High housing costs, coupled with limited childcare, can discourage young couples from starting a family.
example2_zh: 高昂的住房成本加上有限的托育服务，可能使年轻夫妇不愿生育孩子。
collocations: a married couple｜一对已婚夫妇 ; a couple of days｜两三天 ; coupled with｜加上；结合
tip_zh: a couple of后接复数名词，可指两个或少数几个。

meanings_zh: n. 营业时间
definition_en: the hours when a shop or office is open
example1_en: The museum's opening hours are ten to five.
example1_zh: 博物馆的营业时间是十点到五点。
example2_en: Check the opening hours before you visit.
example2_zh: 参观前请查看营业时间。
tip_zh: opening hours 是营业/开放时间。

meanings_zh: n. 准许进入；录取 | n. 入场费 | n. 承认；供认
definition_en: Permission to enter a place or join an institution | The money paid to enter a place | A statement accepting that something is true, often something unpleasant
example1_en: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
example1_zh: 这家博物馆周日免费开放。
example2_en: University admission should reflect academic potential rather than simply rewarding access to expensive private education.
example2_zh: 大学录取应看重学术潜力，而非仅仅让能接受昂贵私立教育的人获益。
collocations: admission to university｜大学录取 ; admission fee｜入场费 ; free admission｜免费入场 ; admission of guilt｜认罪
tip_zh: 进入某处用admission to；承认某事用admission of。

meanings_zh: v. 转移；调动；转账 | v. 转车；转学 | n. 转移；调动；转账
definition_en: To move someone or something from one place to another. | To change to another vehicle, school, or institution. | The act of moving something or someone to another place.
example1_en: Please transfer the photos from your camera to my laptop.
example1_zh: 请把相机里的照片传到我的笔记本电脑上。
example2_en: Governments should support the transfer of clean technology to regions that still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 政府应支持向仍高度依赖化石燃料的地区转移清洁技术。
collocations: transfer money｜转账 ; transfer data｜传输数据 ; transfer to another school｜转学 ; technology transfer｜技术转移
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；过去式transferred双写r。

meanings_zh: adj. 浪漫的；爱情的 | adj. 理想化的；不切实际的 | n. 浪漫的人；理想主义者
definition_en: connected with love or expressing loving feelings | seeing things as more beautiful or exciting than they really are | someone strongly influenced by love, imagination, or idealistic hopes
example1_en: They enjoyed a romantic dinner beside the quiet lake.
example1_zh: 他们在宁静的湖边享用了一顿浪漫的晚餐。
example2_en: Advertisements often present a romantic image of rural life while ignoring limited services and employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 广告常把乡村生活描绘得很美好，却忽视了服务和就业机会不足的问题。
collocations: romantic relationship｜恋爱关系 ; romantic dinner｜浪漫晚餐 ; romantic comedy｜爱情喜剧 ; a romantic view of｜对……的理想化看法
tip_zh: 除爱情义外，也可指把现实想得过于美好。

meanings_zh: n. 硬币 | v. 创造（新词或说法）
definition_en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money | to invent a new word or expression
example1_en: A silver coin rolled under the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 一枚银色硬币滚到了厨房桌子下面。
example2_en: As digital payments become more widespread, fewer consumers carry coins for everyday purchases such as bus fares.
example2_zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，随身携带硬币用于公交车费等日常支出的人越来越少。
collocations: a gold coin｜金币 ; toss a coin｜抛硬币 ; coin a term｜创造术语
tip_zh: coin作动词常指创造词语，如coin a term。

meanings_zh: adj. 燃烧的；很热的
definition_en: on fire; very hot
example1_en: The burning building sent smoke into the sky.
example1_zh: 燃烧的大楼冒出浓烟。
example2_en: She had a burning fever and stayed in bed.
example2_zh: 她发高烧，卧床休息。
tip_zh: burning 是形容词“燃烧的、滚烫的”。

meanings_zh: n. 技能；技巧；本领
definition_en: an ability to do something well, developed through practice
example1_en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
example1_zh: 烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。
example2_en: Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
example2_zh: 学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。
collocations: communication skills｜沟通技能 ; practical skills｜实用技能 ; develop a skill｜培养一项技能 ; skill in doing something｜做某事的技巧
tip_zh: 具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽慰的；放心的
definition_en: No longer worried because something unpleasant has ended or been avoided
example1_en: I felt relieved when I finally found my keys.
example1_zh: 终于找到钥匙时，我松了一口气。
example2_en: Residents were relieved to hear that the local hospital would remain open despite proposed budget cuts.
example2_zh: 尽管有人提议削减预算，居民听说当地医院仍将继续运营，都松了一口气。
collocations: feel relieved｜感到宽慰 ; relieved to hear｜听到后感到放心 ; visibly relieved｜明显松了一口气
tip_zh: 常用be relieved to do或be relieved that从句。

meanings_zh: phr v. 用完；耗尽
definition_en: to use all of something and have none left
example1_en: We ran out of milk, so I went to the shop.
example1_zh: 牛奶喝完了，所以我去商店。
example2_en: Time is running out for the exam.
example2_zh: 考试时间快用完了。
collocations: run out of｜用完
tip_zh: run out of + 名词 表示“用完某物”。

meanings_zh: adv. 以前；先前
definition_en: At a time before now or before another event.
example1_en: I had previously met our neighbour at the library.
example1_zh: 我先前在图书馆见过我们的邻居。
example2_en: Online courses now provide educational opportunities for people who previously had limited access to universities.
example2_zh: 在线课程如今为那些以前难以接受大学教育的人提供了学习机会。
collocations: previously unknown｜先前未知的 ; previously mentioned｜先前提到的 ; previously published｜此前发表的
tip_zh: previously意为先前；表示提前准备通常用in advance。

meanings_zh: v.&n. 搜索；寻找
definition_en: to look for something carefully
example1_en: I searched online for a cheap hotel.
example1_zh: 我在网上搜索便宜的酒店。
example2_en: The search for the missing cat continued all day.
example2_zh: 寻找失踪猫咪的行动持续了一整天。
collocations: search engine｜搜索引擎
tip_zh: search for 是“搜索寻找”；search engine 是搜索引擎。

meanings_zh: n. 笑话；玩笑 | v. 开玩笑
definition_en: Something said or done to make people laugh. | To say something funny or not seriously meant.
example1_en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
example1_zh: 我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。
example2_en: Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.
example2_zh: 教师有时会用笑话缓解焦虑，营造更轻松的课堂氛围。
collocations: tell a joke｜讲笑话 ; play a joke on someone｜捉弄某人 ; joke about something｜拿某事开玩笑
tip_zh: 讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。

meanings_zh: adj. 先前的；以前的
definition_en: happening or existing before the time or thing being discussed
example1_en: The previous tenant left some plants on the balcony.
example1_zh: 上一位租客在阳台上留下了几盆植物。
example2_en: Previous studies suggest that regular physical activity can improve concentration and academic performance among school children.
example2_zh: 先前的研究表明，经常运动能提高学龄儿童的专注力和学习成绩。
collocations: previous experience｜以往经验 ; previous studies｜先前研究 ; the previous year｜前一年
tip_zh: previous是形容词；表示“以前”用副词previously。

meanings_zh: n. 素食者 | adj. 素食的；不含肉鱼的
definition_en: A person who does not eat meat or fish. | Containing no meat or fish, or following this diet.
example1_en: My sister became a vegetarian after learning to cook.
example1_zh: 我姐姐学会做饭后成了一名素食者。
example2_en: Providing vegetarian meals in school canteens can accommodate different dietary preferences and reduce environmental impacts.
example2_zh: 学校食堂提供素食可以满足不同的饮食偏好，并减少对环境的影响。
collocations: vegetarian diet｜素食饮食 ; vegetarian option｜素食选项 ; become a vegetarian｜成为素食者
tip_zh: vegetarian不吃肉和鱼；vegan还不吃蛋奶等动物产品。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的；最重要的 | n. 校长；学院院长 | n. 本金
definition_en: most important among several things | the person in charge of a school or college | money borrowed or invested, excluding interest
example1_en: Our principal reason for moving was the noisy traffic.
example1_zh: 我们搬家的主要原因是交通噪声太大。
example2_en: The principal challenge facing urban planners is providing affordable housing without reducing access to green spaces.
example2_zh: 城市规划者面临的主要挑战是提供经济适用的住房，同时不减少居民享用绿地的机会。
collocations: the principal reason｜主要原因 ; a principal aim｜主要目标 ; a school principal｜校长 ; repay the principal｜偿还本金
tip_zh: principal指“主要的”或“校长”；principle指“原则”。

meanings_zh: n. 洗碗机 | n. 洗碗工
definition_en: a machine that washes dishes and kitchen utensils | a person employed to wash dishes
example1_en: Please load the dishwasher after you finish your lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭吃完后，请把餐具放进洗碗机。
example2_en: Running a dishwasher only when it is full can help households conserve water and energy.
example2_zh: 等洗碗机装满后再运行，有助于家庭节约水和能源。
collocations: load the dishwasher｜把餐具装进洗碗机 ; unload the dishwasher｜取出洗碗机里的餐具 ; dishwasher detergent｜洗碗机专用洗涤剂
tip_zh: 日常多指洗碗机；招聘语境中也可指洗碗工。

meanings_zh: v. 迎接；问候 | v. 映入眼帘；传入耳鼻
definition_en: to welcome someone or say hello | to become noticeable when someone arrives or looks
example1_en: Our neighbours greeted us warmly when we moved in.
example1_zh: 我们搬来时，邻居们热情地向我们打招呼。
example2_en: Visitors are greeted by trained volunteers who explain the museum's collection and help them find their way.
example2_zh: 受过培训的志愿者迎接参观者，介绍博物馆的藏品并为他们指路。
collocations: greet someone warmly｜热情地问候某人 ; greet someone with a smile｜微笑着迎接某人 ; be greeted by｜受到迎接；首先看到
tip_zh: greet直接接人；表示向某人问好不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 宣传册；资料手册
definition_en: A small booklet giving information about products, services, or places.
example1_en: I picked up a travel brochure at the station.
example1_zh: 我在车站拿了一本旅游宣传册。
example2_en: University brochures can help prospective students compare courses, accommodation options, and the facilities available on campus.
example2_zh: 大学宣传册可以帮助有意申请的学生比较课程、住宿选择及校园设施。
collocations: travel brochure｜旅游宣传册 ; university brochure｜大学招生手册 ; promotional brochure｜推广宣传册
tip_zh: 可数名词，常指介绍旅游、课程或产品的小册子。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全地；彻底地
definition_en: In every way or to the fullest possible degree.
example1_en: My shoes were completely wet after walking through the rain.
example1_zh: 在雨中走过之后，我的鞋全湿透了。
example2_en: Although online courses offer flexibility, they cannot completely replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
example2_zh: 虽然在线课程提供了灵活性，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。
collocations: completely different｜完全不同的 ; completely forget｜忘得一干二净 ; completely agree｜完全同意
tip_zh: 表示程度达到全部，常修饰形容词或动词。

meanings_zh: n. 袖子 | n. 保护套；套管
definition_en: The part of a garment that covers an arm. | A protective cover that fits closely around an object.
example1_en: I caught my sleeve on the kitchen door handle.
example1_zh: 我的袖子被厨房门把手勾住了。
example2_en: Workers should keep loose sleeves away from moving machinery to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.
example2_zh: 工人应让宽松的袖子远离运转中的机器，以降低工伤风险。
collocations: long sleeves｜长袖 ; roll up your sleeves｜卷起袖子 ; protective sleeve｜保护套
tip_zh: sleeve指衣服的袖子，不是手臂arm。

meanings_zh: n. 信号；暗号 | n. 电子信号 | v. 示意；表明
definition_en: A sound, movement, or light that communicates a message. | An electrical or radio wave carrying information. | Communicate through an action, or indicate that something is happening.
example1_en: The coach gave a signal, and we started running.
example1_zh: 教练发出信号后，我们开始跑步。
example2_en: Increasing investment in renewable energy may signal a government's commitment to reducing its dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 增加可再生能源投资，可能表明政府致力于减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: give a signal｜发出信号 ; a weak signal｜微弱的信号 ; signal a change｜预示变化
tip_zh: 过去式英式常写signalled，美式常写signaled。

meanings_zh: n. 硬纸板
definition_en: Thick, stiff paper used for boxes and packaging
example1_en: We cut the cardboard into shapes for a model house.
example1_zh: 我们把硬纸板剪成各种形状，用来制作房屋模型。
example2_en: Replacing plastic packaging with recycled cardboard can reduce waste and encourage more sustainable consumption.
example2_zh: 用再生硬纸板替代塑料包装可以减少废弃物，并促进更可持续的消费。
collocations: cardboard box｜纸板箱 ; recycled cardboard｜再生硬纸板 ; a sheet of cardboard｜一张硬纸板
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一张硬纸板说a sheet of cardboard。

meanings_zh: adj. 负责的；有责任的 | adj. 造成某事的；应担责的 | adj. 可靠的；有责任心的
definition_en: having a duty to manage or look after something | being the cause of something, especially something bad | sensible and trustworthy in your actions and decisions
example1_en: I'm responsible for feeding our cat every morning.
example1_zh: 我负责每天早晨喂我们家的猫。
example2_en: Governments are responsible for ensuring that all children have access to safe and affordable education.
example2_zh: 政府有责任确保所有儿童都能接受安全且负担得起的教育。
collocations: responsible for｜对……负责 ; responsible behaviour｜负责任的行为 ; hold someone responsible｜认定某人应担责
tip_zh: responsible for后接名词或动名词；to后接上级。

meanings_zh: adj. 电子的；电子设备的 | adj. 电子形式的；数字化的
definition_en: using circuits to control electrical signals | stored, sent, or accessed using computers
example1_en: Please switch off your electronic devices during the performance.
example1_zh: 演出期间请关闭电子设备。
example2_en: Electronic health records can help doctors share information efficiently, but strong safeguards are needed to protect patient privacy.
example2_zh: 电子健康档案能帮助医生高效共享信息，但必须采取有力措施保护患者隐私。
collocations: electronic devices｜电子设备 ; electronic records｜电子档案 ; electronic payment｜电子支付 ; electronic waste｜电子垃圾
tip_zh: electronic强调电子电路；electric泛指用电的。

meanings_zh: n. 结果；后果 | n. 成绩；比赛结果 | v. 导致；由……造成
definition_en: something that happens because of an action or event | the final score or outcome of a test or competition | to happen because of something or cause something to happen
example1_en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
example1_zh: 这光亮的地板是花了好几个小时打扫的成果。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport can result in lower emissions and shorter commuting times for urban residents.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通，可以减少排放并缩短城市居民的通勤时间。
collocations: as a result｜因此 ; result in｜导致 ; result from｜由……造成 ; exam results｜考试成绩
tip_zh: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

meanings_zh: n. 辅音；辅音字母 | adj. 一致的；相符的
definition_en: a speech sound involving blocked airflow, or its written symbol | agreeing with or matching something
example1_en: Try saying the final consonant slowly and clearly.
example1_zh: 试着把最后一个辅音发得缓慢而清晰。
example2_en: Learners may struggle to pronounce consonant clusters that do not occur in their first language.
example2_zh: 学习者可能难以发出母语中不存在的辅音群。
collocations: consonant sound｜辅音 ; consonant cluster｜辅音群 ; final consonant｜末尾辅音 ; consonant with｜与……一致
tip_zh: 作形容词较正式，常用consonant with表示相符。

meanings_zh: mv. 将会；愿意
definition_en: used to talk about the future
example1_en: I will call you tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我明天会给你打电话。
example2_en: Will you come to my party on Saturday?
example2_zh: 你周六会来参加我的聚会吗？
tip_zh: will + 动词原形表示将来；口语缩写 'll。

meanings_zh: n. 习惯；习性
definition_en: something you do regularly, often without thinking
example1_en: Checking my phone before breakfast has become a habit.
example1_zh: 早餐前查看手机已经成了我的习惯。
example2_en: Developing the habit of regular exercise during childhood can improve health throughout adult life.
example2_zh: 在童年时期养成规律锻炼的习惯，可以改善整个成年阶段的健康状况。
collocations: form a habit｜养成习惯 ; break a habit｜改掉习惯 ; out of habit｜出于习惯 ; get into the habit of｜养成……的习惯
tip_zh: 表示做某事的习惯，用habit of doing。

meanings_zh: adv. 大约；近似地
definition_en: Close to a particular amount, but not exactly.
example1_en: The walk to the lake takes approximately twenty minutes.
example1_zh: 步行到湖边大约需要二十分钟。
example2_en: Approximately half of the households surveyed reported using public transport at least once a week.
example2_zh: 受访家庭中，约有一半表示每周至少使用一次公共交通。
collocations: approximately equal｜大致相等 ; approximately half｜大约一半 ; approximately double｜大约两倍
tip_zh: 多放在数量前，语气比about更正式。

meanings_zh: v. 打钩；作滴答声 | n. 钩号；滴答声 | n. 蜱；壁虱
definition_en: To mark an item as correct, or make repeated clicking sounds. | A mark showing correctness, or a short sound a clock makes. | A small creature that attaches to skin and feeds on blood.
example1_en: The old clock ticks softly beside my bed.
example1_zh: 那只旧钟在我的床边轻轻地滴答作响。
example2_en: Participants should tick the appropriate boxes to indicate how frequently they use public transport.
example2_zh: 参与者应在相应方框内打钩，说明自己使用公共交通的频率。
collocations: tick a box｜在方框内打钩 ; tick off｜打钩标记 ; a tick bite｜蜱虫叮咬 ; a clock ticks｜钟表滴答作响
tip_zh: “打钩”英式常用tick，美式常用check。

meanings_zh: n. 句号（英式）
definition_en: the dot at the end of a sentence (British English)
example1_en: Write a full stop at the end of each sentence.
example1_zh: 每个句子结尾要写句号。
example2_en: In the US, a full stop is called a period.
example2_zh: 在美国，句号叫 period。
tip_zh: full stop 是英式说法；美式说 period。

meanings_zh: n. 警告；提醒 | n. 预兆；警示信号
definition_en: Something said or done to alert someone to danger or problems. | A sign that something harmful or unpleasant may happen.
example1_en: We turned back after the guide's warning about slippery rocks.
example1_zh: 听到向导提醒岩石湿滑后，我们折返了。
example2_en: Effective flood warning systems allow residents to leave dangerous areas before roads become impossible to use.
example2_zh: 有效的洪水预警系统能让居民在道路无法通行前撤离危险区域。
collocations: issue a warning｜发出警告 ; early warning system｜预警系统 ; without warning｜毫无预警地 ; heed a warning｜听从警告
tip_zh: warning是名词，也可作warn的现在分词。

meanings_zh: n. 售票处
definition_en: a place where you buy tickets
example1_en: We bought our train tickets at the booking office.
example1_zh: 我们在售票处买了火车票。
example2_en: The booking office opens at nine in the morning.
example2_zh: 售票处早上九点开门。
tip_zh: booking office 即售票处，常见于火车站、剧院。

meanings_zh: n. 旅行社职员；旅行代理人
definition_en: a person who helps you book holidays
example1_en: The travel agent booked our flights and hotel.
example1_zh: 旅行社职员帮我们订了机票和酒店。
example2_en: Ask the travel agent about cheap packages.
example2_zh: 问问旅行社职员有哪些便宜套餐。
tip_zh: travel agent 是旅行代理；travel agency 是旅行社。

meanings_zh: n. 产品；制品 | n. 产物；结果 | n. 乘积
definition_en: something made or grown to be sold or used | something that results from a process or situation | the result of multiplying two or more quantities
example1_en: This cleaning product removes stains from my kitchen tiles.
example1_zh: 这款清洁产品能去除我家厨房瓷砖上的污渍。
example2_en: Consumers increasingly prefer products that use less packaging and can be repaired rather than replaced.
example2_zh: 消费者越来越偏好包装更少、能够维修而不必更换的产品。
collocations: launch a product｜推出产品 ; dairy products｜乳制品 ; product development｜产品开发 ; the product of｜……的产物
tip_zh: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。

meanings_zh: n. 尝试；努力 | v. 尝试；试图
definition_en: An effort to do something, especially something difficult. | To try to do something, especially something difficult.
example1_en: My first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
example1_zh: 我第一次尝试烤面包，结果出乎意料地成功。
example2_en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.
example2_zh: 许多城市正通过改善公共交通和扩展自行车道网络来尝试减少空气污染。
collocations: make an attempt｜作出尝试 ; attempt to do something｜尝试做某事 ; a successful attempt｜成功的尝试 ; in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip_zh: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

meanings_zh: n. 递送；交付 | n. 分娩 | n. 演讲方式；表达方式
definition_en: the act of taking goods or messages to someone | the process of giving birth to a baby | the way someone speaks or performs in public
example1_en: Our grocery delivery arrived just before we started cooking.
example1_zh: 我们订购的食品杂货在开始做饭前刚好送到了。
example2_en: The growing demand for home delivery has increased traffic congestion in many urban neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 不断增长的送货上门需求加剧了许多城市社区的交通拥堵。
collocations: free delivery｜免费配送 ; delivery service｜配送服务 ; delivery driver｜送货司机 ; a smooth delivery｜顺利分娩
tip_zh: delivery指递送服务或过程；deliver是动词。

meanings_zh: adv. 就个人而言 | adv. 亲自；本人 | adv. 针对个人地
definition_en: used to introduce your own opinion or preference | by a particular person rather than someone acting for them | as relating to someone's character rather than their actions
example1_en: Personally, I prefer walking to taking the bus.
example1_zh: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢步行而不是乘公交车。
example2_en: Personally, I believe that public libraries remain essential because they provide free access to reliable information.
example2_zh: 我个人认为，公共图书馆仍不可或缺，因为它们让人们免费获取可靠信息。
collocations: personally speaking｜就个人而言 ; take something personally｜认为某事针对自己 ; personally responsible｜负有个人责任 ; know someone personally｜与某人本人相识
tip_zh: take it personally指把事情看作针对自己。

meanings_zh: n. 喉咙；咽喉
definition_en: the passage inside the neck through which air and food pass
example1_en: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
example1_zh: 说了一下午话后，我觉得喉咙很干。
example2_en: Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.
example2_zh: 空气质量差会刺激咽喉并加重呼吸问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受到影响。
collocations: a sore throat｜喉咙痛 ; clear your throat｜清嗓子 ; throat infection｜咽喉感染
tip_zh: 喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。

meanings_zh: adj. 自信的 | adj. 确信的；有把握的
definition_en: believing in your own ability to succeed | certain that something is true or will happen
example1_en: After weeks of practice, I felt confident on stage.
example1_zh: 经过几周练习，我站在台上时感到很自信。
example2_en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
example2_zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和练习新技能的机会时，学生会变得更自信。
collocations: feel confident｜感到自信 ; confident about the future｜对未来有信心 ; confident that｜确信
tip_zh: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 剧集的一集 | n. 一段经历；事件 | n. 疾病的一次发作
definition_en: one part of a television or radio series | a particular event or period within a longer story | a period when someone experiences a particular illness or symptom
example1_en: We watched the final episode together after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们一起看了最后一集。
example2_en: Each episode of the documentary explores how urban development affects wildlife in different parts of the world.
example2_zh: 这部纪录片每一集都探讨城市发展如何影响世界不同地区的野生动物。
collocations: the final episode｜最后一集 ; an episode of｜……的一集 ; a pilot episode｜试播集 ; a brief episode｜一段短暂经历
tip_zh: episode指一集；series指整部系列或连续剧。

meanings_zh: phr v. 去取；尝试；选择
definition_en: to choose or try something
example1_en: I'll go for the salad, please.
example1_zh: 我要沙拉。
example2_en: She decided to go for the job interview.
example2_zh: 她决定去参加求职面试。
tip_zh: go for 表示“选择、尝试”，也表“去拿”。

meanings_zh: n. 刹车；制动器 | v. 刹车；制动
definition_en: a device that slows or stops a moving vehicle | to slow or stop a vehicle using its brakes
example1_en: I squeezed the brakes as my bicycle reached the corner.
example1_zh: 自行车骑到拐角时，我捏紧了刹车。
example2_en: Drivers should brake gently on wet roads to reduce the risk of losing control.
example2_zh: 驾驶员在湿滑路面上应轻踩刹车，以降低车辆失控的风险。
collocations: apply the brakes｜踩刹车 ; brake sharply｜急刹车 ; brake pedal｜刹车踏板 ; emergency brake｜紧急制动器
tip_zh: brake指刹车；同音词break指打破或休息。

meanings_zh: n. 框；框架；骨架 | v. 给……装框 | v. 组织表达；构思
definition_en: a structure that surrounds or supports something | to put a picture or similar object inside a frame | to express or present something in a particular way
example1_en: We chose a wooden frame for our family photograph.
example1_zh: 我们为全家福选了一个木制相框。
example2_en: The way journalists frame environmental issues can influence public attitudes towards conservation and government policy.
example2_zh: 记者呈现环境议题的方式会影响公众对环境保护和政府政策的态度。
collocations: a picture frame｜相框 ; a bicycle frame｜自行车车架 ; frame a question｜组织问题的措辞 ; a frame of reference｜参照体系
tip_zh: frame既可指实体框架，也可指组织表达的方式。

meanings_zh: n. 加热器；取暖器
definition_en: a device that heats air, water, or another substance
example1_en: We switched on the heater before the guests arrived.
example1_zh: 客人到来前，我们打开了取暖器。
example2_en: Replacing an inefficient water heater can lower household energy bills and reduce overall electricity consumption.
example2_zh: 更换效率低下的热水器能降低家庭能源账单，并减少总体用电量。
collocations: electric heater｜电暖器 ; water heater｜热水器 ; portable heater｜便携式取暖器
tip_zh: heater是设备；heating指供暖或供暖系统。

meanings_zh: n. 律师
definition_en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.
example1_en: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
example1_zh: 我们的律师在我们签字前解释了合同内容。
example2_en: Access to an affordable lawyer helps ensure that everyone can defend their legal rights.
example2_zh: 能以可负担的费用聘请律师，有助于确保每个人都能维护自己的合法权利。
collocations: hire a lawyer｜聘请律师 ; criminal lawyer｜刑事律师 ; consult a lawyer｜咨询律师
tip_zh: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。

meanings_zh: n. 风景；景色 | n. 舞台布景
definition_en: The natural features of a place considered for their beauty. | Painted backgrounds and structures that create a play's setting.
example1_en: We stopped by the lake to admire the scenery.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边停下来欣赏风景。
example2_en: Protecting natural scenery can attract responsible tourism while preserving valuable habitats for local wildlife.
example2_zh: 保护自然风景可以吸引负责任的旅游活动，同时为当地野生动物保留宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: beautiful scenery｜美丽的风景 ; mountain scenery｜山间景色 ; spectacular scenery｜壮丽的景色 ; stage scenery｜舞台布景
tip_zh: scenery是不可数名词，不说a scenery或sceneries。

meanings_zh: n. 一件物品；一件商品 | n. 项目；条目；一则消息
definition_en: A single object, especially one in a collection. | One part of a list, programme, or news report.
example1_en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
example1_zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。
example2_en: Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
example2_zh: 会议议程中的每一项都涉及当地公共交通服务面临的不同挑战。
collocations: household item｜家居用品 ; luxury item｜奢侈品 ; agenda item｜议程项目 ; news item｜一则新闻
tip_zh: item是可数名词；一件衣物可说an item of clothing。

meanings_zh: n. 肘；肘部 | v. 用肘推挤
definition_en: the joint where your arm bends | to push someone or something with your elbow
example1_en: I knocked my elbow against the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 我的胳膊肘撞到了厨房门上。
example2_en: Passengers sometimes elbow their way onto crowded trains, making public transport uncomfortable for others.
example2_zh: 乘客有时用肘推挤着登上拥挤的列车，让其他人乘车时感到不适。
collocations: bend your elbow｜弯曲手肘 ; rest your elbows on｜将双肘搁在……上 ; elbow your way through｜用肘推挤着穿过
tip_zh: elbow作动词时常指用肘推挤着前进。

meanings_zh: adj. 位于…的 | adj. 处于某种境况的
definition_en: located in a particular place | in a particular set of circumstances
example1_en: Our hotel is situated beside a quiet mountain lake.
example1_zh: 我们的酒店坐落在一处宁静的高山湖泊旁。
example2_en: Schools situated near busy roads may need additional measures to protect pupils from air pollution.
example2_zh: 位于繁忙道路附近的学校可能需要采取额外措施，保护学生免受空气污染的影响。
collocations: conveniently situated｜位置便利的 ; centrally situated｜位于中心的 ; situated near｜位于…附近
tip_zh: 常用be situated in/near，描述位置，较正式。

meanings_zh: conj. 虽然；尽管 | adv. 不过；然而
definition_en: Despite the fact that something is true. | Used to introduce a contrasting point, often at sentence end.
example1_en: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
example1_zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是步行去了面包店。
example2_en: Though online courses offer greater flexibility, many students still benefit from direct interaction with teachers.
example2_zh: 虽然线上课程更加灵活，但许多学生仍能从与教师的直接交流中获益。
collocations: even though｜即使；尽管 ; as though｜仿佛；好像
tip_zh: 引导让步从句时不与but连用；句末可表“不过”。

meanings_zh: adj. 面对面的；当面的 | adv. 面对面地；当面地
definition_en: Involving people physically present together and looking at each other. | With people physically present together rather than communicating remotely.
example1_en: We arranged a face-to-face meeting at the local café.
example1_zh: 我们安排在附近的咖啡馆当面会谈。
example2_en: Face-to-face communication can strengthen relationships between teachers and students by allowing immediate feedback and clearer emotional expression.
example2_zh: 面对面交流能提供即时反馈并更清晰地表达情感，从而增进师生关系。
collocations: a face-to-face meeting｜面对面会议 ; face-to-face communication｜面对面交流 ; a face-to-face interview｜当面访谈
tip_zh: 名词前通常加连字符；作状语时常写face to face。

meanings_zh: conj. 是否
definition_en: if; used to express a choice
example1_en: I don't know whether she will come.
example1_zh: 我不知道她是否会来。
example2_en: Ask whether the shop is open on Sundays.
example2_zh: 问问商店周日是否开门。
tip_zh: whether 与 if 都可表“是否”；whether 后可直接接 or not。

meanings_zh: n. 面粉；谷物粉 | v. 撒面粉于
definition_en: powder made by grinding grain, used especially in baking | to cover a surface or food lightly with flour
example1_en: Add the flour slowly and stir until smooth.
example1_zh: 慢慢加入面粉，搅拌至顺滑。
example2_en: Replacing some refined flour with wholemeal flour can increase the fibre content of everyday foods.
example2_zh: 用全麦面粉替代部分精制面粉，可以提高日常食品中的膳食纤维含量。
collocations: plain flour｜普通面粉 ; wholemeal flour｜全麦面粉 ; rice flour｜米粉 ; flour a surface｜在台面上撒面粉
tip_zh: flour通常不可数，且与flower同音。

meanings_zh: n. 停车；泊车 | n. 停车空间；停车设施
definition_en: The act of leaving a vehicle in a particular place. | Space or facilities where vehicles can be left.
example1_en: Parking is difficult on this narrow street after sunset.
example1_zh: 日落后，在这条狭窄的街道上停车很困难。
example2_en: Reducing free parking in city centres may encourage commuters to use public transport more frequently.
example2_zh: 减少市中心的免费停车位可能促使通勤者更频繁地使用公共交通。
collocations: a parking space｜停车位 ; parking restrictions｜停车限制 ; free parking｜免费停车 ; underground parking｜地下停车设施
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；一个停车位说a parking space。

meanings_zh: v. 替换；取代；更换 | v. 把……放回原处
definition_en: To take something's place or put something else in its place. | To put something back where it was before.
example1_en: We need to replace the broken kitchen chair.
example1_zh: 我们需要换掉厨房里那把坏椅子。
example2_en: Renewable energy could gradually replace fossil fuels if governments invest sufficiently in infrastructure and storage technology.
example2_zh: 如果政府充分投资基础设施和储能技术，可再生能源就可能逐步取代化石燃料。
collocations: replace A with B｜用B替换A ; replace a battery｜更换电池 ; be replaced by｜被……取代
tip_zh: replace A with B是用B换掉A，别弄反方向。

meanings_zh: n. 表演者；演出者 | n. 表现出某种水平的人或事物
definition_en: someone who entertains an audience by acting, singing, or playing | a person or thing achieving a particular level of success
example1_en: A street performer juggled oranges beside the crowded market.
example1_zh: 一名街头艺人在拥挤的市场旁抛接橙子。
example2_en: Public funding can help young performers develop their skills and bring live entertainment to underserved communities.
example2_zh: 公共资金可以帮助年轻表演者提升技能，并将现场演出带到文化服务不足的社区。
collocations: a street performer｜街头艺人 ; a live performer｜现场表演者 ; a top performer｜表现优异者
tip_zh: 不仅指演员；top performer也可指业绩优异的员工。

meanings_zh: n. 院子；庭院 | n. 码（长度单位）
definition_en: An outdoor area beside a building, often enclosed. | A unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 metres.
example1_en: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
example1_zh: 我们的狗追着一个黄色的球跑过院子。
example2_en: Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.
example2_zh: 把闲置的校园庭院改成花园，可以为城市儿童提供宝贵的户外学习机会。
collocations: back yard｜后院 ; school yard｜校园庭院 ; a yard of fabric｜一码布料
tip_zh: 美式yard可指住宅草坪庭院；英式多用garden。

meanings_zh: n. 陆地；土地 | v. 着陆；降落；使着陆 | v. 成功获得
definition_en: Earth's solid surface, or an area used for a particular purpose. | To reach the ground, or bring an aircraft to the ground. | To succeed in getting something desirable, especially a job.
example1_en: After hours at sea, we finally spotted dry land.
example1_zh: 在海上航行数小时后，我们终于看到了陆地。
example2_en: Protecting agricultural land from urban expansion is essential for maintaining food production near growing cities.
example2_zh: 保护农业用地免受城市扩张侵占，对维持发展中城市周边的粮食生产至关重要。
collocations: agricultural land｜农业用地 ; by land｜经陆路 ; land safely｜安全着陆 ; land a job｜成功找到工作
tip_zh: 表示土地通常不可数；land a job指成功获得工作。

meanings_zh: adj. 焦虑的；担忧的 | adj. 渴望的；急切的
definition_en: Worried or nervous about something uncertain. | Very eager to do something or for something to happen.
example1_en: I felt anxious while waiting for my exam results.
example1_zh: 等待考试成绩时，我感到很焦虑。
example2_en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
example2_zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。
collocations: anxious about｜对……感到焦虑 ; anxious to please｜急于讨好 ; feel anxious｜感到焦虑
tip_zh: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

meanings_zh: v. 发光；照耀 | v. 擦亮 | n. 光泽；光亮
definition_en: To give out or reflect light. | To polish something until its surface becomes bright and smooth. | Brightness on a smooth surface that reflects light.
example1_en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，阳光透过我卧室的窗户照了进来。
example2_en: Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 直接照进住宅的路灯会干扰睡眠，降低居民的生活质量。
collocations: shine brightly｜明亮地照耀 ; shine a light on｜用灯照向 ; shine your shoes｜擦亮鞋子 ; a healthy shine｜健康的光泽
tip_zh: 发光的过去式常用shone；擦亮的过去式用shined。

meanings_zh: n. 震惊；意外打击 | v. 使震惊 | n. 休克；电击
definition_en: a strong feeling of surprise caused by something unexpected | to make someone feel very surprised or upset | a dangerous medical collapse, or an electrical jolt through the body
example1_en: The sudden rise in rent came as a shock.
example1_zh: 租金突然上涨，让人十分震惊。
example2_en: Moving abroad can cause culture shock, particularly when everyday customs differ greatly from those at home.
example2_zh: 移居国外可能带来文化冲击，尤其是当日常习俗与本国差异很大时。
collocations: come as a shock｜令人震惊 ; culture shock｜文化冲击 ; electric shock｜电击 ; in a state of shock｜处于震惊状态
tip_zh: 人感到震惊用shocked；事物令人震惊用shocking。

meanings_zh: adj. 可能的
definition_en: probable; expected to happen
example1_en: It is likely to rain this afternoon.
example1_zh: 今天下午很可能下雨。
example2_en: She is likely to win the race.
example2_zh: 她很可能会赢得比赛。
collocations: be likely to do｜可能做
tip_zh: be likely to do 表示“很可能…”；反义 unlikely。

meanings_zh: n. 服务器；服务员
definition_en: a computer that stores data, or a waiter
example1_en: The website is on a server in another country.
example1_zh: 这个网站在另一个国家的服务器上。
example2_en: The server brought our drinks quickly.
example2_zh: 服务员很快送来了我们的饮料。
tip_zh: server 指电脑“服务器”，美式也指餐厅“服务员”。

meanings_zh: adj. 黏的；有黏性的 | adj. 湿热的；闷热的 | adj. 棘手的；难处理的
definition_en: able to stick to things, often because of a substance | uncomfortably warm and damp | difficult or awkward to deal with
example1_en: My fingers were sticky after eating the honey cake.
example1_zh: 吃完蜂蜜蛋糕后，我的手指黏糊糊的。
example2_en: Food packaging often contains sticky residues that must be removed before the materials can be recycled effectively.
example2_zh: 食品包装上常有黏性残留物，必须先清除才能有效回收材料。
collocations: sticky tape｜胶带 ; sticky fingers｜黏糊糊的手指 ; a sticky situation｜棘手的局面 ; hot and sticky｜湿热的
tip_zh: sticky weather指湿热天气；sticky situation指困境。

meanings_zh: n. 蜜月；蜜月旅行 | n. 初期的短暂和谐 | v. 度蜜月
definition_en: A holiday taken by a couple just after their wedding. | An early period when a relationship or situation goes well. | To take a holiday together just after getting married.
example1_en: They spent their honeymoon in a quiet seaside village.
example1_zh: 他们在一个安静的海边村庄度过了蜜月。
example2_en: Popular honeymoon destinations can support local economies, but excessive tourism may damage fragile coastal environments.
example2_zh: 热门蜜月目的地能促进当地经济，但过度旅游可能破坏脆弱的沿海环境。
collocations: on honeymoon｜在度蜜月 ; honeymoon destination｜蜜月目的地 ; honeymoon period｜蜜月期
tip_zh: 英式常说on honeymoon，美式常说on a honeymoon。

meanings_zh: n. 间谍；密探 | v. 从事间谍活动；暗中监视 | v. 突然发现；瞥见
definition_en: Someone who secretly gathers information about a country or organisation | To secretly watch someone or gather information about them | To notice someone or something, especially after looking carefully
example1_en: I spied a tiny kitten hiding behind the flowerpot.
example1_zh: 我瞥见一只小猫躲在花盆后面。
example2_en: Many users worry that connected devices could spy on their activities without permission.
example2_zh: 许多用户担心联网设备可能未经允许就暗中监视他们的活动。
collocations: spy on someone｜暗中监视某人 ; spy novel｜间谍小说 ; spy network｜间谍网
tip_zh: 监视某人用spy on；过去式和过去分词为spied。

meanings_zh: n. 冷冻柜；冷冻室
definition_en: an appliance or compartment that keeps food frozen
example1_en: Put the ice cream back in the freezer.
example1_zh: 把冰激凌放回冷冻室。
example2_en: Using a freezer allows households to store seasonal produce longer and reduce food waste.
example2_zh: 使用冷冻柜能让家庭更长时间地储存时令农产品，减少食物浪费。
collocations: chest freezer｜卧式冷冻柜 ; freezer compartment｜冷冻室 ; defrost the freezer｜给冷冻柜除霜
tip_zh: freezer用于冷冻；fridge主要用于冷藏。

meanings_zh: n. 论说文；短文；随笔
definition_en: A short piece of writing exploring a particular subject.
example1_en: I finished my history essay just before dinner.
example1_zh: 我刚好在晚饭前写完了历史课论文。
example2_en: Writing an essay encourages students to organise their ideas and support arguments with relevant evidence.
example2_zh: 撰写论说文能促使学生整理思路，并用相关证据支持论点。
collocations: write an essay｜写一篇短文 ; essay question｜论述题 ; an essay on｜一篇关于……的文章
tip_zh: 可数名词；一篇关于某主题的文章用an essay on。

meanings_zh: v. 翻译 | v. 转化；转变为
definition_en: To express words or writing in another language | To change something into a different form or practical result
example1_en: Could you translate this recipe into English for me?
example1_zh: 你能帮我把这份食谱翻译成英语吗？
example2_en: Governments must translate environmental commitments into practical policies that encourage businesses to reduce emissions.
example2_zh: 政府必须把环保承诺转化为切实的政策，鼓励企业减少排放。
collocations: translate into English｜翻译成英语 ; translate from Chinese｜从中文翻译 ; translate ideas into action｜将想法付诸行动
tip_zh: 从某语言译成另一语言：translate from…into…。

meanings_zh: n. 小木屋；简易小屋 | n. 船舱；机舱
definition_en: A small, simple house, often built from wood. | A room on a ship or passenger space in an aircraft.
example1_en: We spent the weekend in a cabin beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边的一间小木屋里度过了周末。
example2_en: Holiday cabins in protected forests should be carefully managed to limit their impact on local wildlife.
example2_zh: 保护林区内的度假小屋应得到妥善管理，以限制其对当地野生动物的影响。
collocations: a log cabin｜原木小屋 ; cabin crew｜客舱乘务员 ; a passenger cabin｜客舱 ; cabin baggage｜随身行李
tip_zh: 既指陆地上的小屋，也指船舱或飞机客舱。

meanings_zh: n. 小孩；孩子 | v. 开玩笑；戏弄 | n. 小山羊
definition_en: A child or young person, in informal language. | Say something playfully that is not meant to be believed. | A young goat.
example1_en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
example1_zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。
example2_en: Outdoor activities can help kids develop social skills while improving their physical health.
example2_zh: 户外活动可以帮助孩子们发展社交技能，同时改善身体健康。
collocations: young kids｜年幼的孩子 ; just kidding｜只是开玩笑 ; kid around｜闹着玩
tip_zh: kid较口语；正式作文中“孩子”宜用child。

meanings_zh: n. 努力；精力 | n. 尝试；有组织的行动
definition_en: physical or mental energy used to achieve something | an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal
example1_en: It took considerable effort to push the sofa upstairs.
example1_zh: 把沙发推上楼费了好大力气。
example2_en: Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.
example2_zh: 减少家庭垃圾需要消费者、制造商和地方政府共同努力，改变日常做法。
collocations: make an effort｜作出努力 ; put effort into｜投入精力于 ; a joint effort｜共同努力 ; considerable effort｜相当大的努力
tip_zh: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 设法做到 | v. 管理；经营 | v. 应付；支撑下去
definition_en: To succeed in doing something, especially something difficult. | To direct or control a business, team, or activity. | To cope with a situation despite difficulties or limited resources.
example1_en: I managed to carry all the bags upstairs.
example1_zh: 我总算把所有袋子都提上了楼。
example2_en: Many students manage to balance academic demands with paid employment by planning their weekly schedules carefully.
example2_zh: 许多学生通过仔细安排每周日程，设法兼顾学业要求与有薪工作。
collocations: manage to do something｜设法做成某事 ; manage a team｜管理团队 ; manage your time｜管理时间 ; manage without help｜独自应付
tip_zh: manage to do表示成功做成，不只是尝试。

meanings_zh: v. 晒太阳；日光浴
definition_en: to sit or lie in the sun to get a tan
example1_en: They sunbathe on the beach every afternoon.
example1_zh: 他们每天下午在海滩上晒太阳。
example2_en: Remember to use sun cream when you sunbathe.
example2_zh: 晒太阳时要涂防晒霜。
tip_zh: sunbathe 是动词“做日光浴”；sunbathing 是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 商品；货物 | n. 个人财物
definition_en: Things produced for sale or transported for trade. | Movable possessions belonging to a person.
example1_en: The shop sells handmade goods from nearby villages.
example1_zh: 这家店出售附近村庄制作的手工商品。
example2_en: Transporting goods by rail rather than road can lower emissions and reduce congestion in urban areas.
example2_zh: 采用铁路而非公路运输货物可以降低排放，缓解城市拥堵。
collocations: consumer goods｜消费品 ; luxury goods｜奢侈品 ; household goods｜家用物品 ; transport goods｜运输货物
tip_zh: goods是复数名词；一件商品可说an item。

meanings_zh: v. 浪费 | n. 废物；垃圾 | n. 浪费
definition_en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results. | Unwanted material left after something has been used or made. | An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.
example1_en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
example1_zh: 别让水龙头一直开着，白白浪费水。
example2_en: Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
example2_zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。
collocations: waste time｜浪费时间 ; a waste of money｜浪费金钱 ; household waste｜生活垃圾 ; food waste｜食物浪费
tip_zh: 用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 总统 | n. 主席；总裁；大学校长
definition_en: the head of state in a country without a monarch | the person leading an organisation, company, club, or university
example1_en: The president waved to the crowd outside the palace.
example1_zh: 总统向宫殿外的人群挥手致意。
example2_en: The newly elected president promised to improve public healthcare and expand access to affordable education.
example2_zh: 新当选的总统承诺改善公共医疗，并扩大可负担教育的覆盖范围。
collocations: elect a president｜选举总统 ; presidential election｜总统选举 ; university president｜大学校长 ; vice president｜副总统；副总裁
tip_zh: 可指总统，也可指机构负责人；具体译法看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 理发师（主要为男士）
definition_en: Someone who cuts men's hair and trims or shaves beards.
example1_en: The barber trimmed my hair before the wedding.
example1_zh: 婚礼前，理发师给我修剪了头发。
example2_en: Local businesses, such as a neighbourhood barber, provide essential services and create opportunities for informal social interaction.
example2_zh: 社区理发师等本地商家提供基本服务，也为非正式社交创造机会。
collocations: go to the barber's｜去理发店 ; a barber shop｜男士理发店 ; a barber's chair｜理发椅
tip_zh: barber主要为男士理发修面；barber's可指理发店。

meanings_zh: adj. 睡着的
definition_en: Sleeping rather than awake.
example1_en: The baby was asleep before we reached home.
example1_zh: 我们还没到家，宝宝就睡着了。
example2_en: People who use electronic devices late at night may find it harder to fall asleep.
example2_zh: 深夜使用电子设备的人可能更难入睡。
collocations: fall asleep｜入睡 ; fast asleep｜熟睡的 ; stay asleep｜保持睡眠状态
tip_zh: asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。

meanings_zh: n. 记者
definition_en: Someone who gathers and presents news for the public.
example1_en: A reporter interviewed the coach after the match.
example1_zh: 比赛结束后，一名记者采访了教练。
example2_en: A responsible reporter checks information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion on important social issues.
example2_zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众对重要社会问题看法的报道之前，会仔细核实信息。
collocations: news reporter｜新闻记者 ; television reporter｜电视记者 ; sports reporter｜体育记者
tip_zh: reporter侧重新闻采访报道；journalist涵盖范围更广。

meanings_zh: adj. 震惊的；惊愕的 | adj. 愤慨的；十分反感的
definition_en: Very surprised and upset by something unexpected. | Feeling strong disapproval at something offensive or wrong.
example1_en: I was shocked to find water flooding the kitchen.
example1_zh: 发现厨房里到处是水，我惊呆了。
example2_en: Residents were shocked by the sudden closure of the only hospital serving their rural community.
example2_zh: 当地居民对唯一服务于他们乡村社区的医院突然关闭感到震惊。
collocations: deeply shocked｜深感震惊的 ; shocked by the news｜被消息震惊 ; shocked to hear｜听到后震惊
tip_zh: shocked形容人的感受；shocking形容令人震惊的事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 筋疲力尽的 | adj. 耗尽的；枯竭的
definition_en: extremely tired and lacking energy | completely used up, with nothing remaining
example1_en: After carrying those boxes upstairs, I felt completely exhausted.
example1_zh: 把那些箱子搬上楼后，我感到筋疲力尽。
example2_en: Employees who are constantly exhausted may struggle to concentrate, increasing the risk of mistakes at work.
example2_zh: 长期疲惫不堪的员工可能难以集中注意力，从而增加工作中出错的风险。
collocations: feel exhausted｜感到筋疲力尽 ; physically exhausted｜身体疲惫不堪 ; mentally exhausted｜心力交瘁 ; exhausted resources｜耗尽的资源
tip_zh: 人感到累用exhausted；事情令人累用exhausting。

meanings_zh: n. 气味；嗅觉 | v. 闻到；嗅 | v. 有……气味
definition_en: a quality sensed through the nose, or that sensing ability | notice or examine something using your nose | have or give off a particular scent
example1_en: The smell of fresh bread filled our kitchen.
example1_zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫在我们的厨房里。
example2_en: A reduced sense of smell can affect appetite and make it harder to detect spoiled food.
example2_zh: 嗅觉减退会影响食欲，也会让人更难察觉变质的食物。
collocations: sense of smell｜嗅觉 ; strong smell｜浓烈的气味 ; smell fresh｜闻起来新鲜 ; smell of smoke｜有烟味
tip_zh: smell作系动词后接形容词，如smell good。

meanings_zh: n. 教学；教师职业 | n. 教义；学说
definition_en: The work of helping people learn knowledge or skills. | Ideas or principles taught by a person or tradition.
example1_en: Her love of teaching began at a small village school.
example1_zh: 她对教学的热爱始于一所小乡村学校。
example2_en: Effective teaching should combine clear explanations with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge independently.
example2_zh: 有效的教学应将清晰的讲解与实践活动结合起来，鼓励学生独立运用知识。
collocations: teaching methods｜教学方法 ; teaching materials｜教学材料 ; teaching experience｜教学经验 ; a career in teaching｜教师职业生涯
tip_zh: 指教学时不可数；指教义或学说常用teachings。

meanings_zh: phr v. 结账离开；查看
definition_en: to pay and leave a hotel, or to look at something
example1_en: We checked out of the hotel at noon.
example1_zh: 我们中午退了房。
example2_en: Check out this cool new phone!
example2_zh: 看看这部酷炫的新手机！
tip_zh: check out 指“退房结账”，口语也指“看看”。

meanings_zh: v. 爆炸；使爆炸 | v. 激增；迅速扩大 | v. 突然爆发情绪
definition_en: To burst violently, or cause something to burst violently. | To increase extremely quickly in size, amount, or popularity. | To express strong feelings suddenly and forcefully.
example1_en: We watched colourful fireworks explode above the lake.
example1_zh: 我们看着五彩烟花在湖面上空绽放。
example2_en: Demand for online courses has exploded as more adults seek flexible opportunities to develop new skills.
example2_zh: 随着更多成年人寻求灵活的机会来培养新技能，在线课程的需求激增。
collocations: explode into flames｜突然起火 ; explode with anger｜勃然大怒 ; demand explodes｜需求激增 ; a firework explodes｜烟花炸开
tip_zh: 爆炸物作主语常用主动形式，不必用被动。

meanings_zh: phr. 多少（钱/不可数）；多少钱
definition_en: used to ask about price or amount
example1_en: How much is this T-shirt?
example1_zh: 这件T恤多少钱？
example2_en: How much water do you drink a day?
example2_zh: 你每天喝多少水？
tip_zh: how much 问价格或不可数名词的数量；how many 问可数。

meanings_zh: v. 发展；成长；培养 | v. 开发；研制 | v. 逐渐出现；患上
definition_en: to grow or make something stronger, larger, or more advanced | to create a new product, method, or idea | to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling
example1_en: Children develop confidence when they try new activities.
example1_zh: 孩子们尝试新活动时会逐渐建立自信。
example2_en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
example2_zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。
collocations: develop skills｜培养技能 ; develop a habit｜养成习惯 ; develop new technology｜开发新技术 ; develop symptoms｜出现症状
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

meanings_zh: n. 慢跑
definition_en: Running slowly and steadily as a form of exercise.
example1_en: She goes jogging around the park before breakfast.
example1_zh: 她早饭前会绕着公园慢跑。
example2_en: Regular jogging can improve physical fitness, especially when combined with a balanced diet and adequate rest.
example2_zh: 经常慢跑可以改善体能，尤其是在配合均衡饮食和充足休息的情况下。
collocations: go jogging｜去慢跑 ; jogging shoes｜慢跑鞋 ; jogging route｜慢跑路线
tip_zh: jog变为jogging时须双写g。

meanings_zh: phr. 出差
definition_en: working, not on holiday
example1_en: He travels to Shanghai on business every month.
example1_zh: 他每月出差去上海。
example2_en: I'm here on business, not for a holiday.
example2_zh: 我来这里是出差，不是度假。
tip_zh: on business 表示“出差”；on holiday 是“度假”。

meanings_zh: adj. 严格的；严厉的 | adj. 严谨的；严格限定的
definition_en: requiring rules to be obeyed and standards to be met | following an exact meaning or limit without exceptions
example1_en: Our coach is strict about arriving on time.
example1_zh: 我们的教练对准时到场要求很严格。
example2_en: Strict environmental regulations can encourage manufacturers to adopt cleaner technologies and reduce harmful industrial emissions.
example2_zh: 严格的环境法规可以促使制造商采用更清洁的技术，减少有害工业排放。
collocations: strict rules｜严格的规定 ; strict about punctuality｜严格要求守时 ; strict with children｜对孩子严格 ; in the strict sense｜严格意义上
tip_zh: 对人严格用with；对事情要求严格用about。

meanings_zh: n. 科幻小说；科幻片
definition_en: stories about the future and space
example1_en: She loves reading science fiction novels.
example1_zh: 她喜欢读科幻小说。
example2_en: The film is a science fiction about robots.
example2_zh: 这部电影是关于机器人的科幻片。
tip_zh: science fiction 是科幻文学/电影，口语简称 sci-fi。

meanings_zh: n. 候诊室；等候室
definition_en: a room where people wait, e.g. at a doctor's
example1_en: We sat in the waiting room at the clinic.
example1_zh: 我们坐在诊所的候诊室里。
example2_en: The waiting room has magazines and chairs.
example2_zh: 候诊室有杂志和椅子。
tip_zh: waiting room 是医院/车站等的等候室。

meanings_zh: n. 沙；沙子 | v. 用砂纸打磨
definition_en: Tiny loose grains of rock found on beaches and in deserts. | To make a surface smooth by rubbing it with sandpaper.
example1_en: The children built a castle from wet sand.
example1_zh: 孩子们用湿沙堆了一座城堡。
example2_en: Removing sand from riverbeds for construction can damage habitats and increase the risk of erosion.
example2_zh: 为建筑工程开采河床中的沙子可能破坏栖息地，并增加侵蚀风险。
collocations: fine sand｜细沙 ; a grain of sand｜一粒沙 ; sand dunes｜沙丘 ; sand down｜打磨平整
tip_zh: 表示沙子时不可数；一粒沙用a grain of sand。

meanings_zh: n. 陶器 | n. 制陶；陶艺 | n. 陶器作坊；陶器厂
definition_en: Objects shaped from clay and hardened by heating. | The activity of making objects from clay. | A place where clay objects are made.
example1_en: The market stall displayed pottery in soft earthy colours.
example1_zh: 市场摊位上陈列着色调柔和、带有泥土色泽的陶器。
example2_en: Traditional pottery can reveal how earlier societies stored food, traded goods, and expressed their cultural identity.
example2_zh: 传统陶器能够揭示早期社会如何储存食物、交易商品以及表达文化身份。
collocations: handmade pottery｜手工陶器 ; pottery class｜陶艺课 ; pottery wheel｜陶轮 ; pottery fragments｜陶器碎片
tip_zh: 指陶器统称时不可数；一件用a piece of pottery。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人害怕的；骇人的
definition_en: Making someone feel afraid.
example1_en: The sudden thunder was frightening, but our dog stayed calm.
example1_zh: 突然响起的雷声很吓人，但我们的狗依然很镇定。
example2_en: Experiencing a major flood can be frightening, especially for children who have never faced a natural disaster.
example2_zh: 遭遇大洪水可能令人恐惧，尤其是对从未经历过自然灾害的儿童而言。
collocations: frightening experience｜可怕的经历 ; frightening thought｜令人害怕的想法 ; frightening prospect｜令人担忧的前景
tip_zh: frightening指事物吓人；frightened指人感到害怕。

meanings_zh: n. 小路；跑道；轨道 | v. 追踪；监测 | n. 足迹；车辙
definition_en: A path or course for walking, running, or trains. | To follow movement or monitor changes over time. | A mark left by a person, animal, or vehicle.
example1_en: We followed a narrow track through the pine forest.
example1_zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过松林。
example2_en: Researchers use satellite technology to track animal movements and identify habitats that require greater protection.
example2_zh: 研究人员利用卫星技术追踪动物活动，并确定需要加强保护的栖息地。
collocations: a railway track｜铁路轨道 ; a running track｜跑道 ; track progress｜跟踪进展 ; keep track of｜持续了解；记录
tip_zh: keep track of指持续掌握；lose track of指失去线索。

meanings_zh: adj. 北部的；北方的
definition_en: In, from, or relating to the north.
example1_en: My grandparents live in a quiet northern village.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母住在北方一个安静的村庄。
example2_en: Northern regions often face higher heating costs, making energy efficiency particularly important for local households.
example2_zh: 北部地区的供暖费用往往较高，因此提高能源效率对当地家庭尤其重要。
collocations: northern regions｜北部地区 ; the northern hemisphere｜北半球 ; the northern coast｜北部海岸
tip_zh: northern是形容词，常置于region、coast等名词前。

meanings_zh: conj. 除非；如果不
definition_en: except if; if something does not happen or is untrue
example1_en: We will eat outside unless it starts to rain.
example1_zh: 除非开始下雨，否则我们就在外面吃饭。
example2_en: Public transport will remain unpopular unless local authorities improve its reliability and make fares more affordable.
example2_zh: 除非地方政府提高公共交通的可靠性并降低票价，否则它仍不会受欢迎。
collocations: unless otherwise stated｜除非另有说明 ; unless absolutely necessary｜除非绝对必要 ; unless circumstances change｜除非情况有变
tip_zh: 表将来条件时，unless从句通常用一般现在时。

meanings_zh: v. 生产；创作 | v. 产生；引起 | n. 农产品
definition_en: To make, grow, or create something. | To cause a result or effect. | Food grown on farms, especially fruit and vegetables.
example1_en: Our garden produces enough tomatoes for the whole family.
example1_zh: 我们菜园里种出的番茄够全家吃。
example2_en: Investing in renewable energy can produce long-term benefits for both local communities and the environment.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以为当地社区和环境带来长期益处。
collocations: produce electricity｜发电 ; produce results｜产生效果 ; fresh produce｜新鲜农产品
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；农产品义不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 燃料 | v. 给……加燃料 | v. 加剧；推动
definition_en: material burned or used to produce heat or power | to supply something with fuel | to make a feeling or situation stronger
example1_en: We stopped for fuel before driving into the mountains.
example1_zh: 我们开车进山前停下来加了油。
example2_en: Growing demand for private cars may fuel air pollution unless governments promote cleaner alternatives.
example2_zh: 除非政府推广更清洁的替代出行方式，否则私家车需求的增长可能加剧空气污染。
collocations: fossil fuels｜化石燃料 ; fuel consumption｜燃料消耗 ; fuel prices｜燃料价格 ; fuel speculation｜助长猜测
tip_zh: fuel作动词还可表示助长情绪或推动变化。

meanings_zh: n. 摩托车 | v. 骑摩托车
definition_en: A motor vehicle with two wheels, usually for one or two. | To travel by motorcycle.
example1_en: He parked his motorcycle beside the garden gate.
example1_zh: 他把摩托车停在花园门旁。
example2_en: Although motorcycles require less parking space than cars, riders are more exposed to injury in road accidents.
example2_zh: 尽管摩托车所需的停车空间比汽车小，骑手在交通事故中却更容易受伤。
collocations: ride a motorcycle｜骑摩托车 ; motorcycle helmet｜摩托车头盔 ; motorcycle licence｜摩托车驾驶证
tip_zh: 骑摩托车用ride，通常不用drive。

meanings_zh: adj. 财务的；财政的；金融的
definition_en: relating to money or how it is managed
example1_en: We asked for financial advice before buying our first home.
example1_zh: 购买第一套住房前，我们咨询了理财建议。
example2_en: Financial support for disadvantaged students can improve access to higher education and reduce long-term inequality.
example2_zh: 为弱势学生提供经济支持可以增加他们接受高等教育的机会，并减少长期存在的不平等。
collocations: financial support｜经济支持 ; financial difficulties｜经济困难 ; financial stability｜金融稳定；财务稳定 ; financial services｜金融服务
tip_zh: financial侧重金钱与财务；economic侧重经济整体。

meanings_zh: n. 接待处；服务台 | n. 招待会；欢迎会 | n. 接收效果；反响
definition_en: the area where visitors are welcomed and given information | a formal social event held to welcome or celebrate someone | how well signals are received, or how people respond
example1_en: Please leave your room key at reception before breakfast.
example1_zh: 请在早餐前把房间钥匙留在前台。
example2_en: The proposal received a positive reception from local residents because it addressed their concerns about road safety.
example2_zh: 这项提议回应了当地居民对道路安全的担忧，因此获得了积极反响。
collocations: reception desk｜接待台 ; wedding reception｜婚宴 ; poor reception｜信号接收差 ; warm reception｜热情欢迎
tip_zh: 英式英语常说at reception，表示在接待处。

meanings_zh: n. 下巴
definition_en: The part of your face below your mouth.
example1_en: He rested his chin on his hand and sighed.
example1_zh: 他用手托着下巴，叹了口气。
example2_en: Cyclists should adjust helmet straps beneath the chin to ensure a secure fit during travel.
example2_zh: 骑车者应调节下巴下方的头盔带，确保骑行时头盔佩戴牢固。
collocations: rest your chin on your hand｜用手托着下巴 ; a pointed chin｜尖下巴 ; a double chin｜双下巴
tip_zh: chin指下巴；jaw指颌部，范围更广。

meanings_zh: adv. 部分地；在一定程度上
definition_en: To some extent, but not completely.
example1_en: The path was partly covered with fallen leaves.
example1_zh: 小路上有一部分被落叶覆盖了。
example2_en: The rise in cycling is partly due to improved infrastructure and growing concern about air quality.
example2_zh: 骑自行车的人增多，部分原因是基础设施改善以及人们更加关注空气质量。
collocations: partly because｜部分原因是 ; partly due to｜部分由于 ; partly responsible｜负有部分责任 ; partly cloudy｜局部多云
tip_zh: 表示部分而非全部；常用partly because说明原因。

meanings_zh: adj. 老式的；不时兴的 | adj. 守旧的；传统的
definition_en: Belonging to a style that was common in the past. | Following beliefs or customs associated with earlier times.
example1_en: My grandfather still uses an old-fashioned clock with a pendulum.
example1_zh: 我祖父仍然用着一座带钟摆的老式时钟。
example2_en: Although some teaching methods seem old-fashioned, they can still help students develop concentration and independent thinking.
example2_zh: 尽管某些教学方法看似老式，但它们仍能帮助学生培养专注力和独立思考能力。
collocations: old-fashioned clothes｜老式衣服 ; old-fashioned values｜传统价值观 ; old-fashioned manners｜传统礼仪
tip_zh: 可含怀旧赞赏；outdated更强调已不适用。

meanings_zh: n. 地球 | n. 泥土；土壤
definition_en: the planet where humans and other known living things exist | the loose material on the ground in which plants grow
example1_en: The children dug into the damp earth with small spades.
example1_zh: 孩子们用小铲子挖开湿润的泥土。
example2_en: Life on earth depends on healthy ecosystems that provide clean water, food, and breathable air.
example2_zh: 地球上的生命依赖于能够提供洁净水源、食物和可呼吸空气的健康生态系统。
collocations: on earth｜在地球上 ; planet Earth｜地球 ; damp earth｜湿润的泥土
tip_zh: 指行星时常写Earth；on earth中不加the。

meanings_zh: n. 香草；香草精 | adj. 香草味的
definition_en: A sweet-smelling substance from tropical plant pods, used to flavour food. | Flavoured with vanilla.
example1_en: Add a little vanilla before you mix the batter.
example1_zh: 搅拌面糊之前，加一点香草精。
example2_en: Demand for natural vanilla can provide valuable income for farmers, but unstable prices create financial risks.
example2_zh: 对天然香草的需求能为农民带来可观收入，但价格不稳定会造成财务风险。
collocations: vanilla extract｜香草精 ; vanilla ice cream｜香草冰淇淋 ; vanilla pod｜香草荚 ; vanilla flavour｜香草味
tip_zh: 食品中的vanilla指特定香料，并非泛指所有香草。

meanings_zh: n. 小包；小袋；小盒 | n. 数据包
definition_en: A small container or wrapped quantity of something. | A small unit of data transmitted across a network.
example1_en: She opened a packet of biscuits for the journey.
example1_zh: 她打开了一包饼干，准备在路上吃。
example2_en: Charging customers for each packet of disposable utensils could encourage more sustainable habits in the food industry.
example2_zh: 对每包一次性餐具收费，可以推动餐饮行业形成更可持续的习惯。
collocations: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干 ; seed packet｜种子袋 ; data packet｜数据包
tip_zh: 英式常用a packet of；美式常依物品用pack或bag。

meanings_zh: adj. 回收再制的
definition_en: made from waste materials processed for use again
example1_en: This notebook is made entirely from recycled paper.
example1_zh: 这本笔记本完全由再生纸制成。
example2_en: Using recycled materials in construction can reduce demand for natural resources and limit waste sent to landfill.
example2_zh: 在建筑中使用再生材料，可以减少对自然资源的需求，减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物。
collocations: recycled paper｜再生纸 ; recycled plastic｜再生塑料 ; recycled materials｜再生材料
tip_zh: recycled 指已回收再制；recyclable 指可回收。

meanings_zh: adv. 肯定地；确实；当然
definition_en: certainly, with no doubt about something
example1_en: I will definitely bring an umbrella after yesterday's rain.
example1_zh: 昨天下过雨后，我今天肯定会带伞。
example2_en: Improved insulation will definitely reduce heat loss, although total energy savings depend on household behaviour.
example2_zh: 改善隔热性能肯定能减少热量流失，不过总节能量取决于住户的行为。
collocations: definitely worth｜绝对值得 ; definitely agree｜完全赞同 ; definitely not｜绝对不
tip_zh: 拼写是definitely；不要与defiantly混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 事实；真相 | n. 真理
definition_en: what is real or actually happened | a fact or principle generally accepted as true
example1_en: Please tell me the truth about the broken cup.
example1_zh: 请告诉我杯子打碎的真相。
example2_en: Journalists should seek the truth rather than publish stories that simply attract public attention.
example2_zh: 记者应当寻求真相，而不是发表仅仅吸引公众注意的报道。
collocations: tell the truth｜说实话 ; discover the truth｜发现真相 ; the truth about something｜关于某事的真相
tip_zh: 说实话用tell the truth，通常不能省略the。

meanings_zh: adj. 以前的；前任的 | adj. 前者的
definition_en: having a particular role or condition in the past | being the first of two people or things just mentioned
example1_en: My former neighbour still visits us every summer.
example1_zh: 我以前的邻居每年夏天仍会来看我们。
example2_en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
example2_zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。
collocations: former colleague｜以前的同事 ; former president｜前任总统 ; former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip_zh: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

meanings_zh: n. 喷泉 | n. 饮水器
definition_en: a structure that sends water into the air | a device supplying a stream of water for drinking
example1_en: Children watched the fountain sparkle in the afternoon sunlight.
example1_zh: 孩子们看着喷泉在午后的阳光下闪闪发亮。
example2_en: A fountain can make a public square more attractive, although its maintenance requires water and energy.
example2_zh: 喷泉可以让公共广场更具吸引力，但维护喷泉需要消耗水和能源。
collocations: drinking fountain｜公共饮水器 ; ornamental fountain｜装饰性喷泉 ; fountain pen｜钢笔
tip_zh: drinking fountain是公共饮水器；fountain pen是钢笔。

meanings_zh: n. 计算器
definition_en: A device or application used for mathematical calculations
example1_en: I used a calculator to check the shopping total.
example1_zh: 我用计算器核对了购物总额。
