example2_en: Allowing students to use a calculator can help them focus on solving more complex mathematical problems.
example2_zh: 允许学生使用计算器，可以帮助他们专注于解决更复杂的数学问题。
collocations: use a calculator｜使用计算器 ; scientific calculator｜科学计算器 ; pocket calculator｜袖珍计算器
tip_zh: calculator指工具；calculation指计算过程或结果。

meanings_zh: n. 海盗 | v. 盗版；非法复制 | n. 盗版者
definition_en: someone who attacks ships and steals from them | to copy or distribute protected material without permission | someone who illegally copies or distributes protected material
example1_en: The pirate in the story sailed a wooden ship.
example1_zh: 故事里的海盗驾驶着一艘木船。
example2_en: When companies pirate educational software, they undermine the income that developers need to improve their products.
example2_zh: 企业盗版教育软件，会损害开发者改进产品所需的收入。
collocations: pirate ship｜海盗船 ; pirated software｜盗版软件 ; pirate films｜盗版电影
tip_zh: pirated强调被非法复制；piracy是对应名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 秃头的；秃的 | adj. 光秃的；磨光的
definition_en: having little or no hair on the head | lacking the usual covering or surface texture
example1_en: My uncle is bald and always wears a hat.
example1_zh: 我叔叔是秃头，总是戴着帽子。
example2_en: Driving with bald tyres increases the risk of accidents, particularly when roads are wet or icy.
example2_zh: 使用磨光的轮胎驾驶会增加事故风险，尤其是在道路湿滑或结冰时。
collocations: go bald｜开始秃顶 ; a bald head｜光头 ; a bald patch｜秃斑 ; bald tyres｜磨光的轮胎
tip_zh: bald指秃头；bold指大胆的，注意拼写和发音。

meanings_zh: n. 彩票；抽奖 | n. 抽签；靠运气的事
definition_en: a game where randomly chosen tickets win prizes | a selection process or situation whose outcome depends on chance
example1_en: My uncle bought a lottery ticket at the shop.
example1_zh: 我叔叔在商店买了一张彩票。
example2_en: Allocating school places by lottery may reduce favouritism, but it can also create uncertainty for families.
example2_zh: 通过抽签分配学位或许能减少偏袒，却也可能给家庭带来不确定性。
collocations: a lottery ticket｜一张彩票 ; win the lottery｜中彩票 ; a lottery draw｜彩票开奖 ; by lottery｜通过抽签
tip_zh: by lottery指通过抽签，不一定涉及购买彩票。

meanings_zh: conj. 即使；虽然
definition_en: although; despite the fact that
example1_en: Even though it was cold, we went swimming.
example1_zh: 尽管天冷，我们还是去游泳了。
example2_en: She passed the exam even though she was ill.
example2_zh: 尽管她生病了，还是通过了考试。
tip_zh: even though 比 although 语气更强，强调“即使…仍然…”。

meanings_zh: adj. 温柔的；温和的 | adj. 轻柔的；不强烈的 | adj. 坡度平缓的
definition_en: Kind and careful, without roughness or force. | Mild in strength, movement, or effect. | Rising or falling gradually rather than steeply.
example1_en: Be gentle when you pick up the little kitten.
example1_zh: 抱起那只小猫时，动作要轻柔。
example2_en: Gentle exercise, such as walking or swimming, can improve physical health without placing excessive strain on joints.
example2_zh: 散步或游泳等温和运动可以改善身体健康，又不会给关节带来过大负担。
collocations: a gentle breeze｜微风 ; gentle exercise｜温和运动 ; a gentle slope｜缓坡 ; a gentle touch｜轻柔的触碰
tip_zh: 对人温柔用be gentle with sb。

meanings_zh: v. 打败；胜过 | v. 反复敲打；跳动 | n. 节拍；有节奏的敲击
definition_en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, or contest. | To hit repeatedly, or move with a regular rhythm. | A regular pulse of sound or movement.
example1_en: My sister beat me at chess again yesterday.
example1_zh: 我姐姐昨天又下棋赢了我。
example2_en: Athletes need consistent training and psychological support to beat their strongest competitors in international events.
example2_zh: 运动员需要持续训练和心理支持，才能在国际赛事中击败最强劲的对手。
collocations: beat an opponent｜击败对手 ; beat a record｜打破纪录 ; a steady beat｜稳定的节拍 ; beat an egg｜打鸡蛋
tip_zh: 过去式 beat，过去分词 beaten；赢比赛用 win。

meanings_zh: n. 表现；业绩；性能 | n. 表演；演出 | n. 执行；履行
definition_en: How well a person, organisation or machine does something. | An occasion when someone entertains an audience by performing. | The act of carrying out a task or duty.
example1_en: The coach praised our performance after the football match.
example1_zh: 足球赛后，教练表扬了我们的表现。
example2_en: Regular feedback can improve employee performance by helping workers understand expectations and address specific weaknesses.
example2_zh: 定期反馈能帮助员工了解工作要求并改进具体不足，从而提升工作表现。
collocations: academic performance｜学业表现 ; job performance｜工作表现 ; live performance｜现场演出 ; performance of duties｜履行职责
tip_zh: 表示整体表现通常不可数；一场演出用a performance。

meanings_zh: n. 薪水；薪金
definition_en: A fixed regular payment for work, often expressed yearly
example1_en: Her new job offers a higher salary and shorter hours.
example1_zh: 她的新工作薪水更高，工时也更短。
example2_en: Although salary influences career choices, many graduates also value job security and opportunities for professional development.
example2_zh: 虽然薪水会影响职业选择，但许多毕业生也重视工作保障和职业发展机会。
collocations: annual salary｜年薪 ; starting salary｜起薪 ; salary increase｜加薪 ; competitive salary｜有竞争力的薪酬
tip_zh: salary指固定薪金；wages常指按时或按周计算的工资。

meanings_zh: n. 嗓音；说话声 | n. 发言权；影响力 | v. 表达；吐露
definition_en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing. | The right or opportunity to express opinions and influence decisions. | To express an opinion, feeling, or concern.
example1_en: Her gentle voice helped the frightened puppy settle down.
example1_zh: 她温柔的声音让受惊的小狗安静了下来。
example2_en: Public consultations give local residents a voice in decisions that directly affect their communities.
example2_zh: 公众咨询让当地居民有机会参与直接影响其社区的决策。
collocations: raise your voice｜提高嗓门 ; a voice in decisions｜决策中的发言权 ; voice concerns｜表达担忧 ; lose your voice｜嗓子失声
tip_zh: voice侧重人的嗓音；sound泛指声音。

meanings_zh: phr. 故意地
definition_en: intentionally; not by accident
example1_en: He broke the cup on purpose.
example1_zh: 他故意打碎了杯子。
example2_en: She didn't hurt you on purpose.
example2_zh: 她不是故意伤害你的。
tip_zh: on purpose 是“故意”；反义 by accident/by mistake。

meanings_zh: n. 趋势；潮流 | v. 成为热门话题
definition_en: a general direction of change or development | to become widely discussed or shared online
example1_en: Growing vegetables at home is a popular trend here.
example1_zh: 在家种菜是这里流行的一种风尚。
example2_en: The growing trend towards remote working may reduce traffic congestion in major cities.
example2_zh: 远程办公日益普及的趋势可能缓解大城市的交通拥堵。
collocations: an upward trend｜上升趋势 ; a growing trend｜日益明显的趋势 ; follow a trend｜追随潮流 ; a trend towards｜朝向……的趋势
tip_zh: 朝向某种趋势常用a trend towards后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 山谷；河谷
definition_en: Low land between hills or mountains, often containing a river.
example1_en: A narrow river winds through the green valley.
example1_zh: 一条狭窄的河流蜿蜒穿过翠绿的山谷。
example2_en: Farming communities in the valley depend on seasonal rainfall to maintain their crops and support local livelihoods.
example2_zh: 河谷中的农业社区依靠季节性降雨维持作物生长，保障当地居民的生计。
collocations: a river valley｜河谷 ; a deep valley｜深谷 ; the valley floor｜谷底
tip_zh: valley是两侧山地之间的低地，不等同于盆地basin。

meanings_zh: v. 使确信；使信服 | v. 说服
definition_en: to make someone believe something is true | to persuade someone to do something
example1_en: The photos convinced me that the flat was spacious.
example1_zh: 这些照片让我相信那套公寓很宽敞。
example2_en: Governments must convince residents that improved public transport offers a practical alternative to private cars.
example2_zh: 政府必须让居民相信，改善后的公共交通能够切实替代私家车出行。
collocations: convince someone of something｜使某人相信某事 ; convince someone that｜使某人确信 ; convince someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
tip_zh: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

meanings_zh: v. 缝；缝纫
definition_en: to join or repair fabric using a needle and thread
example1_en: Can you sew this button back onto my coat?
example1_zh: 你能把这颗纽扣缝回我的外套上吗？
example2_en: Learning to sew enables people to repair damaged clothes rather than discard them, reducing household waste.
example2_zh: 学会缝纫能让人们修补破损衣物而不是将其丢弃，从而减少家庭垃圾。
collocations: sew on a button｜缝上纽扣 ; sew by hand｜手工缝制 ; sew clothes｜缝制衣服 ; sew up a hole｜缝补破洞
tip_zh: 过去式sewed；过去分词sewn或sewed；与so同音。

meanings_zh: v. 减少；降低；缩小
definition_en: To make something smaller or less in amount or degree.
example1_en: We can reduce waste by using our leftovers.
example1_zh: 我们可以利用剩饭剩菜来减少浪费。
example2_en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions and improve long-term energy security.
example2_zh: 政府应投资可再生能源，以减少碳排放并改善长期能源安全。
collocations: reduce costs｜降低成本 ; reduce emissions｜减少排放 ; reduce the risk｜降低风险 ; reduce waste｜减少浪费
tip_zh: reduce by接减少量；reduce to接减少后的量。

meanings_zh: adv. 好奇地
definition_en: in a way that shows interest to know more
example1_en: The children looked curiously at the strange machine.
example1_zh: 孩子们好奇地看着这台奇怪的机器。
example2_en: She asked curiously about my holiday.
example2_zh: 她好奇地问起我的假期。
tip_zh: curiously 是 curiously 的副词“好奇地”；形容词 curious。

meanings_zh: conj. 以防；万一
definition_en: to be ready for something that might happen
example1_en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
example1_zh: 带把伞以防下雨。
example2_en: I'll write it down in case I forget.
example2_zh: 我把它记下来以防忘记。
tip_zh: in case 引导从句表示“以防万一”。

meanings_zh: adj. 活泼的；热闹的 | adj. 生动有趣的；热烈的
definition_en: full of energy, activity, or excitement | interesting and engaging, with enthusiastic activity or discussion
example1_en: The lively puppy chased a ball around the garden.
example1_zh: 那只活泼的小狗在花园里追着球跑。
example2_en: Lively classroom discussions can encourage students to consider different perspectives and develop critical thinking skills.
example2_zh: 热烈的课堂讨论能鼓励学生考虑不同观点，并培养批判性思维能力。
collocations: lively debate｜热烈的辩论 ; lively atmosphere｜热闹的气氛 ; lively imagination｜丰富活跃的想象力
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词，不是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 雕塑作品 | n. 雕塑艺术
definition_en: an artwork made by carving, shaping, or assembling materials | the art of creating solid forms from materials
example1_en: A bronze sculpture of a horse stands outside the library.
example1_zh: 图书馆外矗立着一座马的青铜雕塑。
example2_en: Public sculpture can strengthen a city's cultural identity while making art accessible to people outside traditional galleries.
example2_zh: 公共雕塑能增强城市的文化认同，同时让传统美术馆之外的人们也能接触艺术。
collocations: a bronze sculpture｜青铜雕塑 ; public sculpture｜公共雕塑 ; a sculpture garden｜雕塑园 ; abstract sculpture｜抽象雕塑
tip_zh: 指艺术门类不可数；指一件作品可数。

meanings_zh: n. 需求 | n. 坚决要求 | v. 强烈要求；需要
definition_en: the desire or need for particular goods or services | a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed | to insist on receiving something or require something essential
example1_en: Demand for cold drinks rises sharply during hot weather.
example1_zh: 天气炎热时，冷饮的需求量急剧上升。
example2_en: Growing demand for affordable housing has encouraged local authorities to convert unused office buildings into residential accommodation.
example2_zh: 对可负担住房不断增长的需求促使地方政府将闲置办公楼改建为住宅。
collocations: demand for housing｜住房需求 ; meet demand｜满足需求 ; in high demand｜需求旺盛 ; demand an explanation｜要求解释
tip_zh: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

meanings_zh: n. 课程体系；全部课程
definition_en: the subjects and content included in a programme of study
example1_en: Our school has added cooking to the curriculum.
example1_zh: 我们学校已将烹饪加入课程体系。
example2_en: A balanced curriculum should develop practical skills alongside academic knowledge to prepare students for adult life.
example2_zh: 均衡的课程体系应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，为学生的成年生活做准备。
collocations: school curriculum｜学校课程体系 ; national curriculum｜国家课程 ; core curriculum｜核心课程 ; curriculum reform｜课程改革
tip_zh: 复数为curricula或curriculums；不等于单门课。

meanings_zh: v. 承认 | v. 准许进入；接收
definition_en: to accept that something is true, often reluctantly | to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution
example1_en: I admit that I forgot to water your plants.
example1_zh: 我承认我忘了给你的植物浇水。
example2_en: Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
example2_zh: 政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。
collocations: admit a mistake｜承认错误 ; admit doing something｜承认做过某事 ; admit that｜承认…… ; be admitted to hospital｜被收治入院
tip_zh: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

meanings_zh: adj. 著名的；广为人知的
definition_en: known or recognised by many people
example1_en: We visited a well-known castle during our summer holiday.
example1_zh: 暑假期间，我们参观了一座著名的城堡。
example2_en: Well-known tourist destinations often face overcrowding, which can damage historic sites and reduce residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 著名旅游目的地常面临过度拥挤的问题，这可能损坏历史遗迹并降低居民的生活质量。
collocations: well-known author｜著名作家 ; well-known landmark｜著名地标 ; well-known fact｜众所周知的事实
tip_zh: 名词前通常加连字符；表语位置通常写well known。

meanings_zh: adj. 整洁的；整齐的 | adj. 巧妙的；简洁有效的
definition_en: tidy and carefully arranged | clever, simple, and effective
example1_en: She keeps her gardening tools in neat rows.
example1_zh: 她把园艺工具摆放得整整齐齐。
example2_en: Keeping shared workspaces neat can improve efficiency by making essential equipment easier to locate.
example2_zh: 保持共用工作空间整洁，可以让必要设备更容易找到，从而提高效率。
collocations: neat and tidy｜干净整洁的 ; neat handwriting｜工整的字迹 ; a neat solution｜巧妙的解决办法
tip_zh: neat除指整洁，也可形容办法巧妙、简洁。

meanings_zh: v. 交流；沟通 | v. 传达；表达
definition_en: to share information, thoughts, or feelings with others | to make information or feelings known to someone
example1_en: We communicate with our neighbours through a shared online group.
example1_zh: 我们通过一个共同的线上群组与邻居交流。
example2_en: Teachers need to communicate complex ideas clearly so that students with different abilities can understand them.
example2_zh: 教师需要清晰地传达复杂概念，让能力不同的学生都能理解。
collocations: communicate with｜与……交流 ; communicate effectively｜有效沟通 ; communicate ideas｜传达想法
tip_zh: 与某人交流用with；向某人传达某事用某事＋to。

meanings_zh: v. 提供；供应 | v. 供养；赡养
definition_en: To give someone something they need or make it available. | To support someone financially by supplying what they need.
example1_en: The campsite provides clean towels and blankets for every guest.
example1_zh: 营地为每位客人提供干净的毛巾和毯子。
example2_en: Local authorities should provide affordable public transport to ensure that all residents can access essential services.
example2_zh: 地方政府应提供价格可负担的公共交通，确保所有居民都能获得基本服务。
collocations: provide support｜提供支持 ; provide access to｜提供使用……的机会 ; provide someone with something｜向某人提供某物 ; provide for a family｜养家
tip_zh: 用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。

meanings_zh: v. 宣布；公布
definition_en: To make information known publicly or officially.
example1_en: Our teacher announced the winners after lunch today.
example1_zh: 今天午饭后，我们的老师宣布了获奖者。
example2_en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
example2_zh: 地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。
collocations: announce plans｜宣布计划 ; announce a decision｜宣布决定 ; announce the results｜公布结果
tip_zh: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

meanings_zh: n. 社会 | n. 协会；社团
definition_en: People living together in an organised community. | An organisation for people who share an interest or purpose.
example1_en: Everyone has a part to play in society.
example1_zh: 每个人都能在社会中发挥作用。
example2_en: An ageing society requires accessible healthcare and policies that support older people's independence.
example2_zh: 老龄化社会需要便捷可及的医疗服务，以及支持老年人独立生活的政策。
collocations: modern society｜现代社会 ; an ageing society｜老龄化社会 ; society as a whole｜整个社会 ; join a society｜加入社团
tip_zh: 泛指社会常不加the；表示协会时是可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 购物中心
definition_en: a large building or complex containing many shops
example1_en: We spent the rainy afternoon browsing in the mall.
example1_zh: 下雨的下午，我们一直在购物中心闲逛。
example2_en: A new shopping mall may create jobs, but it can also threaten small independent retailers.
example2_zh: 新的购物中心可能创造就业机会，但也可能威胁独立小零售商的生存。
collocations: shopping mall｜购物中心 ; indoor mall｜室内购物中心 ; mall entrance｜购物中心入口
tip_zh: mall常用于美式英语；英式常说shopping centre。

meanings_zh: adv. 专门地；特意地
definition_en: for a particular purpose or person
example1_en: I made this cushion specially for your chair.
example1_zh: 这个靠垫是我特意为你的椅子做的。
example2_en: Schools should provide specially designed learning materials to support students with different educational needs.
example2_zh: 学校应提供专门设计的学习材料，帮助有不同教育需求的学生。
collocations: specially designed｜专门设计的 ; specially trained｜受过专门培训的 ; specially made｜特制的
tip_zh: specially侧重专门目的；especially侧重尤其。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病
definition_en: An illness affecting humans, animals or plants
example1_en: The vet checked our rabbit for signs of disease.
example1_zh: 兽医检查了我们的兔子，看是否有患病迹象。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.
example2_zh: 获得清洁饮用水可以显著减少传染病在脆弱社区中的传播。
collocations: heart disease｜心脏病 ; infectious diseases｜传染病 ; prevent disease｜预防疾病 ; the spread of disease｜疾病传播
tip_zh: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 布告栏；公告板
definition_en: A board displaying announcements for people to read.
example1_en: Someone pinned a lost cat poster to the noticeboard.
example1_zh: 有人把寻猫启事钉在了布告栏上。
example2_en: A shared noticeboard can help residents discover local events and participate more actively in community life.
example2_zh: 共用布告栏可以帮助居民了解当地活动，更积极地参与社区生活。
collocations: community noticeboard｜社区布告栏 ; on the noticeboard｜在布告栏上 ; put up a noticeboard｜安装布告栏
tip_zh: 英式常用noticeboard，美式常用bulletin board。

meanings_zh: v. 道歉
definition_en: To say you are sorry for something you have done.
example1_en: I should apologise for spilling juice on your jacket.
example1_zh: 我把果汁洒在了你的夹克上，应该向你道歉。
example2_en: Companies should apologise publicly when their mistakes cause inconvenience or financial loss to customers.
example2_zh: 当企业的失误给顾客造成不便或经济损失时，企业应该公开道歉。
collocations: apologise to someone｜向某人道歉 ; apologise for something｜为某事道歉 ; apologise sincerely｜真诚道歉
tip_zh: 英式拼写；美式常用apologize，后接to人、for事。

meanings_zh: v. 挑选；选择 | v. 采摘 | n. 镐；鹤嘴锄
definition_en: to choose someone or something from available options | to remove fruit or flowers from a plant | a tool with a pointed metal head for breaking hard ground
example1_en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
example1_zh: 新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。
example2_en: Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。
collocations: pick a winner｜选出获胜者 ; pick fruit｜采摘水果 ; pick carefully｜仔细挑选 ; take your pick｜随你挑选
tip_zh: pick可指挑选或采摘；捡起通常用pick up。

meanings_zh: n. 烟花；焰火
definition_en: an object that burns or explodes with bright colours outdoors
example1_en: A single firework burst above the lake, scattering golden sparks.
example1_zh: 一枚烟花在湖面上空绽放，洒下金色火花。
example2_en: Public firework displays can attract visitors, although their noise may disturb local residents and wildlife.
example2_zh: 公共焰火表演可以吸引游客，但其噪声可能打扰当地居民和野生动物。
collocations: firework display｜焰火表演 ; set off fireworks｜燃放烟花 ; watch fireworks｜观看烟花
tip_zh: 单枚烟花可数；泛指烟花或焰火表演常用fireworks。

meanings_zh: n. 政治；政治活动 | n. 政治观点；政治立场
definition_en: activities concerning government and how a country is run | a person's beliefs about government and public affairs
example1_en: My uncle loves discussing politics over dinner with friends.
example1_zh: 我叔叔喜欢在晚餐时和朋友们讨论政治。
example2_en: Greater involvement in politics can help young people influence decisions that affect their future.
example2_zh: 更多地参与政治能帮助年轻人影响关乎自身未来的决策。
collocations: local politics｜地方政治 ; enter politics｜从政 ; discuss politics｜讨论政治 ; party politics｜政党政治
tip_zh: 指政治活动时通常配单数谓语；政治立场可配复数。

meanings_zh: v. 警告；提醒
definition_en: tell someone about possible danger or an unpleasant consequence
example1_en: Please warn me if the pan gets too hot.
example1_zh: 如果锅太烫，请提醒我。
example2_en: Scientists warn that continued habitat loss could put many more species at risk of extinction.
example2_zh: 科学家警告说，栖息地持续减少可能使更多物种面临灭绝风险。
collocations: warn someone about something｜提醒某人注意某事 ; warn against doing something｜告诫不要做某事 ; warn someone not to do something｜警告某人不要做某事
tip_zh: warn后可接that从句；warn sb not to do表示告诫。

meanings_zh: n. 会计；会计师
definition_en: Someone whose job is to prepare and check financial records
example1_en: The accountant checked our expenses before we opened the café.
example1_zh: 咖啡馆开业前，会计核查了我们的各项开支。
example2_en: Employing a qualified accountant helps small businesses manage taxes accurately and make better financial decisions.
example2_zh: 聘用合格的会计师有助于小企业准确处理税务，并作出更好的财务决策。
collocations: qualified accountant｜合格的会计师 ; chartered accountant｜特许会计师 ; hire an accountant｜聘用会计师
tip_zh: accountant指人；accounting指会计工作或学科。

meanings_zh: adv. 认真地；严重地
definition_en: in a serious way; very badly
example1_en: You should take your studies seriously.
example1_zh: 你应该认真对待学业。
example2_en: He was seriously hurt in the accident.
example2_zh: 他在事故中受了重伤。
collocations: take seriously｜认真对待
tip_zh: take sth seriously 是“认真对待某事”。

meanings_zh: n. 服务；公共服务 | v. 检修；保养 | n. 宗教仪式
definition_en: Help or useful work provided for people or customers. | Check and repair a vehicle or machine to keep it working. | A formal religious ceremony.
example1_en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
example1_zh: 咖啡馆里热情的服务让我们感到宾至如归。
example2_en: Reliable bus services allow residents without cars to reach hospitals, schools and workplaces.
example2_zh: 可靠的公交服务让没有汽车的居民也能到达医院、学校和工作地点。
collocations: customer service｜客户服务 ; public services｜公共服务 ; service a car｜保养汽车 ; religious service｜宗教仪式
tip_zh: 表示服务质量常不可数；各项服务可用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 范围；幅度；一系列 | v. 在一定范围内变化 | n. 山脉
definition_en: The extent or variety of things within certain limits. | To vary between particular limits. | A connected group of mountains.
example1_en: This shop sells a wide range of fresh fruit.
example1_zh: 这家商店出售种类繁多的新鲜水果。
example2_en: Universities should offer a broader range of courses to meet the changing needs of employers.
example2_zh: 大学应提供更广泛的课程，以满足雇主不断变化的需求。
collocations: a wide range of｜种类繁多的 ; range from A to B｜从A到B不等 ; a mountain range｜一条山脉
tip_zh: range from A to B表示变化范围；山脉用名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 现实的；切实可行的 | adj. 逼真的；写实的
definition_en: Based on what is actually possible or likely | Looking or sounding very much like real life
example1_en: Finishing this puzzle tonight is not a realistic goal.
example1_zh: 今晚完成这幅拼图不是一个现实的目标。
example2_en: Governments should set realistic targets for reducing emissions, taking economic conditions and available technology into account.
example2_zh: 政府应考虑经济状况和现有技术，为减排制定切实可行的目标。
collocations: realistic expectations｜现实的期望 ; set realistic goals｜制定切实可行的目标 ; a realistic portrait｜逼真的肖像
tip_zh: realistic强调符合现实或逼真，real强调真实存在。

meanings_zh: n. 谜；无法解释的事 | n. 神秘感 | n. 悬疑故事；推理小说
definition_en: Something that is unknown or cannot be explained | The quality of being strange, secret, or difficult to understand | A story about solving a puzzling event, often a crime
example1_en: Who left these flowers outside remains a mystery.
example1_zh: 是谁把这些花放在外面，至今还是个谜。
example2_en: Despite advances in marine research, the behaviour of many deep ocean species remains a mystery.
example2_zh: 尽管海洋研究取得了进展，许多深海物种的行为仍然是个谜。
collocations: solve a mystery｜解开谜团 ; remain a mystery｜仍然是个谜 ; a sense of mystery｜神秘感 ; mystery novel｜推理小说
tip_zh: 表示一个谜用a mystery；表示神秘感通常不可数。

meanings_zh: phr v. 让路；让行
definition_en: to stop and let others go first
example1_en: Cars must give way to pedestrians at the crossing.
example1_zh: 汽车在斑马线必须给行人让路。
example2_en: The branch gave way under the snow.
example2_zh: 树枝在雪的重压下折断了。
tip_zh: give way 表示“让路”，也引申为“倒塌、垮掉”。

meanings_zh: n. 菠菜
definition_en: A vegetable with dark green leaves eaten raw or cooked.
example1_en: I added fresh spinach to the soup before dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭前，我往汤里加了新鲜菠菜。
example2_en: Leafy vegetables such as spinach provide nutrients that support a healthy, balanced diet.
example2_zh: 菠菜等绿叶蔬菜提供的营养有助于构建健康、均衡的饮食。
collocations: fresh spinach｜新鲜菠菜 ; spinach leaves｜菠菜叶 ; steamed spinach｜蒸菠菜
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一片菠菜叶说a spinach leaf。

meanings_zh: n. 舒适；安逸 | n. 安慰；慰藉 | v. 安慰；抚慰
definition_en: A pleasant state of physical ease and relaxation. | Relief from sadness or worry, or something providing it. | To help someone feel less sad, worried, or upset.
example1_en: I enjoyed the comfort of a warm bed after camping.
example1_zh: 露营后，我享受着温暖床铺带来的舒适。
example2_en: Support groups can comfort patients by providing opportunities to share experiences and discuss concerns openly.
example2_zh: 互助小组让患者有机会分享经历、坦诚讨论忧虑，从而给予他们安慰。
collocations: in comfort｜舒舒服服地 ; take comfort in｜从……中获得慰藉 ; comfort someone｜安慰某人 ; creature comforts｜物质上的舒适享受
tip_zh: 表示舒适或慰藉时通常不可数；作动词直接接人。

meanings_zh: n. 遥控器
definition_en: a small device used to control a machine from a distance
example1_en: Pass me the remote control, please.
example1_zh: 请把遥控器递给我。
example2_en: The TV remote control needs new batteries.
example2_zh: 电视遥控器需要换电池。
tip_zh: remote control 是遥控器，口语常简称 remote。

meanings_zh: phr. 失业的
definition_en: unemployed; without a job
example1_en: He has been out of work since March.
example1_zh: 他从三月起就失业了。
example2_en: Many people are out of work in the town.
example2_zh: 镇上有许多人失业。
tip_zh: out of work 表示“失业”；unemployed 是更正式的说法。

meanings_zh: phr v. 开始从事；占用
definition_en: to start a hobby, or to use space or time
example1_en: She took up painting last year.
example1_zh: 她去年开始学画画。
example2_en: This desk takes up too much space.
example2_zh: 这张桌子太占地方。
tip_zh: take up 表示“开始（爱好）”或“占用（空间/时间）”。

meanings_zh: n. 联系；连接 | n. 链接 | v. 连接；联系起来
definition_en: a connection between people, things, or ideas | a clickable element that opens another webpage or digital resource | to connect things or show a relationship between them
example1_en: The new bridge provides a link between the villages.
example1_zh: 这座新桥连接了这些村庄。
example2_en: Researchers have identified a strong link between regular physical activity and improved mental health.
example2_zh: 研究人员发现，经常运动与心理健康改善之间存在密切联系。
collocations: a link between｜……之间的联系 ; click a link｜点击链接 ; link A to B｜将A与B联系起来 ; transport links｜交通连接
tip_zh: 常用a link between A and B；动词用link A to/with B。

meanings_zh: n. 死亡；去世
definition_en: the end of a person's or animal's life
example1_en: The old dog's death left the family deeply sad.
example1_zh: 老狗的离世让全家人深感悲伤。
example2_en: Improved access to clean drinking water has reduced deaths from preventable diseases in many communities.
example2_zh: 更便利地获得清洁饮用水，已减少了许多社区中可预防疾病导致的死亡。
collocations: cause of death｜死因 ; premature death｜过早死亡 ; prevent deaths｜防止死亡 ; death rate｜死亡率
tip_zh: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 风味；味道 | v. 给……调味 | n. 特色；风格
definition_en: the particular taste of food or drink | to give food or drink a particular taste | a distinctive quality that gives something its character
example1_en: Fresh basil gives this soup a lovely flavour.
example1_zh: 新鲜罗勒让这道汤有了宜人的风味。
example2_en: School cooking lessons can teach children how to improve flavour without adding excessive salt or sugar.
example2_zh: 学校的烹饪课可以教孩子如何在不过量加盐或糖的情况下提升食物风味。
collocations: rich flavour｜浓郁的味道 ; add flavour｜增添风味 ; flavour with herbs｜用香草调味
tip_zh: 英式拼写flavour，美式拼写flavor。

meanings_zh: phr v. 跟上；保持
definition_en: to move at the same speed, or to continue
example1_en: Run faster or you can't keep up with us!
example1_zh: 跑快点，不然你跟不上我们！
example2_en: She works hard to keep up with her classmates.
example2_zh: 她努力学习以跟上同学。
collocations: keep up with｜跟上
tip_zh: keep up with 是“跟上（进度/步伐）”。

meanings_zh: phr v. 打电话；（收银）结算
definition_en: to phone someone, or to total a sale
example1_en: I'll ring up the restaurant to book a table.
example1_zh: 我会打电话给餐厅订位。
example2_en: The cashier rang up the items at the checkout.
example2_zh: 收银员在收银台结算商品。
tip_zh: ring up 表示“打电话”（英式）。

meanings_zh: v. 取消；撤销 | v. 抵消
definition_en: To decide that something planned will not happen. | To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.
example1_en: We had to cancel our picnic because of heavy rain.
example1_zh: 由于下大雨，我们不得不取消野餐。
example2_en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
example2_zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。
collocations: cancel a booking｜取消预订 ; cancel a flight｜取消航班 ; cancel out｜抵消
tip_zh: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

meanings_zh: n. 质量；品质 | n. 特质；品德 | adj. 优质的
definition_en: How good or bad something is. | A characteristic of a person or thing. | Of a high standard.
example1_en: The quality of these shoes surprised me for the price.
example1_zh: 以这个价格来说，这双鞋的质量让我感到惊喜。
example2_en: Governments should improve the quality of public transport before encouraging people to give up driving.
example2_zh: 政府应先提高公共交通的质量，再鼓励人们放弃开车。
collocations: high quality｜高质量 ; quality of life｜生活质量 ; leadership qualities｜领导才能 ; quality control｜质量控制
tip_zh: 表示质量通常不可数；表示特质时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 鲑鱼；三文鱼；其鱼肉 | adj. 鲑肉粉红色的
definition_en: a fish with pink flesh, or its flesh as food | having a pink colour with a slight orange shade
example1_en: We watched a salmon leap up the rocky stream.
example1_zh: 我们看着一条鲑鱼在多石的溪流中跃向上游。
example2_en: Dams can disrupt salmon migration, so river management should consider both energy production and wildlife protection.
example2_zh: 水坝可能阻碍鲑鱼洄游，因此河流管理应兼顾能源生产与野生动物保护。
collocations: smoked salmon｜烟熏三文鱼 ; wild salmon｜野生鲑鱼 ; salmon fillet｜去骨鲑鱼片 ; salmon migration｜鲑鱼洄游
tip_zh: l不发音；指鱼时单复数同形，指鱼肉时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 火鸡 | n. 火鸡肉 | n. 失败之作
definition_en: A large bird often raised for its meat | Meat from a turkey, eaten as food | Something that fails badly, especially a film or play
example1_en: A turkey spread its tail feathers near the farm gate.
example1_zh: 一只火鸡在农场大门旁展开了尾羽。
example2_en: Turkey production provides affordable protein, but intensive farming can raise concerns about animal welfare and environmental damage.
example2_zh: 火鸡养殖提供了价格实惠的蛋白质，但集约化养殖可能引发对动物福利和环境破坏的担忧。
collocations: roast turkey｜烤火鸡 ; turkey breast｜火鸡胸肉 ; wild turkey｜野生火鸡
tip_zh: 鸟可数，肉不可数；表示失败之作时属非正式用法。

meanings_zh: n. 形状；外形 | v. 塑造；影响 | v. 使成形
definition_en: the outer form of something | to influence how something develops | to give something a particular physical form
example1_en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
example1_zh: 她把饼干坯切成了星星的形状。
example2_en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
example2_zh: 幼年经历可以塑造学习态度，并影响未来的学业成就。
collocations: in the shape of｜呈……形状 ; take shape｜逐渐成形 ; shape attitudes｜塑造态度 ; stay in shape｜保持良好的身体状态
tip_zh: in shape可指身体状态好，不只表示形状。

meanings_zh: adj. 未知的；不为人知的 | n. 未知因素；无名之辈
definition_en: Not known, identified, or familiar. | Something not yet understood, or a person not widely known.
example1_en: An unknown caller rang while I was cooking dinner.
example1_zh: 我做晚饭时，一个陌生人打来了电话。
example2_en: The long-term effects of some new materials remain unknown, so further research is essential before widespread use.
example2_zh: 某些新材料的长期影响仍不明确，因此在广泛使用前必须进一步研究。
collocations: remain unknown｜仍然未知 ; unknown to someone｜某人不知道的 ; an unknown cause｜不明原因 ; the unknown｜未知事物
tip_zh: the unknown泛指“未知事物或未知领域”。

meanings_zh: n. 口音 | n. 重音；重音符号 | v. 强调；突出
definition_en: a pronunciation style associated with a place or social group | emphasis on a syllable, or a mark indicating pronunciation | to give special emphasis or prominence to something
example1_en: Her accent reminds me of my neighbours back home.
example1_zh: 她的口音让我想起家乡的邻居。
example2_en: Teachers should value different accents while helping learners develop clear pronunciation for effective international communication.
example2_zh: 教师应尊重不同口音，同时帮助学习者练就清晰的发音，以便有效开展国际交流。
collocations: regional accent｜地方口音 ; strong accent｜浓重的口音 ; speak with an accent｜说话带口音 ; accent mark｜重音符号
tip_zh: accent指发音特点；dialect还涉及词汇和语法。

meanings_zh: adj. 有罪的；有过错的 | adj. 内疚的
definition_en: Responsible for breaking a law or doing something wrong. | Feeling bad because you believe you have done something wrong.
example1_en: I felt guilty about forgetting my sister's birthday.
example1_zh: 我忘了姐姐的生日，感到很内疚。
example2_en: Companies found guilty of illegally dumping waste should face penalties that reflect the environmental damage caused.
example2_zh: 被裁定非法倾倒废物的公司应受到与其造成的环境损害相称的处罚。
collocations: guilty of｜犯有……罪的 ; find someone guilty｜裁定某人有罪 ; plead guilty｜认罪 ; feel guilty about｜因……感到内疚
tip_zh: guilty of接罪行；feel guilty about接内疚的事。

meanings_zh: n. 侄子；外甥
definition_en: A son of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.
example1_en: My nephew proudly showed me his new bicycle.
example1_zh: 我的侄子自豪地给我看他的新自行车。
example2_en: Looking after a nephew or niece can help young adults understand the responsibilities of raising children.
example2_zh: 照顾侄子或侄女可以帮助年轻人理解养育孩子的责任。
collocations: young nephew｜年幼的侄子或外甥 ; nieces and nephews｜侄甥辈孩子
tip_zh: nephew 指男性晚辈；女性对应词是 niece。

meanings_zh: v. 打架；战斗 | v. 抗争；努力争取 | n. 打斗；斗争
definition_en: To use physical force against another person or group. | To try hard to stop something or achieve a goal. | An occasion of physical conflict or a determined effort against something.
example1_en: The two cats fought over a sunny window seat.
example1_zh: 两只猫为了窗边一个有阳光的位置打了起来。
example2_en: Governments should fight poverty by improving access to education, healthcare, and stable employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 政府应通过改善教育和医疗服务的可及性、增加稳定就业机会来消除贫困。
collocations: fight poverty｜与贫困作斗争 ; fight for equality｜争取平等 ; fight against discrimination｜反对歧视 ; get into a fight｜卷入打斗
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为fought；fight for表示争取。

meanings_zh: adv. 极其；非常
definition_en: To a very great degree.
example1_en: The soup was extremely hot, so I waited.
example1_zh: 汤烫极了，所以我等了一会儿。
example2_en: Access to reliable internet is extremely important for students who depend on online learning.
example2_zh: 对于依赖在线学习的学生来说，能够使用可靠的网络极其重要。
collocations: extremely important｜极其重要 ; extremely difficult｜极其困难 ; extremely useful｜极其有用
tip_zh: 修饰可分程度的形容词或副词，语气强于very。

meanings_zh: phr v. 上交；递交
definition_en: to give something to a teacher or official
example1_en: Please hand in your homework before Friday.
example1_zh: 请在周五前交作业。
example2_en: She handed in her resignation yesterday.
example2_zh: 她昨天递交了辞职信。
tip_zh: hand in 是“上交”；give in 也含此义。

meanings_zh: n. 竞争对手 | n. 参赛者；选手
definition_en: A person or organisation trying to succeed against others. | Someone taking part in a competition.
example1_en: The new bakery is our biggest competitor for local customers.
example1_zh: 那家新面包店是我们争取本地顾客时最大的竞争对手。
example2_en: A business must understand its competitors before developing strategies to attract customers in an increasingly crowded market.
example2_zh: 企业必须了解竞争对手，才能制定策略，在日益拥挤的市场中吸引顾客。
collocations: a major competitor｜主要竞争对手 ; a direct competitor｜直接竞争对手 ; a strong competitor｜强劲的竞争者
tip_zh: competitor指竞争者；competition指竞争或比赛。

meanings_zh: v. 呼吸
definition_en: take air into your lungs and let it out
example1_en: Sit by the window and breathe slowly for a minute.
example1_zh: 坐在窗边，缓缓呼吸一分钟。
example2_en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
example2_zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。
collocations: breathe deeply｜深呼吸 ; breathe in｜吸气 ; breathe out｜呼气 ; breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip_zh: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

meanings_zh: v. 预测；预言
definition_en: To say what will happen, often using evidence.
example1_en: They predict heavy rain, so take your umbrella.
example1_zh: 他们预报有大雨，所以带上你的伞吧。
example2_en: Climate models help scientists predict how rising temperatures may affect agricultural production in different regions.
example2_zh: 气候模型帮助科学家预测气温上升可能如何影响不同地区的农业生产。
collocations: predict the outcome｜预测结果 ; accurately predict｜准确预测 ; difficult to predict｜难以预测
tip_zh: 可接that从句；不要与表示预防的prevent混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 使娱乐；使开心 | v. 招待；款待 | v. 考虑；心怀
definition_en: to keep someone interested or amused | to welcome guests and provide food, drink, or activities | to consider an idea or hold a thought or feeling
example1_en: My brother entertained the children with funny animal noises.
example1_zh: 我哥哥模仿动物发出滑稽的叫声，逗孩子们开心。
example2_en: Public museums should educate visitors as well as entertain them through engaging displays and interactive activities.
example2_zh: 公共博物馆应通过引人入胜的展览和互动活动，让参观者既获得知识又享受乐趣。
collocations: entertain an audience｜为观众提供娱乐 ; entertain guests｜招待客人 ; entertain the idea of｜考虑……的想法
tip_zh: entertain an idea指考虑某想法，并非已经接受。

meanings_zh: n. 生菜；莴苣
definition_en: a vegetable with leaves often eaten raw in salads
example1_en: Wash the lettuce before adding it to your sandwich.
example1_zh: 把生菜洗净后再夹进三明治里。
example2_en: Growing lettuce in urban gardens can give residents access to fresh food near their homes.
example2_zh: 在城市菜园种植生菜能让居民在家附近获得新鲜食材。
collocations: lettuce leaves｜生菜叶 ; a head of lettuce｜一棵生菜 ; crisp lettuce｜脆嫩的生菜
tip_zh: 指食材通常不可数；一棵生菜用a head of lettuce。

meanings_zh: adj. 自助式的 | n. 自助服务
definition_en: Requiring customers to serve themselves rather than wait for staff | A system in which customers serve themselves
example1_en: We carried our trays through the self-service cafeteria.
example1_zh: 我们端着托盘穿过了自助餐厅。
example2_en: Although self-service machines can shorten queues, businesses should retain staff to assist customers who need additional support.
example2_zh: 虽然自助机器能缩短队伍，但企业仍应保留员工，为需要额外帮助的顾客提供服务。
collocations: self-service checkout｜自助结账台 ; self-service cafeteria｜自助餐厅 ; self-service machine｜自助服务机
tip_zh: self-service强调顾客自己操作，不等于机器全自动。

meanings_zh: adj. 丑陋的；难看的 | adj. 令人不快的；险恶的
definition_en: Unpleasant to look at. | Unpleasant or threatening, especially involving anger or conflict.
example1_en: We hid the ugly pipes behind a wooden screen.
example1_zh: 我们用木制屏风遮住了那些难看的管道。
example2_en: Poorly planned developments can create ugly urban landscapes that reduce residents' satisfaction with their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 规划不善的开发项目可能形成难看的城市景观，降低居民对社区的满意度。
collocations: ugly building｜难看的建筑 ; ugly sight｜不堪入目的景象 ; turn ugly｜变得险恶 ; ugly confrontation｜激烈冲突
tip_zh: 比较级uglier，最高级ugliest；形容人外貌不礼貌。

meanings_zh: adj. 诚实的；正直的 | adj. 坦率的；真诚的
definition_en: Telling the truth and not cheating or stealing. | Expressing what you really think or feel.
example1_en: The honest cashier returned the money I had overpaid.
example1_zh: 那位诚实的收银员退还了我多付的钱。
example2_en: Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.
example2_zh: 教师与家长之间坦诚的沟通能帮助学校在学生的问题变得严重之前加以解决。
collocations: an honest person｜诚实的人 ; an honest answer｜坦率的回答 ; to be honest｜说实话
tip_zh: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

meanings_zh: n. 损坏；损害 | v. 损坏；损害
definition_en: Harm that makes something less useful, valuable, or healthy. | Harm something or make it less effective.
example1_en: The storm caused serious damage to our garden shed.
example1_zh: 暴风雨严重损坏了我们花园里的棚屋。
example2_en: Uncontrolled tourism can damage fragile ecosystems and reduce the quality of life for local residents.
example2_zh: 不受控制的旅游活动可能破坏脆弱的生态系统，并降低当地居民的生活质量。
collocations: cause damage｜造成损害 ; damage to property｜财产损坏 ; environmental damage｜环境破坏 ; damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip_zh: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

meanings_zh: n. 一段时间；时期 | n. 课时；一节课 | n. 月经；经期
definition_en: A length of time or a stage in history. | A scheduled length of time for a school lesson. | The monthly flow of blood from the uterus.
example1_en: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
example1_zh: 在那阵短暂的大雨期间，我们一直待在室内。
example2_en: A prolonged period of unemployment can affect both financial security and mental health.
example2_zh: 长期失业既会影响经济保障，也会影响心理健康。
collocations: a period of time｜一段时间 ; a transition period｜过渡期 ; a historical period｜历史时期 ; a heavy period｜月经量多
tip_zh: 表示一段时间常用a period of；美式英语也指句号。

meanings_zh: v. 逮捕；拘捕 | n. 逮捕；拘捕 | v. 阻止；使停止
definition_en: to take someone into police custody under legal authority | the act of taking someone into police custody | to stop the progress or development of something
example1_en: Police arrested the suspect outside the station yesterday.
example1_zh: 警方昨天在车站外逮捕了嫌疑人。
example2_en: Early investment in building maintenance can arrest the decline of historic neighbourhoods and preserve their distinctive character.
example2_zh: 尽早投入建筑维护资金可以遏制历史街区的衰落，并保留其独特风貌。
collocations: arrest someone for theft｜因盗窃逮捕某人 ; under arrest｜被捕 ; make an arrest｜实施逮捕 ; arrest the decline｜遏制衰退
tip_zh: 因某事被捕用be arrested for；under arrest表示被捕状态。

meanings_zh: adj. 逗人发笑的；有趣的
definition_en: funny or entertaining in a pleasant way
example1_en: My cousin told an amusing story about his cat.
example1_zh: 我表哥讲了一个关于他家猫的趣事。
example2_en: Teachers can use amusing examples to maintain students' attention while explaining difficult concepts in science lessons.
example2_zh: 教师可以在科学课上用有趣的例子吸引学生注意，同时解释难懂的概念。
collocations: amusing story｜有趣的故事 ; find something amusing｜觉得某事好笑 ; amusing anecdote｜趣闻
tip_zh: amusing形容事物逗人笑；amused形容人觉得好笑。

meanings_zh: phr. 着火；燃烧中
definition_en: burning
example1_en: The kitchen was on fire, so we called 119.
example1_zh: 厨房着火了，我们拨了119。
example2_en: The old barn caught on fire last night.
example2_zh: 昨晚旧谷仓着火了。
collocations: catch fire｜着火
tip_zh: catch fire 是“着火”；be on fire 是“正在燃烧”。

meanings_zh: adj. 感激的；感谢的
definition_en: Feeling thankful for kindness, help, or something good.
example1_en: I am grateful for your help with the move.
example1_zh: 谢谢你帮我搬家。
example2_en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
example2_zh: 许多学生感谢奖学金让他们即使经济困难也能继续学业。
collocations: grateful to someone｜感激某人 ; grateful for something｜感谢某事 ; deeply grateful｜深表感激
tip_zh: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

meanings_zh: n. 日出；日出时分
definition_en: The appearance of the sun above the horizon each morning.
example1_en: We woke early to watch the sunrise over the lake.
example1_zh: 我们早早醒来，观看湖上的日出。
example2_en: Outdoor activities scheduled around sunrise allow tourists to enjoy cooler temperatures and observe local wildlife.
example2_zh: 安排在日出前后的户外活动让游客能在较凉爽的气温下观赏当地野生动物。
collocations: at sunrise｜在日出时 ; watch the sunrise｜看日出 ; before sunrise｜日出前
tip_zh: 在日出时用at sunrise；日落是sunset。

meanings_zh: v. 躺；平放 | v. 说谎 | n. 谎言
definition_en: Rest with your body or an object in a flat position | Say something you know is not true | Something untrue that someone says deliberately
example1_en: I like to lie on the grass after lunch.
example1_zh: 我喜欢午饭后躺在草地上。
example2_en: Advertisements that lie about environmental benefits can undermine public trust and discourage genuinely sustainable purchasing decisions.
example2_zh: 就环保效益撒谎的广告会损害公众信任，并阻碍真正可持续的购买决策。
collocations: lie down｜躺下 ; lie awake｜躺着睡不着 ; lie to someone｜对某人说谎 ; tell a lie｜说谎
tip_zh: 躺：lie–lay–lain；说谎：lie–lied–lied。

meanings_zh: n. 塔；塔楼 | v. 高耸；远高于
definition_en: a tall, narrow structure, standing alone or on a building | rise much higher than nearby people or things
example1_en: We climbed the tower and watched boats cross the bay.
example1_zh: 我们爬上塔，看着船只驶过海湾。
example2_en: The historic tower attracts visitors throughout the year, providing valuable income for nearby shops and restaurants.
example2_zh: 这座历史悠久的塔全年吸引着游客，为附近的商店和餐馆带来可观收入。
collocations: a clock tower｜钟楼 ; a watch tower｜瞭望塔 ; tower above｜高耸于……之上 ; tower over｜远高于
tip_zh: 作动词常接over或above，表示远高于周围事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 愚蠢的；欠考虑的
definition_en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought.
example1_en: It was stupid to leave my umbrella at home.
example1_zh: 把伞留在家里真是太傻了。
example2_en: Calling students stupid can damage their confidence and discourage them from asking questions in class.
example2_zh: 说学生愚蠢会损害他们的信心，使他们不敢在课堂上提问。
collocations: a stupid mistake｜愚蠢的错误 ; a stupid idea｜愚蠢的主意 ; feel stupid｜觉得自己很傻
tip_zh: 直接说别人stupid带侮辱性，评价人时应避免。

meanings_zh: n. 骑自行车的人
definition_en: a person who rides a bicycle
example1_en: The cyclist stopped beside the bridge for water.
example1_zh: 那位骑自行车的人在桥边停下来喝水。
example2_en: Protected cycle lanes can reduce the risk of collisions between cyclists and motor vehicles in busy cities.
example2_zh: 在繁忙的城市中，有隔离设施的自行车道可以降低骑车者与机动车碰撞的风险。
collocations: commuter cyclist｜骑车通勤者 ; professional cyclist｜职业自行车运动员 ; cyclist safety｜骑车者安全
tip_zh: cyclist指骑自行车的人，不指骑摩托车的人。

meanings_zh: n. 熨烫（衣物）
definition_en: the job of making clothes smooth with an iron
example1_en: The ironing takes about half an hour.
example1_zh: 熨衣服大约需要半小时。
example2_en: She does the ironing on Sunday evenings.
example2_zh: 她周日晚熨衣服。
collocations: do the ironing｜熨衣服
tip_zh: do the ironing 是“熨衣服”；iron 是熨斗/熨烫。

meanings_zh: n. 幸福；快乐
definition_en: The feeling of being pleased or satisfied with life.
example1_en: Her face shone with happiness when the puppy arrived.
example1_zh: 小狗到来时，她的脸上洋溢着喜悦。
example2_en: Strong social connections often contribute more to lasting happiness than the purchase of expensive possessions.
example2_zh: 与购买昂贵物品相比，牢固的社会联系往往更能带来持久的幸福。
collocations: lasting happiness｜持久的幸福 ; personal happiness｜个人幸福 ; bring happiness｜带来快乐 ; a sense of happiness｜幸福感
tip_zh: 通常不可数：表达幸福用happiness，不加a。

meanings_zh: v. 康复；恢复 | v. 找回；重新获得
definition_en: return to health or a normal condition after difficulty | get back something lost, stolen, or spent
example1_en: It took several days to recover from the flu.
example1_zh: 流感过后，花了好几天才康复。
example2_en: Local economies often recover more quickly when governments provide timely support for small businesses.
example2_zh: 政府及时为小企业提供支持时，当地经济往往恢复得更快。
collocations: recover from an illness｜病后康复 ; fully recover｜完全恢复 ; recover lost data｜恢复丢失的数据 ; recover costs｜收回成本
tip_zh: 从疾病或挫折中恢复用recover from。

meanings_zh: n. 小号 | v. 大肆宣扬；鼓吹 | v. 发出喇叭般的声音
definition_en: A brass musical instrument with three valves and a bright sound. | To announce or praise something loudly and publicly. | To make a loud sound like an elephant's call.
example1_en: The musician lifted her trumpet and played a cheerful tune.
example1_zh: 那位乐手举起小号，吹奏了一支欢快的曲子。
example2_en: Learning the trumpet in a school orchestra can improve students' concentration and ability to cooperate with others.
example2_zh: 在学校管弦乐队学习小号可以提升学生的专注力及与他人合作的能力。
collocations: play the trumpet｜吹小号 ; trumpet player｜小号手 ; trumpet achievements｜大肆宣扬成就
tip_zh: 乐器义是“小号”；动词可指大肆宣扬。

meanings_zh: n. 网站主页
definition_en: The main page of a website, linking to other sections.
example1_en: The library's homepage has a photo of its new reading room.
example1_zh: 图书馆主页上有一张新阅览室的照片。
example2_en: A university homepage should provide clear access to course information, application guidance, and support services for international students.
example2_zh: 大学主页应提供清晰的入口，方便国际学生查看课程信息、申请指南及支持服务。
collocations: website homepage｜网站主页 ; homepage design｜主页设计 ; visit the homepage｜访问主页
tip_zh: 也可写作home page；不等于网站中的任意网页。

meanings_zh: adv. 百分之……
definition_en: For every hundred, used when expressing a proportion.
example1_en: I saved twenty percent on my new winter coat.
example1_zh: 我买新冬衣时省了百分之二十的钱。
example2_en: Nearly forty percent of surveyed residents supported investing more public money in cycling infrastructure.
example2_zh: 近百分之四十的受访居民支持将更多公共资金投入自行车基础设施。
collocations: ten percent of｜百分之十的 ; a five percent increase｜百分之五的增长 ; one hundred percent｜百分之百
tip_zh: 英式也写per cent；具体比例用percent。

meanings_zh: n. 所有者；物主
definition_en: A person or organisation that something belongs to.
example1_en: The owner of the bakery greets us every morning.
example1_zh: 面包店老板每天早上都向我们打招呼。
example2_en: Property owners should maintain their buildings to ensure the safety of tenants and nearby residents.
example2_zh: 房产业主应维护其建筑，确保租户和附近居民的安全。
collocations: business owner｜企业主 ; property owner｜房产业主 ; rightful owner｜合法所有者
tip_zh: 表示某物的所有者，用the owner of加名词。

meanings_zh: v. 撕破；扯开 | n. 眼泪 | n. 裂口；破洞
definition_en: To pull something apart or make a hole by pulling. | A drop of liquid that comes from your eye. | A hole or split caused by pulling something apart.
example1_en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
example1_zh: 小心别把纸袋撕破了。
example2_en: Thin plastic bags tear easily, making them less suitable for repeated use than durable cloth alternatives.
example2_zh: 薄塑料袋容易撕裂，因此不如耐用的布袋适合反复使用。
collocations: tear up paper｜撕碎纸张 ; burst into tears｜突然哭起来 ; tear apart｜撕开；扯碎
tip_zh: 撕裂读/teə/，眼泪读/tɪə/；动词变化为 tore、torn。

meanings_zh: adj. 简短的；短暂的 | v. 向……介绍情况 | n. 任务说明；工作要求
definition_en: Lasting a short time or using few words. | To give someone essential information or instructions. | Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.
example1_en: We took a brief break before finishing the puzzle.
example1_zh: 我们短暂休息了一下，然后完成了拼图。
example2_en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
example2_zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。
collocations: a brief summary｜简要总结 ; a brief pause｜短暂停顿 ; brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况 ; a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip_zh: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

meanings_zh: n. 标识；徽标
definition_en: a design or symbol that represents an organisation or product
example1_en: The bakery uses a wheat stalk as its logo.
example1_zh: 这家面包店用一支麦穗作为徽标。
example2_en: A distinctive logo helps consumers recognise a company, but product quality is essential for building lasting trust.
example2_zh: 独特的徽标帮助消费者识别企业，但产品质量才是建立持久信任的关键。
collocations: company logo｜公司徽标 ; design a logo｜设计徽标 ; distinctive logo｜独特的徽标
tip_zh: logo指视觉标识；slogan指宣传口号。

meanings_zh: n. 贷款；借款 | n. 借用；出借 | v. 借出；贷给
definition_en: money borrowed and expected to be paid back | the temporary use of something belonging to someone else | to give money or something temporarily, expecting its return
example1_en: We took out a loan to repair the roof.
example1_zh: 我们申请了一笔贷款来修屋顶。
example2_en: Affordable student loans can widen access to university, although repayment may create financial pressure after graduation.
example2_zh: 负担得起的学生贷款可以扩大大学入学机会，但毕业后的还款可能带来经济压力。
collocations: take out a loan｜申请贷款 ; repay a loan｜偿还贷款 ; student loan｜学生贷款 ; on loan｜借用中；出借中
tip_zh: loan作动词意为借出，不是借入。

meanings_zh: adj. 被禁止的；不准的
definition_en: not allowed by a rule, law, or authority
example1_en: Taking photos is forbidden inside this small museum.
example1_zh: 这家小博物馆内禁止拍照。
example2_en: In many protected areas, hunting is strictly forbidden to preserve wildlife populations and maintain ecological balance.
example2_zh: 在许多保护区，狩猎被严格禁止，以保护野生动物种群并维持生态平衡。
collocations: strictly forbidden｜严格禁止的 ; forbidden territory｜禁区 ; forbidden by law｜法律禁止的
tip_zh: 也是forbid的过去分词；过去式为forbade。

meanings_zh: n. 缺陷；故障 | n. 过错；责任 | n. 断层
definition_en: Something wrong with an object, system, or person's character | Responsibility for a mistake or something bad that happened | A break in rock where sections have moved apart
example1_en: A small electrical fault stopped the washing machine yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天一个小小的电路故障让洗衣机停止了运转。
example2_en: Regular inspections can identify a structural fault before it threatens the safety of residents.
example2_zh: 定期检查能在结构缺陷危及居民安全之前发现它。
collocations: electrical fault｜电路故障 ; at fault｜有过错 ; find fault with｜挑剔 ; fault line｜断层线
tip_zh: It's my fault表示“是我的错”，不用mistake替换。

meanings_zh: phr v. 拨号（上网/电话）
definition_en: to make a phone call by dialling
example1_en: In the past, computers used dial-up to go online.
example1_zh: 过去电脑用拨号上网。
example2_en: She dialled up her friend's number.
example2_zh: 她拨了朋友的号码。
tip_zh: dial up 原指“拨号上网/打电话”，现在主要说 dial。

meanings_zh: n. 包裹；邮包 | n. 一块土地 | v. 打包；分配
definition_en: an object wrapped for sending by post or delivery | a piece of land considered as a single unit | to wrap something, or divide it into portions for distribution
example1_en: A small parcel arrived for you this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上有个寄给你的小包裹到了。
example2_en: The growing volume of parcel deliveries has encouraged cities to explore cleaner transport options for local distribution.
example2_zh: 包裹配送量不断增长，促使城市探索更环保的本地配送方式。
collocations: send a parcel｜寄包裹 ; a parcel of land｜一块土地 ; parcel something up｜把某物包好 ; parcel something out｜分配某物
tip_zh: 包裹在英式英语中常用parcel，美式英语更常用package。

meanings_zh: n. 短语；词组；惯用语 | v. 措辞；用语言表达
definition_en: a group of words expressing an idea or forming a unit | to express something using particular words
example1_en: I learned a useful phrase in my English class today.
example1_zh: 今天我在英语课上学到了一个实用短语。
example2_en: Researchers must phrase survey questions carefully to avoid influencing participants and reducing the reliability of their findings.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须仔细斟酌调查问题的措辞，以免影响参与者并降低研究结果的可靠性。
collocations: a common phrase｜常见短语 ; a noun phrase｜名词短语 ; phrase a question｜为问题措辞 ; a useful phrase｜实用短语
tip_zh: phrase是短语，不一定构成完整句子。

meanings_zh: adj. 个人的；单独的 | n. 个人；个体 | adj. 独特的；有个性的
definition_en: Relating to one person or thing rather than a group | One person or living thing considered separately from others | Having qualities that make someone or something different from others
example1_en: The teacher gave each child an individual box of crayons.
example1_zh: 老师给每个孩子单独发了一盒彩色蜡笔。
example2_en: Education systems should recognise individual learning needs rather than expect every student to progress at the same pace.
example2_zh: 教育体系应重视个人的学习需求，而不是指望每个学生都以相同的速度进步。
collocations: individual needs｜个人需求 ; individual responsibility｜个人责任 ; individual differences｜个体差异 ; a talented individual｜有才华的人
tip_zh: 形容词强调单个或个人；作可数名词指一个人或个体。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全；彻底
definition_en: completely; in every way or to the fullest degree
example1_en: I totally forgot to bring my swimming costume.
example1_zh: 我完全忘了带泳衣。
example2_en: Online courses cannot totally replace classroom teaching because students also benefit from direct social interaction.
example2_zh: 在线课程无法完全取代课堂教学，因为学生也能从直接的社交互动中受益。
collocations: totally different｜完全不同 ; totally agree｜完全同意 ; totally unacceptable｜完全不可接受
tip_zh: 语气较强；正式写作中常可换用completely或entirely。

meanings_zh: v. 展示；陈列；显示 | n. 展览；陈列 | n. 显示屏
definition_en: Put something where people can see it | An arrangement of things for people to look at | A screen that shows information or images
example1_en: The bakery displays fresh cakes beside the front window.
example1_zh: 面包店把新鲜蛋糕陈列在前窗旁。
example2_en: Museums increasingly display everyday objects to illustrate how ordinary people lived in the past.
example2_zh: 博物馆越来越多地展示日常物品，以呈现过去普通人的生活方式。
collocations: on display｜在展出 ; display information｜显示信息 ; a colourful display｜色彩缤纷的陈列 ; digital display｜数字显示屏
tip_zh: on display意为“在展出”，中间不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 快乐；满足 | n. 乐事；令人愉快的经历
definition_en: A feeling of happiness or enjoyment | An activity or experience that brings enjoyment
example1_en: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
example1_zh: 她在阳台上种香草，从中获得很大的乐趣。
example2_en: Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆鼓励以阅读为乐，同时让各年龄段的人都能以低廉的成本获取知识。
collocations: take pleasure in｜从……中获得乐趣 ; for pleasure｜为了消遣 ; a great pleasure｜一大乐事 ; with pleasure｜乐意地
tip_zh: 快乐通常不可数；一件乐事可说a pleasure。

meanings_zh: adv. 不久；马上 | adv. 不耐烦地；生硬地
definition_en: After a short amount of time. | In a brief, unfriendly or impatient way.
example1_en: The bus will arrive shortly, so get your bag ready.
example1_zh: 公交车马上就到，把你的包准备好。
example2_en: Shortly after the new railway opened, local businesses reported a significant increase in customer visits.
example2_zh: 新铁路开通后不久，当地商家就报告称到店顾客显著增加。
collocations: arrive shortly｜很快到达 ; shortly after｜在……之后不久 ; shortly before｜在……之前不久
tip_zh: 表示“简要地”通常用briefly，不用shortly。

meanings_zh: n. 士兵；军人
definition_en: a person who serves in an army
example1_en: The soldier helped carry supplies across the flooded road.
example1_zh: 那名士兵帮忙把物资运过被洪水淹没的道路。
example2_en: Soldiers can support emergency services by delivering food and rescuing residents after major natural disasters.
example2_zh: 重大自然灾害发生后，军人可以通过运送食物和救助居民来支援应急部门。
collocations: serve as a soldier｜当兵服役 ; professional soldier｜职业军人 ; train soldiers｜训练士兵
tip_zh: 通常指陆军军人；水手和飞行员另有专称。

meanings_zh: n. 进步；进展 | v. 进步；逐步发展
definition_en: improvement or movement towards a goal | to improve or move towards a more advanced stage
example1_en: You have made real progress with your swimming.
example1_zh: 你的游泳水平确实有了进步。
example2_en: Regular feedback helps students monitor their progress and identify areas that require further practice.
example2_zh: 定期反馈有助于学生了解自己的进步，并找出需要进一步练习的方面。
collocations: make progress｜取得进步 ; steady progress｜稳步进展 ; in progress｜进行中
tip_zh: 名词不可数；动词重音后移，英音/prəˈɡres/。

meanings_zh: n. 饼干（英式用法） | n. 松软小圆面包（美式）
definition_en: a small, flat, crisp baked food, often sweet | a small, soft bread roll raised without yeast
example1_en: She dipped a biscuit into her warm tea.
example1_zh: 她把一块饼干浸进温热的茶里。
example2_en: Replacing sugary biscuits with fresh fruit can help children develop healthier eating habits over time.
example2_zh: 用新鲜水果代替高糖饼干，可以帮助儿童逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: chocolate biscuit｜巧克力饼干 ; a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干 ; biscuit tin｜饼干盒
tip_zh: 英式biscuit通常对应美式cookie；美式另指松软面包。

meanings_zh: n. 登记；注册；挂号 | n. 登记证；注册证明
definition_en: The process of officially recording details or joining something. | An official document showing that something has been registered.
example1_en: Registration for the swimming course opens on Monday.
example1_zh: 游泳课程将于周一开始报名。
example2_en: Online registration can improve access to public services, provided that support remains available for people without internet access.
example2_zh: 网上登记可以让公共服务更易获取，前提是仍为无法上网的人提供帮助。
collocations: online registration｜网上注册 ; registration fee｜报名费 ; vehicle registration｜车辆登记 ; registration form｜登记表
tip_zh: 表示报名或注册某活动，常用registration for。

meanings_zh: adj. 有导游的；有指导的
definition_en: led or supported by someone with knowledge or experience
example1_en: We joined a guided walk through the forest yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们参加了一次有向导带领的森林徒步。
example2_en: Guided learning can help students build confidence before they begin working independently on complex tasks.
example2_zh: 有指导的学习可以帮助学生建立信心，为独立完成复杂任务做好准备。
collocations: guided tour｜导览游 ; guided walk｜向导带领的徒步 ; guided learning｜有指导的学习
tip_zh: guided tour指有导游的游览；guided也是guide的过去分词。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人恶心的；令人反感的 | adj. 令人愤慨的；不可接受的
definition_en: extremely unpleasant, making you feel sick or strongly dislike something | so bad or wrong that it causes strong disapproval
example1_en: A disgusting smell came from the forgotten rubbish bag.
example1_zh: 那个被遗忘的垃圾袋散发出一股令人恶心的气味。
example2_en: Residents described the illegal dumping of waste beside their homes as disgusting and demanded immediate action.
example2_zh: 居民称在住宅旁非法倾倒垃圾的行为令人愤慨，并要求立即采取行动。
collocations: a disgusting smell｜令人恶心的气味 ; disgusting behaviour｜令人反感的行为 ; absolutely disgusting｜极其恶心的
tip_zh: disgusting形容事物令人反感；disgusted形容人感到反感。

meanings_zh: n. 桌布
definition_en: a cloth used to cover a table
example1_en: She spread a white table-cloth for dinner.
example1_zh: 她铺了一块白桌布准备吃晚饭。
example2_en: The table-cloth has a red pattern.
example2_zh: 这块桌布有红色图案。
tip_zh: table-cloth 是桌布；也拼作 tablecloth。

meanings_zh: conj. 每当；每次 | conj. 无论何时；随时 | adv. 究竟什么时候
definition_en: Every time that something happens. | At any time that something happens or is convenient. | Used in questions to express surprise about when something happened.
example1_en: Whenever I cook soup, my cat waits beside the stove.
example1_zh: 每当我煮汤时，我的猫就守在炉子旁边。
example2_en: Whenever cities expand, planners should consider how new developments will affect existing communities and local wildlife.
example2_zh: 每当城市扩张时，规划者都应考虑新开发项目将如何影响现有社区和当地野生动物。
collocations: whenever possible｜只要有可能 ; whenever necessary｜每当有必要时 ; whenever you like｜随你什么时候
tip_zh: 引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时，不用will。

meanings_zh: v. 预订；保留 | n. 储备；储备量 | n. 自然保护区
definition_en: Arrange to keep something for a particular person or purpose. | A supply kept for use when needed. | An area where wildlife and natural habitats are protected.
example1_en: Could you reserve a table for us tonight?
example1_zh: 你能帮我们预订今晚的餐桌吗？
example2_en: Governments should maintain adequate food reserves to protect vulnerable communities during periods of severe drought.
example2_zh: 政府应保持充足的粮食储备，以便在严重干旱期间保护脆弱群体。
collocations: reserve a table｜预订餐桌 ; reserve something for someone｜为某人保留某物 ; nature reserve｜自然保护区 ; oil reserves｜石油储量
tip_zh: 动词常用 reserve sth for sb；储量常用 reserves。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人困惑的；难懂的
definition_en: difficult to understand
example1_en: The instructions were confusing, so I asked for help.
example1_zh: 说明令人困惑，所以我求助了。
example2_en: The map is confusing; we took the wrong road.
example2_zh: 这张地图让人看不懂，我们走错路了。
tip_zh: confusing 形容事物“令人困惑”；confused 形容人“感到困惑”。

meanings_zh: n. 结尾；结局 | n. 词尾
definition_en: the final part of a story, event, or activity | a final word part that often shows grammatical information
example1_en: The film had a surprisingly cheerful ending for everyone.
example1_zh: 这部电影的结局出人意料，所有人都皆大欢喜。
example2_en: An ambiguous ending can encourage readers to question their assumptions and consider alternative interpretations of a novel.
example2_zh: 含义不明确的结局可以促使读者质疑自己的假设，并考虑对小说的其他解读。
collocations: a happy ending｜圆满结局 ; a surprise ending｜出人意料的结局 ; a verb ending｜动词词尾
tip_zh: 故事结局用ending；at the end表示在末尾。

meanings_zh: v. 支持；帮助；供养 | v. 支撑；承托 | n. 支持；援助；支撑
definition_en: to help, encourage, provide for, or agree with someone | to hold something up or bear its weight | help, encouragement, money, or something that holds another thing up
example1_en: My sister supports me whenever I try something new.
example1_zh: 每当我尝试新事物时，姐姐都会支持我。
example2_en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。
collocations: financial support｜资金支持 ; support a family｜养家 ; support an argument｜为论点提供依据 ; emotional support｜情感支持
tip_zh: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。

meanings_zh: n. 运动场；球场 | n. 音高 | v. 推介；推销
definition_en: An area of ground used for outdoor team sports. | How high or low a sound is. | Present an idea or product to persuade someone to accept it.
example1_en: The players ran onto the pitch despite the rain.
example1_zh: 尽管下着雨，球员们还是跑进了球场。
example2_en: Young entrepreneurs often pitch their business ideas to investors who can provide funding and practical guidance.
example2_zh: 年轻创业者经常向能够提供资金和实用指导的投资者推介商业构想。
collocations: football pitch｜足球场 ; high pitch｜高音 ; pitch an idea｜推介想法 ; pitch a tent｜搭帐篷
tip_zh: 球场义常见于英式英语；pitch a tent意为搭帐篷。

meanings_zh: n. 女士；夫人
definition_en: a polite word for an adult woman
example1_en: A kind lady helped me find the station.
example1_zh: 一位好心的女士帮我找到了车站。
example2_en: An elderly lady at the meeting explained how the new bus route had improved her daily life.
example2_zh: 会上，一位年长女士讲述了新公交线路如何改善她的日常生活。
collocations: an elderly lady｜一位年长女士 ; a young lady｜一位年轻女士 ; ladies and gentlemen｜女士们、先生们
tip_zh: woman是中性通用词；lady常用于礼貌称呼。

meanings_zh: adj. 凌乱的；不整洁的 | adj. 不爱收拾的
definition_en: not neat or well arranged | not keeping your belongings or surroundings neat
example1_en: Her untidy desk was covered with cups and notebooks.
example1_zh: 她凌乱的书桌上堆满了杯子和笔记本。
example2_en: Shared workspaces can quickly become untidy unless employees take responsibility for keeping communal areas clean and organised.
example2_zh: 如果员工不主动保持公共区域干净有序，共享办公空间很快就会变得凌乱。
collocations: an untidy room｜凌乱的房间 ; an untidy desk｜杂乱的书桌 ; untidy handwriting｜潦草的字迹
tip_zh: untidy强调不整齐，不一定像dirty那样有污垢。

meanings_zh: v. 影响 | v. 使感动；使悲伤
definition_en: to cause a change in someone or something | to cause someone to feel a strong emotion
example1_en: Too much coffee can affect how well you sleep.
example1_zh: 喝太多咖啡会影响你的睡眠质量。
example2_en: Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
example2_zh: 食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。
collocations: affect health｜影响健康 ; adversely affect｜产生不利影响 ; deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人 ; affect performance｜影响表现
tip_zh: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 兼职的；非全日制的 | adv. 兼职地；非全日制地
definition_en: Involving fewer hours than a full working or studying week. | For fewer hours than a full working or studying week.
example1_en: My sister has a part-time job at a bakery.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在一家面包店做兼职。
example2_en: Part-time employment allows university students to gain practical experience while continuing to focus on their studies.
example2_zh: 兼职工作让大学生能够在继续专注学业的同时积累实践经验。
collocations: a part-time job｜一份兼职工作 ; work part-time｜做兼职 ; a part-time course｜非全日制课程
tip_zh: 可作形容词或副词：a part-time job；work part-time。

meanings_zh: n. 主教座堂；大教堂
definition_en: The main church of a district led by a bishop.
example1_en: Sunlight streamed through the cathedral's beautiful stained glass windows.
example1_zh: 阳光透过大教堂美丽的彩色玻璃窗洒了进来。
example2_en: Restoring a historic cathedral can preserve traditional craftsmanship while attracting visitors who support the local economy.
example2_zh: 修复历史悠久的大教堂既能保护传统工艺，也能吸引游客，支持当地经济。
collocations: medieval cathedral｜中世纪大教堂 ; cathedral tower｜大教堂塔楼 ; cathedral restoration｜大教堂修复
tip_zh: 严格指主教驻地的教堂，并非所有大型教堂。

meanings_zh: n. 优势；有利条件 | n. 好处；益处
definition_en: Something that makes success more likely than for others. | A useful or positive feature of something.
example1_en: Your long arms give you an advantage in swimming.
example1_zh: 你的长手臂让你在游泳时更有优势。
example2_en: One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
example2_zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。
collocations: competitive advantage｜竞争优势 ; have an advantage over｜比……有优势 ; take advantage of｜利用；占……便宜 ; a major advantage｜一大优势
tip_zh: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人不快的；难受的 | adj. 不友善的；粗鲁的
definition_en: Causing discomfort, dislike, or unhappiness. | Behaving in an unfriendly or rude way.
example1_en: An unpleasant smell was coming from the kitchen bin.
example1_zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。
example2_en: Although commuting can be unpleasant, reliable public transport can reduce stress and improve the daily experience of workers.
example2_zh: 虽然通勤可能令人不快，但可靠的公共交通能减轻压力，改善上班族的日常体验。
collocations: an unpleasant smell｜难闻的气味 ; an unpleasant experience｜不愉快的经历 ; unpleasant side effects｜令人难受的副作用 ; unpleasant to someone｜对某人不友善
tip_zh: 形容事物表示令人不快；形容人常指态度不友善。

meanings_zh: n. 录音；录像 | n. 录制；记录
definition_en: sound or moving images saved for later listening or viewing | the process of saving sounds, images, or information
example1_en: We listened to a recording of birds during breakfast.
example1_zh: 早餐时，我们听了一段鸟鸣录音。
example2_en: Access to a lecture recording allows students to review difficult concepts at their own pace.
example2_zh: 能够获取讲座录像，让学生可以按自己的节奏复习难懂的概念。
collocations: make a recording｜录音；录像 ; recording studio｜录音棚 ; audio recording｜音频录音 ; accurate recording｜准确记录
tip_zh: 一段录音可数；表示录制过程时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 紧张的；绷紧的 | n. 时态 | v. 使绷紧；变得紧绷
definition_en: Nervous and unable to relax, or stretched tightly. | A verb form that indicates time. | To tighten muscles or become physically stiff.
example1_en: She looked tense while waiting outside the interview room.
example1_zh: 她在面试室外等候时显得很紧张。
example2_en: A tense working environment can reduce productivity and discourage employees from sharing creative ideas.
example2_zh: 紧张的工作环境可能降低生产效率，并使员工不愿分享创新想法。
collocations: feel tense｜感到紧张 ; a tense atmosphere｜紧张的气氛 ; past tense｜过去时 ; tense your muscles｜绷紧肌肉
tip_zh: 作名词指语法“时态”；作形容词指紧张或绷紧。

meanings_zh: n. 教练；指导教师 | n. 大学讲师（美国）
definition_en: Someone who teaches a particular skill or activity. | A teacher at an American college or university.
example1_en: Our swimming instructor showed us how to breathe properly.
example1_zh: 我们的游泳教练教我们如何正确呼吸。
example2_en: A qualified instructor can help older adults exercise safely and develop confidence in their physical abilities.
example2_zh: 合格的教练能帮助老年人安全锻炼，并增强他们对自身体能的信心。
collocations: driving instructor｜驾驶教练 ; qualified instructor｜合格的教练 ; fitness instructor｜健身教练
tip_zh: 常指教授驾驶、游泳等具体技能的人。

meanings_zh: n. 负载；装载量 | v. 装载；加载 | n. 工作量；负担
definition_en: something carried, or the amount a vehicle or person carries | to put goods into something or data into computer memory | the amount of work or responsibility someone must manage
example1_en: The donkey carried a heavy load up the hill.
example1_zh: 那头驴驮着沉重的货物上山。
example2_en: Sharing household tasks more equally can reduce the load on parents who also work full time.
example2_zh: 更公平地分担家务可以减轻还需全职工作的父母的负担。
collocations: a heavy load｜沉重的负载 ; load a truck｜给卡车装货 ; load data｜加载数据 ; a load of laundry｜一批待洗衣物
tip_zh: load A with B指把B装进A；卸货用unload。

meanings_zh: n. 照片；相片 | v. 拍摄；给……照相
definition_en: a picture made using a camera | to take a picture of someone or something using a camera
example1_en: This photograph shows my grandparents standing beside their first house.
example1_zh: 这张照片里，我的祖父母站在他们的第一所房子旁。
example2_en: Historical photographs provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
example2_zh: 历史照片为城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵的证据。
collocations: take a photograph｜拍照 ; a family photograph｜全家福 ; a black-and-white photograph｜黑白照片
tip_zh: 拍照用take a photograph，不用make。

meanings_zh: v. 出版；刊登 | v. 公布；发布
definition_en: to produce books or other writing for public reading | to make information officially available to the public
example1_en: The local magazine published my photograph of the river.
example1_zh: 当地杂志刊登了我拍摄的河流照片。
example2_en: Researchers should publish their findings openly so that policymakers can make decisions based on reliable evidence.
example2_zh: 研究人员应公开发表研究结果，让政策制定者能够依据可靠证据作出决策。
collocations: publish a book｜出版书籍 ; publish an article｜发表文章 ; publish findings｜公布研究结果 ; publish online｜在线发表
tip_zh: publish强调向公众发行或公布，不等于仅仅印刷。

meanings_zh: n. 调查；探究 | n. 询问；咨询
definition_en: a process of investigating facts or seeking knowledge | a request for information about something
example1_en: My inquiry about the missing parcel received a quick reply.
example1_zh: 我询问了丢失包裹的情况，很快就收到了回复。
example2_en: An independent inquiry into river pollution revealed serious weaknesses in the current system of environmental monitoring.
example2_zh: 一项针对河流污染的独立调查揭示了现行环境监测体系的严重缺陷。
collocations: public inquiry｜公开调查 ; inquiry into｜对……的调查 ; make an inquiry｜进行咨询 ; scientific inquiry｜科学探究
tip_zh: 调查某事用inquiry into；英式enquiry也常指咨询。

meanings_zh: n. 凉鞋
definition_en: A light shoe with straps that leaves much of the foot uncovered.
example1_en: A small stone got stuck inside my sandal.
example1_zh: 一颗小石子卡进了我的凉鞋里。
example2_en: In warm climates, sandals are popular because their open design allows air to circulate around the feet.
example2_zh: 在气候温暖的地区，凉鞋很受欢迎，因为其开放式设计能让脚部通风。
collocations: a pair of sandals｜一双凉鞋 ; leather sandals｜皮凉鞋 ; flat sandals｜平底凉鞋
tip_zh: 单只用sandal，一双用a pair of sandals。

meanings_zh: n. 兴趣；关注 | n. 利息 | v. 使感兴趣
definition_en: a desire to learn about or become involved in something | money paid for borrowing money or earned on savings | to make someone want to know or learn more
example1_en: My interest in cooking began in my grandmother's kitchen.
example1_zh: 我对烹饪的兴趣始于祖母的厨房。
example2_en: Schools can stimulate interest in science by giving students opportunities to conduct experiments and explore practical problems.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生有机会进行实验并探索实际问题，从而激发他们对科学的兴趣。
collocations: take an interest in｜对……产生兴趣 ; stimulate interest｜激发兴趣 ; interest rate｜利率 ; pay interest｜支付利息
tip_zh: 兴趣用interest in；具体爱好可用复数interests。

meanings_zh: n. 农田；耕地
definition_en: land used for farming
example1_en: The village is surrounded by green farmland.
example1_zh: 村庄被绿色的农田环绕。
example2_en: Farmland stretches to the hills in the distance.
example2_zh: 农田一直延伸到远处的山丘。
tip_zh: farmland 是耕地/农田。

meanings_zh: v. 收费；索价 | n. 费用；收费 | v. 给……充电
definition_en: Ask someone to pay a particular amount for something. | An amount of money requested for goods or services. | Put electrical energy into a battery or device.
example1_en: They charge extra if you want breakfast in your room.
example1_zh: 如果你想在房间里吃早餐，他们会额外收费。
example2_en: Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.
example2_zh: 收取门票的博物馆应提供优惠，以确保学生仍能享用文化资源。
collocations: charge a fee｜收取费用 ; free of charge｜免费 ; charge a battery｜给电池充电 ; in charge of｜负责；掌管
tip_zh: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。

meanings_zh: n. 悬崖；峭壁
definition_en: A high, very steep rock face, often beside the sea.
example1_en: We watched seabirds nesting halfway up the cliff.
example1_zh: 我们看着海鸟在悬崖半腰筑巢。
example2_en: Coastal erosion can weaken a cliff over time, putting nearby homes and walking routes at risk.
example2_zh: 海岸侵蚀会逐渐削弱悬崖的稳定性，危及附近的住宅和步行路线。
collocations: a cliff edge｜悬崖边缘 ; a sheer cliff｜陡直的悬崖 ; a cliff face｜峭壁表面 ; coastal cliffs｜海岸悬崖
tip_zh: cliff强调陡峭岩壁，不泛指山坡。

meanings_zh: n. 大使馆
definition_en: An official office representing a country in another country.
example1_en: I contacted the embassy after losing my passport abroad.
example1_zh: 在国外丢失护照后，我联系了大使馆。
example2_en: An embassy provides assistance to citizens overseas and helps maintain diplomatic relations between the two countries.
example2_zh: 大使馆为海外公民提供援助，并帮助维持两国间的外交关系。
collocations: contact the embassy｜联系大使馆 ; embassy staff｜大使馆工作人员 ; foreign embassy｜外国大使馆
tip_zh: embassy指大使馆；consulate指领事馆。

meanings_zh: n. 乱扔的垃圾 | v. 乱扔垃圾；使杂乱 | n. 一窝幼崽
definition_en: Waste left scattered in public places. | To leave rubbish or other objects scattered across a place. | A group of young animals born to one mother together.
example1_en: We picked up litter along the beach before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们沿着海滩捡垃圾。
example2_en: Reducing litter in urban parks requires convenient bins as well as sustained public education campaigns.
example2_zh: 减少城市公园里乱扔的垃圾，需要设置便于使用的垃圾桶，并持续开展公众教育活动。
collocations: drop litter｜乱扔垃圾 ; pick up litter｜捡垃圾 ; a litter of puppies｜一窝小狗
tip_zh: 垃圾义不可数；一窝幼崽用a litter of。

meanings_zh: adj. 定期的；经常的 | adj. 规则的；均匀的 | n. 常客
definition_en: Happening repeatedly, often with similar gaps between events. | Having an even shape, pattern, or arrangement. | Someone who often visits the same place.
example1_en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
example1_zh: 我们的狗需要经常散步，才能保持快乐和健康。
example2_en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic disease and improve overall wellbeing in older adults.
example2_zh: 规律运动可以降低老年人患慢性病的风险，并改善其整体身心健康。
collocations: regular exercise｜规律运动 ; at regular intervals｜每隔固定时间 ; a regular customer｜常客 ; a regular pattern｜规则的模式
tip_zh: regular侧重规律或经常，不等于持续不停的continuous。

meanings_zh: adj. 文化的；与文化有关的 | adj. 艺术的；文艺的
definition_en: relating to a group's customs, beliefs, and way of life | relating to activities such as music, literature, and theatre
example1_en: The festival celebrates the town's rich cultural traditions.
example1_zh: 这个节日颂扬小镇丰富的文化传统。
example2_en: Schools can promote cultural understanding by encouraging students to share their family traditions and experiences.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生分享家庭传统和经历，从而促进文化理解。
collocations: cultural heritage｜文化遗产 ; cultural diversity｜文化多样性 ; cultural differences｜文化差异 ; cultural activities｜文艺活动
tip_zh: cultural指文化相关；cultured形容人有修养。

meanings_zh: phr. 过期的；过时的
definition_en: no longer fresh, or no longer modern
example1_en: The milk is out of date; don't drink it.
example1_zh: 牛奶过期了，别喝。
example2_en: This old phone is out of date now.
example2_zh: 这部旧手机现在过时了。
tip_zh: out of date 是“过期/过时”；up to date 是“最新”。

meanings_zh: v. 接受；同意 | v. 承认；认可 | v. 承担；接受现实
definition_en: Agree to receive something or say yes to an offer | Recognize that something is true or valid | Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation
example1_en: I gladly accepted her invitation to dinner on Saturday.
example1_zh: 我欣然接受了她周六共进晚餐的邀请。
example2_en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
example2_zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。
collocations: accept an offer｜接受提议 ; accept responsibility｜承担责任 ; accept an invitation｜接受邀请 ; accept that｜承认……
tip_zh: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

meanings_zh: adv. 在国外；到国外
definition_en: in or to a foreign country
example1_en: My sister moved abroad and now lives near the sea.
example1_zh: 我姐姐移居国外，现在住在海边。
example2_en: Studying abroad can help students develop independence and gain a better understanding of other cultures.
example2_zh: 出国留学能帮助学生培养独立性，并更好地理解其他文化。
collocations: study abroad｜出国留学 ; go abroad｜出国 ; live abroad｜在国外生活 ; travel abroad｜出国旅行
tip_zh: abroad是副词：说go abroad，不说go to abroad。

meanings_zh: adj. 南部的；南方的
definition_en: Located in, coming from, or relating to the south.
example1_en: We spent a week exploring the island's southern coast.
example1_zh: 我们花了一周探索这座岛的南部海岸。
example2_en: Southern regions of the country may face longer droughts as rising temperatures increase pressure on water supplies.
example2_zh: 随着气温升高加大供水压力，该国南部地区可能面临更持久的干旱。
collocations: southern coast｜南部海岸 ; southern hemisphere｜南半球 ; southern regions｜南部地区 ; southern border｜南部边界
tip_zh: south中/ou/读/aʊ/，southern中的元音读/ʌ/。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；增加 | n. 增长；收益
definition_en: To obtain something useful or increase in amount. | An increase in something or a benefit received.
example1_en: You will gain confidence after a few lessons.
example1_zh: 上几节课后，你就会更有信心。
example2_en: Students can gain valuable practical experience by volunteering for projects that benefit their local communities.
example2_zh: 学生可以通过志愿参与有益于当地社区的项目，获得宝贵的实践经验。
collocations: gain experience｜积累经验 ; gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会 ; gain weight｜体重增加 ; financial gain｜经济收益
tip_zh: gain常接经验、信心等；赢比赛通常用win。

meanings_zh: v. 出席；参加；上学 | v. 处理；照料
definition_en: to go to an event or regularly visit an institution | to deal with something or care for someone
example1_en: My sister attends a dance class every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每周六上午都去上舞蹈课。
example2_en: Students who attend lectures regularly are more likely to understand difficult concepts and complete assignments successfully.
example2_zh: 经常听课的学生更有可能理解难懂的概念并顺利完成作业。
collocations: attend a meeting｜参加会议 ; attend school｜上学 ; attend to a problem｜处理问题
tip_zh: 参加活动直接接宾语；处理、照料用attend to。

meanings_zh: n. 计算机硬件 | n. 五金器具
definition_en: the physical parts of a computer or electronic system | tools and metal goods used for building and household repairs
example1_en: The technician replaced some old hardware inside my computer.
example1_zh: 技术员更换了我电脑里的一些旧硬件。
example2_en: Schools need reliable hardware and regular technical support to make digital learning accessible to all students.
example2_zh: 学校需要可靠的硬件和定期的技术支持，让所有学生都能参与数字化学习。
collocations: computer hardware｜计算机硬件 ; hardware store｜五金店 ; hardware upgrade｜硬件升级 ; hardware failure｜硬件故障
tip_zh: 不可数名词；hardware指硬件，software指软件。

meanings_zh: adj. 被禁止的
definition_en: Not allowed by a law or rule.
example1_en: Feeding the animals is prohibited at this wildlife park.
example1_zh: 这个野生动物园禁止给动物喂食。
example2_en: Private vehicles are prohibited in certain urban areas to improve air quality and protect pedestrians.
example2_zh: 某些城区禁止私家车通行，以改善空气质量并保护行人。
collocations: strictly prohibited｜严格禁止的 ; prohibited by law｜法律禁止的 ; prohibited items｜违禁物品
tip_zh: 也是prohibit的过去式和过去分词；禁止做某事用prohibit doing。

meanings_zh: n. 面包师
definition_en: a person who makes bread and cakes
example1_en: The baker makes fresh bread every morning.
example1_zh: 面包师每天早上做新鲜面包。
example2_en: She bought a cake from the local baker.
example2_zh: 她从当地面包师那里买了一个蛋糕。
tip_zh: baker 是面包师；bakery 是面包店。

meanings_zh: n. 交流；沟通；通信 | n. 函件；消息
definition_en: the process of sharing information, ideas, or feelings | a formal message sent to someone
example1_en: Clear communication helps us share the kitchen without arguments.
example1_zh: 清晰的沟通让我们共用厨房时不发生争执。
example2_en: Effective communication between healthcare professionals and patients can improve treatment outcomes and reduce misunderstandings.
example2_zh: 医护人员与患者之间的有效沟通可以改善治疗效果，减少误解。
collocations: communication skills｜沟通技巧 ; effective communication｜有效沟通 ; nonverbal communication｜非言语交流 ; a breakdown in communication｜沟通中断
tip_zh: 表交流通常不可数；表一封正式函件可数。

meanings_zh: phr. 买走食用；外带 | phr. 拿走；移除
definition_en: to buy prepared food and eat it somewhere else | to remove something from a place or person
example1_en: Could I have a vegetable sandwich to take away?
example1_zh: 请给我一个蔬菜三明治打包带走，好吗？
example2_en: Restaurants should offer reusable containers to customers who buy meals to take away, reducing packaging waste.
example2_zh: 餐馆应为购买外带餐食的顾客提供可重复使用的容器，以减少包装废弃物。
collocations: food to take away｜外带食品 ; take away the plates｜收走盘子 ; take away someone's rights｜剥夺某人的权利
tip_zh: take away是动词短语；外卖餐名词写takeaway。

meanings_zh: n. 交易；协议 | v. 处理；应付 | v. 分发；发牌
definition_en: an agreement between people or organisations, especially in business | to take action about a problem, usually with with | to give cards or other things to several people
example1_en: We got a good deal on our new sofa.
example1_zh: 我们以很划算的价格买到了新沙发。
example2_en: Governments must deal with housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
example2_zh: 政府必须通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通连接来应对住房短缺。
collocations: make a deal｜达成交易 ; deal with a problem｜处理问题 ; a great deal of｜大量的 ; deal cards｜发牌
