tip_zh: deal with表示处理；a great deal of后接不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 道歉；歉意
definition_en: words expressing regret for something wrong or hurtful
example1_en: I sent my neighbour an apology for the noise.
example1_zh: 我为制造噪声向邻居致歉。
example2_en: A sincere public apology can help organisations rebuild trust after mistakes, but practical changes are also necessary.
example2_zh: 犯错后，真诚的公开道歉有助于机构重建信任，但实际改进也不可或缺。
collocations: offer an apology｜表示歉意 ; accept an apology｜接受道歉 ; a sincere apology｜真诚的道歉 ; owe someone an apology｜应该向某人道歉
tip_zh: 向某人道歉用apology to someone for something。

meanings_zh: adj. 书面的；成文的 | v. 写（write的过去分词）
definition_en: Expressed in writing rather than speech. | Past participle of write.
example1_en: Please send written instructions so I can follow them.
example1_zh: 请把书面说明发来，方便我照着做。
example2_en: Written feedback allows students to review their mistakes and improve their performance over time.
example2_zh: 书面反馈让学生能够回顾错误，并逐步提高表现。
collocations: written permission｜书面许可 ; written agreement｜书面协议 ; written exam｜笔试 ; written feedback｜书面反馈
tip_zh: write的变化为write–wrote–written。

meanings_zh: n. 询问；咨询 | n. 调查；查究
definition_en: A question or request for information. | An organised attempt to discover facts about a matter.
example1_en: The receptionist answered my enquiry about the opening hours.
example1_zh: 接待员回答了我关于营业时间的询问。
example2_en: A public enquiry into the transport project could help explain why construction costs rose so sharply.
example2_zh: 对该交通项目开展公开调查，有助于解释建设成本为何大幅上涨。
collocations: make an enquiry｜进行咨询 ; enquiry about｜关于……的询问 ; public enquiry｜公开调查 ; enquiry desk｜问讯处
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数enquiries；美式通常写inquiry。

meanings_zh: adj. 空白的 | adj. 茫然的；无表情的 | n. 空白处
definition_en: having no writing, pictures, or other content | showing no understanding, feeling, or recognition | an empty space where information should be added
example1_en: She handed me a blank sheet and some pencils.
example1_zh: 她递给我一张白纸和几支铅笔。
example2_en: A blank page can encourage creative thinking by allowing learners to organise ideas without a fixed template.
example2_zh: 空白页面让学习者无需固定模板就能组织想法，从而有助于激发创造性思维。
collocations: a blank page｜空白页 ; a blank expression｜茫然的表情 ; fill in the blanks｜填空 ; go blank｜脑中一片空白
tip_zh: go blank可指脑中突然一片空白、想不起来。

meanings_zh: n. 闲暇；空闲时间
definition_en: Time when you are free from work or other duties.
example1_en: She spends most of her leisure time in the garden.
example1_zh: 她把大部分闲暇时间都花在花园里。
example2_en: Public parks provide affordable spaces for leisure, helping urban residents relax and maintain social connections.
example2_zh: 公共公园提供了经济实惠的休闲空间，帮助城市居民放松并维持社交联系。
collocations: leisure time｜闲暇时间 ; leisure activities｜休闲活动 ; leisure centre｜休闲健身中心 ; at your leisure｜在你方便时；从容地
tip_zh: leisure通常不可数；leisure time指闲暇时间。

meanings_zh: adj. 基本的；基础的 | adj. 简单的；无额外设施的
definition_en: Forming the main or most necessary part of something. | Having only necessary features, without anything extra.
example1_en: This course teaches basic cooking skills to complete beginners.
example1_zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技能。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.
example2_zh: 政府应确保所有公民都能获得基本医疗服务，不论其收入如何。
collocations: basic skills｜基本技能 ; basic needs｜基本需求 ; basic knowledge｜基础知识 ; basic principles｜基本原则
tip_zh: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

meanings_zh: adj. 准备好的；有准备的 | adj. 愿意的
definition_en: Ready to deal with something because of previous planning. | Willing to do something, especially something difficult or unpleasant.
example1_en: With spare batteries packed, we were prepared for a blackout.
example1_zh: 备用电池已经备好，我们做好了应对停电的准备。
example2_en: Graduates who gain practical experience are often better prepared for the demands of a competitive labour market.
example2_zh: 有实践经验的毕业生往往更能应对竞争激烈的劳动力市场的要求。
collocations: prepared for emergencies｜做好应急准备的 ; fully prepared｜准备充分的 ; prepared to compromise｜愿意妥协的
tip_zh: prepared for接名词；prepared to do可表愿意。

meanings_zh: n. 进入；进入权 | n. 条目；记录 | n. 参赛作品；参赛者
definition_en: The act of entering, or permission to enter a place. | An individual item in a list, diary, or reference work. | A work or person submitted for a competition.
example1_en: Entry to the swimming pool is free today.
example1_zh: 今天进入游泳池免费。
example2_en: Strict entry requirements may prevent capable students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education opportunities.
example2_zh: 严格的入学要求可能使来自弱势背景的优秀学生无法获得高等教育机会。
collocations: entry requirements｜入学要求；准入条件 ; free entry｜免费入场 ; diary entry｜一则日记 ; competition entry｜参赛作品
tip_zh: 进入某处常用entry to；具体入口通常用entrance。

meanings_zh: adj. 公众的；公用的；公开的 | adj. 政府的；公立的 | n. 公众；民众
definition_en: For everyone to use, see, or know about. | Provided or controlled by the government. | Ordinary people in society considered as a group.
example1_en: The public garden stays open until sunset every day.
example1_zh: 这座公共花园每天开放到日落。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通可以让人们更方便地上班，同时减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: public transport｜公共交通 ; public services｜公共服务 ; the general public｜普通民众 ; in public｜在公共场合
tip_zh: the public指公众；in public指在公共场合。

meanings_zh: v. 需要 | v. 要求；规定
definition_en: To need something for a particular purpose | To make something necessary through a rule or instruction
example1_en: These plants require plenty of sunlight and regular watering.
example1_zh: 这些植物需要充足的阳光和定期浇水。
example2_en: Governments should require manufacturers to provide clear instructions for repairing products rather than replacing them.
example2_zh: 政府应要求制造商提供清晰的产品维修说明，以鼓励维修而非更换。
collocations: require assistance｜需要帮助 ; require attention｜需要关注 ; be required to do something｜被要求做某事 ; require further investigation｜需要进一步调查
tip_zh: require sb to do sth表示要求某人做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 跳高
definition_en: a sport where you jump over a high bar
example1_en: She won the high jump at the sports day.
example1_zh: 她在运动会上赢得了跳高冠军。
example2_en: The high jump needs strong legs.
example2_zh: 跳高需要强壮的腿部力量。
tip_zh: high jump 是跳高；long jump 是跳远。

meanings_zh: n. 十字路口
definition_en: a place where two roads cross
example1_en: Turn left at the crossroads.
example1_zh: 在十字路口向左转。
example2_en: There is a shop at the crossroads.
example2_zh: 十字路口有一家商店。
tip_zh: crossroads 单复数同形；at the crossroads 在十字路口。

meanings_zh: n. 态度；看法
definition_en: how you think or feel about someone or something
example1_en: His cheerful attitude makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
example1_zh: 他乐观的态度让下雨的早晨也显得明朗起来。
example2_en: Schools can encourage a positive attitude towards learning by giving students constructive feedback rather than constant criticism.
example2_zh: 学校可以给予学生建设性的反馈，而非不断批评，以培养积极的学习态度。
collocations: positive attitude｜积极的态度 ; attitude towards｜对……的态度 ; change of attitude｜态度的转变 ; public attitudes｜公众态度
tip_zh: 对某事的态度常用attitude to或towards。

meanings_zh: n. 套头毛衣
definition_en: a sweater you pull over your head
example1_en: He wore a warm pullover in winter.
example1_zh: 冬天他穿一件保暖套头毛衣。
example2_en: This grey pullover is my favourite.
example2_zh: 这件灰色套头毛衣是我的最爱。
tip_zh: pullover 是套头毛衣；美式说 sweater。

meanings_zh: n. 酒吧；饮品吧台 | n. 条；棒；长条块 | v. 禁止；阻止
definition_en: a place or counter where drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, are served | a long narrow piece of solid material | to officially prevent someone from entering or doing something
example1_en: We ordered fresh orange juice at the hotel bar.
example1_zh: 我们在酒店的酒吧点了鲜榨橙汁。
example2_en: Sports centres should not bar residents from using essential facilities simply because they cannot afford membership fees.
example2_zh: 体育中心不应仅因居民付不起会员费，就禁止他们使用基本设施。
collocations: a hotel bar｜酒店酒吧 ; a bar of chocolate｜一条巧克力 ; metal bars｜金属棒 ; bar someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事
tip_zh: 表禁止用bar sb from doing；过去式barred。

meanings_zh: n. 赛车（运动）
definition_en: the sport of racing cars
example1_en: Motor-racing is a dangerous but exciting sport.
example1_zh: 赛车是一项危险但刺激的运动。
example2_en: He watches motor-racing on TV every weekend.
example2_zh: 他每周末在电视上看赛车。
tip_zh: motor-racing 是赛车运动，车手叫 racing driver。

meanings_zh: n. 选择；选择权 | n. 可选之物；选择范围 | adj. 优质的；精选的
definition_en: the act or freedom of choosing between different possibilities | something you can choose, or the range of available options | of especially good quality
example1_en: You have a choice between soup and salad.
example1_zh: 你可以在汤和沙拉之间选择。
example2_en: Reliable public transport gives commuters a wider choice and reduces their dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 可靠的公共交通为通勤者提供更多选择，并减少他们对私家车的依赖。
collocations: make a choice｜作出选择 ; have no choice｜别无选择 ; a wide choice of｜种类丰富的 ; freedom of choice｜选择自由
tip_zh: choice是名词，choose是动词；选择做某事用choose to do。

meanings_zh: n. 西北方；西北部 | adj. 西北部的；来自西北的 | adv. 向西北；在西北
definition_en: The direction between north and west, or an area's northwestern part. | Located in the northwest, or coming from that direction. | Towards or in the direction between north and west.
example1_en: Our cabin is in the northwest of the island.
example1_zh: 我们的小木屋位于岛的西北部。
example2_en: Investment in rail networks could improve access to employment for communities in the northwest of the country.
example2_zh: 对铁路网的投资可以为该国西北部的社区提供更多就业便利。
collocations: in the northwest｜在西北部 ; head northwest｜向西北行进 ; a northwest wind｜西北风
tip_zh: 西北风从西北吹来；向西北走用head northwest。

meanings_zh: n. （节目）主持人
definition_en: a person who introduces a TV or radio show
example1_en: The presenter welcomed the guests on the show.
example1_zh: 主持人在节目里欢迎嘉宾。
example2_en: She works as a news presenter.
example2_zh: 她是一名新闻主持人。
tip_zh: presenter 是节目主持人；host 也指主持人。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人震惊的
definition_en: very surprising and upsetting
example1_en: The news about the accident was shocking.
example1_zh: 关于事故的消息令人震惊。
example2_en: It is shocking how much plastic is in the sea.
example2_zh: 海里塑料之多令人震惊。
tip_zh: shocking 形容事物；shocked 形容人的感受。

meanings_zh: n. 戏剧；戏剧艺术 | n. 戏剧性事件；激动场面
definition_en: Plays and the art of writing or performing them. | An exciting or emotional event or situation.
example1_en: Our drama group rehearses in the hall every Thursday.
example1_zh: 我们的戏剧小组每周四在大厅排练。
example2_en: Teaching drama in schools can develop students' confidence and encourage them to consider different perspectives.
example2_zh: 在学校教授戏剧可以培养学生的自信，并鼓励他们从不同角度思考。
collocations: drama club｜戏剧社 ; television drama｜电视剧 ; study drama｜学习戏剧 ; historical drama｜历史剧
tip_zh: 戏剧艺术用不可数drama；一部戏剧用a drama。

meanings_zh: v. 放松；休息 | v. 放松肌肉；松弛 | v. 放宽；放松限制
definition_en: To become calm and comfortable, or make someone feel this way. | To make muscles less tight, or become less tight. | To make rules or restrictions less strict.
example1_en: I like to relax with music after dinner.
example1_zh: 我喜欢晚饭后听音乐放松。
example2_en: Regular access to green spaces helps urban residents relax and may improve their overall mental health.
example2_zh: 经常接触绿地有助于城市居民放松，也可能改善他们的整体心理健康。
collocations: relax your muscles｜放松肌肉 ; relax restrictions｜放宽限制 ; sit back and relax｜靠着坐好并放松
tip_zh: 人感到放松用relaxed；事物令人放松用relaxing。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓舞；激励 | v. 赋予灵感；启发 | v. 激起；唤起
definition_en: to make someone feel eager and able to do something | to give someone an idea for something creative | to cause a particular feeling in someone
example1_en: Our coach inspired us to try again after losing.
example1_zh: 输掉比赛后，教练鼓励我们再试一次。
example2_en: Teachers who connect lessons with real problems can inspire students to pursue careers in science.
example2_zh: 将课程与实际问题联系起来的教师能够激励学生投身科学事业。
collocations: inspire someone to act｜激励某人行动 ; inspire confidence｜激发信心 ; inspire creativity｜激发创造力 ; be inspired by nature｜从自然中获得灵感
tip_zh: 常用 inspire sb to do sth，表示激励某人做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 位置；地点 | n. 外景拍摄地
definition_en: The place where something is or where something happens. | A place outside a studio where filming takes place.
example1_en: This cafe has a lovely location beside the river.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆坐落在河边，位置很不错。
example2_en: The location of affordable housing strongly influences residents' access to schools, healthcare, and employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 保障性住房的位置会显著影响居民获得教育、医疗服务和就业机会的便利程度。
collocations: central location｜中心位置 ; ideal location｜理想地点 ; on location｜在外景地 ; exact location｜确切位置
tip_zh: on location指在摄影棚外实地拍摄。

meanings_zh: n. 问卷；调查表
definition_en: A set of written questions used to collect information from people.
example1_en: Please complete this short questionnaire before leaving the clinic.
example1_zh: 离开诊所前，请填写这份简短的问卷。
example2_en: Researchers distributed a questionnaire to investigate how commuting time affects workers' wellbeing and satisfaction with their jobs.
example2_zh: 研究人员发放了问卷，调查通勤时间如何影响员工的幸福感和工作满意度。
collocations: complete a questionnaire｜填写问卷 ; design a questionnaire｜设计问卷 ; distribute a questionnaire｜发放问卷 ; questionnaire responses｜问卷回答
tip_zh: 双n，重音在末尾；survey指调查，问卷只是其工具。

meanings_zh: n. 舌头 | n. 语言
definition_en: the soft organ in your mouth used for tasting and speaking | a language used by a particular community
example1_en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
example1_zh: 我喝热汤时烫到了舌头。
example2_en: Children who receive early education in their mother tongue may develop stronger foundations for learning other languages.
example2_zh: 用母语接受早期教育的儿童，可能为学习其他语言打下更牢固的基础。
collocations: mother tongue｜母语 ; stick out your tongue｜伸出舌头 ; bite your tongue｜忍住不说 ; on the tip of your tongue｜话到嘴边却想不起来
tip_zh: tongue指语言多见于mother tongue等搭配。

meanings_zh: n. 运动套装
definition_en: a jacket and trousers worn for sport
example1_en: He wears a tracksuit for morning running.
example1_zh: 他穿运动套装晨跑。
example2_en: The team trained in matching tracksuits.
example2_zh: 队员们穿着配套的运动套装训练。
tip_zh: tracksuit 是运动服套装（上衣+裤子）。

meanings_zh: n. 蚂蚁
definition_en: A small insect that lives in organised groups.
example1_en: An ant carried a crumb across the kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 一只蚂蚁叼着面包屑爬过厨房地板。
example2_en: Ants contribute to healthy ecosystems by moving seeds and improving the structure of soil.
example2_zh: 蚂蚁通过搬运种子和改善土壤结构，促进生态系统健康。
collocations: an ant colony｜蚁群 ; an ant nest｜蚁巢 ; worker ants｜工蚁
tip_zh: ant是可数名词；一只蚂蚁用an ant。

meanings_zh: n. 标签；标牌 | v. 贴标签于；标注 | v. 给…定性；将…归类
definition_en: a small attached piece giving information about something | to attach information to something for identification | to describe someone or something in a particular way
example1_en: Check the label before you wash your new sweater.
example1_zh: 洗新毛衣之前，先看看标签。
example2_en: Schools should avoid labelling children as failures, since this can damage their confidence and motivation.
example2_zh: 学校应避免给孩子贴上失败者的标签，因为这会损害他们的信心和学习动力。
collocations: read the label｜阅读标签 ; food label｜食品标签 ; label someone as｜将某人定性为
tip_zh: 英式过去式labelled，美式常用labeled。

meanings_zh: n. 铁路（美式）
definition_en: the railway system (American English)
example1_en: The railroad crosses the whole country.
example1_zh: 这条铁路贯穿全国。
example2_en: They took photos of the old railroad station.
example2_zh: 他们拍了旧火车站的照片。
tip_zh: railroad 是美式说法；英式说 railway。

meanings_zh: v. 提高；举起 | v. 筹集 | v. 养育；饲养
definition_en: to move something higher or increase its amount or level | to collect money for a particular purpose | to care for children or animals as they grow
example1_en: Please raise your hand if you need another pencil.
example1_zh: 如果你还需要一支铅笔，请举手。
example2_en: Community events can raise funds for conservation projects while helping residents understand local environmental challenges.
example2_zh: 社区活动可以为自然保护项目筹集资金，同时帮助居民了解当地的环境问题。
collocations: raise awareness｜提高认识 ; raise funds｜筹集资金 ; raise a child｜养育孩子 ; raise a question｜提出问题
tip_zh: raise是及物动词，后接宾语；rise表示自身上升。

meanings_zh: v. 喂养；进食 | n. 动物饲料 | n. 信息流
definition_en: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food. | Food given to farm animals. | A regularly updated stream of online content.
example1_en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
example1_zh: 请在上学前喂一下猫。
example2_en: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
example2_zh: 学校供餐计划帮助那些家庭无法持续负担营养食物的儿童吃上饭。
collocations: feed the animals｜喂动物 ; feed on insects｜以昆虫为食 ; animal feed｜动物饲料 ; news feed｜新闻信息流
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为fed；feed on表示以……为食。

meanings_zh: v. 后悔；对……感到遗憾 | n. 后悔；遗憾
definition_en: to feel sorry about something that happened or was done | sadness about a past action, decision, or situation
example1_en: I regret leaving my umbrella at home this morning.
example1_zh: 我后悔今天早上把伞留在了家里。
example2_en: Graduates may regret choosing a career solely for its salary if the work provides little personal satisfaction.
example2_zh: 如果工作难以带来个人满足感，毕业生可能会后悔仅凭薪水选择职业。
collocations: regret doing something｜后悔做过某事 ; deep regret｜深深的遗憾 ; express regret｜表示遗憾 ; regret to inform｜遗憾地告知
tip_zh: regret doing指后悔做过；regret to say指遗憾告知。

meanings_zh: v. 编织；针织 | v. 使紧密结合；愈合
definition_en: to make clothing or fabric by looping yarn with needles | to join closely together or heal into one piece
example1_en: My grandfather knitted a warm scarf for me.
example1_zh: 我爷爷给我织了一条暖和的围巾。
example2_en: Community groups that knit blankets for local shelters combine practical support with opportunities for social interaction.
example2_zh: 为当地收容所编织毯子的社区团体，将实际援助与社交机会结合起来。
collocations: knit a sweater｜织毛衣 ; knit together｜紧密结合；愈合 ; knit your brows｜皱眉
tip_zh: k不发音；过去式和过去分词可用knitted或knit。

meanings_zh: adj. 松动的；未固定的 | adj. 宽松的 | adj. 不严密的；不严格的
definition_en: not firmly attached or held in place | not fitting closely around the body | not exact or strictly controlled
example1_en: One loose screw made the whole chair feel shaky.
example1_zh: 一颗松动的螺丝让整把椅子都摇晃起来。
example2_en: Loose regulations on industrial waste can allow harmful substances to enter rivers and damage local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 对工业废物监管不严，可能导致有害物质进入河流，破坏当地生态系统。
collocations: loose screw｜松动的螺丝 ; loose clothing｜宽松的衣服 ; loose connection｜松动的连接 ; break loose｜挣脱
tip_zh: loose是形容词，尾音/s/；lose是动词，尾音/z/。

meanings_zh: n. 工会 | n. 联合；联盟
definition_en: an organisation that protects workers' rights and interests | the joining of people or groups, or the resulting organisation
example1_en: The union helped staff negotiate better working hours.
example1_zh: 工会帮助员工协商争取到了更合理的工作时间。
example2_en: Joining a union can give employees greater influence over decisions concerning workplace safety and fair pay.
example2_zh: 加入工会能让员工在涉及工作场所安全和公平薪酬的决策中拥有更大的影响力。
collocations: join a union｜加入工会 ; trade union｜工会 ; union representative｜工会代表 ; political union｜政治联盟
tip_zh: union以辅音/j/开头，因此说a union而非an union。

meanings_zh: n. 瀑布
definition_en: Water falling from a height over a steep rock face
example1_en: We could hear the waterfall long before we saw it.
example1_zh: 还没看见瀑布，我们就远远听到了水声。
example2_en: Tourism near a waterfall can support local businesses, but visitor facilities should protect the surrounding natural habitat.
example2_zh: 瀑布附近的旅游业可以带动当地商业，但游客设施应保护周围的自然栖息地。
collocations: a spectacular waterfall｜壮观的瀑布 ; the base of a waterfall｜瀑布底部 ; a cascading waterfall｜飞流而下的瀑布
tip_zh: 可数名词：一处瀑布用a waterfall。

meanings_zh: n. 逗号
definition_en: A punctuation mark separating parts of a sentence or list.
example1_en: I added a comma to make the sentence clearer.
example1_zh: 我加了一个逗号，让句子更清楚。
example2_en: A misplaced comma can change the meaning of a sentence and confuse readers of academic writing.
example2_zh: 位置不当的逗号可能改变句意，使学术文章的读者产生困惑。
collocations: add a comma｜加逗号 ; a misplaced comma｜位置不当的逗号 ; separate items with commas｜用逗号分隔各项
tip_zh: comma是逗号，句号通常叫full stop（英）或period（美）。

meanings_zh: adj. 辛辣的；加香料的
definition_en: containing spices, often with a strong, hot flavour
example1_en: The noodles were too spicy, so I ordered rice.
example1_zh: 面条太辣了，所以我点了米饭。
example2_en: Traditional spicy dishes can attract visitors who want to experience the distinctive flavours of a region.
example2_zh: 传统的辛辣菜肴能吸引想要体验当地独特风味的游客。
collocations: spicy food｜辛辣食物 ; spicy sauce｜辣味酱汁 ; mildly spicy｜微辣的
tip_zh: spicy指香料味浓或辣；hot也可指温度高。

meanings_zh: n. 签证
definition_en: Official permission to enter or stay in a foreign country.
example1_en: My student visa arrived just before the flight.
example1_zh: 我的学生签证在起飞前不久才办下来。
example2_en: Simpler visa procedures can encourage international students to study abroad and contribute to local economies.
example2_zh: 简化签证手续可以鼓励国际学生出国留学，并为当地经济作出贡献。
collocations: apply for a visa｜申请签证 ; student visa｜学生签证 ; visa application｜签证申请 ; visa requirements｜签证要求
tip_zh: visa是签证，passport是护照；通常需凭护照申请签证。

meanings_zh: n. 电源插头 | n. 塞子 | v. 堵住；塞住
definition_en: A device connecting electrical equipment to a power socket. | An object fitted into a hole to stop liquid escaping. | To fill or block a hole or gap.
example1_en: Pull the plug out before you clean the toaster.
example1_zh: 清洁烤面包机前，先拔掉插头。
example2_en: Households can reduce some unnecessary electricity consumption by removing plugs from sockets when appliances are not in use.
example2_zh: 家电不用时拔掉插头，家庭就能减少一些不必要的耗电。
collocations: pull out the plug｜拔出插头 ; plug something in｜给某物接通电源 ; bath plug｜浴缸塞 ; plug a gap｜填补缺口
tip_zh: 插头是plug，插座是socket；plug in表示插电。

meanings_zh: v. 漂浮；浮动 | v. 提出供考虑 | n. 游行彩车
definition_en: To stay on a liquid's surface or move gently through air. | To suggest an idea for others to consider. | A decorated vehicle used in a parade.
example1_en: A yellow leaf floated gently across the garden pond.
example1_zh: 一片黄叶轻轻漂过花园里的池塘。
example2_en: Researchers have floated the idea of using artificial islands to provide additional housing in crowded coastal cities.
example2_zh: 研究人员提出了利用人工岛为拥挤的沿海城市提供更多住房的想法。
collocations: float on water｜浮在水面上 ; float an idea｜提出一个想法 ; float downstream｜顺流漂下 ; parade float｜游行彩车
tip_zh: float an idea是提出想法供讨论，并非实施。

meanings_zh: v. 摧毁；毁灭 | v. 彻底破坏；使丧失
definition_en: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used. | To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.
example1_en: A sudden storm destroyed the old shed behind our house.
example1_zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雨摧毁了我们屋后的旧棚子。
example2_en: Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.
example2_zh: 不受控制的城市扩张会摧毁自然栖息地，威胁依赖这些栖息地的物种生存。
collocations: destroy habitats｜摧毁栖息地 ; destroy evidence｜销毁证据 ; destroy confidence｜摧毁信心 ; completely destroy｜彻底摧毁
tip_zh: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

meanings_zh: n. 小虫；昆虫 | n. 程序错误；故障 | v. 烦扰；使恼火
definition_en: a small insect or similar creature | an error in a computer program that causes problems | to annoy someone, especially repeatedly
example1_en: A tiny green bug landed on my sleeve.
example1_zh: 一只绿色小虫落在了我的袖子上。
example2_en: A software bug can disrupt essential services, highlighting the importance of thorough testing before release.
example2_zh: 软件错误可能导致基本服务中断，这凸显了发布前进行全面测试的重要性。
collocations: a software bug｜软件错误 ; fix a bug｜修复程序错误 ; a tiny bug｜一只小虫
tip_zh: 口语中bug可泛指小虫；技术语境常指程序错误。

meanings_zh: n. 生理性别 | n. 性行为 | v. 辨别性别
definition_en: Biological classification based on reproductive and other physical characteristics. | Physical activity involving sexual intimacy. | To identify the biological sex of an animal.
example1_en: The vet checked the sex of our new kitten.
example1_zh: 兽医检查了我们新养的小猫的性别。
example2_en: Researchers examined whether biological sex influenced participants' responses to the treatment in the clinical study.
example2_zh: 研究人员在临床研究中考察了生理性别是否影响参与者对治疗的反应。
collocations: biological sex｜生理性别 ; sex differences｜性别差异 ; sex education｜性教育 ; determine the sex｜确定性别
tip_zh: sex偏重生理性别；gender常侧重社会性别。

meanings_zh: n. 病毒 | n. 计算机病毒
definition_en: A tiny infectious agent that reproduces inside living cells | Harmful computer code that spreads by infecting files or programs
example1_en: The doctor said a virus was causing my cough.
example1_zh: 医生说我的咳嗽是由病毒引起的。
example2_en: Public health campaigns can limit the spread of a virus by encouraging vaccination and regular handwashing.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传可以通过鼓励接种疫苗和经常洗手来限制病毒传播。
collocations: spread a virus｜传播病毒 ; computer virus｜计算机病毒 ; virus infection｜病毒感染
tip_zh: virus是病毒，bacterium是细菌；两者不能混用。

meanings_zh: adj. 朴素的；无装饰的 | adj. 清楚的；明显的 | n. 平原
definition_en: simple, without decoration or a pattern | easy to see or understand | a large area of flat land
example1_en: She chose a plain white shirt for the interview.
example1_zh: 她选了一件朴素的白衬衫去参加面试。
example2_en: Public health advice should use plain language so that everyone can understand essential information.
example2_zh: 公共卫生建议应使用浅显的语言，让每个人都能理解关键信息。
collocations: plain clothes｜便服 ; plain language｜浅显的语言 ; a coastal plain｜沿海平原
tip_zh: plain可指无花纹；平原用名词plain。

meanings_zh: n. 影响；效果 | v. 实现；使发生
definition_en: A change or result caused by something. | To bring about a change or result.
example1_en: The new curtains had a calming effect on the room.
example1_zh: 新窗帘让房间的氛围变得宁静了。
example2_en: Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.
example2_zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，提高停车费对交通状况的影响可能很小。
collocations: have an effect on｜对……有影响 ; side effect｜副作用 ; take effect｜生效；起作用 ; effect change｜促成变革
tip_zh: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

meanings_zh: adj. 全职的；全日制的 | adv. 全职地；全日制地
definition_en: involving all the usual working or studying hours | for all the usual working or studying hours
example1_en: My sister starts her first full-time job next week.
example1_zh: 我姐姐下周开始做她的第一份全职工作。
example2_en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to return to full-time employment without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
example2_zh: 负担得起的托育服务使更多家长能够重返全职工作，同时不会给家庭经济带来过大压力。
collocations: full-time employment｜全职就业 ; a full-time student｜全日制学生 ; work full-time｜全职工作
tip_zh: 修饰名词时保留连字符，如a full-time job。

meanings_zh: n. 教授
definition_en: A university teacher, especially one holding a senior academic position.
example1_en: Our professor brought ancient coins to class today.
example1_zh: 我们的教授今天带了古钱币来上课。
example2_en: The professor encouraged students to evaluate different sources before drawing conclusions about climate policy.
example2_zh: 这位教授鼓励学生在对气候政策下结论之前评估不同的信息来源。
collocations: university professor｜大学教授 ; professor of economics｜经济学教授 ; visiting professor｜客座教授
tip_zh: 英国通常指高级职称；美国也泛指大学教师。

meanings_zh: prep. 尽管；虽然
definition_en: Without being prevented or affected by something.
example1_en: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold wind.
example1_zh: 尽管寒风吹拂，我们还是散步散得很开心。
example2_en: Despite significant investment in public transport, many commuters still prefer driving because services remain unreliable.
example2_zh: 尽管公共交通获得了大量投资，许多通勤者仍更愿意开车，因为公交服务依然不可靠。
collocations: despite the fact that｜尽管事实是 ; despite difficulties｜尽管有困难 ; despite efforts｜尽管付出了努力
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词，不加of；接从句用the fact that。

meanings_zh: n. 宇宙飞船
definition_en: A vehicle designed to travel through space.
example1_en: The children built a spaceship from cardboard boxes.
example1_zh: 孩子们用纸板箱做了一艘宇宙飞船。
example2_en: Designing a spaceship for long journeys requires careful planning to protect astronauts from radiation and isolation.
example2_zh: 设计用于长途航行的宇宙飞船需要周密规划，以保护宇航员免受辐射和孤独的影响。
collocations: board a spaceship｜登上宇宙飞船 ; launch a spaceship｜发射宇宙飞船 ; aboard a spaceship｜在宇宙飞船上
tip_zh: spaceship可数；spacecraft的单复数形式相同。

meanings_zh: v. 打断；插话；打扰 | v. 使中断；使暂停
definition_en: to stop someone speaking or working by doing something | to stop an activity or process for a time
example1_en: Please don't interrupt me while I explain the rules.
example1_zh: 我讲解规则时，请不要打断我。
example2_en: Frequent phone notifications can interrupt students' concentration and reduce the amount they learn during independent study.
example2_zh: 频繁的手机通知会打断学生的注意力，减少他们在自主学习中的收获。
collocations: interrupt a conversation｜打断谈话 ; interrupt someone｜打断某人 ; interrupt the flow｜打断连贯过程
tip_zh: interrupt指中途打断；disrupt侧重扰乱正常进程。

meanings_zh: n. 游泳者；游泳运动员
definition_en: a person who swims
example1_en: The swimmer won a gold medal at the games.
example1_zh: 这名游泳运动员在运动会上赢得金牌。
example2_en: She is a strong swimmer.
example2_zh: 她是一个游泳好手。
tip_zh: swimmer 是游泳者/游泳运动员。

meanings_zh: n. 诗；诗歌作品
definition_en: A literary work using carefully arranged language, often in lines.
example1_en: Leila read a short poem aloud after dinner.
example1_zh: 莱拉晚饭后朗读了一首短诗。
example2_en: Reading a poem from another culture can help students explore unfamiliar perspectives and develop sensitivity to language.
example2_zh: 阅读来自另一种文化的诗歌，可以帮助学生探索陌生的视角，培养语言敏感度。
collocations: write a poem｜写诗 ; recite a poem｜背诵诗歌 ; a collection of poems｜诗集
tip_zh: poem可数，指一首诗；poetry不可数，统称诗歌。

meanings_zh: n. 棉花 | n. 棉布；棉线
definition_en: Soft white plant fibres used to make thread and fabric. | Fabric or thread made from cotton fibres.
example1_en: This cotton shirt feels soft even after many washes.
example1_zh: 这件棉衬衫洗了很多次后摸起来仍然很柔软。
example2_en: Cotton production can place considerable pressure on water supplies, particularly in regions with limited rainfall.
example2_zh: 棉花生产会给供水带来相当大的压力，尤其是在降雨量有限的地区。
collocations: organic cotton｜有机棉 ; cotton fabric｜棉织物 ; cotton wool｜脱脂棉 ; cotton industry｜棉纺织业
tip_zh: 通常不可数；cotton shirt中cotton作名词定语。

meanings_zh: v. 申请 | v. 应用；适用 | v. 涂；敷
definition_en: To formally ask for a job, place, or permission | To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation | To spread a substance onto a surface
example1_en: Apply sunscreen before you go outside on sunny days.
example1_zh: 晴天出门前要涂防晒霜。
example2_en: Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.
example2_zh: 大学应鼓励家庭条件困难的学生申请涵盖学费和生活费的奖学金。
collocations: apply for a job｜申请工作 ; apply to a university｜向大学提出申请 ; apply knowledge｜应用知识 ; apply sunscreen｜涂防晒霜
tip_zh: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

meanings_zh: v. 搭便车旅行
definition_en: Travel by getting free rides in passing vehicles.
example1_en: We hitchhiked to the coast with our backpacks.
example1_zh: 我们背着背包搭便车去了海边。
example2_en: Although some tourists hitchhike to reduce travel costs, limited transport services can make such journeys unpredictable.
example2_zh: 虽然一些游客为节省交通费用而搭便车，但交通服务有限可能使这类旅程难以预测。
collocations: hitchhike across a country｜搭便车穿越一个国家 ; hitchhike to the coast｜搭便车去海边
tip_zh: 通常作不及物动词；目的地前用to。

meanings_zh: v. 咬；叮 | n. 一口；咬；叮咬伤
definition_en: To cut or grip with teeth, or wound with mouthparts | An act of biting, its wound, or a mouthful of food
example1_en: She bit into the apple and smiled at its sweetness.
example1_zh: 她咬了一口苹果，被甜得笑了起来。
example2_en: Public health campaigns should explain how travellers can prevent mosquito bites in regions with tropical diseases.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传应说明，旅行者在热带疾病流行地区如何预防蚊虫叮咬。
collocations: take a bite｜咬一口 ; bite into an apple｜咬苹果 ; mosquito bite｜蚊子叮咬
tip_zh: 过去式bit，过去分词bitten；一口用a bite。

meanings_zh: n. 顶峰；山峰；最高点 | v. 达到最高点 | adj. 最高的；高峰期的
definition_en: A mountain's top or the highest level of something. | To reach the highest level or amount. | At the highest level of activity, demand, or achievement.
example1_en: Snow still covered the mountain peak in June.
example1_zh: 六月时，山顶仍覆盖着积雪。
example2_en: Electricity demand usually peaks in the early evening, when households use several appliances at once.
example2_zh: 电力需求通常在傍晚达到高峰，因为那时许多家庭会同时使用多种电器。
collocations: reach a peak｜达到顶峰 ; peak demand｜需求高峰 ; mountain peak｜山峰 ; peak season｜旺季
tip_zh: peak at后接峰值；peak season表示旺季。

meanings_zh: n. 结论；推断 | n. 结尾；结束
definition_en: a judgement formed after considering facts or evidence | the final part or ending of something
example1_en: We reached the same conclusion after checking the receipts.
example1_zh: 核对收据后，我们得出了相同的结论。
example2_en: Researchers should consider alternative explanations before drawing a conclusion from a relatively small sample.
example2_zh: 研究人员根据较小的样本得出结论之前，应考虑其他可能的解释。
collocations: reach a conclusion｜得出结论 ; draw a conclusion｜作出推断 ; jump to conclusions｜贸然下结论 ; in conclusion｜总而言之
tip_zh: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

meanings_zh: n. 数量；量
definition_en: the amount or number of something
example1_en: We bought a large quantity of rice yesterday.
example1_zh: 我们昨天买了大量大米。
example2_en: Reducing the quantity of food wasted by households could lower both environmental damage and living costs.
example2_zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量，既能减轻环境损害，也能降低生活成本。
collocations: a large quantity of｜大量的 ; in small quantities｜少量地 ; quality over quantity｜质量优于数量
tip_zh: quantity指数量，quality指质量；a quantity of可接两类名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 随和的；好相处的
definition_en: calm and relaxed in character
example1_en: Our new teacher is very easygoing.
example1_zh: 我们的新老师很随和。
example2_en: She is easygoing and gets on with everyone.
example2_zh: 她很随和，和每个人都合得来。
tip_zh: easygoing 形容人随和、不挑剔。

meanings_zh: n. 人际关系；恋爱关系 | n. 关联；联系
definition_en: The way people know, feel about, and treat each other. | A connection between things or the way they affect each other.
example1_en: She has a warm relationship with her younger sister.
example1_zh: 她和妹妹的关系很亲密。
example2_en: Researchers are investigating the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
example2_zh: 研究人员正在调查城市社区中绿地的可及性与心理健康之间的关系。
collocations: build a relationship｜建立关系 ; a close relationship｜亲密关系 ; the relationship between A and B｜甲与乙之间的关系
tip_zh: 与某人的关系用with；两者关系用between。

meanings_zh: v. 使受伤
definition_en: to cause physical harm to a person or animal
example1_en: You could injure your back lifting that heavy box.
example1_zh: 搬那个重箱子可能会让你的背部受伤。
example2_en: Employers should provide safety training to reduce the risk of workers injuring themselves while operating machinery.
example2_zh: 雇主应提供安全培训，以降低工人操作机器时受伤的风险。
collocations: injure your knee｜伤到膝盖 ; seriously injured｜严重受伤 ; injure yourself｜使自己受伤
tip_zh: injure通常指身体受伤；损坏物品常用damage。

meanings_zh: v. 抱怨；投诉
definition_en: To say that something is wrong or unsatisfactory
example1_en: Our neighbours often complain about noise from the traffic.
example1_zh: 我们的邻居经常抱怨交通噪声。
example2_en: Residents may complain to local authorities when construction work repeatedly disrupts their sleep and daily activities.
example2_zh: 当施工反复影响睡眠和日常活动时，居民可能会向地方当局投诉。
collocations: complain about noise｜抱怨噪声 ; complain to the manager｜向经理投诉 ; complain of pain｜诉说疼痛
tip_zh: 向某人投诉某事：complain to sb about sth。

meanings_zh: n. 职业；专业性职业 | n. 某职业的全体从业者 | n. 公开表白；声明
definition_en: A job requiring specialist knowledge and usually advanced training. | All the people working in a particular specialist occupation. | An open statement of a belief, feeling, or intention.
example1_en: Nursing is a demanding profession, but my sister loves it.
example1_zh: 护理是个要求很高的职业，但我姐姐很喜欢。
example2_en: The teaching profession needs greater public support to attract talented graduates and retain experienced staff.
example2_zh: 教师行业需要更多公众支持，以吸引优秀毕业生并留住经验丰富的教师。
collocations: enter a profession｜进入某职业领域 ; by profession｜就职业而言 ; the medical profession｜医学界 ; a profession of faith｜信仰的公开表白
tip_zh: profession通常指需专门训练的职业，比job范围窄。

meanings_zh: n. 瑜伽
definition_en: A practice combining body positions, controlled breathing, and mental focus.
example1_en: She does yoga on a mat beside the window.
example1_zh: 她在窗边的垫子上练瑜伽。
example2_en: Offering yoga classes in community centres may help residents manage stress and maintain flexibility.
example2_zh: 在社区中心开设瑜伽课可能有助于居民缓解压力并保持身体柔韧。
collocations: do yoga｜练瑜伽 ; yoga mat｜瑜伽垫 ; yoga instructor｜瑜伽教练
tip_zh: 练瑜伽用do或practise yoga，不用play。

meanings_zh: n. 海湾 | n. 专用隔间；停车位
definition_en: An area of sea partly enclosed by land. | A designated space within a building or parking area.
example1_en: Small fishing boats floated in the sheltered bay.
example1_zh: 小渔船漂浮在避风的海湾里。
example2_en: Coastal development around the bay must be carefully managed to protect marine habitats and local livelihoods.
example2_zh: 必须谨慎管理海湾周边的沿海开发，以保护海洋栖息地和当地居民的生计。
collocations: sheltered bay｜避风海湾 ; sandy bay｜沙质海湾 ; parking bay｜停车位 ; loading bay｜装卸区
tip_zh: bay主要指海湾；停车或装卸语境中指专用区域。

meanings_zh: n. 街区；附近地区 | n. 街坊邻里
definition_en: An area around people's homes within a town or city. | The people living in a particular local area.
example1_en: A small bakery has just opened in our neighbourhood.
example1_zh: 我们街区刚开了一家小面包店。
example2_en: Investing in neighbourhood parks can improve residents' health while creating opportunities for people to meet and socialise.
example2_zh: 投资建设社区公园可以改善居民健康，同时创造见面和社交的机会。
collocations: a quiet neighbourhood｜安静的街区 ; in the neighbourhood｜在附近 ; a residential neighbourhood｜住宅区
tip_zh: 英式拼写为neighbourhood，美式为neighborhood。

meanings_zh: v. 作出反应；回应 | v. 发生化学反应
definition_en: Behave or feel in response to something that happens. | Change chemically when combined with another substance.
example1_en: How did your sister react to the surprise party?
example1_zh: 你姐姐对这场惊喜派对有什么反应？
example2_en: Governments must react quickly to public health emergencies while providing clear information to citizens.
example2_zh: 政府必须迅速应对公共卫生紧急事件，同时向公众提供清晰的信息。
collocations: react to news｜对消息作出反应 ; react quickly｜迅速反应 ; react with oxygen｜与氧气反应
tip_zh: 对某事反应用react to；与物质反应用react with。

meanings_zh: adj. 粗糙的；不平的 | adj. 粗略的；大致的 | adj. 艰难的；动荡的；猛烈的
definition_en: Having an uneven surface that is not smooth. | Not exact, detailed, or completely finished. | Difficult to experience, or involving strong, uncontrolled movement or force.
example1_en: The rough wooden bench scratched my bare legs.
example1_zh: 粗糙的木长凳刮到了我裸露的小腿。
example2_en: A rough estimate of construction costs can help local authorities decide whether a housing project is affordable.
example2_zh: 粗略估算建筑成本有助于地方政府判断是否负担得起某个住房项目。
collocations: a rough surface｜粗糙的表面 ; a rough estimate｜粗略估计 ; a rough time｜艰难的时期 ; rough seas｜波涛汹涌的海面
tip_zh: rough estimate是粗略估计；rough中的gh发/f/。

meanings_zh: adj. 错误的；不正确的
definition_en: Not accurate, true, or right.
example1_en: The delivery failed because our address details were incorrect.
example1_zh: 由于我们的地址信息有误，配送未能成功。
example2_en: Incorrect information shared online can undermine public understanding of health issues and influence important personal decisions.
example2_zh: 网上传播的错误信息会妨碍公众理解健康问题，并影响重要的个人决定。
collocations: incorrect information｜错误信息 ; incorrect answer｜错误答案 ; factually incorrect｜事实有误的
tip_zh: incorrect比wrong正式，常用于答案、信息或数据。

meanings_zh: adv. 与此同时；在此期间
definition_en: During the same time or while something else is happening.
example1_en: The soup is simmering; meanwhile, I will prepare dessert.
example1_zh: 汤正在慢炖；趁这会儿，我来准备甜点。
example2_en: New railway lines may take years to complete; meanwhile, cities should improve existing bus services.
example2_zh: 新铁路线可能需要多年才能建成；在此期间，城市应改善现有的公交服务。
collocations: in the meanwhile｜在此期间 ; meanwhile, elsewhere｜与此同时，在别处
tip_zh: 连接两个完整句子时，前面用句号或分号。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全；全然 | adv. 总共 | adv. 总的来说
definition_en: completely or entirely | when everything or everyone is counted | when considering everything
example1_en: We stopped going to that crowded café altogether.
example1_zh: 我们彻底不再去那家拥挤的咖啡馆了。
example2_en: Although online courses improve access, they cannot altogether replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
example2_zh: 虽然在线课程扩大了学习机会，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。
collocations: altogether different｜完全不同 ; not altogether clear｜不完全清楚 ; disappear altogether｜彻底消失
tip_zh: altogether是完全或总共；all together是全在一起。

meanings_zh: n. 耳朵疼
definition_en: pain in your ear
example1_en: The child cried because of an earache.
example1_zh: 孩子因为耳朵疼哭了起来。
example2_en: She has an earache after swimming.
example2_zh: 游泳后她耳朵疼。
collocations: have an earache｜耳朵疼
tip_zh: earache 耳朵疼；toothache 牙疼；stomach ache 肚子疼。

meanings_zh: phr v. 使留在里面；克制
definition_en: to keep something inside, or to stop someone going out
example1_en: We had to keep in the cat during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨期间我们只能把猫关在家里。
example2_en: Keep your hands in your pockets to stay warm.
example2_zh: 把手放在口袋里保暖。
tip_zh: keep in 表示“关在屋内/放在里面”。

meanings_zh: prep. 由于；因为
definition_en: because of
example1_en: The match was cancelled due to heavy rain.
example1_zh: 比赛因大雨被取消。
example2_en: The delay was due to a technical problem.
example2_zh: 延误是由于技术问题。
tip_zh: due to 是正式说法，等于 because of，后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 目的；目标 | v. 力求；旨在 | v. 瞄准；对准
definition_en: something you want or plan to achieve | to intend or try to achieve something | to point something towards a particular target
example1_en: My main aim today is to tidy the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我今天的主要目标是把厨房收拾整齐。
example2_en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
example2_zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。
collocations: the main aim｜主要目标 ; aim to do something｜力求做某事 ; with the aim of｜以……为目的 ; aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip_zh: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；出色的 | adj. 极大的；强烈的
definition_en: Extremely good or enjoyable. | Very great in amount, degree, or intensity.
example1_en: You did a terrific job fixing that old bicycle.
example1_zh: 你把那辆旧自行车修得真棒。
example2_en: Community gardens offer a terrific opportunity for residents to exercise outdoors while developing stronger social connections.
example2_zh: 社区花园为居民提供了极好的机会，让他们在户外锻炼的同时建立更紧密的社会联系。
collocations: terrific job｜出色的工作 ; terrific opportunity｜极好的机会 ; terrific speed｜极快的速度 ; terrific noise｜巨大的响声
tip_zh: 常用于口语赞扬；别与terrible“糟糕的”混淆。

meanings_zh: adv. 主要地；大多
definition_en: mostly, or more than anything else
example1_en: This little shop mainly sells fresh bread and cakes.
example1_zh: 这家小店主要卖新鲜面包和蛋糕。
example2_en: Many rural communities depend mainly on agriculture, making them particularly vulnerable to changes in weather patterns.
example2_zh: 许多农村社区主要依赖农业，因此尤其容易受到天气模式变化的影响。
collocations: mainly because｜主要因为 ; mainly due to｜主要由于 ; consist mainly of｜主要由……组成 ; depend mainly on｜主要依靠
tip_zh: 表示“主要而非全部”；常放在实义动词前。

meanings_zh: v. 意识到；明白 | v. 实现；使成为现实
definition_en: to become aware of a fact or understand a situation | to make a hope, ambition, or possibility become real
example1_en: I suddenly realised my keys were still inside the house.
example1_zh: 我突然意识到钥匙还在屋里。
example2_en: Many students realise the importance of time management when they begin balancing academic work with paid employment.
example2_zh: 许多学生开始兼顾学业与有偿工作时，才意识到时间管理的重要性。
collocations: realise that｜意识到…… ; realise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性 ; realise an ambition｜实现志向 ; realise your potential｜发挥你的潜能
tip_zh: 英式常写realise，美式写realize；可接that从句。

meanings_zh: adj.&prep. 接下来的；在…之后
definition_en: next; coming after something
example1_en: The following day, we visited the museum.
example1_zh: 第二天我们参观了博物馆。
example2_en: Please answer the following questions.
example2_zh: 请回答以下问题。
tip_zh: the following day 是“第二天”；following 也作“以下的”。

meanings_zh: n. 许可；准许
definition_en: agreement allowing someone to do something
example1_en: You need permission to borrow your sister's bicycle.
example1_zh: 你得先征得姐姐同意，才能借她的自行车。
example2_en: Researchers must obtain permission from participants before collecting personal information for a scientific study.
example2_zh: 研究人员为科学研究收集个人信息前，必须征得参与者同意。
collocations: ask for permission｜请求许可 ; give permission｜给予许可 ; without permission｜未经许可 ; permission to do something｜做某事的许可
tip_zh: 通常不可数；说give permission，不加a。

meanings_zh: n. 茶碟；茶托
definition_en: a small shallow dish placed underneath a cup
example1_en: She placed a biscuit on the saucer beside her cup.
example1_zh: 她把一块饼干放在茶托上，紧挨着杯子。
example2_en: Traditional tea sets, including matching cups and saucers, can reflect local craftsmanship and cultural preferences.
example2_zh: 传统茶具，包括配套的茶杯和茶碟，可以体现当地的手工艺和文化偏好。
collocations: cup and saucer｜杯子和茶托 ; matching saucer｜配套茶碟 ; flying saucer｜飞碟
tip_zh: saucer是杯子下的小碟；flying saucer指飞碟。

meanings_zh: n. 阳台 | n. 剧院楼座
definition_en: A raised outdoor platform attached to a building, with a railing. | An upper level of seats in a theatre.
example1_en: She grows herbs in small pots on her balcony.
example1_zh: 她在阳台上的小盆里种香草。
example2_en: Apartments with a balcony offer residents valuable outdoor space, particularly in cities where public gardens are scarce.
example2_zh: 带阳台的公寓为住户提供了宝贵的户外空间，在公共花园稀少的城市尤其如此。
collocations: on the balcony｜在阳台上 ; a private balcony｜私人阳台 ; balcony seats｜楼座座位
tip_zh: 在阳台上用on the balcony，不用in。

meanings_zh: adj. 困倦的；想睡的 | adj. 安静冷清的
definition_en: feeling tired and ready to sleep | quiet and having very little activity
example1_en: I felt sleepy after lunch and took a short nap.
example1_zh: 午饭后我觉得困，就小睡了一会儿。
example2_en: Students who feel sleepy during lessons may struggle to concentrate and retain new information effectively.
example2_zh: 上课时感到困倦的学生可能难以集中注意力，也难以有效记住新知识。
collocations: feel sleepy｜感到困倦 ; sleepy village｜宁静的村庄 ; sleepy eyes｜惺忪的睡眼
tip_zh: sleepy是想睡的；asleep是已经睡着的。

meanings_zh: n. 纪录片；纪实节目 | adj. 文件的；文献的
definition_en: A film or programme presenting facts about real subjects. | Consisting of or supported by written documents.
example1_en: We watched a documentary about penguins after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们看了一部关于企鹅的纪录片。
example2_en: A well-researched documentary can raise public awareness of environmental problems without oversimplifying their causes.
example2_zh: 一部经过充分调研的纪录片能够提高公众对环境问题的认识，同时避免过度简化其成因。
collocations: documentary film｜纪录电影 ; documentary evidence｜书面证据 ; documentary about wildlife｜关于野生动物的纪录片
tip_zh: 作名词指纪录片；documentary evidence指书面证据。

meanings_zh: v. 受苦；患病 | v. 遭受；受损
definition_en: To experience physical pain or mental distress. | To experience something harmful or become worse.
example1_en: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
example1_zh: 我不吃午饭时就会头痛。
example2_en: Small businesses often suffer financial losses when major roadworks prevent customers from reaching their premises.
example2_zh: 大型道路施工导致顾客无法到店时，小企业往往会遭受经济损失。
collocations: suffer from headaches｜受头痛困扰 ; suffer a loss｜遭受损失 ; suffer damage｜遭到损坏 ; suffer badly｜遭受严重影响
tip_zh: 疾病常用suffer from；损失、损坏常直接接在suffer后。

meanings_zh: n. 货摊；摊位 | v. 使停滞；拖延 | v. 使熄火；熄火
definition_en: A small stand or space where goods are sold. | To stop progress or deliberately delay action. | For an engine to stop unexpectedly, or cause this.
example1_en: We bought fresh peaches from a small roadside stall.
example1_zh: 我们在路边的一个小摊买了新鲜桃子。
example2_en: Negotiations may stall if governments cannot agree on how to share the costs of reducing emissions.
example2_zh: 如果各国政府无法就如何分担减排成本达成一致，谈判可能会陷入停滞。
collocations: market stall｜市场摊位 ; stall for time｜拖延时间 ; stall an engine｜使发动机熄火
tip_zh: 作动词可指发动机熄火，也可指谈判等陷入停滞。

meanings_zh: n. 微风 | n. 轻而易举的事 | v. 轻松通过；轻快走动
definition_en: A light, gentle wind | Something that is very easy to do | Move or complete something easily and confidently
example1_en: A cool breeze lifted the curtains beside my bed.
example1_zh: 一阵凉风吹起了我床边的窗帘。
example2_en: Coastal parks offer residents pleasant places to exercise while enjoying the fresh sea breeze.
example2_zh: 沿海公园为居民提供了宜人的锻炼场所，让他们同时享受清新的海风。
collocations: a gentle breeze｜轻柔的微风 ; a sea breeze｜海风 ; be a breeze｜轻而易举 ; breeze through an exam｜轻松通过考试
tip_zh: be a breeze是口语，表示“轻而易举”。

meanings_zh: n. 进步；进展 | v. 前进；促进；推进 | adj. 预先的；事先的
definition_en: An improvement or development in a particular field | Move forward or help something develop | Done or provided before a particular time or event
example1_en: This new treatment is a major advance in medicine.
example1_zh: 这种新疗法是医学上的一大进步。
example2_en: Advances in renewable energy technology could reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve long-term energy security.
example2_zh: 可再生能源技术的进步可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并改善长期能源安全。
collocations: a major advance｜重大进展 ; in advance｜提前 ; advance notice｜事先通知 ; advance knowledge｜推动知识发展
tip_zh: in advance表示提前；advanced表示先进的或高级的。

meanings_zh: n. 家务劳动
definition_en: Work done to keep a home clean and tidy.
example1_en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
example1_zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。
example2_en: Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.
example2_zh: 公平分担家务可以让家庭成员更有效地平衡有偿工作与家庭责任。
collocations: do the housework｜做家务 ; share the housework｜分担家务 ; household chores｜家务杂事
tip_zh: 不可数，不能说a housework；做家务用do。

meanings_zh: n. 贸易；交易 | v. 买卖；交换 | n. 手艺；职业
definition_en: the activity of buying and selling goods or services | to buy, sell, or exchange goods or services | a skilled job, especially one involving practical work
example1_en: At lunch, I traded my apple for a pear.
example1_zh: 午饭时，我用自己的苹果换了一个梨。
example2_en: International trade can create employment, but governments must ensure that workers receive fair wages and adequate protection.
example2_zh: 国际贸易可以创造就业，但政府必须确保工人获得公平的工资和充分的保障。
collocations: international trade｜国际贸易 ; trade agreement｜贸易协定 ; trade with｜与……做生意 ; learn a trade｜学一门手艺
tip_zh: trade A for B指用A换B；by trade指职业上。

meanings_zh: n. 监狱 | n. 监禁
definition_en: A place where people are kept as punishment for crimes. | The state of being kept in a prison.
example1_en: The old prison has become a popular local museum.
example1_zh: 这座旧监狱已成为当地一处受欢迎的博物馆。
example2_en: Education programmes in prison can help individuals develop skills that support their successful return to society.
example2_zh: 监狱内的教育项目能帮助服刑人员培养技能，支持他们顺利回归社会。
collocations: in prison｜在服刑 ; go to prison｜入狱服刑 ; prison sentence｜监禁刑期 ; prison reform｜监狱改革
tip_zh: in prison指服刑；in the prison强调在监狱内。

meanings_zh: n. 敌人；敌方 | n. 危害物；大敌
definition_en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another. | Something that seriously harms or threatens something else.
example1_en: In the story, the prince becomes friends with his enemy.
example1_zh: 故事里，王子和他的敌人成了朋友。
example2_en: Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.
example2_zh: 公众的不信任可能成为有效环境政策的大敌，尤其是在政府未能解释其决策时。
collocations: bitter enemy｜死敌 ; common enemy｜共同的敌人 ; enemy forces｜敌军
tip_zh: enemy指敌人；比赛对手通常用opponent。

meanings_zh: phr v. 查阅；抬头看；好转
definition_en: to find information, or to raise your eyes
example1_en: Look up the word in the dictionary.
example1_zh: 在词典里查这个词。
example2_en: Things are looking up for our team.
example2_zh: 我们队的情况正在好转。
tip_zh: look up 表示“查阅（资料）”；look up to 是“尊敬”。

meanings_zh: n. 雇主；用人单位
definition_en: A person or organisation that pays people to work.
example1_en: My employer lets me work from home on Fridays.
example1_zh: 我的雇主允许我每周五在家办公。
example2_en: Employers can improve staff retention by offering fair wages, flexible schedules, and opportunities for professional development.
example2_zh: 雇主可以通过提供公平的薪资、灵活的工作安排和职业发展机会来提高员工留任率。
collocations: a major employer｜大型用人单位 ; a prospective employer｜潜在雇主 ; current employer｜现雇主
tip_zh: employer是雇主；employee是雇员。

meanings_zh: adv. 非常；极其 | adv. 令人难以置信地
definition_en: To an extremely high degree. | In a way that is surprising or hard to believe.
example1_en: The soup was incredibly hot, so I waited.
example1_zh: 汤特别烫，所以我等了一会儿。
example2_en: Reliable public transport can be incredibly valuable to older residents who no longer drive.
example2_zh: 对于不再开车的老年居民来说，可靠的公共交通可能极其重要。
collocations: incredibly difficult｜极其困难 ; incredibly useful｜非常有用 ; incredibly fast｜快得惊人
tip_zh: 常修饰形容词或副词；句首可表示“难以置信的是”。

meanings_zh: phr. 你知道的；就是说（口语）
definition_en: used in speech to check understanding
example1_en: You know, the new café near the station.
example1_zh: 你知道的，车站附近那家新咖啡馆。
example2_en: It's a really nice place, you know.
example2_zh: 那是个很棒的地方，你懂的。
tip_zh: you know 是口语填充语，用于引出对方已知的信息。

meanings_zh: n. 闪电
definition_en: the bright flash of light in a storm
example1_en: Lightning lit up the sky during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨中闪电照亮了天空。
example2_en: We saw lightning in the distance.
example2_zh: 我们看到了远处的闪电。
collocations: thunder and lightning｜雷电
tip_zh: lightning 是闪电；thunder 是雷声。

meanings_zh: phr v. 撞倒；拆除
definition_en: to hit someone to the ground, or to destroy a building
example1_en: The strong wind knocked down the old fence.
example1_zh: 大风把旧篱笆刮倒了。
example2_en: They plan to knock down the old building.
example2_zh: 他们计划拆除旧楼。
tip_zh: knock down 表示“撞倒/拆除”。

meanings_zh: pron. 一个也没有；毫无 | adv. 毫不；一点也不
definition_en: not any of the people or things being considered | not at all, used before certain comparative expressions
example1_en: I checked the biscuit tin, but there were none left.
example1_zh: 我看了看饼干罐，但一块也没剩下。
example2_en: Although several solutions were proposed, none addressed the underlying causes of inequality in access to education.
example2_zh: 虽然提出了多种解决办法，但没有一种触及教育机会不平等的根本原因。
collocations: none of｜……中没有一个 ; none at all｜完全没有 ; none the wiser｜仍然不明白 ; none other than｜正是；不是别人而是
tip_zh: none可独立用；修饰名词用no，如no books。

meanings_zh: n. 工程学；工程技术
definition_en: using science to design and build machines, structures, or systems
example1_en: My cousin studies engineering and builds small robots at home.
example1_zh: 我的表哥学工程，平时在家制作小型机器人。
example2_en: Advances in engineering have enabled cities to build bridges that withstand extreme weather and carry heavier traffic.
example2_zh: 工程技术的进步使城市能够建造抵御极端天气、承载更大交通量的桥梁。
collocations: civil engineering｜土木工程 ; mechanical engineering｜机械工程 ; electrical engineering｜电气工程 ; an engineering project｜工程项目
tip_zh: 表示学科或技术领域时不可数；engineer可指工程师。

meanings_zh: adj. 有害健康的 | adj. 不健康的；身体虚弱的 | adj. 不正常的；有害的
definition_en: likely to damage physical or mental health | not in good physical condition | harmful or excessive in a way that causes problems
example1_en: Eating only biscuits for dinner is an unhealthy habit.
example1_zh: 晚餐只吃饼干是个不健康的习惯。
example2_en: Advertising unhealthy foods to children may contribute to poor dietary habits and higher rates of obesity.
example2_zh: 向儿童投放不健康食品广告，可能导致不良饮食习惯和更高的肥胖率。
collocations: an unhealthy diet｜不健康的饮食 ; an unhealthy lifestyle｜不健康的生活方式 ; unhealthy competition｜恶性竞争 ; an unhealthy obsession｜有害的痴迷
tip_zh: unhealthy可指事物伤身，也可指身体状况差。

meanings_zh: adj. 准确的；精确的 | adj. 精准的；命中目标的
definition_en: correct and free from mistakes | able to hit or reach the intended target
example1_en: This kitchen scale is accurate enough for baking bread.
example1_zh: 这台厨房秤的精度足以用来做面包。
example2_en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
example2_zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。
collocations: accurate information｜准确信息 ; accurate measurements｜精确测量 ; highly accurate｜高度精确的 ; an accurate prediction｜准确的预测
tip_zh: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

meanings_zh: adj. 科学的；符合科学方法的
definition_en: relating to science or using methods based on evidence
example1_en: Our class used scientific methods to test the water.
example1_zh: 我们班用科学方法检测了水质。
example2_en: Governments should rely on scientific evidence when developing policies to protect public health.
example2_zh: 政府在制定保护公众健康的政策时，应依据科学证据。
collocations: scientific research｜科学研究 ; scientific evidence｜科学证据 ; scientific method｜科学方法
tip_zh: scientific强调科学依据，不等于仅仅有条理。

meanings_zh: phr. 立刻；马上
definition_en: immediately, right now
example1_en: Come here at once! It's important.
example1_zh: 马上过来！有重要的事。
example2_en: She answered the phone at once.
example2_zh: 她立刻接了电话。
tip_zh: at once 是“立刻、马上”的意思。

meanings_zh: n. 准备；准备工作
definition_en: The work done to get ready for something.
example1_en: Dinner preparation takes longer when the children help.
example1_zh: 孩子们帮忙时，准备晚饭反而要花更长时间。
example2_en: Thorough preparation for job interviews can help graduates communicate their skills and experience more confidently.
example2_zh: 充分准备求职面试能帮助毕业生更自信地介绍自己的技能和经验。
collocations: in preparation for｜为……做准备 ; make preparations｜做准备工作 ; food preparation｜食物准备 ; thorough preparation｜充分准备
tip_zh: 泛指准备时不可数；具体筹备工作常用复数preparations。

meanings_zh: n. 警报；警报器；闹钟 | n. 惊慌；担忧 | v. 使惊慌；使担忧
definition_en: A warning signal or device, or something that wakes you. | A sudden feeling of fear or worry. | To make someone frightened or worried.
example1_en: My alarm rang before sunrise, waking the whole family.
example1_zh: 我的闹钟在日出前响了，把全家人都吵醒了。
example2_en: Every school should test its fire alarm regularly to ensure that pupils receive an immediate warning.
example2_zh: 每所学校都应定期测试火灾警报器，确保学生能立即收到警报。
collocations: set an alarm｜设定闹钟 ; fire alarm｜火灾警报器 ; raise the alarm｜发出警报 ; in alarm｜惊慌地
tip_zh: 警报响起用go off，不是go on。

meanings_zh: n. 证书；证明书
definition_en: An official document proving a fact or qualification.
example1_en: Lena proudly showed her swimming certificate to her grandparents.
example1_zh: 莉娜自豪地向祖父母展示了她的游泳证书。
example2_en: A professional certificate can improve employment prospects, but employers also value practical experience.
example2_zh: 专业资格证书可以改善就业前景，但雇主也重视实践经验。
collocations: a birth certificate｜出生证明 ; a medical certificate｜医生证明 ; a professional certificate｜专业资格证书 ; award a certificate｜颁发证书
tip_zh: certificate泛指证明或资格证书，不一定是学位。

meanings_zh: adj. 枯燥的；无趣的 | adj. 暗淡的；阴沉的 | adj. 钝的；不锋利的
definition_en: Not interesting or exciting. | Not bright or sunny. | Having an edge that does not cut easily.
example1_en: The film was so dull that I nearly fell asleep.
example1_zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我差点睡着。
example2_en: Lessons can seem dull when students have few opportunities to ask questions or explore ideas independently.
example2_zh: 如果学生很少有机会提问或独立探索想法，课堂就可能显得枯燥。
collocations: dull routine｜乏味的日常安排 ; dull weather｜阴沉的天气 ; dull blade｜钝刀刃 ; dull ache｜隐痛
tip_zh: 形容刀刃时指“钝”，形容活动时指“无聊”。

meanings_zh: adj. 电的；电气的
definition_en: Related to electricity or equipment that uses it.
example1_en: An electrical fault left our kitchen in darkness.
example1_zh: 一处电路故障让我们的厨房一片漆黑。
example2_en: Regular inspections of electrical equipment can reduce fire risks in crowded residential buildings and workplaces.
example2_zh: 定期检查电气设备可以降低人口密集的住宅楼和工作场所的火灾风险。
collocations: electrical equipment｜电气设备 ; electrical engineering｜电气工程 ; electrical fault｜电路故障 ; electrical wiring｜电气线路
tip_zh: electrical常指电气领域；electric常指电驱动的。

meanings_zh: n. 衣服；服装（总称）
definition_en: Things people wear to cover or protect their bodies.
example1_en: Pack some warm clothing for our weekend camping trip.
example1_zh: 为我们周末的露营之旅带些保暖衣物。
example2_en: The clothing industry can reduce its environmental impact by using recycled materials and designing products that last longer.
example2_zh: 服装行业可以通过使用再生材料和设计更耐穿的产品来减少对环境的影响。
collocations: warm clothing｜保暖衣物 ; protective clothing｜防护服 ; an item of clothing｜一件衣物 ; clothing industry｜服装业
tip_zh: clothing不可数；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

meanings_zh: n. 解释；说明 | n. 原因；解释理由
definition_en: information that makes something easier to understand | a reason given for why something happened
example1_en: Her simple explanation helped me understand the new game.
example1_zh: 她简单的讲解让我明白了这个新游戏。
example2_en: One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 汽车拥有率下降的一个可能原因，是可靠的公共交通越来越普及。
collocations: clear explanation｜清楚的解释 ; give an explanation｜作出解释 ; explanation for｜对……的原因解释 ; explanation of｜对……的说明
tip_zh: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

meanings_zh: phr. 提前；预先
definition_en: Before a planned event or a particular time.
example1_en: We booked our train tickets two weeks in advance.
example1_zh: 我们提前两周订好了火车票。
example2_en: Publishing consultation dates well in advance allows more residents to participate in local planning decisions.
example2_zh: 早早公布咨询会日期，可以让更多居民参与地方规划决策。
collocations: book in advance｜提前预订 ; pay in advance｜预先付款 ; well in advance｜早早地
tip_zh: in advance可独立用；接事件用in advance of。

meanings_zh: n. 高度；身高 | n. 离地高度；海拔 | n. 顶峰；最盛时期
definition_en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is | the distance of something above the ground or sea | the time when something is strongest or most successful
example1_en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
example1_zh: 她调节了椅子的高度，让双脚能够踩到地面。
example2_en: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。
collocations: average height｜平均身高；平均高度 ; at a height of｜在……的高度 ; a fear of heights｜恐高 ; at the height of｜在……的鼎盛时期
tip_zh: height 是名词；形容人高用 tall，物体高可用 high。

meanings_zh: adj. 失望的；沮丧的
definition_en: Unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped.
example1_en: I was disappointed when rain cancelled our beach picnic.
example1_zh: 下雨导致我们的海滩野餐取消，我很失望。
example2_en: Graduates may feel disappointed if their first jobs offer few opportunities to apply the skills they have learned.
example2_zh: 如果第一份工作很少提供运用所学技能的机会，毕业生可能会感到失望。
collocations: disappointed with｜对……失望 ; deeply disappointed｜深感失望 ; disappointed to hear｜听到……感到失望
tip_zh: disappointed形容人的感受；disappointing形容令人失望的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 头盔；安全帽
definition_en: A strong protective covering worn on the head
example1_en: Fasten your helmet before you get on the bicycle.
example1_zh: 骑上自行车前，先扣好头盔。
example2_en: Wearing a helmet can reduce the risk of serious head injuries among cyclists involved in accidents.
example2_zh: 骑车时佩戴头盔，可以降低事故中头部严重受伤的风险。
collocations: wear a helmet｜戴头盔 ; cycle helmet｜自行车头盔 ; safety helmet｜安全帽
tip_zh: 可数名词：戴头盔用wear a helmet。

meanings_zh: adj. 闪闪发光的 | adj. 含气泡的 | adj. 生动有趣的；才华横溢的
definition_en: shining with many small flashes of light | containing bubbles of gas | lively, clever, and entertaining
example1_en: She held the sparkling bracelet up to the sunlight.
example1_zh: 她把闪闪发亮的手链举到阳光下。
example2_en: Restaurants can reduce packaging waste by serving locally filtered sparkling water rather than imported bottled alternatives.
example2_zh: 餐厅可以供应本地过滤的气泡水，代替进口瓶装水，从而减少包装废弃物。
collocations: sparkling water｜气泡水 ; sparkling eyes｜神采奕奕的眼睛 ; sparkling conversation｜妙趣横生的交谈
tip_zh: 饮用水中sparkling指含气泡，still指无气泡。

meanings_zh: n. 睡衣裤
definition_en: a loose top and trousers worn for sleeping
example1_en: I put on my pyjamas and climbed into bed.
example1_zh: 我穿上睡衣裤，爬上了床。
example2_en: Choosing comfortable pyjamas and maintaining a regular bedtime may help children establish healthier sleep routines.
example2_zh: 选择舒适的睡衣裤并保持固定的就寝时间，可能有助于儿童养成更健康的睡眠习惯。
collocations: a pair of pyjamas｜一套睡衣裤 ; cotton pyjamas｜棉质睡衣裤 ; put on pyjamas｜穿上睡衣裤
tip_zh: 用复数；一套用a pair of；美式拼pajamas。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……更远处；在另一边 | prep. 超出；超过 | adv. 在更远处
definition_en: on the farther side of something | outside a particular limit, range, or ability | at or towards a place farther away
example1_en: A narrow path leads to the beach beyond the dunes.
example1_zh: 一条狭窄的小路通向沙丘另一边的海滩。
example2_en: The benefits of university education extend beyond employment prospects to include personal growth and greater social awareness.
example2_zh: 大学教育的益处不仅限于就业前景，还包括个人成长和更强的社会意识。
collocations: beyond repair｜无法修复 ; beyond reach｜够不到 ; beyond recognition｜认不出来 ; go beyond｜超出
tip_zh: beyond不仅表位置，也可表示超出能力或限度。

meanings_zh: v. 竞争；争夺 | v. 参加比赛
definition_en: Try to win or succeed against others. | Take part in a sporting event or other contest.
example1_en: Several bakeries compete for customers on our street.
example1_zh: 我们街上的几家面包店都在争取顾客。
example2_en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
example2_zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。
collocations: compete with｜与……竞争 ; compete for｜争夺 ; compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip_zh: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

meanings_zh: n. 补助金；拨款 | v. 正式准许；授予 | v. 承认
definition_en: money given by an organisation for a particular purpose | to officially give someone something they request | to accept that something is true, often reluctantly
example1_en: A small grant helped us repair the village playground.
example1_zh: 一笔小额补助金帮助我们修好了村里的游乐场。
example2_en: Governments should provide research grants to universities developing affordable technologies for reducing household energy consumption.
example2_zh: 政府应向研发低成本家庭节能技术的大学提供研究拨款。
collocations: apply for a grant｜申请补助金 ; research grant｜研究拨款 ; grant permission｜准许 ; take something for granted｜认为某事理所当然
tip_zh: grant sb sth可改为grant sth to sb。

meanings_zh: adj. 合理的；通情达理的 | adj. 价格公道的 | adj. 尚可的；过得去的
definition_en: Fair and sensible, showing good judgement. | Not too expensive. | Acceptable in quality or amount, though not excellent.
example1_en: Your suggestion sounds reasonable, so let's try it tomorrow.
example1_zh: 你的建议听起来很合理，我们明天试试吧。
example2_en: Employers should set reasonable targets that encourage productivity without placing excessive pressure on their staff.
example2_zh: 雇主应设定合理目标，在提高生产效率的同时避免给员工施加过大压力。
collocations: a reasonable explanation｜合理的解释 ; a reasonable price｜公道的价格 ; reasonable expectations｜合理的期望 ; a reasonable standard｜尚可的水平
tip_zh: 形容价格时指公道、不贵，不一定是非常便宜。

meanings_zh: n. 澳大利亚
definition_en: a country in the south-west Pacific Ocean
example1_en: My aunt lives in Australia.
example1_zh: 我姑姑住在澳大利亚。
example2_en: Australia is famous for its beaches and wildlife.
example2_zh: 澳大利亚以海滩和野生动物闻名。
tip_zh: Australia 是专有名词，注意首字母大写；澳大利亚人叫 Australian。

meanings_zh: phr v. 以…为基础；根据
definition_en: to use something as the starting point
example1_en: The film is based on a true story.
example1_zh: 这部电影根据真实故事改编。
example2_en: You should base your answer on the facts.
example2_zh: 你的回答应该以事实为依据。
tip_zh: be based on 是“基于、以…为依据”，被动形式很常用。

meanings_zh: n. 网络摄像头
definition_en: a small camera used with a computer
example1_en: She turns off her webcam during online classes.
example1_zh: 上网课时她会关闭摄像头。
example2_en: The webcam has a built-in microphone.
example2_zh: 这个摄像头内置麦克风。
tip_zh: webcam 是电脑摄像头，用于视频通话。

meanings_zh: adj. 独立自主的 | adj. 不受控制的；独立的 | adj. 无关联的；互不影响的
definition_en: able to live or act without relying on others | not controlled by another person, organisation, or country | not connected with or affected by something else
example1_en: Living alone has made me much more independent.
example1_zh: 独居让我变得更加独立。
example2_en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
example2_zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。
collocations: financially independent｜经济独立的 ; independent research｜独立研究 ; independent of｜不依赖；不受影响 ; independent judgement｜独立判断
tip_zh: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

meanings_zh: phr v. 分手；解散；破碎
definition_en: to end a relationship, or to break into pieces
example1_en: They broke up after three years together.
example1_zh: 他们在一起三年后分手了。
example2_en: The ice on the lake broke up in spring.
example2_zh: 春天湖面的冰裂开了。
tip_zh: break up 常见义为“分手”；也指“解散、破碎”。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上 | prep. 一……就；在……时
definition_en: on something, especially in formal or literary language | immediately after or at the time of an event
example1_en: The cat rested upon a cushion beside the window.
example1_zh: 猫趴在窗边的垫子上休息。
example2_en: Upon completing their training, new teachers should receive ongoing support from experienced colleagues at school.
example2_zh: 新教师完成培训后，应持续获得校内资深同事的支持。
collocations: upon arrival｜一到达 ; upon completion｜一完成 ; once upon a time｜从前
tip_zh: 比on正式；upon doing表示“一……就”。

meanings_zh: v. 仍然是；保持 | v. 留下；停留 | v. 剩下；余留
definition_en: to continue to be in the same state | to stay in a place rather than leave | to still exist after other things have gone
example1_en: Please remain seated until the bus has stopped completely.
example1_zh: 请留在座位上，直到公交车完全停稳。
example2_en: Despite improvements in public transport, private cars remain the main means of travel in many rural areas.
example2_zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，私家车仍是许多农村地区的主要出行工具。
collocations: remain calm｜保持冷静 ; remain unchanged｜保持不变 ; remain a challenge｜仍是一项挑战 ; remain to be seen｜尚待分晓
tip_zh: 表示保持某状态时，后接形容词或名词，不用副词。

meanings_zh: n. 汇率；兑换率
definition_en: the value of one currency in another
example1_en: The exchange rate between the two currencies changed today.
example1_zh: 今天这两种货币的汇率变了。
example2_en: You can check the exchange rate online.
example2_zh: 你可以在网上查汇率。
tip_zh: exchange rate 是汇率；currency exchange 是货币兑换。

meanings_zh: n. 畅销书；畅销商品
definition_en: A book or other product that sells in very large quantities.
example1_en: Her first novel became a bestseller within weeks.
example1_zh: 她的第一部小说几周内就成了畅销书。
example2_en: A bestseller can introduce complex scientific ideas to readers who rarely engage with academic publications.
example2_zh: 畅销书能向很少接触学术出版物的读者介绍复杂的科学概念。
collocations: international bestseller｜国际畅销书 ; become a bestseller｜成为畅销书 ; bestseller list｜畅销书榜
tip_zh: 指畅销书或商品，不指畅销书作者。

meanings_zh: phr v. 搭起；张贴；举起
definition_en: to build, hang or raise something
example1_en: They put up a tent in the garden.
example1_zh: 他们在花园里搭了一顶帐篷。
example2_en: Please put up your hand if you know the answer.
example2_zh: 知道答案请举手。
tip_zh: put up 有“搭起、张贴、举起”等义。

meanings_zh: n. 公主；王妃
definition_en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.
example1_en: The princess waved to the crowd from her carriage.
example1_zh: 公主从马车里向人群挥手。
example2_en: Traditional stories often portray a princess as dependent, whereas modern adaptations increasingly emphasise her independence and leadership.
example2_zh: 传统故事常将公主塑造成依赖他人的形象，而现代改编作品越来越强调她的独立性和领导力。
collocations: a royal princess｜王室公主 ; a fairy-tale princess｜童话公主
tip_zh: 可指君主的女儿，也可指王子的妻子。

meanings_zh: phr v. 放弃；戒掉
definition_en: to stop trying or stop doing something
example1_en: Don't give up; you are doing well!
example1_zh: 别放弃，你做得很好！
example2_en: He gave up smoking last year.
example2_zh: 他去年戒烟了。
collocations: give up smoking｜戒烟
tip_zh: give up 表示“放弃”或“戒除（习惯）”。

meanings_zh: v. 祈祷 | v. 热切盼望；祈求
definition_en: To speak to a god to ask, thank, or worship. | To hope very strongly that something will happen.
example1_en: They gather quietly each morning to pray for peace.
example1_zh: 他们每天早晨静静地聚在一起，为和平祈祷。
example2_en: Providing quiet spaces allows people of different faiths to pray while studying or working on campus.
example2_zh: 提供安静的空间能让不同信仰的人在校园学习或工作期间祈祷。
collocations: pray for peace｜祈求和平 ; pray to God｜向上帝祈祷 ; pray that｜祈求……
tip_zh: pray to 接祈祷对象，pray for 接所求之事。

meanings_zh: n. 灌木；灌木丛 | n. 荒野；丛林地带
definition_en: A woody plant with several branches growing near the ground. | Wild, uncultivated land, especially in Australia or Africa.
example1_en: A small bird was hiding in the rose bush.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟躲在玫瑰丛里。
example2_en: Planting native bushes in urban gardens can provide shelter and food for local wildlife.
example2_zh: 在城市花园中种植本地灌木，可以为当地野生动物提供庇护和食物。
collocations: rose bush｜玫瑰丛 ; dense bushes｜茂密的灌木丛 ; in the bush｜在荒野中
tip_zh: 灌木是可数名词；the bush可指澳洲等地的荒野。

meanings_zh: adj. 突然的；意外的
definition_en: Happening quickly and unexpectedly
example1_en: A sudden gust blew my hat into the pond.
example1_zh: 一阵突如其来的风把我的帽子吹进了池塘。
example2_en: A sudden rise in food prices can place considerable pressure on families with low incomes.
example2_zh: 食品价格突然上涨会给低收入家庭带来相当大的压力。
collocations: a sudden change｜突变 ; a sudden increase｜骤增 ; a sudden movement｜突然的动作 ; all of a sudden｜突然
tip_zh: sudden是形容词；修饰动作通常用suddenly。

meanings_zh: phr v. 摆脱；扔掉
definition_en: to remove something unwanted
example1_en: We need to get rid of this old sofa.
example1_zh: 我们需要扔掉这张旧沙发。
example2_en: He got rid of his bad habit of staying up late.
example2_zh: 他改掉了熬夜的坏习惯。
tip_zh: get rid of 是“摆脱/处理掉”。

meanings_zh: adj. 迷人的；讨人喜欢的
definition_en: very pleasant or attractive in a way that delights people
example1_en: We found a charming little café beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边发现了一家迷人的小咖啡馆。
example2_en: Preserving charming historic neighbourhoods can attract visitors while strengthening residents' sense of belonging to their city.
example2_zh: 保护迷人的历史街区可以吸引游客，同时增强居民对城市的归属感。
collocations: charming smile｜迷人的微笑 ; charming village｜迷人的村庄 ; charming personality｜讨人喜欢的性格
tip_zh: 既可形容人讨喜，也可形容地方迷人。

meanings_zh: phr v. 放松；冷静
definition_en: to relax completely
example1_en: We chilled out by the pool all afternoon.
example1_zh: 我们整个下午都在泳池边放松。
example2_en: Chill out! Everything will be fine.
example2_zh: 冷静点！一切都会好的。
tip_zh: chill out 是口语“放松、冷静”。

meanings_zh: n. 保安；警卫
definition_en: a person who protects a building or people
example1_en: The security guard checked our bags at the entrance.
example1_zh: 保安在入口检查了我们的包。
example2_en: A security guard watches the building at night.
example2_zh: 保安夜里看守大楼。
tip_zh: security guard 是保安/警卫人员。

meanings_zh: n. 到达；到来 | n. 新来的人；新到的事物
definition_en: The act of reaching a place. | A person or thing that has recently reached a place.
example1_en: Our arrival at the campsite was delayed by heavy rain.
example1_zh: 大雨耽误了我们抵达营地的时间。
example2_en: The arrival of faster rail services has made smaller towns more attractive to commuters seeking affordable housing.
example2_zh: 更快捷的铁路服务使小城镇对寻求可负担住房的通勤者更有吸引力。
collocations: on arrival｜一到达 ; arrival time｜到达时间 ; new arrival｜新来者；新到物 ; arrival at the airport｜抵达机场
tip_zh: on arrival意为一到达，相当于upon arrival。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人失望的
definition_en: making you feel sad because it is not as good as hoped
example1_en: The film was disappointing; the ending was weak.
example1_zh: 这部电影令人失望，结尾很弱。
example2_en: It was disappointing that it rained on our picnic.
example2_zh: 野餐时下雨真让人失望。
tip_zh: disappointing 形容事物；disappointed 形容人的感受。

meanings_zh: phr. 面对面
definition_en: in person, looking at each other
example1_en: We talked face to face instead of texting.
example1_zh: 我们面对面交谈而不是发短信。
example2_en: She wanted to meet the singer face to face.
example2_zh: 她想和歌手面对面见面。
tip_zh: face to face 是“面对面地”。

meanings_zh: adj. 频繁的；经常发生的 | v. 常去；常到访
definition_en: Happening often or at short intervals | Visit a particular place regularly
example1_en: Frequent buses make getting to the market easy.
example1_zh: 公交车班次密集，去市场很方便。
example2_en: Frequent changes in education policy can make it difficult for teachers to plan effective lessons.
example2_zh: 教育政策频繁变化，可能使教师难以规划有效的课堂教学。
collocations: frequent visits｜频繁到访 ; frequent delays｜频繁延误 ; a frequent visitor｜常客 ; frequent changes｜频繁变化
tip_zh: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: n. 数学（美式口语）
definition_en: mathematics (American English)
example1_en: Math is my favourite subject at school.
example1_zh: 数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。
example2_en: She is good at math and science.
example2_zh: 她擅长数学和科学。
tip_zh: math 是美式说法；英式说 maths。

meanings_zh: adj. 最近的；不久前的
definition_en: having happened or started a short time ago
example1_en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
example1_zh: 你看过我们家小狗最近的照片吗？
example2_en: Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.
example2_zh: 医疗技术的近期进步改善了偏远社区患者的治疗选择。
collocations: recent research｜近期研究 ; recent developments｜近期进展 ; in recent years｜近年来
tip_zh: recent是形容词；修饰动作要用recently。

meanings_zh: n. 蜡烛
definition_en: a piece of wax with a central string that burns
example1_en: He lit a candle when the electricity went off.
example1_zh: 停电时，他点了一支蜡烛。
example2_en: Although candles create a pleasant atmosphere, they should never be left burning unattended in homes or public spaces.
example2_zh: 虽然蜡烛能营造宜人的氛围，但在住宅或公共场所，绝不能让其在无人看管时燃烧。
collocations: light a candle｜点蜡烛 ; blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛 ; scented candle｜香薰蜡烛
tip_zh: 点蜡烛用light；吹灭用blow out。

meanings_zh: adj. 失明的 | adj. 盲目的；未察觉的 | n. 卷帘；百叶窗
definition_en: Unable to see. | Unwilling or unable to recognize facts or problems. | A window covering that can be raised or adjusted.
example1_en: My blind uncle reads stories using his fingertips.
example1_zh: 我失明的叔叔用指尖触读故事。
example2_en: Public transport systems should provide clear audio announcements to help blind passengers travel safely and independently.
example2_zh: 公共交通系统应提供清晰的语音播报，帮助失明乘客安全、独立地出行。
collocations: blind passengers｜失明乘客 ; blind faith｜盲目信任 ; blind to the risks｜无视风险 ; roller blind｜卷帘
tip_zh: blind to表示未察觉或无视；窗帘义是可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 休闲的；非正式的 | adj. 临时的；不定期的 | adj. 不经意的；随意的
definition_en: relaxed and not formal | done occasionally rather than regularly or permanently | done without much attention or serious thought
example1_en: You can wear casual clothes to dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚吃饭你可以穿休闲服。
example2_en: Casual employment offers flexibility, but workers may lack the financial security associated with permanent jobs.
example2_zh: 临时工作提供了灵活性，但从业者可能缺乏固定工作带来的经济保障。
collocations: casual clothes｜休闲服 ; casual conversation｜闲聊 ; casual work｜临时工作 ; casual remark｜随口说的话
tip_zh: casual可指穿着随意，也可指工作非长期固定。

meanings_zh: adj. 右手的；右侧的
definition_en: on or towards the right side
example1_en: The shops are on the right-hand side of the street.
example1_zh: 商店在街道右侧。
example2_en: She is my right-hand helper in the office.
example2_zh: 她是我在办公室的得力助手。
tip_zh: right-hand 是“右侧的”；right-hand side 右侧。

meanings_zh: n. 玫瑰；蔷薇 | v. 上升；增加（rise过去式）
definition_en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems | past tense of rise: moved upwards or increased
example1_en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
example1_zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插进了玻璃花瓶。
example2_en: Demand for public transport rose sharply after the city introduced cheaper fares and more frequent services.
example2_zh: 该市降低票价并增加班次后，公共交通需求大幅上升。
collocations: a bunch of roses｜一束玫瑰 ; rose petals｜玫瑰花瓣 ; rose sharply｜急剧上升
tip_zh: rose也可作rise的过去式；过去分词是risen。

meanings_zh: n. 按钮 | n. 纽扣 | v. 扣上纽扣
definition_en: A small control you press to operate something | A small object that fastens clothing through a hole | Fasten clothing using buttons
example1_en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
example1_zh: 按绿色按钮启动洗衣机。
example2_en: Emergency buttons on public transport allow passengers to alert staff quickly when assistance is needed.
example2_zh: 公共交通工具上的紧急按钮让乘客能够在需要帮助时迅速通知工作人员。
collocations: press a button｜按按钮 ; push a button｜按下按钮 ; button up a coat｜扣好外套 ; sew on a button｜缝上纽扣
tip_zh: button up指扣好纽扣；拉链用zip，不用button。

meanings_zh: n. 牛；牛群
definition_en: Farm animals kept for their milk or meat.
example1_en: The cattle gathered under a tree during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨中，牛群聚集在一棵树下。
example2_en: Raising cattle requires substantial land and water, which can place pressure on local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 养牛需要大量土地和水，这可能给当地生态系统带来压力。
collocations: raise cattle｜养牛 ; a herd of cattle｜一群牛 ; dairy cattle｜奶牛 ; beef cattle｜肉牛
tip_zh: cattle是复数集合名词，用are；单头牛不用a cattle。

meanings_zh: n. 空军
definition_en: the part of a country's military that uses planes
example1_en: His uncle is a pilot in the air force.
example1_zh: 他叔叔是空军飞行员。
example2_en: The air force held an air show at the airport.
example2_zh: 空军在机场举行了飞行表演。
tip_zh: air force 是空军；navy 海军，army 陆军。

meanings_zh: n. 香料；调味香料 | v. 给……加香料 | n. 趣味；刺激
definition_en: A plant substance used to add flavour to food. | To add spices to food. | Something that makes an experience more interesting or exciting.
example1_en: This warming spice gives the soup a lovely flavour.
example1_zh: 这种带来暖意的香料让汤的味道十分美妙。
example2_en: The historical spice trade connected distant societies and encouraged the exchange of agricultural knowledge and cooking techniques.
example2_zh: 历史上的香料贸易连接了遥远的社会，并促进了农业知识与烹饪技术的交流。
collocations: ground spices｜磨碎的香料 ; spice trade｜香料贸易 ; spice rack｜香料架 ; spice up｜增添趣味；加香料
tip_zh: spice不一定辣；spice up也可指增添趣味。

meanings_zh: n. 吉他手
definition_en: a person who plays the guitar
example1_en: The guitarist played a beautiful solo.
example1_zh: 吉他手演奏了一段优美的独奏。
example2_en: She is a guitarist in a rock band.
example2_zh: 她是一支摇滚乐队的吉他手。
tip_zh: guitarist 是吉他手；pianist 钢琴手。

meanings_zh: n. 污垢；灰尘 | n. 泥土
definition_en: Unwanted material that makes something unclean | Loose earth, especially on the ground
example1_en: Please wipe the dirt off your shoes before entering.
example1_zh: 进来之前，请把鞋上的泥污擦掉。
example2_en: Regular handwashing removes dirt and reduces the spread of infections in schools and other shared spaces.
example2_zh: 经常洗手可以去除污垢，减少学校及其他公共场所的感染传播。
collocations: remove dirt｜去除污垢 ; covered in dirt｜沾满污垢 ; dirt road｜土路
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示“泥土”时多见于美式英语。

meanings_zh: n. 支持者；球迷
definition_en: a person who supports a team or an idea
example1_en: The football supporters cheered loudly.
example1_zh: 足球迷们大声欢呼。
example2_en: She is a strong supporter of the environment.
example2_zh: 她是环保的坚定支持者。
tip_zh: supporter 是“支持者”；体育场景中指球迷。

meanings_zh: n. 电灯泡 | n. 鳞茎
definition_en: A glass or plastic device that produces electric light. | A rounded underground plant part that stores food and grows shoots.
example1_en: The kitchen bulb failed while I was washing dishes.
example1_zh: 我洗碗时，厨房的灯泡坏了。
example2_en: Replacing traditional bulbs with energy-efficient alternatives can reduce household electricity consumption and lower long-term costs.
example2_zh: 用节能灯泡替换传统灯泡可以减少家庭用电量，并降低长期成本。
collocations: light bulb｜电灯泡 ; change a bulb｜换灯泡 ; energy-saving bulb｜节能灯泡 ; plant bulbs｜种植鳞茎
tip_zh: 既指灯泡，也指洋葱、水仙等植物的鳞茎。

meanings_zh: n. 玉米 | n. 谷物；谷粒
definition_en: a tall crop with large heads of yellow edible seeds | grain crops such as wheat or barley, especially in British English
example1_en: We grilled fresh corn and served it with butter.
