example1_zh: 我们烤了新鲜玉米，配着黄油一起吃。
example2_en: Farmers growing corn may need more efficient irrigation systems as droughts become increasingly frequent.
example2_zh: 随着干旱日益频繁，种植玉米的农民可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。
collocations: corn on the cob｜玉米棒 ; corn kernels｜玉米粒 ; corn field｜玉米田 ; corn oil｜玉米油
tip_zh: 美式corn通常指玉米；英式也可泛指谷物。

meanings_zh: adj. 错误的；不真实的 | adj. 假的；人造的 | adj. 不真诚的；虚伪的
definition_en: not true or based on facts | made to resemble something real or natural | intended to hide someone's real feelings or intentions
example1_en: That rumour about our neighbour is completely FALSE.
example1_zh: 那条关于我们邻居的传闻完全不实。
example2_en: Claims that all online information is reliable are FALSE, so students should learn to evaluate sources critically.
example2_zh: 声称所有网络信息都可靠是错误的，因此学生应学会批判性地评估信息来源。
collocations: false information｜虚假信息 ; false impression｜错误印象 ; false alarm｜虚惊；误报 ; false teeth｜假牙
tip_zh: false指不真实；fake更强调刻意仿冒。通常写作小写。

meanings_zh: v. 坚决要求；坚持主张 | v. 坚持说；坚称
definition_en: to demand something firmly despite disagreement | to state firmly that something is true
example1_en: My grandparents insist on paying for lunch every time.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母每次都坚持要付午餐钱。
example2_en: Many parents insist that schools provide regular physical education, even when academic subjects compete for classroom time.
example2_zh: 即使文化课挤占课时，许多家长仍坚决要求学校定期开设体育课。
collocations: insist on doing something｜坚持做某事 ; insist that｜坚决要求；坚称 ; insist on payment｜坚持要求付款
tip_zh: 用insist on doing，不用insist to do。

meanings_zh: phr v. 来访；打电话进来；请来
definition_en: to visit briefly, or to phone in
example1_en: She called in to see us on her way home.
example1_zh: 她回家路上顺便来看我们。
example2_en: Listeners can call in to the radio show.
example2_zh: 听众可以打电话进广播节目。
tip_zh: call in 表示“顺便来访”或“打电话进来”。

meanings_zh: n. 灰尘；尘土 | v. 擦去灰尘；掸灰 | v. 撒上少量粉末
definition_en: Fine, dry particles that settle on surfaces or float. | To remove dust from a surface. | To cover something lightly with a powder.
example1_en: A thick layer of dust covered the old piano.
example1_zh: 那架旧钢琴上积了厚厚一层灰。
example2_en: Construction dust can reduce local air quality and cause breathing difficulties among nearby residents.
example2_zh: 施工扬尘会降低当地空气质量，并导致附近居民呼吸困难。
collocations: a layer of dust｜一层灰尘 ; gather dust｜积灰；闲置不用 ; dust the shelves｜掸去架子上的灰 ; dust with flour｜撒上少量面粉
tip_zh: dust作动词既可指除尘，也可指撒粉，看宾语判断。

meanings_zh: n. 嘴唇 | n. 边缘；边沿
definition_en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth. | The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.
example1_en: My lips felt dry after walking in the wind.
example1_zh: 在风中走了一阵后，我觉得嘴唇很干。
example2_en: Clear face coverings can improve communication for people who rely on watching lips to understand speech.
example2_zh: 透明面罩可以帮助那些依靠观察嘴唇来理解话语的人更顺畅地交流。
collocations: upper lip｜上嘴唇 ; dry lips｜干燥的嘴唇 ; bite your lip｜咬嘴唇 ; the lip of a cup｜杯口边缘
tip_zh: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。

meanings_zh: n. 旅游业；观光旅游
definition_en: travel for pleasure and the businesses serving people who travel
example1_en: Tourism brings many visitors to our village each summer.
example1_zh: 每年夏天，旅游业都会为我们村带来许多游客。
example2_en: Sustainable tourism can generate income for local communities while protecting the natural landscapes that attract visitors.
example2_zh: 可持续旅游能为当地社区创造收入，同时保护吸引游客的自然景观。
collocations: sustainable tourism｜可持续旅游 ; mass tourism｜大众旅游 ; domestic tourism｜国内旅游 ; tourism industry｜旅游业
tip_zh: tourism通常不可数；表示一个游客用a tourist。

meanings_zh: n. 室友
definition_en: a person who shares a room or flat with you
example1_en: My roommate is from Italy.
example1_zh: 我的室友来自意大利。
example2_en: She gets on well with her roommate.
example2_zh: 她和室友相处得很好。
tip_zh: roommate 是室友；英式分房间共享说 flatmate/housemate。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽阔的；广泛的
definition_en: wide; including many things
example1_en: They crossed a broad river by boat.
example1_zh: 他们乘船渡过一条宽阔的河。
example2_en: The course covers a broad range of topics.
example2_zh: 这门课程涵盖广泛的主题。
collocations: broad range｜广泛的范围
tip_zh: broad 与 wide 都指“宽”；broad 也引申为“广泛的”。

meanings_zh: v. 抢劫；盗取财物 | v. 剥夺；使丧失
definition_en: To take money or property illegally from someone or somewhere. | To unfairly take away something valuable or important.
example1_en: Someone tried to rob the shop near our house.
example1_zh: 有人试图抢劫我们家附近的商店。
example2_en: Long working hours can rob parents of valuable opportunities to spend time with their children.
example2_zh: 过长的工作时间可能使父母失去与孩子共度时光的宝贵机会。
collocations: rob a bank｜抢银行 ; rob someone of something｜抢走某人某物 ; rob someone of opportunities｜剥夺某人的机会
tip_zh: rob接人或地点；steal接被偷的物品。

meanings_zh: v. 存在 | v. 生存；勉强维生
definition_en: To be real or present in the world. | To stay alive, especially with very limited resources.
example1_en: Do you think creatures like these really exist?
example1_zh: 你觉得这样的生物真的存在吗？
example2_en: Significant differences in access to healthcare still exist between rural communities and major urban centres.
example2_zh: 农村社区与主要城市中心在医疗服务的可及性方面仍存在显著差异。
collocations: already exist｜已经存在 ; continue to exist｜继续存在 ; exist in nature｜存在于自然界 ; exist on limited resources｜靠有限资源维生
tip_zh: 是不及物动词，不用被动语态；“不存在”用does not exist。

meanings_zh: adv. 相当；颇 | adv. 宁愿；更愿意 | adv. 更确切地说
definition_en: To a noticeable degree, often more than expected. | Used with would to express a preference. | Used to correct or make a previous statement more accurate.
example1_en: This soup is rather salty, but the bread is delicious.
example1_zh: 这汤有点咸，不过面包很好吃。
example2_en: Many commuters would rather cycle to work if safer routes were available throughout the city.
example2_zh: 如果全市都有更安全的骑行路线，许多通勤者会更愿意骑车上班。
collocations: rather difficult｜相当困难 ; would rather stay｜宁愿留下 ; rather than｜而不是 ; or rather｜更确切地说
tip_zh: would rather后接动词原形；rather than意为“而不是”。

meanings_zh: adj. 不重要的
definition_en: not important
example1_en: The colour of the box is unimportant.
example1_zh: 盒子的颜色不重要。
example2_en: Don't worry about unimportant details.
example2_zh: 别为无关紧要的细节担心。
tip_zh: unimportant 是 important 的反义词“不重要的”。

meanings_zh: n. 男邮递员
definition_en: a man whose job is to deliver letters and parcels
example1_en: The postman left a parcel beside our front door.
example1_zh: 邮递员把一个包裹放在了我们家门旁。
example2_en: In remote villages, a postman may provide an essential link between residents and public services.
example2_zh: 在偏远村庄，邮递员可能是连接居民与公共服务的重要纽带。
collocations: the local postman｜当地邮递员 ; work as a postman｜当邮递员 ; the postman's round｜邮递员的投递路线
tip_zh: 英式常用；美式常用mail carrier，且不限定性别。

meanings_zh: v. 提到；说起 | n. 提及
definition_en: to refer to someone or something briefly | a brief reference to someone or something
example1_en: Did you mention the broken window to the landlord?
example1_zh: 你向房东提过那扇坏了的窗户吗？
example2_en: Reports on urban transport often mention congestion but overlook the needs of people with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 城市交通报告经常提到拥堵，却忽视行动不便人群的需求。
collocations: mention something to someone｜向某人提及某事 ; mention that｜提到…… ; make no mention of｜未提及 ; not to mention｜更不用说
tip_zh: 直接接所提内容：mention sth，不用 mention about。

meanings_zh: adv. 幸运地；幸好
definition_en: Luckily, especially when something bad could have happened.
example1_en: Fortunately, I found my keys before the bus arrived.
example1_zh: 幸好，我在公交车到站前找到了钥匙。
example2_en: Fortunately, improvements in water treatment have helped many communities reduce the spread of preventable diseases.
example2_zh: 幸运的是，水处理技术的改进帮助许多社区减少了可预防疾病的传播。
collocations: fortunately for us｜对我们来说幸运的是 ; fortunately enough｜很幸运 ; fortunately, nobody was hurt｜幸好无人受伤
tip_zh: 常置于句首，后加逗号，评价整件事令人庆幸。

meanings_zh: n. 阴凉处；背阴 | n. 色调；颜色深浅 | v. 遮阳；遮蔽
definition_en: an area protected from direct sunlight | a particular form of a colour | to protect something from direct light
example1_en: We rested in the shade beneath a large tree.
example1_zh: 我们在一棵大树下的阴凉处休息。
example2_en: Planting trees along urban streets provides shade and can reduce residents' exposure to extreme summer heat.
example2_zh: 沿城市街道种树可以提供荫凉，减少居民受到夏季酷热的影响。
collocations: in the shade｜在阴凉处 ; provide shade｜提供荫凉 ; a shade of blue｜一种蓝色调 ; shade your eyes｜遮住眼睛挡光
tip_zh: shade常指阴凉区域；shadow指物体投下的影子。

meanings_zh: v. 滚动；使滚动 | v. 卷起；卷成 | n. 一卷；小面包
definition_en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly | To form something into a curved or cylindrical shape | Material wound around itself, or a small individual bread
example1_en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
example1_zh: 橙子从桌上滚下来，滚到了我的椅子底下。
example2_en: Workers roll sheets of recycled material into compact bundles to simplify storage and transportation.
example2_zh: 工人把再生材料薄片卷成紧实的捆，以便储存和运输。
collocations: roll down a hill｜滚下山坡 ; roll up your sleeves｜卷起袖子 ; a roll of paper｜一卷纸 ; bread roll｜小圆面包
tip_zh: roll强调翻转滚动；卷起常用roll up。

meanings_zh: n. 回收利用 | n. 待回收物品
definition_en: the process of turning waste into materials usable again | waste materials collected to be processed and used again
example1_en: Our building has separate bins for recycling and food waste.
example1_zh: 我们这栋楼分别设有回收物桶和厨余垃圾桶。
example2_en: Effective recycling programmes require convenient collection services as well as clear public guidance on sorting household waste.
example2_zh: 有效的回收利用计划既需要便利的收集服务，也需要向公众明确说明如何分类生活垃圾。
collocations: recycling centre｜回收中心 ; recycling bin｜回收物桶 ; recycling scheme｜回收计划 ; household recycling｜家庭废物回收
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示回收活动或待回收的物品。

meanings_zh: phr v. 变成；转变为
definition_en: to become something different
example1_en: The old factory turned into a museum.
example1_zh: 旧工厂变成了博物馆。
example2_en: Water turns into ice when it freezes.
example2_zh: 水结冰时变成冰。
tip_zh: turn into 表示“变成”；turn A into B 把A变成B。

meanings_zh: phr. 事实上；其实
definition_en: actually; used to give more information
example1_en: I thought he was a teacher; in fact, he's a doctor.
example1_zh: 我以为他是老师，事实上他是医生。
example2_en: In fact, the city is quite small.
example2_zh: 事实上，这座城市很小。
tip_zh: in fact 用来纠正或补充事实。

meanings_zh: n. 极限运动
definition_en: a dangerous and exciting sport
example1_en: Skydiving is an extreme sport.
example1_zh: 跳伞是一项极限运动。
example2_en: He loves extreme sports like rock climbing.
example2_zh: 他喜欢攀岩之类的极限运动。
tip_zh: extreme sport 是极限运动，如跳伞、攀岩、冲浪等。

meanings_zh: adj. 爱发号施令的；专横的
definition_en: always telling other people what to do
example1_en: Her older sister is a bit bossy.
example1_zh: 她姐姐有点爱发号施令。
example2_en: Don't be so bossy; let everyone decide.
example2_zh: 别这么专横，让大家自己决定。
tip_zh: bossy 是形容词，形容喜欢指挥别人的人。

meanings_zh: n. 实验室；研究室
definition_en: a room or building equipped for scientific work
example1_en: We wore safety glasses inside the school laboratory.
example1_zh: 我们在学校实验室里戴着护目镜。
example2_en: Investment in laboratory equipment enables university students to develop practical skills and conduct reliable experiments.
example2_zh: 投资实验室设备能让大学生培养实践技能并开展可靠的实验。
collocations: laboratory equipment｜实验室设备 ; laboratory tests｜实验室检测 ; research laboratory｜研究实验室
tip_zh: 常缩写为lab；英美发音的重音位置不同。

meanings_zh: adv. 否则；不然 | adv. 在其他方面 | adv. 以其他方式；不同地
definition_en: If this does not happen or is not done. | In all other ways apart from the one mentioned. | In a different way or with a different result.
example1_en: Take an umbrella; otherwise, you will get wet.
example1_zh: 带把伞吧，否则你会淋湿的。
example2_en: Cities must invest in reliable public transport; otherwise, more residents may choose to drive.
example2_zh: 城市必须投资建设可靠的公共交通，否则更多居民可能选择开车。
collocations: unless otherwise stated｜除非另有说明 ; think otherwise｜持不同看法 ; otherwise healthy｜除此之外身体健康
tip_zh: 表示“否则”时，书面语常在前面用分号。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓励；给予信心 | v. 促进；鼓励发展
definition_en: Give someone confidence or support to do something | Make an activity or development more likely
example1_en: My sister encouraged me to join the swimming club.
example1_zh: 姐姐鼓励我加入游泳俱乐部。
example2_en: Local governments can encourage cycling by providing safer routes and secure bicycle parking near workplaces.
example2_zh: 地方政府可以通过提供更安全的路线和工作场所附近的安全自行车停车设施来鼓励骑行。
collocations: encourage someone to do something｜鼓励某人做某事 ; strongly encourage｜大力鼓励 ; encourage participation｜鼓励参与
tip_zh: 用encourage sb to do sth表示鼓励某人做某事。

meanings_zh: adj. 难以置信的 | adj. 极好的；极糟的
definition_en: So surprising or unlikely that it is hard to believe. | Extremely good or bad, causing strong surprise.
example1_en: The view from the mountain was unbelievable at sunrise.
example1_zh: 日出时山上的景色美得令人难以置信。
example2_en: Some online advertisements promise unbelievable results, making it difficult for consumers to distinguish evidence from exaggeration.
example2_zh: 一些网络广告承诺令人难以置信的效果，使消费者难以区分实证与夸大宣传。
collocations: an unbelievable story｜难以置信的故事 ; unbelievable results｜惊人的效果 ; unbelievable luck｜难以置信的好运
tip_zh: 既可表示不可信，也可口语强调极好或极糟。

meanings_zh: n. 阿司匹林（药片）
definition_en: a medicine that stops pain and fever
example1_en: She took an aspirin for her headache.
example1_zh: 她吃了片阿司匹林治头痛。
example2_en: Aspirin can help with a fever.
example2_zh: 阿司匹林有助于退烧。
collocations: take an aspirin｜吃一片阿司匹林
tip_zh: take an aspirin 吃阿司匹林；服药说 take medicine。

meanings_zh: v. 由…组成 | v. 在于
definition_en: to be formed from particular parts or members | to have something as the essential feature
example1_en: Our picnic lunch consists of sandwiches, fruit, and juice.
example1_zh: 我们的野餐午饭有三明治、水果和果汁。
example2_en: An effective recycling programme consists of convenient collection services and clear guidance for local residents.
example2_zh: 有效的回收计划包括便捷的收集服务和面向当地居民的明确指引。
collocations: consist of｜由…组成 ; consist mainly of｜主要由…组成 ; consist in｜在于
tip_zh: consist of表组成，不用被动；consist in表在于。

meanings_zh: adj. 每年的；年度的 | n. 年刊；年鉴 | n. 一年生植物
definition_en: Happening once a year or relating to a whole year | A book or magazine published once each year | A plant that completes its life cycle within one year
example1_en: Our annual family picnic was held beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们一年一度的家庭野餐在湖边举行。
example2_en: The annual report provides useful evidence of how public funding has improved local transport services.
example2_zh: 年度报告提供了有用的证据，说明公共资金如何改善了当地交通服务。
collocations: annual report｜年度报告 ; annual income｜年收入 ; annual leave｜年假 ; annual event｜一年一度的活动
tip_zh: annual 表示每年的；annually 是副词，意为每年。

meanings_zh: n. 上唇胡须；小胡子
definition_en: Hair growing above the upper lip.
example1_en: My uncle carefully trims his moustache every Sunday.
example1_zh: 我叔叔每个星期天都会仔细修剪他的小胡子。
example2_en: In historical portraits, a carefully styled moustache often reflected contemporary ideas about fashion and social status.
example2_zh: 在历史肖像画中，精心打理的小胡子往往反映了当时关于时尚和社会地位的观念。
collocations: grow a moustache｜留小胡子 ; trim a moustache｜修剪小胡子 ; a thick moustache｜浓密的小胡子
tip_zh: moustache指上唇胡须；beard指下巴等处的胡须。

meanings_zh: v. 选择；挑选 | adj. 精选的；优等的
definition_en: Choose someone or something carefully from available options. | Carefully chosen for special quality or suitability.
example1_en: Please select a fresh apple from the basket.
example1_zh: 请从篮子里挑选一个新鲜的苹果。
example2_en: Universities should select applicants using a range of criteria rather than relying entirely on examination results.
example2_zh: 大学应依据多种标准选拔申请者，而非完全依赖考试成绩。
collocations: select a candidate｜挑选候选人 ; select from a list｜从列表中选择 ; select someone for a role｜选某人担任角色 ; a select group｜精选的一群人
tip_zh: select 比 choose 正式，常强调仔细挑选。

meanings_zh: n. 联系；关联 | n. 连接；接通 | n. 换乘；接续交通工具
definition_en: a relationship between people, things, or ideas | a link that allows devices or systems to work together | a further bus, train, or flight taken during a journey
example1_en: Our internet connection stopped working during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨期间，我们的网络连接中断了。
example2_en: Researchers have found a strong connection between regular physical activity and improved mental health among young adults.
example2_zh: 研究人员发现，经常进行体育活动与年轻成年人心理健康改善之间存在密切联系。
collocations: a connection between｜……之间的联系 ; internet connection｜网络连接 ; miss a connection｜错过换乘 ; in connection with｜与……有关
tip_zh: 表示两者的联系用connection between A and B。

meanings_zh: adj. 工作的；运转中的
definition_en: doing a job, or functioning
example1_en: The working hours here are nine to five.
example1_zh: 这里的工作时间是九点到五点。
example2_en: Is the machine still working?
example2_zh: 机器还在运转吗？
tip_zh: working 是“工作的/运转的”；working hours 工作时间。

meanings_zh: n. 缺口；间隙 | n. 差距；分歧 | n. 间隔；中断
definition_en: An empty space between things or within something. | A difference between people, groups, or situations. | A period when something stops or does not happen.
example1_en: The kitten squeezed through a gap in the fence.
example1_zh: 小猫从篱笆的一个缺口钻了过去。
example2_en: Improving access to affordable education could narrow the gap between wealthy households and disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 让更多人获得负担得起的教育，可以缩小富裕家庭与弱势社区之间的差距。
collocations: a gap in the fence｜篱笆上的缺口 ; narrow the gap｜缩小差距 ; the generation gap｜代沟 ; a gap year｜间隔年
tip_zh: 两者间的差距用 gap between A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 粉；粉末 | v. 给……搽粉；撒粉
definition_en: A dry substance consisting of very small loose particles. | To put a layer of powder on something.
example1_en: Stir the cocoa powder into a little warm milk.
example1_zh: 把可可粉搅入少量温牛奶中。
example2_en: Some manufacturers turn surplus fruit into powder to extend its shelf life and reduce food waste.
example2_zh: 一些生产商将多余的水果制成果粉，以延长保质期并减少食物浪费。
collocations: washing powder｜洗衣粉 ; baking powder｜泡打粉 ; fine powder｜细粉 ; cocoa powder｜可可粉
tip_zh: powder通常不可数；一勺粉用a spoonful of powder。

meanings_zh: v. 悬挂；吊着 | v. 垂下；低垂
definition_en: attach something above the ground, or remain suspended | fall or bend downwards loosely
example1_en: Please hang your wet coat beside the front door.
example1_zh: 请把你的湿外套挂在前门旁边。
example2_en: Museums often hang paintings at different heights to make their collections accessible to visitors of all ages.
example2_zh: 博物馆常将画作挂在不同高度，方便各年龄段的参观者欣赏馆藏。
collocations: hang a picture｜挂画 ; hang on a wall｜挂在墙上 ; hang your head｜垂下头 ; hang out the washing｜晾衣服
tip_zh: 悬挂的过去式、过去分词均为hung；绞死则用hanged。

meanings_zh: n. 政治家；政客
definition_en: Someone whose work involves politics, especially an elected government member.
example1_en: A local politician visited our neighbourhood to discuss transport.
example1_zh: 一位当地政治人物来到我们社区讨论交通问题。
example2_en: Politicians should consult local communities before making decisions that could affect access to public services.
example2_zh: 政治人物在作出可能影响公共服务获取的决定前，应征求当地社区的意见。
collocations: a local politician｜地方政治人物 ; an elected politician｜民选政治人物 ; a senior politician｜资深政治人物
tip_zh: politician指从政者，本身不一定含贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 桶；一桶的量
definition_en: An open container with a handle, or the amount it holds.
example1_en: She filled a bucket with water to wash the windows.
example1_zh: 她装了一桶水，准备用来擦窗户。
example2_en: Collecting rainwater in a bucket can help households reduce the amount of drinking water used for gardening.
example2_zh: 用桶收集雨水可以帮助家庭减少园艺活动中的饮用水用量。
collocations: a bucket of water｜一桶水 ; fill a bucket｜装满一只桶 ; mop and bucket｜拖把和水桶
tip_zh: 一桶水用a bucket of water，of后接所装物。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人紧张的；压力大的
definition_en: Causing worry or mental strain
example1_en: Moving house was stressful, but our friends helped.
example1_zh: 搬家让人压力很大，但朋友们帮了忙。
example2_en: Long commutes can make working life more stressful and leave less time for family activities.
example2_zh: 长时间通勤会增加工作生活的压力，并减少与家人活动的时间。
collocations: a stressful situation｜令人紧张的处境 ; a stressful job｜压力大的工作 ; a stressful experience｜令人紧张的经历
tip_zh: stressful形容压力来源；stressed形容人的感受。

meanings_zh: v. 证明；证实 | v. 结果是；证明是
definition_en: Show that something is true using evidence | Turn out to be a particular thing or quality
example1_en: These photos prove that our dog opened the cupboard.
example1_zh: 这些照片证明是我们的狗打开了橱柜。
example2_en: Long-term studies may prove that regular exercise improves concentration as well as physical health.
example2_zh: 长期研究可能证实，经常锻炼既能改善注意力，也能增强身体健康。
collocations: prove a point｜证明一个观点 ; prove effective｜证明有效 ; prove someone wrong｜证明某人错了
tip_zh: prove可接that从句，也可直接接形容词。

meanings_zh: v. 装饰；布置 | v. 粉刷；装修
definition_en: to make something more attractive by adding beautiful things | to paint walls or cover them with wallpaper
example1_en: We decorated the balcony with colourful pots and tiny lights.
example1_zh: 我们用彩色花盆和小灯装饰了阳台。
example2_en: Allowing students to decorate shared learning spaces may increase their sense of ownership and responsibility.
example2_zh: 允许学生装饰公共学习空间，可能增强他们的主人翁意识和责任感。
collocations: decorate with flowers｜用花装饰 ; decorate a room｜装饰房间 ; beautifully decorated｜装饰精美的
tip_zh: decorate A with B表示用B装饰A。

meanings_zh: n. 鳕鱼；鳕鱼肉
definition_en: A large sea fish, or its white flesh eaten as food.
example1_en: We baked the cod with lemon and fresh herbs.
example1_zh: 我们用柠檬和新鲜香草烤了鳕鱼。
example2_en: Strict fishing limits can help cod populations recover while protecting the long-term livelihoods of coastal communities.
example2_zh: 严格的捕捞限额可以帮助鳕鱼种群恢复，同时保障沿海社区的长远生计。
collocations: cod fillet｜鳕鱼片 ; cod liver oil｜鱼肝油 ; cod stocks｜鳕鱼资源量
tip_zh: 鱼的单复数均为cod；指鳕鱼肉时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 远征；考察；探险 | n. 探险队；考察队
definition_en: An organised journey made for exploration or a specific purpose. | A group of people travelling together to explore or investigate.
example1_en: We packed warm clothes for our expedition into the mountains.
example1_zh: 我们为进山探险打包了保暖衣物。
example2_en: A scientific expedition to the polar regions collected valuable evidence of changes in sea ice.
example2_zh: 一支前往极地的科学考察队收集了海冰变化的重要证据。
collocations: a scientific expedition｜科学考察 ; go on an expedition｜去探险 ; lead an expedition｜带领探险队 ; an expedition to Antarctica｜南极考察
tip_zh: expedition多指有组织、有特定目的的远行。

meanings_zh: n. 发明家；发明者
definition_en: someone who creates a device or process not previously existing
example1_en: The inventor showed us a lamp powered by sunlight.
example1_zh: 这位发明家向我们展示了一盏太阳能灯。
example2_en: Inventors often need financial support to turn promising ideas into practical technologies that benefit society.
example2_zh: 发明者往往需要资金支持，才能把有前景的想法转化为造福社会的实用技术。
collocations: a brilliant inventor｜杰出的发明家 ; the inventor of｜……的发明者 ; an aspiring inventor｜有志成为发明家的人
tip_zh: inventor创造新事物；discoverer发现已有事物。

meanings_zh: v. 陪同；陪伴 | v. 伴随；与……同时发生 | v. 为……伴奏
definition_en: Go somewhere with someone. | Exist or happen together with something else. | Play music to support a singer or another musician.
example1_en: My sister will accompany me to the clinic tomorrow.
example1_zh: 明天姐姐会陪我去诊所。
example2_en: Investment in public transport should accompany urban expansion to prevent congestion and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 城市扩张应配合公共交通投资，以防止交通拥堵并改善就业可达性。
collocations: accompany someone to｜陪某人去 ; be accompanied by｜伴有；由……陪同 ; accompany on the piano｜用钢琴伴奏
tip_zh: 直接接人作宾语，不说accompany with someone。

meanings_zh: n. 锦标赛 | n. 冠军称号；冠军地位
definition_en: a competition to decide the best player or team | the position or title of being a champion
example1_en: Our school team reached the final of the championship.
example1_zh: 我们校队打进了锦标赛的决赛。
example2_en: Hosting an international championship can attract visitors, but the cost of new facilities may burden local taxpayers.
example2_zh: 举办国际锦标赛可以吸引游客，但新建设施的费用可能加重当地纳税人的负担。
collocations: win a championship｜赢得冠军 ; world championship｜世界锦标赛 ; championship title｜冠军头衔
tip_zh: 既可指争夺冠军的赛事，也可指冠军头衔。

meanings_zh: n. 某次；场合 | n. 特殊活动；盛会 | n. 机会；时机
definition_en: a particular time when something happens | an important or special event | a suitable opportunity to do something
example1_en: I have met your sister on several occasions.
example1_zh: 我见过你姐姐好几次。
example2_en: Community festivals provide an occasion for residents from different backgrounds to share traditions and build friendships.
example2_zh: 社区节庆让不同背景的居民有机会分享传统、建立友谊。
collocations: on several occasions｜好几次 ; a special occasion｜特殊场合 ; on occasion｜偶尔 ; rise to the occasion｜成功应对挑战
tip_zh: 表示“在某次场合”用on，不用in。

meanings_zh: n. 间隔；间距 | n. 幕间休息
definition_en: A period or distance between events or objects. | A short break between parts of a performance.
example1_en: There was a short interval between the two calls.
example1_zh: 两通电话之间隔了一小会儿。
example2_en: Taking breaks at regular intervals can help students maintain concentration during long periods of study.
example2_zh: 长时间学习时，定时休息有助于学生保持专注。
collocations: at regular intervals｜每隔固定时间或距离 ; a short interval｜短暂的间隔 ; a time interval｜时间间隔 ; during the interval｜在幕间休息时
tip_zh: at intervals表示每隔一段时间或距离。

meanings_zh: n. 决定；抉择
definition_en: a choice made after considering different possibilities
example1_en: Moving closer to work was a good decision.
example1_zh: 搬到离工作地点更近的地方是个明智的决定。
example2_en: Governments should base every major transport decision on reliable evidence and consultation with the communities affected.
example2_zh: 政府的每项重大交通决策都应以可靠证据及与受影响社区的协商为基础。
collocations: make a decision｜作出决定 ; reach a decision｜达成决定 ; informed decision｜基于充分了解的决定 ; final decision｜最终决定
tip_zh: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

meanings_zh: n. 友谊；朋友关系
definition_en: a relationship between people who like and support each other
example1_en: Our friendship began when we shared a school desk.
example1_zh: 我们的友谊始于上学时做同桌的日子。
example2_en: Close friendship can improve mental health by providing emotional support during periods of stress.
example2_zh: 亲密的友谊可以在压力时期提供情感支持，从而改善心理健康。
collocations: close friendship｜亲密的友谊 ; form a friendship｜建立友谊 ; lasting friendship｜持久的友谊 ; a bond of friendship｜友谊的纽带
tip_zh: 泛指友谊不可数；具体一段友谊可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 高效的；节省资源的
definition_en: Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.
example1_en: Our new washing machine is quieter and more efficient.
example1_zh: 我们的新洗衣机更安静，也更节能。
example2_en: An efficient public transport network allows cities to move more people while consuming less energy.
example2_zh: 高效的公共交通网络使城市能够以更低的能耗运送更多乘客。
collocations: energy-efficient buildings｜节能建筑 ; efficient use of resources｜高效利用资源 ; highly efficient｜效率很高的 ; efficient service｜高效的服务
tip_zh: efficient强调少浪费；effective强调达到预期效果。

meanings_zh: n. 热；高温 | v. 加热；变热 | n. 预赛
definition_en: warmth or a high temperature | to make or become warmer | a race that decides who enters the next round
example1_en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
example1_zh: 我们在树下休息，躲避酷热。
example2_en: Cities can reduce extreme heat by planting trees and replacing dark surfaces with materials that reflect sunlight.
example2_zh: 城市可以通过植树以及用反射阳光的材料替换深色表面来缓解酷热。
collocations: extreme heat｜酷热 ; heat loss｜热量流失 ; heat up food｜加热食物 ; a qualifying heat｜一场预赛
tip_zh: heat作名词指热，hot作形容词指热的。

meanings_zh: n. 外貌；外观 | n. 出现；露面
definition_en: the way someone or something looks | an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present
example1_en: A fresh coat of paint transformed the room's appearance.
example1_zh: 重新刷了一层漆，房间的面貌焕然一新。
example2_en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
example2_zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。
collocations: physical appearance｜外貌 ; make an appearance｜露面 ; outward appearance｜外表 ; improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip_zh: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

meanings_zh: n. 图形；图像
definition_en: Images or designs used on screens or in printed materials.
example1_en: The game's colourful graphics looked amazing on our new screen.
example1_zh: 这款游戏色彩鲜艳的画面在我们的新屏幕上看起来棒极了。
example2_en: Clear graphics can make complex scientific information easier to understand for audiences without specialist knowledge.
example2_zh: 清晰的图示能让没有专业知识的受众更容易理解复杂的科学信息。
collocations: computer graphics｜计算机图形 ; high-quality graphics｜高质量图像 ; graphics card｜显卡
tip_zh: 指多个图像时用复数谓语：the graphics are。

meanings_zh: adv. 完美地；毫无差错地 | adv. 完全；十分
definition_en: In a way that has no faults or mistakes. | Completely; used to emphasize a description.
example1_en: The new curtains match our sofa perfectly.
example1_zh: 新窗帘和我们的沙发非常相配。
example2_en: It is perfectly reasonable for residents to expect reliable public services in return for their taxes.
example2_zh: 居民纳税后期望获得可靠的公共服务，是完全合理的。
collocations: fit perfectly｜完全合适 ; work perfectly｜运转无误 ; perfectly reasonable｜完全合理 ; perfectly clear｜十分清楚
tip_zh: perfectly clear意为十分清楚，不译作完美地清楚。

meanings_zh: n. 队长；船长；机长 | v. 担任队长；率领 | n. 陆军上尉；海军上校
definition_en: The leader of a team or person commanding a vessel. | To lead a team or command a ship. | An officer holding a particular rank in the armed forces.
example1_en: Our captain gathered the team before the final match.
example1_zh: 决赛前，我们的队长把全队召集到一起。
example2_en: A team captain can encourage cooperation by ensuring that every player feels valued and included.
example2_zh: 队长可以通过确保每位队员都感到受到重视和接纳来促进合作。
collocations: team captain｜队长 ; ship's captain｜船长 ; captain a team｜率领一支队伍
tip_zh: 军衔含义随军种变化；海军中通常指上校。

meanings_zh: adj. 适当的；正确的 | adj. 像样的；真正的 | adj. 严格意义上的；本身的
definition_en: Suitable or correct for a particular purpose or situation. | Real or satisfactory, rather than incomplete or inadequate. | Strictly understood, excluding surrounding or related things.
example1_en: You need proper shoes for walking on rocky paths.
example1_zh: 在碎石小路上走，你需要穿合适的鞋。
example2_en: Workers should receive proper training before operating machinery that could pose a risk to their safety.
example2_zh: 工人在操作可能危及自身安全的机器前，应接受适当培训。
collocations: proper training｜适当的培训 ; proper care｜妥善照料 ; a proper meal｜一顿像样的饭 ; the city proper｜市区本身
tip_zh: 表示“本身的”时放名词后，如the city proper。

meanings_zh: n. 恐惧；担忧 | v. 害怕；担心
definition_en: An unpleasant feeling about danger or something bad happening. | To feel afraid or worried about someone or something.
example1_en: She held my hand because of her fear of heights.
example1_zh: 她因为恐高而握住了我的手。
example2_en: Fear of failure may prevent students from asking questions, especially in highly competitive learning environments.
example2_zh: 对失败的恐惧可能使学生不敢提问，在竞争激烈的学习环境中尤其如此。
collocations: fear of heights｜恐高 ; overcome a fear｜克服恐惧 ; fear for someone's safety｜担心某人的安全 ; for fear of｜唯恐；生怕
tip_zh: fear sth是害怕某事；fear for sb是为某人担忧。

meanings_zh: v. 更喜欢；宁愿
definition_en: To like or choose something more than another option.
example1_en: I prefer fresh fruit to cake after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，比起蛋糕，我更喜欢吃新鲜水果。
example2_en: Some employees prefer working from home because it offers greater flexibility and eliminates daily commuting.
example2_zh: 一些员工更喜欢居家办公，因为这样更灵活，也免去了每天通勤。
collocations: prefer A to B｜比起B更喜欢A ; prefer to do｜更愿意做 ; would prefer｜宁愿；更想
tip_zh: 用prefer A to B；过去式preferred双写r。

meanings_zh: n. 黄瓜
definition_en: A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.
example1_en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
example1_zh: 她把一根黄瓜切成片，加入沙拉。
example2_en: Growing cucumbers in greenhouses can provide a reliable food supply, but heating these structures requires energy.
example2_zh: 在温室中种植黄瓜可以提供稳定的食物供应，但为这些设施供暖需要消耗能源。
collocations: sliced cucumber｜黄瓜片 ; cucumber salad｜黄瓜沙拉 ; as cool as a cucumber｜非常镇定
tip_zh: 通常可数：a cucumber；表示食材时也可不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 永久的；长期不变的 | adj. 长期雇用的；正式的
definition_en: Lasting indefinitely rather than for a limited time. | Employed without a fixed end date.
example1_en: The hot pan left a permanent mark on the table.
example1_zh: 滚烫的锅在桌上留下了无法去除的印痕。
example2_en: Investment in flood prevention can reduce the risk of permanent damage to homes and public infrastructure.
example2_zh: 投资防洪措施可以降低住房和公共基础设施遭受永久性损害的风险。
collocations: permanent damage｜永久性损害 ; permanent resident｜永久居民 ; permanent job｜长期工作 ; permanent address｜固定住址
tip_zh: permanent job指无固定结束日期的工作，不保证终身任职。

meanings_zh: n. 比赛；竞争 | v. 质疑；对……提出异议 | v. 争夺；参加竞选
definition_en: an event or struggle in which people compete to win | to formally challenge a decision, claim, or result | to compete for a position, prize, or political seat
example1_en: My cousin won a baking contest with her lemon cake.
example1_zh: 我表姐凭她做的柠檬蛋糕赢得了烘焙比赛。
example2_en: Citizens should have access to affordable legal advice when they wish to contest an official decision.
example2_zh: 公民希望对官方决定提出异议时，应能获得价格合理的法律咨询。
collocations: enter a contest｜参加比赛 ; a close contest｜势均力敌的比赛 ; contest a decision｜对决定提出异议 ; contest an election｜参加竞选
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: n. 示意图；图解 | v. 用图解表示
definition_en: a simple drawing showing how something works or is arranged | to explain or represent something using a simple drawing
example1_en: The diagram shows how to put the shelves together.
example1_zh: 这张示意图展示了如何组装架子。
example2_en: A clear diagram can help students understand complex biological processes more effectively than a lengthy explanation.
example2_zh: 一张清晰的示意图能比冗长的讲解更有效地帮助学生理解复杂的生物过程。
collocations: draw a diagram｜画示意图 ; a labelled diagram｜带标注的示意图 ; a flow diagram｜流程图
tip_zh: 侧重结构或原理的图解，不等同于数据图表。

meanings_zh: n. 美；美丽 | n. 妙处；优点
definition_en: The quality of being pleasing to see, hear, or experience. | A particularly useful or attractive feature of something.
example1_en: We stopped to admire the beauty of the lake.
example1_zh: 我们停下来欣赏湖泊的美景。
example2_en: Protecting the natural beauty of coastal areas can support tourism while preserving valuable habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 保护沿海地区的自然美景既能促进旅游业，也能保全珍贵的野生动物栖息地。
collocations: natural beauty｜自然美 ; outstanding beauty｜非凡的美 ; the beauty of something｜某事物的妙处
tip_zh: 表示“美”通常不可数；the beauty of也指妙处。

meanings_zh: phr v. 划掉；删去
definition_en: to draw a line through something written
example1_en: Cross out the wrong answers on the list.
example1_zh: 把清单上错误的答案划掉。
example2_en: She crossed out a sentence and rewrote it.
example2_zh: 她划掉了一个句子重写。
tip_zh: cross out 表示“用线划掉”。

meanings_zh: adj. 附近的；邻近的 | adv. 在附近；不远处
definition_en: located a short distance away | at or to a place a short distance away
example1_en: We bought fresh bread from a nearby bakery.
example1_zh: 我们从附近的一家面包店买了新鲜面包。
example2_en: Access to nearby parks encourages urban residents to exercise regularly and spend more time outdoors.
example2_zh: 附近有方便前往的公园，能鼓励城市居民经常锻炼，并增加户外活动时间。
collocations: a nearby park｜附近的公园 ; nearby residents｜附近居民 ; live nearby｜住在附近
tip_zh: nearby不用作介词：说near the school，不说nearby the school。

meanings_zh: n. 古董；古玩 | adj. 古董的；年代久远的
definition_en: An old object valued for its age, beauty, or rarity | Old and valuable because of age, beauty, or rarity
example1_en: We found a beautiful antique in a small shop.
example1_zh: 我们在一家小店里发现了一件漂亮的古董。
example2_en: Preserving antique furniture helps future generations understand traditional craftsmanship and the everyday lives of people in the past.
example2_zh: 保存古董家具有助于后代理解传统工艺以及过去人们的日常生活。
collocations: an antique shop｜古董店 ; antique furniture｜古董家具 ; an antique dealer｜古董商
tip_zh: antique强调古老且有收藏价值，不只是旧。

meanings_zh: n. 安全带
definition_en: a strap that keeps you safe in a car
example1_en: Please fasten your seat belt before we drive.
example1_zh: 开车前请系好安全带。
example2_en: Everyone in the car must wear a seat belt.
example2_zh: 车里每个人都要系安全带。
collocations: fasten your seat belt｜系安全带
tip_zh: fasten/put on your seat belt 是“系安全带”。

meanings_zh: adj. 壮观的；引人注目的 | adj. 惊人的；显著的
definition_en: extremely impressive to see or experience | unusually great or impressive in degree
example1_en: We watched a spectacular sunset from the hilltop.
example1_zh: 我们在山顶看了一场壮观的日落。
example2_en: The region's spectacular mountain scenery attracts tourists, creating jobs but also increasing pressure on fragile ecosystems.
example2_zh: 该地区壮观的山景吸引着游客，创造了就业机会，但也加重了脆弱生态系统的压力。
collocations: spectacular scenery｜壮观的风景 ; a spectacular display｜精彩的展示 ; spectacular growth｜惊人的增长
tip_zh: 既可形容壮观景象，也可修饰growth等抽象名词。

meanings_zh: v. 雇用 | v. 使用；采用
definition_en: Pay someone to work for you. | Use a method, skill, or resource for a purpose.
example1_en: The bakery employs three people from our neighbourhood.
example1_zh: 这家面包店雇用了我们街区的三个人。
example2_en: Teachers can employ a range of practical activities to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
example2_zh: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。
collocations: employ staff｜雇用员工 ; employ someone as｜雇用某人担任 ; employ a strategy｜采用策略
tip_zh: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。

meanings_zh: n. 心情；情绪 | n. 气氛；氛围
definition_en: the way someone feels at a particular time | the feeling that a place, event, or artwork creates
example1_en: A short walk usually puts me in a better mood.
example1_zh: 散一小会儿步通常就能让我的心情好一些。
example2_en: Access to green spaces can improve residents' mood and encourage more positive interactions within urban communities.
example2_zh: 能够享用绿地可以改善居民心情，促进城市社区内更积极的互动。
collocations: in a good mood｜心情好 ; in the mood for｜有心情做…… ; mood swings｜情绪波动 ; set the mood｜营造气氛
tip_zh: in the mood for后接名词；接动词用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 视力；视觉 | n. 看见；视野 | n. 景象；名胜
definition_en: The ability to see. | The act of seeing or the area that can be seen. | Something seen, especially something impressive or worth visiting.
example1_en: Her sight improved after she got new glasses.
example1_zh: 她配了新眼镜后看得更清楚了。
example2_en: Regular eye examinations can help preserve sight by detecting problems before they cause permanent damage.
example2_zh: 定期眼部检查能在问题造成永久损伤前将其发现，从而帮助保护视力。
collocations: lose one's sight｜失明 ; out of sight｜在视野之外 ; at first sight｜乍一看 ; the sights｜名胜景点
tip_zh: 视力通常不可数；表示名胜常用复数sights。

meanings_zh: phr. 最后；终于
definition_en: finally, after everything
example1_en: In the end, we decided to stay home.
example1_zh: 最后我们决定待在家里。
example2_en: Everything worked out well in the end.
example2_zh: 最后一切都很顺利。
tip_zh: in the end 表示“最终结果”；at the end 是“在…的末尾”。

meanings_zh: n. 博主
definition_en: a person who writes a blog
example1_en: She is a food blogger who posts recipes online.
example1_zh: 她是一位在网上分享食谱的美食博主。
example2_en: The blogger wrote about her trip to Japan.
example2_zh: 博主写了她的日本之旅。
tip_zh: blogger 是写博客的人；blog 是博客。

meanings_zh: v. 安装；设置 | v. 正式任命；使就职
definition_en: to put equipment or software in place for use | to formally place someone in an important position
example1_en: We hired an electrician to install the new ceiling fan.
example1_zh: 我们请了一位电工来安装新吊扇。
example2_en: Schools need sufficient funding to install reliable internet connections and maintain essential digital equipment.
example2_zh: 学校需要充足的资金来安装可靠的网络连接，并维护必要的数字设备。
collocations: install software｜安装软件 ; install solar panels｜安装太阳能板 ; install an alarm｜安装警报器
tip_zh: 下载是download；下载后安装才是install。

meanings_zh: n. 外卖；（英）外卖店
definition_en: cooked food bought to eat at home
example1_en: We ordered a takeaway for dinner.
example1_zh: 我们点了外卖当晚餐。
example2_en: The takeaway round the corner sells pizza.
example2_zh: 拐角的外卖店卖披萨。
tip_zh: takeaway 是英式“外卖”；美式说 take-out。

meanings_zh: adj. 最初的；开始的 | n. 姓名首字母 | v. 用姓名首字母签署
definition_en: Happening or existing at the beginning | The first letter of a person's name | To mark a document with the first letters of your names
example1_en: My initial excitement faded when I saw the price.
example1_zh: 看到价格后，我最初的兴奋消退了。
example2_en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
example2_zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。
collocations: initial reaction｜最初的反应 ; initial assessment｜初步评估 ; initial cost｜初期费用 ; initial stages｜初始阶段
tip_zh: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

meanings_zh: v. 使恼怒；使烦躁
definition_en: To make someone feel slightly angry or irritated.
example1_en: Those dripping taps annoy me when I try to sleep.
example1_zh: 我想睡觉时，那些滴水的水龙头让我心烦。
example2_en: Frequent online advertisements can annoy users and discourage them from returning to otherwise useful educational websites.
example2_zh: 频繁的网络广告会让用户感到烦躁，使他们不愿再次访问原本有用的教育网站。
collocations: annoy someone｜惹某人生气 ; annoyed with someone｜生某人的气 ; annoying habit｜烦人的习惯
tip_zh: 人感到烦用annoyed；事物令人烦用annoying。

meanings_zh: adv. 快乐地；高兴地 | adv. 乐意地 | adv. 幸好；幸运地
definition_en: In a way that shows pleasure or enjoyment. | Willingly and without objection. | With a fortunate or pleasing result.
example1_en: The children chatted happily while making sandwiches together.
example1_zh: 孩子们一起做三明治，开心地聊着天。
example2_en: Many residents would happily use public transport if services were more reliable and affordable.
example2_zh: 如果公共交通服务更可靠、价格更实惠，许多居民都会乐意乘坐。
collocations: smile happily｜开心地微笑 ; happily married｜婚姻幸福的 ; happily agree｜欣然同意
tip_zh: 句首Happily可表“幸好”，不只表示开心。

meanings_zh: adj. 焦虑的；压力大的 | adj. 重读的 | adj. 受应力的
definition_en: Feeling worried and unable to relax | Pronounced with greater emphasis than surrounding sounds | Experiencing physical force that may cause strain or damage
example1_en: I felt stressed before my first driving lesson.
example1_zh: 第一次上驾驶课之前，我感到很紧张。
example2_en: Students who feel stressed during examinations may benefit from regular exercise and adequate sleep.
example2_zh: 在考试期间感到焦虑的学生，可能会从规律运动和充足睡眠中受益。
collocations: feel stressed｜感到有压力 ; stressed about exams｜为考试焦虑 ; a stressed syllable｜重读音节 ; highly stressed components｜承受高应力的部件
tip_zh: 也可作stress的过去式或过去分词，表示“强调”。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；有趣的
definition_en: Giving pleasure or making you feel happy
example1_en: The cooking class was enjoyable, especially making fresh pasta.
example1_zh: 这堂烹饪课很有趣，尤其是制作新鲜意面的时候。
example2_en: Making physical activity enjoyable can encourage children to develop healthy habits that continue into adulthood.
example2_zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童养成延续至成年的健康习惯。
collocations: enjoyable experience｜愉快的经历 ; enjoyable activity｜有趣的活动 ; highly enjoyable｜非常令人愉快的 ; an enjoyable evening｜愉快的夜晚
tip_zh: 形容活动令人愉快用 enjoyable，不用 enjoyed。

meanings_zh: phr v. 进入；（车）到达；被录取
definition_en: to enter a place or vehicle
example1_en: Get in the car; we are leaving now.
example1_zh: 上车吧，我们现在就走。
example2_en: The train gets in at ten.
example2_zh: 火车十点到达。
tip_zh: get in 表示“进入/上车”；车到达也说 get in。

meanings_zh: v. 承诺；答应 | n. 承诺；诺言 | n. 潜力；前景
definition_en: to say firmly that you will do something | a firm statement that you will do something | signs that someone or something may succeed
example1_en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
example1_zh: 我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。
example2_en: Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.
example2_zh: 虽然可再生能源技术展现出巨大潜力，但仍需进一步投资，使其价格能被大众接受。
collocations: keep a promise｜信守承诺 ; break a promise｜违背诺言 ; promise to do something｜承诺做某事 ; show promise｜展现潜力
tip_zh: 用promise to do，不用promise doing。

meanings_zh: n. 一系列；连续的一组 | n. 系列节目；丛书
definition_en: several related things or events following one another | a set of programmes or books sharing characters or a subject
example1_en: A series of small delays made us miss lunch.
example1_zh: 接连几次小耽搁让我们错过了午饭。
example2_en: The university introduced a series of workshops to help students evaluate information found on social media.
example2_zh: 这所大学推出了一系列研讨课，帮助学生评估社交媒体上的信息。
collocations: a series of events｜一连串事件 ; a television series｜电视系列节目 ; a lecture series｜系列讲座
tip_zh: 单复数同形：a series；two series。

meanings_zh: adj. 特定的；某一的 | adj. 特别的；格外的 | adj. 讲究的；挑剔的
definition_en: used to refer to one specific person, thing, or situation | greater or more noticeable than usual | having strong preferences and being difficult to satisfy
example1_en: Are you looking for any particular book today?
example1_zh: 你今天是在找某一本特定的书吗？
example2_en: Schools should pay particular attention to students who lack access to digital resources at home.
example2_zh: 学校应特别关注那些在家中无法获得数字资源的学生。
collocations: a particular reason｜某个特定原因 ; particular attention｜特别关注 ; in particular｜尤其；特别 ; particular about｜对……很讲究
tip_zh: in particular意为尤其；be particular about表示对……讲究。

meanings_zh: v. 狩猎；猎捕 | v. 搜寻；寻找 | n. 搜寻；狩猎
definition_en: to chase wild animals to catch or kill them | to search carefully for someone or something | an organised search or an activity involving chasing wild animals
example1_en: We hunted for my keys under the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们在沙发底下找我的钥匙。
example2_en: When natural habitats shrink, predators may hunt closer to farms, increasing conflict between wildlife and local communities.
example2_zh: 自然栖息地缩小时，捕食动物可能到更靠近农场的地方捕猎，加剧野生动物与当地社区的冲突。
collocations: hunt for food｜觅食 ; hunt for a job｜找工作 ; a treasure hunt｜寻宝活动 ; hunt wild animals｜猎捕野生动物
tip_zh: 猎捕动物可直接接宾语；寻找物品常用hunt for。

meanings_zh: n. 代理机构；中介公司 | n. 专门机构；政府部门 | n. 自主行动能力
definition_en: A business that arranges services for people or other businesses. | An organisation responsible for a particular area of work. | The ability to make choices and act independently.
example1_en: The travel agency booked our flights and hotel.
example1_zh: 旅行社为我们预订了航班和酒店。
example2_en: A national environmental agency should monitor industrial pollution and ensure that factories comply with safety regulations.
example2_zh: 国家环境机构应监测工业污染，并确保工厂遵守安全规定。
collocations: a travel agency｜旅行社 ; a recruitment agency｜招聘中介 ; a government agency｜政府机构 ; individual agency｜个人自主行动能力
tip_zh: 表示机构时可数；表示自主行动能力时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 忽视；不理睬
definition_en: Pay no attention to someone or something
example1_en: Please don't ignore that strange noise from the engine.
example1_zh: 请别忽视发动机发出的那种怪声。
example2_en: Governments cannot ignore the long-term effects of air pollution on children's health and development.
example2_zh: 政府不能忽视空气污染对儿童健康与发育的长期影响。
collocations: ignore a warning｜无视警告 ; ignore the evidence｜无视证据 ; completely ignore｜完全不理会
tip_zh: 直接接宾语；不表示法律上的“驳回诉讼”。

meanings_zh: adv. 经常；定期地 | adv. 均匀地；有规律地
definition_en: often or at repeated intervals | with equal spaces or a consistent pattern
example1_en: We regularly walk along the river after dinner.
example1_zh: 我们经常晚饭后沿着河边散步。
example2_en: People who exercise regularly are more likely to maintain good physical health as they grow older.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼的人随着年龄增长，更有可能保持良好的身体健康。
collocations: exercise regularly｜经常锻炼 ; check regularly｜定期检查 ; regularly updated｜定期更新的 ; regularly spaced｜间距均匀的
tip_zh: 可表示经常，也可表示固定间隔；不一定指每天。

meanings_zh: n. 临时照看孩子的人
definition_en: Someone who temporarily looks after children while their parents are away.
example1_en: The babysitter read a story while the children ate.
example1_zh: 孩子们吃东西时，临时保姆给他们读了一个故事。
example2_en: Finding a reliable babysitter can help parents balance occasional evening commitments with their childcare responsibilities.
example2_zh: 找到可靠的临时保姆，可以帮助父母兼顾偶尔的晚间事务和照顾孩子的责任。
collocations: hire a babysitter｜雇用临时保姆 ; reliable babysitter｜可靠的临时保姆 ; find a babysitter｜找人临时照看孩子
tip_zh: 通常指临时照看孩子的人，不只照顾婴儿。

meanings_zh: adj. 紧急的；急迫的
definition_en: Needing immediate attention or action
example1_en: The plumber came quickly because the leak was urgent.
example1_zh: 漏水急需处理，所以水管工很快就赶来了。
example2_en: There is an urgent need for affordable housing as urban populations continue to grow.
example2_zh: 随着城市人口持续增长，人们迫切需要负担得起的住房。
collocations: urgent action｜紧急行动 ; an urgent need｜迫切的需要 ; urgent medical attention｜紧急医疗救治
tip_zh: urgent强调必须立即处理，不仅是重要。

meanings_zh: n. 阳光 | n. 欢乐；带来快乐的人或事
definition_en: light and warmth coming from the sun | happiness, or someone or something that brings happiness
example1_en: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
example1_zh: 我们在外面温暖的阳光下吃了早餐。
example2_en: Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.
example2_zh: 能够享用公园和阳光可以改善居民的身心健康，在人口密集的城市地区尤其如此。
collocations: bright sunshine｜明媚的阳光 ; in the sunshine｜在阳光下 ; hours of sunshine｜日照时长 ; a ray of sunshine｜带来快乐的人或事
tip_zh: sunshine通常不可数；表示晴天可说a sunny day。

meanings_zh: v. 扣紧；系牢；固定
definition_en: to close or attach something securely
example1_en: Please fasten your seat belt before we leave.
example1_zh: 出发前请系好安全带。
example2_en: Passengers must fasten their seat belts during takeoff and landing to reduce the risk of injury.
example2_zh: 乘客在飞机起飞和降落时必须系好安全带，以降低受伤风险。
collocations: fasten a seat belt｜系好安全带 ; fasten a button｜扣好纽扣 ; fasten securely｜牢牢固定
tip_zh: t不发音；反义词unfasten表示解开。

meanings_zh: n. 作用；职责 | n. 角色
definition_en: The function or responsibility someone or something has. | A character played by an actor in a performance.
example1_en: My role is to welcome guests at the door.
example1_zh: 我的职责是在门口迎接客人。
example2_en: Public libraries play an important role in providing equal access to information and educational resources.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆在提供平等获取信息和教育资源的机会方面发挥着重要作用。
collocations: play a role in｜在……中起作用 ; a key role｜关键作用 ; take on a role｜承担职责 ; a leading role｜主角
tip_zh: 表示“在……中起作用”用play a role in。

meanings_zh: v. 作弊 | v. 欺骗；骗取 | n. 作弊者；骗子
definition_en: To break rules dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage. | To deceive someone to obtain something unfairly. | A person who acts dishonestly to gain an advantage.
example1_en: My cousin cheated by hiding cards under the table.
example1_zh: 我的表亲把牌藏在桌子下面作弊。
example2_en: Schools can discourage students from cheating by designing assessments that reward original thinking rather than memorisation.
example2_zh: 学校可以设计注重独立思考而非死记硬背的考核，减少学生作弊。
collocations: cheat in an exam｜考试作弊 ; cheat at cards｜打牌作弊 ; cheat someone out of money｜骗取某人的钱
tip_zh: cheat someone out of something指骗走某人的某物。

meanings_zh: n. 离开；出发 | n. 背离；改变
definition_en: The act of leaving a place. | A change from what is usual or expected.
example1_en: We packed our bags the night before departure.
example1_zh: 我们在出发前一晚收拾好了行李。
example2_en: The new housing policy represents a significant departure from previous approaches to urban development.
example2_zh: 这项新的住房政策与以往的城市发展思路有了显著不同。
collocations: departure time｜出发时间 ; departure lounge｜候机厅 ; a departure from tradition｜对传统的突破
tip_zh: departure from可指“从……出发”或“背离……”。

meanings_zh: n. 安全；安全保障 | n. 安保人员；保安工作 | n. 稳定；保障
definition_en: Protection against danger, crime, loss, or unwanted access | People or activities responsible for protecting a place | Freedom from worries about losing money, work, or essential support
example1_en: We fitted stronger locks to improve our home security.
example1_zh: 我们安装了更坚固的锁，以加强家中的安全防护。
example2_en: Organisations must strengthen data security to protect personal information as more services move online.
example2_zh: 随着更多服务转移到线上，各机构必须加强数据安全，以保护个人信息。
collocations: security measures｜安全措施 ; data security｜数据安全 ; job security｜工作保障 ; security guard｜保安
tip_zh: security侧重防范威胁；safety更广指免受危险。

meanings_zh: n. 文化；习俗 | n. 文化艺术活动 | n. 培养物
definition_en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group | activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work | cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions
example1_en: Sharing traditional meals helps children learn about their culture.
example1_zh: 分享传统餐食有助于孩子了解自己的文化。
example2_en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
example2_zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。
collocations: local culture｜本土文化 ; cultural exchange｜文化交流 ; popular culture｜流行文化 ; bacterial culture｜细菌培养物
tip_zh: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

meanings_zh: v. 击败；战胜 | n. 失败；失利 | v. 挫败；使落空
definition_en: to win against someone in a competition or conflict | an occasion when someone loses a competition or conflict | to prevent a plan or aim from succeeding
example1_en: Our team defeated the champions in a thrilling final.
example1_zh: 我们队在一场激动人心的决赛中击败了冠军队。
example2_en: Although electoral defeat can damage a political party, it may also encourage necessary changes in leadership and policy.
example2_zh: 尽管选举失利会对政党造成打击，但也可能促使其对领导层和政策作出必要调整。
collocations: defeat an opponent｜击败对手 ; suffer a defeat｜遭遇失败 ; admit defeat｜承认失败 ; defeat the purpose｜使目的落空
tip_zh: defeat后接对手；win后接比赛、奖项等。

meanings_zh: adj. 厚的；粗的 | adj. 浓密的；浓重的 | adj. 黏稠的
definition_en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces | having many things close together or being difficult to see through | flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream
example1_en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
example1_zh: 她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。
example2_en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
example2_zh: 厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。
collocations: thick fog｜浓雾 ; thick hair｜浓密的头发 ; thick soup｜浓汤 ; thick layer｜厚厚的一层
tip_zh: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病；生病
definition_en: a disease, or the state of being unwell
example1_en: She missed our picnic because of a sudden illness.
example1_zh: 她突然生病，没能参加我们的野餐。
example2_en: Early access to medical care can prevent minor illnesses from developing into serious health problems.
example2_zh: 及早获得医疗服务可以防止小病发展为严重的健康问题。
collocations: serious illness｜重病 ; mental illness｜精神疾病 ; recover from an illness｜病后康复 ; due to illness｜因病
tip_zh: 泛指生病时不可数；指具体疾病时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 抱怨；投诉 | n. 疾病；不适
definition_en: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory | an illness or physical problem
example1_en: She made a complaint about the cold soup.
example1_zh: 她投诉汤是凉的。
example2_en: Local authorities should investigate residents' complaints about noise before approving new entertainment venues in residential areas.
example2_zh: 地方政府在批准住宅区内的新娱乐场所前，应调查居民关于噪声的投诉。
collocations: make a complaint｜提出投诉 ; a formal complaint｜正式投诉 ; handle complaints｜处理投诉 ; a common complaint｜常见病症；常见抱怨
tip_zh: complaint是名词，complain是动词；投诉某事用about。

meanings_zh: phr v. 切碎；剪碎
definition_en: to cut something into small pieces
example1_en: Cut up the vegetables before cooking.
example1_zh: 烹饪前把蔬菜切碎。
example2_en: She cut up the paper into small squares.
example2_zh: 她把纸剪成小方块。
tip_zh: cut up 是“切碎/剪碎”。

meanings_zh: v. 挖；掘 | v. 探究；深入搜寻 | n. 考古发掘
definition_en: Move earth to make a hole or uncover something | Search carefully for hidden information | An organized activity to uncover ancient objects in the ground
example1_en: We dug a deep hole for the young apple tree.
example1_zh: 我们为这棵苹果树苗挖了一个深坑。
example2_en: Researchers dig into historical records to understand how earlier societies responded to periods of rapid environmental change.
example2_zh: 研究人员深入查阅历史记录，以了解过去的社会如何应对环境迅速变化的时期。
collocations: dig a hole｜挖坑 ; dig up｜挖出 ; dig into｜深入探究 ; an archaeological dig｜考古发掘
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为dug；dig into可指深入调查。

meanings_zh: n. 生产；制造 | n. 制作；演出作品
definition_en: the process of making or growing things for use | the making of a film or play, or the resulting work
example1_en: The factory has increased production to meet summer demand.
example1_zh: 工厂已增加产量，以满足夏季需求。
example2_en: Cleaner energy production can reduce air pollution while supporting the development of a modern economy.
example2_zh: 更清洁的能源生产可以减少空气污染，同时支持现代经济的发展。
collocations: mass production｜大规模生产 ; food production｜食品生产 ; production costs｜生产成本 ; film production｜电影制作
tip_zh: production通常不可数；指一部演出作品时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 位置；姿势 | n. 职位；地位；立场 | v. 放置；安置
definition_en: where something is or how a body is arranged | a job, social rank, or opinion on an issue | to put someone or something in a particular place
example1_en: Can you move the lamp to a better position?
example1_zh: 你能把灯挪到一个更合适的位置吗？
example2_en: The report explains the government's position on providing affordable housing for young families.
example2_zh: 这份报告阐明了政府在为年轻家庭提供可负担住房方面的立场。
collocations: sitting position｜坐姿 ; apply for a position｜申请职位 ; take a position on｜对……表明立场 ; position carefully｜小心放置
tip_zh: 表示立场常用position on；表示职位为可数名词。

meanings_zh: v. 出现；显现 | v. 似乎；显得 | v. 登场；出庭
definition_en: To become visible or come into view. | To seem to be a certain way. | To take part in a performance or attend court formally.
example1_en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
example1_zh: 天空渐渐变暗，星星开始出现。
example2_en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
example2_zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。
collocations: appear suddenly｜突然出现 ; appear to be｜似乎是 ; appear in court｜出庭
tip_zh: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: adv. 无处；哪里都不
definition_en: not in or to any place
example1_en: There was nowhere to sit on the crowded train.
example1_zh: 拥挤的火车上没有地方可坐。
example2_en: Without affordable housing, some low-income families have nowhere to live despite having regular paid employment.
example2_zh: 如果缺乏可负担的住房，一些低收入家庭即使有固定工作，也无处居住。
collocations: nowhere else｜别的地方都不 ; nowhere near｜远不及；远非 ; get nowhere｜毫无进展 ; in the middle of nowhere｜在偏僻之地
tip_zh: 本身含否定意义：I have nowhere to go。

meanings_zh: n. 模式；规律 | n. 图案；花纹
definition_en: A regular or repeated way something happens or is done. | An arrangement of shapes, lines, or colours forming a design.
example1_en: My cat follows the same sleeping pattern every day.
example1_zh: 我的猫每天都遵循相同的睡眠规律。
example2_en: Researchers analyse patterns of energy consumption to identify opportunities for reducing waste in households.
example2_zh: 研究人员分析能源消耗模式，以寻找减少家庭能源浪费的机会。
collocations: a pattern of behaviour｜行为模式 ; sleep patterns｜睡眠规律 ; a floral pattern｜花卉图案 ; follow a pattern｜遵循某种模式
tip_zh: 表示规律常用a pattern of＋名词。

meanings_zh: n. 户外烧烤聚餐 | n. 烧烤架 | v. 烧烤
definition_en: An outdoor meal where food is cooked over a fire. | Equipment for cooking food over a fire outdoors. | To cook food on a grill over a fire.
example1_en: We invited our neighbours to a barbecue in the garden.
example1_zh: 我们邀请邻居来花园参加烧烤聚餐。
example2_en: Designated barbecue areas allow visitors to cook outdoors while reducing the risk of fires in public parks.
example2_zh: 指定烧烤区既能让游客在户外烹饪，也能降低公园发生火灾的风险。
collocations: have a barbecue｜举办烧烤聚餐 ; barbecue sauce｜烧烤酱 ; barbecue vegetables｜烧烤蔬菜
tip_zh: 既指烧烤聚餐或烤架，也可作动词；常缩写为BBQ。

meanings_zh: n. 液体 | adj. 液态的 | adj. 易变现的；流动的
definition_en: A substance that flows and takes the shape of its container. | In a form that flows freely rather than remaining solid. | Available as cash or easily converted into cash.
example1_en: She poured the warm liquid carefully into a glass.
example1_zh: 她小心地把温热的液体倒进玻璃杯。
example2_en: Scientists analyse liquid samples from rivers to identify pollutants and assess potential risks to public health.
example2_zh: 科学家分析河流中的液体样本，以识别污染物并评估其对公众健康的潜在风险。
collocations: clear liquid｜透明液体 ; liquid water｜液态水 ; liquid soap｜洗手液 ; liquid assets｜流动资产
tip_zh: liquid作名词指液体；liquid assets指现金或易变现资产。

meanings_zh: n. 降雪；降雪量
definition_en: the amount of snow that falls
example1_en: The city had heavy snowfall last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚这座城市下了大雪。
example2_en: Snowfall in the mountains makes skiing possible.
example2_zh: 山里的降雪使滑雪成为可能。
tip_zh: snowfall 是“降雪/降雪量”。

meanings_zh: n. 曲调；旋律 | v. 为乐器调音 | v. 调节；调谐
definition_en: a series of musical notes forming a recognizable pattern | to adjust an instrument so it produces the correct notes | to adjust a device to work or receive signals correctly
example1_en: My brother whistled a cheerful tune while washing dishes.
example1_zh: 哥哥洗碗时，用口哨吹着一段欢快的曲调。
example2_en: A memorable tune can help young learners retain new vocabulary and develop greater confidence in speaking.
example2_zh: 容易记住的曲调可以帮助低龄学习者记忆新词汇，并增强口语表达的信心。
collocations: catchy tune｜朗朗上口的曲调 ; in tune｜音调准确 ; out of tune｜走调 ; tune a piano｜给钢琴调音
tip_zh: in tune指音调准确；out of tune指走调。

meanings_zh: phr. 终于；最后
definition_en: finally, after a long time
example1_en: At last, the bus arrived!
example1_zh: 公交车终于来了！
example2_en: We finished the project at last.
example2_zh: 我们终于完成了这个项目。
tip_zh: at last 强调“经过等待终于发生”，比 finally 更有感情色彩。

meanings_zh: prep. 到……上面
definition_en: Moving to a position on a surface.
example1_en: The cat jumped onto the sofa beside me.
example1_zh: 猫跳到我旁边的沙发上。
example2_en: Moving freight onto trains could reduce road congestion and lower emissions from the transport sector.
example2_zh: 将货物转移到火车上运输，可以缓解道路拥堵并降低运输业的排放。
collocations: climb onto｜爬到……上 ; step onto｜踏上 ; load goods onto｜把货物装到……上
tip_zh: onto强调移动到表面；on常表示已在上面。

meanings_zh: n. 肉贩；肉类分割工 | v. 屠宰；分割肉类 | v. 把……弄糟
definition_en: someone who prepares and sells meat | to kill animals for meat or cut up their meat | to do something very badly, spoiling the result
example1_en: The butcher wrapped our chicken and suggested a simple recipe.
example1_zh: 肉贩把我们的鸡肉包好，还推荐了一个简单的做法。
example2_en: A local butcher can help customers reduce food waste by recommending suitable cuts and portion sizes.
example2_zh: 当地肉贩可以推荐合适的肉块和分量，帮助顾客减少食物浪费。
collocations: local butcher｜当地肉贩 ; butcher's shop｜肉店 ; butcher a song｜把一首歌唱砸
tip_zh: 肉店常说the butcher's；动词也可指把表演等搞砸。

meanings_zh: n. 周年纪念日
definition_en: A date marking another year since an important event.
example1_en: We cooked a special meal for our wedding anniversary.
example1_zh: 我们为结婚纪念日做了一顿特别的饭菜。
example2_en: The museum celebrated its anniversary by offering free admission to encourage more residents to explore local history.
example2_zh: 博物馆在周年纪念日提供免费入场，鼓励更多居民了解当地历史。
collocations: wedding anniversary｜结婚纪念日 ; celebrate an anniversary｜庆祝周年纪念日 ; mark an anniversary｜纪念周年
tip_zh: 指重要事件每年对应的纪念日，不只用于婚礼。

meanings_zh: n. 速度；速率 | v. 快速移动；疾驰 | v. 超速驾驶
definition_en: How fast something moves, happens, or operates | To move or travel very fast | To drive faster than the legal limit
example1_en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
example1_zh: 我们离开小镇时，火车加快了速度。
example2_en: Reducing vehicle speeds near schools can significantly improve road safety for children walking or cycling to class.
example2_zh: 降低学校附近的车速，可以显著提高步行或骑车上学的儿童的道路安全。
collocations: at high speed｜高速地 ; a speed limit｜速度限制 ; pick up speed｜加速 ; speed up｜加快
tip_zh: speed up表示加快；speed也可作动词指超速驾驶。

meanings_zh: n. 运动衫；卫衣
definition_en: a warm soft shirt with long sleeves
example1_en: He wears a blue sweatshirt to school.
example1_zh: 他穿蓝色卫衣上学。
example2_en: This sweatshirt is warm and comfortable.
example2_zh: 这件卫衣又暖和又舒服。
tip_zh: sweatshirt 是运动卫衣；hoodie 是连帽卫衣。

meanings_zh: n. 典礼；仪式 | n. 礼节；客套
definition_en: A formal event marking an important occasion. | Formal behaviour required by tradition or social rules.
example1_en: We attended a small wedding ceremony by the lake.
example1_zh: 我们参加了湖边一场小型婚礼。
example2_en: A graduation ceremony allows students and families to celebrate educational achievements together as a community.
example2_zh: 毕业典礼让学生和家人齐聚一堂，共同庆祝学业成就。
collocations: opening ceremony｜开幕式 ; graduation ceremony｜毕业典礼 ; without ceremony｜不拘礼节地
tip_zh: 指具体典礼时可数；without ceremony意为不拘礼节。

meanings_zh: n. 药丸；药片 | n. 口服避孕药
definition_en: a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow | an oral medicine used to prevent pregnancy
example1_en: He swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
example1_zh: 他用一杯水把药片吞了下去。
example2_en: Although a pill may relieve symptoms, lasting improvements in health often require changes to daily habits.
example2_zh: 虽然药物可能缓解症状，但要持久改善健康，往往需要改变日常习惯。
collocations: take a pill｜服药 ; swallow a pill｜吞服药片 ; vitamin pill｜维生素片 ; the pill｜口服避孕药
tip_zh: take a pill指服药；the pill常特指口服避孕药。

meanings_zh: adj. 平均的；普通的 | n. 平均数；平均水平 | v. 平均为
definition_en: Representing a calculated middle value, or typical rather than exceptional. | A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count. | Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.
example1_en: The average price of these jackets is quite reasonable.
example1_zh: 这些夹克的平均价格相当合理。
example2_en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
example2_zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。
collocations: on average｜平均而言 ; above average｜高于平均水平 ; average income｜平均收入 ; average temperature｜平均气温
tip_zh: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

meanings_zh: n. 图书馆员
definition_en: A person who manages library resources and helps library users.
example1_en: The librarian helped me find a book about birds.
example1_zh: 图书馆员帮我找到了一本关于鸟类的书。
example2_en: School librarians support independent learning by teaching students how to locate reliable sources and evaluate information.
example2_zh: 学校图书馆员通过教授学生如何寻找可靠来源并评估信息，来支持自主学习。
collocations: school librarian｜学校图书馆员 ; chief librarian｜图书馆馆长 ; ask a librarian｜咨询图书馆员
tip_zh: library指图书馆；librarian指在那里工作的馆员。

meanings_zh: v. 隐藏；躲藏 | v. 隐瞒；掩饰 | n. 兽皮
definition_en: To put or stay somewhere out of sight. | To prevent others from knowing or noticing something. | The skin of a large animal, often used for leather.
example1_en: We hid the birthday present under the bed.
example1_zh: 我们把生日礼物藏在了床底下。
example2_en: Companies should not hide information about environmental risks associated with their products or manufacturing processes.
example2_zh: 企业不应隐瞒其产品或生产流程所涉及的环境风险信息。
collocations: hide from view｜藏起来不让看见 ; hide the truth｜隐瞒真相 ; hide your feelings｜掩饰感情 ; animal hide｜兽皮
tip_zh: 过去式hid，过去分词hidden；hide from意为躲避。

meanings_zh: adj. 醒着的 | v. 醒来；唤醒
definition_en: not sleeping | to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping
example1_en: I was still awake when the rain finally stopped.
example1_zh: 雨终于停下时，我还醒着。
example2_en: Students who stay awake late at night may struggle to concentrate during lessons the following morning.
example2_zh: 熬夜不睡的学生第二天上午上课时可能难以集中注意力。
collocations: wide awake｜完全清醒的 ; stay awake｜保持清醒 ; lie awake｜躺着睡不着
tip_zh: 形容词通常作表语；动词变化为awoke、awoken。

meanings_zh: n. 棍；枝条；手杖 | v. 粘贴；粘住 | v. 插入；刺入
definition_en: A long, thin piece of wood used for various purposes. | To attach something, or become attached, using a sticky substance. | To push a pointed object into something.
example1_en: The dog brought a stick back to me.
example1_zh: 那只狗把一根树枝叼回给我。
example2_en: Students can stick pictures onto a shared poster to present their research on local wildlife.
example2_zh: 学生可以把图片贴在共同制作的海报上，展示他们对当地野生动物的研究。
collocations: walking stick｜手杖 ; stick to a plan｜坚持计划 ; stick a picture on｜把图片贴在……上 ; stick together｜团结一致
tip_zh: 动词过去式和过去分词均为stuck；stick to表示坚持。

meanings_zh: v. 删除
definition_en: To remove written material or stored information.
example1_en: Please delete those blurry photos from my phone.
example1_zh: 请把我手机里那些模糊的照片删掉。
example2_en: Online services should allow users to delete their personal data when they no longer need an account.
example2_zh: 当用户不再需要账户时，网络服务应允许他们删除个人数据。
collocations: delete a file｜删除文件 ; delete an account｜删除账户 ; permanently delete｜永久删除
tip_zh: 常用delete something from...表示从某处删除。

meanings_zh: prep. 除……之外还 | adv. 而且；再说
definition_en: In addition to someone or something. | Used to add another fact or supporting reason.
example1_en: Besides apples, we need some bread and fresh milk.
example1_zh: 除了苹果，我们还需要一些面包和鲜奶。
example2_en: Besides reducing air pollution, investment in public transport can make cities more accessible to older residents.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通除了能减少空气污染，还能让老年居民在城市中出行更方便。
collocations: besides that｜除此之外 ; besides being｜除了是……之外 ; besides the fact that｜除了……这一事实之外
tip_zh: besides表示额外包括；beside表示在旁边。

meanings_zh: n. 路标；指路牌 | v. 设置路标 | v. 提示结构；指明要点
definition_en: A roadside post showing directions to different places. | Mark a route or place with signs showing directions. | Make the structure or direction of an explanation clear.
example1_en: We stopped at the signpost beside the forest path.
example1_zh: 我们在林间小路旁的路标处停了下来。
example2_en: Writers should signpost changes in their argument so that readers can follow complex discussions more easily.
example2_zh: 作者应提示论证中的转折，让读者更容易跟上复杂的讨论。
collocations: follow the signposts｜沿路标前行 ; clearly signposted｜有清晰路标的 ; signpost an argument｜提示论证脉络
tip_zh: 写作中作动词，指用衔接表达提示论证结构。

meanings_zh: phr v. 办理登机/入住手续
definition_en: to register at an airport or hotel
example1_en: We need to check in two hours before the flight.
example1_zh: 我们需要在起飞前两小时办理登机手续。
example2_en: Please check in at the front desk when you arrive.
example2_zh: 到达后请到前台办理入住。
collocations: check in online｜网上值机
tip_zh: check in 是动词短语；check-in 是名词“值机/入住手续”。

meanings_zh: n. 泵；抽水机；打气筒 | v. 用泵输送；抽；打气
definition_en: a device that moves liquid or gas | to move liquid or gas using a pump
example1_en: I keep a bicycle pump beside the garage door.
example1_zh: 我把自行车打气筒放在车库门旁边。
example2_en: Solar power can operate a water pump, helping rural communities obtain clean water without relying on expensive fuel.
example2_zh: 太阳能可以驱动水泵，帮助农村社区获取清洁用水，而无需依赖昂贵的燃料。
collocations: water pump｜水泵 ; bicycle pump｜自行车打气筒 ; pump water｜抽水 ; pump up a tyre｜给轮胎打气
tip_zh: pump up a tyre表示给轮胎打气；抽水用pump water。

meanings_zh: n. 烧水壶
definition_en: A container with a handle and spout for boiling water.
example1_en: Put the kettle on while I find the cups.
example1_zh: 你先烧水，我来找杯子。
example2_en: Boiling only the water needed in a kettle can reduce household electricity consumption over time.
example2_zh: 每次只烧所需的水，长期下来可以减少家庭用电量。
collocations: electric kettle｜电热水壶 ; put the kettle on｜烧水 ; boil the kettle｜烧一壶水
tip_zh: kettle 用来烧水，teapot 用来泡茶。

meanings_zh: n. 惊险小说；惊悚片
definition_en: An exciting story or film involving danger, suspense, or crime.
example1_en: We watched a thriller and kept guessing the ending.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部惊悚片，一直在猜结局。
example2_en: A well-made thriller can encourage audiences to consider ethical questions while maintaining a strong sense of suspense.
example2_zh: 制作精良的惊悚片能在保持强烈悬念的同时，引导观众思考伦理问题。
collocations: a crime thriller｜犯罪惊悚作品 ; a psychological thriller｜心理惊悚作品 ; a political thriller｜政治惊悚作品
tip_zh: thriller重悬念与紧张感，不等于恐怖片。

meanings_zh: n. 奢华；奢侈的享受 | n. 奢侈品；非必需的享受 | adj. 奢华的；高档的
definition_en: Great comfort and pleasure involving expensive surroundings or possessions. | Something enjoyable or expensive that is not essential. | Providing exceptional comfort and quality, usually at a high price.
example1_en: The hotel offered a taste of luxury for one night.
example1_zh: 这家酒店让我们体验了一晚奢华享受。
example2_en: As household incomes rise, goods once considered a luxury often become part of everyday life.
example2_zh: 随着家庭收入增加，曾被视为奢侈品的商品往往成为日常生活的一部分。
collocations: live in luxury｜过奢华生活 ; luxury goods｜奢侈品 ; luxury hotel｜豪华酒店 ; afford the luxury of｜有条件享受……
tip_zh: 指奢华状态时不可数；指一项享受时可数。

meanings_zh: n. （自行车/摩托车的）车把
definition_en: the bars you hold to steer a bike
example1_en: Hold the handlebars firmly when you ride.
example1_zh: 骑车时握紧车把。
example2_en: The handlebars of the bicycle are too high for me.
example2_zh: 这辆自行车的车把对我来说太高了。
tip_zh: handlebars 常用复数，指自行车/摩托车的车把。

meanings_zh: phr v. 分发
definition_en: to give something to each person
example1_en: The volunteers handed out water to the runners.
example1_zh: 志愿者给跑步者分发水。
example2_en: She handed out the invitations at school.
example2_zh: 她在学校分发请柬。
tip_zh: hand out 是“分发”；handout 是名词“讲义”。

meanings_zh: adj. 不能的；无法的
definition_en: Not having the ability or opportunity to do something.
example1_en: I was unable to open the tightly sealed jar.
example1_zh: 我打不开那个封得很紧的罐子。
example2_en: Without affordable internet access, many students are unable to participate fully in online learning programmes.
example2_zh: 如果没有负担得起的网络服务，许多学生就无法充分参与在线学习课程。
collocations: be unable to attend｜无法出席 ; be unable to afford｜负担不起 ; be unable to cope｜无法应付
tip_zh: 用 be unable to do，不用 unable doing。

meanings_zh: conj. 为了；以便
definition_en: so that; for the purpose of
example1_en: She studies hard in order to pass the exam.
example1_zh: 她努力学习以便通过考试。
example2_en: In order to save money, we cook at home.
example2_zh: 为了省钱，我们在家做饭。
tip_zh: in order to + 动词原形 表示目的“为了”。

meanings_zh: v. 涉及；包含；需要 | v. 使参与
definition_en: to include something as a necessary part | to make someone take part in an activity
example1_en: My new job involves talking to customers all day.
example1_zh: 我的新工作需要整天与顾客交谈。
example2_en: Local authorities should involve residents in planning decisions to ensure that new developments meet community needs.
example2_zh: 地方政府应让居民参与规划决策，确保新的开发项目满足社区需求。
collocations: involve doing something｜需要做某事 ; involve someone in something｜让某人参与某事 ; be closely involved｜密切参与
tip_zh: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 女性的；雌性的 | n. 雌性动物；女性
definition_en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs. | An animal or person of the female sex.
example1_en: The female lion rested beside her cubs in the shade.
example1_zh: 母狮和幼狮一起在阴凉处休息。
example2_en: Encouraging female students to study engineering can help reduce gender inequality in the technology sector.
example2_zh: 鼓励女生学习工程学有助于减少科技行业中的性别不平等。
collocations: female students｜女生 ; female employees｜女性员工 ; a female elephant｜一头母象
tip_zh: 指成年女性通常用women；female作定语较自然。

meanings_zh: phr. 分成两半
definition_en: into two equal parts
example1_en: Cut the apple in half and share it.
example1_zh: 把苹果切成两半分着吃。
example2_en: She folded the paper in half.
example2_zh: 她把纸对折。
tip_zh: cut/divide in half 表示“分成两半”。

meanings_zh: v. 想象；设想 | v. 猜想；认为
definition_en: Form a picture or idea of something in your mind. | Think something is probably true without being certain.
example1_en: Imagine living in a little house beside the sea.
example1_zh: 想象一下住在海边一栋小房子里的情景。
example2_en: Urban planners must imagine how future residents will use shared spaces before designing new neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 城市规划者在设计新社区之前，必须设想未来居民将如何使用公共空间。
collocations: imagine doing something｜想象做某事 ; hard to imagine｜难以想象 ; imagine the future｜设想未来
tip_zh: imagine后接动名词，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 航空公司
definition_en: A company that transports passengers or goods by aircraft
example1_en: The airline sent us new tickets after cancelling our flight.
example1_zh: 航班取消后，航空公司给我们发了新机票。
example2_en: Airlines can lower their environmental impact by investing in more efficient aircraft and reducing unnecessary flights.
example2_zh: 航空公司可以通过投资更高效的飞机并减少不必要的航班来降低环境影响。
collocations: budget airline｜廉价航空公司 ; airline ticket｜机票 ; airline industry｜航空业
tip_zh: airline指航空公司；具体航班用flight。

meanings_zh: n. 影响；影响力 | v. 影响
definition_en: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves | to affect someone's decisions, behaviour, or development
example1_en: My older sister had a strong influence on me.
example1_zh: 姐姐对我有很大的影响。
example2_en: Advertising can influence children's food preferences, which makes responsible marketing particularly important for public health.
example2_zh: 广告会影响儿童的食物偏好，因此负责任的营销对公众健康尤为重要。
collocations: have an influence on｜对……有影响 ; a positive influence｜积极的影响 ; influence a decision｜影响决定
tip_zh: 名词后常接on；动词直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 材料；原料；布料 | n. 资料；素材 | adj. 物质的；实质性的
definition_en: A substance used to make things, including cloth. | Information or ideas used for study or creative work. | Relating to physical possessions, or significant enough to matter.
example1_en: This bag is made from a strong waterproof material.
example1_zh: 这个包用结实的防水材料制成。
example2_en: Using recycled material in construction can reduce waste and lower demand for newly extracted natural resources.
example2_zh: 在建筑中使用再生材料可以减少废弃物，并降低对新开采自然资源的需求。
collocations: raw materials｜原材料 ; building materials｜建筑材料 ; reading material｜阅读资料 ; material possessions｜物质财富
tip_zh: 资料义通常不可数；多种材料可用materials。

meanings_zh: n. 电话答录机
definition_en: a machine that records phone messages
example1_en: She left a message on my answerphone.
example1_zh: 她在我的答录机上留了言。
example2_en: The answerphone recorded three calls while we were out.
example2_zh: 我们外出时答录机录了三个电话。
tip_zh: answerphone 是英式说法，指电话答录机。

meanings_zh: n. 建议；提议 | n. 暗示；细微迹象
definition_en: an idea offered for someone to consider | a slight sign that something exists or may be true
example1_en: Your suggestion to bring a picnic was really helpful.
example1_zh: 你提议带上野餐食物，真是帮了大忙。
example2_en: The suggestion to expand cycle lanes received strong support from residents concerned about road safety.
example2_zh: 扩建自行车道的建议得到了关注道路安全的居民的大力支持。
collocations: make a suggestion｜提出建议 ; a useful suggestion｜有用的建议 ; a suggestion of｜一丝；些许
tip_zh: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 海滨；海边 | adj. 海滨的；海边的
definition_en: The area beside the sea, especially where people spend holidays | Located beside the sea, especially in a holiday area
example1_en: We spent the afternoon building sandcastles at the seaside.
example1_zh: 我们下午在海边堆沙堡。
example2_en: Seaside towns often depend on summer tourism, which can create unstable employment for local residents.
example2_zh: 海滨小镇往往依赖夏季旅游业，这可能使当地居民的就业不稳定。
collocations: at the seaside｜在海边 ; seaside resort｜海滨度假胜地 ; seaside town｜海滨小镇 ; seaside holiday｜海滨度假
tip_zh: 名词常用 the seaside；表示“在海边”用 at。

meanings_zh: n. 叶子
definition_en: the flat green part of a plant
example1_en: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
example1_zh: 秋天叶子变黄。
example2_en: A leaf fell from the tree and landed on the path.
example2_zh: 一片叶子从树上落下，落在小路上。
tip_zh: leaf 的复数是 leaves（不规则变化）。

meanings_zh: adj. 紧的；紧身的 | adj. 紧张的；余地很小的 | adv. 紧紧地；牢牢地
definition_en: Fitting closely or held firmly, with little room to move. | Leaving very little extra time, money, or space. | Firmly and securely, without becoming loose.
example1_en: These shoes are too tight around my toes.
example1_zh: 这双鞋的鞋头太紧，挤着我的脚趾。
example2_en: Schools operating on tight budgets may struggle to provide students with modern equipment and adequate support.
example2_zh: 预算紧张的学校可能难以为学生提供现代化设备和充分的支持。
collocations: tight jeans｜紧身牛仔裤 ; a tight budget｜紧张的预算 ; a tight deadline｜很紧的截止期限 ; hold tight｜紧紧抓住
tip_zh: tight本身可作副词，如hold tight；tightly也表紧紧地。

meanings_zh: n. 女演员
definition_en: a woman who performs characters in plays or films
example1_en: The actress waved to the crowd outside the theatre.
example1_zh: 那位女演员向剧院外的人群挥手。
example2_en: A successful actress can encourage young people to explore careers in the performing arts.
example2_zh: 一位成功的女演员可以鼓励年轻人探索表演艺术领域的职业道路。
collocations: leading actress｜女主角 ; supporting actress｜女配角 ; award-winning actress｜获奖女演员
tip_zh: actor也可指女性；actress明确指女演员。

meanings_zh: v. 安排；筹备 | v. 排列；整理
definition_en: Make plans or preparations for something to happen. | Put things in a particular order or position.
example1_en: I arranged to meet my cousin outside the cinema.
example1_zh: 我约好和表亲在电影院外见面。
example2_en: Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.
example2_zh: 学校可以安排学生参观当地企业，帮助他们了解不同职业的实际要求。
collocations: arrange a meeting｜安排会议 ; arrange to meet｜约好见面 ; arrange for someone to do something｜安排某人做某事 ; arrange flowers｜插花
tip_zh: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

meanings_zh: n. 水手；海员；帆船运动者
definition_en: Someone who works on ships or sails boats
example1_en: The sailor tied the boat securely to the dock.
example1_zh: 水手把船牢牢地系在码头上。
example2_en: Modern navigation technology helps sailors avoid dangerous waters, but practical experience remains essential for safety at sea.
example2_zh: 现代导航技术帮助海员避开危险水域，但实践经验对海上安全仍至关重要。
collocations: experienced sailor｜经验丰富的海员 ; professional sailor｜职业海员 ; a crew of sailors｜一组船员
tip_zh: 指在船上工作或驾驶帆船的人，不泛指乘客。

meanings_zh: adj. 穿着得体的；衣着考究的
definition_en: Wearing attractive, neat, and appropriate clothes.
example1_en: A well-dressed guest arrived in a neatly pressed suit.
example1_zh: 一位衣着考究的客人穿着熨烫平整的西装到来。
example2_en: Although well-dressed applicants may create positive first impressions, employers should prioritise relevant skills and professional experience.
example2_zh: 尽管衣着得体的求职者可能留下良好的第一印象，雇主仍应优先考虑相关技能和工作经验。
collocations: well-dressed guests｜衣着考究的宾客 ; a well-dressed applicant｜衣着得体的求职者
tip_zh: 强调穿着整洁得体，不一定指衣服昂贵或紧跟潮流。

meanings_zh: adj. 隐藏的；不易察觉的
definition_en: Kept out of sight or not easily noticed.
example1_en: We found a hidden cupboard behind the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房门后发现了一个隐蔽的橱柜。
example2_en: Consumers should consider the hidden costs of online purchases, including delivery fees and charges for returning items.
example2_zh: 消费者应考虑网购的隐性成本，包括运费和退货费用。
collocations: hidden costs｜隐性成本 ; hidden meaning｜隐藏的含义 ; hidden talent｜未显露的才能
tip_zh: 也是hide的过去分词；隐藏不等于肉眼不可见。

meanings_zh: n. 会员身份；成员资格 | n. 全体会员；会员人数
definition_en: the status of belonging to a club or organisation | all members of a group, or the total member count
example1_en: My gym membership includes free swimming lessons every weekend.
example1_zh: 我的健身房会员权益包括每个周末的免费游泳课。
example2_en: Affordable membership fees can encourage more residents to use local sports facilities and improve their health.
example2_zh: 价格合理的会员费可以鼓励更多居民使用当地体育设施，改善健康状况。
collocations: membership fee｜会员费 ; annual membership｜年度会员资格 ; renew your membership｜续办会员资格 ; union membership｜工会会员身份
tip_zh: 表示加入某组织的资格，常用membership of。

meanings_zh: v. 打开行李取出物品 | v. 剖析；详细解释
definition_en: take things out of a bag, box, or other container | examine an idea carefully to explain its different parts
example1_en: I unpacked my suitcase and hung up my shirts.
example1_zh: 我把衣物从行李箱里拿出来，挂好了衬衫。
example2_en: Teachers can help students unpack complex arguments by examining the evidence and assumptions behind each claim.
example2_zh: 教师可以通过审视每个论点背后的证据和假设，帮助学生剖析复杂的论证。
collocations: unpack a suitcase｜取出行李箱中的物品 ; unpack boxes｜打开箱子取出物品 ; unpack an argument｜剖析论证
tip_zh: 既可指取出行李，也可比喻拆解复杂观点。

meanings_zh: n. 工作室；录音室；演播室 | n. 电影制片公司 | n. 单间公寓
definition_en: A room where art, music, or broadcasts are produced | A company that makes films | A flat combining living and sleeping space in one room
example1_en: The artist invited us into her bright upstairs studio.
example1_zh: 那位艺术家邀请我们参观她楼上明亮的工作室。
example2_en: Public funding for affordable studio spaces can help emerging artists contribute to a city's cultural life.
