example2_zh: 为价格可负担的工作室提供公共资金，能帮助新兴艺术家丰富城市文化生活。
collocations: recording studio｜录音室 ; art studio｜艺术工作室 ; film studio｜电影制片公司 ; studio flat｜单间公寓
tip_zh: 英式studio flat、美式studio apartment均指单间公寓。

meanings_zh: v. 使害怕；吓唬
definition_en: To make someone feel afraid.
example1_en: Sudden loud noises can frighten our new puppy.
example1_zh: 突然的巨响会吓到我们新养的小狗。
example2_en: Alarming news reports may frighten children, so adults should explain difficult events in an appropriate way.
example2_zh: 令人不安的新闻报道可能吓到儿童，因此成人应以恰当的方式解释复杂事件。
collocations: frighten someone away｜把某人吓跑 ; frighten someone into doing｜吓得某人去做 ; frighten someone to death｜把某人吓坏
tip_zh: frightened指感到害怕的；frightening指令人害怕的。

meanings_zh: adj. 中年的
definition_en: between young and old, about 40 to 60
example1_en: The middle-aged man walked his dog every day.
example1_zh: 这位中年男子每天遛狗。
example2_en: The book is popular with middle-aged readers.
example2_zh: 这本书受中年读者欢迎。
tip_zh: middle-aged 指中年（约40-60岁）。

meanings_zh: n. 脚后跟 | n. 鞋跟
definition_en: The rounded back part of the foot below the ankle. | The raised part beneath the back of a shoe.
example1_en: These new shoes rub against my left heel.
example1_zh: 这双新鞋磨我的左脚后跟。
example2_en: Shoes that support the heel properly may improve comfort for people who spend long hours standing.
example2_zh: 能适当支撑脚后跟的鞋子，可以让长时间站立的人感觉更舒适。
collocations: heel pain｜足跟疼痛 ; high heels｜高跟鞋 ; low heels｜低跟鞋
tip_zh: heel是脚后跟或鞋跟；heal意为愈合，二者同音。

meanings_zh: v. 表现；举止 | v. 守规矩 | v. 运转；作出特定反应
definition_en: to act in a particular way | to act politely and do what is expected | to work or react in a particular way
example1_en: Our dog behaves calmly when visitors come to the house.
example1_zh: 有客人来家里时，我们的狗表现得很平静。
example2_en: Children often learn how to behave in social situations by observing the adults around them.
example2_zh: 孩子往往通过观察身边的成年人，学习在社交场合如何举止得当。
collocations: behave responsibly｜负责任地行事 ; behave well｜表现良好 ; behave yourself｜规矩一点 ; behave like｜表现得像
tip_zh: behave yourself意为守规矩，不是“表现自己”。

meanings_zh: n. 买家；购买者 | n. 采购员
definition_en: a person or organisation that purchases something | someone whose job is choosing goods for a business
example1_en: The buyer checked the bicycle before handing over cash.
example1_zh: 买家在付现金前检查了那辆自行车。
example2_en: First-time buyers often struggle to enter the housing market because property prices rise faster than wages.
example2_zh: 由于房价上涨速度超过工资，首次购房者往往难以进入住房市场。
collocations: potential buyer｜潜在买家 ; first-time buyer｜首次购房者 ; a buyer's market｜买方市场
tip_zh: buyer 指买方；customer 更强调店铺或服务的顾客。

meanings_zh: n. 恶意；怨恨 | v. 故意使恼怒；刁难
definition_en: A desire to upset or hurt someone deliberately. | To deliberately upset someone, often because you feel angry.
example1_en: He hid his sister's favourite toy out of spite.
example1_zh: 他出于恶意，把妹妹最喜欢的玩具藏了起来。
example2_en: In spite of limited funding, the community centre continues to provide valuable support for local families.
example2_zh: 尽管资金有限，社区中心仍继续为当地家庭提供宝贵的支持。
collocations: out of spite｜出于恶意 ; in spite of｜尽管 ; pure spite｜纯粹的恶意
tip_zh: in spite of后接名词或动名词，不直接接句子。

meanings_zh: n. 考官；审查员
definition_en: a person who tests or judges exams
example1_en: The examiner asked me three questions.
example1_zh: 考官问了我三个问题。
example2_en: She was nervous when the examiner walked in.
example2_zh: 考官进来时她很紧张。
tip_zh: examiner 是考官，在考试中出题/评分的人。

meanings_zh: v. 创造；创作 | v. 造成；引起
definition_en: to make something new or bring something into existence | to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop
example1_en: We created a colourful bird from folded paper.
example1_zh: 我们用折纸做出了一只色彩鲜艳的小鸟。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源能创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: create opportunities｜创造机会 ; create jobs｜创造就业机会 ; create a problem｜造成问题 ; create a work of art｜创作艺术作品
tip_zh: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

meanings_zh: n. 公共交通
definition_en: buses and trains that everyone can use
example1_en: Public transport is cheap and convenient here.
example1_zh: 这里公共交通便宜又方便。
example2_en: Many people use public transport to go to work.
example2_zh: 许多人乘公共交通上班。
tip_zh: public transport 是公共交通（公交、地铁、火车）。

meanings_zh: n. 组织；机构；团体 | n. 组织安排；条理
definition_en: A group of people working together for a particular purpose. | The planning and arrangement of activities, people, or things.
example1_en: He joined a local organisation that rescues injured birds.
example1_zh: 他加入了一个救助受伤鸟类的当地组织。
example2_en: Effective organisation of healthcare services can shorten waiting times and improve access for rural communities.
example2_zh: 有效组织医疗服务能够缩短等候时间，并改善农村社区获得医疗服务的机会。
collocations: charitable organisation｜慈善组织 ; international organisation｜国际组织 ; non-governmental organisation｜非政府组织 ; require careful organisation｜需要周密安排
tip_zh: 英式常写organisation，美式通常写organization。

meanings_zh: v. 识别；辨认 | v. 找出；确定 | v. 产生共鸣；认同
definition_en: To recognize and establish who or what someone or something is. | To discover or establish something through examination. | To feel connected to someone through shared feelings or experiences.
example1_en: Can you identify the bird sitting on our fence?
example1_zh: 你能认出停在我们围栏上的那只鸟吗？
example2_en: Schools should identify learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support before falling behind.
example2_zh: 学校应尽早发现学习困难，让学生在落后之前获得适当的支持。
collocations: identify a problem｜发现问题 ; identify the cause｜确定原因 ; identify someone as｜认出某人是 ; identify with｜与……产生共鸣
tip_zh: identify with某人指产生共鸣，不是辨认对方。

meanings_zh: n. 服务费；学费；酬金
definition_en: Money charged for a service, course, or professional advice.
example1_en: The gym charges a small fee for each class.
example1_zh: 这家健身房每节课收取少量费用。
example2_en: High tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from applying to university, even when financial assistance is available.
example2_zh: 高昂的学费可能使家境困难的学生不愿申请大学，即使有经济援助可用。
collocations: tuition fees｜学费 ; entrance fee｜入场费 ; legal fees｜法律服务费 ; pay a fee｜支付费用
tip_zh: fee指服务或入场等费用；小费通常用tip。

meanings_zh: adj. 古代的 | adj. 非常古老的
definition_en: belonging to a period thousands of years in the past | having existed for a very long time
example1_en: We explored an ancient temple during our holiday.
example1_zh: 我们度假时游览了一座古代寺庙。
example2_en: Studying ancient civilisations helps researchers understand how early societies managed water, trade, and public health.
example2_zh: 研究古代文明有助于研究人员了解早期社会如何管理用水、贸易和公共卫生。
collocations: ancient history｜古代史 ; ancient civilisation｜古代文明 ; ancient ruins｜古代遗址 ; ancient monument｜古代历史遗迹
tip_zh: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

meanings_zh: n. 数量；数额 | v. 总计；相当于
definition_en: How much of something there is. | To total something or be equivalent to it.
example1_en: Add a small amount of milk to the bowl.
example1_zh: 往碗里加少量牛奶。
example2_en: Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.
example2_zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量可以显著降低食品生产对环境的影响。
collocations: a large amount of｜大量的 ; total amount｜总量；总额 ; amount to｜总计；相当于
tip_zh: amount of接不可数名词；动词常用amount to。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻标题 | v. 成为头条新闻；领衔演出
definition_en: the title of a news report | to be the main news story or featured performer
example1_en: The headline caught my attention while I ate breakfast.
example1_zh: 我吃早餐时，那个新闻标题吸引了我的注意。
example2_en: Misleading headlines can shape public opinion before readers examine the evidence presented in a news report.
example2_zh: 误导性的标题可能在读者查看新闻报道中的证据之前就影响公众舆论。
collocations: front-page headline｜头版标题 ; make headlines｜成为头条新闻 ; misleading headline｜误导性标题
tip_zh: make headlines指成为新闻焦点，不是制作标题。

meanings_zh: v. 考虑；仔细斟酌 | v. 认为；视为 | v. 顾及；考虑到
definition_en: to think carefully about something before deciding | to have a particular opinion about someone or something | to take someone or something into account
example1_en: We're considering taking the train instead of driving tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我们正在考虑明天坐火车，而不开车。
example2_en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
example2_zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。
collocations: consider doing something｜考虑做某事 ; consider the consequences｜考虑后果 ; consider all options｜考虑所有选择 ; be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip_zh: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

meanings_zh: n. 赊购；信贷 | n. 赞扬；认可 | n. 学分
definition_en: An arrangement allowing payment later or borrowing money. | Recognition that someone deserves for an achievement. | A unit earned towards a qualification by completing coursework.
example1_en: We bought our new fridge on credit last month.
example1_zh: 我们上个月赊购了一台新冰箱。
example2_en: Affordable credit can help small businesses invest in equipment and create jobs within local communities.
example2_zh: 成本可负担的信贷能帮助小企业投资设备，并为当地社区创造就业机会。
collocations: buy on credit｜赊购 ; give someone credit｜肯定某人的功劳 ; earn credits｜修得学分 ; credit card｜信用卡
tip_zh: on credit表示赊购；学分义可数，常用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 潜水员；跳水者
definition_en: a person who dives under water or jumps into water
example1_en: The diver explored the coral reef.
example1_zh: 潜水员探索了珊瑚礁。
example2_en: The diver jumped into the pool perfectly.
example2_zh: 跳水者完美地跳入泳池。
tip_zh: diver 指潜水员或跳水运动员；diving 是潜水/跳水运动。

meanings_zh: n. 气候 | n. 社会环境；风气；氛围
definition_en: The typical weather conditions of a place over many years. | The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.
example1_en: These plants grow well in a warm, dry climate.
example1_zh: 这些植物在温暖干燥的气候中长得很好。
example2_en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
example2_zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。
collocations: climate change｜气候变化 ; mild climate｜温和的气候 ; political climate｜政治环境
tip_zh: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

meanings_zh: adj. 身体不舒服的；不舒适的 | adj. 不自在的；不安的
definition_en: Causing or feeling physical discomfort. | Feeling worried, embarrassed, or uneasy.
example1_en: These new shoes feel uncomfortable after a long walk.
example1_zh: 走了很久以后，这双新鞋穿着很不舒服。
example2_en: Students may feel uncomfortable asking questions in large classes, which can limit their participation and understanding.
example2_zh: 学生在大班课堂上提问时可能感到不自在，这会影响他们的参与和理解。
collocations: an uncomfortable chair｜不舒服的椅子 ; feel uncomfortable｜感到不适 ; an uncomfortable silence｜令人尴尬的沉默
tip_zh: 既可指身体不适，也可指心理上的不自在。

meanings_zh: n. 洞穴；山洞
definition_en: A large natural hollow inside rock or under the ground.
example1_en: We sheltered from the rain inside a small cave.
example1_zh: 我们躲进一个小山洞里避雨。
example2_en: Ancient paintings found in a cave can reveal how early communities understood their surroundings.
example2_zh: 洞穴中发现的古代绘画可以揭示早期群体如何理解周围环境。
collocations: explore a cave｜探索洞穴 ; cave entrance｜洞口 ; cave paintings｜洞穴壁画
tip_zh: cave指洞穴；动词短语cave in表示坍塌或屈服。

meanings_zh: n. 东南；东南部 | adj. 东南的；来自东南的 | adv. 向东南；在东南
definition_en: The direction between south and east, or an area's southeastern part. | Located in the southeast, or coming from that direction. | Towards or in the southeast.
example1_en: Our kitchen window faces southeast and catches the morning sun.
example1_zh: 我们厨房的窗户朝东南，早晨能照到阳光。
example2_en: Population growth in the southeast has increased demand for affordable housing and reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 东南部的人口增长增加了对可负担住房和可靠公共交通的需求。
collocations: in the southeast｜在东南部 ; southeast of｜在……的东南方 ; head southeast｜向东南行进 ; the southeast coast｜东南海岸
tip_zh: 名词前常用the；副词不用：head southeast。

meanings_zh: n. 香草；药草
definition_en: A plant used to flavour food or make medicines.
example1_en: She grows fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
example1_zh: 她在厨房窗边的花盆里种了新鲜香草。
example2_en: Growing herbs at home can encourage healthier cooking and reduce the need for packaged seasonings.
example2_zh: 在家种植香草可以鼓励更健康的烹饪方式，并减少对包装调味料的需求。
collocations: fresh herbs｜新鲜香草 ; dried herbs｜干香草 ; medicinal herbs｜药草 ; herb garden｜香草园
tip_zh: 英音h发音，美音通常不发；对应a herb和an herb。

meanings_zh: n. 视频片段；短片
definition_en: a short video
example1_en: She shared a funny video clip with her friends.
example1_zh: 她给朋友分享了一个搞笑短视频。
example2_en: The video clip of the concert went popular online.
example2_zh: 音乐会的视频片段在网上火了。
tip_zh: video clip 是短视频/片段。

meanings_zh: v. 削皮；剥皮 | v. 剥落；脱落 | n. 果皮；蔬菜皮
definition_en: To remove the outer skin of fruit or vegetables. | To come off a surface in thin pieces. | The outer skin of a fruit or vegetable.
example1_en: Could you peel these potatoes while I chop the carrots?
example1_zh: 我切胡萝卜时，你能帮忙削这些土豆吗？
example2_en: Households can compost vegetable peels rather than discard them, reducing the amount of waste sent to landfill.
example2_zh: 家庭可以将蔬菜皮制成堆肥而非丢弃，从而减少送往填埋场的垃圾量。
collocations: peel potatoes｜削土豆皮 ; orange peel｜橙皮 ; peeling paint｜剥落的油漆
tip_zh: peel作动词可指削皮，也可指油漆等剥落。

meanings_zh: n. 小说；虚构文学 | n. 虚构之事；编造
definition_en: Stories about imagined people and events. | Something invented that is presented as true.
example1_en: My sister reads fiction on the train every morning.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每天早上在火车上读小说。
example2_en: Reading fiction can help young people understand unfamiliar perspectives and develop greater empathy for others.
example2_zh: 阅读小说能帮助年轻人理解陌生的视角，并更加体谅他人。
collocations: science fiction｜科幻小说 ; historical fiction｜历史小说 ; a work of fiction｜一部小说作品 ; fact and fiction｜事实与虚构
tip_zh: 统称小说时不可数；一部小说可说a work of fiction。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全地；充分地
definition_en: Completely or to the greatest possible extent.
example1_en: Make sure your phone is fully charged before leaving.
example1_zh: 出门前确保手机已经充满电。
example2_en: Students benefit most from online learning when they fully understand how to use the available digital tools.
example2_zh: 学生充分了解如何使用现有数字工具时，才能最大程度地从在线学习中受益。
collocations: fully aware｜充分意识到的 ; fully equipped｜设备齐全的 ; fully understand｜充分理解 ; fully booked｜预订已满的
tip_zh: 常修饰分词或形容词，如fully prepared。

meanings_zh: adj. 有资格的；能胜任的 | adj. 有限度的；有保留的
definition_en: having the training, skills, or experience needed for something | not complete or unconditional; involving limits or reservations
example1_en: Only a qualified electrician should repair that damaged socket.
example1_zh: 只有具备资质的电工才应该修理那个损坏的插座。
example2_en: Governments should invest in teacher training to ensure that every school has enough qualified staff.
example2_zh: 政府应投入资金培训教师，确保每所学校都有足够的合格教职人员。
collocations: fully qualified｜完全具备资格的 ; qualified to teach｜有资格任教 ; qualified for the job｜能胜任这份工作 ; qualified support｜有保留的支持
tip_zh: qualified for＋名词；qualified to do表示有资格做。

meanings_zh: n. 地点；场所 | n. 斑点；污点 | v. 发现；认出
definition_en: A particular place or position. | A small mark differing in colour from its surroundings. | Notice or recognise someone or something.
example1_en: We found a shady spot beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边找到了一处阴凉的地方。
example2_en: Satellite images help researchers spot changes in forest cover before extensive damage occurs.
example2_zh: 卫星图像帮助研究人员在大面积破坏发生之前发现森林覆盖的变化。
collocations: a quiet spot｜安静的地方 ; on the spot｜当场；在现场 ; spot a mistake｜发现错误 ; a tourist spot｜旅游景点
tip_zh: on the spot可指“当场”或“在现场”，依语境判断。

meanings_zh: n. 侄女；外甥女
definition_en: A daughter of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.
example1_en: My niece brought her new puppy to our picnic.
example1_zh: 我的侄女带着她新养的小狗来参加我们的野餐。
example2_en: Flexible working hours can help adults care for relatives, including a young niece or nephew.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助成年人照顾亲属，包括年幼的侄女或侄子。
collocations: young niece｜年幼的侄女或外甥女 ; nieces and nephews｜侄子侄女及外甥外甥女
tip_zh: niece指女性晚辈，nephew指男性晚辈。

meanings_zh: v. 应该；应当 | v. 应该会；按理应当
definition_en: Used with to for advice, duty, or the right action. | Used with to to express what is likely or expected.
example1_en: You ought to take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
example1_zh: 你应该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。
example2_en: Governments ought to ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of family income.
example2_zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。
collocations: ought to do｜应该做 ; ought not to do｜不应该做 ; ought to have done｜本应该做
tip_zh: ought是情态动词，后接to do；否定为ought not to。

meanings_zh: n. 处方；处方药 | n. 解决方案；对策 | adj. 凭处方购买的
definition_en: A doctor's written order for medicine, or the medicine ordered | A suggested method for dealing with a problem | Available only with a doctor's written order
example1_en: The doctor gave me a prescription for eye drops.
example1_zh: 医生给我开了眼药水的处方。
example2_en: Requiring a prescription for certain medicines can reduce misuse and protect public health.
example2_zh: 要求某些药物凭处方购买，可以减少滥用并保护公众健康。
collocations: write a prescription｜开处方 ; fill a prescription｜按处方配药 ; prescription medicine｜处方药 ; a prescription for success｜成功之道
tip_zh: 处方用for引出药物；on prescription指凭处方。

meanings_zh: n. 守门员；保管人
definition_en: short for goalkeeper, or a person who looks after things
example1_en: The keeper caught the ball easily.
example1_zh: 守门员轻松接住了球。
example2_en: The zoo keeper feeds the animals every day.
example2_zh: 动物园管理员每天喂动物。
tip_zh: keeper 常指守门员（goalkeeper 的简称），也指管理员。

meanings_zh: adv. 显然；明显地
definition_en: in a way that is easy to see or understand
example1_en: The puppy was obviously tired after its long walk.
example1_zh: 走了很长一段路后，小狗显然累了。
example2_en: Although renewable energy obviously benefits the environment, its initial costs may discourage investment in poorer regions.
example2_zh: 虽然可再生能源显然有益于环境，但其初期成本可能阻碍较贫困地区的投资。
collocations: obviously pleased｜明显很高兴 ; obviously wrong｜显然错误 ; obviously important｜显然重要
tip_zh: 表示情况显而易见；讨论争议观点时慎用，以免武断。

meanings_zh: phr. 及时；赶得上
definition_en: early enough; before the deadline
example1_en: We arrived in time for the film.
example1_zh: 我们及时赶到了，赶上了电影。
example2_en: Finish your homework in time for dinner.
example2_zh: 及时完成作业好赶上晚饭。
collocations: just in time｜刚好赶上
tip_zh: in time 是“及时，来得及”；on time 是“准时”。

meanings_zh: n. 磁盘；计算机存储盘 | n. 圆盘；盘状物
definition_en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface | a flat, thin, round object
example1_en: My laptop's disk is almost full of holiday photos.
example1_zh: 我的笔记本电脑磁盘里几乎存满了度假照片。
example2_en: Regular backups protect important research data against accidental deletion and unexpected disk failure in university computer systems.
example2_zh: 定期备份可保护重要研究数据，避免其因误删或大学计算机系统的突发磁盘故障而丢失。
collocations: hard disk｜硬盘 ; disk space｜磁盘空间 ; disk drive｜磁盘驱动器 ; disk failure｜磁盘故障
tip_zh: 计算机磁盘用disk；英式圆盘、光盘通常写disc。

meanings_zh: v. 宣布；声明 | v. 申报
definition_en: to announce something publicly or officially | to officially report goods, income or other required information
example1_en: The judges declared her the winner of the competition.
example1_zh: 评委宣布她赢得了比赛。
example2_en: Local authorities may declare a public holiday to encourage participation in an important community celebration.
example2_zh: 地方政府可能宣布放假一天，以鼓励民众参加重要的社区庆典。
collocations: declare a winner｜宣布获胜者 ; declare an emergency｜宣布进入紧急状态 ; declare goods｜申报物品 ; declare income｜申报收入
tip_zh: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。

meanings_zh: n. 蚊子
definition_en: A small flying insect whose females bite and suck blood.
example1_en: A mosquito landed on my arm during dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭时，一只蚊子落在了我的胳膊上。
example2_en: Warmer temperatures may allow mosquito populations to spread into regions where they were previously uncommon.
example2_zh: 气温升高可能使蚊子种群扩散到以前蚊子不常见的地区。
collocations: mosquito bite｜蚊子叮咬 ; mosquito net｜蚊帐 ; mosquito repellent｜驱蚊剂
tip_zh: 复数可写mosquitoes或mosquitos。

meanings_zh: n. 边；边缘 | n. 优势 | v. 缓慢移动
definition_en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface. | A quality that makes someone or something more competitive. | To move slowly and carefully in a particular direction.
example1_en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
example1_zh: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。
example2_en: Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.
example2_zh: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。
collocations: on the edge of｜在……边缘 ; a competitive edge｜竞争优势 ; have an edge over｜比……有优势 ; edge towards｜慢慢向……移动
tip_zh: 表示优势时常用an edge over，指胜过某人。

meanings_zh: n. 问候；招呼 | n. 祝愿；祝福
definition_en: Words or actions used when meeting or welcoming someone. | Friendly wishes expressed on a special occasion.
example1_en: She gave us a cheerful greeting at the door.
example1_zh: 她在门口愉快地向我们打招呼。
example2_en: Learning local greeting customs can help international students build relationships and avoid misunderstandings in their new environment.
example2_zh: 了解当地的问候习俗可以帮助国际学生建立人际关系，避免在新环境中产生误解。
collocations: a warm greeting｜热情的问候 ; exchange greetings｜互致问候 ; a greeting card｜贺卡 ; birthday greetings｜生日祝福
tip_zh: 表示节日祝福常用复数greetings，如birthday greetings。

meanings_zh: n. 数据；资料
definition_en: facts or information collected for analysis or computer use
example1_en: My watch collects data about how far I walk.
example1_zh: 我的手表会收集有关我步行距离的数据。
example2_en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
example2_zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。
collocations: collect data｜收集数据 ; analyse data｜分析数据 ; personal data｜个人数据 ; data protection｜数据保护
tip_zh: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

meanings_zh: prep. 经由；途经 | prep. 通过；借助
definition_en: travelling through a particular place on the way somewhere | using a particular method, system, or person
example1_en: We travelled to the coast via a small mountain village.
example1_zh: 我们途经一个山间小村庄，前往海岸。
example2_en: Providing medical advice via video calls can improve access to healthcare for people in remote communities.
example2_zh: 通过视频通话提供医疗建议，可以让偏远社区的居民更容易获得医疗服务。
collocations: travel via｜途经 ; via email｜通过电子邮件 ; via satellite｜通过卫星
tip_zh: via后直接接地点或方式，如via email。

meanings_zh: n. 改善；进步 | n. 改进之处
definition_en: The process or result of becoming better. | A change that makes something better.
example1_en: Your latest drawing shows a real improvement in shading.
example1_zh: 你最近这幅画的明暗处理确实有进步。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can bring significant improvements in air quality and reduce travel times for urban residents.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通能显著改善空气质量，并缩短城市居民的出行时间。
collocations: significant improvement｜显著改善 ; room for improvement｜改进空间 ; an improvement on｜比…更好的事物 ; make improvements｜作出改进
tip_zh: 某方面的改善用 in；比原来更好用 an improvement on。

meanings_zh: adj. 有经验的；老练的
definition_en: having skill from doing something for a long time
example1_en: She is an experienced driver.
example1_zh: 她是一位有经验的司机。
example2_en: The experienced teacher helped the new students.
example2_zh: 经验丰富的老师帮助了新学生。
tip_zh: experienced 是形容词“有经验的”；反义 inexperienced。

meanings_zh: n. 铁轨；铁路运输 | n. 栏杆；扶手；横杆 | v. 愤怒抱怨；严厉指责
definition_en: a steel track for trains, or transport by train | a horizontal bar used for support or as a barrier | to complain angrily and strongly about something
example1_en: We travelled by rail through the snowy mountains.
example1_zh: 我们乘火车穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。
example2_en: Investment in rail infrastructure can reduce road congestion and provide a cleaner alternative to domestic flights.
example2_zh: 投资铁路基础设施可以缓解道路拥堵，并提供比国内航班更环保的出行选择。
collocations: travel by rail｜乘火车出行 ; rail network｜铁路网 ; hold onto the rail｜抓住扶手 ; rail against｜愤怒地指责
tip_zh: by rail表示乘火车，不加冠词；动词常接against。

meanings_zh: phr v. 下来；取下
definition_en: to move down, or to bring something down
example1_en: Get down from that tree carefully!
example1_zh: 小心地从树上下来！
example2_en: She got the books down from the high shelf.
example2_zh: 她把书从高架子上取下来。
tip_zh: get down 表示“下来”或“取下”。

meanings_zh: n. 报告；报道 | v. 报告；报道 | v. 报到
definition_en: A spoken or written account giving information about something | To give information about an event or situation | To arrive somewhere and tell the person in charge
example1_en: I finished my report before lunch and emailed it.
example1_zh: 我午饭前写完了报告，并通过电子邮件发了出去。
example2_en: The report suggests that improved access to green spaces can benefit residents' physical and mental health.
example2_zh: 这份报告指出，让居民更方便地使用绿地有益于他们的身心健康。
collocations: write a report｜撰写报告 ; a news report｜新闻报道 ; report a problem｜报告问题 ; report for duty｜报到上班
tip_zh: report on后接报道主题；report for duty指报到上班。

meanings_zh: n. 勇气；胆量
definition_en: Ability to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
example1_en: It took courage to admit my mistake in class.
example1_zh: 在课堂上承认自己的错误需要勇气。
example2_en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
example2_zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。
collocations: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事 ; show courage｜表现出勇气 ; take courage｜鼓起勇气
tip_zh: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

meanings_zh: v. 处理；应付 | v. 拿；触摸；操纵 | n. 把手；柄
definition_en: To deal with a situation, task, or person. | To hold, touch, move, or control something with your hands. | The part of an object used for holding or moving it.
example1_en: Can you handle dinner while I collect the children?
example1_zh: 我去接孩子，你能负责准备晚饭吗？
example2_en: Healthcare workers need effective training to handle stressful situations while maintaining a high standard of care.
example2_zh: 医护人员需要有效的培训，以便应对压力大的情况，同时保持高水平的护理质量。
collocations: handle complaints｜处理投诉 ; handle with care｜小心轻放 ; door handle｜门把手 ; handle pressure｜应对压力
tip_zh: handle作处理讲直接接宾语，不加with。

meanings_zh: v. 照看小孩（临时保姆）
definition_en: to look after children while their parents are out
example1_en: She babysits for the neighbours on Friday nights.
example1_zh: 她每周五晚上帮邻居照看孩子。
example2_en: I babysit my little cousin when my aunt works.
example2_zh: 姑姑上班时我照看小表弟。
tip_zh: babysit 是动词“照看小孩”；照看者叫 babysitter。

meanings_zh: v. 交换；兑换 | n. 交换；交流 | n. 交易所
definition_en: to give something and receive something else in return | an act of giving and receiving things, information, or ideas | a market where shares, currencies, or goods are traded
example1_en: Can I exchange this shirt for a smaller size?
example1_zh: 我能把这件衬衫换成小一号的吗？
example2_en: International exchange programmes allow students to experience different cultures and develop greater confidence in communicating.
example2_zh: 国际交流项目让学生体验不同文化，并增强他们沟通时的信心。
collocations: exchange ideas｜交流想法 ; exchange rate｜汇率 ; in exchange for｜作为……的交换 ; stock exchange｜证券交易所
tip_zh: exchange A for B表示用A换B，注意介词for。

meanings_zh: adj. 满意的；满足的 | adj. 确信的；信服的
definition_en: Pleased because something meets your needs or expectations. | Convinced that something is true or has been done properly.
example1_en: I'm satisfied with these shoes; they fit perfectly.
example1_zh: 我对这双鞋很满意，穿着特别合脚。
example2_en: Employees who feel satisfied with their working conditions are more likely to remain with the same organisation.
example2_zh: 对工作条件感到满意的员工更有可能留在同一家机构。
collocations: satisfied with｜对……满意 ; fully satisfied｜完全满意 ; satisfied that｜确信……
tip_zh: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。

meanings_zh: phr v. 调低（音量）；拒绝
definition_en: to reduce sound, or to refuse
example1_en: Please turn down the music; it's too loud.
example1_zh: 请把音乐调小，太吵了。
example2_en: She turned down the job offer.
example2_zh: 她拒绝了这份工作邀请。
tip_zh: turn down 表示“调低”或“拒绝”。

meanings_zh: adj. 合群的；爱交际的
definition_en: Enjoying meeting people and spending time with them.
example1_en: My sociable neighbour invites everyone over for tea.
example1_zh: 我那位爱交际的邻居邀请大家去喝茶。
example2_en: Shared spaces can encourage residents to become more sociable and develop stronger relationships with their neighbours.
example2_zh: 公共空间可以鼓励居民更多地与人交往，并与邻居建立更紧密的关系。
collocations: a sociable person｜爱交际的人 ; a sociable atmosphere｜友好的社交氛围 ; sociable activities｜社交活动
tip_zh: sociable指爱交际；social多指社会或社交的。

meanings_zh: n. 奖励；回报；酬金 | v. 奖励；酬谢
definition_en: Something received for good work, helpful behaviour, or achievement. | To give something to someone for their efforts or help.
example1_en: We gave the puppy a treat as a reward.
example1_zh: 我们给了小狗一块零食作为奖励。
example2_en: Schools should reward consistent effort rather than focus exclusively on students who achieve the highest grades.
example2_zh: 学校应奖励持续的努力，而不是只关注成绩最好的学生。
collocations: financial reward｜经济回报 ; reward someone for something｜因某事奖励某人 ; reap the rewards｜收获回报
tip_zh: reward强调付出后的回报；award常指正式授奖。

meanings_zh: n. 全体船员；机组人员 | n. 工作组；团队 | v. 担任船员
definition_en: The people who work together on a ship or aircraft | A group working together on a particular practical task | Work as a member of a boat's crew
example1_en: The crew welcomed us aboard with warm smiles.
example1_zh: 机组人员面带亲切的笑容，欢迎我们登机。
example2_en: Airlines must ensure that every crew member receives regular safety training to protect passengers during emergencies.
example2_zh: 航空公司必须确保每位机组成员定期接受安全培训，以便在紧急情况下保护乘客。
collocations: cabin crew｜客舱乘务组 ; crew member｜机组成员；船员 ; film crew｜摄制组 ; rescue crew｜救援队
tip_zh: crew是集体名词；单个成员说a crew member。

meanings_zh: v. 保护；保卫 | v. 辩护；捍卫 | v. 防守
definition_en: to protect someone or something from attack or harm | to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised | to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport
example1_en: The mother duck spread her wings to defend her ducklings.
example1_zh: 鸭妈妈张开翅膀保护小鸭。
example2_en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
example2_zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。
collocations: defend against attack｜抵御攻击 ; defend human rights｜捍卫人权 ; defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护 ; defend a title｜卫冕
tip_zh: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

meanings_zh: n. 肩；肩膀 | v. 承担；肩负
definition_en: the body part where an arm joins the upper body | to accept responsibility for something difficult
example1_en: She rested her head on her father's shoulder.
example1_zh: 她把头靠在父亲的肩膀上。
example2_en: Governments and businesses must shoulder greater responsibility for reducing the environmental impact of industrial production.
example2_zh: 政府和企业必须承担更大的责任，减少工业生产对环境的影响。
collocations: shoulder responsibility｜承担责任 ; shoulder the burden｜承担重担 ; shoulder to shoulder｜肩并肩 ; look over your shoulder｜回头看
tip_zh: 作动词常接responsibility或burden，表示承担。

meanings_zh: n. 王子；亲王 | n. 公国君主
definition_en: A male royal family member, often a monarch's son. | A male ruler of a small independent state.
example1_en: The prince waved to visitors from the palace balcony.
example1_zh: 王子在宫殿阳台上向来访者挥手。
example2_en: In some constitutional monarchies, a prince may support charitable organisations without holding any direct political power.
example2_zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，王子可能支持慈善组织，但不掌握任何直接的政治权力。
collocations: crown prince｜王储 ; young prince｜年轻的王子
tip_zh: prince不一定是王子，也可指亲王或公国君主。

meanings_zh: n. 观众；听众 | n. 读者群；受众
definition_en: People watching or listening to a performance, speech, or programme | People who read or receive particular content
example1_en: The audience clapped loudly when the dancers finished.
example1_zh: 舞者表演结束时，观众热烈鼓掌。
example2_en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
example2_zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。
collocations: a large audience｜众多观众 ; a target audience｜目标受众 ; reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众 ; audience participation｜观众参与
tip_zh: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

meanings_zh: n. 紧急情况；突发事件
definition_en: A serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action.
example1_en: Keep a torch nearby in case of an emergency.
example1_zh: 在手边备好手电筒，以防出现紧急情况。
example2_en: Governments should invest in emergency services to ensure that communities receive rapid assistance during natural disasters.
example2_zh: 政府应投资应急服务，确保社区在自然灾害期间迅速获得援助。
collocations: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下 ; emergency services｜应急救援部门 ; emergency evacuation｜紧急疏散 ; a state of emergency｜紧急状态
tip_zh: 是可数名词；emergency exit中的名词作定语。

meanings_zh: v. 拖；拉 | v. 缓慢进行；拖沓 | n. 阻力；拖累
definition_en: To pull something along a surface, often with effort. | To pass or progress so slowly that it feels boring. | A force or influence that slows movement or progress.
example1_en: We dragged the heavy rug across the floor.
example1_zh: 我们拖着沉重的地毯穿过房间。
example2_en: Complicated approval procedures can drag on for months, delaying essential improvements to public transport.
example2_zh: 复杂的审批程序可能拖延数月，耽误公共交通的必要改善。
collocations: drag a chair｜拖动椅子 ; drag on｜拖延下去 ; drag and drop｜拖放 ; a drag on growth｜增长的拖累
tip_zh: drag过去式为dragged；drag on指拖延下去。

meanings_zh: v. 复习 | v. 修订；修改
definition_en: To study material again in preparation for an examination. | To change something to correct or improve it.
example1_en: I need to revise for my biology exam tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚我得复习，准备生物考试。
example2_en: Governments should revise outdated housing policies to ensure that affordable homes remain accessible to young families.
example2_zh: 政府应修订过时的住房政策，确保年轻家庭仍能获得负担得起的住房。
collocations: revise for an exam｜复习备考 ; revise a draft｜修改草稿 ; revise an estimate｜修正估算 ; revise a policy｜修订政策
tip_zh: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

meanings_zh: n. 毕业；毕业典礼
definition_en: Completing a course of study, or the ceremony celebrating this.
example1_en: My sister wore a blue gown at her graduation.
example1_zh: 姐姐在毕业典礼上穿了一件蓝色学位袍。
example2_en: Universities should provide career guidance before graduation to help students make a successful transition into employment.
example2_zh: 大学应在学生毕业前提供职业指导，帮助他们顺利过渡到职场。
collocations: graduation ceremony｜毕业典礼 ; after graduation｜毕业后 ; graduation gown｜学位袍
tip_zh: 表示从某校毕业，动词用graduate from。

meanings_zh: v. 回答；答复 | n. 回答；答复
definition_en: to answer someone or respond to a message | an answer given in speech or writing
example1_en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
example1_zh: 请在周五之前回复，好让我预订晚餐。
example2_en: Local officials should reply promptly to residents who raise concerns about public transport services.
example2_zh: 地方官员应及时答复对公共交通服务提出担忧的居民。
collocations: reply to a message｜回复消息 ; a prompt reply｜及时的答复 ; in reply to｜作为对……的答复
tip_zh: reply to后接人或消息，不直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 便宜货；划算的买卖 | v. 讨价还价；商谈条件 | n. 协议；约定
definition_en: Something bought for less than its usual price | To discuss prices or conditions to reach an agreement | An agreement about what each person will do
example1_en: This warm winter coat was a real bargain.
example1_zh: 这件暖和的冬季外套买得真划算。
example2_en: Consumers can often bargain with local sellers, although fixed prices are more common in large stores.
example2_zh: 消费者通常可以与当地商贩讨价还价，但大型商店更常采用固定价格。
collocations: a real bargain｜真正的便宜货 ; bargain with someone｜与某人讨价还价 ; strike a bargain｜达成协议 ; keep your side of the bargain｜履行自己约定的义务
tip_zh: 便宜货用可数名词；bargain with sb表示与某人议价。

meanings_zh: n. 平底煎锅
definition_en: a flat pan used for frying food
example1_en: Heat the frying pan before adding the oil.
example1_zh: 先加热煎锅再放油。
example2_en: She put the frying pan on the stove.
example2_zh: 她把煎锅放到炉子上。
tip_zh: frying pan 是平底煎锅；美式常说 skillet。

meanings_zh: n. 兴奋；激动 | n. 令人兴奋的事；刺激
definition_en: a feeling of great enthusiasm and eager anticipation | something that creates strong interest or enthusiasm
example1_en: The children jumped with excitement when the puppies arrived.
example1_zh: 小狗到来时，孩子们兴奋得跳了起来。
example2_en: Although international sporting events generate excitement, host cities must carefully assess their long-term financial costs.
example2_zh: 虽然国际体育赛事令人振奋，但主办城市必须仔细评估其长期财务成本。
collocations: with excitement｜兴奋地 ; a sense of excitement｜兴奋感 ; generate excitement｜引发兴奋 ; contain your excitement｜抑制兴奋之情
tip_zh: 表示兴奋情绪通常不可数：with excitement。

meanings_zh: v. 介绍；引见 | v. 引进；推行 | v. 使初次了解
definition_en: Tell people each other's names when they first meet. | Bring something into use or a place for the first time. | Help someone experience or learn about something for the first time.
example1_en: Let me introduce you to my new neighbour.
example1_zh: 让我把你介绍给我的新邻居。
example2_en: Schools should introduce practical financial education to help students manage money responsibly in adult life.
example2_zh: 学校应引入实用的理财教育，帮助学生成年后负责任地管理财务。
collocations: introduce yourself｜介绍自己 ; introduce someone to someone｜把某人介绍给某人 ; introduce new measures｜推行新措施 ; introduce someone to a subject｜引导某人了解一门学科
tip_zh: 把甲介绍给乙用introduce A to B，不能用with。

meanings_zh: adj. 倒霉的；不幸的 | adj. 被认为不吉利的
definition_en: Experiencing bad things because of chance | Believed to bring bad luck
example1_en: We were unlucky to miss the bus by seconds.
example1_zh: 我们真倒霉，只差几秒就错过了公交车。
example2_en: Students who are unlucky enough to fall ill during examinations should be offered alternative assessment arrangements.
example2_zh: 不幸在考试期间生病的学生应获得其他考核安排。
collocations: unlucky in love｜情场失意 ; unlucky enough to｜不幸竟然…… ; an unlucky day｜倒霉的一天
tip_zh: unlucky强调运气差，不等于unhappy（不开心）。

meanings_zh: v. 攻击；猛烈抨击 | n. 攻击；抨击 | n. 疾病发作
definition_en: Try to hurt someone or criticize something strongly | An act of violence or strong criticism | A sudden period of illness or severe symptoms
example1_en: The goose attacked my bag when I approached the pond.
example1_zh: 我走近池塘时，那只鹅突然啄起我的包。
example2_en: Critics attacked the proposal because it offered little support for families living in poverty.
example2_zh: 批评者猛烈抨击这项提案，因为它几乎没有为贫困家庭提供支持。
collocations: come under attack｜遭到攻击或抨击 ; heart attack｜心脏病发作 ; attack a proposal｜抨击一项提案
tip_zh: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an attack on。

meanings_zh: v. 吹；刮 | n. 打击；不幸事件 | n. 重击；击打
definition_en: to move air, or move because of moving air | an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss | a hard hit with a hand or object
example1_en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
example1_zh: 一阵冷风把树叶吹过空荡荡的操场。
example2_en: The closure of the local factory dealt a serious blow to employment opportunities in the region.
example2_zh: 当地工厂的关闭严重打击了该地区的就业机会。
collocations: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛 ; blow your nose｜擤鼻涕 ; a major blow｜重大打击 ; deal a blow to｜给……造成打击
tip_zh: 动词变化为blow–blew–blown。

meanings_zh: adv. 在前面；向前 | adv. 领先；提前 | adv. 在未来；预先
definition_en: In front of someone or something, or moving forward. | Further advanced than others or earlier than expected. | In the future, or in preparation for it.
example1_en: Walk straight ahead until you reach the little bridge.
example1_zh: 一直往前走，直到走到那座小桥。
example2_en: Cities need to plan ahead to ensure that transport networks can meet the demands of growing populations.
example2_zh: 城市需要提前规划，确保交通网络能满足人口增长带来的需求。
collocations: straight ahead｜正前方；径直向前 ; ahead of schedule｜比预定时间提前 ; plan ahead｜提前规划 ; ahead of the competition｜领先竞争对手
tip_zh: ahead是副词；后接人或事物时用ahead of。

meanings_zh: phr. 按要求；应请求
definition_en: if someone asks for it
example1_en: A free map is available on request at the desk.
example1_zh: 前台可应要求提供免费地图。
example2_en: Vegetarian meals are served on request.
example2_zh: 应要求提供素食。
tip_zh: on request 表示“经要求提供”，常用于服务说明。

meanings_zh: n. 日落；日落时分 | n. 落日景象；晚霞
definition_en: the time when the sun disappears below the horizon | the colourful sky seen as the sun goes down
example1_en: We reached the beach just before sunset yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在日落前刚好赶到了海滩。
example2_en: Coastal destinations often attract tourists with spectacular sunset views, creating valuable opportunities for local businesses.
example2_zh: 沿海目的地常以壮丽的落日景色吸引游客，为当地企业创造宝贵商机。
collocations: at sunset｜在日落时分 ; watch the sunset｜看日落 ; a spectacular sunset｜壮丽的落日景象
tip_zh: 表示在日落时用at sunset，通常不加冠词。

meanings_zh: adv. 确实；的确 | adv. 甚至；实际上
definition_en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true. | Used to add information that strengthens a previous statement.
example1_en: The soup was very tasty indeed, so I had more.
example1_zh: 这汤确实非常好喝，所以我又喝了一些。
example2_en: Public transport can reduce congestion; indeed, reliable bus services may persuade many commuters to stop driving.
example2_zh: 公共交通能够缓解拥堵；事实上，可靠的公交服务可能使许多通勤者放弃开车。
collocations: very useful indeed｜确实非常有用 ; indeed the case｜确实如此 ; if indeed｜如果确实
tip_zh: 可用very＋形容词＋indeed加强语气。

meanings_zh: n. 地区；区域 | n. 身体部位
definition_en: an area of a country or the world | a particular area of the body
example1_en: This region is famous for its apples and cheese.
example1_zh: 这个地区以苹果和奶酪闻名。
example2_en: Improved transport links could attract more businesses to the region and create jobs for local residents.
example2_zh: 改善交通联系可以吸引更多企业进入该地区，并为当地居民创造就业机会。
collocations: coastal region｜沿海地区 ; rural region｜乡村地区 ; in the region of｜大约
tip_zh: in the region of接金额等，表示“大约”。

meanings_zh: n. 考试（复数）
definition_en: tests at school or university
example1_en: I have three exams next week.
example1_zh: 我下周有三场考试。
example2_en: She studies hard before the exams.
example2_zh: 考试前她努力学习。
collocations: final exams｜期末考试
tip_zh: exams 是 exam 的复数；final exams 是期末考试。

meanings_zh: n. 呼吸的空气；气息 | n. 一次呼吸
definition_en: air moving into or out of your lungs | one act of taking air into your lungs
example1_en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
example1_zh: 她呼出的气在冷空气中形成了一团白雾。
example2_en: Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.
example2_zh: 缓慢地深呼吸一次，有助于学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。
collocations: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气 ; out of breath｜上气不接下气 ; hold your breath｜屏住呼吸 ; catch your breath｜喘口气
tip_zh: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

meanings_zh: adj. 二手的；用过的 | adj. 间接获得的 | adv. 以二手方式；间接地
definition_en: previously owned or used by someone else | learned from others rather than through direct experience | from a previous owner, or through another person's account
example1_en: My second-hand bicycle still rides smoothly after years of use.
example1_zh: 我的二手自行车用了多年，骑起来仍很顺畅。
example2_en: Buying second-hand furniture can reduce household spending and prevent usable goods from ending up in landfill.
example2_zh: 购买二手家具能减少家庭开支，并避免尚可使用的物品最终被填埋。
collocations: second-hand clothes｜二手衣物 ; second-hand shop｜二手商店 ; buy second-hand｜买二手货 ; second-hand information｜间接获得的信息
tip_zh: 既可指物品用过，也可指信息并非亲身获得。

meanings_zh: phr v. 闲逛；一起玩
definition_en: to spend time relaxing with friends
example1_en: We hang out at the café after school.
example1_zh: 放学后我们在咖啡馆闲逛。
example2_en: She hangs out with her cousins on weekends.
example2_zh: 她周末和表亲们一起玩。
tip_zh: hang out 是口语“闲逛/消磨时间”。

meanings_zh: n. 渡船；轮渡 | v. 运送；摆渡
definition_en: A boat carrying passengers or vehicles across water regularly. | To carry people or goods between places, often repeatedly.
example1_en: We took the ferry across the lake this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我们乘渡船穿过了湖。
example2_en: Reliable ferry services connect island communities with mainland hospitals, schools, and employment opportunities throughout the year.
example2_zh: 可靠的轮渡服务全年将岛屿社区与大陆的医院、学校和就业机会连接起来。
collocations: take a ferry｜乘渡船 ; ferry terminal｜轮渡码头 ; ferry service｜轮渡服务
tip_zh: 复数为ferries；动词也可指用车反复接送。

meanings_zh: v. 提醒 | v. 使想起
definition_en: Help someone remember something they need to do or know | Make someone think of a similar person, thing, or experience
example1_en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
example1_zh: 出门前请提醒我带伞。
example2_en: Schools should regularly remind students to protect their personal information when using online learning platforms.
example2_zh: 学校应定期提醒学生，在使用在线学习平台时保护个人信息。
collocations: remind someone to do something｜提醒某人做某事 ; remind someone of something｜使某人想起某事 ; gently remind｜轻声提醒
tip_zh: 提醒去做用remind sb to do；使想起用of。

meanings_zh: v. 促进；提倡 | v. 晋升；提拔 | v. 宣传；推销
definition_en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted | to give someone a higher position at work | to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales
example1_en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
example1_zh: 我们当地的俱乐部通过免费的周末骑行活动推广骑车。
example2_en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过提供营养餐并鼓励学生定期锻炼来倡导更健康的生活方式。
collocations: promote economic growth｜促进经济增长 ; promote awareness｜提高意识 ; be promoted to manager｜获晋升为经理 ; promote a product｜推销产品
tip_zh: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

meanings_zh: n. 管弦乐队
definition_en: A large group of musicians playing different instruments together.
example1_en: The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
example1_zh: 灯光暗下来时，管弦乐队开始演奏。
example2_en: Public funding helps the local orchestra offer affordable concerts and introduce classical music to younger audiences.
example2_zh: 公共资助帮助当地管弦乐队举办票价亲民的音乐会，并向年轻观众介绍古典音乐。
collocations: symphony orchestra｜交响乐团 ; conduct an orchestra｜指挥管弦乐队 ; play in an orchestra｜在管弦乐队演奏
tip_zh: 指整个乐队；成员通常演奏弦乐、管乐及打击乐器。

meanings_zh: n. 管子；管道 | v. 用管道输送 | n. 烟斗
definition_en: A hollow tube that carries liquid or gas. | To carry liquid or gas through pipes. | A small bowl with a tube used for smoking tobacco.
example1_en: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
example1_zh: 水从洗涤槽下面一根破裂的管子里滴下来。
example2_en: Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.
example2_zh: 更换受损水管可以帮助城市节约资源，并确保清洁饮用水的可靠供应。
collocations: water pipe｜水管 ; a burst pipe｜爆裂的管道 ; pipe water to｜用管道把水输送到
tip_zh: pipe可作动词：pipe water to把水输送到某处。

meanings_zh: adv. 真诚地；由衷地
definition_en: In a way that expresses what you genuinely feel.
example1_en: I sincerely hope you feel better very soon.
example1_zh: 我由衷地希望你很快好起来。
example2_en: Organisations should listen sincerely to residents' concerns before introducing changes that affect the local community.
example2_zh: 机构在推行影响当地社区的变革之前，应真诚倾听居民的关切。
collocations: sincerely hope｜由衷希望 ; sincerely apologise｜真诚道歉 ; sincerely believe｜真心相信 ; Yours sincerely｜谨上
tip_zh: 英式书信称呼已知姓名者，结尾常用Yours sincerely。

meanings_zh: v. 剃；刮去毛发 | v. 削去薄片；少量削减 | n. 剃须；刮脸
definition_en: To remove hair from skin using a razor. | To remove thin pieces or reduce something by a small amount. | An act of removing facial hair with a razor.
example1_en: I shave every morning before leaving for work.
example1_zh: 我每天早晨出门上班前都会刮胡子。
example2_en: Improved transport connections could shave several minutes off daily journeys and encourage more people to commute by train.
example2_zh: 改善交通衔接可以缩短几分钟的日常行程，并鼓励更多人乘火车通勤。
collocations: shave your head｜剃光头 ; have a shave｜刮胡子 ; shave time off｜缩短时间
tip_zh: 过去式shaved；过去分词shaved或shaven。

meanings_zh: n. 羔羊；小羊 | n. 羊羔肉
definition_en: a young sheep | meat from a young sheep, eaten as food
example1_en: A small lamb followed its mother across the field.
example1_zh: 一只小羊跟着妈妈穿过田野。
example2_en: Producing lamb requires land and water, so its environmental impact should be considered when planning sustainable diets.
example2_zh: 生产羊羔肉需要土地和水，因此规划可持续饮食时应考虑其环境影响。
collocations: newborn lamb｜新生羔羊 ; roast lamb｜烤羊羔肉 ; lamb chops｜羊排
tip_zh: 词尾b不发音；指小羊可数，指肉不可数。

meanings_zh: phr v. 破门而入；闯入
definition_en: to enter a building by force, usually to steal
example1_en: Someone broke in last night and took the TV.
example1_zh: 昨晚有人闯入偷走了电视。
example2_en: The police caught a man trying to break in.
example2_zh: 警察抓住了一个企图闯入的人。
tip_zh: break in 表示“闯入”；break into 后面接地点。

meanings_zh: n. 桃；桃子 | adj. 桃色的；浅粉橙色的
definition_en: A juicy fruit with fuzzy skin and a large hard stone | Having a pale pinkish orange colour
example1_en: She sliced a ripe peach into her breakfast bowl.
example1_zh: 她把一个熟桃切成片，放进早餐碗里。
example2_en: Peach growers may face reduced harvests when unusually warm winters disrupt the trees' natural flowering cycle.
example2_zh: 冬季异常温暖会扰乱桃树的自然开花周期，桃农可能因此面临减产。
collocations: a ripe peach｜熟桃 ; peach juice｜桃汁 ; a peach tree｜桃树
tip_zh: 桃核英式常说 stone，美式常说 pit。

meanings_zh: n. 庄稼；农作物 | n. 一季的收成 | v. 裁剪；剪短
definition_en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses | the amount of a plant harvested at one time | to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short
example1_en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨过后，农民查看了自己的小麦。
example2_en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
example2_zh: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。
collocations: grow crops｜种植庄稼 ; crop yields｜农作物产量 ; a bumper crop｜大丰收 ; crop a photo｜裁剪照片
tip_zh: crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。

meanings_zh: n. 脏乱；杂乱 | n. 困境；混乱局面 | v. 弄乱；弄糟
definition_en: A dirty or untidy state or collection of things. | A situation full of problems or confusion. | To make something untidy or spoil it, usually with up.
example1_en: The kitchen was a mess after we baked biscuits.
example1_zh: 我们烤完饼干后，厨房一片狼藉。
example2_en: Without clear responsibilities, a community project can quickly become a mess, wasting both time and resources.
example2_zh: 如果职责不清，社区项目很快就可能陷入混乱，既浪费时间又浪费资源。
collocations: make a mess｜弄得一团糟 ; in a mess｜乱七八糟 ; mess up｜弄糟
tip_zh: 常说make a mess；mess up可指弄乱或搞砸。

meanings_zh: adv. 相当；还算 | adv. 通情达理地；合理地 | adv. 价格公道地
definition_en: to a fairly good or satisfactory degree | in a sensible, fair, or logical way | at a fair and affordable price
example1_en: The kitchen is reasonably clean, but the floor needs sweeping.
example1_zh: 厨房还算干净，不过地板需要扫一扫。
example2_en: Public transport must be reasonably priced if cities want more residents to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 如果城市希望更多居民不开车出门，公共交通就必须定价合理。
collocations: reasonably good｜相当不错 ; reasonably priced｜价格公道的 ; reasonably expect｜合理预期
tip_zh: 表示程度时近于 fairly，并非 very。

meanings_zh: v. 去取来；去接来 | v. 售得；卖得
definition_en: To go somewhere and bring someone or something back. | To be sold for a particular amount of money.
example1_en: Could you fetch my jacket from the bedroom?
example1_zh: 你能去卧室把我的夹克拿来吗？
example2_en: Homes near reliable public transport often fetch higher prices because buyers value convenient access to employment.
example2_zh: 公共交通便利可靠的地段，住宅往往售价更高，因为买家重视通勤的便利性。
collocations: fetch some water｜去取些水 ; fetch someone from school｜去学校接某人 ; fetch a high price｜卖个高价
tip_zh: fetch强调去后取回；bring只强调带来。

meanings_zh: v. 结冰；冷冻 | v. 冻结；暂停 | v. 突然僵住
definition_en: To become ice or make something extremely cold and solid. | To stop something changing or being used temporarily. | To stop moving suddenly because of fear or surprise.
example1_en: Freeze the leftover soup and eat it next week.
example1_zh: 把剩下的汤冷冻起来，下周再喝。
example2_en: Governments may freeze public transport fares to reduce financial pressure on households during economic downturns.
example2_zh: 在经济低迷时期，政府可能会冻结公共交通票价，以减轻家庭的经济压力。
collocations: freeze food｜冷冻食物 ; freeze wages｜冻结工资 ; freeze with fear｜吓得僵住
tip_zh: 过去式froze，过去分词frozen。

meanings_zh: n. 海关 | n. 关税 | n. 风俗；习俗
definition_en: The authority or place checking goods entering a country | Taxes charged on goods brought into a country | Traditional practices shared by a community or social group
example1_en: We opened our suitcases for inspection at customs.
example1_zh: 我们在海关打开行李箱接受检查。
example2_en: More efficient customs procedures can reduce delays at borders and support international trade without weakening security.
example2_zh: 更高效的海关程序可以减少边境延误，在不削弱安全保障的情况下促进国际贸易。
collocations: go through customs｜过海关 ; customs officer｜海关官员 ; customs duty｜关税 ; local customs｜当地习俗
tip_zh: 表示海关时保留词尾s；custom单数不表示海关。

meanings_zh: v. 不喜欢；厌恶 | n. 反感；不喜欢
definition_en: To find someone or something unpleasant or not enjoyable. | A feeling of not liking someone or something.
example1_en: I dislike waiting outside when it is raining.
example1_zh: 我不喜欢下雨时在外面等候。
example2_en: Some students dislike group assignments because they feel that individual contributions are not assessed fairly.
example2_zh: 一些学生不喜欢小组作业，因为他们觉得个人贡献没有得到公平评价。
collocations: dislike doing something｜不喜欢做某事 ; a strong dislike of｜对……的强烈反感 ; take a dislike to｜开始讨厌
tip_zh: dislike后接名词或动名词：dislike waiting。

meanings_zh: n. 讲座；大学课堂讲授 | v. 讲课；作讲座 | v. 训斥；说教
definition_en: an educational talk given to an audience, especially university students | to give an educational talk to an audience | to criticize someone at length about their behaviour
example1_en: I stayed after the lecture to ask a question.
example1_zh: 讲座结束后，我留下来问了一个问题。
example2_en: Universities should combine traditional lectures with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge.
example2_zh: 大学应将传统授课与鼓励学生运用知识的实践活动结合起来。
collocations: attend a lecture｜听讲座 ; give a lecture｜作讲座 ; lecture on biology｜讲授生物学 ; lecture someone about｜就某事训斥某人
tip_zh: lecture on讲授某主题；lecture someone可指训斥。

meanings_zh: n. 面试；面谈 | n. 采访；访谈 | v. 面试；采访
definition_en: a meeting to assess someone's suitability for a position | a conversation where someone answers questions for media or research | to ask someone questions for selection, reporting, or research
example1_en: I practised answering questions before my first job interview.
example1_zh: 第一次求职面试前，我练习了如何回答问题。
example2_en: Researchers should interview residents from diverse backgrounds to understand how housing policies affect different social groups.
example2_zh: 研究人员应访谈不同背景的居民，了解住房政策如何影响不同社会群体。
collocations: job interview｜求职面试 ; conduct an interview｜进行面试或访谈 ; interview candidates｜面试候选人 ; an in-depth interview｜深度访谈
tip_zh: interviewer是提问者；interviewee是接受面试或采访者。

meanings_zh: n. 想法；念头 | n. 思考；考虑 | v. 想；认为（过去式）
definition_en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind | the process of thinking carefully about something | past tense and past participle of think
example1_en: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 一个突然冒出的念头让我检查了一下外套口袋。
example2_en: Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.
example2_zh: 城市规划需要仔细考虑公共空间如何服务不同年龄的人群。
collocations: give something some thought｜考虑某事 ; deep in thought｜陷入沉思 ; a sudden thought｜突然冒出的念头 ; food for thought｜引人深思的事物
tip_zh: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 钦佩；敬佩 | v. 欣赏；赞赏
definition_en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements | To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive
example1_en: I admire my sister for staying calm under pressure.
example1_zh: 我钦佩姐姐在压力下依然保持冷静。
example2_en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
example2_zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。
collocations: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人 ; greatly admire｜十分钦佩 ; admire the view｜欣赏风景
tip_zh: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

meanings_zh: n. 状况；状态 | n. 条件；环境 | n. 疾病；健康问题
definition_en: The physical state of someone or something | A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity | A medical problem affecting someone's health
example1_en: Despite its age, this bicycle is in excellent condition.
example1_zh: 这辆自行车虽然年头已久，但状况极佳。
example2_en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
example2_zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。
collocations: in good condition｜状况良好 ; working conditions｜工作条件 ; on condition that｜条件是 ; medical condition｜疾病；健康问题
tip_zh: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

meanings_zh: adv. 大声地；响亮地
definition_en: With a sound that has high volume.
example1_en: Everyone cheered loudly when our team won the match.
example1_zh: 我们队赢得比赛时，大家都大声欢呼。
example2_en: Passengers who speak loudly on public transport can disturb others, particularly during early morning or late evening journeys.
example2_zh: 在公共交通工具上大声说话的乘客会打扰他人，尤其是在清晨或深夜的行程中。
collocations: speak loudly｜大声说话 ; laugh loudly｜放声大笑 ; cheer loudly｜大声欢呼
tip_zh: loudly强调音量大；aloud强调出声而非默读。

meanings_zh: adj. 分开的；各自的 | v. 分开；分离
definition_en: not joined, shared, or considered together | to divide things or move them apart
example1_en: We keep clean towels in a separate cupboard.
example1_zh: 我们把干净毛巾放在一个单独的柜子里。
example2_en: Local authorities should provide separate bins for recyclable materials to make household waste sorting easier.
example2_zh: 地方政府应为可回收材料提供专用垃圾桶，让家庭垃圾分类更方便。
collocations: separate rooms｜分开的房间 ; separate from｜与……分开 ; separate accounts｜独立账户 ; separate waste｜分类垃圾
tip_zh: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词词尾读/eɪt/。

meanings_zh: adj. 纯的；无杂质的 | adj. 纯粹的；完全的 | adj. 纯理论的
definition_en: not mixed with other substances | complete and containing nothing of a different kind | concerned with theory rather than practical uses
example1_en: This soft scarf is made from pure wool.
example1_zh: 这条柔软的围巾是纯羊毛制成的。
example2_en: Investment in pure science can lead to unexpected discoveries with important practical applications decades later.
example2_zh: 对纯理论科学的投资可能带来意想不到的发现，并在几十年后产生重要的实际应用。
collocations: pure water｜纯净水 ; pure wool｜纯羊毛 ; pure chance｜纯属偶然 ; pure mathematics｜纯数学
tip_zh: pure既可指无杂质，也可加强语气，如pure luck。

meanings_zh: n. 重量；体重 | n. 重物；砝码 | n. 重要性；影响力
definition_en: How heavy someone or something is. | A heavy object used for exercise or measuring weight. | The importance or influence given to something.
example1_en: The weight of this suitcase makes it hard to lift.
example1_zh: 这个行李箱太重，很难提起来。
example2_en: Policymakers should give greater weight to scientific evidence when designing strategies to improve public health.
example2_zh: 政策制定者在设计改善公共健康的策略时，应更加重视科学证据。
collocations: lose weight｜减重 ; gain weight｜增重 ; lift weights｜举重训练 ; give weight to｜重视
tip_zh: weight是名词；weigh是动词：How much does it weigh?

meanings_zh: n. 罢工 | v. 击打；撞击 | v. 突然想到；给……印象
definition_en: a refusal to work to demand better employment conditions | hit someone or something with force | occur suddenly to someone or create a strong impression
example1_en: The drivers are on strike, so we walked home.
example1_zh: 司机们正在罢工，所以我们走路回了家。
example2_en: Workers may go on strike when negotiations over pay and working conditions fail.
example2_zh: 当有关薪酬和工作条件的谈判失败时，工人可能会举行罢工。
collocations: go on strike｜举行罢工 ; be on strike｜正在罢工 ; strike a balance｜取得平衡 ; strike someone as unusual｜让某人觉得不寻常
tip_zh: 过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。

meanings_zh: adj. 有天赋的；有才能的
definition_en: Having a natural ability to do something very well.
example1_en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
example1_zh: 我那位有绘画天赋的表亲画了这幅漂亮的花园图。
example2_en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
example2_zh: 学校应为有才华的学生提供机会，让他们在标准课程之外发展自己的能力。
collocations: a talented musician｜有天赋的音乐家 ; a talented artist｜有才华的艺术家 ; highly talented｜极具天赋的
tip_zh: talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

meanings_zh: adj. 嫉妒的 | adj. 因担心失去爱而吃醋的
definition_en: unhappy because someone has something you want | upset because someone you love shows interest in another person
example1_en: I felt jealous when my cousin got a bicycle.
example1_zh: 表弟得到一辆自行车时，我心里很嫉妒。
example2_en: Social media can make users jealous of others whose lives appear more successful or exciting.
example2_zh: 社交媒体可能让用户嫉妒那些生活看起来更成功或更精彩的人。
collocations: jealous of someone｜嫉妒某人 ; feel jealous｜感到嫉妒 ; a jealous partner｜爱吃醋的伴侣
tip_zh: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

meanings_zh: n. 花生；花生米 | n. 极少的钱
definition_en: an edible seed that grows underground inside a thin shell | a very small amount of money, expressed as peanuts
example1_en: She cracked the shell and ate the peanut inside.
example1_zh: 她剥开壳，吃掉了里面的花生米。
example2_en: Schools should consider peanut allergies when planning meals to ensure that all children can eat safely.
example2_zh: 学校安排膳食时应考虑花生过敏问题，确保所有儿童都能安全用餐。
collocations: peanut butter｜花生酱 ; peanut allergy｜花生过敏 ; roasted peanuts｜烤花生 ; work for peanuts｜为微薄报酬工作
tip_zh: 表示“极少的钱”时用复数peanuts，属非正式用法。

meanings_zh: phr. 步行
definition_en: walking, not using transport
example1_en: We went to the station on foot.
example1_zh: 我们步行去车站。
example2_en: The school is close, so I go there on foot.
example2_zh: 学校很近，所以我步行去。
tip_zh: on foot 表示“步行”；go on foot 步行去。

meanings_zh: n. 乘船游览；邮轮旅行 | v. 巡航；悠然行驶
definition_en: a holiday travelling by ship and visiting different places | to travel smoothly at a steady speed
example1_en: We took a cruise around the islands last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘船游览了那些岛屿。
example2_en: The growing popularity of cruise holidays has raised concerns about air pollution in coastal cities.
example2_zh: 邮轮度假日益流行，引发了人们对沿海城市空气污染的担忧。
collocations: go on a cruise｜乘邮轮旅行 ; cruise ship｜邮轮 ; cruise along｜平稳前行
tip_zh: 作名词指一次邮轮旅行时可数：a cruise。

meanings_zh: n. 病人；患者 | adj. 有耐心的；能忍耐的
definition_en: Someone receiving medical care. | Able to wait or handle difficulties without becoming annoyed.
example1_en: The nurse brought the patient a glass of water.
example1_zh: 护士给病人端来了一杯水。
example2_en: Allowing patients to discuss treatment options can improve trust and lead to better health outcomes.
example2_zh: 让患者讨论治疗方案可以增进信任，并改善健康结果。
collocations: treat a patient｜治疗患者 ; patient care｜患者护理 ; be patient with｜对……有耐心
tip_zh: 作名词是“患者”；作形容词常接with。

meanings_zh: n. 登机手续；入住登记
definition_en: the process of registering at an airport or hotel
example1_en: The check-in opened two hours before the flight.
example1_zh: 登机手续在起飞前两小时开始办理。
example2_en: Please go to the check-in desk with your passport.
example2_zh: 请带护照去值机柜台。
tip_zh: check-in 是名词形式；动词形式是 check in。

meanings_zh: n. 机器人；自动机械
definition_en: a machine programmed to perform tasks automatically
example1_en: A small robot cleaned the floor while we ate breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们吃早饭时，一台小机器人清扫了地板。
example2_en: Robots can perform repetitive factory tasks, but workers may need additional training to move into new roles.
example2_zh: 机器人可以执行重复性的工厂任务，但工人可能需要额外培训才能转入新岗位。
collocations: industrial robot｜工业机器人 ; robot arm｜机械臂 ; autonomous robot｜自主机器人
tip_zh: robot是可数名词；robotics指机器人学。

meanings_zh: n. 领导者；带领者 | n. 领先者；领先机构
definition_en: Someone who guides or directs a group of people. | A person or organization ahead of others in a field.
example1_en: Our group leader showed us the safest mountain path.
example1_zh: 我们的领队给我们指明了最安全的山路。
example2_en: Effective leaders encourage employees to share ideas rather than simply follow instructions without question.
example2_zh: 高效的领导者鼓励员工分享想法，而不是毫无疑问地服从指令。
collocations: team leader｜团队负责人 ; political leader｜政治领袖 ; market leader｜市场领先企业 ; leadership skills｜领导技能
tip_zh: leader指领导者；leadership指领导能力或领导层。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的；最重要的 | n. 主管道；干线
definition_en: Most important or largest among others. | A large pipe or cable supplying water, gas, or electricity.
example1_en: The main entrance is beside the little coffee shop.
example1_zh: 正门就在那家小咖啡馆旁边。
example2_en: One main reason for urban migration is the wider range of employment opportunities available in cities.
example2_zh: 人们迁往城市的一个主要原因是城市提供的就业机会更多。
collocations: main reason｜主要原因 ; main entrance｜正门 ; main concern｜主要关切 ; water main｜供水主管道
tip_zh: 形容词通常放在名词前；主要地用mainly。

meanings_zh: n. 拳击（运动）
definition_en: a sport where two people fight with gloved hands
example1_en: He trains in boxing three times a week.
example1_zh: 他每周训练三次拳击。
example2_en: Boxing needs strength and quick reactions.
example2_zh: 拳击需要力量和快速反应。
tip_zh: boxing 是拳击运动；boxer 是拳击手。

meanings_zh: adj. 沉默的；不说话的 | adj. 无声的；寂静的 | adj. 不发音的
definition_en: Not speaking or choosing not to speak. | Making no sound or containing no noise. | Written in a word but not pronounced.
example1_en: He remained silent while his sister explained the problem.
example1_zh: 妹妹解释问题时，他一直没有说话。
example2_en: Employees may remain silent about workplace problems if they fear losing their jobs.
example2_zh: 如果员工担心失去工作，就可能对职场问题保持沉默。
collocations: remain silent｜保持沉默 ; fall silent｜安静下来 ; silent film｜无声电影 ; silent letter｜不发音的字母
tip_zh: silent强调不出声；quiet也可表示声音很小。

meanings_zh: n. 背包旅行
definition_en: travelling with everything you need in a backpack
example1_en: They went backpacking across Europe last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天他们背包游遍了欧洲。
example2_en: Backpacking is a cheap way to see the world.
example2_zh: 背包旅行是看世界的省钱方式。
collocations: go backpacking｜背包旅行
tip_zh: go backpacking 是“去背包旅行”。

meanings_zh: n. 理发师；美发师
definition_en: someone whose job is to cut and style hair
example1_en: The hairdresser trimmed my hair and dried it gently.
example1_zh: 美发师修剪了我的头发，然后轻轻吹干。
example2_en: Training as a hairdresser combines practical skills with customer service, offering a career path outside traditional academic education.
example2_zh: 美发师培训将实操技能与客户服务相结合，提供了传统学术教育之外的职业道路。
collocations: qualified hairdresser｜合格的美发师 ; go to the hairdresser's｜去理发店 ; hairdresser's salon｜美发沙龙
tip_zh: hairdresser指人；the hairdresser's通常指理发店。

meanings_zh: adv. 以某种方式；不知怎么地
definition_en: in some way, though you don't know how
example1_en: Somehow, we found the way back home.
example1_zh: 不知怎么地，我们找到了回家的路。
example2_en: She somehow finished the race despite the pain.
example2_zh: 尽管疼痛，她还是设法完成了比赛。
tip_zh: somehow 表示“以某种方式/不知怎么地”。

meanings_zh: n. 情绪；感受 | n. 知觉；身体感觉 | n. 直觉；看法
definition_en: An emotional state or response to something | A physical sensation or the ability to sense touch | An impression or belief not necessarily supported by evidence
example1_en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
example1_zh: 考试结束后，我顿时感到如释重负。
example2_en: A strong feeling of belonging can improve students' confidence and encourage participation in school activities.
example2_zh: 强烈的归属感可以增强学生的自信，并鼓励他们参与学校活动。
collocations: a feeling of relief｜如释重负的感觉 ; hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情 ; lose feeling｜失去知觉 ; mixed feelings｜复杂的心情
tip_zh: feelings常指感情；have a feeling that表示直觉。

meanings_zh: n. 田径运动
definition_en: sports such as running, jumping and throwing
example1_en: She is good at athletics, especially running.
example1_zh: 她擅长田径，尤其是跑步。
example2_en: The school athletics meeting is next month.
example2_zh: 学校田径运动会下个月举行。
tip_zh: athletics 是田径运动总称；athlete 是运动员。

meanings_zh: adj. 巨大的；极大的
definition_en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree
example1_en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
example1_zh: 一个巨大的南瓜占满了厨房桌上的篮子。
example2_en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
example2_zh: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络及其他基本公共服务带来巨大压力。
collocations: enormous pressure｜巨大压力 ; an enormous amount of｜大量的 ; enormous potential｜巨大潜力
tip_zh: 既可形容体积，也可形容压力、数量或影响很大。

meanings_zh: n. 魔法；魔术 | n. 魅力；奇妙之处 | adj. 有魔力的；魔术的
definition_en: An imaginary supernatural power, or tricks that seem to use it. | A special quality that makes something exciting or wonderful. | Having supernatural powers or used in performing tricks.
example1_en: The children laughed when he performed a magic trick.
example1_zh: 他表演魔术时，孩子们笑了起来。
example2_en: Although technology can improve education, it is not a magic solution to every problem schools face.
example2_zh: 虽然技术能够改善教育，但它不是解决学校所有问题的神奇办法。
collocations: magic trick｜魔术戏法 ; magic wand｜魔杖 ; magic solution｜神奇的解决办法
tip_zh: magic 多指魔法或魔术；magical 也可形容美妙体验。

meanings_zh: n. 安排；筹备 | n. 排列；布置 | n. 商定；协议
definition_en: A plan or preparation for something that will happen. | The way objects are positioned or organised. | An agreement about how something will be done.
example1_en: We made arrangements for someone to feed the cat.
example1_zh: 我们安排了人来喂猫。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents balance professional responsibilities with the demands of family life.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助父母兼顾工作职责与家庭生活的需要。
collocations: make arrangements｜作出安排 ; travel arrangements｜旅行安排 ; flower arrangement｜插花 ; come to an arrangement｜达成协议
tip_zh: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；技巧；手法 | n. 技艺；技术水平
definition_en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill. | The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.
example1_en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
example1_zh: 教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。
example2_en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
example2_zh: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。
collocations: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法 ; relaxation techniques｜放松技巧 ; improve your technique｜提高技艺 ; teaching techniques｜教学方法
tip_zh: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

meanings_zh: n. 大风；强风
definition_en: a very strong wind
example1_en: The gale blew down several trees in the park.
example1_zh: 大风刮倒了公园里的几棵树。
example2_en: Strong gales are expected on the coast tonight.
example2_zh: 预计今晚沿海有大风。
tip_zh: gale 是强风；比 breeze（微风）强得多。

meanings_zh: v. 放置；铺设 | v. 产卵；下蛋 | adj. 非专业的；非神职的
definition_en: to put something down carefully or arrange it flat | to produce eggs from the body | not professionally trained in a subject or ordained in religion
example1_en: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
example1_zh: 请把干净毛巾放在浴室架子上。
example2_en: Investment in early childhood education can lay the foundations for a more skilled and adaptable workforce.
example2_zh: 投资幼儿教育可以为培养技能更强、适应力更高的劳动力奠定基础。
collocations: lay the foundations｜奠定基础 ; lay eggs｜产卵 ; lay the table｜摆好餐具 ; lay cables｜铺设电缆
tip_zh: 放置用lay–laid–laid；躺下用lie–lay–lain。

meanings_zh: n. 出版商；出版社
definition_en: a company or person that publishes books
example1_en: The publisher released the new novel in June.
example1_zh: 出版社六月发行了这部新小说。
example2_en: She sent her story to several publishers.
example2_zh: 她把故事寄给了几家出版社。
tip_zh: publisher 是出版社/出版商。

meanings_zh: n. 退款；退还的金额 | v. 退还款项
definition_en: Money returned after a purchase or an overpayment. | To return money paid for something.
example1_en: The shop gave me a refund for the broken kettle.
example1_zh: 商店把坏水壶的货款退给了我。
example2_en: Airlines should offer passengers a full refund when flights are cancelled without reasonable alternatives.
example2_zh: 航班取消且没有合理的替代方案时，航空公司应向乘客提供全额退款。
collocations: a full refund｜全额退款 ; request a refund｜申请退款 ; refund the cost｜退还费用
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词读/rɪˈfʌnd/，重音在后。

meanings_zh: n. 体操
definition_en: A sport involving controlled movements that develop strength, balance, and flexibility.
example1_en: My sister practises gymnastics at the local sports centre.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在当地体育中心练体操。
example2_en: Including gymnastics in school programmes can help children develop coordination, physical confidence, and an interest in exercise.
example2_zh: 将体操纳入学校课程有助于儿童提高协调性、增强身体自信，并培养运动兴趣。
collocations: do gymnastics｜做体操 ; artistic gymnastics｜竞技体操 ; rhythmic gymnastics｜艺术体操
tip_zh: 虽以-s结尾，表示运动时作单数：gymnastics is。

meanings_zh: n. 更衣室
definition_en: a room where you change clothes, e.g. at a shop or pool
example1_en: Try the dress on in the changing room.
example1_zh: 去更衣室试穿这条裙子。
example2_en: The swimming pool has separate changing rooms.
example2_zh: 游泳池有分开的更衣室。
tip_zh: changing room 是更衣室；商店里试衣服也叫 fitting room。

meanings_zh: n. 智能手机
definition_en: A mobile phone with internet access and computer-like functions.
example1_en: I used my smartphone to photograph the evening sky.
example1_zh: 我用智能手机拍下了傍晚的天空。
example2_en: Although smartphones provide convenient access to information, excessive use may disrupt sleep and reduce concentration.
example2_zh: 虽然智能手机让获取信息更加方便，但过度使用可能干扰睡眠并降低专注力。
collocations: smartphone app｜智能手机应用 ; smartphone user｜智能手机用户 ; smartphone addiction｜智能手机成瘾
tip_zh: smartphone是可数名词，通常写成一个词。

meanings_zh: adj. 精确的；确切的 | v. 强求；索取
definition_en: Correct in every detail, without any difference or error. | Demand and obtain something, often through authority or force.
example1_en: Can you tell me the exact time we should arrive?
example1_zh: 你能告诉我我们应该到达的确切时间吗？
example2_en: Researchers need exact measurements to determine whether changes in air quality are linked to new transport policies.
example2_zh: 研究人员需要精确的测量数据，以判断空气质量变化是否与新的交通政策有关。
collocations: exact location｜确切位置 ; exact amount｜准确数量 ; exact copy｜完全相同的复制品 ; exact a heavy toll｜造成惨重损失
tip_zh: exact强调分毫不差；副词形式为exactly。

meanings_zh: n. 复印件 | v. 复印
definition_en: A paper copy of a document made using a machine. | To make a paper copy of a document using a machine.
example1_en: Please bring a photocopy of your passport tomorrow.
example1_zh: 请明天带一份你的护照复印件来。
example2_en: Students should keep a photocopy of important application documents in case the originals are lost.
example2_zh: 学生应保留重要申请文件的复印件，以防原件丢失。
collocations: make a photocopy｜制作复印件 ; a photocopy of a document｜文件复印件 ; photocopy a form｜复印表格
tip_zh: 既作名词也作动词；复数和三单均为photocopies。

meanings_zh: n. 权力；影响力 | n. 动力；电力 | v. 为…提供动力
definition_en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions. | Energy used to make machines and equipment work. | To supply energy that makes something work.
example1_en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
example1_zh: 经理有权调整我们的班次。
example2_en: Solar panels can power rural schools while reducing their dependence on expensive and unreliable fuel supplies.
example2_zh: 太阳能板可以为乡村学校供电，同时减少其对昂贵且不稳定的燃料供应的依赖。
collocations: political power｜政治权力 ; renewable power｜可再生能源电力 ; power supply｜电源；电力供应 ; the power to decide｜决定权
tip_zh: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

meanings_zh: n. 播客；播客节目 | v. 制作并发布播客
definition_en: An online audio programme available to stream or download. | To produce and distribute an online audio programme.
example1_en: I listen to a cooking podcast while making dinner.
example1_zh: 我做晚饭时会听一档烹饪播客。
example2_en: Educational podcasts allow learners to explore complex subjects while travelling or completing routine household tasks.
example2_zh: 教育类播客让学习者能够在出行或做日常家务时探索复杂的主题。
collocations: listen to a podcast｜收听播客 ; podcast episode｜一期播客 ; host a podcast｜主持播客节目 ; subscribe to a podcast｜订阅播客
tip_zh: 收听播客用listen to a podcast，别漏掉to。

meanings_zh: v. 比较；对比 | v. 把……比作 | v. 比得上；可相比
definition_en: To examine things to find similarities and differences. | To describe something as similar to another thing. | To be as good as, or similar to, something else.
example1_en: We compared several backpacks before choosing the lightest one.
example1_zh: 我们比较了几个背包，最后选了最轻的那个。
example2_en: Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.
example2_zh: 研究人员应比较可再生能源与传统能源的长期成本。
collocations: compare prices｜比较价格 ; compare A with B｜将A与B比较 ; compare A to B｜将A比作B；比较A和B ; compare favourably with｜比起来不逊于
tip_zh: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

meanings_zh: adj. 基础的；初级的 | adj. 小学的
definition_en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning. | Relating to the first years of formal school education.
example1_en: This course teaches elementary cooking skills to complete beginners.
example1_zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技巧。
example2_en: Elementary education should develop children's curiosity as well as their ability to read and calculate.
example2_zh: 小学教育不仅应培养儿童的阅读和计算能力，还应激发他们的好奇心。
collocations: elementary knowledge｜基础知识 ; elementary school｜小学 ; elementary education｜小学教育 ; elementary level｜初级水平
tip_zh: elementary school主要用于美式英语，英式常用primary school。

meanings_zh: adj. 西部的；西方的 | adj. 西方国家及文化的 | n. 西部电影；西部小说
definition_en: In, from, or relating to the west of an area. | Relating to Europe, North America, and their associated cultures. | A film or story about the historical American West.
example1_en: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
example1_zh: 我们的小屋位于湖的西岸，面朝湖水。
example2_en: Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.
example2_zh: 对西部地区的投资可以改善交通联系，减少国内经济差距。
collocations: the western coast｜西海岸 ; western regions｜西部地区 ; Western culture｜西方文化 ; a western film｜西部电影
tip_zh: 指西方国家或文化时常大写为 Western。

meanings_zh: n. 区域；地带 | v. 划定用途区域
definition_en: An area with a particular purpose, feature, or condition. | Officially assign land to a particular use.
example1_en: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
example1_zh: 汽车不得驶入这片安静的步行区。
example2_en: Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.
example2_zh: 只要有价格合理的公共交通，设立低排放区就能减少空气污染。
collocations: a pedestrian zone｜步行区 ; a time zone｜时区 ; a residential zone｜住宅区 ; zone land for housing｜将土地划为住宅用地
tip_zh: zone强调特定用途或特征的区域；area含义更宽泛。

meanings_zh: n. 铁；铁元素 | n. 熨斗 | v. 熨烫
definition_en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body. | A tool with a heated base for smoothing clothes. | To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.
example1_en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
example1_zh: 这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。
example2_en: A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.
example2_zh: 摄入足量铁的饮食有助于预防贫血，对儿童和孕妇尤其重要。
collocations: iron deficiency｜缺铁 ; iron ore｜铁矿石 ; cast iron｜铸铁 ; iron a shirt｜熨衬衫
tip_zh: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。

meanings_zh: adv. 相隔；分开 | adv. 成碎片；散开 | adv. 除外
definition_en: separated by distance or time; not together | into separate pieces | except for something being considered
example1_en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
example1_zh: 我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。
example2_en: Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.
example2_zh: 与家人分开生活可以让留学生更加独立，但也可能带来孤独感。
collocations: far apart｜相距很远 ; take apart｜拆开 ; apart from｜除……之外 ; tell apart｜区分
tip_zh: apart from可指“除外”或“除……还”，需看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 专家；行家 | adj. 专业的；熟练的
definition_en: Someone with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject. | Having or showing great knowledge or skill.
example1_en: We asked an expert to examine the old painting.
example1_zh: 我们请了一位专家来鉴定这幅旧画。
example2_en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
example2_zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。
collocations: an expert on｜某方面的专家 ; expert advice｜专家建议 ; medical expert｜医学专家
tip_zh: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

meanings_zh: adj. 相似的；相像的 | adv. 同样地；两者都
definition_en: similar in appearance or character | in the same way, or equally for both groups
example1_en: These two jackets look alike, but one feels warmer.
example1_zh: 这两件夹克看起来很像，但有一件穿着更暖和。
example2_en: Public parks benefit children and adults alike by providing accessible spaces for exercise and relaxation.
example2_zh: 公共公园提供方便使用的运动和休闲空间，让儿童和成人同样受益。
collocations: look alike｜看起来相像 ; think alike｜想法相同 ; treat everyone alike｜一视同仁
tip_zh: 形容词通常放在系动词后，不放在名词前。

meanings_zh: n. 庆祝活动；庆典 | n. 庆祝
definition_en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion. | The act of showing happiness about something special.
example1_en: We decorated the garden for our grandparents' anniversary celebration.
example1_zh: 我们为祖父母的结婚周年庆祝活动布置了花园。
example2_en: Community celebrations can strengthen social bonds by bringing together residents from different cultural backgrounds.
example2_zh: 社区庆祝活动能让不同文化背景的居民相聚，从而加强社会联系。
collocations: hold a celebration｜举办庆祝活动 ; in celebration of｜为庆祝…… ; birthday celebration｜生日庆祝活动
tip_zh: 指具体庆祝活动时可数；指庆祝行为时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 细节；具体信息 | n. 详尽程度 | v. 详细说明
definition_en: a small fact or feature of something | the amount of specific information provided | to describe something fully, including specific facts
example1_en: Please check every detail before you send the invitation.
example1_zh: 发送邀请前，请核对每一处细节。
example2_en: The report details how improved housing conditions can reduce health inequalities among families in urban areas.
example2_zh: 该报告详细说明了改善住房条件如何减少城市家庭之间的健康差距。
collocations: in detail｜详细地 ; pay attention to detail｜注重细节 ; contact details｜联系方式 ; further details｜更多具体信息
tip_zh: in detail不用复数；联系方式用contact details。

meanings_zh: n. 天赋；才能 | n. 人才；有才能的人
definition_en: A natural ability to do something well. | People who have strong abilities in a particular field.
example1_en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
example1_zh: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。
example2_en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
example2_zh: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。
collocations: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋 ; natural talent｜天生的才能 ; nurture talent｜培养人才 ; attract talent｜吸引人才
tip_zh: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 放松；休息 | n. 肌肉松弛 | n. 规定的放宽
definition_en: Rest or enjoyable activity that reduces stress and tension. | The process of muscles becoming less tight. | The act of making rules or restrictions less strict.
example1_en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
example1_zh: 下班后，我喜欢泡个热水澡放松一下。
example2_en: Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.
example2_zh: 学校应教授放松技巧，帮助学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。
collocations: relaxation techniques｜放松技巧 ; muscle relaxation｜肌肉松弛 ; relaxation of restrictions｜限制的放宽
tip_zh: 表示放松、休息时通常不可数：for relaxation。

meanings_zh: n. 金枪鱼；金枪鱼肉
definition_en: a large sea fish, or its flesh eaten as food
example1_en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
example1_zh: 我今天做了一个金枪鱼三明治当午餐。
example2_en: International cooperation is essential to prevent overfishing and ensure that tuna populations remain healthy for future generations.
example2_zh: 国际合作对于防止过度捕捞、确保金枪鱼种群为后代保持健康至关重要。
collocations: tuna sandwich｜金枪鱼三明治 ; canned tuna｜罐装金枪鱼 ; bluefin tuna｜蓝鳍金枪鱼 ; tuna stocks｜金枪鱼资源量
tip_zh: 指鱼肉时不可数；指鱼时复数通常仍为tuna。

meanings_zh: phr v. 磨损；使精疲力竭
definition_en: to become old from use, or to make someone tired
example1_en: The soles of my shoes are worn out.
example1_zh: 我的鞋底磨破了。
example2_en: The long journey wore us out.
example2_zh: 漫长的旅途让我们精疲力竭。
tip_zh: wear out 表示“磨损”或“使人疲惫”；worn out 是形容词。

meanings_zh: phr v. 收好；放好
