definition_en: to put something in its proper place
example1_en: Put away your toys before dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭前把玩具收好。
example2_en: She put away the clean clothes in the drawers.
example2_zh: 她把干净衣服收进抽屉。
tip_zh: put away 是“收起来放好”。

meanings_zh: v. 慢跑 | n. 慢跑 | v. 轻碰；轻撞
definition_en: To run slowly and steadily, usually for exercise. | A period of slow, steady running. | To knock or push something slightly, often accidentally.
example1_en: We jog around the park before breakfast every morning.
example1_zh: 我们每天早饭前都绕着公园慢跑。
example2_en: People who jog regularly may improve their cardiovascular health without needing expensive equipment or gym memberships.
example2_zh: 经常慢跑的人无需昂贵的器材或健身房会员资格，也能改善心血管健康。
collocations: go for a jog｜去慢跑 ; jog along｜沿着……慢跑 ; jog someone's memory｜唤起某人的记忆
tip_zh: jog someone's memory意为“唤起某人的记忆”。

meanings_zh: n. 超级英雄
definition_en: a hero in stories with special powers
example1_en: The superhero saved the city from danger.
example1_zh: 超级英雄拯救了城市。
example2_en: Children love dressing up as superheroes.
example2_zh: 孩子们喜欢打扮成超级英雄。
tip_zh: superhero 是超级英雄；复数 superheroes。

meanings_zh: n. 小说家
definition_en: A person who writes novels.
example1_en: The novelist spends every morning writing at her kitchen table.
example1_zh: 这位小说家每天上午都在厨房的桌边写作。
example2_en: A skilled novelist can reveal social inequalities through characters whose experiences differ greatly from those of readers.
example2_zh: 技艺娴熟的小说家可以通过经历与读者大不相同的人物，揭示社会不平等。
collocations: historical novelist｜历史小说家 ; bestselling novelist｜畅销小说作家 ; aspiring novelist｜立志成为小说家的人
tip_zh: novelist通常指长篇小说作家，novel是长篇小说。

meanings_zh: adj. 时髦的；有格调的
definition_en: Attractive and fashionable in appearance or design
example1_en: Her stylish green jacket looked great with plain trousers.
example1_zh: 她那件时髦的绿色夹克搭配素色长裤很好看。
example2_en: Affordable, stylish furniture can encourage young consumers to choose recycled materials for their homes.
example2_zh: 价格实惠且设计时尚的家具，可以鼓励年轻消费者为家中选用再生材料。
collocations: stylish clothes｜时髦的衣服 ; a stylish design｜有格调的设计 ; a stylish interior｜雅致的室内空间
tip_zh: stylish强调时尚美观；不等于昂贵或奢华。

meanings_zh: n. 气候变化
definition_en: the long-term change in the earth's weather
example1_en: Climate change is affecting weather around the world.
example1_zh: 气候变化正在影响全世界的天气。
example2_en: Scientists are studying the causes of climate change.
example2_zh: 科学家正在研究气候变化的原因。
tip_zh: climate change 是气候变化的科学术语，常与环保话题相关。

meanings_zh: n. 微波炉 | v. 用微波炉加热或烹调 | n. 微波
definition_en: An electric oven that heats food using electromagnetic waves | To cook or heat food in a microwave oven | A short electromagnetic wave used for heating and communication
example1_en: I heated yesterday's soup in the microwave for lunch.
example1_zh: 我用微波炉热了昨天的汤，当作午餐。
example2_en: Using a microwave to reheat small portions can consume less energy than using a conventional oven.
example2_zh: 用微波炉加热少量食物，比使用普通烤箱可能更节能。
collocations: microwave oven｜微波炉 ; microwave food｜用微波炉加热食物 ; microwave radiation｜微波辐射
tip_zh: 作动词可直接接食物：microwave the soup。

meanings_zh: n. 长笛
definition_en: A wind instrument held sideways and played by blowing across it.
example1_en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
example1_zh: 她每天下午都在卧室窗边练习长笛。
example2_en: Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.
example2_zh: 学习吹长笛可以培养专注力，并鼓励儿童参加合奏团体。
collocations: play the flute｜吹长笛 ; a flute solo｜长笛独奏 ; flute lessons｜长笛课
tip_zh: 英式常称演奏者为flautist，美式常用flutist。

meanings_zh: adj. 宁静的；安详的 | adj. 和平的；非暴力的
definition_en: quiet and calm, without disturbance or worry | not involving war, violence, or fighting
example1_en: The lake looks peaceful in the early morning light.
example1_zh: 晨光中的湖泊显得格外宁静。
example2_en: Creating peaceful public spaces can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage more people to spend time outdoors.
example2_zh: 营造宁静的公共空间可以提升居民的幸福感，并鼓励更多人到户外活动。
collocations: peaceful surroundings｜宁静的周边环境 ; peaceful protest｜和平抗议 ; peaceful solution｜和平解决办法
tip_zh: 可形容环境安静，也可指行动不使用暴力。

meanings_zh: n. 想象力；想象
definition_en: The ability to form mental pictures or invent new ideas.
example1_en: With a little imagination, this box becomes a spaceship.
example1_zh: 只需一点想象力，这个盒子就能变成宇宙飞船。
example2_en: Creative activities encourage children to use their imagination and approach unfamiliar problems from different perspectives.
example2_zh: 创意活动鼓励儿童运用想象力，从不同角度处理陌生的问题。
collocations: use your imagination｜发挥想象力 ; vivid imagination｜丰富的想象力 ; capture the imagination｜引发遐想 ; a figment of the imagination｜凭空想象的事物
tip_zh: imaginative指有想象力的；imaginary指想象中的。

meanings_zh: adj. 不友好的；冷淡的 | adj. 不利的；难以使用的
definition_en: not kind or welcoming towards others | making an activity difficult or causing harm
example1_en: The new neighbour seemed unfriendly but was simply shy.
example1_zh: 新邻居看似冷淡，其实只是害羞。
example2_en: An unfriendly working environment can discourage employees from sharing ideas and seeking support.
example2_zh: 不友好的工作环境可能使员工不愿分享想法或寻求支持。
collocations: unfriendly atmosphere｜冷淡的氛围 ; unfriendly attitude｜不友好的态度 ; environmentally unfriendly｜对环境不利的
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，但通常是形容词，不是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 雷；雷声 | v. 打雷；轰隆作响
definition_en: The loud sound in the sky caused by lightning | Produce thunder or make a similarly loud, deep noise
example1_en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
example1_zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。
example2_en: Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.
example2_zh: 当雷声表明雷暴已逼近到危险距离时，应暂停户外体育赛事。
collocations: a clap of thunder｜一声雷响 ; a rumble of thunder｜低沉的隆隆雷声 ; thunder and lightning｜雷电
tip_zh: thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。

meanings_zh: v. 到达；达到 | v. 伸手；够到 | n. 可及范围；影响范围
definition_en: to arrive at a place or achieve a particular level | to stretch out your arm towards something or touch it | the distance or extent over which something can act
example1_en: We reached the station just before the rain started.
example1_zh: 我们刚到车站，雨就下起来了。
example2_en: Governments must invest in public transport if they hope to reach their targets for reducing urban emissions.
example2_zh: 政府若希望达到减少城市排放的目标，就必须投资公共交通。
collocations: reach a destination｜到达目的地 ; reach an agreement｜达成协议 ; reach for something｜伸手拿某物 ; out of reach｜够不着
tip_zh: 表示到达时直接接地点：reach the station，不加at。

meanings_zh: n. 挑战；艰巨任务 | v. 质疑；提出异议 | v. 向…挑战；考验
definition_en: A difficult task or situation that tests someone's abilities. | Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable. | Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.
example1_en: Cooking dinner for twelve guests was quite a challenge.
example1_zh: 给十二位客人做晚饭真是个不小的挑战。
example2_en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
example2_zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。
collocations: face a challenge｜面临挑战 ; meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战 ; challenge an assumption｜质疑假设 ; challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip_zh: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

meanings_zh: phr. 按顺序；井然有序
definition_en: arranged correctly or neatly
example1_en: Put the books in order on the shelf.
example1_zh: 把书按顺序放在书架上。
example2_en: Everything in the room is in order.
example2_zh: 房间里的一切都井然有序。
tip_zh: in order 是“有序”；out of order 是“故障/混乱”。

meanings_zh: n. 纸巾 | n. 组织
definition_en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping. | A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.
example1_en: She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
example1_zh: 我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张纸巾。
example2_en: Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.
example2_zh: 科学家正在开发新疗法，帮助受损组织在受伤后更有效地修复。
collocations: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾 ; muscle tissue｜肌肉组织 ; damaged tissue｜受损组织 ; tissue repair｜组织修复
tip_zh: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 新娘；准新娘
definition_en: A woman who is getting married or has just married.
example1_en: The bride held fresh flowers as she entered the garden.
example1_zh: 新娘手捧鲜花走进花园。
example2_en: In many cultures, the bride and her family share responsibility for organising the wedding celebration.
example2_zh: 在许多文化中，新娘及其家人共同负责筹办婚礼庆典。
collocations: bride and groom｜新娘与新郎 ; a beautiful bride｜美丽的新娘 ; a bride-to-be｜准新娘
tip_zh: bride指新娘，groom指新郎。

meanings_zh: adj. 困惑的；糊涂的 | adj. 混乱的；难懂的
definition_en: unable to understand something or think clearly | unclear or difficult to follow because of poor organisation
example1_en: I felt confused when both doors led outside.
example1_zh: 两扇门都通向外面，让我感到困惑。
example2_en: Students may become confused if teachers introduce too many unfamiliar concepts in a single lesson.
example2_zh: 如果教师在一堂课中引入太多陌生概念，学生可能会感到困惑。
collocations: confused about｜对……感到困惑 ; look confused｜显得困惑 ; a confused account｜混乱的叙述
tip_zh: confused形容人困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

meanings_zh: n. 骑手；骑马者
definition_en: a person who rides a horse or bike
example1_en: The rider fell off the horse but was not hurt.
example1_zh: 骑手从马上摔下来但没有受伤。
example2_en: A bicycle rider passed us quickly.
example2_zh: 一个骑自行车的人很快超过我们。
tip_zh: rider 是骑手（骑马/骑自行车）。

meanings_zh: adv. 很少；难得
definition_en: Not often; on very few occasions.
example1_en: We rarely eat outside when the weather turns cold.
example1_zh: 天气转冷时，我们很少在户外吃饭。
example2_en: People living in remote villages rarely have easy access to specialist medical services.
example2_zh: 住在偏远村庄的人很少能方便地获得专科医疗服务。
collocations: rarely ever｜极少 ; rarely seen｜罕见的 ; rarely used｜很少使用的
tip_zh: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；本身有否定意味。

meanings_zh: adj. 全新的
definition_en: completely new
example1_en: He bought a brand new bicycle.
example1_zh: 他买了一辆全新的自行车。
example2_en: The brand new school opens next week.
example2_zh: 这所崭新的学校下周开学。
tip_zh: brand new 强调“崭新”，比 new 语气更强。

meanings_zh: n. 预约；预订 | n. 疑虑；保留意见
definition_en: An arrangement to keep a room, seat, or table available. | A doubt that prevents complete acceptance of something.
example1_en: I made a reservation for dinner by the window.
example1_zh: 我预订了一个靠窗的位置吃晚饭。
example2_en: Some residents expressed reservations about the proposed airport expansion because of increased noise pollution.
example2_zh: 一些居民担心噪声污染加剧，对拟议中的机场扩建持保留意见。
collocations: make a reservation｜预订 ; cancel a reservation｜取消预订 ; have reservations about｜对……有疑虑 ; without reservation｜毫无保留地
tip_zh: 表示疑虑常用复数：have reservations about。

meanings_zh: n. 最低限度；最小量 | adj. 最低的；最小的
definition_en: The smallest amount or level possible or allowed. | Being the smallest amount or level possible or allowed.
example1_en: Please keep the noise to a minimum tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚请尽量保持安静。
example2_en: A higher minimum wage may improve living standards for workers in low-paid service jobs.
example2_zh: 提高最低工资可能改善低薪服务业劳动者的生活水平。
collocations: a minimum of｜至少 ; keep something to a minimum｜将某事物减至最低程度 ; minimum wage｜最低工资 ; minimum requirements｜最低要求
tip_zh: a minimum of 后接数量，表示“至少”。

meanings_zh: n. 平底锅；烤盘 | v. 严厉批评 | v. 摇摄；转动镜头
definition_en: a metal container used for cooking or baking food | to criticize a performance, book, or film very harshly | to turn a camera slowly across a scene
example1_en: Heat the oil in a pan before adding onions.
example1_zh: 先把锅里的油烧热，再放入洋葱。
example2_en: Television chefs can encourage healthier eating by demonstrating how to prepare nutritious meals using a single pan.
example2_zh: 电视厨师可以通过演示如何用一口锅烹制营养餐，来鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: frying pan｜煎锅 ; baking pan｜烤盘 ; be panned by critics｜受到评论家的严厉批评 ; pan across a scene｜摇摄整个场景
tip_zh: 作动词时过去式为panned，现在分词为panning。

meanings_zh: n. 一步；台阶 | n. 步骤；措施 | v. 迈步；踏；踩
definition_en: a foot movement when walking, or a stair surface | one action in a process or towards a goal | to move by lifting and placing your foot
example1_en: Take one step forward and close the door.
example1_zh: 向前迈一步，把门关上。
example2_en: Improving public transport is an important step towards reducing traffic congestion and air pollution in cities.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通是减少城市交通拥堵和空气污染的重要一步。
collocations: take a step｜迈一步；采取措施 ; step by step｜逐步地 ; take steps to｜采取措施以 ; step on｜踩到
tip_zh: take steps to do sth表示“采取措施做某事”。

meanings_zh: n. 公告；宣布
definition_en: a public statement giving people information or news
example1_en: We heard an announcement about our train being delayed.
example1_zh: 我们听到了一则关于所乘列车晚点的通知。
example2_en: The government's announcement of additional education funding was welcomed by teachers and parents.
example2_zh: 政府宣布追加教育经费，受到教师和家长的欢迎。
collocations: make an announcement｜发布公告 ; official announcement｜官方公告 ; public announcement｜公开声明
tip_zh: 表示发布公告时用make an announcement。

meanings_zh: n. 运河；人工水渠 | n. 身体内的管道
definition_en: an artificial waterway for boats or carrying water | a narrow passage inside the body
example1_en: We watched a narrow boat glide along the canal.
example1_zh: 我们看着一艘窄船沿运河缓缓驶过。
example2_en: Restoring historic canals can attract tourists while providing valuable habitats for wildlife in densely populated urban areas.
example2_zh: 修复历史悠久的运河既能吸引游客，也能为人口密集城区的野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: irrigation canal｜灌溉水渠 ; canal boat｜运河船 ; ear canal｜耳道
tip_zh: canal通常为人工水道；river指天然河流。

meanings_zh: n. 双胞胎之一 | adj. 成对的；双胞胎的
definition_en: One of two children born to the same mother together. | Forming a matching pair, or relating to twins.
example1_en: My twin and I share a love of swimming.
example1_zh: 我的双胞胎手足和我都喜欢游泳。
example2_en: Studies involving identical twins help researchers understand how genes and environment influence human development.
example2_zh: 涉及同卵双胞胎的研究有助于研究人员了解基因和环境如何影响人的发育。
collocations: identical twins｜同卵双胞胎 ; twin sister｜双胞胎姐妹 ; twin beds｜两张单人床
tip_zh: a twin指双胞胎中的一人；twins指两人。

meanings_zh: adv. 几乎不；几乎没有 | adv. 刚刚；才
definition_en: almost not, or only to a very small degree | only just, before something else happens
example1_en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
example1_zh: 雨声太大，我几乎听不见你说话。
example2_en: Expanding roads alone is hardly sufficient to solve traffic congestion without improvements to public transport.
example2_zh: 如果不改善公共交通，仅靠拓宽道路几乎不足以解决交通拥堵。
collocations: hardly ever｜几乎从不 ; hardly any｜几乎没有 ; can hardly wait｜迫不及待 ; hardly surprising｜不足为奇
tip_zh: hardly意为几乎不，并非hard的副词形式。

meanings_zh: n. 乡间小屋；村舍
definition_en: A small house, usually in the countryside.
example1_en: Their cottage has a tiny garden full of roses.
example1_zh: 他们的乡间小屋有一个种满玫瑰的小花园。
example2_en: Converting an unused cottage into holiday accommodation can provide rural families with an additional source of income.
example2_zh: 将闲置的村舍改为度假住宿，可以为农村家庭增加一项收入来源。
collocations: a country cottage｜乡间小屋 ; a thatched cottage｜茅草顶村舍 ; a holiday cottage｜度假小屋
tip_zh: 通常指乡间小住宅，不等同于豪华的villa。

meanings_zh: adj. 喜欢的；喜爱的 | adj. 深情的；温情的
definition_en: having a liking or affection for someone or something | showing or expressing warmth and affection
example1_en: My grandmother is fond of walking by the river.
example1_zh: 我奶奶喜欢在河边散步。
example2_en: Many adults retain fond memories of teachers who encouraged their curiosity and supported their ambitions.
example2_zh: 许多成年人仍深情地记得那些激发他们好奇心、支持他们志向的老师。
collocations: be fond of｜喜欢 ; fond memories｜温馨的回忆 ; a fond farewell｜深情的告别
tip_zh: be fond of后接名词或动词-ing，不接to do。

meanings_zh: v. 争吵；争论 | v. 论证；主张
definition_en: To disagree with someone, often in an angry way. | To give reasons supporting an opinion or position.
example1_en: The children argued about whose turn it was to play.
example1_zh: 孩子们为轮到谁玩而争吵。
example2_en: Some researchers argue that affordable public transport is essential for reducing inequality in large cities.
example2_zh: 一些研究者认为，价格可负担的公共交通对于减少大城市中的不平等至关重要。
collocations: argue with someone｜与某人争论 ; argue about something｜就某事争论 ; argue that｜主张…… ; argue for｜据理支持
tip_zh: argue that常用于议论文，表示提出有理由的主张。

meanings_zh: n. 困难；费力 | n. 难题；困境
definition_en: The state of being hard to do or understand. | A problem that makes progress or success harder.
example1_en: I had difficulty opening the jar with wet hands.
example1_zh: 我手湿着，很难打开那个罐子。
example2_en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
example2_zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。
collocations: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难 ; overcome difficulties｜克服困难 ; financial difficulties｜经济困难 ; with difficulty｜费力地
tip_zh: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

meanings_zh: n. 行为；举止 | n. 运行方式；反应特性
definition_en: The way a person or animal acts. | The way something functions or reacts under particular conditions.
example1_en: The puppy's calm behaviour surprised everyone at the park.
example1_zh: 小狗温顺的表现让公园里的每个人都感到意外。
example2_en: Schools can encourage positive behaviour by establishing clear expectations and recognising students' efforts to cooperate.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过明确要求并肯定学生的合作努力，鼓励良好行为。
collocations: good behaviour｜良好行为 ; consumer behaviour｜消费者行为 ; animal behaviour｜动物行为 ; behaviour patterns｜行为模式
tip_zh: 通常不可数；英式拼写behaviour，美式拼写behavior。

meanings_zh: n. 传记
definition_en: a written account of someone's life by another person
example1_en: I'm reading a biography of an explorer before bed.
example1_zh: 我睡前正在读一本探险家的传记。
example2_en: A well-researched biography can reveal how social conditions influence an individual's choices and achievements.
example2_zh: 一本研究扎实的传记可以揭示社会条件如何影响个人的选择与成就。
collocations: write a biography｜写传记 ; a biography of someone｜某人的传记 ; an authorised biography｜经本人授权的传记
tip_zh: biography是他人为某人写的传记；自传用autobiography。

meanings_zh: phr v. 扑灭；熄灭
definition_en: to stop a fire or light burning
example1_en: The firemen put out the fire quickly.
example1_zh: 消防员很快扑灭了大火。
example2_en: Please put out the candle before you sleep.
example2_zh: 睡前请吹灭蜡烛。
tip_zh: put out 表示“扑灭（火）、熄灭（灯）”。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；办法 | n. 条理；系统性
definition_en: A particular way of doing something. | An organized and systematic approach to an activity.
example1_en: This method keeps my herbs fresh for several days.
example1_zh: 这个方法能让我的香草保鲜好几天。
example2_en: Teachers should adapt their teaching methods to meet the varied needs of students in mixed-ability classrooms.
example2_zh: 教师应调整教学方法，以满足能力水平不同的学生的多样化需求。
collocations: teaching method｜教学方法 ; research method｜研究方法 ; method of payment｜付款方式 ; effective method｜有效方法
tip_zh: 常用a method of/for doing sth表示做事的方法。

meanings_zh: phr v. 最终处于；以…告终
definition_en: to finally be in a situation or place
example1_en: We got lost and ended up at the beach.
example1_zh: 我们迷路了，最后到了海滩。
example2_en: He studied hard and ended up with a good job.
example2_zh: 他努力学习，最后得到了一份好工作。
tip_zh: end up 表示“最终落得/到达某状态”，后接介词短语或动名词。

meanings_zh: phr. 同时
definition_en: at one moment together; at once
example1_en: The two trains arrived at the station at the same time.
example1_zh: 两列火车同时到达车站。
example2_en: She can study and listen to music at the same time.
example2_zh: 她能同时学习和听音乐。
tip_zh: at the same time 表示“同时发生”。

meanings_zh: phr v. 屈服；让步；上交
definition_en: to stop fighting and accept, or to hand in
example1_en: He refused to give in and kept trying.
example1_zh: 他拒绝放弃，继续尝试。
example2_en: Please give in your homework by Friday.
example2_zh: 请周五前交作业。
tip_zh: give in 表示“屈服/让步”；英式也指“交作业”。

meanings_zh: n. 网络；关系网 | n. 广播网；电视网 | v. 建立人脉
definition_en: A system of connected people, things or places. | A group of broadcasting stations sharing programmes. | To meet people and develop useful professional relationships.
example1_en: Our home network connects three laptops and a printer.
example1_zh: 我们的家庭网络连接着三台笔记本电脑和一台打印机。
example2_en: An efficient public transport network can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 高效的公共交通网络可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地前往工作地点。
collocations: transport network｜交通网络 ; wireless network｜无线网络 ; support network｜支持网络 ; network with colleagues｜与同行建立联系
tip_zh: network强调多个节点之间相互连接。

meanings_zh: v. 含有；容纳 | v. 控制；遏制
definition_en: to have something inside or as a part | to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger
example1_en: This small box contains all my sewing supplies.
example1_zh: 这个小盒子里装着我所有的缝纫用品。
example2_en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
example2_zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。
collocations: contain ingredients｜含有成分 ; contain the spread｜遏制蔓延 ; contain costs｜控制成本 ; contain your excitement｜抑制兴奋
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓掌；拍手 | n. 拍手声；响亮的短促声
definition_en: To strike your hands together, often to show approval. | A sudden loud sound, especially from hands striking together.
example1_en: Everyone clapped when the children finished their song.
example1_zh: 孩子们唱完歌时，大家都鼓起掌来。
example2_en: Audiences often clap after live performances to express appreciation for the skill and effort of the artists.
example2_zh: 现场演出结束后，观众常常鼓掌，以表达对艺术家技艺和付出的赞赏。
collocations: clap your hands｜拍手 ; clap along｜跟着节奏拍手 ; a clap of thunder｜一声霹雳
tip_zh: 过去式clapped；现在分词clapping，双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 信纸；便条纸
definition_en: paper used for writing letters or short messages
example1_en: She took some notepaper from the desk drawer.
example1_zh: 她从书桌抽屉里拿出了一些便条纸。
example2_en: Providing recycled notepaper in offices is a simple measure that can support more sustainable purchasing practices.
example2_zh: 在办公室提供再生便条纸，是支持更可持续采购方式的一项简单措施。
collocations: a sheet of notepaper｜一张信纸 ; a pad of notepaper｜一本便条纸 ; personal notepaper｜私人信纸
tip_zh: 不可数名词；一张用a sheet of notepaper。

meanings_zh: adv. 向后；朝后 | adv. 倒序地；逆向地
definition_en: Towards the back, or with the back facing forwards. | In the opposite order or direction to the usual one.
example1_en: She stepped backwards to let the cyclist pass.
example1_zh: 她向后退了一步，让骑车的人过去。
example2_en: Researchers can work backwards from current pollution levels to identify the likely sources of environmental damage.
example2_zh: 研究人员可以根据当前污染水平反向追溯，找出环境破坏的可能来源。
collocations: walk backwards｜倒着走 ; backwards and forwards｜来回 ; work backwards｜反向推导
tip_zh: backwards是副词；修饰名词通常用backward。

meanings_zh: adj. 免关税的 | adv. 免关税地
definition_en: Sold without certain taxes, especially to international travellers. | Without paying certain taxes on goods.
example1_en: She bought some duty-free perfume before boarding her flight.
example1_zh: 登机前，她买了一些免税香水。
example2_en: Duty-free shopping can generate substantial revenue for airports, although travellers may not always find the lowest prices.
example2_zh: 免税购物能为机场带来可观收入，但旅客未必总能买到价格最低的商品。
collocations: duty-free shop｜免税店 ; duty-free goods｜免税商品 ; duty-free allowance｜免税额度
tip_zh: duty此处指关税；免税商品仍受入境额度限制。

meanings_zh: n. 宗教；宗教信仰
definition_en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices
example1_en: We learned about different religions at school today.
example1_zh: 今天我们在学校了解了不同的宗教。
example2_en: Schools can teach students about religion while encouraging respect for people with different beliefs.
example2_zh: 学校可以教授宗教知识，同时鼓励学生尊重持不同信仰的人。
collocations: freedom of religion｜宗教自由 ; organised religion｜制度化宗教 ; religious beliefs｜宗教信仰
tip_zh: 泛指宗教时不可数；指某一种宗教时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 讨论；商讨 | n. 论述；探讨
definition_en: An exchange of ideas or opinions about a subject. | A detailed examination of a subject in speech or writing.
example1_en: We had a lively discussion about our holiday plans.
example1_zh: 我们热烈讨论了度假计划。
example2_en: Public discussion of transport policy can help governments design services that better meet residents' needs.
example2_zh: 对交通政策的公开讨论可以帮助政府设计更符合居民需求的服务。
collocations: have a discussion｜进行讨论 ; group discussion｜小组讨论 ; under discussion｜在讨论中 ; in-depth discussion｜深入探讨
tip_zh: 名词可接about或of；动词discuss后直接接话题。

meanings_zh: n. 婚礼
definition_en: A ceremony in which two people get married.
example1_en: Their wedding took place in a small garden.
example1_zh: 他们的婚礼在一个小花园里举行。
example2_en: Wedding traditions often reflect cultural values, although many couples now choose simpler and less expensive celebrations.
example2_zh: 婚礼习俗往往反映文化价值观，不过如今许多新人选择更简单、费用更低的庆祝方式。
collocations: wedding ceremony｜婚礼仪式 ; wedding reception｜婚宴 ; wedding anniversary｜结婚纪念日 ; attend a wedding｜参加婚礼
tip_zh: wedding指婚礼；marriage指婚姻关系。

meanings_zh: adv. 稍微；略微
definition_en: by a small amount or to a small degree
example1_en: Please open the window slightly; it feels warm.
example1_zh: 请把窗户稍微打开一点，感觉有些热。
example2_en: Although average incomes rose slightly, many households continued to struggle with higher food and energy costs.
example2_zh: 尽管平均收入略有上升，许多家庭仍难以应付不断上涨的食品和能源费用。
collocations: slightly higher｜略高 ; slightly different｜略有不同 ; slightly more｜稍多一些
tip_zh: 可修饰形容词、比较级或动词，如slightly higher。

meanings_zh: n. 发现；被发现的事物
definition_en: finding something previously unknown, or the thing that is found
example1_en: We made an exciting discovery behind the old cupboard.
example1_zh: 我们在旧橱柜后有了一个令人兴奋的发现。
example2_en: The discovery of new antibiotics could help health services respond more effectively to drug-resistant infections.
example2_zh: 新抗生素的发现有助于医疗机构更有效地应对耐药性感染。
collocations: make a discovery｜有所发现 ; scientific discovery｜科学发现 ; major discovery｜重大发现 ; accidental discovery｜意外发现
tip_zh: discovery是发现原已存在的事物，不同于invention。

meanings_zh: n. 退休
definition_en: the time when you stop working because of age
example1_en: My grandfather enjoys gardening after retirement.
example1_zh: 爷爷退休后喜欢园艺。
example2_en: She is planning for her retirement.
example2_zh: 她正在规划退休生活。
tip_zh: retirement 是“退休”；retired 是“退休的”。

meanings_zh: n. 娱乐；娱乐活动
definition_en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.
example1_en: The hotel provides live entertainment beside the pool every evening.
example1_zh: 酒店每晚都在泳池边提供现场娱乐表演。
example2_en: Affordable entertainment facilities can improve urban life by giving residents opportunities to relax and socialise.
example2_zh: 价格亲民的娱乐设施能让居民有机会放松和社交，从而改善城市生活。
collocations: live entertainment｜现场娱乐表演 ; the entertainment industry｜娱乐业 ; family entertainment｜适合全家的娱乐 ; a form of entertainment｜一种娱乐形式
tip_zh: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。

meanings_zh: v. 想知道；琢磨 | n. 惊叹；惊奇 | n. 奇观；奇迹
definition_en: to think about something you do not know | a feeling of surprise and admiration | something unusually impressive or surprising
example1_en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
example1_zh: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。
example2_en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
example2_zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。
collocations: wonder whether｜想知道是否 ; wonder about｜对……感到好奇 ; in wonder｜惊叹地 ; natural wonders｜自然奇观
tip_zh: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。

meanings_zh: n. 添加；增加 | n. 加法 | n. 新增事物
definition_en: the act of putting something extra into something | the process of finding the total of quantities | something extra that joins an existing group or collection
example1_en: The addition of fresh lemon made the soup delicious.
example1_zh: 加入新鲜柠檬后，汤变得十分美味。
example2_en: The addition of cycle lanes can make urban transport safer and encourage residents to exercise regularly.
example2_zh: 增设自行车道可以提高城市交通的安全性，并鼓励居民经常锻炼。
collocations: in addition to｜除……之外还 ; the addition of｜……的添加 ; a welcome addition｜受欢迎的新事物 ; simple addition｜简单加法
tip_zh: in addition作连接语；in addition to后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 布满灰尘的；多尘的
definition_en: Covered with dust or containing a lot of dust.
example1_en: I wiped the dusty shelf with a damp cloth.
example1_zh: 我用湿布擦了擦落满灰尘的架子。
example2_en: Workers in dusty environments need appropriate protective equipment to reduce their risk of developing respiratory diseases.
example2_zh: 在多尘环境中工作的人员需要适当的防护装备，以降低患呼吸系统疾病的风险。
collocations: a dusty road｜尘土飞扬的道路 ; dusty shelves｜积满灰尘的架子 ; a dusty environment｜多尘的环境
tip_zh: dusty形容有灰尘；dust作动词可表示掸去灰尘。

meanings_zh: n. 例子；事例；情况
definition_en: A particular example or occurrence of something.
example1_en: Some fruits freeze well; berries, for instance, keep their flavour.
example1_zh: 有些水果适合冷冻，比如浆果就能保留风味。
example2_en: This project provides an instance of successful cooperation between local businesses and environmental research groups.
example2_zh: 这个项目提供了当地企业与环境研究团体成功合作的实例。
collocations: for instance｜例如 ; in this instance｜在这种情况下 ; an isolated instance｜个别事例
tip_zh: for instance意为“例如”，作用类似for example。

meanings_zh: adj. 结冰的；冻硬的 | adj. 冷冻保存的 | adj. 冻僵的；冷极了的
definition_en: Turned into ice or made hard by extreme cold. | Kept at very low temperatures to preserve freshness. | Feeling extremely cold.
example1_en: A frozen puddle cracked beneath my boot this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，一处结冰的水洼被我的靴子踩裂了。
example2_en: Frozen vegetables can help households reduce food waste because they remain usable much longer than fresh produce.
example2_zh: 冷冻蔬菜的保存时间比新鲜农产品长得多，因此可以帮助家庭减少食物浪费。
collocations: frozen lake｜结冰的湖 ; frozen food｜冷冻食品 ; frozen solid｜冻得硬邦邦的 ; frozen with fear｜吓得动弹不得
tip_zh: 也是freeze的过去分词；过去式为froze。

meanings_zh: v. 通知；告知 | v. 影响；为……提供依据
definition_en: To give someone facts or tell them about something. | To provide knowledge that shapes a decision, opinion, or approach.
example1_en: Please inform the receptionist if you lose your key.
example1_zh: 如果你弄丢了钥匙，请告知接待员。
example2_en: Reliable research should inform government decisions about how to allocate funding for public health services.
example2_zh: 政府决定如何分配公共卫生服务资金时，应以可靠的研究为依据。
collocations: inform someone of something｜告知某人某事 ; keep someone informed｜随时告知某人最新情况 ; inform policy｜为政策提供依据
tip_zh: 告知某人某事用inform sb of/about sth。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人满意的；合格的
definition_en: Good enough to meet a particular need or standard
example1_en: The mechanic confirmed that the brakes were satisfactory.
example1_zh: 修理工确认刹车状况合格。
example2_en: Providing satisfactory public transport is essential if cities want residents to rely less on private cars.
example2_zh: 城市若希望居民减少对私家车的依赖，就必须提供令人满意的公共交通服务。
collocations: satisfactory results｜令人满意的结果 ; satisfactory explanation｜令人满意的解释 ; satisfactory progress｜符合预期的进展
tip_zh: 强调达到要求，不一定出色；人的满意感用satisfied。

meanings_zh: v. 雇用 | v. 租用 | n. 租用；租借
definition_en: To pay someone to do a job. | To pay to use something for a limited time. | An arrangement to use something temporarily in exchange for payment.
example1_en: We hired a van to move our furniture.
example1_zh: 我们租了一辆货车来搬家具。
example2_en: Businesses that hire local workers can strengthen regional economies and reduce the need for long commutes.
example2_zh: 雇用当地员工的企业可以增强区域经济，并减少长途通勤的需要。
collocations: hire staff｜雇用员工 ; hire a car｜租车 ; for hire｜供出租 ; car hire｜汽车租赁
tip_zh: 租车英式常用hire，美式常用rent。

meanings_zh: adj. 失业的
definition_en: Without a paid job but available for work
example1_en: My neighbour has been unemployed since the factory closed.
example1_zh: 自从工厂关闭后，我的邻居就一直失业。
example2_en: Providing affordable training for unemployed adults can help them develop skills that match changing labour market demands.
example2_zh: 为失业成年人提供负担得起的培训，可以帮助他们掌握符合劳动力市场变化需求的技能。
collocations: become unemployed｜失业 ; unemployed workers｜失业工人 ; the long-term unemployed｜长期失业者
tip_zh: the unemployed指失业者群体，谓语用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 积极乐观的；有益的 | adj. 确信的；肯定的 | adj. 阳性的；正数的
definition_en: Hopeful, confident, or producing a good effect. | Completely certain that something is true. | Showing a condition is present, or mathematically greater than zero.
example1_en: She stayed positive even when rain spoiled our picnic.
example1_zh: 即使下雨毁了我们的野餐，她仍然保持乐观。
example2_en: Regular contact with nature can have a positive effect on children's emotional development and overall wellbeing.
example2_zh: 经常接触大自然可以对儿童的情绪发展和整体健康产生积极影响。
collocations: positive attitude｜积极的态度 ; positive impact｜积极影响 ; positive result｜阳性结果；良好结果
tip_zh: 检测结果positive指阳性，不一定是好消息。

meanings_zh: v. 分开；分配 | v. 除；除以 | n. 分歧；差距
definition_en: to separate something into parts or share it among people | to calculate how many times one quantity fits into another | a major difference separating people or groups
example1_en: Let's divide the cake into slices before everyone arrives.
example1_zh: 趁大家还没来，我们先把蛋糕切成小块吧。
example2_en: Unequal access to reliable internet services can deepen the digital divide between urban and rural communities.
example2_zh: 获得可靠互联网服务的机会不均，可能加深城乡社区之间的数字鸿沟。
collocations: divide into groups｜分成小组 ; divide equally｜平均分配 ; divide by｜除以 ; the digital divide｜数字鸿沟
tip_zh: divide into表示分成；divide by表示除以。

meanings_zh: v. 认出；辨认出 | v. 承认；意识到 | v. 正式认可；表彰
definition_en: to identify someone or something known from before | to accept or understand that something is true or important | to officially accept something or honour someone's achievements
example1_en: I recognised your brother immediately, despite his new haircut.
example1_zh: 虽然你哥哥换了发型，我还是立刻认出了他。
example2_en: Schools increasingly recognise that regular physical activity can improve both students' health and academic performance.
example2_zh: 学校日益认识到，经常运动能够改善学生的健康状况和学习表现。
collocations: recognise a face｜认出一张脸 ; recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性 ; officially recognise｜正式认可
tip_zh: recognise 常见于英式英语；美式多用 recognize。

meanings_zh: adj. 上面的；上部的 | adj. 较高的；上层的
definition_en: Located above another part or nearer the top. | Higher in rank, level, or position within a range.
example1_en: Keep the spare blankets on the upper shelf.
example1_zh: 把备用毯子放在上层架子上。
example2_en: Residents on the upper floors of apartment buildings may face difficulties when lifts stop working.
example2_zh: 公寓楼高层住户在电梯停运时可能会遇到困难。
collocations: upper floor｜楼上层 ; upper body｜上半身 ; upper limit｜上限 ; upper class｜上层阶级
tip_zh: 通常放在名词前，如upper floor；反义词是lower。

meanings_zh: n. 车费；船费；机票费 | v. 进展；过得 | n. 饭菜；饮食
definition_en: The money paid for a journey on public transport. | To perform or experience a particular level of success. | Food of a particular kind served in a place.
example1_en: I had just enough coins for the bus fare.
example1_zh: 我的硬币刚好够付公交车费。
example2_en: Reducing train fares could encourage commuters to leave their cars at home and use public transport.
example2_zh: 降低火车票价可以鼓励通勤者不开车，改用公共交通。
collocations: bus fare｜公交车费 ; fare increase｜票价上涨 ; fare well｜表现良好 ; traditional fare｜传统饭菜
tip_zh: fare是交通票价；fee多指服务费或学费。

meanings_zh: adj. 价值……的 | adj. 值得的 | n. 价值；作用
definition_en: Having a particular value in money. | Deserving the time, effort, or money something requires. | The value, importance, or usefulness of something.
example1_en: This old bicycle is still worth fifty pounds.
example1_zh: 这辆旧自行车仍然值五十英镑。
example2_en: Investing in public transport is worth the initial expense because it can reduce congestion and pollution.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通值得付出前期费用，因为这能减少拥堵和污染。
collocations: be worth doing｜值得做 ; be worth the effort｜值得付出努力 ; prove your worth｜证明自己的价值
tip_zh: 表示值得做用be worth doing，不用worth to do。

meanings_zh: n. 很久（口语）；年龄（复数）
definition_en: a very long time (informal)
example1_en: I haven't seen you for ages!
example1_zh: 我好久没见你了！
example2_en: It took ages to finish the homework.
example2_zh: 做完作业花了很久。
collocations: for ages｜很久
tip_zh: for ages 是口语“很长时间”，用于夸张表达。

meanings_zh: n. 衣领 | n. 动物颈圈 | v. 抓住；拦住
definition_en: The part of a garment that surrounds the neck. | A band worn around an animal's neck. | To catch or stop someone, often to speak to them.
example1_en: He straightened his shirt collar before the interview.
example1_zh: 面试前，他整理了一下衬衫衣领。
example2_en: A well-fitted collar allows owners to attach a lead and keep dogs under control in public spaces.
example2_zh: 合适的颈圈方便主人系上牵引绳，在公共场所管好狗。
collocations: shirt collar｜衬衫领子 ; dog collar｜狗颈圈 ; a stiff collar｜硬衣领 ; turn up your collar｜竖起衣领
tip_zh: white-collar指白领的；blue-collar指蓝领的。

meanings_zh: v. 折叠；对折 | n. 褶；折痕 | v. 倒闭；停业
definition_en: to bend something so one part lies over another | a bend or crease in paper, cloth, or skin | to close because a business cannot continue operating
example1_en: Please fold these towels and put them on the shelf.
example1_zh: 请把这些毛巾叠好，放到架子上。
example2_en: Small businesses may fold when rising rental costs make it impossible to maintain a reasonable profit.
example2_zh: 当租金上涨导致无法维持合理利润时，小企业可能倒闭。
collocations: fold in half｜对折 ; fold your arms｜双臂交叉抱在胸前 ; fold up a chair｜把椅子折起来 ; fold the laundry｜叠洗好的衣物
tip_zh: fold强调折叠；bend只表示弯曲，不一定叠合。

meanings_zh: phr. 分成两半；成两段
definition_en: into two pieces
example1_en: The rope broke in two.
example1_zh: 绳子断成两段。
example2_en: She tore the paper in two.
example2_zh: 她把纸撕成两半。
tip_zh: break/tear in two 表示“断/撕成两半”。

meanings_zh: adj. 可靠的；可信赖的
definition_en: Able to be trusted to work well or behave consistently
example1_en: Our old car is still reliable in cold weather.
example1_zh: 我们的旧车在寒冷天气里依然很可靠。
example2_en: Access to reliable information helps citizens make informed decisions about their health and finances.
example2_zh: 获取可靠的信息有助于公民就健康和财务作出明智决定。
collocations: reliable source｜可靠来源 ; reliable information｜可靠信息 ; reliable service｜可靠的服务
tip_zh: reliable可形容人、信息或机器，强调值得信赖。

meanings_zh: adv. 轻声地；安静地 | adv. 悄悄地；不张扬地
definition_en: with little or no noise | without attracting attention or making something widely known
example1_en: Please close the door quietly; the baby is sleeping.
example1_zh: 请轻轻关门，宝宝正在睡觉。
example2_en: Students who work quietly in shared study areas help create an environment that supports concentration.
example2_zh: 在公共学习区域安静学习的学生有助于营造利于专注的环境。
collocations: speak quietly｜轻声说话 ; sit quietly｜安静地坐着 ; quietly confident｜自信而不张扬
tip_zh: quietly是副词；注意别与quite（相当）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 可爱的；讨人喜欢的
definition_en: Attractive in a sweet or charming way.
example1_en: That cute kitten is sleeping inside my slipper.
example1_zh: 那只可爱的小猫正睡在我的拖鞋里。
example2_en: Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.
example2_zh: 广告常用可爱的动物吸引注意，让人们对产品产生好感。
collocations: a cute baby｜可爱的婴儿 ; a cute smile｜可爱的笑容 ; look cute｜看起来可爱
tip_zh: 偏口语，常形容婴儿、小动物或讨喜的外表。

meanings_zh: n. 背包客
definition_en: a person who travels with a backpack, usually cheaply
example1_en: Backpackers often stay in cheap hostels.
example1_zh: 背包客通常住便宜的青年旅舍。
example2_en: He met other backpackers on the train.
example2_zh: 他在火车上遇到了其他背包客。
tip_zh: backpacker 是背包旅行的游客；backpacking 是背包旅行。

meanings_zh: n. 字母表
definition_en: the complete set of letters used in a language
example1_en: My little sister learned the alphabet through a song.
example1_zh: 我的小妹妹通过一首歌学会了字母表。
example2_en: Learning the alphabet is an important early step towards literacy, but children also need regular reading practice.
example2_zh: 学习字母表是掌握读写能力的重要起点，但孩子也需要经常练习阅读。
collocations: the English alphabet｜英语字母表 ; learn the alphabet｜学习字母表 ; alphabet song｜字母歌
tip_zh: alphabet指整套字母；单个字母用letter。

meanings_zh: n. 法律；法规 | n. 法学 | n. 定律；规律
definition_en: an official rule, or the system of such rules | the study or profession concerned with legal rules | a general scientific rule describing how something always behaves
example1_en: The law requires drivers to stop at red lights.
example1_zh: 法律要求驾驶员在红灯前停车。
example2_en: Governments should enforce environmental laws consistently to prevent businesses from gaining advantages through harmful practices.
example2_zh: 政府应始终如一地执行环境法律，防止企业通过有害行为获取优势。
collocations: break the law｜违法 ; enforce the law｜执法 ; study law｜学习法学 ; the laws of physics｜物理定律
tip_zh: 具体一条法律可数；法学用不可数的law。

meanings_zh: n. 版本；改编形式 | n. 个人叙述；说法
definition_en: A particular form of something that exists in different forms | One person's account of an event
example1_en: The new version of this app loads much faster.
example1_zh: 这个应用的新版本加载快多了。
example2_en: Comparing each witness's version of events helps investigators develop a more accurate understanding of what happened.
example2_zh: 比较各位目击者对事件的叙述，有助于调查人员更准确地了解事情的经过。
collocations: the latest version｜最新版本 ; an updated version｜更新版 ; a version of events｜对事件的一种说法 ; a film version｜电影改编版
tip_zh: version指同一事物的不同形式，也指个人对事件的说法。

meanings_zh: n. 芯片；集成电路 | n. 碎屑；缺口 | v. 碰掉一小块；使缺损
definition_en: a tiny electronic component containing many connected circuits | a small broken piece or the mark it leaves | to break a small piece off something
example1_en: The repairer replaced a damaged chip inside my laptop.
example1_zh: 维修人员更换了我笔记本电脑内部一块损坏的芯片。
example2_en: Demand for advanced chips is increasing as more industries adopt artificial intelligence and automated production systems.
example2_zh: 随着更多行业采用人工智能和自动化生产系统，对先进芯片的需求正在增长。
collocations: computer chip｜计算机芯片 ; silicon chip｜硅芯片 ; a chip in a cup｜杯子上的缺口 ; chip a tooth｜磕掉一小块牙齿
tip_zh: 食物中的chips：英式指薯条，美式通常指薯片。

meanings_zh: phr v. （闹钟）响；（食物）变质
definition_en: to ring, or to become bad (about food)
example1_en: My alarm clock went off at seven.
example1_zh: 我的闹钟七点响了。
example2_en: The milk has gone off; don't drink it.
example2_zh: 牛奶变质了，别喝。
tip_zh: go off 指闹钟“响”或食物“变质”。

meanings_zh: n. 西南方；西南部 | adj. 西南的；来自西南的 | adv. 向西南；在西南
definition_en: the direction between south and west, or an area's southwestern part | in the southwest, or coming from that direction | towards or in the direction between south and west
example1_en: Our village lies southwest of the nearest town.
example1_zh: 我们的村庄位于最近那座城镇的西南方。
example2_en: The southwest of the country attracts visitors because of its mild climate and varied coastal landscapes.
example2_zh: 该国西南部因气候温和、海岸景观多样而吸引游客。
collocations: in the southwest｜在西南部 ; southwest of｜在……西南方 ; head southwest｜向西南行进 ; southwest coast｜西南海岸
tip_zh: 英国英语也常写作south-west。

meanings_zh: adj. 有挑战性的；困难的 | adj. 挑衅的；表示质疑的
definition_en: Difficult in a way that tests skills or determination. | Expressing doubt or inviting disagreement or competition.
example1_en: This challenging puzzle kept us busy all afternoon.
example1_zh: 这道有难度的谜题让我们忙了整整一下午。
example2_en: Providing affordable healthcare in remote communities remains challenging because trained medical staff and essential equipment are often scarce.
example2_zh: 由于受过培训的医护人员和必要设备往往短缺，在偏远社区提供可负担的医疗服务仍然困难。
collocations: challenging task｜艰巨的任务 ; challenging environment｜充满挑战的环境 ; intellectually challenging｜考验智力的
tip_zh: 形容任务有难度用challenging，不用challenged。

meanings_zh: n. 警卫；守卫 | v. 守卫；保护；看守 | n. 防护装置
definition_en: a person whose job is to protect people or places | to protect someone or something from danger or escape | a cover or barrier that prevents injury or damage
example1_en: The guard checked my ticket before opening the gate.
example1_zh: 警卫检查了我的票才打开大门。
example2_en: Museums employ trained staff to guard valuable collections while ensuring that visitors can enjoy them safely.
example2_zh: 博物馆雇用受过培训的工作人员保护珍贵藏品，同时确保游客能够安全地观赏。
collocations: security guard｜保安 ; guard against｜防范 ; on guard｜警戒着 ; protective guard｜防护罩
tip_zh: guard against表示防范某种风险或错误。

meanings_zh: v. 杀死；使死亡 | v. 使终止；扼杀
definition_en: To cause a person, animal, or other organism to die | To cause something to stop or fail
example1_en: This soap helps kill germs on your hands.
example1_zh: 这种肥皂有助于杀灭手上的病菌。
example2_en: Excessive use of pesticides can kill beneficial insects and disrupt the natural balance of agricultural ecosystems.
example2_zh: 过量使用农药会杀死益虫，破坏农业生态系统的自然平衡。
collocations: kill germs｜杀灭病菌 ; kill time｜消磨时间 ; kill off｜使全部死亡；彻底消除 ; kill enthusiasm｜打击热情
tip_zh: kill强调造成死亡；die表示自身死亡，不接宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 在…下面画线 | v. 强调；凸显
definition_en: to draw a line beneath a word or phrase | to show that something is especially important
example1_en: Our teacher asked us to underline the unfamiliar words.
example1_zh: 老师让我们在不熟悉的单词下面画线。
example2_en: These findings underline the importance of providing affordable housing near public transport for families on low incomes.
example2_zh: 这些发现凸显了在公共交通附近为低收入家庭提供可负担住房的重要性。
collocations: underline a word｜在单词下面画线 ; underline the importance of｜强调…的重要性 ; underline the need for｜凸显对…的需要
tip_zh: 本义是在下方画线，也常用于强调重要性。

meanings_zh: n. 小溪；溪流 | n. 连续不断的人流或事物 | v. 流动；在线播放
definition_en: A small, narrow river. | A continuous flow of people or things. | To flow continuously, or play media directly over the internet.
example1_en: We crossed the shallow stream on flat stones.
example1_zh: 我们踩着扁平的石头穿过了那条浅溪。
example2_en: Many students now stream educational videos at home, making reliable internet access increasingly important for learning.
example2_zh: 许多学生如今在家在线观看视频课程，因此可靠的网络连接对学习越来越重要。
collocations: a mountain stream｜山间小溪 ; a steady stream of visitors｜络绎不绝的访客 ; stream music｜在线播放音乐
tip_zh: a stream of可指接连不断的人或事物。

meanings_zh: n. 芭蕾舞；芭蕾舞剧
definition_en: A formal dance style, or a performance using this style.
example1_en: My sister practises ballet at the studio every Saturday.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每周六都在舞蹈室练习芭蕾舞。
example2_en: Public funding for ballet can help preserve artistic traditions and make performances accessible to a wider audience.
example2_zh: 为芭蕾舞提供公共资金有助于保护艺术传统，并让更多观众有机会观看演出。
collocations: ballet dancer｜芭蕾舞演员 ; ballet company｜芭蕾舞团 ; ballet lessons｜芭蕾舞课 ; classical ballet｜古典芭蕾舞
tip_zh: 词尾t不发音；英式重音在前，美式在后。

meanings_zh: phr v. 出发；启程
definition_en: to start a journey
example1_en: We set off for the beach at eight in the morning.
example1_zh: 我们早上八点出发去海滩。
example2_en: They set off early to avoid the traffic.
example2_zh: 他们早出发以避开交通拥堵。
tip_zh: set off 表示“出发”；set off for + 目的地。

meanings_zh: n. 失望；沮丧 | n. 令人失望的人或事
definition_en: sadness because something was not as good as expected | someone or something that fails to meet your hopes
example1_en: Her face showed disappointment when the picnic was cancelled.
example1_zh: 野餐取消时，她脸上露出了失望的神情。
example2_en: Teaching young people to cope with disappointment can help them respond more positively to academic setbacks.
example2_zh: 教年轻人应对失望，有助于他们更积极地面对学业上的挫折。
collocations: to my disappointment｜令我失望的是 ; a bitter disappointment｜极其令人失望的事 ; cope with disappointment｜应对失望
tip_zh: 指情绪通常不可数；指令人失望的事可用a disappointment。

meanings_zh: n. 锻炼；健身训练
definition_en: a period of physical exercise to improve strength or fitness
example1_en: After a short workout, I felt ready for breakfast.
example1_zh: 短暂锻炼后，我觉得可以好好吃顿早饭了。
example2_en: A regular workout can improve physical health and help office workers manage stress more effectively.
example2_zh: 定期锻炼可以改善身体健康，并帮助办公室职员更有效地缓解压力。
collocations: daily workout｜每日锻炼 ; intense workout｜高强度训练 ; workout routine｜健身训练安排
tip_zh: workout是名词；动词短语work out要分开写。

meanings_zh: n. 行星
definition_en: A large round object that travels around a star.
example1_en: We watched a bright planet through the telescope tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚我们用望远镜观察了一颗明亮的行星。
example2_en: Scientists study distant planets to understand whether conditions suitable for life exist beyond Earth.
example2_zh: 科学家研究遥远的行星，以了解地球以外是否存在适合生命的条件。
collocations: a distant planet｜遥远的行星 ; orbit a planet｜绕行星运行 ; protect the planet｜保护地球
tip_zh: planet是行星，star是恒星；the planet常指地球。

meanings_zh: adj. 传统的；沿袭已久的
definition_en: Following customs or methods passed down over a long time.
example1_en: We cooked a traditional meal for the family gathering.
example1_zh: 我们为家庭聚会做了一顿传统饭菜。
example2_en: Traditional farming methods can preserve local knowledge, although some require adaptation to cope with climate change.
example2_zh: 传统耕作方法能够保留地方知识，但其中一些需要调整以应对气候变化。
collocations: traditional customs｜传统习俗 ; traditional crafts｜传统手工艺 ; traditional methods｜传统方法
tip_zh: traditional强调传承已久，不一定表示落后。

meanings_zh: n. 农业；农场经营
definition_en: Growing crops or raising animals for food and other products
example1_en: My grandparents earn their living from sheep farming.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母以养羊为生。
example2_en: Sustainable farming can protect soil quality while providing enough food for a growing population.
example2_zh: 可持续农业既能保护土壤质量，也能为不断增长的人口提供充足的食物。
collocations: organic farming｜有机农业 ; dairy farming｜奶牛养殖 ; intensive farming｜集约化农业 ; sustainable farming｜可持续农业
tip_zh: 泛指农业时通常不可数；养殖也可用farming。

meanings_zh: n. 成就；成绩 | n. 实现；达成
definition_en: Something valuable accomplished through effort or skill. | The successful completion of a goal through effort.
example1_en: Finishing my first long hike felt like a real achievement.
example1_zh: 完成第一次长途徒步让我觉得很有成就感。
example2_en: Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
example2_zh: 学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。
collocations: a major achievement｜重大成就 ; a sense of achievement｜成就感 ; academic achievement｜学业成绩 ; the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip_zh: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 洒出；溢出；使散落 | n. 洒出物；泄漏
definition_en: To accidentally let liquid or loose material escape its container. | An amount of liquid spilled, or an incident involving spilling.
example1_en: I spilled orange juice all over my clean shirt.
example1_zh: 我把橙汁洒得干净衬衫上到处都是。
example2_en: Oil spills can damage marine ecosystems and threaten the livelihoods of communities that depend on fishing.
example2_zh: 石油泄漏会破坏海洋生态系统，并威胁依赖捕鱼的社区的生计。
collocations: spill a drink｜洒出饮料 ; an oil spill｜石油泄漏 ; spill over｜溢出；波及 ; spill the beans｜泄露秘密
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词可用spilled或spilt。

meanings_zh: adj. 大胆的；勇敢的 | adj. 醒目的；鲜明的 | adj. 粗体的
definition_en: Willing to take risks or act with confidence. | Strong and easily noticed in colour, shape, or design. | Printed with thicker, darker lines than ordinary type.
example1_en: She made a bold decision to open her own bakery.
example1_zh: 她大胆决定开一家自己的面包店。
example2_en: Governments need bold policies to address housing shortages while protecting green spaces and supporting affordable development.
example2_zh: 政府需要大胆的政策来解决住房短缺，同时保护绿地并支持可负担住房的开发。
collocations: bold decision｜大胆的决定 ; bold colours｜鲜明的色彩 ; bold type｜粗体字 ; bold approach｜大胆的做法
tip_zh: in bold表示“用粗体”，常用于排版说明。

meanings_zh: n. 篮子；筐 | n. 篮筐；投篮得分
definition_en: A container made from woven strips, wire, or similar materials | The hoop and net in basketball, or a score through it
example1_en: I carried a basket of fresh apples into the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我提着一篮新鲜苹果走进厨房。
example2_en: Providing reusable shopping baskets can encourage customers to reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bags.
example2_zh: 提供可重复使用的购物篮可以鼓励顾客减少对一次性塑料袋的依赖。
collocations: shopping basket｜购物篮 ; laundry basket｜洗衣篮 ; a basket of fruit｜一篮水果 ; score a basket｜投篮得分
tip_zh: a basket of apples指一篮苹果；篮子数量用baskets。

meanings_zh: n. 小偷；窃贼
definition_en: someone who steals another person's belongings
example1_en: The thief took my bicycle while I was shopping.
example1_zh: 我购物时，小偷偷走了我的自行车。
example2_en: Secure bicycle parking can make it harder for a thief to steal from commuters.
example2_zh: 安全的自行车停车设施能让小偷更难偷走通勤者的自行车。
collocations: a bicycle thief｜偷自行车的人 ; catch a thief｜抓住小偷 ; a petty thief｜小偷小摸的人
tip_zh: 复数是thieves；robber通常涉及暴力或威胁抢劫。

meanings_zh: adj. 锋利的；尖的 | adj. 急剧的；显著的 | adj. 敏锐的；机敏的
definition_en: Having an edge or point that cuts or pierces easily. | Sudden and large in degree or amount. | Quick to notice, understand, or respond to things.
example1_en: This knife is sharp enough to slice tomatoes easily.
example1_zh: 这把刀足够锋利，切番茄很轻松。
example2_en: A sharp increase in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving out of their parents' homes.
example2_zh: 住房成本急剧上涨，迫使许多年轻人推迟搬离父母家的计划。
collocations: sharp knife｜锋利的刀 ; sharp increase｜急剧增长 ; sharp contrast｜鲜明对比 ; sharp mind｜敏锐的头脑
tip_zh: 形容变化时常指幅度大且突然，如a sharp rise。

meanings_zh: n. 账户；账号 | n. 叙述；报告 | v. 解释；占（比例）
definition_en: an arrangement for managing money or accessing a service | a spoken or written description of events | with for: explain something or constitute a share of something
example1_en: I opened a savings account at the local bank.
example1_zh: 我在当地银行开了一个储蓄账户。
example2_en: Transport costs account for a substantial share of household spending, particularly in areas with limited public services.
example2_zh: 交通费用占家庭支出的很大一部分，在公共服务有限的地区尤其如此。
collocations: open an account｜开立账户 ; give an account of｜叙述 ; account for｜解释；占 ; take into account｜考虑到
tip_zh: account for可表示“解释原因”或“占某比例”。

meanings_zh: adj. 不友善的；刻薄的
definition_en: not caring about others' feelings or treating them kindly
example1_en: It was unkind to laugh at his first drawing.
example1_zh: 嘲笑他第一次画的画很不友善。
example2_en: Schools should teach children how unkind comments online can affect the emotional wellbeing of their classmates.
example2_zh: 学校应教导孩子认识到，网上刻薄的评论会如何影响同学的心理健康。
collocations: unkind remarks｜刻薄的话 ; be unkind to someone｜对某人不友善 ; unkind behaviour｜不友善的行为
tip_zh: 表示“对某人不友善”用be unkind to someone。

meanings_zh: n. 寂静；沉默 | v. 使安静；压制言论
definition_en: a lack of sound or speech | to stop someone or something making noise or expressing opinions
example1_en: We sat in silence as the snow fell outside.
example1_zh: 外面下着雪，我们静静地坐着。
example2_en: Extended periods of silence in classrooms can give students valuable time to reflect on difficult questions.
example2_zh: 课堂上较长的安静时段可以给学生宝贵的时间来思考难题。
collocations: in silence｜默默地 ; break the silence｜打破沉默 ; complete silence｜一片寂静 ; silence criticism｜压制批评
tip_zh: in silence意为默默地；silent是形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 国界；边界 | n. 边缘；装饰边 | v. 与……接壤；紧邻
definition_en: the dividing line between countries or regions | a strip around the outside edge of something | to share a boundary with a place
example1_en: We crossed the border by train early this morning.
example1_zh: 我们今天一早乘火车越过了边境。
example2_en: Countries that share a border often need to cooperate closely on trade and environmental protection.
example2_zh: 接壤的国家往往需要在贸易和环境保护方面密切合作。
collocations: cross the border｜越过边境 ; border controls｜边境管制 ; share a border｜接壤 ; a decorative border｜装饰边
tip_zh: border作动词直接接地点；border on还可表示近乎。

meanings_zh: adj. 可接受的；合格的
definition_en: good enough or suitable to be allowed or approved
example1_en: These shoes are acceptable for work, but trainers aren't.
example1_zh: 这双鞋适合上班穿，但运动鞋不行。
example2_en: Governments must establish acceptable limits for industrial emissions to protect public health and nearby ecosystems.
example2_zh: 政府必须为工业排放设定可接受的限值，以保护公众健康和周边生态系统。
collocations: acceptable standard｜合格标准 ; socially acceptable｜社会认可的 ; acceptable to everyone｜人人都能接受的
tip_zh: acceptable表示达到要求，不等于优秀。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人尴尬的；使人难堪的
definition_en: Making someone feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable
example1_en: It was embarrassing when my phone rang during the ceremony.
example1_zh: 典礼进行时我的手机响了，真让人尴尬。
example2_en: Students may avoid asking questions if they believe that making mistakes in front of classmates is embarrassing.
example2_zh: 如果学生觉得在同学面前犯错很丢脸，他们可能会避免提问。
collocations: an embarrassing mistake｜令人尴尬的错误 ; an embarrassing situation｜令人难堪的处境 ; deeply embarrassing｜极其尴尬的
tip_zh: 事物令人尴尬用embarrassing；人感到尴尬用embarrassed。

meanings_zh: n. 长篇小说 | adj. 新颖的；新奇的
definition_en: A long written story about imaginary people and events. | New and different from what is already known.
example1_en: I finished the novel on the train yesterday.
example1_zh: 我昨天在火车上读完了这部长篇小说。
example2_en: Schools can use historical novels to help students understand how ordinary people experienced major social changes.
example2_zh: 学校可以利用历史小说，帮助学生理解普通人如何经历重大的社会变革。
collocations: write a novel｜写长篇小说 ; historical novel｜历史小说 ; novel approach｜新颖的方法
tip_zh: 作名词指长篇小说；作形容词指新颖的。

meanings_zh: n. 雇员；员工
definition_en: Someone paid to work for a person or organisation.
example1_en: A new employee showed me around the bakery.
example1_zh: 一位新员工带我参观了面包店。
example2_en: Employers should provide every employee with appropriate training to maintain a safe and productive workplace.
example2_zh: 雇主应为每位员工提供适当培训，以保持工作场所的安全和高效。
collocations: full-time employee｜全职员工 ; employee benefits｜员工福利 ; employee training｜员工培训 ; employee turnover｜员工流动率
tip_zh: employee是雇员，employer是雇主。

meanings_zh: n. 铁路；铁路系统
definition_en: Tracks and services used by trains to transport people or goods.
example1_en: Our house overlooks the railway near the old bridge.
example1_zh: 从我们家能望见旧桥附近的铁路。
example2_en: Investment in railway networks can reduce road congestion while improving access to employment in neighbouring cities.
example2_zh: 投资铁路网络可以缓解道路拥堵，同时方便人们前往邻近城市就业。
collocations: a railway station｜火车站 ; a railway line｜铁路线 ; a railway network｜铁路网 ; railway infrastructure｜铁路基础设施
tip_zh: railway常用于英式英语，美式常用railroad。

meanings_zh: adj. 有智慧的；明智的
definition_en: Showing good judgment based on knowledge and experience.
example1_en: Taking a warm coat was a wise decision today.
example1_zh: 今天带上一件暖和的外套是个明智的决定。
example2_en: It would be wise for governments to invest in preventive healthcare rather than rely solely on hospital treatment.
example2_zh: 政府投资预防性医疗，而非仅仅依靠医院治疗，会是明智之举。
collocations: a wise decision｜明智的决定 ; wise advice｜睿智的忠告 ; wise to do something｜做某事是明智的
tip_zh: wise强调判断明智；clever更强调聪明、学得快。

meanings_zh: n. 描述；描写
definition_en: an account explaining what someone or something is like
example1_en: Your description helped me find the little bakery.
example1_zh: 你的描述帮我找到了那家小面包店。
example2_en: A clear description of research methods allows other scientists to evaluate the reliability of a study.
example2_zh: 清楚描述研究方法，有助于其他科学家评估研究的可靠性。
collocations: a detailed description｜详细描述 ; give a description of｜描述 ; a job description｜岗位职责说明 ; an accurate description｜准确描述
tip_zh: 表示对某物的描述，用a description of，不用about。

meanings_zh: adj. 消极的；不利的 | adj. 否定的；阴性的 | adj. 负的；小于零的
definition_en: expressing pessimism or having a harmful effect | expressing refusal or showing that something tested for is absent | less than zero
example1_en: Her negative comments made me doubt my cooking skills.
example1_zh: 她的负面评价让我怀疑自己的厨艺。
example2_en: Heavy reliance on private cars can have negative effects on air quality and public health.
example2_zh: 过度依赖私家车可能对空气质量和公众健康产生不利影响。
collocations: negative impact｜负面影响 ; negative attitude｜消极态度 ; test negative for｜检测结果为阴性 ; negative number｜负数
tip_zh: 检测结果为negative指未检出，并非结果不好。

meanings_zh: n. 锅 | n. 盆；罐；壶 | v. 把植物栽入盆中
definition_en: A deep container used for cooking food. | A container used for plants, storage, or serving drinks. | To put a plant into a container with soil.
example1_en: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
example1_zh: 汤在一口大锅里咕嘟咕嘟地轻轻翻滚。
example2_en: Growing vegetables in pots allows residents with limited outdoor space to produce some of their own food.
example2_zh: 用盆种菜能让户外空间有限的居民自己种出一些食物。
collocations: a pot of soup｜一锅汤 ; a plant pot｜花盆 ; a pot of tea｜一壶茶 ; pot plants｜把植物栽入盆中
tip_zh: 锅、盆、罐都可用pot；平底煎锅常用pan。

meanings_zh: n. 婚姻；结婚 | n. 紧密结合
definition_en: the legally or socially recognised relationship between two spouses | a successful combination of different things
example1_en: Their marriage grew stronger as they learned to listen.
example1_zh: 随着他们学会倾听，婚姻关系变得更加稳固。
example2_en: Changing attitudes towards marriage have influenced household structures and housing demand in many societies.
example2_zh: 在许多社会中，人们对婚姻态度的变化影响了家庭结构和住房需求。
collocations: a happy marriage｜幸福的婚姻 ; marriage certificate｜结婚证 ; marriage ceremony｜结婚仪式 ; marriage to someone｜与某人的婚姻
tip_zh: marriage指婚姻关系；wedding主要指婚礼。

meanings_zh: n. 锦标赛；联赛
definition_en: a competition involving several games between different players or teams
example1_en: Our school tennis tournament starts next Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我们学校的网球锦标赛下周六早上开始。
example2_en: Hosting an international tournament can boost tourism, but maintaining sports facilities afterwards may prove expensive.
example2_zh: 举办国际锦标赛能够促进旅游业，但赛后维护体育设施可能费用高昂。
collocations: host a tournament｜主办锦标赛 ; enter a tournament｜报名参赛 ; win a tournament｜赢得锦标赛 ; tennis tournament｜网球锦标赛
tip_zh: 通常包含多场比赛；单场比赛常用match或game。

meanings_zh: adj. 怀孕的；妊娠的
definition_en: having a baby developing inside the body
example1_en: My cousin is pregnant and expects her baby in June.
example1_zh: 我表姐怀孕了，预产期在六月。
example2_en: Accessible healthcare helps pregnant women receive regular check-ups and reliable advice throughout their pregnancy.
example2_zh: 便捷可及的医疗服务有助于孕妇在整个孕期获得定期检查和可靠的建议。
collocations: become pregnant｜怀孕 ; pregnant women｜孕妇 ; heavily pregnant｜怀孕临近足月的
tip_zh: 表示怀孕多久可说six months pregnant。

meanings_zh: n. 知识；学识 | n. 知晓；了解
definition_en: information and understanding gained through learning or experience | awareness of a particular fact or situation
example1_en: My grandfather shared his knowledge of birds with me.
example1_zh: 祖父和我分享了他对鸟类的了解。
example2_en: Schools should help students apply their knowledge to practical problems rather than simply memorise facts.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生运用知识解决实际问题，而不只是记忆事实。
collocations: gain knowledge｜获取知识 ; practical knowledge｜实用知识 ; knowledge of｜对……的了解 ; without someone's knowledge｜在某人不知情的情况下
tip_zh: 通常不可数；可说a good knowledge of某领域。

meanings_zh: phr. 度假
definition_en: on vacation; taking a break from work
example1_en: The Smiths are on holiday in Spain this week.
example1_zh: 史密斯一家这周在西班牙度假。
example2_en: She is on holiday and will be back on Monday.
example2_zh: 她在度假，周一回来。
tip_zh: on holiday 是英式“度假”；美式说 on vacation。

meanings_zh: v. 按；压 | n. 新闻界；报刊 | v. 催促；敦促
definition_en: Push firmly against something. | Newspapers, magazines, and the journalists who produce them. | Try firmly to persuade someone to do something.
example1_en: Press this button to open the garage door.
example1_zh: 按这个按钮就能打开车库门。
example2_en: A free press helps citizens understand public affairs and holds those in power accountable.
example2_zh: 自由的新闻界帮助公民了解公共事务，并监督掌权者承担责任。
collocations: press a button｜按按钮 ; freedom of the press｜新闻自由 ; press conference｜新闻发布会 ; press for change｜敦促改革
tip_zh: 表示新闻界通常用the press；按按钮不用push down。

meanings_zh: v. 说服；劝服 | v. 使相信；使信服
definition_en: To get someone to do something by giving reasons | To make someone believe something is true
example1_en: I persuaded my brother to join our walking group.
example1_zh: 我说服弟弟加入了我们的步行小组。
example2_en: Public health campaigns can persuade people to adopt healthier habits by explaining the benefits in accessible language.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传可以用通俗语言解释益处，说服人们养成更健康的习惯。
collocations: persuade someone to do something｜说服某人做某事 ; persuade someone of something｜使某人相信某事 ; hard to persuade｜难以说服
tip_zh: persuade sb to do强调劝服成功，不只是提出建议。

meanings_zh: phr v. 确保；查明
definition_en: to check that something is true or done
example1_en: Make sure you lock the door before leaving.
example1_zh: 离开前确保锁好门。
example2_en: She made sure all the lights were off.
example2_zh: 她确认所有灯都关了。
tip_zh: make sure (that) + 从句，表示“确保”。

meanings_zh: n. 竞速运动；赛马 | adj. 竞速比赛用的
definition_en: The sport of competing to move faster than others. | Designed or used for races.
example1_en: My cousin enjoys watching bicycle racing on weekend afternoons.
example1_zh: 我表亲喜欢在周末下午看自行车比赛。
example2_en: Professional motor racing encourages technological innovation, but its environmental impact remains a subject of debate.
example2_zh: 职业赛车运动推动技术创新，但其环境影响仍存在争议。
collocations: horse racing｜赛马 ; motor racing｜赛车运动 ; a racing car｜赛车 ; a racing bike｜竞赛自行车
tip_zh: 作运动名称通常不可数；一场比赛用a race。

meanings_zh: n. 炸弹 | v. 轰炸；投弹于
definition_en: A weapon designed to explode and cause damage. | To attack a place using bombs.
example1_en: The museum displayed an empty bomb casing behind glass.
example1_zh: 博物馆在玻璃后陈列了一个空炸弹壳。
example2_en: Construction projects may be delayed when workers discover an unexploded bomb left over from a past conflict.
example2_zh: 当工人发现过去冲突遗留的未爆炸弹时，建设项目可能会延期。
collocations: an unexploded bomb｜未爆炸弹 ; defuse a bomb｜拆除炸弹引信 ; a bomb disposal team｜拆弹小组
tip_zh: 词尾b不发音；bombing指轰炸或炸弹袭击。

meanings_zh: n. 兽医 | v. 审查；仔细检查
definition_en: a person trained to treat sick or injured animals | to check someone or something carefully before giving approval
example1_en: The vet gently checked our puppy's ears and paws.
example1_zh: 兽医轻柔地检查了我们小狗的耳朵和爪子。
example2_en: Organisations should vet potential employees carefully when recruiting people who will work with children or vulnerable adults.
example2_zh: 组织在招聘将与儿童或弱势成年人接触的人员时，应仔细审查应聘者。
collocations: take a pet to the vet｜带宠物看兽医 ; vet applicants｜审查申请人 ; vetting process｜审查流程
tip_zh: 动词过去式vetted，动名词vetting，均双写t。

meanings_zh: adj. 壮丽的；宏伟的 | adj. 极出色的
definition_en: Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive. | Exceptionally good or skilfully done.
example1_en: The balcony offers a magnificent view of snowy mountains.
example1_zh: 从阳台可以欣赏到壮丽的雪山景色。
example2_en: Preserving magnificent historic buildings can strengthen local identity and attract visitors from other regions.
example2_zh: 保护宏伟的历史建筑能增强当地认同感，并吸引其他地区的游客。
collocations: magnificent scenery｜壮丽的景色 ; a magnificent building｜宏伟的建筑 ; a magnificent achievement｜卓越的成就
tip_zh: 多形容景色、建筑或成就，不表示品德高尚。

meanings_zh: n. 一代人；一代 | n. 产生；发电 | n. 产品的一代
definition_en: people born and living at roughly the same time | the process of producing something, especially electricity | a stage in the development of a product or technology
example1_en: Three generations of our family gathered for dinner yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们家三代人聚在一起吃晚饭。
example2_en: Each generation faces different challenges as technological progress changes the skills required in the workplace.
example2_zh: 随着技术进步改变职场所需的技能，每一代人都面临不同的挑战。
collocations: future generations｜后代 ; generation gap｜代沟 ; electricity generation｜发电 ; younger generation｜年轻一代
tip_zh: 表示“一代人”时可数；表示“产生”时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 诊所；门诊部
definition_en: A place providing medical advice or treatment without overnight stays.
example1_en: The clinic near our house opens early on weekdays.
example1_zh: 我们家附近的诊所工作日很早就开门。
example2_en: Local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals by treating common illnesses and providing preventive care.
example2_zh: 当地诊所可以通过治疗常见病和提供预防性保健来减轻医院的压力。
collocations: dental clinic｜牙科诊所 ; outpatient clinic｜门诊部 ; attend a clinic｜去门诊就诊
tip_zh: clinic指诊所或门诊部；“临床的”用clinical。

meanings_zh: v. 推迟；延期
definition_en: to arrange for something to happen later than originally planned
example1_en: We postponed our picnic because heavy rain was forecast.
example1_zh: 因为天气预报说有大雨，我们推迟了野餐。
example2_en: Local authorities decided to postpone construction until a full assessment of the environmental impact was completed.
example2_zh: 地方当局决定推迟施工，直到完成全面的环境影响评估。
collocations: postpone a meeting｜推迟会议 ; postpone a decision｜推迟决定 ; postpone until further notice｜延期至另行通知
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词：postpone doing，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 犯罪；犯罪活动 | n. 罪行
definition_en: illegal activities considered as a whole | an action that breaks the law
example1_en: Better street lighting has helped reduce crime here.
example1_zh: 更好的街道照明帮助减少了这里的犯罪。
example2_en: Investment in education and employment opportunities may reduce crime more effectively than increasingly severe punishments.
example2_zh: 投资教育和增加就业机会，可能比不断加重惩罚更有效地减少犯罪。
collocations: commit a crime｜犯罪 ; prevent crime｜预防犯罪 ; crime rate｜犯罪率 ; violent crime｜暴力犯罪
tip_zh: 泛指犯罪不可数；指具体罪行可数，如commit a crime。

meanings_zh: v. 逃跑；逃脱 | v. 避开；免遭 | n. 逃脱；解脱
definition_en: to get away from confinement or a dangerous situation | to avoid something unpleasant or harmful | the act of getting free from danger or unpleasant conditions
example1_en: Our rabbit escaped through a small gap in the fence.
example1_zh: 我们的兔子从围栏的一处小缝隙逃走了。
example2_en: Accessible parks offer urban residents an escape from crowded streets and opportunities to enjoy nature.
example2_zh: 便利可达的公园让城市居民得以远离拥挤的街道，并有机会亲近自然。
collocations: escape from danger｜脱离危险 ; narrow escape｜侥幸脱险 ; escape injury｜幸免受伤 ; escape route｜逃生路线
tip_zh: 逃离某处用escape from；免遭某事可直接接名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 中级的；中间的 | n. 中级学习者
definition_en: Between basic and advanced levels, or between two stages. | A learner whose skills are between beginner and advanced levels.
example1_en: This swimming class is suitable for intermediate learners.
example1_zh: 这门游泳课适合中级学员。
example2_en: Intermediate language courses should balance grammar instruction with opportunities for meaningful communication outside the classroom.
example2_zh: 中级语言课程应兼顾语法教学与课堂外有实际意义的交流机会。
collocations: intermediate level｜中级水平 ; an intermediate course｜中级课程 ; an intermediate stage｜中间阶段
tip_zh: 常指介于beginner与advanced之间的水平。

meanings_zh: adj. 生的；未煮熟的 | adj. 未加工的；未经处理的 | adj. 擦痛的；红肿疼痛的
definition_en: not cooked | in its original state before processing or analysis | sore because the skin is damaged or irritated
example1_en: I prefer raw carrots because they are so crunchy.
example1_zh: 我更喜欢生胡萝卜，因为吃起来很脆。
example2_en: Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.
example2_zh: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格骤变的冲击。
collocations: raw vegetables｜生蔬菜 ; raw materials｜原材料 ; raw data｜原始数据 ; raw talent｜未经雕琢的天赋
tip_zh: raw强调未烹煮或未加工，不等于“新鲜的”fresh。

meanings_zh: v. 允许；准许 | n. 许可证；通行证 | v. 使成为可能
definition_en: to officially allow someone to do something | an official document allowing a particular activity | to make an action or situation possible
example1_en: The museum permits visitors to take photos without flash.
example1_zh: 这家博物馆允许游客在不开闪光灯的情况下拍照。
example2_en: Local authorities should permit new housing developments only when adequate transport and healthcare services are available.
example2_zh: 地方政府只有在交通和医疗服务充足时，才应批准新的住宅开发项目。
collocations: permit someone to do something｜允许某人做某事 ; work permit｜工作许可 ; building permit｜建筑许可证 ; weather permitting｜天气允许的话
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词在前；permit sb to do。

meanings_zh: v. 减去；扣除
definition_en: to take one number or amount away from another
example1_en: Subtract the delivery charge to find the original price.
example1_zh: 减去运费，就能算出原价。
example2_en: Researchers subtract production costs from total revenue to calculate the profit generated by each farming method.
example2_zh: 研究人员从总收入中减去生产成本，计算每种耕作方式带来的利润。
collocations: subtract from｜从……中减去 ; subtract the cost｜扣除费用
tip_zh: subtract A from B 表示用B减去A。

meanings_zh: adj. 合适的；适宜的
definition_en: right for a particular person, purpose, or situation
example1_en: These walking shoes are suitable for muddy forest paths.
example1_zh: 这双步行鞋适合走泥泞的林间小路。
example2_en: Cities should provide suitable housing for older residents, with easy access to healthcare and public transport.
example2_zh: 城市应为老年居民提供合适的住房，方便他们就医和乘坐公共交通。
collocations: suitable for children｜适合儿童的 ; suitable accommodation｜合适的住处 ; a suitable candidate｜合适的候选人
tip_zh: 常用suitable for sb/sth或suitable to do sth。

meanings_zh: n. 炖锅；深平底锅
definition_en: a deep pan with a handle for cooking
example1_en: She boiled the soup in a saucepan.
example1_zh: 她用炖锅煮汤。
example2_en: Put the saucepan on the stove, please.
example2_zh: 请把炖锅放到炉子上。
tip_zh: saucepan 是带柄的深锅，用来煮汤/炖菜。

meanings_zh: n. 馅饼；派
definition_en: Food with a pastry base or covering and a filling.
example1_en: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一个热苹果派。
example2_en: Traditional dishes, such as fruit pie, can help preserve regional food culture across generations.
example2_zh: 水果派等传统菜肴有助于让地方饮食文化代代相传。
collocations: apple pie｜苹果派 ; meat pie｜肉馅饼 ; a slice of pie｜一块馅饼
tip_zh: pie指馅饼；“饼图”须说pie chart。

meanings_zh: n. 热带丛林 | n. 竞争残酷的环境
definition_en: A tropical forest with thick, closely growing plants and trees | A confusing or dangerous situation involving fierce competition
example1_en: Thick vines hung above the narrow jungle path.
example1_zh: 茂密的藤蔓垂在狭窄的丛林小路上方。
example2_en: Clearing jungle for agriculture destroys wildlife habitats and can reduce biodiversity across an entire region.
example2_zh: 清除热带丛林以开辟农田会破坏野生动物栖息地，并可能降低整个地区的生物多样性。
collocations: dense jungle｜茂密的丛林 ; jungle canopy｜丛林树冠层 ; urban jungle｜都市丛林
tip_zh: 通常指热带的茂密丛林；forest泛指森林。

meanings_zh: n. 程序员
definition_en: a person who writes computer programs
example1_en: She works as a programmer for a tech company.
example1_zh: 她在一家科技公司当程序员。
example2_en: The programmer fixed the problem in the app.
example2_zh: 程序员修复了应用里的问题。
tip_zh: programmer 是程序员；美式拼写也作 programmer。

meanings_zh: n. 注意；注意力 | n. 照料；处理；关心
definition_en: The act of focusing your mind on someone or something. | Care or action given to someone or something that needs it.
example1_en: Please pay attention while I explain the game.
example1_zh: 我讲解游戏规则时，请认真听。
example2_en: Schools should give greater attention to students' emotional wellbeing alongside their academic progress.
example2_zh: 学校在关注学生学业进展的同时，也应更加重视他们的情绪健康。
collocations: pay attention to｜注意 ; attract attention｜吸引注意 ; medical attention｜医疗救治 ; attention span｜注意力持续时间
tip_zh: pay attention to后接名词或动名词，to是介词。

meanings_zh: v. 证实；确认属实 | v. 确认安排；正式批准
definition_en: To establish that something is true or correct. | To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.
example1_en: Please call the hotel to confirm our booking today.
example1_zh: 请今天给酒店打电话，确认我们的预订。
example2_en: Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.
example2_zh: 还需要进一步研究，以证实小学小班教学是否能持续改善学习效果。
collocations: confirm a booking｜确认预订 ; confirm that｜证实…… ; confirm a diagnosis｜确诊 ; confirm receipt｜确认收到
tip_zh: 可接名词或that从句；不要用confirm to do。

meanings_zh: n. 皮肤 | n. 果皮；外皮 | v. 剥去皮
definition_en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body. | The thin outer layer of certain fruits and vegetables. | Remove the skin from an animal, fruit or vegetable.
example1_en: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
example1_zh: 在泳池游泳后，我觉得皮肤很干。
example2_en: Protecting skin from excessive sunlight can reduce the risk of serious health problems later in life.
example2_zh: 保护皮肤免受过度日晒，可以降低日后出现严重健康问题的风险。
collocations: dry skin｜干性皮肤 ; sensitive skin｜敏感皮肤 ; skin care｜皮肤护理 ; potato skins｜土豆皮
tip_zh: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。

meanings_zh: v. 找到；确定位置 | v. 设于；把…安置在
definition_en: To find the exact position of someone or something. | To place something or establish a business somewhere.
example1_en: We finally located the missing keys behind the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们终于在沙发后面找到了丢失的钥匙。
example2_en: Local authorities should locate new health centres near public transport routes to improve access for elderly residents.
example2_zh: 地方政府应将新的医疗中心设在公共交通线路附近，以方便老年居民就医。
collocations: locate a fault｜查明故障位置 ; locate the source｜找到源头 ; be located in｜位于 ; centrally located｜位于中心位置的
tip_zh: 表示“位于”常用be located in/near，不直接用locate。

meanings_zh: n. 大头针；别针 | v. 用针别住；钉住 | v. 按住；使不能动
definition_en: a small pointed metal object used to hold things together | to fasten something with a pin or similar object | to hold someone or something firmly so movement is impossible
example1_en: She used a pin to hold the fabric together.
example1_zh: 她用一枚大头针把布料固定在一起。
example2_en: Teachers can pin students' artwork to classroom walls to celebrate creativity and encourage participation.
example2_zh: 教师可以把学生的美术作品钉在教室墙上，以肯定创造力并鼓励参与。
collocations: safety pin｜安全别针 ; drawing pin｜图钉 ; pin something to｜把某物钉在……上 ; pin down｜按住；明确确定
tip_zh: pin作动词时，过去式pinned，进行式pinning。

meanings_zh: adj. 疼痛的；引起疼痛的 | adj. 令人痛苦的；令人难堪的
definition_en: causing physical pain or hurting | causing sadness, distress, or embarrassment
example1_en: My ankle is still painful when I climb stairs.
example1_zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是很疼。
example2_en: For many workers, losing a secure job is a painful experience that affects both confidence and financial stability.
example2_zh: 对许多劳动者而言，失去稳定工作是一段痛苦的经历，既影响信心，也影响经济稳定。
collocations: a painful injury｜令人疼痛的伤 ; a painful experience｜痛苦的经历 ; painful memories｜痛苦的回忆 ; painful to touch｜一碰就疼
tip_zh: painful可指身体疼痛，也可指情感痛苦或难堪。

meanings_zh: v. 判断；评价 | n. 法官 | n. 裁判；评委
definition_en: To form an opinion after considering someone or something. | An official who oversees court proceedings and makes legal decisions. | Someone who assesses performances or decides the winner of a competition.
example1_en: Don't judge the soup until you have tasted it.
example1_zh: 先尝尝这汤，再评价它。
example2_en: Schools should judge students on a range of abilities rather than relying entirely on examination results.
example2_zh: 学校应根据学生的多方面能力作出评价，而不是完全依赖考试成绩。
collocations: judge by appearances｜以貌取人 ; judge fairly｜公正评判 ; a panel of judges｜评审团 ; a court judge｜法院法官
tip_zh: judge A by B表示依据B判断A。

meanings_zh: n. 责任；义务 | n. 工作职责；值勤 | n. 关税；税
definition_en: something you should do because it is right or required | work required by a job or a period of service | a tax charged on certain goods
example1_en: It is my duty to keep these animals safe.
example1_zh: 保护这些动物的安全是我的责任。
example2_en: Governments have a duty to protect vulnerable citizens while ensuring that public services remain financially sustainable.
example2_zh: 政府有责任保护弱势公民，同时确保公共服务在财政上可持续。
collocations: a sense of duty｜责任感 ; on duty｜值班 ; import duty｜进口关税 ; carry out duties｜履行职责
tip_zh: on duty指值班；具体岗位职责常用复数duties。

meanings_zh: n. 申请；申请书 | n. 应用；运用 | n. 应用程序
definition_en: a formal request for a job, place, or permission | the practical use of knowledge, skills, or methods | a computer program designed to perform particular tasks
example1_en: I sent my job application before breakfast this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早饭前，我提交了求职申请。
example2_en: Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.
example2_zh: 简化申请流程可能鼓励更多来自弱势家庭的学生申请大学奖学金。
collocations: submit an application｜提交申请 ; application form｜申请表 ; practical application｜实际应用 ; software application｜软件应用程序
tip_zh: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

meanings_zh: adv. 诚实地；坦诚地 | adv. 说实话；确实
definition_en: In a truthful way, without lying or cheating. | Used to emphasize sincerity or introduce a frank opinion.
example1_en: Please answer honestly: did you enjoy the soup?
example1_zh: 请坦白回答：你喜欢这道汤吗？
example2_en: Companies that communicate honestly about environmental challenges are more likely to earn lasting public trust.
example2_zh: 坦诚说明环境挑战的企业更有可能赢得公众的长期信任。
collocations: answer honestly｜如实回答 ; honestly believe｜真心相信 ; speak honestly｜坦诚地说
tip_zh: honestly重在诚实；表示公正通常用fairly。

meanings_zh: n. 膝盖；膝关节
definition_en: The joint where your leg bends in the middle.
example1_en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
example1_zh: 开始锻炼前，她轻轻弯了弯膝盖。
example2_en: Regular low-impact exercise can strengthen the muscles around the knee and help maintain mobility in older adults.
example2_zh: 经常进行低冲击运动可以增强膝关节周围的肌肉，帮助老年人保持行动能力。
collocations: knee joint｜膝关节 ; knee injury｜膝部损伤 ; bend your knees｜弯曲膝盖 ; on your knees｜跪着
tip_zh: 词首k不发音；复数knees读作/niːz/。

meanings_zh: n. 童年；幼年时期
definition_en: the period of life when someone is a child
example1_en: My happiest childhood memories involve baking with my grandmother.
example1_zh: 我最快乐的童年记忆都与和祖母一起烘焙有关。
example2_en: Access to safe outdoor spaces during childhood can support physical development and emotional wellbeing.
example2_zh: 童年时期能够使用安全的户外空间，有助于身体发育和心理健康。
collocations: early childhood｜幼儿时期 ; childhood memories｜童年回忆 ; a happy childhood｜快乐的童年
tip_zh: during childhood泛指童年；in my childhood指我的童年。

meanings_zh: adj. 复杂的；难懂的
definition_en: Having many connected parts and therefore difficult to understand or manage.
example1_en: This recipe is too complicated for a quick lunch.
example1_zh: 这道菜的做法太复杂，不适合赶时间做午饭。
example2_en: Complicated application procedures may discourage eligible students from seeking financial support for their university studies.
example2_zh: 复杂的申请程序可能使符合条件的学生不愿申请大学学业资助。
collocations: complicated procedure｜复杂的程序 ; complicated relationship｜复杂的关系 ; highly complicated｜极其复杂的
tip_zh: 强调复杂难懂；complex也可仅指结构复杂。

meanings_zh: n. 拇指 | v. 快速翻阅
definition_en: The short, thick finger on the side of your hand. | To turn pages quickly without reading everything carefully.
example1_en: I accidentally hit my thumb while hanging a picture.
example1_zh: 挂画时，我不小心砸到了拇指。
example2_en: Many readers thumb through printed magazines before deciding which articles deserve their full attention.
example2_zh: 许多读者会先快速翻阅纸质杂志，再决定仔细阅读哪些文章。
collocations: thumb through｜快速翻阅 ; a thumbs-up｜竖拇指赞许 ; a rule of thumb｜经验法则
tip_zh: b不发音；thumb through表示快速翻阅。

meanings_zh: adv. 出声地
definition_en: With an audible voice rather than silently.
example1_en: Please read the recipe aloud while I mix.
example1_zh: 我搅拌的时候，请把食谱读出来。
example2_en: Reading stories aloud can help young children develop vocabulary and strengthen their understanding of spoken language.
example2_zh: 大声朗读故事可以帮助幼儿积累词汇，并增强他们对口语的理解。
collocations: read aloud｜朗读 ; think aloud｜把想法说出来 ; say aloud｜出声说
tip_zh: aloud强调发出声音，不一定像loudly那样响亮。

meanings_zh: n. 公司；商行 | adj. 坚固的；结实的 | adj. 坚定的；严格的
definition_en: a business that provides goods or professional services | solid and not easily moved or pressed out of shape | unlikely to change a decision or allow rules to be broken
example1_en: My sister works for a small engineering firm.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在一家小型工程公司工作。
example2_en: Each firm should provide regular training to help employees adapt to technological change.
example2_zh: 每家公司都应提供定期培训，帮助员工适应技术变革。
collocations: a law firm｜律师事务所 ; a firm belief｜坚定的信念 ; firm ground｜坚实的地面 ; take a firm stand｜采取坚定立场
tip_zh: 作名词指公司；作形容词可指物体结实或态度坚定。

meanings_zh: n. 待洗或洗好的衣物 | n. 洗衣；洗衣房
definition_en: Clothes and other fabrics waiting to be washed or freshly washed. | The activity of washing clothes, or a place providing this service.
example1_en: Please put your dirty laundry in the basket.
example1_zh: 请把脏衣服放进篮子里。
