example2_en: Shared laundry facilities can reduce water consumption and save space in modern apartment buildings.
example2_zh: 共用洗衣设施可以减少用水量，并节省现代公寓楼的空间。
collocations: do the laundry｜洗衣服 ; dirty laundry｜脏衣物 ; a laundry basket｜洗衣篮 ; laundry facilities｜洗衣设施
tip_zh: 表示衣物或洗衣这件事时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 体积；总量 | n. 音量 | n. 卷；册
definition_en: The space something occupies, or the total amount of something. | The level of loudness of a sound. | A book, especially one belonging to a larger set.
example1_en: Please turn the volume down while the baby sleeps.
example1_zh: 宝宝睡觉时请把音量调低。
example2_en: The growing volume of household waste highlights the need for better recycling facilities in urban areas.
example2_zh: 不断增加的生活垃圾量凸显了城市地区改善回收设施的必要性。
collocations: a high volume of traffic｜很大的交通流量 ; turn down the volume｜调低音量 ; calculate the volume｜计算体积 ; a companion volume｜配套的一卷
tip_zh: volume可指体积、总量或音量；面积用area。

meanings_zh: phr v. 发生；举行
definition_en: to happen
example1_en: The concert will take place in the town hall.
example1_zh: 音乐会将市政厅举行。
example2_en: The meeting took place last Friday.
example2_zh: 会议上周五举行。
tip_zh: take place 表示“发生/举行”，比 happen 更正式。

meanings_zh: adj. 不感兴趣的
definition_en: not wanting to learn about or take part in something
example1_en: Leo seemed uninterested in the game and went outside.
example1_zh: 利奥似乎对游戏不感兴趣，便出去了。
example2_en: Students may appear uninterested in science when lessons offer few opportunities for practical experiments.
example2_zh: 如果课堂很少提供动手实验的机会，学生可能会显得对科学不感兴趣。
collocations: uninterested in politics｜对政治不感兴趣 ; seem uninterested｜显得不感兴趣 ; remain uninterested｜仍然不感兴趣
tip_zh: 接in；勿与表示“公正无私”的disinterested混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 极小的；微小的
definition_en: Extremely small in size or amount.
example1_en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
example1_zh: 一只小小的青蛙从花盆里跳了出来。
example2_en: Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
example2_zh: 即使日常习惯的微小改变，长期下来也能减少家庭能源消耗。
collocations: a tiny amount｜极少量 ; a tiny fraction｜极小部分 ; a tiny village｜小村庄
tip_zh: 比small语气更强，强调小得惊人。

meanings_zh: adj. 痛苦的；难过的 | adj. 悲惨的；令人难受的
definition_en: Very unhappy or uncomfortable | Extremely unpleasant or of very poor quality
example1_en: I felt miserable when rain ruined our picnic plans.
example1_zh: 大雨毁了我们的野餐计划，让我很难过。
example2_en: Overcrowded housing can create miserable living conditions and negatively affect residents' physical and mental health.
example2_zh: 住房过度拥挤会造成恶劣的生活条件，并损害居民的身心健康。
collocations: feel miserable｜感到难过 ; miserable weather｜令人难受的天气 ; miserable conditions｜恶劣的条件
tip_zh: 既可形容人的心情，也可形容天气或生活条件。

meanings_zh: adj. 愿意的；乐意的 | adj. 积极肯干的
definition_en: ready and happy to do something | eager to help or work without needing persuasion
example1_en: I'm willing to help you move this weekend.
example1_zh: 我愿意这周末帮你搬家。
example2_en: Consumers may be more willing to buy sustainable products if prices remain affordable and information is clear.
example2_zh: 如果价格仍可负担且信息清晰，消费者可能更愿意购买可持续产品。
collocations: be willing to do something｜愿意做某事 ; a willing volunteer｜热心的志愿者 ; a willing helper｜乐于帮忙的人
tip_zh: 常用be willing to do，表示愿意，不等于将要。

meanings_zh: n. 夜生活；夜间娱乐
definition_en: Entertainment and social activities available in a place at night
example1_en: We enjoyed the city's nightlife after dinner by the river.
example1_zh: 在河边吃过晚饭后，我们体验了这座城市的夜生活。
example2_en: A vibrant nightlife can attract tourists and create jobs, but noise may disturb local residents.
example2_zh: 丰富的夜生活可以吸引游客并创造就业机会，但噪声可能扰民。
collocations: vibrant nightlife｜充满活力的夜生活 ; enjoy the nightlife｜享受夜生活 ; nightlife scene｜夜间娱乐场景
tip_zh: nightlife通常不可数，指夜间社交娱乐活动。

meanings_zh: adj. 结冰的；覆冰的 | adj. 冰冷的 | adj. 冷漠的；不友好的
definition_en: Covered with ice. | Extremely cold. | Showing no warmth or friendliness.
example1_en: We walked slowly along the icy path this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，我们沿着结冰的小路慢慢走。
example2_en: Local authorities should treat icy roads promptly to reduce accidents and maintain reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 地方政府应及时处理结冰路面，以减少事故并保障公共交通可靠运行。
collocations: icy roads｜结冰的道路 ; icy water｜冰冷的水 ; an icy stare｜冷冰冰的凝视
tip_zh: icy既可指覆冰或极冷，也可形容态度冷漠。

meanings_zh: phr v. 看起来像；好像
definition_en: to have the appearance of, or seem
example1_en: He looks like his father.
example1_zh: 他长得像他爸爸。
example2_en: It looks like it's going to snow.
example2_zh: 看起来要下雪了。
tip_zh: look like 表示“长得像/看起来像”。

meanings_zh: n. 收银台；结账处
definition_en: the place in a shop where you pay
example1_en: The checkout has a long queue today.
example1_zh: 今天收银台排着长队。
example2_en: She put her shopping on the checkout counter.
example2_zh: 她把买的东西放在收银台上。
tip_zh: checkout 是超市/商店的收银结账处。

meanings_zh: adj. 稀有的；罕见的 | adj. 肉煎得嫩生的
definition_en: not common or not happening often | cooked briefly so the inside remains red
example1_en: We spotted a rare bird beside the lake yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在湖边发现了一只罕见的鸟。
example2_en: Protecting rare species requires long-term investment in habitat restoration and effective controls on illegal trade.
example2_zh: 保护稀有物种需要长期投资于栖息地修复，并有效管制非法贸易。
collocations: rare species｜稀有物种 ; rare opportunity｜难得的机会 ; rare steak｜嫩生的牛排
tip_zh: rare形容肉时指内部仍红，熟度低于medium。

meanings_zh: n. 合同；契约 | v. 收缩；缩小 | v. 感染；患上
definition_en: A legally binding agreement between people or organisations. | To become smaller or make something smaller. | To catch or develop a disease.
example1_en: Read the contract carefully before you agree to sign it.
example1_zh: 同意签字之前，要仔细阅读合同。
example2_en: A clear employment contract protects both workers and employers by defining responsibilities, working hours and payment terms.
example2_zh: 明确的劳动合同通过规定职责、工作时间和薪酬条款，保护员工和雇主双方的权益。
collocations: sign a contract｜签订合同 ; employment contract｜劳动合同 ; breach of contract｜违约 ; contract a disease｜感染疾病
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词英/kənˈtrækt/，美同。

meanings_zh: n. 自动取款机
definition_en: a machine that gives you money from your bank account
example1_en: I got some money from the cash machine.
example1_zh: 我从取款机取了些钱。
example2_en: The cash machine is outside the bank.
example2_zh: 取款机在银行外面。
tip_zh: cash machine 是英式说法；美式常说 ATM。

meanings_zh: n. 缺乏；不足 | v. 缺少；没有
definition_en: The absence of something or not having enough of it | Not have something necessary or enough of it
example1_en: A lack of sleep made me tired all morning.
example1_zh: 睡眠不足让我整个上午都很疲惫。
example2_en: Many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with practical science lessons.
example2_zh: 许多乡村学校缺少为学生开设科学实践课所需的资源。
collocations: a lack of resources｜资源短缺 ; lack confidence｜缺乏信心 ; for lack of funding｜因缺少资金 ; a lack of sleep｜睡眠不足
tip_zh: 名词用a lack of；动词直接接宾语，不加of。

meanings_zh: adj. 聋的；听力严重受损的
definition_en: Unable to hear, or able to hear very little.
example1_en: My deaf cousin taught me some useful everyday signs.
example1_zh: 我失聪的表亲教了我一些实用的日常手语。
example2_en: Providing captions and sign language interpretation can make public information more accessible to deaf people.
example2_zh: 提供字幕和手语翻译可以让聋人更方便地获取公共信息。
collocations: deaf people｜聋人 ; born deaf｜先天失聪 ; go deaf｜失去听力
tip_zh: 读音同def；大写Deaf可强调聋人文化身份。

meanings_zh: n. 怀疑；不确定 | v. 怀疑；认为不大可能
definition_en: A feeling of uncertainty about whether something is true or possible. | To feel uncertain about something or think it unlikely.
example1_en: I doubt the shop is still open this late.
example1_zh: 这么晚了，我觉得那家店大概已经关门了。
example2_en: There is little doubt that access to clean water is essential for improving public health.
example2_zh: 毫无疑问，获得清洁用水对于改善公共卫生至关重要。
collocations: have doubts about｜对……有疑虑 ; no doubt｜无疑 ; cast doubt on｜使人怀疑 ; beyond doubt｜毫无疑问
tip_zh: b不发音；I doubt that常表示认为某事不大可能。

meanings_zh: adj. 身体不适的；生病的
definition_en: feeling ill or not in good health
example1_en: I felt unwell and went home before lunch.
example1_zh: 我感觉身体不适，午饭前就回家了。
example2_en: Employees who feel unwell should be encouraged to stay home to prevent infections spreading at work.
example2_zh: 应鼓励身体不适的员工居家休息，以防感染在工作场所传播。
collocations: feel unwell｜感觉不舒服 ; become unwell｜身体开始不适 ; slightly unwell｜略感不适
tip_zh: 常放在feel或be后作表语，不常放在名词前。

meanings_zh: adj. 最初的；原来的 | adj. 独创的；新颖的 | n. 原件；原作
definition_en: existing at the beginning, before any changes | new and different rather than copied from something else | the first version from which copies are made
example1_en: The kitchen still has its original wooden floor.
example1_zh: 厨房仍保留着原来的木地板。
example2_en: Schools should encourage original thinking rather than reward students only for repeating information from textbooks.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励独创性思考，而不是只奖励复述课本知识的学生。
collocations: original plan｜最初的计划 ; original design｜原创设计 ; original research｜原创研究 ; original version｜原始版本
tip_zh: 可指最初的，也可指原创的；看语境区分。

meanings_zh: adj. 人的；人类的 | n. 人；人类成员
definition_en: Relating to people rather than animals or machines. | A person, as distinct from an animal or machine.
example1_en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
example1_zh: 这个机器人能识别熟悉的人声。
example2_en: Human activity has significantly altered natural habitats, making wildlife conservation an urgent priority for governments.
example2_zh: 人类活动已显著改变自然栖息地，使野生动物保护成为各国政府迫切需要优先处理的事项。
collocations: human beings｜人类 ; human rights｜人权 ; human activity｜人类活动 ; human error｜人为失误
tip_zh: human是“人类的”；humane是“人道的”。

meanings_zh: n. 和平；和睦 | n. 安宁；平静
definition_en: a situation without war, fighting, or serious disagreement | a state of quietness or freedom from worry
example1_en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
example1_zh: 我喜欢早餐前这座花园里的宁静。
example2_en: Lasting peace depends on cooperation between communities and fair access to essential resources.
example2_zh: 持久和平有赖于各群体之间的合作以及公平获取基本资源的机会。
collocations: lasting peace｜持久和平 ; peace and quiet｜清静 ; peace of mind｜安心 ; peace talks｜和平谈判
tip_zh: 通常不可数；peace of mind表示安心、心安。

meanings_zh: n. 海浪；波浪；波 | v. 挥手；挥舞 | n. 浪潮；一阵
definition_en: A moving ridge of water or a travelling energy disturbance. | To move a hand or object repeatedly as a signal. | A sudden increase or spread of something.
example1_en: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
example1_zh: 一个大浪冲过了我们的小沙堡。
example2_en: Coastal wetlands can absorb wave energy, helping to protect nearby settlements from erosion and storm damage.
example2_zh: 沿海湿地能够吸收波浪能量，帮助保护附近居民区免受侵蚀和风暴破坏。
collocations: wave goodbye｜挥手告别 ; wave at someone｜向某人挥手 ; sound waves｜声波 ; a wave of protests｜一波抗议
tip_zh: 向某人挥手用wave at或wave to someone。

meanings_zh: n. 两周；十四天
definition_en: A period of two weeks.
example1_en: We're spending a fortnight by the sea this summer.
example1_zh: 今年夏天我们要在海边待两周。
example2_en: Allowing employees to work remotely for a fortnight could help employers evaluate the benefits of flexible working.
example2_zh: 允许员工远程工作两周，可以帮助雇主评估灵活办公的益处。
collocations: a fortnight ago｜两周前 ; in a fortnight｜两周后 ; once a fortnight｜每两周一次
tip_zh: 主要用于英式英语；美式通常说two weeks。

meanings_zh: phr. 以名字；凭名字
definition_en: using the name of a person or thing
example1_en: The teacher knows every student by name.
example1_zh: 老师认识每个学生的名字。
example2_en: Please address the letter to me by name.
example2_zh: 请把信写上我的名字寄给我。
tip_zh: know sb by name 是“知道某人的名字”。

meanings_zh: n. 天气预报
definition_en: a report about tomorrow's weather
example1_en: The weather forecast says it will be sunny tomorrow.
example1_zh: 天气预报说明天晴朗。
example2_en: We watched the weather forecast before the trip.
example2_zh: 旅行前我们看了天气预报。
tip_zh: weather forecast 是天气预报；forecast 也作动词“预报”。

meanings_zh: pron. 无论什么；任何事物 | det. 无论哪种；任何的
definition_en: anything that; no matter what | any kind of something, without restriction
example1_en: You can choose whatever you like for dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚晚餐你想吃什么都可以选。
example2_en: Whatever their background, students should have equal access to high-quality education and appropriate learning support.
example2_zh: 无论背景如何，学生都应平等地获得优质教育和适当的学习支持。
collocations: whatever happens｜无论发生什么 ; whatever the reason｜无论原因是什么 ; whatever you like｜任何你喜欢的东西
tip_zh: whatever不限范围；whichever常指限定范围内任选。

meanings_zh: n. 亲戚；亲属 | adj. 相对的；比较而言的
definition_en: A person connected to you by blood or marriage. | Judged by comparison rather than by a fixed standard.
example1_en: A relative brought us homemade bread during the holidays.
example1_zh: 假期里，一位亲戚给我们带来了自制面包。
example2_en: The relative cost of public transport influences whether residents choose buses over private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通的相对费用会影响居民是否选择公交车而非私家车。
collocations: a close relative｜近亲 ; a distant relative｜远亲 ; relative importance｜相对重要性 ; relative to｜相对于
tip_zh: 作名词指亲属；作形容词常与to连用表示比较。

meanings_zh: phr. 结束；完了
definition_en: to have finished
example1_en: The lesson is over at half past three.
example1_zh: 课三点半结束。
example2_en: When the film was over, we went home.
example2_zh: 电影结束后我们回家了。
tip_zh: be over 表示“结束”；The concert is over. 音乐会结束了。

meanings_zh: v. 流动；流通 | n. 流动；流量
definition_en: To move continuously, like water through a channel. | Continuous movement, or the amount moving through a place.
example1_en: Rainwater flowed down the path and into the garden.
example1_zh: 雨水沿着小路流进了花园。
example2_en: Improved public transport can ease the flow of traffic and reduce air pollution in crowded cities.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以使交通更加顺畅，并减少拥挤城市的空气污染。
collocations: flow into｜流入 ; traffic flow｜交通流量 ; cash flow｜现金流 ; flow rate｜流量
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为flowed，不是flew。

meanings_zh: phr. 恋爱中的；相爱的
definition_en: feeling strong love for someone
example1_en: They are deeply in love with each other.
example1_zh: 他们深深相爱。
example2_en: She fell in love with the city at first sight.
example2_zh: 她第一眼就爱上了这座城市。
collocations: fall in love｜爱上
tip_zh: fall in love with 是“爱上”；be in love 是“恋爱中”。

meanings_zh: v. 抓住；猛地拿取 | v. 匆忙吃喝或获取 | v. 吸引注意
definition_en: to take hold of something suddenly or firmly | to get food, drink, or something else quickly | to attract someone's attention strongly
example1_en: She grabbed her umbrella and ran towards the bus.
example1_zh: 她抓起雨伞，朝公交车跑去。
example2_en: Public health campaigns often use striking images to grab attention and encourage people to change unhealthy habits.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传常用醒目的图片吸引注意，鼓励人们改变不健康的习惯。
collocations: grab someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意 ; grab a bite｜匆忙吃点东西 ; grab an opportunity｜抓住机会
tip_zh: grab较口语化；过去式grabbed，分词grabbing。

meanings_zh: adj. 损坏的；受损的
definition_en: broken or harmed
example1_en: The damaged bike cannot be ridden anymore.
example1_zh: 这辆损坏的自行车不能再骑了。
example2_en: She returned the damaged phone to the shop.
example2_zh: 她把损坏的手机退回商店。
tip_zh: damaged 是过去分词作形容词“受损的”。

meanings_zh: adv. 经常；频繁地
definition_en: Often or many times
example1_en: Our neighbour frequently brings us vegetables from her garden.
example1_zh: 邻居经常给我们送来她园子里种的蔬菜。
example2_en: People who frequently use public transport may spend less on travel than those who drive daily.
example2_zh: 经常使用公共交通的人，出行开支可能低于每天开车的人。
collocations: frequently asked questions｜常见问题 ; occur frequently｜频繁发生 ; frequently used｜经常使用的
tip_zh: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后，与often近义。

meanings_zh: n.&v. 传真；传真机；发传真
definition_en: a machine that sends copies of documents by phone lines
example1_en: Please send the form by fax.
example1_zh: 请把表格用传真发过来。
example2_en: She faxed the contract to the office.
example2_zh: 她把合同传真到办公室。
collocations: send a fax｜发传真
tip_zh: fax 可作名词“传真”或动词“发传真”。

meanings_zh: phr v. 举起；延误；抢劫
definition_en: to raise something, or to delay
example1_en: Hold up your hand if you have a question.
example1_zh: 有问题请举手。
example2_en: The traffic was held up by an accident.
example2_zh: 交通因事故延误了。
tip_zh: hold up 有“举起、延误、抢劫”等多个意思。

meanings_zh: adv. 通常；一般情况下 | adv. 正常地
definition_en: usually, or in most situations | in the usual, expected, or healthy way
example1_en: I normally walk to work unless it rains heavily.
example1_zh: 除非下大雨，我通常步行上班。
example2_en: Students normally benefit from regular feedback, especially when teachers provide clear guidance on improving their work.
example2_zh: 学生通常能从定期反馈中受益，尤其是在教师明确指导他们改进作业时。
collocations: normally expect｜通常预期 ; function normally｜正常运转 ; breathe normally｜正常呼吸
tip_zh: 既可表频率“通常”，也可表状态“正常地”。

meanings_zh: adv. 如今；现今
definition_en: At the present time, especially compared with the past.
example1_en: Nowadays, I usually pay for groceries with my phone.
example1_zh: 如今，我买食品杂货通常用手机付款。
example2_en: Nowadays, many employees expect flexible working arrangements that allow them to balance professional and family responsibilities.
example2_zh: 如今，许多员工希望有灵活的工作安排，以便兼顾工作和家庭责任。
collocations: nowadays, many people｜如今许多人 ; more common nowadays｜如今更常见 ; rarely used nowadays｜如今很少使用
tip_zh: 常与一般现在时连用，强调今昔对比；不用加介词。

meanings_zh: n. 口香糖 | n. 牙龈 | n. 树胶；胶质
definition_en: A sweet substance chewed but not swallowed | The firm pink flesh surrounding the bases of teeth | A sticky substance from plants, often used for making glue
example1_en: She offered me a piece of mint gum.
example1_zh: 她给了我一片薄荷口香糖。
example2_en: Regular dental checkups can help detect gum disease before it causes serious damage.
example2_zh: 定期进行牙科检查有助于在牙龈疾病造成严重损害前发现问题。
collocations: chewing gum｜口香糖 ; a piece of gum｜一片口香糖 ; gum disease｜牙龈疾病 ; natural gum｜天然树胶
tip_zh: 口香糖不可数；牙龈通常用复数gums。

meanings_zh: n. 人口；全体居民 | n. 种群
definition_en: all people living in an area, or their total number | all organisms of one species living in a particular area
example1_en: The village population grows when families move here.
example1_zh: 有家庭搬来时，村里的人口就会增加。
example2_en: An ageing population can place additional pressure on healthcare systems and increase demand for accessible public transport.
example2_zh: 人口老龄化会给医疗系统带来额外压力，并增加对无障碍公共交通的需求。
collocations: population growth｜人口增长 ; ageing population｜老龄化人口 ; population density｜人口密度 ; bird population｜鸟类种群
tip_zh: 人口多或少用large或small，不用many或few。

meanings_zh: adj. 个人的；本人的 | adj. 私人的；隐私的 | adj. 针对个人的；人身攻击的
definition_en: Belonging or relating to one particular person. | Concerning someone's private life rather than public matters. | Directed at someone's character rather than their ideas or actions.
example1_en: Please keep your personal belongings close while boarding the train.
example1_zh: 上火车时，请将个人物品放在身边。
example2_en: Online services should protect personal information and explain clearly how they collect and use customer data.
example2_zh: 在线服务应保护个人信息，并清楚说明如何收集和使用客户数据。
collocations: personal belongings｜个人物品 ; personal information｜个人信息 ; personal experience｜亲身经历 ; personal attack｜人身攻击
tip_zh: personal指个人的；personnel指全体员工，注意拼写。

meanings_zh: prep. 除了…之外
definition_en: except for, or in addition to
example1_en: Apart from the weather, the trip was perfect.
example1_zh: 除了天气，这次旅行很完美。
example2_en: Everyone came to the party apart from Tom.
example2_zh: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加聚会了。
tip_zh: apart from 既可表“除了…之外（排除）”，也可表“除了…还（补充）”。

meanings_zh: n. 慈善机构 | n. 慈善；救济
definition_en: an organisation that helps people or causes in need | help, especially money, given to those in need
example1_en: My sister volunteers at a charity that rescues dogs.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在一家救助狗的慈善机构做志愿者。
example2_en: Local charities can provide essential support, but governments remain responsible for ensuring access to basic services.
example2_zh: 地方慈善机构可以提供重要支持，但政府仍有责任保障基本服务的可及性。
collocations: donate to charity｜向慈善事业捐款 ; raise money for charity｜为慈善事业筹款 ; charity event｜慈善活动
tip_zh: 指机构时可数；指慈善事业或救济时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 软垫；靠垫 | v. 缓冲；减轻冲击 | n. 缓冲物；保障
definition_en: A soft filled bag used for comfort or support. | To soften an impact or reduce a harmful effect. | Something that protects against difficulty, loss, or sudden change.
example1_en: She put a soft cushion behind her back.
example1_zh: 她在背后放了一个柔软的靠垫。
example2_en: Emergency savings can cushion the financial impact of unemployment and help families maintain their living standards.
example2_zh: 应急储蓄可以减轻失业带来的经济冲击，帮助家庭维持生活水平。
collocations: soft cushion｜柔软的靠垫 ; cushion the impact｜减轻冲击 ; financial cushion｜经济保障
tip_zh: 动词常搭配impact或blow，表示减轻冲击。

meanings_zh: v. 移走；取下；脱去 | v. 清除；消除 | v. 免职；撤职
definition_en: to take something away from where it is | to get rid of something unwanted | to make someone leave a job or position
example1_en: Please remove your shoes before stepping onto the new carpet.
example1_zh: 踩上新地毯前，请先脱鞋。
example2_en: Governments should remove unnecessary barriers that prevent qualified workers from entering the labour market.
example2_zh: 政府应消除阻碍合格劳动者进入劳动力市场的不必要障碍。
collocations: remove stains｜去除污渍 ; remove barriers｜消除障碍 ; remove waste｜清除废弃物 ; remove someone from office｜免去某人职务
tip_zh: 常用 remove A from B，表示从B中移除A。

meanings_zh: v. 消失；不见；失踪 | v. 不复存在；灭绝
definition_en: To become impossible to see or find. | To stop existing.
example1_en: We watched the boat disappear into the thick fog.
example1_zh: 我们看着小船消失在浓雾中。
example2_en: Many traditional crafts may disappear unless governments support skilled workers and encourage younger generations to learn them.
example2_zh: 除非政府支持技艺工人并鼓励年轻一代学习，否则许多传统手艺可能消失。
collocations: disappear from view｜从视野中消失 ; disappear without a trace｜消失得无影无踪 ; disappear completely｜完全消失
tip_zh: 通常是不及物动词，不说 be disappeared。

meanings_zh: phr. 用手；手工
definition_en: done using hands, not a machine
example1_en: The card was made by hand.
example1_zh: 这张卡片是手工制作的。
example2_en: Please sign the form by hand.
example2_zh: 请用手写签名。
tip_zh: by hand 表示“手工地”；made by hand 手工制作。

meanings_zh: phr. 目前；现在
definition_en: now, at this time
example1_en: At present, she is studying in London.
example1_zh: 目前她在伦敦学习。
example2_en: At present, the shop is closed for repairs.
example2_zh: 目前这家店因装修停业。
tip_zh: at present 是书面语“目前”，等于 now/currently。

meanings_zh: adj. 暂时的；临时的
definition_en: Lasting for only a limited period of time.
example1_en: This temporary desk will do until the new one arrives.
example1_zh: 新书桌送来之前，先用这张临时桌子就行。
example2_en: Temporary accommodation provides essential shelter while families wait for suitable permanent housing to become available.
example2_zh: 在家庭等待合适的永久住房期间，临时住处提供了必要的栖身之所。
collocations: temporary accommodation｜临时住处 ; temporary job｜临时工作 ; temporary solution｜临时解决办法 ; temporary closure｜临时关闭
tip_zh: 强调持续时间有限，反义词为permanent。

meanings_zh: adj. 犯罪的；刑事的 | n. 罪犯
definition_en: relating to crime or the legal treatment of crime | a person who has committed a crime
example1_en: The police found evidence of criminal activity in the warehouse.
example1_zh: 警方在仓库里发现了犯罪活动的证据。
example2_en: Education and employment programmes may reduce criminal behaviour by providing young people with better opportunities.
example2_zh: 教育和就业项目可以为年轻人提供更好的机会，从而可能减少犯罪行为。
collocations: criminal offence｜刑事犯罪 ; criminal record｜犯罪记录 ; criminal justice system｜刑事司法体系 ; criminal behaviour｜犯罪行为
tip_zh: criminal 可作形容词或名词；crime 是“罪行”。

meanings_zh: v. 吸引；引起兴趣 | v. 吸引靠近
definition_en: Make someone interested in or drawn towards something | Pull something closer through a physical force
example1_en: The bright flowers attract butterflies to our small balcony.
example1_zh: 鲜艳的花朵把蝴蝶吸引到我们的小阳台上。
example2_en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport are more likely to attract businesses and skilled workers.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市更有可能吸引企业和技术人才。
collocations: attract attention｜吸引注意 ; attract tourists｜吸引游客 ; attract investment｜吸引投资 ; attract customers｜吸引顾客
tip_zh: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 零花钱
definition_en: small money given to children by parents
example1_en: She saves her pocket money to buy books.
example1_zh: 她存零花钱买书。
example2_en: My pocket money is ten pounds a week.
example2_zh: 我的零花钱是每周十英镑。
tip_zh: pocket money 是孩子每周的零花钱；美式说 allowance。

meanings_zh: v. 操作；运转 | v. 经营；运营 | v. 做手术
definition_en: to control equipment, or to work as a machine | to run a business or provide a service | to perform surgery on a patient
example1_en: Can you show me how to operate this printer?
example1_zh: 你能教我怎么操作这台打印机吗？
example2_en: Companies that operate in rural areas often face higher transport costs and limited access to skilled workers.
example2_zh: 在农村地区经营的公司往往面临较高的运输成本，而且难以找到技术熟练的员工。
collocations: operate machinery｜操作机器 ; operate a business｜经营企业 ; operate on a patient｜给病人做手术 ; operate efficiently｜高效运转
tip_zh: 操作机器直接接宾语；给某人做手术用operate on。

meanings_zh: n. 战斗；战役 | n. 斗争；艰苦努力 | v. 奋力斗争；搏斗
definition_en: A fight between armed forces. | A difficult struggle to achieve something or overcome a problem. | To struggle hard against someone or something.
example1_en: The museum displays armour from a famous battle.
example1_zh: 博物馆展出了某场著名战役中使用的盔甲。
example2_en: The battle against air pollution requires coordinated action from governments, businesses, and individuals across urban areas.
example2_zh: 对抗空气污染需要城市各地的政府、企业和个人协调行动。
collocations: win a battle｜赢得战斗 ; an uphill battle｜艰巨的斗争 ; battle against pollution｜与污染作斗争 ; battle for survival｜为生存而斗争
tip_zh: battle可指具体战斗，也常比喻与疾病或困难抗争。

meanings_zh: adj. 不必要的；多余的
definition_en: Not needed or serving no useful purpose.
example1_en: Bring a light jacket, but heavy boots are unnecessary.
example1_zh: 带一件薄外套吧，但厚靴子就没必要了。
example2_en: Clear instructions can prevent unnecessary delays and help public services operate more efficiently.
example2_zh: 清晰的指引可以避免不必要的延误，帮助公共服务更高效地运作。
collocations: unnecessary expense｜不必要的开支 ; unnecessary stress｜不必要的压力 ; avoid unnecessary delays｜避免不必要的延误
tip_zh: 表示“没必要做”可用 it is unnecessary to do。

meanings_zh: v. 破坏；糟蹋 | v. 溺爱；宠坏 | v. 变质；使变质
definition_en: To make something less enjoyable, useful, or attractive. | To give someone excessive attention or everything they want. | To become, or make food become, unfit to eat.
example1_en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
example1_zh: 请别告诉你姐姐，免得破坏这份惊喜。
example2_en: Poorly planned construction can spoil natural landscapes and reduce their appeal to both residents and tourists.
example2_zh: 规划不当的建设会破坏自然景观，降低其对居民和游客的吸引力。
collocations: spoil the surprise｜破坏惊喜 ; spoil a child｜宠坏孩子 ; spoil your appetite｜影响食欲
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均可用spoiled或spoilt。

meanings_zh: v. 流血；出血
definition_en: To lose blood from a wound or inside the body.
example1_en: My finger started to bleed after a small paper cut.
example1_zh: 我的手指被纸轻轻划了一下，开始流血了。
example2_en: First aid courses teach people how to respond safely when minor injuries cause someone to bleed.
example2_zh: 急救课程教人们在轻伤导致出血时如何安全应对。
collocations: bleed heavily｜大量出血 ; bleed internally｜内出血 ; stop the bleeding｜止血
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为bled；blood是名词“血”。

meanings_zh: conj. 虽然；尽管
definition_en: despite the fact that
example1_en: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
example1_zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是走回了家。
example2_en: Although renewable energy requires substantial initial investment, it can lower electricity costs in the long term.
example2_zh: 虽然可再生能源需要大量前期投资，但从长远来看，它能降低电力成本。
collocations: although it is true that｜虽然确实…… ; although not always｜虽然并非总是
tip_zh: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

meanings_zh: v. 避免；防止 | v. 避开；躲避
definition_en: to prevent something from happening or refrain from doing something | to stay away from someone or something
example1_en: We left early to avoid the morning traffic.
example1_zh: 我们很早就出发了，以避开早高峰的车流。
example2_en: Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.
example2_zh: 城市应改善公共交通，以避免交通拥堵和空气污染进一步加剧。
collocations: avoid doing something｜避免做某事 ; avoid mistakes｜避免犯错 ; avoid contact｜避免接触
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 有创造力的；创新的
definition_en: Able to produce original ideas, or involving imagination.
example1_en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
example1_zh: 我富有创意的姐姐把旧罐子变成了彩色灯具。
example2_en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
example2_zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。
collocations: creative thinking｜创造性思维 ; creative writing｜创意写作 ; a creative solution｜创新的解决方案
tip_zh: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。

meanings_zh: phr v. 装满；加满（油）
definition_en: to make something completely full
example1_en: We filled up the car with petrol.
example1_zh: 我们把汽车加满了油。
example2_en: Fill up the bottle with water, please.
example2_zh: 请把瓶子装满水。
collocations: fill up the tank｜加满油箱
tip_zh: fill up 是“装满/加满”；加油时也说 fill it up。

meanings_zh: n. 地区；行政区
definition_en: An area defined by its features or official boundaries.
example1_en: We found a small bakery in the old market district.
example1_zh: 我们在老市场区找到了一家小面包店。
example2_en: Improving public transport in suburban districts can reduce car dependence and widen access to employment.
example2_zh: 改善郊区的公共交通可以减少对汽车的依赖，并增加就业机会。
collocations: residential district｜住宅区 ; business district｜商业区 ; school district｜学区 ; electoral district｜选区
tip_zh: 可指行政划分，也可指具有特定功能的城区。

meanings_zh: adj. 普遍的；总体的 | adj. 大致的；非具体的 | n. 将军
definition_en: affecting or involving most people, things, or situations | describing main points rather than particular details | an officer with a very high rank in the army
example1_en: There was general agreement that the kitchen needed repainting.
example1_zh: 大家普遍同意厨房需要重新刷漆。
example2_en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
example2_zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。
collocations: in general｜一般来说 ; general public｜公众 ; general knowledge｜常识 ; general overview｜总体概述
tip_zh: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

meanings_zh: adv. 是的；嗯（口语）
definition_en: informal way of saying yes
example1_en: 'Are you coming?' 'Yeah, I'll be there.'
example1_zh: “你来吗？”“嗯，我会去的。”
example2_en: Yeah, I really like this song.
example2_zh: 是啊，我真的很喜欢这首歌。
tip_zh: yeah 是 yes 的口语形式，非正式场合用。

meanings_zh: v. 责怪；归咎于 | n. 责任；责备
definition_en: To consider someone or something responsible for a problem. | Responsibility for something bad that has happened.
example1_en: Don't blame me for the broken kitchen chair.
example1_zh: 别把厨房椅子坏了的事怪到我头上。
example2_en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
example2_zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。
collocations: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人 ; blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人 ; take the blame｜承担责任 ; be to blame｜应负责任
tip_zh: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。

meanings_zh: n. 自动取款机（英式）
definition_en: a machine that gives cash (British English)
example1_en: There's a cashpoint around the corner.
example1_zh: 拐角处有一台取款机。
example2_en: I need to find a cashpoint to get money.
example2_zh: 我需要找台取款机取钱。
tip_zh: cashpoint 是英式说法，等于 ATM。

meanings_zh: adj. 中等教育的；中学的 | adj. 次要的；辅助的
definition_en: Relating to education after primary school and before higher education. | Less important than something else.
example1_en: My sister starts secondary school after the summer holidays.
example1_zh: 暑假过后，我妹妹就要上中学了。
example2_en: Access to quality secondary education can improve employment prospects for young people in rural communities.
example2_zh: 获得优质中等教育的机会可以改善农村年轻人的就业前景。
collocations: secondary school｜中学 ; secondary education｜中等教育 ; of secondary importance｜次要的 ; secondary to｜次于
tip_zh: 表示“次于”用secondary to，不用secondary than。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……下面 | adv. 在下面；在底下
definition_en: Directly below something, often covered or hidden by it. | In a lower position, often beneath a covering.
example1_en: Your slippers are underneath the chair by the bed.
example1_zh: 你的拖鞋在床边那把椅子下面。
example2_en: Insulation installed underneath floors can reduce heat loss and improve energy efficiency in older homes.
example2_zh: 在地板下面铺设保温材料，可以减少老房屋的热量流失并提高能源效率。
collocations: underneath the bed｜在床下面 ; underneath the surface｜在表面之下 ; hidden underneath｜藏在下面
tip_zh: 后接名词时是介词；单独使用时是副词。

meanings_zh: adv. 永远 | adv. 老是；不断地
definition_en: for all future time | very often, especially in an annoying way
example1_en: I wish these sunny afternoons could last forever.
example1_zh: 我希望这些阳光明媚的午后能永远持续下去。
example2_en: Without effective conservation measures, some rare animal species could disappear forever within the next few decades.
example2_zh: 如果没有有效的保护措施，一些珍稀动物物种可能在未来几十年内永远消失。
collocations: last forever｜永远持续 ; gone forever｜永远消失 ; forever changing｜不断变化
tip_zh: be forever doing常表示不满：老是做某事。

meanings_zh: v. 允许；准许
definition_en: allowed something; the past tense and past participle of permit
example1_en: We were permitted to feed the goats at noon.
example1_zh: 我们获准在中午给山羊喂食。
example2_en: Students should be permitted to use digital tools when these genuinely support learning rather than distract from it.
example2_zh: 当数字工具确实有助于学习而非分散注意力时，应允许学生使用。
collocations: be permitted to do something｜获准做某事 ; not permitted｜不被允许 ; legally permitted｜法律允许的
tip_zh: permit过去式双写t；被动式后接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 纪念碑；纪念建筑 | n. 历史遗迹；古迹
definition_en: A structure built to honour a person or important event. | An old structure valued for its historical importance.
example1_en: We left flowers beside the monument in the town square.
example1_zh: 我们把鲜花放在镇广场的纪念碑旁。
example2_en: Protecting ancient monuments can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting employment in local communities.
example2_zh: 保护古迹既能增强文化认同，又能吸引游客，为当地社区创造就业机会。
collocations: a monument to｜纪念……的建筑 ; an ancient monument｜古迹 ; a historic monument｜历史遗迹 ; erect a monument｜树立纪念碑
tip_zh: 纪念某人或某事用a monument to。

meanings_zh: v. 锁上；锁定 | n. 锁 | n. 一绺头发
definition_en: to secure something so it cannot open, move, or be accessed | a device that keeps something shut until opened correctly | a small section of someone's hair
example1_en: Please lock the back door before you go upstairs.
example1_zh: 上楼前请把后门锁好。
example2_en: Employees should lock their computers whenever they leave their desks to prevent unauthorised access to confidential information.
example2_zh: 员工离开办公桌时应锁定电脑，以防机密信息被未经授权的人查看。
collocations: lock the door｜锁门 ; lock the screen｜锁屏 ; a door lock｜门锁 ; a lock of hair｜一绺头发
tip_zh: lock是锁上，unlock是解锁；两者不可混用。

meanings_zh: adj. 卷曲的；鬈曲的
definition_en: forming curls or curved shapes, especially when describing hair
example1_en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
example1_zh: 她跑上楼时，一头卷发随着步伐上下弹动。
example2_en: Advertising should represent people with diverse appearances, including those with curly hair and different skin tones.
example2_zh: 广告应展现外貌各异的人，包括卷发者和不同肤色的人。
collocations: curly hair｜卷发 ; naturally curly｜天生卷曲的 ; a curly tail｜卷曲的尾巴
tip_zh: curly卷曲程度明显；wavy通常指轻柔的波浪状。

meanings_zh: v. 烤；炙烤 | n. 烤架；烧烤炉 | v. 严厉盘问；追问
definition_en: To cook food using direct heat from above or below. | A cooking device that exposes food to direct heat. | To question someone intensely, often for a long time.
example1_en: We grilled some peppers and ate them with rice.
example1_zh: 我们烤了些甜椒，配米饭吃。
example2_en: Grilling vegetables with little oil can be a practical way to prepare healthier meals at home.
example2_zh: 用少量油烤蔬菜，是在家制作更健康餐食的一种实用方法。
collocations: grilled fish｜烤鱼 ; a charcoal grill｜炭火烤炉 ; under the grill｜在烤架热源下 ; grill someone about something｜就某事盘问某人
tip_zh: 英式grill常指从上方加热；美式常指从下方烤。

meanings_zh: v. 毁坏；毁掉 | n. 废墟；遗迹 | n. 毁灭；破产
definition_en: to damage something so badly that it loses its value | the remains of a building that has been badly damaged | the complete loss of money, success, or good condition
example1_en: Heavy rain ruined the picnic we had planned.
example1_zh: 大雨毁掉了我们计划好的野餐。
example2_en: Uncontrolled tourism can ruin fragile natural habitats unless visitor numbers and construction activities are carefully managed.
example2_zh: 除非严格管理游客数量和建设活动，否则无序旅游可能毁掉脆弱的自然栖息地。
collocations: ruin someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划 ; ancient ruins｜古代遗迹 ; financial ruin｜经济上的破产 ; in ruins｜成为废墟
tip_zh: 表示建筑遗迹常用复数ruins，如ancient ruins。

meanings_zh: n. 练习；训练 | n. 惯例；做法 | n. 实践；实际应用
definition_en: Repeated activity done to improve a skill. | A usual or established way of doing something. | The actual use of an idea, method, or skill.
example1_en: Daily practice helped me play the guitar more confidently.
example1_zh: 每天练习让我弹吉他时更加自信。
example2_en: Schools should give students opportunities to put scientific knowledge into practice through experiments and practical projects.
example2_zh: 学校应让学生有机会通过实验和实践项目，将科学知识付诸应用。
collocations: regular practice｜定期练习 ; common practice｜惯常做法 ; in practice｜实际上 ; put into practice｜付诸实践
tip_zh: 英式名词用practice，动词用practise；美式均用practice。

meanings_zh: n. 朋友；伙伴 | n. 动物的配偶 | v. 交配；使交配
definition_en: A friend or someone you share an activity with | An animal's partner for breeding | To breed, or bring animals together to breed
example1_en: I'm meeting a mate for lunch near the station.
example1_zh: 我要在车站附近和一个朋友吃午饭。
example2_en: Some bird species stay with the same mate for years, sharing responsibility for raising their young.
example2_zh: 某些鸟类会与同一配偶相伴多年，共同承担养育幼鸟的责任。
collocations: a close mate｜亲密的朋友 ; find a mate｜寻找配偶 ; mate for life｜终生配对
tip_zh: 表示朋友时属英式非正式用语，正式写作宜用friend。

meanings_zh: n. 银行账户
definition_en: an arrangement with a bank to keep your money
example1_en: She opened a bank account to save her pocket money.
example1_zh: 她开了个银行账户存零花钱。
example2_en: You need your ID to open a bank account.
example2_zh: 开银行账户需要身份证件。
collocations: open a bank account｜开银行账户
tip_zh: open a bank account 是“开户”；save money 存钱。

meanings_zh: adj. 狭窄的 | adj. 有限的；勉强的 | v. 缩小；变窄
definition_en: having little distance from one side to the other | limited in range or achieved by only a small margin | to become or make something less wide or extensive
example1_en: The narrow path only allows us to walk single file.
example1_zh: 这条狭窄的小路只容得下我们排成一列走。
example2_en: Governments should invest in rural schools to narrow the educational gap between urban and remote communities.
example2_zh: 政府应投资乡村学校，缩小城市与偏远社区之间的教育差距。
collocations: a narrow street｜狭窄的街道 ; a narrow victory｜险胜 ; narrow the gap｜缩小差距 ; narrow down the options｜缩小选择范围
tip_zh: narrow down表示缩小选择范围，不指道路变窄。

meanings_zh: v. 帮助；协助
definition_en: To help someone do something.
example1_en: A friendly librarian assisted me with the printer.
example1_zh: 一位友善的图书管理员帮我使用了打印机。
example2_en: Local volunteers can assist older residents with online services, making essential information more accessible.
example2_zh: 当地志愿者可以帮助老年居民使用在线服务，让他们更容易获取重要信息。
collocations: assist someone with something｜帮助某人处理某事 ; assist in doing something｜协助做某事 ; assist someone to do something｜帮助某人做某事
tip_zh: 比help正式；常用assist someone with something。

meanings_zh: conj. 只要；和…一样长
definition_en: if; on condition that
example1_en: You can borrow the book as long as you return it.
example1_zh: 只要你归还，就可以借这本书。
example2_en: We'll play football as long as it doesn't rain.
example2_zh: 只要不下雨，我们就踢足球。
tip_zh: as long as 引导条件从句，表示“只要”。

meanings_zh: n. 饥饿；食物匮乏 | n. 渴望 | v. 渴望；渴求
definition_en: the need for food or suffering caused by its lack | a strong desire for something | to want something very strongly
example1_en: A bowl of warm soup quickly satisfied my hunger.
example1_zh: 一碗热汤很快就让我不饿了。
example2_en: Reducing global hunger requires reliable food supplies as well as better access to education and employment.
example2_zh: 减少全球饥饿既需要可靠的食物供应，也需要更多受教育和就业的机会。
collocations: satisfy your hunger｜填饱肚子 ; combat hunger｜抗击饥饿 ; a hunger for knowledge｜求知欲 ; hunger for success｜渴望成功
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；渴望某物用hunger for。

meanings_zh: n. 发烧；发热 | n. 狂热；极度兴奋
definition_en: a body temperature higher than normal, usually caused by illness | intense excitement shared by a person or group
example1_en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
example1_zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。
example2_en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
example2_zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。
collocations: have a fever｜发烧 ; a high fever｜高烧 ; a mild fever｜低烧 ; football fever｜足球热
tip_zh: 表示发烧常说have a fever，也可说have a temperature。

meanings_zh: n. 石头；石料 | n. 结石 | n. 果核
definition_en: Hard natural material from the ground, or a piece of it. | A hard mass that forms inside an organ. | The hard central part of some fruits containing the seed.
example1_en: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
example1_zh: 她在湖边捡起了一块光滑的石头。
example2_en: Buildings constructed from local stone can preserve regional character and reduce the environmental costs of transporting materials.
example2_zh: 使用当地石料建造的建筑可以保留地域特色，并降低运输建材带来的环境成本。
collocations: made of stone｜石制的 ; precious stone｜宝石 ; kidney stone｜肾结石 ; a stone wall｜石墙
tip_zh: 石料用不可数stone；一块石头用a stone。

meanings_zh: n. 储物柜；带锁小柜
definition_en: a small cupboard for keeping personal belongings secure
example1_en: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
example1_zh: 我把运动鞋留在健身房的储物柜里了。
example2_en: Providing each student with a locker can reduce the weight of bags carried around school.
example2_zh: 为每位学生配备储物柜，可以减轻他们在校园内携带的书包重量。
collocations: locker room｜更衣室 ; school locker｜学校储物柜 ; locker key｜储物柜钥匙
tip_zh: locker通常是存放个人物品的小柜，不指上锁的人。

meanings_zh: n. 全球变暖
definition_en: the rise in the earth's temperature
example1_en: Global warming is caused partly by pollution.
example1_zh: 全球变暖部分是由污染造成的。
example2_en: Many countries are working to stop global warming.
example2_zh: 许多国家正在努力阻止全球变暖。
tip_zh: global warming 是“全球变暖”，与 climate change 相关。

meanings_zh: prep. 关于；有关
definition_en: On the subject of someone or something.
example1_en: I called the hotel regarding our missing suitcase.
example1_zh: 我给酒店打了电话，询问我们丢失的行李箱一事。
example2_en: Schools should consult parents before making major decisions regarding changes to the curriculum or assessment methods.
example2_zh: 学校在就课程或评估方式的调整作出重大决定之前，应征求家长意见。
collocations: information regarding｜关于……的信息 ; questions regarding｜有关……的问题 ; concerns regarding｜对……的担忧
tip_zh: regarding直接接名词，不加to；比about正式。

meanings_zh: adv. 最近；近来
definition_en: during the recent period up to the present
example1_en: Have you been sleeping well lately, or feeling tired?
example1_zh: 你最近睡得好吗，还是觉得疲倦？
example2_en: Lately, researchers have paid greater attention to the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health.
example2_zh: 近来，研究人员更加关注绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。
collocations: have lately become｜近来已变得 ; until lately｜直到最近 ; more often lately｜最近更频繁
tip_zh: 常与现在完成时连用；不要与表示迟到的late混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 深蓝色的；藏青色的
definition_en: very dark blue
example1_en: She wore a navy blue jacket to the interview.
example1_zh: 她穿了一件藏青色夹克去面试。
example2_en: The school uniform is navy blue.
example2_zh: 校服是藏青色的。
tip_zh: navy blue 是深蓝/藏青色。

meanings_zh: phr v. 照顾；处理
definition_en: to look after someone or something
example1_en: She takes care of her younger brother.
example1_zh: 她照顾弟弟。
example2_en: Please take care of the problem before Friday.
example2_zh: 请在周五前处理这个问题。
tip_zh: take care of 是“照顾/处理”，等于 look after。

meanings_zh: adj. 明显的；显而易见的
definition_en: Easy to notice or understand.
example1_en: The muddy footprints made the dog's hiding place obvious.
example1_zh: 泥脚印让狗的藏身处一目了然。
example2_en: The environmental benefits of cycling are obvious, but safer routes are needed to encourage more people to cycle.
example2_zh: 骑自行车的环境效益显而易见，但还需更安全的路线来鼓励更多人骑行。
collocations: an obvious advantage｜明显的优势 ; for obvious reasons｜出于显而易见的原因 ; obvious to everyone｜人人都看得出来
tip_zh: 常用It is obvious that…表示“显然……”。

meanings_zh: phr v. 出现；调高（音量）
definition_en: to arrive, or to increase sound
example1_en: He turned up at the party with his friends.
example1_zh: 他和朋友们出现在聚会上。
example2_en: Turn up the radio; I can't hear it.
example2_zh: 把收音机调大声，我听不见。
tip_zh: turn up 表示“出现”或“调高”。

meanings_zh: adj. 不适合的；不合格的 | adj. 体能差的；不健康的
definition_en: not suitable or good enough for a particular purpose | not physically healthy or strong, often through lack of exercise
example1_en: The rusty bicycle was unfit for the long journey.
example1_zh: 那辆生锈的自行车不适合用来长途骑行。
example2_en: Poor maintenance can make public housing unfit for occupation, putting additional pressure on local authorities.
example2_zh: 维护不善可能使公共住房不宜居住，给地方政府带来额外压力。
collocations: unfit for purpose｜不符合用途要求 ; unfit for human consumption｜不宜供人食用 ; physically unfit｜体能差 ; unfit to drive｜不宜驾驶
tip_zh: 常用unfit for sth或unfit to do sth。

meanings_zh: v. 批准；核准 | v. 赞成；认可
definition_en: To officially accept or allow something. | To think that someone or something is good or acceptable.
example1_en: My manager approved my request for a day off.
example1_zh: 经理批准了我请一天假的申请。
example2_en: Local authorities should approve housing developments only when adequate transport and essential services are available.
example2_zh: 地方政府应仅在交通和基本服务充足的情况下批准住宅开发项目。
collocations: approve a proposal｜批准提案 ; approve of something｜赞成某事 ; approve an application｜批准申请
tip_zh: 批准某事用approve；赞成某事用approve of。

meanings_zh: n. 报告；演示 | n. 呈现方式；外观 | n. 颁发；赠送
definition_en: a talk that explains something to an audience | the way something is arranged, shown, or expressed | the formal act of giving something to someone
example1_en: I practised my presentation in front of my sister.
example1_zh: 我在姐姐面前练习了一遍报告。
example2_en: Giving a group presentation allows students to develop communication skills and learn how to divide responsibilities.
example2_zh: 进行小组报告能让学生培养沟通能力，并学习如何分工。
collocations: give a presentation｜作报告 ; oral presentation｜口头报告 ; food presentation｜菜品摆盘 ; award presentation｜颁奖
tip_zh: 作报告用give a presentation；注意present作动词的重音。

meanings_zh: n. 限度；限制 | v. 限制；限定
definition_en: the greatest amount or level that is allowed or possible | to control how much something can increase or happen
example1_en: There is a limit to what this bag can hold.
example1_zh: 这个包能装的东西是有限的。
example2_en: Governments should limit industrial emissions while providing financial support for businesses adopting cleaner production methods.
example2_zh: 政府应限制工业排放，同时为采用更清洁生产方式的企业提供资金支持。
collocations: speed limit｜速度限制 ; time limit｜时间限制 ; set a limit｜设定限度 ; limit something to｜将某事物限制在
tip_zh: limit A to B意为将A限制在B范围内。

meanings_zh: n. 建筑师 | n. 缔造者；设计者
definition_en: Someone whose job is to design buildings | Someone who plans and develops an important change or project
example1_en: The architect showed us a model of our future home.
example1_zh: 建筑师给我们看了未来新家的模型。
example2_en: Architects can reduce energy consumption by designing buildings that make better use of natural light.
example2_zh: 建筑师可以通过设计更充分利用自然光的建筑来降低能耗。
collocations: qualified architect｜有资质的建筑师 ; chief architect｜首席建筑师；主要设计者 ; the architect of reform｜改革的设计者
tip_zh: architect指人，architecture指建筑学或建筑风格。

meanings_zh: n. 纪念品
definition_en: An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.
example1_en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
example1_zh: 我们买了一只小木船作为纪念品。
example2_en: Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
example2_zh: 购买当地制作的纪念品可以支持传统工艺，并为依靠旅游业的社区带来收入。
collocations: souvenir shop｜纪念品商店 ; buy a souvenir｜购买纪念品 ; as a souvenir｜作为纪念品
tip_zh: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活动的纪念品。

meanings_zh: n. 脸颊 | n. 厚脸皮；无礼
definition_en: either side of the face below the eyes | rude behaviour that shows a lack of respect
example1_en: A cold raindrop landed on my cheek outside.
example1_zh: 在外面，一滴冰凉的雨水落在了我的脸颊上。
example2_en: Protective clothing should cover exposed areas, including the cheeks, when people work in extremely cold environments.
example2_zh: 在极寒环境中工作时，防护服应遮住包括脸颊在内的裸露部位。
collocations: rosy cheeks｜红润的脸颊 ; a kiss on the cheek｜脸颊上的一吻 ; have the cheek to｜竟厚着脸皮做 ; cheek by cheek｜脸贴脸
tip_zh: 脸颊义可数；无礼义通常不可数，多用于英式口语。

meanings_zh: n. 志向；抱负 | n. 进取心；雄心
definition_en: A strong desire to achieve a particular goal. | Determination to become successful, powerful, or highly skilled.
example1_en: Her childhood ambition was to design bridges across rivers.
example1_zh: 她儿时的志向是设计跨河大桥。
example2_en: Schools should nurture students' ambition while helping them set realistic goals and develop practical skills.
example2_zh: 学校应培养学生的进取心，同时帮助他们设定切实可行的目标并发展实用技能。
collocations: achieve an ambition｜实现抱负 ; lifelong ambition｜毕生志向 ; political ambition｜政治抱负 ; ambition to succeed｜追求成功的雄心
tip_zh: 具体志向可数，进取心不可数；常接to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 秘密的；保密的 | n. 秘密 | n. 秘诀；诀窍
definition_en: Kept hidden from people who should not know. | Information known only to a limited group of people. | An important way of achieving a particular result.
example1_en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
example1_zh: 我们悄悄为祖父母策划了一次野餐。
example2_en: Governments must balance the need to keep information secret with the public's right to know.
example2_zh: 政府必须在信息保密的需要与公众的知情权之间取得平衡。
collocations: keep a secret｜保守秘密 ; in secret｜秘密地 ; secret information｜机密信息 ; the secret to success｜成功的秘诀
tip_zh: 秘诀常用the secret to，to后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 上升；增加；上涨 | v. 起身；站起来 | n. 上升；增长；上涨
definition_en: To move upwards or become greater in amount or level. | To get up from sitting or lying down. | An increase in amount, level, or value.
example1_en: Warm air rises above the heater beside my desk.
example1_zh: 我书桌旁的暖气上方，热空气向上升腾。
example2_en: A sharp rise in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
example2_zh: 住房成本大幅上涨，迫使许多年轻人推迟搬出去独立居住。
collocations: a sharp rise｜急剧上涨 ; rise steadily｜稳步上升 ; rise to your feet｜站起身 ; a rise in prices｜物价上涨
tip_zh: rise不及物，过去式rose，过去分词risen；raise及物。

meanings_zh: n. 先生；老师（尊称） | n. 爵士（姓名前的头衔）
definition_en: A polite way to address a man or male teacher. | A title used before a knight's or baronet's name.
example1_en: Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
example1_zh: 打扰一下，先生，您忘拿伞了。
example2_en: In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.
example2_zh: 在一些学校，学生上课时用 sir 称呼男教师，以示尊重。
collocations: yes, sir｜是的，先生 ; excuse me, sir｜打扰一下，先生 ; Dear Sir｜尊敬的先生（信函称呼）
tip_zh: 爵士头衔用Sir加名字或全名，不单加姓氏。

meanings_zh: adj. 减少的；降价的
definition_en: made smaller or cheaper
example1_en: The reduced prices attracted many customers.
example1_zh: 降价吸引了许多顾客。
example2_en: She bought the jacket at a reduced price.
example2_zh: 她以折扣价买了这件夹克。
collocations: reduced price｜降价
tip_zh: reduced 表示“减价/降低的”；at a reduced price 打折价。

meanings_zh: phr. （机器）故障；失灵
definition_en: not working (about machines)
example1_en: The lift is out of order, so use the stairs.
example1_zh: 电梯故障，请走楼梯。
example2_en: The ticket machine is out of order today.
example2_zh: 售票机今天出故障了。
tip_zh: out of order 表示机器“故障/不能使用”。

meanings_zh: phr v. 分发；发出
definition_en: to hand things to people, or to produce
example1_en: The teacher gave out the test papers.
example1_zh: 老师分发了试卷。
example2_en: The fire gives out a lot of heat.
example2_zh: 火散发出很多热量。
tip_zh: give out 是“分发”或“发出（光热）”。

meanings_zh: v. 滑动；使滑行 | n. 幻灯片 | n. 滑梯
definition_en: to move smoothly across a surface without lifting | a single image or page shown during a presentation | a sloping structure that children slide down
example1_en: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
example1_zh: 她把盘子沿着桌面推滑到我面前。
example2_en: Teachers can use a carefully designed slide to explain complex scientific processes more clearly.
example2_zh: 教师可以用精心设计的幻灯片更清楚地解释复杂的科学过程。
collocations: slide across｜滑过 ; slide into｜滑入 ; presentation slide｜演示幻灯片 ; go down a slide｜滑滑梯
tip_zh: 动词过去式和过去分词均为slid。

meanings_zh: adj. 最大的；最多的；最高的 | n. 最大值；上限
definition_en: being the greatest amount or level possible or allowed | the greatest amount or level possible or allowed
example1_en: This lift has a maximum capacity of eight people.
example1_zh: 这部电梯最多可容纳八人。
example2_en: Governments should set maximum limits on industrial emissions to protect public health and improve air quality.
example2_zh: 政府应对工业排放设定上限，以保护公众健康并改善空气质量。
collocations: maximum capacity｜最大容量 ; maximum speed｜最高速度 ; a maximum of｜最多 ; reach the maximum｜达到上限
tip_zh: a maximum of表示“最多”；反义词是minimum。

meanings_zh: n. 冠军 | n. 拥护者；捍卫者 | v. 支持；捍卫
definition_en: a person or team that wins a competition | someone who strongly supports a cause or group | to actively support or defend a cause or person
example1_en: The new champion lifted her trophy with both hands.
example1_zh: 新冠军双手举起了奖杯。
example2_en: Local organisations can champion affordable housing by working with residents and presenting practical proposals to councils.
example2_zh: 地方组织可以与居民合作，向地方议会提交切实可行的提案，推动提供可负担住房。
collocations: world champion｜世界冠军 ; defending champion｜卫冕冠军 ; a champion of equality｜平等的拥护者 ; champion a cause｜支持一项事业
tip_zh: 作动词直接接宾语：champion a cause。

meanings_zh: n. 手电筒 | n. 火把；火炬
definition_en: A small electric light carried in the hand. | A stick with burning material at one end, providing light.
example1_en: I used a torch to find my missing keys.
example1_zh: 我用手电筒寻找丢失的钥匙。
example2_en: Hikers should carry a torch and spare batteries when exploring remote areas after sunset.
example2_zh: 徒步者在日落后探索偏远地区时，应携带手电筒和备用电池。
collocations: switch on a torch｜打开手电筒 ; a torch beam｜手电筒的光束 ; carry a torch｜携带火把 ; a flaming torch｜燃烧的火炬
tip_zh: 手电筒英式叫torch，美式叫flashlight。

meanings_zh: adj. 私人的；非公开的 | adj. 私营的；私有的 | adj. 私密的；保密的
definition_en: For a particular person or group, not for everyone. | Owned or managed independently of the government. | Not intended to be known or shared with others.
example1_en: Each guest has a private bathroom beside their bedroom.
example1_zh: 每位客人的卧室旁都有一间专用浴室。
example2_en: Private companies can improve public transport, but governments must ensure that fares remain affordable.
example2_zh: 私营公司可以改善公共交通，但政府必须确保票价仍在民众承受范围内。
collocations: private property｜私有财产 ; private sector｜私营部门 ; private life｜私生活 ; in private｜私下地
tip_zh: in private表示私下地；in public表示公开地。

meanings_zh: adj. 快乐的；乐观的 | adj. 令人愉快的；明快的
definition_en: Feeling or showing happiness and a positive attitude. | Making a place or experience feel bright and pleasant.
example1_en: Our cheerful neighbour waved as we left the house.
example1_zh: 我们出门时，开朗的邻居向我们挥了挥手。
example2_en: A cheerful classroom atmosphere can encourage younger learners to participate more actively in group discussions.
example2_zh: 愉快的课堂氛围能鼓励年幼的学习者更积极地参与小组讨论。
collocations: cheerful smile｜愉快的笑容 ; cheerful mood｜愉悦的心情 ; cheerful atmosphere｜欢快的氛围
tip_zh: 既可形容人心情开朗，也可形容环境明快。

meanings_zh: adj. 愚蠢的；不明智的 | adj. 滑稽的；逗趣的
definition_en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought | Playfully funny in a way that is not serious
example1_en: It was silly to leave my umbrella at home.
example1_zh: 把伞留在家里真是不明智。
example2_en: Teachers should avoid calling any question silly, as this may discourage students from participating in class.
example2_zh: 教师应避免说任何问题愚蠢，因为这可能打击学生参与课堂的积极性。
collocations: silly mistake｜愚蠢的错误 ; silly question｜傻问题 ; silly joke｜无厘头的笑话 ; feel silly｜觉得自己很傻
tip_zh: 语气通常比stupid轻，也可表示逗趣、不正经。

meanings_zh: adj. 极度害怕的；惊恐的
definition_en: Feeling extremely afraid.
example1_en: I was terrified when thunder shook the windows last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚雷声震得窗户发抖时，我吓坏了。
example2_en: Students who are terrified of public speaking may benefit from practising presentations in small, supportive groups.
example2_zh: 极度害怕公开演讲的学生，可以通过在互相支持的小组中练习展示而受益。
collocations: terrified of｜极度害怕 ; terrified at the thought of｜一想到就惊恐 ; absolutely terrified｜吓坏了
tip_zh: 人感到害怕用terrified；事物吓人用terrifying。

meanings_zh: n. 一排；一行 | v. 划船 | n. 争吵；吵闹
definition_en: people or things arranged in a straight line | to move a boat through water using oars | a noisy argument or loud disturbance
example1_en: We found two empty seats in the front row.
example1_zh: 我们在前排找到了两个空座位。
example2_en: Planting a row of trees beside busy roads can help reduce noise and improve local air quality.
example2_zh: 在繁忙道路旁种植一排树木，有助于降低噪声并改善当地空气质量。
collocations: in a row｜排成一排；连续 ; front row｜前排 ; row a boat｜划船 ; have a row｜吵架
tip_zh: “排、划船”读/rəʊ/；“争吵”英美均读/raʊ/。

meanings_zh: n. 税；税款 | v. 对……征税 | v. 使负担沉重；使费尽
definition_en: Money paid to the government to fund public services. | Require someone to pay money to the government. | Put heavy demands on someone's strength or abilities.
example1_en: The tax on my monthly salary has gone up.
example1_zh: 我每月工资要缴的税增加了。
example2_en: Governments can use tax revenue to improve public transport and make healthcare more accessible.
example2_zh: 政府可以利用税收改善公共交通，让医疗服务惠及更多人。
collocations: income tax｜所得税 ; pay tax｜缴税 ; tax revenue｜税收收入 ; tax goods｜对商品征税
tip_zh: tax可作名词或动词；taxing常指费力的、累人的。

meanings_zh: n. 组成；成分 | n. 作文；乐曲 | n. 创作；作曲
definition_en: The parts or substances that something consists of | A piece of writing or music | The activity of creating music or written work
example1_en: We tested the composition of soil in our garden.
example1_zh: 我们检测了自家花园土壤的成分。
example2_en: Changes in the composition of household waste can reveal how consumer habits develop over time.
example2_zh: 生活垃圾构成的变化可以反映消费习惯如何随时间演变。
collocations: chemical composition｜化学成分 ; soil composition｜土壤成分 ; musical composition｜音乐作品 ; write a composition｜写作文
tip_zh: 指构成或创作过程通常不可数；指作品可数。

meanings_zh: adv. 相当；还算 | adv. 公平地；公正地
definition_en: to a moderate degree, but not very | in a way that treats people equally and reasonably
example1_en: The walk home was fairly short and very pleasant.
example1_zh: 走路回家的路程还算短，一路也很惬意。
example2_en: Schools should distribute resources fairly so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds receive the support they need.
example2_zh: 学校应公平分配资源，让背景不利的学生获得所需的支持。
collocations: fairly easy｜还算容易 ; fairly common｜相当常见 ; treat people fairly｜公平待人 ; distribute resources fairly｜公平分配资源
tip_zh: 表程度时弱于very；fairly good是还不错，并非极好。

meanings_zh: mv. 过去常常（现在不再）
definition_en: something happened regularly in the past but not now
example1_en: I used to play the piano when I was young.
example1_zh: 我年轻时曾经常弹钢琴。
example2_en: She used to live in this street.
example2_zh: 她以前住在这条街上。
tip_zh: used to + 动词原形表示过去的习惯；be used to doing 是“习惯做”。

meanings_zh: n. 电缆；线缆 | n. 钢缆；缆绳
definition_en: covered wires carrying electricity or electronic signals | a thick strong rope, usually made of metal wires
example1_en: The charging cable was tangled beneath my desk.
example1_zh: 充电线在我的书桌下面缠成了一团。
example2_en: Undersea cable networks carry vast amounts of data, making them essential infrastructure for international communication and trade.
example2_zh: 海底电缆网络传输大量数据，是国际通信和贸易不可或缺的基础设施。
collocations: power cable｜电源线 ; fibre-optic cable｜光缆 ; undersea cable｜海底电缆 ; steel cable｜钢缆
tip_zh: 既可传电或信号，也可指承重用的钢缆。

meanings_zh: n. 女主角 | n. 女英雄；杰出女性
definition_en: the main female character in a story | a woman admired for courage or remarkable achievements
example1_en: The heroine of this novel sails across the ocean.
example1_zh: 这部小说的女主角驾船横渡大洋。
example2_en: A confident heroine in children's literature can challenge stereotypes and broaden young readers' expectations.
example2_zh: 儿童文学中自信的女主角能够挑战刻板印象，拓宽小读者对未来的期待。
collocations: the heroine of a novel｜小说的女主角 ; a national heroine｜民族女英雄 ; a tragic heroine｜悲剧女主角
tip_zh: 与heroin（海洛因）同音，注意末尾的e。

meanings_zh: n. 感官；感觉能力 | n. 感觉；意识 | v. 察觉；感觉到
definition_en: An ability to perceive through sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell. | A feeling or awareness of something. | To become aware of something without being directly told.
example1_en: Dogs have a much stronger sense of smell than humans.
example1_zh: 狗的嗅觉比人类灵敏得多。
example2_en: Community gardens can strengthen residents' sense of belonging by creating opportunities for regular social interaction.
example2_zh: 社区花园可以创造日常社交机会，从而增强居民的归属感。
collocations: sense of smell｜嗅觉 ; sense of belonging｜归属感 ; common sense｜常识 ; make sense｜有道理；讲得通
tip_zh: make sense指讲得通；make sense of指理解。

meanings_zh: n. 隧道；地下通道 | v. 挖隧道
definition_en: A passage built underground or through a hill. | To dig a passage underground or through something.
example1_en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
example1_zh: 火车驶入了山下的一条漆黑隧道。
example2_en: Building a tunnel under the river could reduce traffic congestion and improve connections between neighbouring districts.
example2_zh: 在河底修建隧道可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善相邻区域之间的交通联系。
collocations: railway tunnel｜铁路隧道 ; dig a tunnel｜挖隧道 ; tunnel through｜挖隧道穿过
tip_zh: 介词 through 常表示从隧道内部穿过。

meanings_zh: n. 金额 | n. 总和；总数 | v. 概括；总结
definition_en: an amount of money | the total obtained by adding amounts together | to state the main points, usually with up
example1_en: She saved a small sum for a new bicycle.
example1_zh: 她为买一辆新自行车攒了一小笔钱。
example2_en: Governments invest large sums in public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 政府在公共交通上投入巨资，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: a large sum of money｜一大笔钱 ; the sum of｜……的总和 ; sum up｜概括；总结
tip_zh: sum up表示总结；一笔钱用a sum of money。

meanings_zh: phr v. 报名；注册
definition_en: to join or register for something
example1_en: She signed up for the swimming course.
example1_zh: 她报名参加了游泳课程。
example2_en: You can sign up for the newsletter online.
example2_zh: 你可以在网上注册订阅新闻通讯。
tip_zh: sign up for 是“报名参加”。

meanings_zh: v. 脱衣服；给某人脱衣服
definition_en: To take off your own clothes or someone else's clothes.
example1_en: I undressed behind the curtain and put on pyjamas.
example1_zh: 我在帘子后脱下衣服，换上睡衣。
example2_en: Healthcare staff should provide private spaces where patients can undress comfortably before a physical examination.
example2_zh: 医护人员应提供私密空间，让患者在体检前安心脱衣。
collocations: get undressed｜脱掉衣服 ; undress for bed｜脱衣就寝
tip_zh: undress可不接宾语；脱某件衣服用take off。

meanings_zh: phr v. 放下；写下
definition_en: to place something down, or to write down
example1_en: Put down your bag and sit down.
example1_zh: 放下包，坐下来。
example2_en: Put down your name on the list.
example2_zh: 在名单上写下你的名字。
tip_zh: put down 表示“放下”或“记下”。

meanings_zh: phr v. 接通（电话）
definition_en: to connect someone on the phone
example1_en: Please put me through to the manager.
example1_zh: 请帮我接通经理。
example2_en: She was put through to the wrong department.
example2_zh: 她被接到了错误的部门。
tip_zh: put through 是电话用语“接通”。

meanings_zh: n. 场面；景象 | n. 事发现场 | n. 一场戏；片段
definition_en: a view or situation that you see | the place where an event happens | a short part of a play or film
example1_en: The children playing by the lake made a peaceful scene.
example1_zh: 孩子们在湖边玩耍，构成了一幅宁静的画面。
example2_en: The film's opening scene highlights the challenges faced by families living in crowded urban neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 影片的开场片段突出了居住在拥挤城市社区的家庭面临的挑战。
collocations: a peaceful scene｜宁静的景象 ; at the scene｜在现场 ; opening scene｜开场片段 ; behind the scenes｜在幕后
tip_zh: scene可数；scenery指整体风景，不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 羽绒被
definition_en: a soft warm quilt for a bed
example1_en: I bought a new duvet for the winter.
example1_zh: 我买了一条新羽绒被过冬。
example2_en: The bed has a white duvet and soft pillows.
example2_zh: 床上有白色羽绒被和柔软的枕头。
tip_zh: duvet 是英式说法，指羽绒被。

meanings_zh: n. 复习；温习 | n. 修改；修订
definition_en: Studying material again to prepare for an examination | The process or result of changing something to improve it
example1_en: I do my revision at the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我在厨房的餐桌旁复习。
example2_en: Regular revision helps students retain knowledge more effectively than studying intensively just before an examination.
example2_zh: 定期复习比考前突击学习更能帮助学生牢固掌握知识。
collocations: do revision｜进行复习 ; revision timetable｜复习时间表 ; major revision｜重大修订
tip_zh: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

meanings_zh: phr. 度假（美式）
definition_en: on holiday (American English)
example1_en: They are on vacation in Hawaii.
example1_zh: 他们在夏威夷度假。
example2_en: The office is closed because the boss is on vacation.
example2_zh: 老板去度假了，办公室关门。
tip_zh: on vacation 是美式说法；英式说 on holiday。

meanings_zh: adv. 通常；一般地 | adv. 普遍地；广泛地
definition_en: In most cases or at most times. | By most people or across most places.
example1_en: I generally walk to work unless it rains.
example1_zh: 除非下雨，否则我通常步行上班。
example2_en: Public transport is generally more energy-efficient than private cars, especially when services carry large numbers of passengers.
example2_zh: 公共交通通常比私家车更节能，尤其是在载客量较大的情况下。
collocations: generally speaking｜一般来说 ; generally accepted｜普遍接受的 ; generally regarded as｜普遍被视为
tip_zh: generally表示多数情况，并非毫无例外；句首可用generally speaking。

meanings_zh: n. 堆；一堆东西 | v. 堆放；堆积
definition_en: Objects placed together, often one on top of another. | To put things together in a heap.
example1_en: A pile of dirty dishes filled the sink.
example1_zh: 一堆脏餐具塞满了水槽。
example2_en: When waste collection services are inadequate, piles of rubbish can threaten public health in densely populated neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 垃圾清运服务不足时，成堆的垃圾可能威胁人口密集社区的公共卫生。
collocations: a pile of books｜一堆书 ; pile up｜堆积起来 ; pile plates on a table｜把盘子堆在桌上
tip_zh: a pile of后接所堆之物；pile up表示积聚。

meanings_zh: adj. 年老的；上了年纪的
definition_en: old, especially when describing people
example1_en: An elderly neighbour showed me how to grow tomatoes.
example1_zh: 一位年长的邻居教我如何种番茄。
example2_en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that elderly residents can remain active and independent.
example2_zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让老年居民能够保持活跃并独立生活。
collocations: elderly people｜老年人 ; elderly residents｜老年居民 ; elderly care｜老年护理
tip_zh: 指人年老，不指中年；older people通常更中性。

meanings_zh: adj. 确信的；有把握的 | adj. 必然的；确定的 | adj. 某个；某些
definition_en: having no doubt about something | definitely going to happen | particular but not named or fully described
example1_en: I'm certain I left my keys on the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我确信自己把钥匙放在厨房桌上了。
example2_en: Certain types of public transport are more suitable for densely populated cities than rural areas.
example2_zh: 某些类型的公共交通更适合人口密集的城市，而非农村地区。
collocations: certain of｜对……有把握 ; certain to happen｜必然发生 ; make certain｜确保 ; certain types of｜某些类型的
tip_zh: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

meanings_zh: adj. 普通的；平常的
definition_en: Normal or usual, without special or unusual features.
example1_en: It looked like an ordinary box until we opened it.
example1_zh: 打开之前，它看起来就是一个普通盒子。
example2_en: Urban planning should reflect the needs of ordinary residents rather than focus exclusively on attracting wealthy investors.
example2_zh: 城市规划应反映普通居民的需求，而不是只顾吸引富有的投资者。
collocations: ordinary people｜普通人 ; ordinary life｜平常生活 ; an ordinary day｜平凡的一天 ; out of the ordinary｜不寻常
tip_zh: ordinary强调不特别；不等于表示平均水平的average。

meanings_zh: n. 手帕
definition_en: A small cloth used for wiping your nose or face.
example1_en: She pulled a clean handkerchief from her coat pocket.
example1_zh: 她从外套口袋里掏出一块干净的手帕。
example2_en: Using a washable handkerchief instead of disposable tissues can reduce everyday household waste.
example2_zh: 使用可清洗的手帕代替一次性纸巾，可以减少日常生活垃圾。
collocations: a clean handkerchief｜干净的手帕 ; a cotton handkerchief｜棉手帕 ; a pocket handkerchief｜口袋手帕
tip_zh: 指擦脸、擦鼻子的手帕，一般不指头巾。

meanings_zh: n. 枪；炮 | n. 枪状工具
definition_en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells | a tool shaped like a gun that releases a substance
example1_en: The old gun was displayed behind glass at the museum.
example1_zh: 那支旧枪陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。
example2_en: Strict gun storage regulations can help prevent accidents and improve safety within local communities.
example2_zh: 严格的枪支存放规定有助于预防事故，提高当地社区的安全水平。
collocations: gun control｜枪支管制 ; a loaded gun｜装有弹药的枪 ; a glue gun｜胶枪 ; a spray gun｜喷枪
tip_zh: gun也可指枪状工具，如glue gun（胶枪）。

meanings_zh: adj. 热衷的；渴望的 | adj. 敏锐的 | adj. 激烈的；强烈的
definition_en: very interested in something or eager to do it | quick to notice or understand things | very strong or intense
example1_en: Leila is keen to join our weekend hiking group.
example1_zh: 莱拉很想加入我们的周末徒步小组。
example2_en: Students who are keen on science benefit from practical experiments that connect theory with everyday experience.
example2_zh: 热爱科学的学生能从将理论与日常经验相结合的实践实验中受益。
collocations: keen to learn｜渴望学习 ; keen on sport｜热衷运动 ; a keen eye for detail｜敏锐的细节观察力 ; keen competition｜激烈的竞争
tip_zh: keen on后接名词或动名词；keen to后接动词原形。

meanings_zh: n. 照料；护理 | v. 关心；在意 | n. 小心；谨慎
definition_en: Support and attention given to someone who needs help | To feel concern or consider something important | Attention given to avoiding mistakes or damage
example1_en: My grandmother receives excellent care at the local clinic.
example1_zh: 我奶奶在当地诊所得到很好的照料。
example2_en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to remain employed while ensuring that young children receive appropriate care.
example2_zh: 价格可负担的托育服务让更多家长能够继续工作，同时确保幼儿得到妥善照料。
collocations: medical care｜医疗护理 ; take care of｜照顾 ; care about｜关心；在意 ; with care｜小心地
tip_zh: care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜欢。

meanings_zh: n. 墨水；油墨 | v. 给…上墨
definition_en: coloured liquid used for writing, drawing or printing | to apply ink to a surface
example1_en: Blue ink leaked from my pen onto my sleeve.
example1_zh: 蓝色墨水从钢笔里漏出来，沾到了我的袖子上。
example2_en: Schools can reduce their environmental impact by using less paper and choosing refillable ink cartridges.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过减少纸张用量和选择可填充墨盒来降低对环境的影响。
collocations: in ink｜用墨水 ; ink cartridge｜墨盒 ; printing ink｜印刷油墨 ; run out of ink｜墨水用完
tip_zh: ink作名词通常不可数；“用墨水写”用in ink。

meanings_zh: adj. 尴尬的；难为情的
definition_en: Feeling uncomfortable or ashamed about something others notice.
example1_en: I felt embarrassed when my phone rang during dinner.
example1_zh: 吃饭时手机响了，我感到很尴尬。
example2_en: Students may feel embarrassed about making mistakes, so teachers should create a supportive classroom environment.
example2_zh: 学生可能因犯错而感到难为情，因此教师应营造支持性的课堂环境。
collocations: feel embarrassed｜感到尴尬 ; embarrassed about｜因……而难为情 ; too embarrassed to ask｜难为情而不敢问
tip_zh: 人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事令人尴尬用embarrassing。

meanings_zh: adj. 残忍的；刻薄的 | adj. 令人痛苦的；无情的
definition_en: Causing suffering without caring about others' feelings. | Causing great suffering or disappointment.
example1_en: It was cruel to laugh at her mistake.
example1_zh: 嘲笑她的错误很刻薄。
example2_en: Schools should address cruel behaviour early to ensure that every child feels safe and respected.
example2_zh: 学校应及早处理伤害他人的行为，确保每个孩子都感到安全并受到尊重。
collocations: be cruel to animals｜虐待动物 ; a cruel remark｜刻薄的话 ; a cruel blow｜沉重的打击
tip_zh: 表示对某人或动物残忍，用be cruel to。

meanings_zh: n. 远足；徒步旅行 | v. 远足；徒步旅行 | n. 大幅上涨
definition_en: A long walk, usually through the countryside or mountains. | To walk a long distance, especially in natural surroundings. | A large increase in a price, cost, or rate.
example1_en: Our weekend hike ended beside a clear mountain lake.
example1_zh: 我们周末的徒步旅行在一片清澈的山间湖泊旁结束。
example2_en: A sharp hike in public transport fares could discourage commuters from choosing buses over private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通票价大幅上涨可能会降低通勤者选择公交车而非私家车的意愿。
collocations: go for a hike｜去远足 ; mountain hike｜山地徒步 ; price hike｜价格大幅上涨
tip_zh: hike通常指较长的户外步行，也可指价格猛涨。

meanings_zh: n. 陌生人 | n. 初到某地的人；外来者
definition_en: someone you do not know | someone unfamiliar with a particular place or community
example1_en: A kind stranger helped me carry my heavy suitcase.
example1_zh: 一位好心的陌生人帮我提了沉重的行李箱。
example2_en: Community events can encourage residents to interact with strangers and develop a stronger sense of belonging.
example2_zh: 社区活动可以鼓励居民与陌生人交流，增强归属感。
collocations: complete stranger｜完全不认识的人 ; stranger to the area｜初到这一地区的人 ; no stranger to｜对……并不陌生
tip_zh: stranger是陌生人，不等于foreigner外国人。

meanings_zh: phr v. 留下；留在后面
definition_en: to remain in a place after others leave
example1_en: A few students stayed behind to ask questions.
example1_zh: 几个学生留下来问问题。
example2_en: Please stay behind after the meeting for a moment.
example2_zh: 会后请留一下。
tip_zh: stay behind 表示“留在原处（别人走后）”。

meanings_zh: n. 选举 | n. 当选
definition_en: a process in which people vote to choose representatives | the act of being chosen for a position by voting
example1_en: Our club is holding an election for its next chair.
example1_zh: 我们俱乐部正在举行选举，选出下一任主席。
example2_en: A fair election requires transparent procedures and equal opportunities for candidates to present their policies.
example2_zh: 公平的选举需要透明的程序，并让候选人有平等机会介绍其政策。
collocations: hold an election｜举行选举 ; general election｜大选 ; election campaign｜竞选活动 ; win an election｜赢得选举
tip_zh: elect强调投票选出；select泛指挑选。

meanings_zh: n. 影子；阴影 | v. 跟随观察；跟岗学习
definition_en: A dark shape or area where something blocks light. | To follow someone closely, often to learn about their work.
example1_en: The cat chased its shadow across the sunny kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 猫在阳光照着的厨房地板上追逐自己的影子。
example2_en: Allowing students to shadow experienced nurses can help them understand the practical demands of a healthcare career.
example2_zh: 让学生跟随经验丰富的护士学习，有助于他们了解医疗职业的实际要求。
collocations: cast a shadow｜投下影子 ; in the shadows｜在暗处 ; job shadowing｜跟岗学习
tip_zh: shadow指具体影子；shade多指遮阳的阴凉处。

meanings_zh: adj. 不公平的；不公正的
definition_en: not treating people equally or reasonably
example1_en: It seems unfair that I always wash the dishes.
example1_zh: 总是让我洗碗，这似乎不公平。
example2_en: Unfair hiring practices can prevent qualified applicants from accessing employment opportunities and reduce diversity in the workplace.
example2_zh: 不公平的招聘做法可能使合格的求职者失去就业机会，并降低职场的多样性。
collocations: unfair treatment｜不公平待遇 ; unfair advantage｜不公平的优势 ; unfair competition｜不公平竞争 ; unfair to someone｜对某人不公平
tip_zh: 表示“对某人不公平”用unfair to someone。

meanings_zh: n. 小学
definition_en: a school for young children
example1_en: My son goes to the local primary school.
example1_zh: 我儿子在本地小学上学。
example2_en: Primary school starts at nine in the morning.
example2_zh: 小学早上九点上课。
tip_zh: primary school 是英式“小学”；美式说 elementary school。

meanings_zh: n. 问候；致意
definition_en: good wishes sent to someone
example1_en: Please give my regards to your parents.
example1_zh: 请代我向你父母问好。
example2_en: With best regards, Anna.
example2_zh: 此致最美好的祝愿，安娜。
collocations: best regards｜致以最美好的祝愿
tip_zh: best regards 是信件结尾敬语；give my regards to 是“代我问候”。

meanings_zh: v. 数；计数 | v. 重要；有价值 | n. 计数；总数
definition_en: to find how many things there are | to matter or have an important effect | the act of counting, or the total found
example1_en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
example1_zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下盘子。
example2_en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
example2_zh: 评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。
collocations: count up｜合计 ; lose count｜数不清；忘记数到哪里 ; count on someone｜依靠某人 ; every minute counts｜每分钟都很重要
tip_zh: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。

meanings_zh: n. 情况；形势；处境
definition_en: The conditions and events affecting someone or something at a time.
example1_en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
example1_zh: 汽车抛锚时，我们陷入了困境。
example2_en: The housing situation has become increasingly difficult for young people living in major cities.
example2_zh: 对居住在大城市的年轻人来说，住房形势已变得日益严峻。
collocations: a difficult situation｜困境 ; the current situation｜当前形势 ; deal with a situation｜应对某种情况
tip_zh: 表示处于某种情况，用in a situation。

meanings_zh: adj. 粗心的；不小心的
definition_en: Not giving enough attention to avoid mistakes or damage.
example1_en: I was careless and left my keys in the door.
example1_zh: 我一时粗心，把钥匙留在了门上。
example2_en: Careless disposal of household waste can pollute local waterways and create serious risks for wildlife.
example2_zh: 随意丢弃生活垃圾会污染当地水道，并给野生动物带来严重风险。
collocations: a careless mistake｜粗心造成的错误 ; careless driving｜疏忽驾驶 ; careless with money｜花钱不谨慎
tip_zh: careless是粗心的；carefree才是无忧无虑的。

meanings_zh: n. 照片
definition_en: A picture made using a camera.
example1_en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
example1_zh: 我们在那座老桥旁拍了张照片。
example2_en: Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
example2_zh: 历史照片为研究城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵证据。
collocations: take a photo｜拍照 ; a family photo｜全家福 ; a photo album｜相册 ; a photo of｜一张……的照片
tip_zh: photo是photograph的常用简称；复数为photos。

meanings_zh: phr. 起初；一开始
definition_en: in the beginning, before later
example1_en: At first, the maths problem seemed difficult.
example1_zh: 起初这道数学题看起来很难。
example2_en: At first I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
example2_zh: 一开始我不喜欢这座城市，现在我很喜欢。
tip_zh: at first 表示“最初”，常与 later/now 形成对比。

meanings_zh: n. 警探；私人侦探
definition_en: Someone whose job is to investigate crimes or discover facts
example1_en: The detective found a muddy footprint beside the window.
example1_zh: 警探在窗边发现了一个带泥的脚印。
example2_en: Modern detectives increasingly rely on digital evidence, which raises important questions about privacy and data protection.
example2_zh: 现代警探越来越依赖数字证据，这引发了有关隐私和数据保护的重要问题。
collocations: private detective｜私人侦探 ; detective work｜侦查工作 ; detective novel｜侦探小说
tip_zh: detective novel中detective作名词定语。

meanings_zh: n. 火箭 | v. 飞涨；迅速上升
definition_en: A vehicle driven forward by powerful gases, often into space | Rise or increase very quickly
example1_en: We watched the rocket rise above the clouds.
example1_zh: 我们看着火箭升到云层上方。
example2_en: As housing demand continues to grow, rents may rocket in cities with limited space for new development.
example2_zh: 随着住房需求持续增长，新开发空间有限的城市可能出现租金飞涨。
collocations: launch a rocket｜发射火箭 ; rocket engine｜火箭发动机 ; prices rocket｜价格飞涨
tip_zh: 作动词常描述价格等猛涨，比increase语气更强。

meanings_zh: v. 暂停；停顿 | n. 暂停；停顿
definition_en: to stop briefly before continuing | a short break in an activity or speech
example1_en: She paused at the door to check her bag.
example1_zh: 她在门口停下来检查了一下包。
example2_en: Teachers should pause after asking questions to give students enough time to develop their answers.
example2_zh: 教师提问后应稍作停顿，让学生有足够的时间组织答案。
collocations: pause for a moment｜稍停片刻 ; a brief pause｜短暂停顿 ; pause a video｜暂停视频
tip_zh: pause指暂时停下，通常暗示还会继续。

meanings_zh: n. 文学；文学作品 | n. 文献；资料
definition_en: Written works valued for their artistic qualities. | Written material about a particular subject.
example1_en: My sister studies literature and always recommends wonderful novels.
example1_zh: 我姐姐学文学，总能推荐很棒的小说。
example2_en: A review of the scientific literature suggests that regular exercise can improve mental health.
example2_zh: 对科学文献的综述表明，经常运动可以改善心理健康。
collocations: English literature｜英国文学；英语文学 ; scientific literature｜科学文献 ; literature review｜文献综述 ; children's literature｜儿童文学
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示多篇文献时也不用加s。

meanings_zh: n. 厢式货车；面包车
definition_en: A covered vehicle used to carry goods or people.
example1_en: We loaded the boxes into a small white van.
example1_zh: 我们把箱子装进了一辆白色的小型厢式货车。
example2_en: Replacing diesel delivery vans with electric vehicles could help reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 用电动车替换柴油送货车，有助于减少人口密集城市的空气污染。
collocations: delivery van｜送货车 ; hire a van｜租一辆厢式货车 ; load a van｜往厢式货车上装货
tip_zh: 常指载货的封闭式车辆；不要与敞篷货车混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 翻译 | n. 译文；译本
definition_en: The process of expressing meaning in another language. | A spoken or written version in another language.
example1_en: This translation of the story is easy to understand.
example1_zh: 这个故事的译文很容易理解。
example2_en: Accurate translation allows researchers from different countries to share findings and collaborate more effectively.
example2_zh: 准确的翻译使不同国家的研究人员能够分享研究结果，并更有效地合作。
collocations: accurate translation｜准确的翻译 ; machine translation｜机器翻译 ; literal translation｜直译 ; translation into English｜译成英语
tip_zh: 翻译成某语言用into；从某语言翻译用from。

meanings_zh: adj. 不太可能的 | adj. 出人意料的；非典型的
definition_en: Not expected to happen or be true. | Surprising because someone or something does not seem suitable.
example1_en: With such dark clouds, sunshine seems unlikely this afternoon.
example1_zh: 云层这么黑，今天下午看来不太可能有阳光。
example2_en: Public transport use is unlikely to increase unless services become more reliable and affordable.
example2_zh: 除非服务变得更可靠、票价更实惠，否则公共交通的使用量不太可能增加。
collocations: unlikely to happen｜不太可能发生 ; highly unlikely｜极不可能的 ; an unlikely friendship｜出人意料的友谊
tip_zh: 常用be unlikely to do或It is unlikely that。

meanings_zh: n. 汽车挡风玻璃
definition_en: The front window of a car or other vehicle.
example1_en: Heavy rain splashed against the windscreen throughout our journey.
example1_zh: 一路上，大雨不断拍打着汽车的挡风玻璃。
example2_en: A damaged windscreen can reduce visibility, so regular vehicle inspections are essential for maintaining road safety.
example2_zh: 受损的挡风玻璃会影响视野，因此定期检查车辆对维护道路安全至关重要。
collocations: windscreen wipers｜挡风玻璃雨刷 ; cracked windscreen｜开裂的挡风玻璃 ; heated windscreen｜加热式挡风玻璃
tip_zh: 英式英语用windscreen，美式英语通常用windshield。

meanings_zh: n. 笔迹；手写字
definition_en: The particular way someone forms words when writing by hand.
example1_en: Your handwriting is much neater with this new pen.
example1_zh: 你用这支新笔写的字工整多了。
example2_en: Although digital devices are common in classrooms, clear handwriting remains useful for examinations and personal communication.
example2_zh: 虽然数字设备在课堂上很常见，但清晰的手写字在考试和个人交流中仍然有用。
collocations: neat handwriting｜工整的笔迹 ; illegible handwriting｜难以辨认的笔迹 ; improve your handwriting｜改善书写
tip_zh: 通常不可数；优美书法这门艺术用calligraphy。

meanings_zh: phr v. 分手；分开
definition_en: to end a relationship, or to divide
example1_en: They split up after five years.
example1_zh: 他们五年后分手了。
example2_en: Let's split up and search the park.
example2_zh: 我们分开搜索公园吧。
tip_zh: split up 表示“分手/分开”。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性 | n. 可考虑的选择；可能的事
definition_en: the chance that something might happen or be true | something that might happen or could be chosen
example1_en: There is a possibility of snow later tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚晚些时候可能会下雪。
